p-001.title: Amandla okufudumeza ifleksi
p-001.summary: Ukuba uthulule amanzi ashushu kuqala ukuze ufudumeze ifleksi, isiselo sihlala sifudumele ixesha elide kakhulu.
p-001.principle: Ukulahleka kobushushu kwenzeka ngokuhanjiswa, ngokuhamba komoya nangemitha; umgangatho we-vacuum unciphisa ukuhanjiswa nokuhamba komoya, odongeni olufakwe isilivere lunciphisa imitha. Ubushushu obungaka-$Q = mc\Delta T$ busetyenziswa kuqala ukufudumeza udonga lwesikhongozeli.
p-001.example: Ukufudumeza udonga lwentsimbi engenatsimbi ye-500mL yefleksi (malunga ne-200g, $c\approx0.5\ \mathrm{J/g\cdot K}$) ukusuka kwi-20°C ukuya kwi-90°C kufuna malunga ne-7kJ. Ukuba awufudumezi kuqala, isiselo sinikela olu bushushu size sipholile malunga ne-3~4°C ngoko nangoko.
p-001.actionItem: Kule ntsasa, zalisa ifleksi ngamanzi abilayo, uyiyeke imizuzu emi-3, uyitshise, uze ufake isiselo.

p-002.title: Poza ukutya okushushu ngaphambi kwefriji
p-002.summary: Ukufaka isobho eshushu ngqo efrijini kufudumeza nokunye ukutya kwaye kusebenzisa umbane ongakumbi.
p-002.principle: Ifriji kufuneka ikhuphe ubushushu obungenayo $Q = mc\Delta T$ ngekhompresa. Izitya ezingenzulu ezibanzi zinomphezulu omkhulu zipholile ngokukhawuleza ngakumbi $P = hA\Delta T$.
p-002.example: Ukupholisa isobho ye-3L (80°C) ukuya kwi-5°C kwenza ifriji ithwale malunga ne-$3000\times4.18\times75\approx940\ \mathrm{kJ}$. Ukuyipholisa kuqala ekubeni kwiqondo lobushushu legumbi ukuya kwi-40°C kususa phantse isiqingatha salo mthwalo.
p-002.actionItem: Namhla, wahlule ukutya okuvuthiweyo kube ziitya ezingenzulu, ukupholise ude ufike kwi-30~40°C, uze ukubeke efrijini ngaphakathi kweeyure ezi-2.

p-003.title: Ukugquma iifestile ngeplastiki yeebhubhu
p-003.summary: Ukunamathisela iplastiki yeebhubhu efestileni kwenza umgangatho womoya ongashukumiyo unciphise kakhulu ukulahleka kobushushu.
p-003.principle: Ukuhanjiswa kobushushu komoya ongashukumiyo kungange-$0.026\ \mathrm{W/m\cdot K}$, okuyi-1/40 yeglasi ($1.0$). Ukulahleka kobushushu $Q = UA\Delta T$ kunciphisa $U$.
p-003.example: Ifestile enye ye-2 $\mathrm{m^2}$, ngomahluko wobushushu phakathi nangaphandle we-20°C, $U\approx5.8$ ilahlekelwa yi-232W. Ukuba iplastiki yeebhubhu yehlisa oku $U\approx3.5$ kube yi-140W, uhlawula malunga ne-90W.
p-003.actionItem: Namhla, fafaza amanzi ngokwesayizi sefestile uze unamathisele icala elilulamileyo leplastiki yeebhubhu kuglasi.

p-004.title: Ingubo yombane okanye ibhoyila
p-004.summary: Xa ukuyedwa, ingubo yombane efudumeza kuphela ukuzunguleka komzimba isebenza ngcono kunokufudumeza igumbi lonke.
p-004.principle: Amandla okufudumeza alingana $E = Pt$ nobungakanani bendawo ekufuneka ifudunyezwe. Ukuba ufudumeza kuphela umthamo omncinci phakathi komzimba nengubo, ubushushu obufunekayo bucuthene.
p-004.example: Ingubo yombane ye-50W isetyenziswe iiyure ezi-8 yi-0.4kWh. Ukufudumeza igumbi lonke elinokufudumeza kwe-4kW iiyure ezi-8 kufikelela kwi-32kWh, umahluko wamaxesha amaninzi.
p-004.actionItem: Ngobu busuku, yehlise useto lwebhoyila nge-1~2°C uze uvule ingubo yombane kubushushu obuphantsi.

p-005.title: Ukugcina isitya sertyisi sishushu okanye ukuqhwaba ngamacandelo
p-005.summary: Ukwahlula irayisi ibe ziingxenye uyiqhwabe uze uyifudumeze kwakhona kusebenzisa umbane ongaphantsi kunokulishiya isitya sertyisi kwimo yokugcina ubushushu ngaphezu kweeyure ezili-12.
p-005.principle: Ukugcina ubushushu kufuna ukuxhasa rhoqo ukulahleka kobushushu $P = UA\Delta T$ ngodonga. Ukufudumeza kwakhona nge-microwave kusebenzisa $E = Pt$ kuphela xa kufuneka.
p-005.example: Ukugcina ubushushu kwe-60W malunga neeyure ezingama-24 kuyi-1.44kWh. Ukufudumeza kwakhona isitya esinye (200g) nge-700W imizuzu emi-2 kuyi-0.023kWh malunga.
p-005.actionItem: Namhla, songa irayisi eseleyo ibe sisitya ngasinye nge-plastiki uyiqhwabe, uze ucime iqhosha lokugcina ubushushu.

p-006.title: Ibhetri yefowuni ebandle
p-006.summary: Xa ifowuni icima ngequbuliso kwiqondo elingaphantsi kwe-0, kungenxa yokuba iimpendulo zekhemikhali ngaphakathi kwebhetri ziyacotha.
p-006.principle: Isantya sentshukumo ye-ion silandela $k = Ae^{-E_a/RT}$ ye-Arrhenius, siyehla kakhulu njengoko ubushushu buphantsi, kwaye ukuxhathisa kwangaphakathi kuyonyuka ngoko umbane uyehla.
p-006.example: Ibhetri ye-lithium-ion inokwehla kubuchule obusetyenziswayo bube yi-70~80% kwi-0°C, nangaphantsi kuloo nto kwi--10°C. Ifowuni eyayiyi-100% ingabonakala ibe yi-30% ngaphandle ize icime.
p-006.actionItem: Xa uphuma, faka ifowuni epokothweni yangaphakathi, kwaye ukuba icimile, yifudumeze ngomzimba wakho uze uyivule kwakhona.

p-007.title: Ukukhangela ibhetri yemoto ebusika ngaphambi kokuqala ngeekhebula
p-007.summary: Isizathu sokuba imoto ingaqali kwiqondo elingaphantsi kwe-0 kukuba amandla ebhetri ayehla kwaye ioli yenjini iba nzima.
p-007.principle: Amandla ebhetri ngu-$P = V I$ kwaye ebusika ukuxhathisa kwangaphakathi $r$ kuyonyuka, kwaye umbane wesiphelo $V = \varepsilon - Ir$ uyehla.
p-007.example: Kumbane wokuqala we-400A, ukuba ukuxhathisa kwangaphakathi kunyuka ukusuka kwi-0.01Ω ukuya kwi-0.02Ω, ukwehla kombane kunyuka ukusuka kwi-4V ukuya kwi-8V, kwaye kunzima ukuqalisa ngebhetri ye-12V.
p-007.actionItem: Namhla, cima iilambu zangaphambili nesifudumezi uze uqale imoto, kwaye ukuba ibhetri iphelelwe ziminyaka emi-3 yenze ihlolwe.

p-008.title: Indlela yokuhamba kumkhenkce
p-008.summary: Ekhenkceni, ukunciphisa ubude bamanyathelo nokunyathela unyawo lonke ngokuthe tyaba yindlela yokusebenzisa ukungqubana ngokugqibeleleyo.
p-008.principle: Imeko yokungatyibilizi ngamandla athe tye $F \le \mu N$. Ekhenkceni $\mu\approx0.05\text{-}0.1$ yi-1/10 malunga ye-asphalt eyomileyo ($\approx0.7$).
p-008.example: Ekuhambeni, xa umlinganiselo wecandelo elithe tye lonyawo lwangaphambili kumandla athe nkqo $\tan\theta$ odlula $\mu$, uyatyibilika. Ukunciphisa ubude bamanyathelo ube sisiqingatha kwenza $\theta$ abe mncinci uze ungene kwindawo ekhuselekileyo.
p-008.actionItem: Namhla, ngosuku lekhephu, wenze amanyathelo abe sisiqingatha sesiqhelo uze ukhuphe izandla ezipokothweni.

p-009.title: Ukushiya iziko le-microwave lingenanto embindini
p-009.summary: Ukubeka ukutya ngohlobo lwedonati ngasemaphethelweni kwenza i-microwave ifudumeze ngokulinganayo ngakumbi.
p-009.principle: I-microwave ifudumeza ngamaza amiyo e-2.45GHz, kwaye ngokobude bamaza $\lambda = c/f \approx 12.2\ \mathrm{cm}$ kubakho amanqaku ashushu namanqaku abandayo.
p-009.example: Iziko lesitya liyaqhelela ukuba libande kuba imitha ibuthathaka. Ukubeka ukutya ngaphandle ngasemaphethelweni uze ugxobhoze kanye embindini kunokunciphisa umahluko wobushushu ngaphezu kwe-20°C.
p-009.actionItem: Namhla, ukutya ofuna ukukufudumeza, shiya umbindi ungenanto, ukubeke ngasemaphethelweni uze ugxobhoze kanye kwisiqingatha sexesha.

p-010.title: Ukubilisa ngesigqubuthelo
p-010.summary: Ukugquma nje ibhodlo kuyayehlisa kakhulu iindleko zegesi.
p-010.principle: Xa amanzi etshatyalaliswa ngomphunga, kuphuma ubushushu bomphunga $L \approx 2260\ \mathrm{J/g}$. Isigqubuthelo sithintela ukulahleka komphunga nokuhamba komoya, ngoko ubilisa ngokukhawuleza ngobushushu obufanayo.
p-010.example: Ukufudumeza amanzi e-1L ukusuka kwi-20°C ukuya kwi-100°C kufuna $Q = 1000\times4.18\times80\approx334\ \mathrm{kJ}$. Ukugquma kudla ngokunciphisa ixesha negesi ngama-20~30%.
p-010.actionItem: Namhla, xa ubilisa ii-noodles nesobho, gquma ibhodlo ukususela ekuqaleni.

p-011.title: Zalisa ifriza, ushiye ifriji ingenanto
p-011.summary: Xa ifriza izele, ubushushu abunyuki kangako nokuba uvula ucango, kodwa ifriji kufuneka umoya ujikeleze.
p-011.principle: Amandla okugcina ubushushu $C = mc$ eqhwa nokutya okukhulu agcina ukubanda kwaye anciphisa utshintsho lobushushu $\Delta T = Q/C$. Ifriji ifuna ukujikeleza komoya obandayo.
p-011.example: Ukuvula ucango imizuzwana eli-10 kutshintsha malunga nama-100L omoya wefriza kwaye indawo engenanto inyuka malunga nge-5°C, kodwa kwifriza ezeleyo ukutya kuyalinganisa kwaye ukubuya kwiqondo kukhawuleza kakhulu.
p-011.actionItem: Namhla, khenkceza iibhotile zamanzi ezimbalwa uzibeke kwiindawo ezingenanto zefriza.

p-012.title: Isiboniso emva kwe-radiator
p-012.summary: Ukunamathisela i-aluminium foil eludongeni olungasemva kwe-radiator kubuyisela ubushushu ngaphakathi egumbini.
p-012.principle: Ubushushu bemitha bu-$P = \varepsilon\sigma A T^4$ kwaye i-aluminium ecwebileyo inesikhuphi esiphantsi nesikhanyiso esiphezulu, ngoko ibonisa ii-infrared ngakwigumbi.
p-012.example: Inxalenye yobushushu be-radiator ejongene nodonga lwangaphandle iyafunxwa ludonga. Ukuba isiboniso siyibuyisela, ngokufudumeza okufanayo ukulahleka kobushushu ngakudonga kuyancipha igumbi lifudumale ngokukhawuleza.
p-012.actionItem: Namhla, namathisela isiboniso se-foil esishinyeneyo emva kwe-radiator ecaleni kodonga lwangaphandle.

p-013.title: Ukuzingela umbane wokulinda
p-013.summary: Izixhobo ezibonakala zicinyiwe kodwa zisafakwe kwi-plug zisadla umbane.
p-013.principle: Amandla ngu-$E = Pt$. Ukulinda kwe-5W kubonakala kuncinci kodwa kuyaqokelela ngeeyure ezingama-24 ngosuku, ezingama-8760 ngonyaka.
p-013.example: Ukulinda ngokuthotyelwa kwe-20W yi-$0.02\times8760 \approx 175\ \mathrm{kWh}$, kwaye ngama-200 amawon ngekWh, yi-35,000 yawon ngonyaka.
p-013.actionItem: Namhla, qhagamshela i-TV, i-set-top box nabatshaji kwi-multi-plug enesiswitshi uze uzicime ngaphambi kokulala.

p-014.title: Ukwehlisa ukufudumeza nge-1°C
p-014.summary: Nokuba wehlisa ubushushu begumbi nge-1°C kuphela, amandla okufudumeza ayancipha ngokubonakalayo.
p-014.principle: Ukulahleka kobushushu kuyi-$Q = UA\Delta T$ kwaye kulingana nomahluko wobushushu phakathi nangaphandle $\Delta T$.
p-014.example: Xa ubushushu bangaphandle bu-0°C, ukwehlisa ngaphakathi ukusuka kwi-22°C ukuya kwi-21°C kwenza $\Delta T$ yehle ukusuka kwi-22 ukuya kwi-21 malunga nge-4.5%, ngoko amandla okufudumeza ancipha malunga nalo mlinganiselo.
p-014.actionItem: Namhla, yehlise useto lokufudumeza nge-1°C uze unxibe ikhadigan.

p-015.title: Ubude bamakhethini nokulahleka kobushushu efestileni
p-015.summary: Ikhethini eshinyeneyo efika emgangathweni ithintela ukujikeleza komoya obandayo ecaleni kwefestile.
p-015.principle: Umoya ocaleni kweglasi ebandayo uzele ngakumbi uyehla ngaphantsi, kwenza ukuhamba komoya. Ikhethini yehlisa ukulahleka kobushushu $Q = hA\Delta T$ ngokwehlisa i-coefficient yokuhamba komoya $h$.
p-015.example: Ukuvala ikhethini eshinyeneyo ukusuka kwisakhelo sefestile ukuya emgangathweni kudla ngokunciphisa ukulahleka kobushushu efestileni nge-10~25%. Ukuba kukho izikhewu, umoya obandayo uyabaleka njengentsimbi yomsi.
p-015.actionItem: Ebusuku obu, xa ilanga lidinga, vala amakhethini ngokupheleleyo uze ubone ukuba umphetho ongezantsi ufikelela emgangathweni.

p-016.title: Ukuvala umoya ongena emnyango
p-016.summary: Isikhewu somnyango esingu-1mm sidla iindleko zokufudumeza ebusika.
p-016.principle: Umoya ongena ngesikhewu kufuneka ufudunyezwe ngomlinganiselo womthamo $\dot V$ kwaye $P = \rho c \dot V \Delta T$. Umoya $\rho c \approx 1.2\ \mathrm{kJ/m^3K}$.
p-016.example: Umoya ongena ngezikhewu we-20 $\mathrm{m^3/h}$, $\Delta T=20$°C yi-$P \approx 1.2\times20\times20/3.6\approx133\ \mathrm{W}$. Ukuvala isiqingatha ngetheyiphu yomnyango kusindisa malunga nama-66W.
p-016.actionItem: Namhla, namathisela itheyiphu yomnyango kwisikhewu esingezantsi komnyango nasemaphethelweni efestile.

p-017.title: Uxinzelelo lomoya wamathayara ebusika
p-017.summary: Xa ubushushu buyehla, uxinzelelo lomoya wamathayara luyehla kunye nabo.
p-017.principle: Kwigesi efanelekileyo enomthamo ongatshintshiyo $P/T = \text{const}$. Xa ubushushu obupheleleyo $T$ buyehla, uxinzelelo $P$ luyehla ngokulinganayo.
p-017.example: Ithayara eyi-35psi kwi-20°C (293K) kwi--10°C (263K) iba $35\times263/293\approx31.4\ \mathrm{psi}$, yehla malunga ne-3.6psi.
p-017.actionItem: Kule ntsasa, linganisa uxinzelelo lomoya kwithayara ebandayo uze uzalise ude ufike kwixabiso elicetyiswayo.

p-018.title: Isizathu sokuba iimitten zifudumele ngakumbi
p-018.summary: Iimitten ezinweleni zeminwe ezinamathele ndawonye zifudumele ngakumbi kunamagilavu.
p-018.principle: Ukulahleka kobushushu kuyi-$Q = hA\Delta T$ kwaye kulingana nomphezulu ovuliweyo $A$. Ukuzibuthanisa iminwe kunciphisa umphezulu kwaye ihlanganyela ubushushu.
p-018.example: Iimitten zinomphezulu ovuliweyo omncinci ngama-20~30% kunamagilavu agquma iminwe emihlanu ngokwahlukeneyo, ngoko kunye nokufanayo kokufakwa, ukulahleka kobushushu kuyancipha ngokulinganayo.
p-018.actionItem: Namhla, ngosuku olubanda kakhulu, nxiba iimitten phezu kwamagilavu.

p-019.title: Umoya phakathi kwemigangatho yeempahla
p-019.summary: Iimpahla ezincinci ezininzi zinokufudumala ngakumbi kunemvunulo enye eshinyeneyo.
p-019.principle: Umoya ongashukumiyo phakathi kweempahla unika ukugquma. Ukuxhathisa ubushushu ngokupheleleyo $R = \sum d_i/k_i$ kuyanda njengoko imigangatho inyuka.
p-019.example: Umgangatho omnye womoya ongashukumiyo oshinyene ngo-5mm wongeza $R = 0.005/0.026\approx0.19\ \mathrm{m^2K/W}$. Ukuba ushushu, khupha umgangatho omnye ukuthintela ukupholisa ngokuhamba kwezithukuthuku.
p-019.actionItem: Namhla, xa uphuma, zama ukunxiba imigangatho emi-3 ngokulandelelana: impahla yangaphantsi enoboya, ihempe, ingubo ekhuselayo emoyeni.

p-020.title: Ukomisa impahla ngaphakathi nokuvula umoya
p-020.summary: Impahla ngaphakathi yomile ngokukhawuleza ngakumbi ukuba uyinikela umgama nokuvula umoya okanye usebenzise idehumidifier.
p-020.principle: Isantya sokutshatyalaliswa ngumphunga sicutshungulwa $\dot m \propto A(p_s - p_a)$ kwaye silingana nomphezulu nomahluko wobunzima bomphunga.
p-020.example: Xa malunga nama-500g amanzi kwi-1kg yempahla emanzi etshatyalalisiwe ngomphunga, ithabatha malunga ne-$500\times2.26\approx1130\ \mathrm{kJ}$. Ukwandisa umgama kunokunciphisa ukomisa phantse ube sisiqingatha sexesha.
p-020.actionItem: Namhla, xanela impahla ushiye indawo phakathi kwayo uze uvule umpha ngokuthambileyo.

p-021.title: Ukuthintela ukwaphuka kweglasi eshushu
p-021.summary: Ukuthulula amanzi ashushu ngequbuliso kwiglasi kunokuyophula.
p-021.principle: Umahluko wobushushu wenza ukwandiswa okwahlukileyo, kudala uxinzelelo lobushushu $\sigma = E\alpha\Delta T$. Iglasi eqhelekileyo ye-soda-lime ayinakumelana kakuhle noko.
p-021.actionItem: Namhla, kwiglasi ebandayo, yifudumeze kuqala ngamanzi afudumele uze uthulule isiselo esishushu.

p-022.title: Ukulungisa isiseko sebhodlo kwi-induction
p-022.summary: I-induction isebenza ngcono xa isiseko sebhodlo sithe tye kwaye sifanelekile ngobungakanani.
p-022.principle: Ukufudumeza nge-induction kwenza ubushushu be-$P = I^2R$ buvele ngqo kwisiseko sebhodlo ngee-eddy currents. Kufuneka iqulethe izinto zemagnethi, kwaye ukudibana okungcono kwenza ukusebenza kakuhle.
p-022.example: Ukuba ububanzi bebhodlo buncinci kakhulu kunebhobhini, ubushushu buyancipha kwaye kuthatha ixesha elide. Ukusebenza kakuhle kungama-85~90%, ngaphezulu kwegesi (malunga nama-40~50%).
p-022.actionItem: Namhla, tyela imagnethi kwisiseko sebhodlo ukubona ukuba inamathela na.

p-023.title: Ukusebenzisa ukuhamba komoya kwi-air fryer
p-023.summary: I-air fryer iba crispy xa ushiya indawo phakathi kokutya.
p-023.principle: Ukuhamba komoya okunyanzelweyo okujikelezisa umoya oshushu ngokukhawuleza $Q = hA\Delta T$ kwenza $h$ kube kukhulu. Ukubeka ukutya phezu kwesinye kunciphisa $A$ ofikelelwa ngumoya.
p-023.example: Ukuhamba komoya kwi-oven $h\approx10\ \mathrm{W/m^2K}$, kwi-fan $h\approx30\text{-}50$ kukhawuleza ngamaxesha angama-3~5. Ukusasaza kwimigangatho emnye kunciphisa imizuzu eyi-10 ngamanye amaxesha.
p-023.actionItem: Namhla, sasaza ukutya kwisitya se-air fryer kumgangatho omnye ngaphandle kokuwubeka phezu komnye.

p-024.title: Ukucoca isihluzi se-dryer
p-024.summary: Ukukhupha ulusu kwisihluzi se-dryer kunciphisa ixesha lokomisa.
p-024.principle: Xa isihluzi sivaliwe, ukuhamba komoya $\dot V$ kuyancipha nesantya sokususa ukufuma $\dot m = \dot V\Delta\omega\rho$ siyehla.
p-024.example: Isihluzi esivaliweyo sinokongeza ama-20~30% exesha lokomisa. Xa imizuzu engama-80 iba ngama-100, ibhetri eyongezelelweyo ye-0.4kWh (ngokwe-2kW) iyadingeka.
p-024.actionItem: Namhla, vula isihluzi se-dryer uze ukhuphe ulusu.

p-025.title: Ukunciphisa ugesi otshixayo ebusika
p-025.summary: Ukuthi tsho kwindlela yomnyango ebusika kubangelwa kukuba kumoya owomileyo ubuncinci bayo abunakubaleka.
p-025.principle: Ibhatyi $Q$ eqokelelwe kukuxubha injani njenge-capacitor $V = Q/C$ umbane uyanda, kwaye xa umoya womile ukukhutshwa kuyacotha, kufikelela kumawaka e-V.
p-025.example: Umzimba womntu $C\approx100\ \mathrm{pF}$ kwi $Q=0.3\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ yi $V = 3000\ \mathrm{V}$. Ukunyusa ukufuma ukuya ngaphezu kwe-40% kwenza ibhatyi ibaleke kancinci kancinci.
p-025.actionItem: Namhla, phambi kokubamba isibambo somnyango, cofa isitshixo okanye udonga kuqala ukukhupha umbane.

p-026.title: Ukuthintela ukuthwala kakhulu kwe-multi-plug
p-026.summary: Ukufaka izifudumezi ezininzi ezinkulu kwi-multi-plug kunobungozi bomlilo ngenxa yokushisa.
p-026.principle: Amandla $P = VI$, ngoko kwi-220V $I = P/V$ kwaye ukushisa $P_\text{heat} = I^2R$ kulingana nesikwere samandla ombane.
p-026.example: Isifudumezi se-1500W + ikettle yombane ye-1000W $2500/220\approx11.4\ \mathrm{A}$ idlula i-multi-plug eqhelekileyo ye-10A. Nokuba ugesi unyuka nge-10% kuphela, ukushisa kunyuka nge-21%.
p-026.actionItem: Namhla, jonga irethingi ye-multi-plug (umz. 10A) uze ufake izifudumezi ngqo kwisokethi yodonga.

p-027.title: Ukutshaja ibhetri ukusuka kwi-20 ukuya kwi-80%
p-027.summary: Ukusebenzisa ifowuni phakathi kwe-20~80% kwandisa ubomi bebhetri.
p-027.principle: Umbane ophezulu wokutshaja ukhawulezisa ukuqhawuka kwe-electrolyte. Isantya sokonakala sinovakalelo kubushushu $k\propto e^{-E_a/RT}$.
p-027.example: Ukuphepha ukutshaja kwi-100% nokuvezwa ebushushini kuxelwa ukuba kunokongeza amakhulu ambalwa ezijikelezo kwiicycle ezimalunga nama-500 zokugcina ubuchule be-80%.
p-027.actionItem: Namhla, vula u'Optimized Charging' okanye umda we-80% kwifowuni yakho.

p-028.title: Kuyasindisa kangakanani ukutshintshela kwi-LED
p-028.summary: Nokuba ibhalbhu inika ukukhanya okufanayo, i-LED isebenzisa umbane omncinci kakhulu.
p-028.principle: Siqhathanisa ngokusebenza kokukhanya $\eta = \Phi/P$ (lm/W). I-incandescent malunga ne-13 lm/W, i-LED malunga ne-100 lm/W okanye ngaphezulu.
p-028.example: Ibhalbhu ye-800 lm yi-60W ye-incandescent, i-8W ye-LED. Ngeeyure ezi-5 ngosuku, usindisa $0.052\times5\times365\approx95\ \mathrm{kWh}$ ngonyaka.
p-028.actionItem: Namhla, tshintsha ibhalbhu enye kwigumbi elisebenza ixesha elide kwi-LED.

p-029.title: Isizathu sokuba isibambo sentsimbi sibande ngakumbi
p-029.summary: Nangona kukho ubushushu obufanayo, intsimbi iviwa ibanda kakhulu kunomthi.
p-029.principle: Ukuhamba kobushushu ekudibaneni kulingana ne-effusivity yobushushu $e = \sqrt{k\rho c}$. Xa ubushushu bubaleka ngokukhawuleza, siva ukuba kuyabanda.
p-029.example: Intsimbi $e\approx10{,}000\text{-}20{,}000$, umthi $e\approx400$ (SI) umahluko wamaxesha amashumi. Nakwi-0°C efanayo, intsimbi iviwa ibanda kakhulu.
p-029.actionItem: Namhla, xa uphuma ebusika, bamba izibambo zentsimbi unxibe iiglavu okanye uzigqume ngelaphu.

p-030.title: Indlela yokuthintela imibhobho yamanzi ukuba iqhwaze
p-030.summary: Xa ubushushu buwela ngaphantsi kwe-0, amanzi emibhobho aqaqamba andise umthamo, kwaye umbhobho unokuqhuma.
p-030.principle: Xa amanzi eqhwaba, umthamo unyuka malunga ne-9%. Kumbhobho ovaliweyo uxinzelelo lunyuka kakhulu, $\Delta P = K\Delta V/V$ umbhobho wophuka.
p-030.example: Xa kubalwa nge-bulk modulus $K\approx2\ \mathrm{GPa}$, ngokwethiyori ifikelela kumakhulu e-MPa kwaye iqhuma. Amanzi aqhubekayo ukuhamba anzima ukuqhwaba.
p-030.actionItem: Namhla, ukuba kuxelwe ubushushu obungaphantsi kwe-0, vula ithepu ngokuncinane kakhulu uze ugqume imitha ngesinyibilikisi.

p-031.title: Ukucima okanye ukushiya ukufudumeza xa uphuma
p-031.summary: Kuphuma okufutshane, gcina ukufudumeza; kuphuma ixesha elide, kungcono ukuwehlisa.
p-031.principle: Izinga lokulahleka kobushushu liyi-$P = UA(T_\text{in}-T_\text{out})$ kwaye ubushushu obuphantsi, kuncinci ukulahleka. Amandla okufudumeza kwakhona alingana namandla okugcina $C\Delta T$.
p-031.example: Ukuphuma iiyure ezili-12 kwehlisa igumbi ukusuka kwi-22°C ukuya kwi-17°C, ukulahleka kuyancipha malunga nama-25%, kwaye ubushushu bokufudumeza kwakhona bumncinci kunale nto, ngoko kuyingeniso. Kwiiyure ezi-2~3, ingeniso incinci.
p-031.actionItem: Namhla, xa uphuma iiyure ezi-6 okanye ngaphezulu, tshintshela kwimo yokuphuma, kwaye kwiimini ezimfutshane shiya njengoko injalo.

p-032.title: Umgama wokunqumama ekhephini
p-032.summary: Ekhephini, umgama wokunqumama wandiswa ngamaxesha aliqela xa kuthelekiswa nendlela eyomileyo.
p-032.principle: Umgama wokunqumama yi-$d = v^2/(2\mu g)$. Ulingana nesikwere sesantya kwaye uchaseneyo ne-coefficient yokungqubana.
p-032.example: Kwi-50km/h (13.9m/s) endleleni eyomileyo $\mu=0.7$ yi-$d\approx14\ \mathrm{m}$, ekhephini $\mu=0.2$ yi-$d\approx49\ \mathrm{m}$. Ukunciphisa isantya ukuya kwi-30km/h kuyi-18m malunga.
p-032.actionItem: Namhla, ekhephini, nciphisa isantya sibe sisiqingatha sesiqhelo uze wandise umgama phakathi kweemoto.

p-033.title: Ukukhusela ikhephu ukukhusela umqolo
p-033.summary: Xa ukhupha ikhephu, ukubamba isibambo sefosholo side uze usebenzise umzimba kunciphisa umthwalo emqolweni.
p-033.principle: I-torque ye-lever yi-$\tau = Fd$. Ukuba umthwalo ukude nomqolo, umzuzu emqolweni uba mkhulu.
p-033.example: Ukuba uphakamisa ikhephu eli-5kg ngengalo elolile kumgama we-0.6m ukusuka emqolweni, $\tau\approx5\times9.8\times0.6\approx29\ \mathrm{N\cdot m}$, kwaye xa ulibamba usondele emzimbeni nge-0.2m, malunga ne-10N·m, yi-1/3.
p-033.actionItem: Namhla, xa ukhupha ikhephu, phakamisa ngobunono rhoqo kufutshane nomzimba, usebenzise imilenze endaweni yomqolo.

p-034.title: Ukuvula isiciko sebhotile ngokulula
p-034.summary: Isiciko sebhotile esiqinileyo sivulwa ngokwandisa irediyasi yesandla ukwandisa i-torque.
p-034.principle: I-torque yi-$\tau = Fr$. Nangamandla afanayo, ukwandisa irediyasi $r$ kwenza i-torque inyuke ngokulinganayo.
p-034.example: Ngobubanzi besiciko be-3cm ($r=1.5\ \mathrm{cm}$) i-torque efunekayo i-3N·m yi-$F=200\ \mathrm{N}$. Ngesivuli $r=6\ \mathrm{cm}$ yi-$F=50\ \mathrm{N}$, i-1/4.
p-034.actionItem: Namhla, songa iglavu yerabha okanye ithawula esicikweni uze usibambe okanye usebenzise isixhobo sokuvula ibhotile.

p-035.title: Ngaphambi kokuthi uye phezu kwesitulo
p-035.summary: Xa uye phezu kwesitulo, iziko lobunzima kufuneka libe ngaphezu komphezulu wokumela ukuze ungawi.
p-035.principle: Into izinzile xa umgca othe nkqo weziko lobunzima ungaphakathi komphezulu wokumela. Umda wokuthambeka yi-$\tan\theta = b/h$.
p-035.example: Kwisiseko esine-$b=20\ \mathrm{cm}$ ububanzi, ukuba ukuphakama kweziko lobunzima lomntu yi-$h=100\ \mathrm{cm}$, ukuthambeka nge-$\theta=\arctan0.2\approx11^\circ$ kuphela kwenza awe.
p-035.actionItem: Namhla, kwiindawo eziphakamileyo, sebenzisa isitebhisi esizinzileyo endaweni yesitulo.

p-036.title: Isitebhisi nge-75 degrees
p-036.summary: Ukuba i-engile yesitebhisi ime nkqo kakhulu siwela ngasemva, ukuba silele sitshibilika.
p-036.principle: Imeko yokuba isitebhisi singatshibilika yi-$\tan\theta \ge 1/(2\mu)$ (ukungahoyi ukungqubana kodonga).
p-036.example: Kwiindawo ezingezantsi $\mu=0.4$ kwakhona $\tan\theta \ge 1.25$, oko kukuthi $\theta\ge51^\circ$. Umgangatho wokhuseleko ocetyiswayo ngama-75° (ukushiya ngezantsi umgama we-1/4 yobude).
p-036.actionItem: Namhla, misa isitebhisi ngokushiya umgama we-1/4 yobude baso ukusuka eludongeni ezantsi.

p-037.title: Umhlwa wesipili sasekhaya
p-037.summary: Isipili sebhafu siba mdaka emva kokuhlamba kuba umphunga uyaqhina ungaphantsi kweqondo lombethe.
p-037.principle: Ukuba ubushushu bomphezulu $T_d$ bungaphantsi kwe-dew point iyaqhina. Ulinganiselo $T_d \approx T - (100-RH)/5$.
p-037.example: Ibhafu ye-30°C, ukufuma kwe-90% yi-$T_d\approx28$°C. Ukuba isipili si-25°C siyaqhina. Ukwehlisa ukufuma kube yi-60% ngefeni, yi-$T_d\approx14$°C.
p-037.actionItem: Namhla, xa uhlamba, vula ifeni uze uyishiye imizuzu eli-10 emva kokugqiba.

p-038.title: Ungatsali ifenitshala enzima
p-038.summary: Ifenitshala enzima ilula ukuyisusa ngokuphakamisa icala elinye nokubeka ilaphu kunokuyisunduza.
p-038.principle: Ukungqubana okumileyo $f = \mu_s N$. Ukubeka ilaphu kunciphisa $\mu$ kwaye kuthintela umonakalo womgangatho.
p-038.example: Ikhabhathi ye-50kg, $\mu=0.5$ yi-$f=0.5\times50\times9.8\approx245\ \mathrm{N}$. Ngesivimbo sefenitshala $\mu=0.2$ iba yi-98N, inciphe nge-60%.
p-038.actionItem: Namhla, beka ifelt pad okanye ithawula phantsi kweenyawo zefenitshala uze uyisunduze.

p-039.title: Ukulinganisa amanzi ekettle yombane
p-039.summary: Ukubilisa kuphela okuya kuselwa kunciphisa umbane nexesha ngokulinganayo.
p-039.principle: Ubushushu bokubilisa yi-$Q = mc\Delta T$ kwaye bulingana nobunzima bamanzi $m$.
p-039.example: Ukubilisa i-1L ukusuka kwi-20°C ukuya kwi-100°C kuthatha i-334kJ ≈ 0.093kWh. Ikomityi enye (250mL) yi-0.023kWh, ikota yoko.
p-039.actionItem: Namhla, jonga imarko kwikomityi uze ubilise kuphela amanzi afunekayo.

p-040.title: Shiya umgama emva kwefriji
p-040.summary: Ukuba ifriji inamathele eludongeni, ubushushu abukhuphuki ngakumbi nombane ongakumbi uyadingeka.
p-040.principle: Ubushushu obukhutshwa yikhompresa bukhutshwa ngokuhamba komoya ngokwemvelo kwi-radiator engasemva. Xa ukujikeleza komoya $Q = hA\Delta T$ kuvaleka, $h$ kuyancipha.
p-040.example: Xa ukukhupha ubushushu kuvaleka kwaye ubushushu be-condenser buyonyuka nge-10°C, ukusebenza kakuhle (COP) kuyehla kwaye amandla asetyenzisiweyo anganyuka nge-10~15%. Ngokwe-400kWh ngonyaka, yi-40~60kWh.
p-040.actionItem: Namhla, shiya i-5~10cm ukusuka eludongeni emva nasecaleni kwefriji uze usule uthuli.

p-041.title: Ukunciphisa ukungcangcazela kwe-washing machine ngexesha lokuphotha
p-041.summary: Xa impahla yokuhlamba iya kwicala elinye, umshini wokuhlamba ungcangcazela kakhulu ngexesha lokuphotha.
p-041.principle: Xa ubunzima obungalinganiyo $m$ bujikeleza kwirediyasi $r$, kuvela amandla e-centrifugal $F = m\omega^2 r$ alingana nesikwere sesantya se-angular.
p-041.example: Kwi-1000 rpm ($\omega\approx105\ \mathrm{rad/s}$), ubunzima obungalinganiyo be-1kg, $r=0.2\ \mathrm{m}$ yi-$F\approx2200\ \mathrm{N}$. Ukuba ulinganisa, la mandla phantse apheliswa.
p-041.actionItem: Namhla, xa ufaka impahla enkulu efana neengubo, yongeze impahla encinci uze uzisasaze ngokulinganayo.

p-042.title: Ukubuyisela amandla okufunxa kwe-vacuum cleaner
p-042.summary: Ukukhupha isihluzi nesitya sothuli kwi-vacuum cleaner kubuyisela amandla okufunxa phantse njengasekuqaleni.
p-042.principle: Isiphumo somahluko wokufunxa uxinzelelo $\Delta P$ nokuhamba komoya $Q$ yi-$P = \Delta P\cdot Q$ amandla okufunxa. Xa kuvaleke, ukuhamba kuyancipha kakhulu.
p-042.example: Xa isihluzi sivaleke isiqingatha, ukuhamba kunokuncipha nge-30~50%. Nangemoto efanayo, amandla okufunxa uthuli ancipha ngokulinganayo, ixesha lokucoca liyonyuka.
p-042.actionItem: Namhla, khupha isitya sothuli kwi-vacuum cleaner uze unyakazise okanye uhlambe isihluzi uze usomise.

p-043.title: Ubushushu obufihlakeleyo bepakethe yeqhwa
p-043.summary: Ukugcina izinto zibanda, ukusebenzisa ubushushu obufihlakeleyo bokunyibilika kweqhwa yeyona ndlela isebenza kakuhle.
p-043.principle: Xa iqhwa linyibilika $Q = mL$ lifunxa ubushushu be-$L=334\ \mathrm{J/g}$ kwaye ubushushu bugcinwa kwi-0°C.
p-043.example: Ipakethe yeqhwa ye-500g ifunxa $500\times334\approx167\ \mathrm{kJ}$ ukunyibilika. Kuphindwe ka-16 ubushushu (10kJ) obunyusa amanzi alinganayo e-0°C nge-5°C.
p-043.actionItem: Namhla, xa uthenga, faka ipakethe yeqhwa uze ubeke ukutya okuqhwabileyo ekugqibeleni.

p-044.title: Umthwalo wekhephu ophezu kophahla
p-044.summary: Ikhephu elimanzi lisindiwe amaxesha ambalwa kunekhephu elomileyo, kwaye linokuwisa uphahla neendlu zeplastiki.
p-044.principle: Umthwalo $P = \rho g h$. Ikhephu elomileyo $\rho\approx100\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, ikhephu elimanzi $\rho\approx400\text{-}500$.
p-044.example: Ikhephu elimanzi eli-30cm ($\rho=400$) yi-$400\times9.8\times0.3\approx1180\ \mathrm{Pa}$ amaxesha ama-4 ikhephu elomileyo (malunga ne-300Pa).
p-044.actionItem: Namhla, xa kuna ikhephu elininzi, susa ikhephu phezu kweendlu zeplastiki nezinqunjana kwindawo ekhuselekileyo.

p-045.title: Ukusebenza kakuhle kokufudumeza nge-heat pump air conditioner
p-045.summary: Ukufudumeza nge-air conditioner kuvelisa ubushushu obuninzi ngombane ofanayo kunesifudumezi sombane.
p-045.principle: I-heat pump ihambisa ubushushu ngoko $\mathrm{COP} = Q_h/W$ mkhulu kuno-1. Isifudumezi sombane yi-$\mathrm{COP}=1$.
p-045.example: Ngo-COP 3, i-1kWh ivelisa i-3kWh yobushushu. Ukufudumeza kwe-3kW iiyure ezi-5 kuyi-15kWh ngesifudumezi sombane, i-5kWh nge-heat pump, kusindiswa i-10kWh.
p-045.actionItem: Namhla, endaweni yesifudumezi sombane, zama imo yokufudumeza ye-air conditioner kwi-20°C.

p-046.title: Isizathu sokuba iiglavu ezimanzi zibande ngakumbi
p-046.summary: Iiglavu ezimanzi zikhupha ubushushu ngokukhawuleza kakhulu kunezomileyo.
p-046.principle: Ukuhanjiswa kobushushu kwamanzi kungange-$0.6\ \mathrm{W/m\cdot K}$ malunga namaxesha angama-23 omoya ($0.026$), kwaye ubushushu bokutshatyalaliswa ngumphunga buyongezwa, $Q = kA\Delta T/d$ ukanti mkhulu.
p-046.example: Nangobubanzi obufanayo, ukulahleka kobushushu kweglavu ezele ngamanzi kuyonyuka ngamaxesha aliqela, izandla zibanda ngokukhawuleza. Ngokutshatyalaliswa ngumphunga okungu-1g ngamnye, i-2.26kJ ongezelelweyo iyaphuma.
p-046.actionItem: Namhla, yomisa iiglavu ezibambe ikhephu ngokukhawuleza uze ubeke ipari eyongezelelweyo.

p-047.title: I-icicles emaphethelweni ophahla luphawu lokuvuza kobushushu uye ophahleni
p-047.summary: Ikhephu ophahleni elinyibilika ukusuka ezantsi kwaye liqhwabe kwakhona emaphethelweni liyakwazi ukuba bubungqina bokuba ubushushu bangaphakathi buvuza uye ophahleni.
p-047.principle: Izinga lokulahleka kobushushu yi-$\dot Q=UA\,\Delta T$. Ukuba ukugquma kubi, $U$ kuyonyuka kwaye ubushushu bomphezulu wophahla bunyuka bungaphezu kwe-0°C ikhephu linyibilike.
p-047.example: Ophahleni lwe-100m², ukuba $U$ yehla ukusuka kwi-0.5 ukuya kwi-0.25 $\mathrm{W/(m^2\,K)}$, xa $\Delta T=20$ K, ilahleko yehla ukusuka kwi-$0.5\times100\times20=1{,}000$ W ukuya kwi-500W, isiqingatha.
p-047.actionItem: Namhla, jonga ukuba ikho na i-icicle emaphethelweni ophahla okanye kumphezulu webalkoni (ungemi ngezantsi), kwaye ukuba zininzi, khangela ukugquma kophahla okanye i-attic.

p-048.title: Umgangatho wesepha owanele ukuthintela ukufuma kwiiglasi zamehlo
p-048.summary: Nokuba unxibe imaski, iiglasi ziba mdaka kuba umphezulu welensi ubanda kunendawo yombethe yokuphefumula. Ukugquma ilensi ngomgangatho omncinci wesepha kwenza umgangatho ocacileyo wamanzi endaweni yamaconsi ukuze umbono ugcinwe.
p-048.principle: Xa ubushushu bomphezulu $T_s$ bungaphantsi kwe-dew point $T_d$, umphunga uyaqhina. I-surfactant yehlisa i-engile yoqhagamshelwano ukuze amaconsi amancinci asasazeke abe ngumgangatho ocacileyo.
p-048.example: I-dew point yokuphefumula kwe-34℃ nokufuma kwe-100% iyi-34℃, kodwa umphezulu welensi ungama-20℃, ngoko iyaqhina ngoko nangoko. Ukusasaza iconsi elinye lesepha engathathi hlangothi ngokuncinci kwilensi nokuyomisa kwenza amaconsi asasazeke kuyo yonke ilensi, ukufuma kuyancipha kakhulu.
p-048.actionItem: Namhla, sasaza iconsi elinye kuphela lesepha engathathi hlangothi kumacala omabini elensi, ungasusi, uyiyeke yomile ngokwemvelo, uze ucofe ucingo lwempumlo yemaski ukuze ukuphefumula kungabaleki phezulu.

p-049.title: Ukwahlula iiglasi zelanga ze-polarized zenyani
p-049.summary: Ukukhanya okubonakalayo okuvela emanzini nasezindleleni ezimanzi kuxhaphake ukuba kuphindwe ngokuthe tye, ngoko ilensi ye-polarized iyayihluza ukunciphisa ukukhanya okuhlaba amehlo nokudinwa kwamehlo. Ezingeyonyani zinokuba ziilensi ezimnyama kuphela ngombala, ngoko zijonge ngokwakho.
p-049.principle: Ubukhulu bokukhanya obudlula kwi-polarizer bulandela umthetho kaMalus $I=I_0\cos^2\theta$, kwaye ukubonakala kwamanzi kudla ngokuphela kwe-polarized ngokupheleleyo kufutshane ne-engile kaBrewster $\theta_B=\arctan(n)\approx 53^\circ$.
p-049.example: Xa uhlangothi lwe-polarization nomgca welensi $90^\circ$, $\cos^2 90^\circ=0$ ngoko ukukhanya okubonakalayo phantse kuvaliwe. Ngokuchaseneyo, ukubeka iilensi ezimbini $90^\circ$ kuyenza ibe mnyama, ngoko unokuqinisekisa ukuba iyinyani. Nokuba i-polarized, ukuvalwa kwe-UV (UV400) kwahlukile, ngoko jonga uphawu.
p-049.actionItem: Jonga isikrini sefowuni ngelensi, jikelezisa ilensi nge-$90^\circ$ ukujonga ukuba isikrini siba mnyama na, kwaye uhlole uphawu lwe-UV400.

p-050.title: Isizathu sokuba indlela ephezu kwebhulorho iqhwabe kuqala
p-050.summary: Ibhulorho iqhubana kuqala kunendlela eqhelekileyo kuba ucala lwayo lomibini lujongene nomoya obandayo, kwaye ukuba kwi-black ice engabonakali lula kuyaxhaphaka.
p-050.principle: Indlela ephezu komhlaba ifumana ubushushu obuvela emhlabeni bupholile kancinci, kodwa ibhulorho ine-moya nangezantsi, ngoko akukho ukulungiselelwa kobushushu. Umgama wokunqumama yi-$d=\dfrac{v^2}{2\mu g}$.
p-050.example: Kwi-50km/h ($v\approx13.9$ m/s) kwindlela eyomileyo $\mu\approx0.7$ yi-14m malunga, kumkhenkce $\mu\approx0.1$ yi-99m malunga, ukwanda kuphantse kube kasixhenxe.
p-050.actionItem: Ekuseni nasebusuku xa ubushushu bungaphantsi kwe-3°C, nciphisa isantya kwangaphambili phambi kwebhulorho, kwingqumba yetonela, nakwiindawo ezinomthunzi.

p-051.title: Isizathu sokuba i-magnification ye-2~3 ibe yanela kwisipili sokwenza inkangeleko
p-051.summary: Isipili esikhulisayo asiyongcono ngokuthi sibe nobukhulu obuphezulu. Ukuba ubude beziko bumfutshane, kufuneka ubeke ubuso kufutshane kakhulu kwaye ububanzi obubonwayo buyancipha.
p-051.principle: Isipili se-concave $\dfrac1f=\dfrac1{d_o}+\dfrac1{d_i}$, ukukhulisa $m=-\dfrac{d_i}{d_o}$. Ukuba into ingaphakathi kweziko, kubonakala umfanekiso othe nkqo okhuliswe wenyani engeyiyo.
p-051.example: Isipili esinobude beziko be-$f=20$ cm, ukubeka ubuso kwi-$d_o=10$ cm kubonakala kwi-$d_i=-20$ cm, $m=2$ amaxesha. Isipili se-10× esinobude beziko be-5cm sifuna ukubeka ubuso ngaphakathi kwe-5cm, ngoko iliso elinye kuphela libonakala ngexesha elinye. Ukuya ngaphaya kweziko, umfanekiso uguqulwa phantsi.
p-051.actionItem: Xa uthenga isipili, linganisa umgama oqhele ukuba ubuso bakho bube kuwo uze ukhethe imveliso enobude beziko obungamaxesha ama-2 alo mgama (ukukhulisa kwe-2~3).

p-052.title: Ukunciphisa ixesha lokupheka neendleko zegesi ngekhukhari yoxinzelelo
p-052.summary: Ikhukhari yoxinzelelo inyusa uxinzelelo lwangaphakathi ukunyusa indawo yokubilisa amanzi ukuya malunga ne-120℃, inciphisa ixesha lokupheka ukuya kwi-1/3 okanye ngaphantsi.
p-052.principle: Indawo yokubilisa inyuka ngoxinzelelo (Clausius-Clapeyron). Isantya sempendulo sibhabha kabini nge-$10^\circ$C ngokulinganayo, ngoko $2^{(120-100)/10}=4$ ngokukhawuleza amaxesha.
p-052.example: Ngo-1 atmosphere yegeyiji (malunga ne-2 atmospheres epheleleyo) indawo yokubilisa yi-120℃ malunga. Inyama ethatha imizuzu engama-60 ebhodleni eliqhelekileyo igqitywa kwimizuzu engama-20 malunga, isindisa i-1kWh malunga nge-induction ye-1.5kW. Ungavuli isiciko ngaphambi kokuba uxinzelelo luphume ngokupheleleyo.
p-052.actionItem: Ngobu busuku, pheka isitya esibiliswa ixesha elide (inyama ebilisiweyo, iimbotyi, izitya ezibhukudiweyo) ngekhukhari yoxinzelelo, kwaye endaweni yokufudumeza okungaphezulu, cima umlilo uze usebenzise uxinzelelo olusele ukuvuthisa.

p-053.title: Isikhewu somnyango esi-1% sehlisa ukucinezelwa kwengxolo ukusuka kwi-30dB ukuya kwi-20dB
p-053.summary: Nomnyango otyebileyo, ukuba kukho isikhewu esinye ngezantsi, ukusebenza kokucinezela ingxolo kuyehla kakhulu. Itheyiphu yomnyango yamawon ambalwa amawaka inciphisa ingxolo nomoya ongenayo ngaxeshanye.
p-053.principle: Ukuhanjiswa kwesixhobo $\tau=\dfrac{\sum S_i\tau_i}{\sum S_i}$, ilahleko yokuhanjiswa $TL=-10\log_{10}\tau$.
p-053.example: Kumnyango one-30dB yokucinezela ingxolo (τ=0.001), ukuba kukho isikhewu se-1% yendawo (τ≈1) $\tau=0.99\times0.001+0.01=0.011$ i-TL yi-19.6dB malunga, oko kukuthi yehla ukusuka kwi-30 ukuya kwi-20dB. Ukuvala isikhewu ngetheyiphu (malunga namawon angama-3,000) kunciphisa nomoya ongenayo ebusika, kuncedisa iindleko zokufudumeza.
p-053.actionItem: Vala umnyango uze ujonge ukuba ukukhanya kuvuza kwizikhewu ezingaphantsi nasecaleni komnyango, uze unamathisele iseal ye-silicone okanye i-door sweep.

p-054.title: Ukutshintsha indawo yomthombo we-WiFi kwenza isantya sitshintshe
p-054.summary: Nganye xa umgama uphindwe kabini, uphawu luyabuthathaka ngamaxesha ama-4 (6dB), kwaye ngodonga ngalunye kulahleka i-3~10dB eyongezelelweyo. Ukubeka i-router kwindawo evulekileyo embindini wendlu kuphucula isantya.
p-054.principle: Ilahleko yendlela yesithuba esingenanto $FSPL(\mathrm{dB})=20\log_{10}d+20\log_{10}f+32.44$ ($d$ km, $f$ MHz).
p-054.example: Kwi-2.4GHz, i-10m ilingana ne-60.0dB malunga, i-20m ilingana ne-66.0dB, oko kukuthi +6dB xa umgama uphindwe kabini. Ukuba kukho udonga lwekhonkrithi, i-5~10dB eyongezelelweyo iyalahleka, ngoko isantya sehla kakhulu egumbini elisemva.
p-054.actionItem: Khupha i-router emva kwe-TV okanye kwiilawulo okanye emgangathweni, uyibeke kwishelufu evulekileyo embindini wendlu ekuphakameni kwe-1~1.5m, uze uthelekise isantya egumbini elisemva phambi nasemva.

p-055.title: Nganye i-3dB yevolumu yeearphones, ixesha elikhuselekileyo liyincitshiswa libe sisiqingatha
p-055.summary: Nganye xa ukuqina kwesandi kunyuka nge-3dB, amandla aphindwe kabini kwaye ixesha lokumamela ngokukhuselekileyo liba sisiqingatha. Ukunciphisa ivolumu kancinci kwandisa kakhulu ixesha lokukhusela iindlebe.
p-055.principle: Inqanaba loxinzelelo lwesandi $L=10\log_{10}\dfrac{I}{I_0}$ ($I_0=10^{-12}$W/m²). Iingcebiso zokuvezwa: i-85dB iiyure ezi-8, nganye xa inyuka nge-3dB ixesha liba sisiqingatha.
p-055.example: I-85dB iiyure ezi-8, i-88dB iiyure ezi-4, i-91dB iiyure ezi-2, i-94dB iyure e-1, i-100dB imizuzu eli-15. Ukuba ukunyusa ivolumu ngenxa yengxolo yesitimela esingaphantsi komhlaba kufikelela kwi-95dB okanye ngaphezulu, nemizuzu engama-30 inzima.
p-055.actionItem: Namhla, vula useto lokhuseleko lweheadphone nokumiselwa kwevolumu kwifowuni uze umisele ivolumu ephezulu malunga nama-60%.

p-056.title: I-hydroplaning emvuleni yentwasahlobo, nciphisa isantya nge-20% kuphela
p-056.summary: Endleleni emanzi, ukuba isantya siphezulu, amanzi angaphambi kwethayara awakwazi ukubaleka aba yi-wedge aphakamise ithayara. Xa kwenzeka i-hydroplaning, ukuqhuba nokunqumama kuphantse kungenzeki.
p-056.principle: Xa uxinzelelo lwamandla lwamanzi $q=\tfrac12\rho v^2$ lusondela koxinzelelo loqhagamshelwano $p$, umgangatho wamanzi uphakamisa ithayara. Isantya esibalulekileyo $v\approx\sqrt{2p/\rho}$ (uqikelelo olulula).
p-056.example: Ngoxinzelelo loqhagamshelwano lwe-220kPa malunga $v\approx\sqrt{2\times220000/1000}\approx21$m/s, oko kukuthi malunga ne-76km/h. Xa iingoma zidlile, ukuhamba kwamanzi akwenzeki, kwenzeka nakwizantya eziphantsi, ngoko ukunciphisa indawo ye-100km/h ukuya kwi-80km/h kukhuselekile.
p-056.actionItem: Jonga ukuba isalathiso somda wokunxiba (TWI) phakathi kweengoma zethayara silingana nokuphakama kwengoma, uze ngeentsuku zemvula uqhube nge-80% yesantya esiqhelekileyo.

p-057.title: Ungakholelwa kuphela kwinani le-NRR kwii-earplugs
p-057.summary: I-NRR ebhalwe kwiphakheji yixabiso eliphezulu elilinganiselwe elabhoratri, ngoko ukwehla kwenyani kuncinci kakhulu. Kwii-earplugs zeekonsathi nemizi-mveliso, thelekisa ngexabiso elilungisiweyo.
p-057.principle: Uqikelelo lokwehla kwenyani ⟦$\mathrm{NRR}_{\text{okwenyani}}\approx\dfrac{\mathrm{NRR}-7}{2}$⟧ dB (emva kokulungiswa kwe-A-weighting, kusetyenziswa i-50%).
p-057.example: Ukukhuselwa kwenyani kwe-foam earplug ye-NRR 33 yi-$(33-7)/2=13$dB. Kwi-concert yokuvakala kwe-100dB yehla ibe yi-87dB, ngoko isaphezulu kancinci kumgangatho we-85dB. Ukunxiba ngokufanelekileyo kubalulekile ngaphezu kwenani.
p-057.actionItem: Songa i-foam earplug ibe mfutshane, utsale indlebe phezulu nangasemva uze uyifake, uze uyicinezele ngomnwe imizuzwana engama-30 ukuyivumela ukuba ikhule.

p-058.title: Ukutshaja ngaphandle kwentambo, indawo yekhoyili ichaphazela ukusebenza kakuhle
p-058.summary: Ukutshaja ngaphandle kwentambo kunelahleko enkulu kunokutshaja ngentambo, ngoko ukuba indawo ayilunganga kuvela ubushushu kwaye kusetyenziswa umbane ongakumbi. Ukulungelelanisa kakuhle kuphela kunciphisa ilahleko nokonakala kwebhetri.
p-058.principle: Ukusebenza kakuhle kwe-inductive coupling kuyatshintsha ngokwe-coupling coefficient $k$ kwaye $\eta=\dfrac{k^2Q_1Q_2}{\left(1+\sqrt{1+k^2Q_1Q_2}\right)^2}$. Ukuba akulungelelananga, $k$ liyehla kakhulu.
p-058.example: Xa utshaja ifowuni ye-5000mAh·3.85V (malunga ne-19.3Wh), ngokungena kwintambo ye-90% yi-21.4Wh, ngokungena kwentambo ye-70% yi-27.5Wh, ngokungalungelelani kwi-50% yi-38.5Wh. Ukutshaja kanye ngemini, ngokulungelelanisa kusetyenziswa malunga ne-2kWh ngonyaka, ngokungalungelelani malunga ne-6kWh ngonyaka ngaphezulu.
p-058.actionItem: Beka ifowuni ngqo embindini wophawu lwekhoyili kwi-charging pad, uze ususe ikesi ewuqingqiweyo okanye amakhadi nesinyithi ngaphambi kokutshaja.

p-059.title: Susa unyawo kwipedali yokukhawulezisa kwangaphambili phambi kwesibane
p-059.summary: Xa ubona isibane sokumisa kwaye unyathela ibrek, amandla entshukumo yemoto aphulukana njengobushushu. Ukususa unyawo kwangaphambili kwenza imoto ihambe ngokungena kwephethroli ivaliwe isindise iphethroli.
p-059.principle: Amandla entshukumo $E_k=\tfrac12mv^2$. Amandla alahlekayo ngokunyathela ibrek alingana nesikwere sesantya.
p-059.example: Imoto ye-1,500kg ihamba nge-60km/h (16.7m/s) yi-$E_k\approx208$kJ. Ukuba amandla asebenzayo e-1L yephethroli athathwa njenge-8.5MJ malunga, ngokumisa kanye kulingana ne-25mL malunga. Ukuphendula kwangaphambili kwizibane ezili-10 kusindisa amashumi~amakhulu ambalwa e-mL ngemini.
p-059.actionItem: Namhla, xa uqhuba, ukuba isibane esingaphambili sibomvu, susa unyawo kwipedali malunga ne-150m kwangaphambili, uyivumele iqengqeleke yodwa, uze usebenzise ibrek ngobunono kuphela xa kuyimfuneko.

p-060.title: Ukuhambisa amanzi ngesiphon ngaphandle kwepompo
p-060.summary: Ukutshintsha amanzi etanki okanye ukuthulula umgqomo wamanzi emvula, kufuneka kuphela ipayipi nomahluko wokuphakama. Kanye emva kokuba uzalise ipayipi ngamanzi, amanzi aqhubeka ehamba aye kwicala elingezantsi.
p-060.principle: Ukuba intanda iphantsi $\Delta h$ kuneqondo lamanzi, amanzi ahamba ngomahluko woxinzelelo $\Delta P=\rho g\Delta h$ kwaye isantya esifanelekileyo $v=\sqrt{2g\Delta h}$.
p-060.example: Ngomahluko wokuphakama we-0.5m isantya esifanelekileyo yi-3.1m/s, kodwa ngenxa yokungqubana kwepayipi kwenyani malunga ne-1m/s. Epayipini enobubanzi be-10mm $Q\approx0.08$L/s, ngoko i-20L ihanjiswa malunga nemizuzu emi-4.
p-060.actionItem: Faka ipayipi emanzini uyizalise, vala elinye icala, uze uhambise kwibhakethi esendaweni ephantsi. Ungaze ufunxe uketshezi lwekhemikhali ngomlomo.

p-061.title: Ngoosuku lwekhephu, imitha ye-UV ivela phezulu naphantsi
p-061.summary: Ikhephu elitsha libonisa imitha ye-UV ngokubanzi, ngoko ebusika emathafeni anekhephu amehlo nobuso zitshiswa lilanga lula kunokuba bekucingwa.
p-061.principle: Isalathisi sokubonisa (albedo) yi-$\alpha=I_r/I_0$ kwaye ukuvezwa ngokupheleleyo kwi-UV malunga ne-$I_0(1+\alpha)$. I-albedo ye-UV yekhephu elitsha malunga ne-0.8~0.9, ingca malunga ne-0.03.
p-061.example: Ukuba i-UV ethe ngqo ithathwa njengo-1, entsheni malunga ne-1.03, phezu kwekhephu elitsha malunga ne-1.8~1.9, phantse kabini.
p-061.actionItem: Xa uya ngosuku lwekhephu okanye emathafeni anekhephu, thatha iiglasi zelanga (iigogglesi) ezikhusela i-UV nesunscreen.

p-062.title: Isizathu sokuba indlebe zivaleke xa inqwelomoya ihlala
p-062.summary: Uxinzelelo lwaphakathi kwenqwelomoya lulingana nokuphakama kwamamitha angama-2,400 ngaphezu komgangatho wolwandle, ngoko emva kokuhamba komoya ophakathi endlebeni uyandlondlobala, uze uncitywe kwakhona ekuhlaleni. Ukuvula iindlebe ukususela ekuqaleni kokuhla kunqanda iintlungu.
p-062.example: Xa uxinzelelo luhla ukusuka kwi-101kPa emhlabeni ukuya kuma-75kPa ngexesha lokubhabha, umthamo womoya ophakathi endlebeni uba $101/75\approx1.35$ amaxesha, oko kukuthi uyanda nge-35%. Ekuhleni kuyehla, ize ibhedu lendlebe litsalwe ngaphakathi. Ukuba impumlo ivaliwe lisukuma, i-Eustachian tube ayivuleki lula.
p-062.actionItem: Xa isaziso sokufika sivakala, hlafuna intshungama okanye uphindaphinde ukuyawula nokugulula, ungalali, uhlale uphapheme.

p-063.title: Inombolo yedurbhini 8x42, indlela yokufunda nokukhanya kwayo
p-063.summary: Iinombolo zedurbhini zibonisa ukukhulisa×ububanzi be-lens. Ukuba uyisebenzisa ekuseni kakhulu okanye ngokuhlwa, kufuneka i-exit pupil ibe nkulu ukuze ikhanye, ukuba usebenzisa emini kuphela, imveliso encinci nekhaphukhaphu ingcono.
p-063.example: I-8x42 yi-$42/8=5.25$ mm xa i-exit pupil ingu-5.25mm, ukukhanya okuthelekisiweyo malunga nama-27.6, ngelixa i-10x25 ingu-2.5mm, malunga nama-6.3, ngoko ikhanya ngaphezu kwamaxesha amane ezindaweni ezimnyama. Umntwana wegama lamehlo womntu ezindaweni ezimnyama ungu-5~7mm, ngoko ukujonga iintaka ekuseni kulunge ngakumbi nge-exit pupil engaphezu kwe-4mm.
p-063.actionItem: Ukuba usetyenziso lwakho kukujonga iintaka ekuseni okanye ngokuhlwa, khetha imveliso engu-$D/M\ge4$ mm; ukuba kukhenketha emini kuphela, khetha encinci ekhaphukhaphu uze uyibone ngokwakho ngaphambi kokuthenga.

p-064.title: Ukonga imibhobho yamanzi ashushu kwenza ubushushu buphume kancinci
p-064.summary: Umbhobho wamanzi ashushu ongagqunyiwe ukusuka kwi-boiler ukuya kwitephu ulahlekelwa bubushushu rhoqo. Ukuwugquma ngento yokugquma kunciphisa ilahleko kakhulu.
p-064.principle: Ilahleko yobushushu bombhobho ilingana $\dot Q\propto \Delta T/R$, kwaye into yokugquma inyusa ukumelana kobushushu $R$. Ukuba $R$ iphindwe kabini, ilahleko ngokwahlukana okufanayo $\Delta T$ yehla ibe sisiqingatha.
p-064.example: Ukuba umbhobho wamanzi ashushu ongagqunyiwe wemitha eyi-10 uhluke nge-25K kubushushu begumbi, kwaye uthi ulahlekelwe malunga nama-25W ngemitha nganye, ngama-250W. Emva kokugquma ukuya malunga nama-60W, ugcina malunga nama-1.9kWh ngosuku olunamaiyure ali-10.
p-064.actionItem: Linganisa ubude bombhobho wamanzi ashushu ongagqunyiwe egumbini le-boiler okanye phantsi kwesinki, uze ucwangcise ukuthenga intsimbi yokugquma ukuze uyigqume.

p-065.title: Ibhokisi ephezu kophahla, yehlise ekuqaleni kwentwasahlobo
p-065.summary: Ukushiya ibhokisi yophahla ebisetyenziselwa izixhobo zokutyibiliza ekhephini ebusika kwandisa ukumelana komoya ekuqhubeni ngesantya esikhulu, kuze kulahleke ipetroli.
p-065.example: Imoto engu-$C_dA=0.69\,\mathrm{m^2}$ ehamba ngama-100km ngeyure (27.8m/s) isebenzisa malunga nama-8.9kW, kodwa ukuba $C_dA$ inyuka nge-20% ngenxa yebhokisi yophahla, ifikelela kuma-10.7kW, oko kukuthi 1.8kW ngaphezulu. Kuhambo lwe-100km oku kulingana nokusebenzisa malunga ne-0.8L ngaphezulu.
p-065.actionItem: Khangela ibhokisi yophahla namabha amnqamlezo ophahla, kwaye ukuba akukho nto ngaphakathi, uwakhuphe namhlanje uwabeke kwigaraji.

p-066.title: Ungalihluli i-hook yokunamathela ngokuyiphakamisa, yitsale ide ibe ende
p-066.summary: I-hook yokunamathela inamandla xa itsalwa ezantsi (shear), kodwa ayinamandla xa isuswa isuka eludongeni ngokuthe nkqo (peel).
p-066.principle: Kwi-shear, indawo yonke enamathelayo yabelana ngamandla, kodwa kwi-peel, amandla agxile kumgca omnye osemaphethelweni, ngoko $F_{\text{peel}}\ll F_{\text{shear}}$.
p-066.example: Umzekelo, i-hook ephatha i-2 kgf kwi-shear inokuwa kwi-0.2~0.5 kgf kwi-peel. Ngenxa yoko, nangona ubunzima obulenga ezantsi bububhetele, ukuyiphakamisa kuyenza iwe lula.
p-066.actionItem: Xa unamathisela i-hook, sula uthuli namanzi kumphezulu uze uyicinezele ngaphezu komzuzu omnye. Xa uyisusa, yitsale ngokucotha ngokuhambelana nodonga ide ibe ende.

p-067.title: Ukunciphisa ivolumu nge-6dB ngokucima ingxolo
p-067.summary: Ukucima ingxolo kudala isandi esichasene nesigaba sengxolo ukuze sirhoxise. Kwitreyini okanye kwibhasi, akufuneki unyuse ivolumu, kuze kukhuseleke iindlebe zakho.
p-067.principle: Ukuphazamiseka okurhoxisayo: $A\sin\omega t+A\sin(\omega t+\pi)=0$. Kusebenza kakuhle kwiinzwana ezingaguquguqukiyo zomgama ophantsi (ngaphantsi kwe-1kHz).
p-067.example: Kwingxolo yetreyini engu-80dB, ukuba ukucima ingxolo kunciphisa ingxolo yomgangatho ophantsi nge-20dB, unokuphulaphula umculo ofanayo ngevolumu eyehle nge-6dB (umzekelo 91dB→85dB), kwaye ixesha lokuphulaphula elikhuselekileyo landa ngamaxesha amane ukusuka kwiiyure ezi-2 ukuya kwezi-8.
p-067.actionItem: Etreyini okanye kwibhasi, vula ukucima ingxolo uze unciphise ivolumu ngamanqanaba amabini okanye amathathu.

p-068.title: Ikhoyili enemvula yentwasahlobo, nanku umda wesantya
p-068.summary: Isantya esiphezulu ongajika ngaso ngokukhuselekileyo ekhoyilini sigqitywa lufriksheni yendlela nemitha. Xa kumanzi, umda wehla kakhulu.
p-068.principle: Umda wesantya $v=\sqrt{\mu g r}$ (amandla ajikelezayo = amandla efriksheni).
p-068.example: Kwikhoyili yemitha eyi-50, indlela eyomileyo ($\mu=0.7$) malunga nama-67km/h, eyimanzi (0.4) malunga nama-50km/h, ekhephini (0.2) malunga nama-36km/h. Isantya esiboniswe kwiziqhelo zidla ngokusekelwa kwindlela eyomileyo, ngoko xa kunemvula, yehlisa ngakumbi.
p-068.actionItem: Phambi kokungena ekhoyilini, yehlisa isantya kwangaphambili kumgca othe tye, kwaye ngaphakathi ekhoyilini ungabeki ibrek okanye ukujika ngesiquphe.

p-069.title: Ubukhulu beTV, umgama wokubukela ubaluleke ngaphezu kokuphela
p-069.summary: Amehlo abantu anokwahlula malunga nomzuzu omnye we-angle. Ukuba uhleli kude, amehlo awakwazi ukwahlula phakathi kwe-4K ne-Full HD, ngoko kungcono ukutyala imali kubukhulu besikrini endaweni yokuphela.
p-069.principle: Amandla okwahlula kwamehlo $\theta\approx1'\approx2.9\times10^{-4}$ rad, xa isithuba sepixels singu-$p$, umgama omkhulu wokwahlula $d=\dfrac{p}{\theta}$.
p-069.example: Isithuba sepixels ye-4K yeeintshi ezingama-55 singama-0.32mm, ngoko izinto ezahlukileyo zepixels zibonakala kuphela ngaphakathi kwe-$d\approx1.1$ m. Ukuba i-sofa ikude ngeemitha ezi-3, i-Full HD ayibonakali ngepixels kude kube yiintshi ezingama-75, ngoko jonga ubukhulu nomgangatho (ukwahlukana, i-HDR) kunokuba uthenge i-4K ngexabiso eliphezulu.
p-069.actionItem: Linganisa umgama ukusuka kwindawo yokufaka iTV ukuya kwi-sofa ngerula, uze usebenzise loo mgama ukukhetha ubukhulu besikrini.

p-070.title: Xa umkhenkce wefriza utyebile, usebenzisa umbane ngakumbi
p-070.summary: Umkhenkce wefriza unomoya omninzi phakathi kwamakristali omkhenkce, ngoko usebenza njengomaleko wokugquma, uthintela ukuhanjiswa kobushushu obubandayo, ze ikhompresa ihlale ixesha elide isebenza.
p-070.principle: Ukumelana kobushushu $R=d/k$ kulingana nobukhulu $d$. $k$ yomkhenkce wefriza malunga ne-0.2~0.5 $\mathrm{W/(m\,K)}$, incinci kakhulu kuneyomkhenkce ococekileyo (malunga ne-2.2).
p-070.example: Xa $k=0.3$, i-5mm yomkhenkce wefriza $R=0.005/0.3\approx0.017\ \mathrm{m^2K/W}$, amaxesha amahlanu kune-1mm. Ukusebenza kokupholisa kuyehla ngokufanayo.
p-070.actionItem: Xa umkhenkce uphezulu kune-3~5mm, cima umbane uvumele ukunyibilika ngokwemvelo. Musa ukuyikrwela ngommese okanye isixhobo esibukhali.

p-071.title: Iilitha ezingama-200 zamanzi emvula, amanzi asimahla kumyezo wentwasahlobo
p-071.summary: Ukuqokelela imvula yentwasahlobo ewa ophahleni kuvumela ukunkcenkceshela umyezo ngaphandle kwamanzi aselwandle. Ukuphakamisa idrum kuvumela ukudibanisa umbhobho ngoxinzelelo lwamanzi.
p-071.principle: Uxinzelelo lwamanzi $P=\rho g h$, ubungakanani obuqokelelweyo $V=A\times R$ (indawo×imvula).
p-071.example: Xa imvula engama-20mm iwa kuphahla lwe-10m², $10\times20=200$ L iyaqokelelwa. Ukuphakamisa idrum ngemitha enye kudala uxinzelelo lwe-9.8kPa (malunga ne-0.1bar), ukuze isitshixo sinkcenkceshele iibhedi eziphantsi ngomxhuzulane.
p-071.actionItem: Beka idrum yamanzi emvula phezu kwesiseko esiphakamileyo ngaphezu kwe-50cm uze uyigqume ngesigqubuthelo nenethi ukuze kungabikho zinambuzane.

p-072.title: Ukuvelisa isandi kwemayikhrofoni, ukunciphisa nge-3dB kuyayisusa
p-072.summary: Xa imayikhrofoni iphinda yandise isandi sesipikha, kuvela isandi esibukhali 'i-i-i'. Ngokulungisa umgama nevolumu kuphela, unokuyithintela ngokulula.
p-072.principle: $G=g_{amp}\cdot g_{path}\ge1$ kunye nesigaba esifanayo, kwenzeka ukungqubana.
p-072.example: Ukuphinda umgama phakathi kwemayikhrofoni nesipikha kunyusa ilahleko yendlela nge-6dB, ngoko unokunyusa ivolumu ngakumbi ngokufanayo. Kwelinye icala, ukunciphisa ivolumu nge-3dB kuphela kuhlisa i-loop gain ibe sisiqingatha, ngoko isandi siyanyamalala.
p-072.actionItem: Musa ukubeka isipikha kwicala ejongwe yimayikhrofoni, bhekisa isipikha kubaphulaphuli, kwaye wehlise ivolumu yeempawu zemayikhrofoni nge-3dB (inyathelo elinye okanye amabini).

p-073.title: Ukulinganisa amandla e-UV ngesithunzi
p-073.summary: Ukuba isithunzi sifutshane kuneentende zakho, ukuphakama kwelanga kungaphezu kwamadigri angama-45 kwaye i-UV inamandla. Ekupheleni kukaMatshi, isithunzi sasemini sele sifutshane kunobude bakho.
p-073.principle: Isixa se-UV silingana $\alpha$ $\sin\alpha$ sokuphakama kwelanga, kwaye ubude besithunzi $L=\dfrac{h}{\tan\alpha}$.
p-073.example: Kwi-latitude yama-37, ekuhlaleni kwe-equinox (malunga nomhla wama-20 kaMatshi) ukuphakama kwemini kuyi-$90^\circ-37^\circ=53^\circ$, isithunzi sibe $1/\tan53^\circ=0.75$ amaxesha obude bakho. Ekuqaleni kukaFebruwari (ukuphakama malunga nama-38) kwakungu-1.28.
p-073.actionItem: Jonga isithunzi sakho malunga nasemini namhlanje, kwaye ukuba sifutshane kunobude bakho, faka isikrini selanga se-SPF30 okanye ngaphezulu uze unxibe umnqwazi.

p-074.title: Ukuhamba ngokukhawuleza kwindawo yomlinganiselo wesantya kugcina imizuzu emibini kuphela
p-074.summary: Ukulawulwa kwecandelo kusebenzisa isantya esiqhelekileyo. Ixesha olizuzayo ngokukhawuleza ngesiquphe lincinci kakhulu, kodwa amandla nengozi ziyanda kakhulu.
p-074.principle: Isantya esiqhelekileyo $\bar v=\dfrac{\Delta s}{\Delta t}$, amandla okumelana komoya $\propto v^3$.
p-074.example: Ukuhamba ikhilomitha ezingama-20 ngama-100km/h kuthatha imizuzu eyi-12, ngama-120km/h kuthatha imizuzu eyi-10, ngoko umahluko yimizuzu emibini, kodwa amandla okumelana komoya aba $1.2^3=1.73$ amaxesha (+73%) kwaye amandla ehlaba andiswa nge-44%. Ukukhawuleza kwicandelo langaphambili kufuneka kuhlawulwe ngasemva, ngoko akukho nzuzo.
p-074.actionItem: Kwindawo yokulawula icandelo, setha i-cruise control kumda wesantya uhambe ngokuthe ngqo.

p-075.title: Jonga ubuntununtunu (dB) besipikha, hayi ii-watt
p-075.summary: Umahluko wobuntununtunu we-3dB uthetha umahluko wamandla e-amplifier aphindwe kabini ukwenza ivolumu efanayo. Inani elikhulu le-watt aliqinisekisi isandi esikhulu.
p-075.example: Ukwenza i-85dB ngeemitha ezi-3, kufuneka malunga nama-94.5dB ukuguqulelwa kwemitha enye. Isipikha esine-90dB sidinga malunga nama-2.8W, esine-84dB sidinga malunga nama-11.2W, ngoko umahluko ngamaxesha amane.
p-075.actionItem: Jonga ubuntununtunu (dB/1W/1m) kwitheyibhile yeenkcukacha zesipikha ofuna ukusithenga uze ukhethe esinobuntununtunu obuphezulu.

p-076.title: Ukunciphisa isantya sefeni nge-20% kuthi kuhlise umbane ube sisiqingatha
p-076.summary: Amandla asetyenzisiweyo efeni alingana nekyubhu yokujikeleza. Ukuba ungakhathali ngomoya obuthathaka kancinci, unokonga umbane kakhulu.
p-076.principle: Umthetho wokufana kwefeni: ubuninzi bomoya $Q\propto N$, amandla asetyenzisiweyo $P\propto N^3$.
p-076.example: Ukuhlisa ukujikeleza kube yi-80%, ubuninzi bomoya buba yi-80%, amandla aba $0.8^3=0.51$ okanye isiqingatha. Kwifeni ye-40W, kwehla ibe malunga nama-20W, igcina malunga nama-4.7kWh ngenyanga xa isetyenziswa iiyure ezi-8 ngosuku.
p-076.actionItem: Namhlanje setha ifeni okanye i-exhaust fan kwi-'middle' endaweni ye-'strong' uze ujonge ukuba ukuziva kwanele na.

p-077.title: Ipayipi yomyezo enenozzle enye ilondoloza i-40% yamanzi
p-077.summary: Ukucinezela isiphelo sepayipi kwenza umlambo wamanzi ube nesantya esikhulu kumsinga ofanayo ukuze uhambe kude, kwaye inozzle yokucima iphelisa ilahleko ngexesha lokuhamba.
p-077.example: Xa i-10L/min (0.167L/s) iphuma kwipayipi yobubanzi obungama-15mm, isantya senkqubo malunga ne-0.94m/s, kwaye ukuba ufaka inozzle yobubanzi obuyi-5mm, sikhawuleza kuya kuma-8.5m/s, amaxesha alithoba, kudinga uxinzelelo lwe-36kPa. Ukuvala amanzi ngenozzle yokucima ngexesha lokuhamba kunciphisa i-50L yemizuzu emi-5 ukuya kuma-30L.
p-077.actionItem: Faka inozzle yokucima yesibambo esiphelweni sepayipi, uze unkcenkceshele kuphela kwingcambu yezityalo.

p-078.title: Isandi 'kwaa' xa uvala itephu, i-water hammer
p-078.summary: Ukuvala ngokukhawuleza kwenza amanzi asebenzayo ame ngesiquphe, kudale amaza abetha kwimibhobho, kwenze isandi 'kwaa' kwaye kungonakalisa imibhobho.
p-078.principle: Ifomula kaJoukowsky $\Delta p=\rho c\,\Delta v$ (c: isantya sesandi emibhobhweni).
p-078.example: Kumbhobho wekopa onesantya samanzi esingu-2m/s, $c\approx1200$ m/s, ukuvala ngokukhawuleza kwenza $\Delta p\approx2.4$ MPa (24bar), amaxesha ama-6 oxinzelelo oluqhelekileyo lwamanzi lwe-3~4bar. Ukuba ixesha lokuvala lide ngaphezu kwe-$2L/c$ (malunga ne-17ms kumbhobho wemitha eyi-10), impembelelo yehla kakhulu.
p-078.actionItem: Vala iitephu ezinomlomo wokujika kunye nevalvu yomatshini wokuhlamba ngokucotha, kwaye ukuba kuyaphindaphinda, buza malunga nokufaka i-water hammer arrester.

p-079.title: Ixesha lokutshintsha izihlangu zokubaleka, uxinzelelo lwempembelelo
p-079.summary: Xa i-cushion ikhatshiwe, ixesha lokumisa unyawo liba lifutshane, ngoko amandla asebenza kwiqatha nakwiqhuzu ayanda. Jonga rhoqo emva kwe-500~800km.
p-079.principle: Impuls $F\,\Delta t=\Delta p$, ngoko amandla aphakathi $F=\dfrac{m\Delta v}{\Delta t}$.
p-079.example: Ukulula ngokucinga ukuba umntu onobunzima obuyi-70kg wehlisa i-momentum ye-70N·s ekufikeni, ukuba umisa kwi-0.035 imizuzwana kuba yi-2,000N, kwaye xa i-cushion ikhatshiwe ukumisa kwi-0.02 imizuzwana kuba yi-3,500N (malunga namaxesha amahlanu ubunzima bomzimba), ukwanda nge-75%.
p-079.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga ukuba isoli yezihlangu zakho zokubaleka iyacinezeleka yenze imisonto na, uze urekhode umgama emva kokutshintsha okugqibeleleyo.

p-080.title: Ukuqhuba ebusuku, kuyingozi ukukhawuleza ngaphezu komgama wezibane eziphantsi
p-080.summary: Umgama okhanyiswa zizibane eziphantsi malunga nama-40m, kodwa umgama wokuma kwama-80km/h ude kunoko. Kufana nokuya kwindawo engabonakaliyo.
p-080.example: Kwi-80km/h (22.2m/s), ukusabela kwemizuzwana eyi-1, $\mu=0.7$, ngu-$22.2+36=58$ m, odlula ama-40m. Kwi-60km/h ngu-$16.7+20=37$ m ukhuselekile. Umkhenkce nomaleko wamafutha ngaphakathi kwegilasi langaphambili uhlakazisa ukukhanya, unciphisa ukubona ngakumbi.
p-080.actionItem: Phambi kokuhamba, sula ngaphakathi kwegilasi langaphambili nezibane zangaphambili, kwaye ezitalatweni ezimnyama ezisecaleni hamba ngaphantsi kwama-60km/h.

p-081.title: Ihelmethi yebhayisikili, ubukhulu bokufunxa impembelelo bubalulekile
p-081.summary: Ihelmethi inyusa umgama wokumisa intloko ukunciphisa amandla empembelelo. Isatifikethi kunye nokulingana ngokufanelekileyo kubaluleke ngaphezu kwexabiso okanye uyilo.
p-081.example: Ukuba intloko ye-5kg ibetha kwi-6m/s, $E_k=90$ J. Ngaphandle kwehelmethi, umgama wokumisa we-2mm unika malunga ne-45kN, kwaye nge-20mm ye-EPS foam malunga ne-4.5kN, okwesihlandlo seshumi. I-EPS ibhuduza ixesha elinye kwaye ukusebenza kwayo kuyanyamalala.
p-081.actionItem: Jonga uphawu lwesatifikethi se-KC, CPSC, EN1078, kwaye uyilungise ukuze ilingane ngokuphakama kweminwe emibini ngaphezulu kwamasuntswana, kwaye ibhanti yesilevu yenze u-Y phantsi kweendlebe.

p-082.title: Isibane sasegadini esiyilanga, ukusimisa ngama-35 degrees ukuya emazantsi kufumana i-25% ngaphezulu
p-082.summary: Iphaneli yelanga ifumana ukukhanya okuninzi xa ithe nkqo elangeni. Ukuthambeka kwesibane segadi ngokwe-latitude kunyusa ukutshaja.
p-082.principle: Ukukhanya okufunyenweyo $\propto\cos\theta$ ($\theta$: i-angle yokungena). Ukuthambeka okufanelekileyo $\approx$ i-latitude.
p-082.example: Kwi-latitude yama-37, ekuhambeni kwelanga kwe-equinox ngama-53 degrees, iphaneli ethe tye ifumana $\sin53^\circ=0.80$, iphaneli ethe nkqo eludongeni $\cos53^\circ=0.60$, kwaye iphaneli ethambeke ngama-37 degrees ifumana 1.0. Ifumana malunga ne-25% ngaphezulu kunethe tye, kunye nama-67% ngaphezulu kunethe nkqo.
p-082.actionItem: Jonga iphaneli yesibane segadi ibheke emazantsi, uyithambise ngama-35~40 degrees, kwaye ususe izithunzi noothuli.

p-083.title: Isibane setafile, ukusitsala nge-30cm kunciphisa umbane ube yinxalenye yesine
p-083.summary: Ukukhanya kuyehla ngokulingana nesikwere somgama. Ukubeka isibane kufutshane kuthi ufumane ukukhanya okufanayo ngebhalbhu ebuthathaka.
p-083.example: Ukuhambisa isibane ukusuka kwi-60cm ukuya kwi-30cm kwenza ukukhanya kube ngamaxesha amane. Ukuba ufuna i-500lux kwi-60cm, kufuneka i-LED ye-12W, kodwa kwi-30cm i-3W iyaneleyo, ugcina malunga nama-13kWh ngonyaka xa usebenzisa iiyure ezi-4 ngosuku.
p-083.actionItem: Beka isibane malunga ne-30cm ukusuka kwincwadi, kwicala elichaseneyo nesandla sokubhala, uze utshintshe ubeke ibhalbhu yewatt ephantsi.

p-084.title: Isizathu sokuba umnxeba unqumke kwilifti
p-084.summary: Ibhokisi yentsimbi yibhokisi kaFaraday ethintela amaza e-electromagnetic, ngoko isignali ayikwazi ukungena. Ukulungiselela phambi kokuba isignali inqumke kukhusela iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo.
p-084.principle: Ubunzulu begolidi $\delta=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{\pi f\mu\sigma}}$ (ubunzulu apho amaza ancipha ngaphakathi kwe-conductor).
p-084.example: Kwi-aluminium ($\sigma=3.8\times10^7$ S/m), ubunzulu begolidi bamaza e-1.8GHz malunga ne-1.9µm kuphela, ngoko nesilayi sentsimbi esincinci sithintela isignali. Ixhomekeke kwisignali encinci engena ngokunqwabela kweengcango neembobo zomoya.
p-084.actionItem: Gqibezela iminxeba ebalulekileyo phambi kokungena kwilifti okanye uvule ukufowuna nge-Wi-Fi, uze ukhuphele iifayile ezifunekayo phambi kokungena kwindawo yokupaka phantsi komhlaba.

p-085.title: Ukuhlanjwa kwentwasahlobo, sula uthuli ungalutshayeli
p-085.summary: Uthuli oluncinci lufana lubonakalisa ixesha elahlukileyo lokuhlala emoyeni ngokobukhulu. Ukutshayela kuvusa uthuli olwalusezantsi, lungene kwiindlela zokuphefumla.
p-085.example: Uthuli lobubanzi be-10µm lwehla malunga nama-6mm/s, ngoko imitha enye ithatha malunga nemizuzu emi-3, kodwa lobubanzi be-2.5µm isantya sisondele $1/16$ kokunye, i-0.38mm/s, ngoko ithatha malunga nemizuzu engama-44. Iinkozo ezincinci zihlala emoyeni ixesha elide emva kokucoca.
p-085.actionItem: Namhlanje cocisa ngelaphu elimanzi endaweni yokutshayela, kwaye emva kokugqiba vula iifestile uvelise umoya iyure enye.

p-086.title: Umgaqo weesekhondi ezi-2 womgama okhuselekileyo ezindleleni ezikhulu
p-086.summary: Ukuba uyaqhuba ngomgama ofanayo nemoto engaphambili, isithuba esifunekayo ngumgama wokusabela womqhubi. Ukushiya iisekhondi ezi-2 kukunika malunga nama-56m kwi-100km/h.
p-086.example: Kwi-100km/h (27.8m/s) ukusabela kweesekhondi ezi-1.5 kufuna $41.7$ m, kwaye umgaqo weesekhondi ezi-2 uyi-55.6m, ngoko kuneshiyekileyo. Ngemini enemvula yandisa ukuya kwiisekhondi ezi-3~4.
p-086.actionItem: Xa imoto engaphambili idlula uphawu lwendlela okanye isibane sasesitratweni, bala 'nye, mbini' uze ujonge ukuba ugqiba ukubala phambi kokufika kuloo ndawo.

p-087.title: Iikhaya zamavili amakhulu zinqumla ngokulula iindlela eziphakamileyo
p-087.summary: Ivili elinobubanzi obukhulu linyuka ngekona ethambileyo kwakuloo ndlela iphakamileyo, ngoko lifuna amandla ambalwa.
p-087.principle: Xa ivili lemitha $R$ lidlula kwindlela ephakamileyo yokuphakama $h$, amandla athe tye atyhala i-axle ngu-$F=mg\,\dfrac{\sqrt{2Rh-h^2}}{R-h}$.
p-087.example: Xa ubunzima obunyuswa livili $mg=100$ N, ukuphakama kwendlela $h=1$ cm, ivili lobubanzi obuyi-6cm lifuna malunga ne-112N, elobubanzi obuyi-10cm malunga nama-75N, elobubanzi obuyi-16cm malunga nama-55N.
p-087.actionItem: Xa ukhetha ibhegi okanye ipram, jonga ububanzi bevili nezinto (irabha, i-urethane), kwaye phambi kwendlela ephakamileyo phakamisa ivili langaphambili kancinci.

p-088.title: I-fast charging, isizathu sokuba i-voltage ephezulu inciphise ilahleko
p-088.summary: Ubushushu obuphulukana kumelana kwekhebula bulingana nesikwere sombane. Nangona kuyintsebenziswano efanayo, ukutshaja nge-voltage ephezulu nombane ophantsi kunciphisa ilahleko.
p-088.example: Ukuthumela ama-18W nge-5V kuphuma ngama-3.6A, ngoko kwikhebula yokumelana kwe-0.2Ω kuyanyamalala ama-2.6W (14%), kodwa nge-9V kuba yi-2A, kuyanyamalala ama-0.8W kuphela (4.4%). Iikhebula ezibhityileyo nezinde zine-lahleko enkulu.
p-088.actionItem: Sebenzisa ikhebula eshinyeneyo nemfutshane exhasa umgangatho ofanayo netshaja (PD njl.), uze utshintshe iikhebula ezindala.

p-089.title: Ukomisa impahla ngelanga nomoya wentwasahlobo
p-089.summary: Ukuphelisa amanzi empahleni emanzi kufuna amandla amaninzi. Ilanga nomoya zikunika la mandla simahla.
p-089.principle: Ubushushu obufihlakeleyo bokuphuma $Q=mL$ ($L=2.26\times10^6$), izinga lokuphuma $E\propto(a+bu)(e_s-e_a)$ (kwandiswa ngomoya $u$).
p-089.example: Ukuphelisa amanzi ku-1kg yempahla kufuna $2.26$MJ $\approx0.63$kWh. Ukusebenzisa ukuphuma kwe-1,000rpm okanye ngaphezulu kunye nomoya we-2m/s kwenza yome ngokukhawuleza kunangaphakathi, kwaye ugcina malunga nama-2~3kWh asetyenziswa ngumatshini wokomisa. Ngemini enentsimbi yeentyatyambo, sebenzisa ngaphakathi.
p-089.actionItem: Emva kokuphuma, qhwatha impahla uyiphahle uyibeke elangeni kwindawo enomoya kunye nesithuba.

p-090.title: Ukutshintsha ii-tyre ekuqaleni kwentwasahlobo, amanati evili angavulekiyo
p-090.summary: Xa uguqula kumavili asebusika ukuya kwiqhelekileyo, amanati akhululeka kunzima ngenxa yamandla ajikelezayo afunekayo. I-wrench ende yehlisa amandla.
p-090.example: Ukukhulula inati yevili le-torque elinikiweyo malunga nama-110N·m nge-wrench yemitha ye-0.3 kufuna malunga nama-370N, nge-wrench yemitha ye-0.6 malunga nama-183N, isiqingatha. Kodwa xa ucinezela, ungazisebenzisi iipayipi ukuhlomisa, ugcine ixabiso elicetyiswayo nge-torque wrench.
p-090.actionItem: Phambi kokuphakamisa imoto nge-jack, khulula inati ngesiqingatha sejikelezo imoto ityhutyha emhlabeni, uze usebenze kwindawo ethe tyaba.

p-091.title: Ibhegi yokukhwela intaba, beka izinto ezinzima kufutshane nomqolo
p-091.summary: Xa ibhegi ikude nomzimba, amandla ajikelezayo kumqolo nakwiintsiba ayanda. Ukubeka izinto ezinzima ngasemqolo nokudlulisela umthwalo ngebhanti yomqolo kunciphisa ukudinwa.
p-091.principle: Torque $\tau=mgd$ ($d$: umgama ukusuka kwi-axis yomzimba ukuya kwindawo yomxhuzulane yomthwalo).
p-091.example: Ukuba umthwalo we-6kg ukwi-25cm ukusuka emzimbeni, $\tau=6\times9.8\times0.25=14.7$ N·m, xa ubekwe kwi-10cm, ibe yi-5.9N·m, ukwehla malunga nama-60%. Yenza ibhanti yomqolo idlulisele i-70% yomthwalo ezinqeni.
p-091.actionItem: Beka izinto ezinzima ngaphakathi kwebhegi njengebhotile yamanzi okanye ibhokisi yesidlo kumbindi ngasemqolo, ucinezele ibhanti yomqolo, uze uhambe.

p-092.title: Ukuvulela umoya imizuzu eyi-10 ngokuvula ezimbini ezijongene
p-092.summary: Ukuvula iifestile ezimbini ezijongene kutshintsha umoya wangaphakathi ngokukhawuleza kunokuvula enye kuphela.
p-092.principle: Ukuhamba komoya kulandela ifomula kaBernoulli $p+\tfrac{1}{2}\rho v^2=\mathrm{const}$ kunye nomlinganiselo $Q=Av$. Xa kukho ukungena nokuphuma, umoya uyadlula, kwandise ukutshintsha komoya.
p-092.example: Egumbini le-75m³, xa umoya we-1m/s ungena ngokuvula kwe-0.5m², $Q=0.5\times1=0.5\ \mathrm{m^3/s}$ (1,800m³/h). Eneneni, kutshintshwa amaxesha angama-5~10 ngeyure, ngoko imizuzu eyi-10 iyaneleyo, kodwa ukuvula ifestile enye kuphela kuthi kube kuphela kwesi-1~2.
p-092.actionItem: Namhlanje vula ngaxeshanye iifestile ezijongene (okanye isango nefestile) uvelise umoya imizuzu eyi-10.

p-093.title: Uxinzelelo lwe-tyre yebhayisikili nokumelana nokujikeleza
p-093.summary: Xa uxinzelelo lwe-tyre lungonelanga, ukuhamba ngesantya esifanayo kuba nzima kakhulu.
p-093.principle: Ukumelana nokujikeleza $F_\mathrm{rr}=C_\mathrm{rr}\,mg$, xa umoya uphuma indawo yokungqubana inyuka, ilahleko yokutshintsha imo yanda ze $C_\mathrm{rr}$ inyuke.
p-093.example: Xa ubunzima obupheleleyo bungu-80kg, xa $C_\mathrm{rr}$ inyuka ukusuka kwi-0.005 ukuya kwi-0.010, $F_\mathrm{rr}$ iphindwa kabini ukusuka kuma-3.9N ukuya kuma-7.8N, kwaye kwi-20km/h (5.6m/s) kwanda ukusuka kuma-22W ukuya kuma-44W.
p-093.actionItem: Phambi kokuhamba, tshaja i-tyre ngoxinzelelo olucetyiswayo (psi/bar) olubhalwe ecaleni kwe-tyre.

p-094.title: Imaski yothuli lwaseTshayina igqitha ngombane omileyo
p-094.summary: Iimaski ze-KF zibamba uthuli oluncinci ngombane omileyo, hayi ngemingxuma emincinci, ngoko xa zichukumisa amanzi okanye utywala, ukusebenza kwazo kuyehla.
p-094.principle: Imicu yesihluzi ineeitshaji ezingapheliyo ezitsala iinkozo ngamandla kaCoulomb $F=k\dfrac{q_1q_2}{r^2}$. Xa kungena amanzi, utywala okanye ukubila, itshaji iyanyamalala.
p-094.example: I-KF94 ihluza ngaphezulu kwama-94% eenkozo ze-0.4μm, kodwa emva kokusasazwa kotywala ukusebenza kunokuya ngaphantsi kwama-80%. Ukusetyenziswa kwesihlandlo esinye kusidla ngokufanela usuku olunye (malunga neeyure ezi-8 ubuninzi).
p-094.actionItem: Musa ukuhlamba okanye ukutshiza i-disinfectant kwimaski, kwaye ukuba imanzi okanye iguquliwe, utshintshe ngenye entsha namhlanje.

p-095.title: Ikofu yedrip nomlambo wamanzi
p-095.summary: Ukuthulula umlambo omncinci wamanzi ngokucotha kwenza ukukhutshwa kulingane, ngoko ufumana incasa enamandla kwiimbotyi ezifanayo.
p-095.principle: Umlomo omncinci unyusa isantya sokuhamba $v=Q/A$ kwaye udala ukuphazamiseka ukuze uxube umgubo ngokulinganayo. Ukukhutshwa kuxhomekeke kwixesha lokunxibelelana nobushushu.
p-095.example: Imigangatho eqhelekileyo kukuthulula i-250mL yamanzi ayi-92~96°C kwi-15g yeembotyi kwimizuzu engama-2 nemizuzwana engama-30 ukuya kwemi-3. Ukuba uthulula amanzi onke kwimizuzwana engama-30, ixesha lonxibelelwano lehla libe nesihlanu, ize incasa ibe buthathaka noburharha.
p-095.actionItem: Namhlanje ekuseni thulula amanzi kwiinxalenye ezintathu, ngomlambo omncinci, ngokucotha.

p-096.title: Ukunciphisa ukukhanya kwesikrini kunciphisa nombane
p-096.summary: Amandla e-backlight yeLCD alingana kakhulu nokukhanya, ngoko ukuhlisa ukukhanya kunciphisa umbane nokudinwa kwamehlo kunye.
p-096.principle: Amandla e-backlight alingana nokukhanya $P\approx kB$ ngendlela $B$, kwaye ixesha elipheleleyo $P=P_0+kB$.
p-096.example: Ukuba kwi-40W epheleleyo i-backlight ineewati ezingama-25 kwi-100% yokukhanya, kwi-50% iyehla ngama-12.5W, igcina malunga nama-31%. Iiyure ezi-8 ngosuku zibe $0.0125\times8\times30\approx3$ kWh ngenyanga.
p-096.actionItem: Namhlanje hlisa ukukhanya kwesikrini somonitha okanye iTV malunga ne-50% ukuhambelana nokukhanya okujikelezileyo.

p-097.title: Imbiza ye-induction kufuneka ibe nesiseko esithe tye
p-097.summary: I-induction ishushubeza ngokudala umbane kwisiseko sembiza, ngoko xa isiseko sigobile, ukusebenza kobushushu kuyehla.
p-097.principle: Umazibuko ojikelezayo wenza umbane ojikelezayo kwisiseko sembiza kwaye uphuma ubushushu nge-Joule $P=I^2R$. Xa isithuba phakathi kwesiseko nesitovu sikhulu, ukudibana kuba buthathaka.
p-097.example: Ukusebenza kwe-induction malunga nama-85~90%, ephezulu kuneyesitovu segesi (malunga nama-40~50%). Ukuba isiseko siphakanyiswe ngaphezulu kwe-2mm, ukusebenza kuyehla ngokubonakalayo kwaye ukubilisa kuthatha imizuzu embalwa ngaphezulu.
p-097.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga ukuba isiseko sembiza sibekwe kumphezulu othe tye singashukumi okanye singaphakanyiswa.

p-098.title: Beka iincwadi ezinzima kufutshane nesixhasi senkqantosi
p-098.summary: Nangona kuyingcinga efanayo, xa ikude nesixhasi, imomenti yenkqantosi iyanda ize ibhitye okanye iwe.
p-098.example: Iincwadi ze-5kg (malunga nama-49N) ezibekwe kwi-5cm ukusuka kwisixhasi zinika $M\approx2.5\ \mathrm{N\,m}$, kwi-25cm $M\approx12\ \mathrm{N\,m}$, amaxesha amahlanu.
p-098.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ucwangcisa iinkqantosi, beka izinto ezinzima kufutshane nodonga nesixhasi, nezilula ngaphandle.

p-099.title: Musa ukugcina ucango lwefriji luvulekile ixesha elide
p-099.summary: Xa uvula ucango, umoya obandayo uyaphuma, kwaye umoya ofudumeleyo uyangena, ngoko ikhompresa kufuneka isebenze kwakhona.
p-099.principle: Umoya uhamba ngokwahluko kobuninzi kwaye ubushushu bungena $Q=mc\Delta T$. Umoya wefriji eyi-300L malunga ne-0.36kg.
p-099.example: Ukuvula ucango imizuzwana engama-30 kunyusa ubushushu bangaphakathi ukusuka kwi-4°C ukuya kufutshane nama-10°C, kwaye ukuphola kwakhona kufuna imizuzu eyi-10~20 yokusebenza kwekhompresa. Ukuvula ngokungeyomfuneko amaxesha angama-20 ngosuku kunganyusa umbane wenyanga nge-2~4%.
p-099.actionItem: Namhlanje phambi kokuvula ucango lwefriji, wenze isigqibo sento oza kuyikhupha uze uvale ngaphakathi kwemizuzwana eyi-10.

p-100.title: Ingxolo yehla nge-6dB xa umgama uphindwe kabini
p-100.summary: Ukuhamba kude nomthombo wesandi kuphela kunciphisa ingxolo kakhulu, yindlela elula kakhulu yokukhusela ukuva.
p-100.principle: Amandla omthombo wesixa $I\propto1/r^2$ kwaye inqanaba loxinzelelo lwesandi $L=10\log_{10}(I/I_0)$. Xa umgama uphindwe kabini, $\Delta L=-20\log_{10}2\approx-6\ \mathrm{dB}$.
p-100.example: Isipikha esine-90dB kwi-1m sibe ne-84dB kwi-2m, 78dB kwi-4m. I-85dB iyiyure ezi-8, i-91dB iyiyure ezi-2 njengomda ocetyiswayo wokubonakalisa, ngoko ukugcina umgama kwandisa ixesha elikhuselekileyo.
p-100.actionItem: Namhlanje kwiindawo zomculo okanye zokwakha, yima kude ngokuphindwe kabini nasezipikheni okanye kwimithombo yengxolo.

p-101.title: Ukuphindwa kabini kwesantya kuphindaphinda umgama wokubreka amaxesha amane
p-101.summary: Ukunciphisa isantya sokuqhuba kancinci kunciphisa umgama wokubreka kakhulu, ngoko ngokuhlisa ingozi yeengozi.
p-101.principle: Umgama wokubreka kwi-kinetic energy $\tfrac{1}{2}mv^2=\mu mg\,d$ ngu-$d=\dfrac{v^2}{2\mu g}$. Ulingana nesikwere sesantya.
p-101.example: Kwindlela eyomileyo ($\mu\approx0.7$) i-50km/h (13.9m/s) malunga ne-14m, i-100km/h (27.8m/s) malunga nama-56m, amaxesha amane. Kwindlela emanzi ($\mu\approx0.4$) kwi-100km/h kufuneka malunga nama-98m.
p-101.actionItem: Ngomhla wemvula, namhlanje hlisa nge-20% kunomda wesantya ubeke umgama ophindwe kabini kwimoto engaphambili.

p-102.title: Linganisa kwindawo eqinileyo ethe tye
p-102.summary: Kwikhaphethi ethambileyo okanye kumgangatho otyekeleyo, amandla awasebenzi ngokulinganayo kwisensa yesikali, ngoko iziphumo ziyaphazamiseka.
p-102.principle: Isikali silinganisa ngesixa $W=\sum F_i$ seesensa ezine zeekona. Xa umgangatho utyekele okanye uthambile, ukwabiwa komthwalo kwisensa nganye kuyahluka.
p-102.example: Ubunzima be-70kg bunika $mg\approx686$ N ohlulwa phakathi kweesensa ezine malunga nama-171N ngesensa, kodwa xa unyawo olunye lucinezelwa kumgangatho othambileyo, isensa enye ifumana ngakumbi, kudale impazamo.
p-102.actionItem: Gcina isikali kwindawo eqinileyo ethe tye njengethayile yegumbi lokuhlamba, uze ulinganise kwindawo enye rhoqo.

p-103.title: Isongezelelo se-suction sidinga ukukhupha umoya ukuze sinamathele
p-103.summary: Amandla okunamathisela esongezelelo se-suction sasegumbini lokuhlamba ayiyiyo i-glue kodwa amandla acinezelwa ngoxinzelelo lomoya wangaphandle.
p-103.principle: Amandla e-suction $F=\Delta P\cdot A$. Ukukhupha umoya ongaphakathi kudala umahluko kuxinzelelo lomoya wangaphandle (malunga nama-101kPa) ocinezela icwecwe.
p-103.example: Indawo yecwecwe lobubanzi be-5cm ngu-$A=\pi(0.025)^2\approx1.96\times10^{-3}\ \mathrm{m^2}$, ngoko amandla aphezulu anokwenzeka kukuba $101{,}000\times1.96\times10^{-3}\approx198$ N. Eneneni, incinci kakhulu ngenxa yomoya ophumayo.
p-103.actionItem: Phambi kokunamathisela, sula amanzi nothuli kwithayile okanye kwiglasi, cinezela ukuze ukhuphe umoya, uze ulenge ngaphandle kokudlula umthwalo ovumelekileyo obonisiweyo.

p-104.title: Cima izibane ngexesha lasemini usebenzisa ukukhanya kwefestile
p-104.summary: Ngomhla wentwasahlobo ocacileyo, ukukhanya kwendalo ecaleni kwefestile kukhanya amaxesha amaninzi kunokukhanya ngaphakathi, ngoko emini ngokuqhelekileyo kwanela ukucima izibane.
p-104.principle: Ukukhanya $E=\Phi/A$ (iyunithi lx). Ngomhla ocacileyo ecaleni kwefestile ngokuqhelekileyo ngaphezu kwe-1,000 lx, ukukhanya kwangaphakathi okucetyiswayo kwiofisi nokufunda kungama-300~500 lx.
p-104.example: Ukucima iibhalbhu ezintathu ze-LED ze-8W (24W) kwigumbi lokuhlala iiyure ezi-6 emini kugcina $0.024\times6\times30\approx4.3$ kWh ngenyanga.
p-104.actionItem: Namhlanje emini vula iikhethini uze uhambise itafile okanye indawo yokufunda ecaleni kwefestile ucime izibane.

p-105.title: Thelekisa ifeni ngevolumu yomoya (CMM) kunye nengxolo
p-105.summary: Nangona ububanzi bufanayo, ubuninzi bomoya buyahluka. Ubuninzi bomoya bumiselwa sisiphumo sendawo yebhleyidi nesantya somoya.
p-105.principle: Ubuninzi bomoya yi-$Q=Av$ (iyunithi $\mathrm{m^3/min}$). Indawo yefeni yobubanzi $D$ ngu-$A=\pi D^2/4$.
p-105.example: Xa ifeni yobubanzi be-0.3m ($A\approx0.071\ \mathrm{m^2}$) iphephetha ngesantya esiphakathi sama-3m/s, $Q\approx0.21\ \mathrm{m^3/s}\approx12.8\ \mathrm{m^3/min}$, kwaye ixuba umoya wegumbi le-30 $\mathrm{m^3}$ kanye kwimizuzu emi-2 nemizuzwana engama-20.
p-105.actionItem: Xa uthenga ifeni okanye i-circulator, thelekisa ivolumu yomoya (CMM), ingxolo (dB) nokusetyenziswa kwamandla (W) kwitheyibhile yemveliso.

p-106.title: Isikrini sezinambuzane xa shinyene sithintela izinambuzane kodwa sinciphisa umoya
p-106.summary: Xa inani lemesh landa, imingxuma incipha ithintele izinambuzane ezincinci, kodwa indawo apho umoya udlula (inqanaba lokuvuleka) nayo iyehla.
p-106.principle: Ubungakanani bomngxuma malunga $25.4/N-d$ mm ($N$: inani leentambo ngeintshi, $d$: ububanzi bentambo) kwaye inqanaba lokuvuleka $\varphi=\left(\dfrac{p-d}{p}\right)^2$ ($p=25.4/N$).
p-106.example: Ukuba ububanzi bentambo bungu-0.25mm, i-18 mesh inomngxuma malunga ne-1.16mm, ivuleke malunga nama-68%, kwaye i-24 mesh inomngxuma malunga ne-0.81mm, ivuleke malunga nama-58%.
p-106.actionItem: Phambi kokutshintsha isikrini sezinambuzane, nquma ubungakanani bezinambuzane ofuna ukuzithintela nenqanaba lomoya ofunekayo, uze ukhethe inani le-mesh.

p-107.title: Umbane ongaphezulu ufunekayo ngokweyisa itshaja
p-107.summary: Amandla asuka kwisokethi makhulu kunalawo angena kwibhetri yefowuni. Umahluko ulahleka njengobushushu kwitshaja nebhetri.
p-107.example: Ibhetri ye-5,000 mAh·3.85V malunga nama-19.3Wh. Ukuba ukusebenza kwetshaja kungama-85%, kusetyenziswa $19.3/0.85\approx22.7$ Wh kwisokethi, kwaye ukutshaja amaxesha angama-300 ngonyaka kuba malunga nama-6.8kWh.
p-107.actionItem: Namhlanje xa utshaja, sebenzisa i-adapter egunyaziswe okanye yomgangatho ofanayo, uze utshaje kwindawo enomoya hayi phantsi kwengubo.

p-108.title: Ukuthobisa intloko kuninzi, umthwalo emqaleni uba mkhulu
p-108.summary: Ubunzima bentloko bufuna amandla amakhulu emisipha yentamo xa buhamba ngaphambili kwiintsimbi zentamo ngenxa yempembelelo yelebha.
p-108.principle: Xa ubunzima bentloko $W$ bukude ngaphambili $d$ ukusuka kwindawo yokuxhasa intamo, kudalwa imomenti $M=Wd$, kwaye imisipha kufuneka iyixhase.
p-108.example: Ubunzima bentloko malunga nama-5 kgf, kwaye imodeli yophando ibonisa ukuba ukuthobisa intloko nge-15° kuyandisa umthwalo wentamo ukuya kuma-12 kgf, kwi-60° ukuya kuma-27 kgf.
p-108.actionItem: Namhlanje phakamisa isikrini seleptop okanye sefowuni ukuya kumgangatho wamehlo, uze uphakamise intloko uwolule intamo yakho rhoqo emva kwemizuzu engama-30.

p-109.title: Itafile enemilenze emine ixhuma kwiindawo ezintathu, ngoko iyashukuma
p-109.summary: Umphezulu uchazwa ngamanqaku amathathu, ngoko ukuba umlenze wesine awukho kumphezulu ofanayo, omnye umlenze uhlala uphakanyisiwe, ize itafile ishukume.
p-109.principle: Imeko yokulingana $\sum F=W$ kunye $\sum M=0$. Inkxaso yamanqaku amathathu ihlala izinzile, kodwa amane axhuma kuphela xa esemphezulwini ofanayo.
