p-109.example: Ukuba umlenze omnye ufutshane nge-1mm, loo mlenze uphakanyisiwe, kwaye imilenze emithathu esele yabelana ngomthwalo. Iphepha elinye elisongiweyo lidla ngokuba ne-0.1~0.2mm, ngoko kufuneka usonge amaphepha ambalwa.
p-109.actionItem: Faka iphepha elisongiweyo okanye iphedi yokulungisa ukuphakama phantsi komlenze oshukumayo, uze ukuba kulingene, ucinezele ngesandla ujonge ukushukuma.

p-110.title: Xa umlambo wamanzi e-shower uba buthathaka
p-110.summary: Xa umhlaba we-lime ulungele kwimingxuma ye-shower, imingxuma iyaqina kwaye ukuhamba kwehla kakhulu.
p-110.principle: Ukuhamba komsinga kumbhobho omncinci ngumthetho wePoiseuille $Q=\dfrac{\pi r^4\Delta P}{8\eta L}$, ulingana nobukhulu bomgama kwi-4.
p-110.example: Ukuba umgama wemingxuma wehla nge-20%, ukuhamba kuba $0.8^4\approx0.41$ amaxesha, ukwehla nge-59%. Ukufaka intloko ye-shower emanzini avingciweyo nge-vinegar malunga ne-1:1 imizuzu engama-30 kunyibilikisa i-lime.
p-110.actionItem: Namhlanje susa intloko ye-shower uyifake kwi-vinegar ehlanjululweyo imizuzu engama-30, uze uyihlambe.

p-111.title: Uxinzelelo lwamanzi lwentente ngoomm lubonakalisa ukuphakama kwekholamu yamanzi
p-111.summary: Ukumelana namanzi entente yekampu ngexesha lemvula kuthetha ukuphakama kwekholamu yamanzi (mm) elixhaswa lilaphu.
p-111.principle: Uxinzelelo olumileyo $P=\rho g h$. Ikholamu yamanzi ye-1,000mm malunga ne-9.8kPa.
p-111.example: Ukumelana namanzi kwe-1,500mm yilaphu elixhasa $1000\times9.8\times1.5=14.7$ kPa. Kwimvula enamandla nakumgangatho ocinezelwa bubunzima babantu, ixabiso eliphezulu lilunge ngakumbi.
p-111.actionItem: Phambi kokukampa ngexesha lemvula, jonga ukumelana namanzi kwelebhile yentente (kucetyiswa ngaphezulu kwe-1,500mm kwi-fly) kunye nemeko yokutywina iindawo zokudibanisa.

p-112.title: Jonga i-gasket yocango lwefriji ngephepha elinye
p-112.summary: Ukuba i-gasket yerabha yocango ikhululekile, umoya ofudumeleyo uyangena, ngoko ikhompresa isebenza ixesha elide.
p-112.principle: Ubushushu obungena ngokuhamba kwezithuba $\dot Q=\dot m c_p\Delta T$. Xa indawo yesithuba inkulu, ukuhamba komoya nokungena kobushushu kuyanda.
p-112.example: Ukuba isithuba esiqhelekileyo sine-1mm, umjikelo wocango yi-3m, indawo yesithuba $0.001\times3=3\times10^{-3}\ \mathrm{m^2}$, oko kukuthi i-30cm², okufana nomngxuma owomkhulu wesandla ovulekileyo.
p-112.actionItem: Faka iphepha elinye kwisithuba socango, uvale, uze utsale. Ukuba kukho indawo ephuma lula, sula okanye utshintshe i-gasket.

p-113.title: Umbane osetyenziswa zizixhobo ekugqibeleni uba bubushushu egumbini
p-113.summary: Phantse wonke amandla ombane ekugqibeleni aguqulwa abe bubushushu aze anyuse ubushushu begumbi. Umthwalo we-aircon uyanda kunye.
p-113.principle: Ngokulondolozwa kwamandla $Q=Pt$. Amandla asetyenziswa sisixhobo $P$ phantse ngokupheleleyo aba bubushushu begumbi.
p-113.example: Ikhompyutha ye-100W isetyenziswe iiyure ezi-4 $0.1\times4=0.4$ kWh, oko kukuthi malunga nama-1.44MJ, ashiyeka njengobushushu egumbini, ngokufana nesishushubezi esincinci se-100W.
p-113.actionItem: Namhlanje cima iikhompyutha, izibane nezitshaji ezingasetyenziswayo ukunciphisa imithombo yobushushu begumbi.

p-114.title: Thelekisa ilebhile yokusebenza kwamandla nge-kWh yonyaka
p-114.summary: Ungajongi kuphela amanqanaba; ukuthelekisa i-kWh yonyaka (okanye yenyanga) kwilebhile kukubonisa ukusetyenziswa kombane okwenyani.
p-114.principle: Amandla asetyenzisiweyo $E=Pt$ (kWh). Umahluko wamandla asetyenziswa ngonyaka, xa uphindaphindwa ngexesha lokusetyenziswa, uba ngumahluko ophelele wombane osetyenzisiweyo.
p-114.example: Ifriji ye-300kWh ngonyaka nefriji ye-450kWh ngonyaka zinomahluko we-150kWh ngonyaka, i-1,500kWh kwiminyaka eyi-10.
p-114.actionItem: Xa uthenga isixhobo, thelekisa inqanaba lokusebenza kwamandla kunye ne-kWh yonyaka kwilebhile.

p-115.title: Khetha i-air purifier nge-CADR nomthamo wegumbi
p-115.summary: Ngexesha lothuli lwaseTshayina, ukusebenza kwe-purifier kufuneka kulingane nobukhulu begumbi. Okuphambili kukuba umoya uhluzwa amaxesha amaphi ngeyure.
p-115.principle: Inani lokutshintsha komoya ngeyure $\mathrm{ACH}=\mathrm{CADR}/V$. I-CADR yisixa somoya ococekileyo ($\mathrm{m^3/h}$).
p-115.example: Ukusebenzisa i-purifier ye-CADR $\mathrm{m^3/h}$ egumbini le-25 $\mathrm{m^2}$ × 2.4m = 60 $\mathrm{m^3}$, kuba $300/60=5$ amaxesha ngeyure.
p-115.actionItem: Namhlanje phindaphinda indawo yegumbi nokuphakama kophahla ufumane umthamo, uze ujonge ukuba i-CADR ye-purifier ingaphezulu kwamaxesha amahlanu omthamo.

p-116.title: Umkhenkce wegilasi lemoto ngenxa ye-dew point
p-116.summary: Xa ubushushu begilasi buba ngaphantsi kwe-dew point yomoya wangaphakathi, umphunga wamanzi uyanyibilika ube ngumkhenkce.
p-116.principle: I-dew point $\mathrm{RH}$ inqunywa ngomswakama onxulumeneyo $T_d$ nobushushu bomoya, kwaye ifomula kaMagnus $T_d\approx\dfrac{243.12\,\gamma}{17.62-\gamma}$, $\gamma=\ln\mathrm{RH}+\dfrac{17.62\,T}{243.12+T}$.
p-116.example: Ngaphakathi kwe-22°C, umswakama onxulumeneyo we-70%, i-dew point malunga ne-16.3°C. Ukuba ubushushu begilasi buyi-10°C, kuba nomkhenkce, kwaye ukuvula i-aircon (ukunciphisa umswakama) kunye nomoya ofudumeleyo kunciphisa umswakama ngaphezulu kwegilasi.
p-116.actionItem: Xa igilasi langaphambili linomkhenkce, namhlanje cinezela iqhosha le-aircon uze utshintshele kwisetingi yomoya wangaphandle ukunciphisa umswakama.

p-117.title: Sika izinto ezishinyeneyo ngaphakathi kwebhleyidi yesikere
p-117.summary: Isikere yilebha, ngoko ngokusondela kwi-axis ngaphakathi kwebhleyidi, ngamandla esandla afanayo kuvela amandla okusika amakhulu.
p-117.principle: Ukulingana kwelebha $F_{\text{usiko}}\,d_c=F_{\text{isandla}}\,d_h$. Xa indawo yokusika isondele kwi-axis, $d_c$ incipha ize $F_{\text{usiko}}$ ibe nkulu.
p-117.example: Xa $d_h=10$ cm ukusuka esandleni ukuya kwi-axis, xa indawo yokusika ikwi-3cm ukusuka kwi-axis, amandla esandla e-50N aba $50\times10/3\approx167$ N. Ekupheleni (10cm) ahlala eyi-50N.
p-117.actionItem: Namhlanje xa usika izinto zokupakisha okanye ikhadibhodi ezishinyeneyo, zibambe zinzulu ngaphakathi kwebhleyidi yesikere uze usike.

p-118.title: Ukunyuka ngezitepsi kungumthambo omhle ngokobuninzi bamandla
p-118.summary: Ukunyuka umgangatho omnye ngenyawo kuthetha ukwenza umsebenzi wokuphakamisa umzimba, ngoko kudala amandla aphezulu ngexesha elifutshane.
p-118.principle: Amandla okunyuka $P=\dfrac{mgh}{t}$. Yingeniso yamandla endawo $mgh$ ahlulwe ngexesha elithathiweyo.
p-118.example: Umntu onobunzima obuyi-70kg unyuka umgangatho omnye (3m) kwiisekhondi ezili-15, $P=70\times9.8\times3/15\approx137$ W. Ngelo xesha amandla endawo omgangatho omnye malunga nama-2.1kJ, kwaye ngokucinga ukusebenza kwemisipha kwe-25%, amandla e-metabolic malunga nama-2kcal.
p-118.actionItem: Namhlanje endaweni yelifti nyuka imigangatho emibini ngezitepsi, ubambe iliveyili ukuze uhambe ngokukhuselekileyo.

p-119.title: Kwi-adapter yohambo jonga i-voltage nombane, hayi imo yeplagi
p-119.summary: Ayizizo zonke izixhobo ezinokusetyenziswa nje ngokuba iplagi ilingana. Xa i-voltage yamazwe ahluka, umbane nokhuseleko lwesixhobo kuyahluka.
p-119.principle: Amandla $P=VI$, ngoko kumandla afanayo xa i-voltage iphantsi, umbane $I=P/V$ uba mkhulu.
p-119.example: Isixhobo se-1,500W kwi-220V sine-$I\approx6.8$ A, kodwa xa sisetyenziswa nge-transformer kwilizwe le-110V siba $I\approx13.6$ A, kwaye kulula ukugqitha ukulinganiswa kwe-adapter.
p-119.actionItem: Phambi kohambo, jonga i-voltage yendawo ofika kuyo kunye ne-voltage yokufaka kwilebhile yesixhobo sakho (umzekelo 100-240V), uze ujonge umbane ovumelekileyo we-adapter.

p-120.title: Kwibhasi emiswa ngesiquphe, goba amadolo uphahlise iinyawo
p-120.summary: Xa ibhasi ibreka ngesiquphe, umzimba uyatyhalwa ngaphambili yi-inertia. Isimo kunye nokungqubana kwenyawo kuthintela ukuwa.
p-120.principle: Amandla e-inertia $F=ma$, kwaye ukuze unyawo lungafiki lutyibilike, ukungqubana kufuneka kube $\mu\ge a/g$.
p-120.example: Ukuba ukunciphisa isantya $a=3\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$ (malunga ne-0.3g), umntu onobunzima obuyi-60kg ufumana malunga nama-180N ngaphambili, kwaye ukungqubana kwesihlangu nomgangatho kufuneka kube $\mu\ge0.31$ ukuze kungatyibilika.
p-120.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba umi ebhasini okanye kwitreyini, phahlisa iinyawo ngokubhekisa kwicala lokuhamba uze ubambe isibambo.

p-121.title: Ummese obukhali udinga amandla ambalwa
p-121.summary: Xa ibhleyidi ibukhali, indawo yonxibelelwano incinci, ngoko ngamandla afanayo uxinzelelo luba lukhulu kakhulu, ize into yohlulwe ngokulula.
p-121.principle: Uxinzelelo $P=\dfrac{F}{A}$. Xa indawo yomphetho $A$ incinci, kumandla afanayo $F$, $P$ iba nkulu.
p-121.example: Ukuba ububanzi bomphetho wobude obungu-1cm bungu-0.02mm, $A=2\times10^{-6}\ \mathrm{m^2}$, kwi-20N, $P=10\ \mathrm{MPa}$. Xa ibuthuntu kwi-0.2mm, iba yi-1MPa, isixa seshumi, ngoko kufuneka ucinezele ngamandla ngakumbi, kwanda ingozi yokutyibilika nokonzakala.
p-121.actionItem: Namhlanje vavanya ukuba ummese owusebenzisayo usika iphepha elinye ngokulula na, kwaye ukuba ubuthuntu, uwukhaphe ngelitye lokukhaphela okanye umatshini wokukhaphela.

p-122.title: Musa ukucima nokuvula i-aircon ye-inverter
p-122.summary: I-aircon ye-inverter ilungisa isantya sekhompresa ukugcina ubushushu obusetiweyo, ngoko kungcono ukuyishiya ivuliwe.
p-122.principle: Isalathisi sokusebenza kokupholisa $\mathrm{COP}=\dfrac{Q_c}{W}$ siba siphezulu kumthwalo ongaphelelanga kuba i-heat exchanger inkulu ngokunxulumene nomahluko wobushushu obuncitshisiweyo.
p-122.example: Ukuba uhlobo lwesantya esisigxina lusebenzisa ngokomndilili ama-480W (0.8kW×ukusebenza kwe-60%), kwaye i-inverter malunga nama-300W, kwiiyure ezi-6 ngosuku yi-2.88 ngokuchasene ne-1.8kWh, ngeentsuku ezingama-30 igcina malunga nama-32kWh.
p-122.actionItem: Namhlanje setha i-aircon kwi-26~28°C uyishiye ivuliwe ngokuqhubekayo.

p-123.title: Yenza isithunzi kwisixhobo sangaphandle se-air conditioner
p-123.summary: Xa umoya ojikeleze isixhobo sangaphandle upholile, i-compressor isebenza kancinci kwaye iyapholisa ngokulinganayo ngombane omncinci.
p-123.principle: Ukusebenza okufanelekileyo kokuphola yi-COP ka-Carnot $\mathrm{COP}_\mathrm{max}=\dfrac{T_c}{T_h-T_c}$. Ubushushu bokuxinana $T_h$ xa buphantsi, ixabiso likhula.
p-123.example: Xa ubushushu bomphunga $T_c=280\ \mathrm{K}$, $T_h=318\ \mathrm{K}$ yi-7.4 kwaye $308\ \mathrm{K}$ yi-10, malunga ne-35% ephezulu. Kwisixhobo sokwenyani, ukunciphisa ubushushu bomoya ongenayo nge-3–5°C kunciphisa umbane nge-5–10%.
p-123.actionItem: Namhlanje beka isithunzi ngaphezulu kwesixhobo sangaphandle, kodwa ungavali ukuhamba komoya kwi-30cm okanye ngaphezulu ngaphambili nangasemva.

p-124.title: Sebenzisa i-air conditioner kunye nefeni
p-124.summary: Xa ifeni ivelisa umoya, ubushushu obuvakalayo buyehla nge-2–3°C kwaye ungaphakamisa useto lwe-air conditioner.
p-124.principle: Ukulahleka kobushushu besikhumba ngokuhamba kwemoya yi-$Q=hA(T_s-T_a)$, kwaye xa isantya somoya sikhula, i-coefficient yokudluliselwa kobushushu $h$ iyakhula.
p-124.example: Isikhumba 33°C, igumbi 28°C, indawo 1.8m², ngaphandle komoya $h\approx5$ ilahlekelwa ngama-45W, kwaye ngomoya we-1m/s $h\approx10$ ilahlekelwa malunga nama-90W kwaye iyapholisa. Ukuphakamisa useto nge-1°C kunciphisa umbane malunga ne-5–10%.
p-124.actionItem: Namhlanje phakamisa i-air conditioner ibe yi-28°C uqhube ifeni ngesantya esiphantsi kunye nayo.

p-125.title: Pholisa iqokobhe lesiselo ngokukhawuleza ngetawula yasekhitshini emanzi
p-125.summary: Ngomgaqo wokuba amanzi athatha ubushushu xa ebhanga, ukusonga iphepha elimanzi nokuvula emoyeni kwenza isiselo sehle ngamanqanaba ambalwa.
p-125.principle: Ukubhanga kufuna ubushushu $Q=mL_v$, kwaye kumanzi $L_v\approx2.4\ \mathrm{kJ/g}$. Olu bushushu lufunyanwa kwisiselo.
p-125.example: Amanzi ayi-10g xa ebhanga afunxa malunga ne-24kJ, ngoko isiselo se-355mL sehla ngokwethiyori $\Delta T=24/(0.355\times4.0)\approx17\ \mathrm{K}$. Kwinyani yi-5–8°C ngemizuzu eyi-10 phantsi komoya.
p-125.actionItem: Namhlanje songa iqokobhe elifudumeleyo ngetawula yasekhitshini emanzi uyibeke phambi kwefeni imizuzu eyi-10.

p-126.title: Isithunzi sisebenza kakuhle xa sikwindawo engaphandle kweglasi
p-126.summary: Xa uvala ilanga emva kokuba lidlule kwiglasi, ubushushu sele bungene ngaphakathi. Isithunzi sangaphandle sisebenza kakhulu.
p-126.principle: Ubushushu belanga obungena ngefestile yi-$Q=\mathrm{SHGC}\times A\times I$. Ukufaka isixhobo sokuvala kunciphisa i-SHGC esebenzayo.
p-126.example: Kwifestile ye-2m², ilanga 600W/m², iglasi ecacileyo (SHGC 0.8) yi-960W, ikhethini yangaphakathi (0.5) yi-600W, kwaye isithunzi sangaphandle (0.15) malunga ne-180W, ukuncitshiswa malunga ne-80%.
p-126.actionItem: Namhlanje phanda izithunzi onokuzibeka ngaphandle kwefestile (i-awning, iblinds zeqabaka, iscreen sokuqengqeleka).

p-127.title: Ngaphakathi kwemoto emisiweyo kushushu ngokukhawuleza
p-127.summary: Ngaphantsi kwelanga, ngaphakathi kwemoto ubushushu buvalelwe njengegreenhouse, kwaye kuyingozi ukushiya umntwana okanye isilwanyana sasekhaya nokuba ngexesha elifutshane.
p-127.principle: Iglasi ivumela ukukhanya kwelanga kwamaza amafutshane ukuba kudlule, kodwa ivalela amaza amade (infrared) akhutshwa ngaphakathi okufudumeleyo. Ubushushu obufunxiweyo $Q=\alpha IA$ bukhulu kunelahleko ngokuhamba komoya nokuqhuba.
p-127.example: Kwi-30°C ngaphandle, ngaphakathi kunganyuka kufike malunga ne-50°C ngemizuzu engama-30, kwaye idashboard kufike ngaphezu kwe-70°C. Ukuvula ifestile kancinci akunciphisi kakhulu ukunyuka kobushushu.
p-127.actionItem: Namhlanje rhoqo xa ukhuphuka kwimoto, jonga isihlalo sangasemva, kwaye ungashiyi umntwana okanye isilwanyana sasekhaya naphakade.

p-128.title: Lungisa ubude besitulo sebhayisikile ukuze iqatha ligoba kancinci
p-128.summary: Ukuba isitulo siphantsi kakhulu iqatha lithwala umthwalo omkhulu, kwaye ukuba siphezulu kakhulu ibhetyebhetye lonyakama lingenzakalisa ukhalo neqatha.
p-128.principle: Ifomula esetyenziswa kakhulu bubude besitulo $\approx0.883\times$ (ubude besinqe ukusuka emhlabeni ukuya kwesinqe). Xa ipedal iphantsi kakhulu iqatha ligoba nge-25–35°.
p-128.example: Ubude besinqe sisi-80cm, ubude besitulo $0.883\times80\approx70.6$ cm (ukusuka kwi-axle yepedal ukuya phezulu kwesitulo).
p-128.actionItem: Namhlanje phambi kokuba ukhwele ibhayisikile, linganisa ubude besitulo, kwaye xa ipedal iphantsi kakhulu beka isithende kuyo ukuqinisekisa ukuba iqatha lithe tye phantse ngokupheleleyo.

p-129.title: Ukunciphisa ubushushu bamanzi okuhlamba nge-2–4°C kunciphisa amandla
p-129.summary: Nokuba ukusetyenziswa kwamanzi ashushu kufana, ukufudumeza amanzi ukuya kubushushu obuphezulu kufuna amandla amaninzi ngaloo mlinganiselo.
p-129.principle: Ubushushu bokufudumeza amanzi yi-$Q=mc\Delta T$. Ubushushu obuthile bamanzi yi-$c=4.18\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\,K)}$.
p-129.example: Amanzi ommandla 15°C, amanzi okuhlamba e-40L efudunyezwa ukuya kwi-42°C yi-$40\times4.18\times27\approx4{,}514$ kJ (1.25kWh), nakwi-38°C malunga ne-3,846kJ (1.07kWh), umahluko we-0.19kWh ngokuhlamba ngalinye nemalunga ne-68kWh ngonyaka.
p-129.actionItem: Namhlanje nciphisa ubushushu bamanzi okuhlamba nge-2–4°C, kwaye ukuba ubanda, qala ucinge ngokufutshane ixesha lokuhlamba.

p-130.title: Zama ukunciphisa nje i-10km/h kwindlela enkulu
p-130.summary: Ukumelana komoya kukhula ngesikwere sesantya, ngoko nokuba usuka kancinci kuyonga ioyile ngokubonakalayo.
p-130.principle: Amandla okumelana komoya $F_d=\tfrac{1}{2}C_d\rho A v^2$ kwaye amandla asetyenzisiweyo $P=\tfrac{1}{2}C_d\rho A v^3$.
p-130.example: $C_dA=0.7\ \mathrm{m^2}$, i-110km/h (30.6m/s) malunga ne-12.0kW, kwaye i-100km/h malunga ne-9.0kW, i-25% ephantsi. Amandla ngomgama $(100/110)^2\approx0.83$ amaxesha, i-17% ephantsi, kwaye ixesha kwi-100km lonyuka ngemizuzu emi-5 kuphela.
p-130.actionItem: Namhlanje kwindlela enkulu qhuba ngesantya esingatshintshiyo unciphise i-10km/h ngaphakathi komda wesantya.

p-131.title: Jonga uluhlu lobunzima kunye namandla okuntanta (N) elebhakhethi yokuhlangula ubomi
p-131.summary: Itywina lokubhukuda alililo ibhakhethi yokuhlangula ubomi. Ibhakhethi yokuhlangula ubomi inika amandla okuntanta anele ukugcina ubuso ngaphezu kwamanzi.
p-131.principle: Amandla okuntanta yi-$F_b=\rho V g$. Ukushukumisa ilitha eli-1 lamanzi kunika amandla angama-9.8N.
p-131.example: Ibhakhethi yamandla okuntanta e-50N lilingana namandla okuntanta ashukumisa malunga neelitha ezi-5 zamanzi (malunga ne-5.1 kgf). Abantwana nabantu abadala bafuna amandla okuntanta ahlukileyo, ngoko imveliso kufuneka ihambelane noluhlu lobunzima.
p-131.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokubhukuda, jonga uluhlu lobunzima nophawu lwesiqinisekiso kwileyibhile yebhakhethi yokuhlangula ubomi, kwaye emva kokuyinxiba, qinisa ibhanti lomhlathi.

p-132.title: Ukukhwela ibhayisikile emva komntu osecaleni kufuna amandla amancinci
p-132.summary: Ngenxa ye-slipstream, apho umntu wangaphambili evala umoya, ungaqhuba ngesantya esifanayo ngamandla amancinci kakhulu.
p-132.principle: Amandla okumelana komoya yi-$P=\tfrac{1}{2}C_d\rho A v^3$. Ukuqhuba emva, $C_d$ esebenzayo iyancipha.
p-132.example: Kumhlaba othe tyaba, i-30km/h (8.3m/s), ukuba $C_dA=0.35\ \mathrm{m^2}$, $P\approx0.5\times0.35\times1.2\times8.3^3\approx120\ \mathrm{W}$ ingama-120W, kwaye ngqo emva yi-30–40% ephantsi, malunga nama-75–85W.
p-132.actionItem: Namhlanje kuhambo lweqela, qhuba ngeemitha ezi-1–2 emva komntu wangaphambili, kodwa ungavumeli amavili angaphambili ukuba adibane.

p-133.title: Jonga isiqinisekiso nobushushu bejaji ekhawulezayo
p-133.summary: Xa amandla okutshaja ekhula nobushushu buyakhula, ngoko ijaji eqinisekisiweyo nokungena komoya zigqiba ukhuseleko nobomi bebhetri.
p-133.principle: Amandla yi-$P=VI$, kwaye ilahleko yoguqulo yi-$P_\mathrm{loss}=(1-\eta)P$. Xa $\eta=0.88$ injalo, ijaji ye-20W ivelisa malunga ne-2.4W njengobushushu.
p-133.example: Ubushushu bejaji ye-5W malunga ne-0.6W, kwaye ijaji ye-65W malunga ne-7.8W. Xa ubushushu bungaphumi, njengakwibhlanethi, ibhetri idlula i-35°C, ukutshaja kuyacotha kwaye ubomi buyancipha.
p-133.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga uphawu lwesiqinisekiso olufana ne-KC kwijaji kunye ne-W ehambelana nesixhobo, kwaye uphephe ukutshaja phantsi kwebhlanethi.

p-134.title: Ukuma ngaphezu kwemizuzwana eyi-10, kungcono ukucima injini
p-134.summary: Injini ebhidayo engashukumiyo isatshisa ioyile. Xa uma ixesha elide, kokukhona kuyilahleko ikhula.
p-134.principle: Ukusetyenziswa kweoyile yi-$V_f=\dot V_f\,t$, kwaye ireyithi yokusetyenziswa kweoyile xa ibhidayo $\dot V_f$ ngokuqhelekileyo yi-0.6–1L/h kwimoto yabakhweli.
p-134.example: $\dot V_f=0.8$ L/h, ukubhida imizuzu emi-5 (300 s) yi-$0.8/3600\times300\approx0.067$ L, kanye ngosuku iintsuku ezingama-365 ingama-24L.
p-134.actionItem: Xa ulinde kwindawo yokupaka okanye umntu, cima injini (iimoto ezinomsebenzi wokumisa ngokuzenzekelayo kwizibane zomgaqo zingawusebenzisa).

p-135.title: Isithende esicekeceke senza ubunzima obufanayo buxinezeleke amaxesha amaninzi
p-135.summary: Xa ubunzima buqokelelana kwindawo enye, uxinzelelo luyakhula kwaye unyawo nomhlaba ziyatshutshiswa.
p-135.principle: Uxinzelelo yi-$P=F/A$. Nokuba amandla ayafana, indawo yokunxibelelana $A$ xa incinci uxinzelelo lukhulu.
p-135.example: Ubunzima obuyi-60 kgf (malunga ne-588N) kunyawo olunye, isithende esinendawo yokunxibelelana ye-1cm² sinika malunga ne-5.9MPa, kwaye isithende esibanzi se-20cm² malunga ne-0.29MPa, umahluko wamaxesha angama-20.
p-135.actionItem: Namhlanje kwiintsuku zokuhamba ixesha elide, xhoma izihlangu ezinendawo ebanzi yokunxibelelana ukunciphisa umthwalo kunyawo nakwiqatha.

p-136.title: Ingxolo yomgangatho ongaphezulu ifuna ubunzima nokufunxa isandi
p-136.summary: Izinto ezinzima nezityebileyo zisebenza kakuhle ukuvala isandi, kwaye ukunciphisa isoyikiso ngemati okanye ipadi kuyanceda.
p-136.principle: Ngomthetho wobunzima, ilahleko yokudlula yi-$TL\approx20\log_{10}(mf)-47\ \mathrm{dB}$ dB ($m$: kg/m², $f$: Hz), kwaye ubunzima bukhula kabini bukhula malunga ne-6dB.
p-136.example: Ukuncipha kwe-10dB kukuphi apho isandi sivakala singesiqingatha sobungakanani. Ukunamathelisa ipadi ye-felt emilenzeni yesitulo kunganciphisa ingxolo yokurhuqa malunga ne-5–10dB, kwaye imati ekhulu ncinci ingxolo yesoyikiso sokubaleka.
p-136.actionItem: Namhlanje namathelisa iipadi ze-felt emilenzeni yesitulo uze ubeke imati etyebileyo apho uhamba rhoqo.

p-137.title: Ukusebenzisa intonga xa uhla intaba kunceda iqatha
p-137.summary: Intonga yabelana ngenxalenye yomthwalo ngezandla yaza ikunciphise umthwalo weqatha xa uhla.
p-137.principle: Xa uhla, iqatha lifumana amandla angamaxesha angama-3 obunzima bomzimba ngokufunxa uxinzelelo, kwaye xa intonga yabelana ngamandla okuxhasa $F_s$ amandla eqatha ayancipha abe $F_k=3mg-F_s$.
p-137.example: Ubunzima be-70kg yi-686N kwaye amandla eqatha malunga ne-2,060N. Xa intonga ithwala malunga ne-20%, malunga ne-410N iyancipha.
p-137.actionItem: Namhlanje ekukhwelweni kwentaba, lungisa ubude bentonga ukuze indololwane ibe ngama-90 degrees uze unyuse xa uhla.

p-138.title: Ukunyibilikisa ukutya okubandayo kwifriji kubuyisa ubushushu obuphantsi
p-138.summary: Xa umkhenkce unyibilika ufunxa ubushushu, ngoko ukunyibilikisa kwifriji kuvumela obo bushushu obuphantsi ukuba bupholise ifriji.
p-138.example: Inyama ebandayo ye-1kg enomkhenkce omalunga ne-70%, ukunyibilika kufunxa $0.7\times334\approx234$ kJ (malunga ne-0.065kWh). Ifriji isebenza kancinci ngolo mlinganiselo.
p-138.actionItem: Namhlanje ngobusuku obandulelayo hambisa izithako zesidlo sasebusuku ukusuka kwifriza ukuya kwifriji. Phephe ukunyibilikisa kubushushu begumbi ngenxa yococeko.

p-139.title: Xa intambo yokuxhoma impahla ibanjwe iqine, amandla kwintambo nakwii-hooks ayakhula
p-139.summary: Xa utsala intambo yokuxhoma impahla iqine kakhulu, ukuhla kuyancipha, kodwa umxhuzulane kwintambo nakwiindawo zokuyibopha uyanda kakhulu.
p-139.principle: Ubunzima $W$ obulengiswa embindini wentambo ethe tye kwaye intambo ineekona $\theta$ ngokuthe tye, umxhuzulane yi-$T=\dfrac{W}{2\sin\theta}$.
p-139.example: Kwimpahla ye-5kg (malunga ne-49N), ikona yokuhla yi-30° $T=49\text{ N}$, kodwa ukuba yi-5° $T\approx281$ (malunga ne-29 kgf), malunga namaxesha ayi-6.
p-139.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ufaka intambo yokuxhoma impahla okanye isihlalo sokomisa, ungayitsali iqine kakhulu, uyishiye ihla malunga ne-5–10% yobude bentambo.

p-140.title: Ukugweba ubushushu ngobushushu obuvakalayo (isalathiso sobushushu)
p-140.summary: Nokuba ubushushu bomoya bufana, xa ukumanzi kuphezulu, ukubila akomi kwaye kushushu ngakumbi nokungeyomkhuseleko.
p-140.principle: Isalathiso sobushushu sisiqhelo sobushushu bomoya nokumanzi okuhambelanayo $HI = f(T, RH)$, kwaye njengoko ukupholisa ngokubhanga kunciphisa, ubushushu obuvakalayo buyanyuka.
p-140.example: Kubushushu bomoya obuyi-32°C, ukumanzi kwe-40% kuvakala njenge-32°C, kodwa ukumanzi kwe-70% kuvakala njenge-41°C, ibanga lesilumkiso kwizifo zobushushu.
p-140.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokuphuma kwixesha lemvula, jonga ukumanzi kunye nobushushu bomoya uze uguqule ixesha lemisebenzi yangaphandle.

p-141.title: Ungazi ukuba i-ambulensi isondela ngokuphakama nokuhla kwesandi
p-141.summary: Isirini iphakama isandi xa isondela kwaye ihla xa isuka, kwaye oko kuyi-Doppler effect.
p-141.principle: Umthombo wesandi uhamba ngesantya $v_s$, ukuphindaphinda okuvakalayo yi-$f'=f\,\dfrac{v}{v\mp v_s}$ (ukusondela $-$, ukusuka $+$).
p-141.example: Imoto enesirini ye-1,000Hz isondela ngesantya se-20m/s, ivakala $1000\times343/323\approx1{,}062$ Hz, kwaye ukusuka ivakala $1000\times343/363\approx945$ Hz.
p-141.actionItem: Namhlanje xa isirini ikhula iphakame, jonga ujikeleze uvule indlela.

p-142.title: Khetha amandla e-air conditioner ngobungakanani begumbi
p-142.summary: I-air conditioner enkulu ayilunge, ukusebenza kakuhle kulunge xa ihambelana nomthwalo wokupholisa wegumbi.
p-142.principle: Khetha amandla ngomthwalo wokupholisa $Q \approx q_0 A$ (malunga ne-150–200W kwindawo nganye). Ukuba inkulu kakhulu, ukusebenza kokuvula nokucima ixesha elifutshane kuyanda.
p-142.example: Igumbi le-15m² lifaneleke malunga ne-2.3–3.0kW (malunga ne-8,000–10,000 BTU/h). Ukuba amandla makhulu kakhulu, ukusebenza kuyehla ngenxa yokuvula nokucima.
p-142.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokukhetha i-air conditioner, bhala indawo yegumbi, ukuba ikhona ifestile ejonge entshona, kunye nomgangatho, uze uqhathanise amandla nomthengisi.

p-143.title: Ukuphakamisa useto lwe-air conditioner nge-1–2°C kunciphisa umthwalo wokupholisa
p-143.summary: Xa umahluko wobushushu phakathi kwangaphandle nangaphakathi mncinane, ubushushu obungena ngeendonga namafestile buyancipha kwaye i-air conditioner isebenza kancinci.
p-143.principle: Ubushushu obungena ngokuqhuba yi-$\dot Q=UA\,\Delta T$, ilingana nomahluko wobushushu $\Delta T$.
p-143.example: Xa ngaphandle yi-33°C, ukuphakamisa ngaphakathi ukusuka kwi-24°C ukuya kwi-26°C, $\Delta T$ iyehla ukusuka kwi-9K ukuya kwi-7K, kwaye ubushushu obungena ngokuqhuba buyancipha malunga ne-22%.
p-143.actionItem: Namhlanje phakamisa useto lwe-air conditioner lube yi-26°C uze usebenzise ifeni ngesantya esiphantsi kunye nayo.

p-144.title: Ukuba ilangatye liphuma ngaphandle kwesiseko sembiza, irhasi iyalahleka
p-144.summary: Ilangatye elikhulu kunesiseko sembiza lidlula ecaleni libe lifudumeza umoya kuphela. Ukulilungisa ngaphakathi kwesiseko, ubushushu bufika embizeni ngcono.
p-144.principle: Ubushushu obuhanjiswa kwimbiza yi-$Q=\eta E_{\text{amafutha}}$. Ukusebenza kobushushu kokukhona $\eta$ kuphezulu, ioyile encinci iyafuneka kwakuloo mfudumalo.
p-144.example: Ukufudumeza ilitha eli-1 lamanzi ukusuka kwi-20°C ukuya kwi-100°C kufuna i-334kJ, kwaye $\eta$ ukuba yi-40% ioyile ye-835kJ, ne-50% i-668kJ iyafuneka. Ngokuqikelela okuqhelekileyo, i-20% iyalondolozwa.
p-144.actionItem: Namhlanje xa upheka, nciphisa ilangatye ukuze lingafikeleli emphethweni wesiseko sembiza.

p-145.title: Ukunqanda amanzi komnqwazi kunye nekona yokunxibelelana
p-145.summary: Umnqwazi ubuyisa amathontsi amanzi kuba ikona yokunxibelelana yomphezulu inkulu, kwaye ukunqanda amanzi kunokubuyiselwa emva kokuhlamba.
p-145.example: Indwangu yomnqwazi ephathwe ukunqanda amanzi inekona yokunxibelelana malunga ne-110–120°, kwaye amathontsi aqengqeleka njengamaso. Xa ikona iwela ngaphantsi kwe-70° ngenxa yokunxiba kokungqubana, iqala ukumanzi.
p-145.actionItem: Vula umnqwazi omanzi uwomise esithunzini, kwaye xa amathontsi eqala ukungena, ufafaze isitshizi sokunqanda amanzi.

p-146.title: Ukulinganisa umgama ngomsantsa phakathi kombane nokuduma
p-146.summary: Ukuba ubala imizuzwana phakathi kokukhanya kombane nokuduma, ungazi ukuba umbane usondele kangakanani.
p-146.principle: Isandi yi-$v \approx 343\ \mathrm{m/s}$ kwaye ukukhanya kufika phantse ngoko nangoko, ngoko umgama yi-$d = vt$.
p-146.example: Ukuba ukuduma kuvakala emva kwemizuzwana eyi-9 emva kokukhanya, $d \approx 343 \times 9 \approx 3.1\ \mathrm{km}$. Ngaphakathi kwemizuzwana eyi-10 (3.4km) sele liyingozi yombane.
p-146.actionItem: Ngexesha lemvula xa uva ukuduma, yeka imisebenzi yangaphandle ungene kwisakhiwo okanye kwimoto.

p-147.title: Ibhreyiki yebhayisikile: sebenzisa ephambili neyasemva kunye, ephambili ngakumbi
p-147.summary: Xa ubophela ibhreyiki, ubunzima buya kwivili lengaphambili, ngoko ivili lengaphambili linokwenza amandla amakhulu ebhreyiki.
p-147.principle: Umthwalo odluliselwa kwivili lengaphambili xa kubophelwa ibhreyiki yi-$\Delta N=\dfrac{m a h}{L}$ ($h$: ukuphakama kweziko lobunzima, $L$: umgama phakathi kweeaxle).
p-147.example: Ubunzima be-80kg, $h=1.0$ m, $L=1.0$ m, ukuncipha kwesantya $a=4\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$ yi-$\Delta N=320$ N. Umthwalo ongatshintshiyo ngaphambili 314N nangasemva 470N utshintsha ube ngaphambili 634N nasemva 150N.
p-147.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ukhwela ibhayisikile, ungasebenzisi ibhreyiki yasemva kuphela, bamba ephambili neyasemva kunye ngobunono. Ukubamba kuphela ephambili ngequbuliso kunokukwenza uwe.

p-148.title: Ithemometha engachukumisiyo: jonga umgama kunye ne-emissivity
p-148.summary: Ithemometha ye-infrared ifunda ubushushu ngobushushu bemitha obukhutshwa yinto, ngoko ixabiso lohluka ngemeko yomphezulu nomgama.
p-148.principle: Ubunzima bemitha yi-$P=\varepsilon\sigma T^4$. Imiphezulu ecwebezelayo ene-emissivity $\varepsilon$ ephantsi ifundwa ngaphantsi kunokwenyani.
p-148.example: I-emissivity yesikhumba malunga ne-0.98 ngoko iyalingana kakuhle, kodwa isinyithi esicwebezelayo yi-0.1–0.3 kwaye impazamo inkulu. Ukuba umlinganiselo wamabanga yi-12:1, ekumgama we-1.2m ithatha umndilili wendawo ene-diameter ye-10cm.
p-148.actionItem: Xa uthenga ithemometha, jonga umgama wokusetyenziswa nendawo yokulinganisa, kwaye namhlanje linganisa ngokulandela umgama obhaliweyo kumyalelo (ngokuqhelekileyo ii-cm ezimbalwa).

p-149.title: Ngokupheka okuncinci, i-toaster oven encinci isebenzisa ubushushu obuncinci
p-149.summary: I-oven enkulu inomoya nentsimbi eninzi yokufudumeza, ngoko kumntu omnye okanye ababini i-oven encinci ngokwaneleyo ngobushushu obuncinci kakhulu.
p-149.principle: Ubushushu bokufudumeza yi-$Q=\sum m c\,\Delta T$. Ubunzima obuncinci bokufudumeza, ubushushu obuncinci buyafuneka.
p-149.example: Ukunyusa ubushushu beplate nentsimbi yangaphakathi ye-5kg ($c\approx0.45$ kJ/(kg·K)) nge-180K kufuna malunga ne-405kJ, kodwa i-1kg malunga ne-81kJ. Ukufudumeza umoya we-60L malunga ne-13kJ kuphela.
p-149.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ukhe ube nesixa esincinci sokubhaka, sebenzisa i-toaster oven okanye i-air fryer endaweni ye-oven enkulu.

p-150.title: Cima ilangatye kwangoko kancinci ugqibezele ngobushushu obushiyekileyo
p-150.summary: Amanzi nezithako ezisembizeni zigcina ubushushu, ngoko ukushiya isiciko sivaliwe, ukupheka kuyaqhubeka ngaphandle kwelangatye.
p-150.principle: Ubushushu obugcinwayo yi-$Q=mc\Delta T$, kwaye ngesiciko ilahleko yobushushu incinci kwaye ubushushu buhla kancinci.
p-150.example: Isitovu se-3kW (ngokucinga ukusebenza kwerhasi kwe-40%), ukucima imizuzu emi-2 kwangoko, ubushushu bamafutha $3\times120=360$ kJ bayalondolozwa. Amanzi e-1.5L anesiciko agcina ngaphezulu kwe-90°C iminyaka emininzi yemizuzu.
p-150.actionItem: Namhlanje xa upheka iimpuku, isobho okanye ukubhoqa, cima ilangatye imizuzu emi-1–2 kwangoko, uvale isiciko uze ugqibezele ngobushushu obushiyekileyo.

p-151.title: Songa intambo ye-earphone ngendlela ye-8 ukuze ingathungelani
p-151.summary: Ukuba usongela intambo kwicala elinye kuphela, intambo iqokelela ukujikeleza ize ithungelane xa ivulwa. Ngendlela ye-8, ukujikeleza kuyaphikisana.
p-151.principle: Ukujikeleza ngalinye kwentambo kuqokelela ikona yokujikeleza $\theta=2\pi$, kwaye umzuzwana wokujikeleza yi-$\tau=\dfrac{GJ}{L}\theta$.
p-151.example: Intambo ye-1m isongelwe amaxesha ali-10 kwicala elinye, ukujikeleza kuqokeleleka amaxesha ali-10, kodwa ukuba isongelwe amaxesha ama-5 +, amaxesha ama-5 − (i-8), isixa yi-0 kwaye akukho kuthungelana xa ivulwa.
p-151.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ulungisa ii-earphone namacingo okutshaja, ungazisongeli esinweni, zisonge ngendlela ye-8 uze uzigcine.

p-152.title: Amanzi angene endlebeni awaphumi ngenxa yoxinzelelo lomphezulu
p-152.summary: Iconsi lamanzi ngaphakathi kwembobo ebhityileyo yendlebe liphethwe luxinzelelo oluvela koxinzelelo lomphezulu kwaye akuphumi lula.
p-152.principle: Uxinzelelo lukaLaplace yi-$\Delta P=\dfrac{2\gamma}{r}$ kwaye $\gamma\approx0.072$ N/m ngamanzi. Rediyasi $r$ incinci, uxinzelelo lukhulu.
p-152.example: $r=3$ mm, $\Delta P=2\times0.072/0.003=48$ Pa, kwaye ngomxhuzulane kuphela kunzima ukuphuma.
p-152.actionItem: Emva kokubhukuda, gobisa intloko, tsala kancinci indlebe yangaphandle uze utsibe ngonyawo olunye. Ungasebenzisi i-cotton swab, kwaye ukuba kukho ubuhlungu okanye ulwelo, yiya esibhedlele.

p-153.title: Betha i-peg yentenda ngokuthe gruzu kwicala elichasene nentambo
p-153.summary: Xa i-peg ibethwa isondele kwikona ethe nkqo kunye nesalathiso sentambo, umhlaba umelana kakuhle namandla okuyikhupha.
p-153.principle: Umxhuzulane wentambo $T$ wahlulwa waba yinxalenye ethe tye $T\cos\theta$ nenxalenye ethe nkqo $T\sin\theta$, kwaye inxalenye ethe nkqo itsala i-peg phezulu.
p-153.example: Umxhuzulane we-100N, ikona yentambo i-45°, amandla athe tye yi-71N kunye namandla okukhupha yi-71N. Ukubetha i-peg ngokuthe gruzu malunga ne-45–60° ukuya kwicala elichasene nentambo, umhlaba uyamelana.
p-153.actionItem: Namhlanje kwikampu okanye kwipikiniki, betha ii-peg ngokuthe gruzu usondele kwikona ethe nkqo kunye nesalathiso sentambo, kwaye utsale intambo kwikona ye-45° malunga.

p-154.title: Khetha ibhokisi yomkhenkce ngobukhulu, isiciko esivaliweyo kakuhle nobungakanani bomkhenkce
p-154.summary: Ixesha apho ibhokisi yomkhenkce ihlala ibanda lisalathiswa bubukhulu bokugquma nobungakanani bomkhenkce.
p-154.principle: Ubushushu obungena ngodonga yi-$\dot Q=\dfrac{kA\Delta T}{d}$, ubushushu bokunyibilika komkhenkce yi-$Q=mL_f$, kwaye $L_f\approx334$ kJ/kg.
p-154.example: Ubushushu obungenayo bukwi-10W, umkhenkce we-2kg (668kJ) uhlala $668{,}000/10\approx18.6$ iiyure, kwaye ukuba yi-20W malunga neeyure ezi-9.3.
p-154.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba unohlelo lohambo, gcwalisa ibhokisi ngaphandle kwezikhewu ngomkhenkce we-2kg okanye ngaphezulu neziselo ezipholile kwangaphambili, kwaye ungavuli isiciko rhoqo.

p-155.title: Inxalenye yombane we-air conditioner ngexesha lemvula isetyenziselwa ukukhanda ukumanzi
p-155.summary: Ngeentsuku ezimanzi, kufuneka amandla hayi kupholisa umoya kuphela kodwa nokuguqula umphunga wamanzi ube ngamanzi.
p-155.principle: Xa umphunga wamanzi uba ngamanzi, ubushushu be-$Q=mL_v$ buyakhutshwa, kwaye kumanzi $L_v\approx2{,}260\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$.
p-155.example: Kwigumbi le-60 $\mathrm{m^3}$ (umoya malunga ne-72kg), ukuncipha kwe-2g yomphunga ngekhilogram nganye yomoya, i-air conditioner iphatha $0.144\times2{,}260\approx325$ kJ (malunga ne-0.09kWh).
p-155.actionItem: Namhlanje ngosuku olumanzi, sebenzisa imodi yokunciphisa ukumanzi okanye umoya ophantsi we-26–28°C, uze uvale iingcango namafestile ukuze ukumanzi kungangeni.

p-156.title: Ikettle yombane ineempawu zamandla ezisebenza ngcono kunesitovu serhasi
p-156.summary: Xa ubilisa amanzi, ikettle yombane engavuzi bushushu isebenzisa amandla amancinci ukubilisa amanzi afanayo.
p-156.principle: Ukusebenza $\eta = \frac{mc\Delta T}{E_{in}}$. Ukufudumeza ilitha eli-1 lamanzi ukusuka kwi-20°C ukuya kwi-100°C kufuna $1 \times 4.18 \times 80 = 334\ \mathrm{kJ}$ ($\approx 0.093\ \mathrm{kWh}$).
p-156.example: Ikettle yombane enokusebenza okumalunga ne-90% isebenzisa malunga ne-0.103kWh, kwaye ilangatye lerhasi elimalunga ne-40% lisebenzisa malunga ne-0.23kWh yamandla.
p-156.actionItem: Xa ubilisa amanzi, linganisa isixa esifunekayo kuphela uze ubilise ngekettle yombane.

p-157.title: Ixesha lokufudumeza indebe enye lingagqitywa ngokubala
p-157.summary: Ukuba ugqiba ixesha le-microwave ngokuqikelela, kulula ukuqhuba ixesha elide uphalaze amandla.
p-157.principle: Ubushushu bokufudumeza amanzi yi-$Q=mc\Delta T$, kwaye ixesha elifunekayo yi-$t=Q/P_{\text{amandla}}$.
p-157.example: Ukufudumeza amanzi e-250g ukusuka kwi-20°C ukuya kwi-90°C kufuna $0.25\times4.18\times70\approx73$ kJ, kwaye ngamandla e-700W malunga nemizuzwana eyi-104 (umzuzu o-1 imizuzwana engama-44).
p-157.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ufudumeza isiselo, qala usebenzise malunga nomzuzu o-1 imizuzwana engama-30, kwaye ukuba akwanelanga yongeza imizuzwana engama-20 ngalinye.

p-158.title: Xa imvula inethwa ukusuka phezulu kuphela, ukugijima kukunyiselisa kancinci
p-158.summary: Ukugijima ngemvula kunciphisa ixesha lokubethwa entloko nasemagxeni, kodwa isixa semvula ebetha ngaphambili emzimbeni sigqitywa ngumgama.
p-158.principle: Kwimvula enethayo ethe nkqo, isixa esibetha inxalenye ephezulu yi-$W_{\text{phezulu}}\propto t=L/v$ ngokuchaseneyo nesantya, kwaye isixa esibetha ngaphambili silingana nomgama $L$ kuphela.
p-158.example: Ukuhamba i-100m (1.4m/s) malunga nemizuzwana engama-71, ukugijima (3.5m/s) malunga nemizuzwana engama-29, kwaye ixesha lokubethwa phezulu liyancipha nge-59%. Xa kuvuthuza umoya, iziphumo ziyatshintsha.
p-158.actionItem: Namhlanje xa kunetha imvula, kwiindawo ezifutshane ezingenamnqwazi hamba ngokukhawuleza ngokungachaphazeli ukhuseleko, kwaye uqaphele imigangatho etyibilikayo.

p-159.title: Umthetho we-20-20-20: rhoqo ngemizuzu engama-20 jonga i-6m kude imizuzwana engama-20
p-159.summary: Xa ujonga iscreen esiseduze ixesha elide, ilensi yeliso iqhubeka ityebisa kwaye ukudinwa kuyaqokelelana.
p-159.principle: Kwifomula yelensi $\dfrac1f=\dfrac1{d_o}+\dfrac1{d_i}$, xa into isondele, amandla okugoba ukukhanya (idiopter) afunekayo $D=1/d_o$ ayakhula.
p-159.example: Iscreen se-40cm sifuna ukulungiswa kwe-2.5 D, kodwa umgama we-6m malunga ne-0.17 D, oko kukuthi umthwalo uyancipha phantse amaxesha ali-15.
p-159.actionItem: Namhlanje beka itayima yemizuzu engama-20, kwaye ngalo lonke ixesha ikhala jonga indawo ekude ngaphezulu kwe-6m imizuzwana engama-20.

p-160.title: Ukuba uthathwe yi-rip current, ubhukuda ngokuhambelana nonxweme
p-160.summary: I-rip current yindlela encinci nekhawulezayo yamanzi ukusuka elunxwemeni ukuya elwandle, kwaye ukubhukuda ngokuchasene nayo kuyadinisa.
p-160.principle: Ngokulingana kokuqhubeka $A_1v_1=A_2v_2$, xa amanzi eqokelelana kwindlela encinci isantya sokuhamba siyakhula.
p-160.example: Isantya se-rip current sinokufikelela kuma-2m/s, ngaphezulu kwesantya sokubhukuda somntu (malunga ne-1m/s), kwaye ububanzi bayo ngokuqhelekileyo ngamashumi eemitha, ngoko ukuhamba ecaleni nge-20–30m kunokukukhupha.
p-160.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba unohlelo lokubhukuda elwandle, dlala kwindawo enabahlangulizi, kwaye ukuba uthathwe yi-rip current, gcina amandla, bhukuda ngokuhambelana nonxweme, uze uqhwaye isandla ucele uncedo.

p-161.title: I-parasol ilunge xa ingaphandle ikhanya nangaphakathi imnyama
p-161.summary: Umbala omhlophe wangaphandle ubuyisela ukukhanya kwelanga, kwaye umbala omnyama wangaphakathi ufunxa ukukhanya okubuyiselweyo okuvela emhlabeni.
p-161.principle: Isixa semitha esifunxwa ngumphezulu yi-$q=(1-\alpha)I$. $\alpha$ yi-reflectivity.
p-161.example: Kwilanga lasemini le-800 $\mathrm{W/m^2}$, umhlophe onokubuyisela kwe-0.7 ufunxa i-240 $\mathrm{W/m^2}$ kwaye omnyama onokubuyisela kwe-0.05 ufunxa i-760 $\mathrm{W/m^2}$ (ukucinga).
p-161.actionItem: Xa uthenga i-parasol, jonga umbala wangaphandle nophawu lokukhusela i-UV olufana ne-UPF 50+.

p-162.title: Kutheni ifeni enkulu isebenza ngcono
p-162.summary: Kumoya ofanayo, ifeni enamaphiko amakhulu ejikeleza ngesantya esiphantsi isebenzisa amandla amancinci kakhulu.
p-162.principle: Amandla enyameko yokushukuma komoya $P = \frac{1}{2}\rho A v^3 = \frac{\rho Q^3}{2A^2}$ ($Q = Av$ umthamo womoya).
p-162.example: Umthamo ongama-0.5m³/s, i-diameter ye-30cm inamandla ethiyori angama-15W, kwaye i-60cm malunga ne-1W. Xa indawo ingamaxesha ama-4, amandla yi-1/16.
p-162.actionItem: Xa uthenga ifeni, qhathanisa iidiameters zamaphiko uze usebenzise imveliso enkulu ngesantya esiphantsi.

p-163.title: Kwi-5km, ibhayisikile isebenzisa amandla amancinci kakhulu kunemoto
p-163.summary: Ukuya kumgama omfutshane ngebhayisikile endaweni yemoto kunciphisa kakhulu ioyile namandla.
p-163.principle: Amandla okushukuma abalwa ngomsebenzi $W=Pt$ nokusebenza. Ilitha eli-1 lepetroli linamandla angama-9kWh amakhemikhali.
p-163.example: Ibhayisikile i-5km (15km/h, 100W, imizuzu engama-20) yi-33Wh, kwaye nokuba kuthathwa ukusebenza kwemisipha kwe-25% malunga ne-0.13kWh. Imoto yabakhweli ye-12km/L isebenzisa malunga ne-3.7kWh ngeekhilomitha ezi-5, umahluko wamaxesha angama-28.
p-163.actionItem: Namhlanje kuhambo olungaphakathi kwe-5km, zama ukuhamba ngeenyawo okanye ukusebenzisa ibhayisikile.

p-164.title: Ukuthontsisa isitshizi ukusuka ezantsi, amanzi angena nge-capillary
p-164.summary: Izikhewu ezincinci phakathi kwamasuntswana omhlaba zitsala amanzi phezulu, ngoko nokuthulula amanzi kwisosiji esezantsi, amanzi afika kwiingcambu.
p-164.principle: Ukuphakama kwe-capillary yi-$h=\dfrac{2\gamma\cos\theta}{\rho g r}$. Rediyasi yesikhewu $r$ xa incinci, amanzi anyuka ngaphezulu.
p-164.actionItem: Namhlanje thulula amanzi kwisosiji yesitshizi, uwashiye imizuzu engama-20 uze uphose awashiyekileyo. Amanzi amile abangela ukubola kwengcambu nokuzalana kweempukane.

p-165.title: Linganisa uxinzelelo lwegazi ngesandla esikumgangatho wentliziyo
p-165.summary: Xa isandla singaphantsi kwentliziyo, ubunzima begazi (uxinzelelo lwehydrostatic) ayanda kwaye uxinzelelo lwegazi lufundwa lukhulu kunokwenyani.
p-165.principle: Umahluko woxinzelelo lwehydrostatic yi-$\Delta P=\rho g h$. Ubuninzi begazi malunga ne-1,060 $\mathrm{kg/m^3}$ kwaye i-1kPa ingama-7.5mmHg.
p-165.example: Isandla singaphantsi kwentliziyo nge-20cm, $\Delta P=1060\times9.8\times0.2\approx2.08$ kPa, oko kukuthi malunga ne-15.6mmHg ngaphezulu yelinganiswa.
p-165.actionItem: Xa ulinganisa uxinzelelo lwegazi, hlala esitulweni, uncede umva, ubeke isandla esinekhafu etafileni ukufikelela kumgangatho wentliziyo.

p-166.title: Impahla ephakathi kwemoto ibhabha phambili ngamandla amakhulu xa kubhulwa ngequbuliso
p-166.summary: Umthwalo ongaboshwanga ugijima ngenxa ye-inertia nokuba imoto imisiwe, kwaye ngamandla amakhulu embetho xa kubhulwa ngequbuliso.
p-166.principle: Amandla asebenza kumthwalo xa imoto yehla isantya $F=ma$ kwaye $a=v/\Delta t$.
p-166.example: Umthwalo we-10kg uma ukusuka kwi-50km/h (13.9m/s) ngemizuzwana eyi-0.1, $a\approx139\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$, $F\approx1{,}390$ N (malunga ne-140 kgf).
p-166.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ulayisha imoto, beka umthwalo phantsi kwebhuti uwuboshe, kwaye ungabeki izinto ezinzima kwishelufu yesihlalo sangasemva okanye phezu kweezitulo.

p-167.title: Inani lomgangatho wokungena kwamanzi i-IPX lithetha imeko yokufika kwamanzi
p-167.summary: I-IPX4 ngamanzi ahlaba, kwaye i-IPX7 ithetha ukumelana nokutshona kwi-1m ubunzulu imizuzu engama-30, kwaye inani elikhulu alinyanzelekanga ukuba lilungile rhoqo.
p-167.principle: Uxinzelelo lwamanzi yi-$P=\rho g h$. Uxinzelelo lobunzulu be-1m malunga ne-9.8kPa.
p-167.example: I-IPX4 ivavanywa ngamanzi ahlaba kuyo yonke imithombo, kwaye i-IPX7 ngemeko yokumelana ukuya kuthi ga kwimizuzu engama-30 kubunzulu be-1m, kwaye amanzi olwandle, amanzi esepha namanzi ashushu ayingabo ababhaliweyo kaninzi.
p-167.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga inani le-IPX le-earphone nesipikha, kwaye ukuba ufuna ukuzisebenzisa ngosuku lwemvula, qinisekisa ukuba i-IPX4 okanye ngaphezulu.

p-168.title: I-dehumidifier: uhlobo lwe-compressor nohlobo lwe-Peltier
p-168.summary: Xa igumbi likhulu uhlobo lwe-compressor luyafaneleka, kwaye kwindawo encinci njengeklosethi yempahla uhlobo lwe-Peltier.
p-168.principle: I-coefficient yokusebenza $COP = \frac{Q_c}{W}$. Uhlobo lwe-compression malunga ne-3 kwaye i-Peltier malunga ne-0.5.
p-168.example: Ukuxinana kwe-1kg yamanzi kufuna malunga ne-2.26MJ (0.63kWh). Uhlobo lwe-compression malunga ne-0.2kWh kwaye i-Peltier malunga ne-1.3kWh.
p-168.actionItem: Ngexesha lemvula, jonga umthamo we-dehumidification ohambelana nobukhulu begumbi uze ulawule igumbi lokuhlala ngohlobo lwe-compressor.

p-169.title: Xa umoya wasebusuku upholile, ngenisa umoya ukukhupha ubushushu bendlu
p-169.summary: Ubushushu obuqokelelweyo emini bunokukhutshwa ngaphandle kwamandla ebusuku xa umoya wangaphandle upholile ngokuvula iifestile.
p-169.principle: Ubushushu obuphuma ngokungenisa umoya yi-$\dot Q=\dot m c_p\Delta T$.
p-169.example: Ngaphakathi 28°C, umoya wangaphandle wasebusuku 22°C, ukuba ungenisa umoya we-600 $\mathrm{m^3/h}$ (umoya malunga ne-0.2kg ngomzuzwana), unokukhupha ubushushu be-$0.2\times1.005\times6\approx1.2$ kW.
p-169.actionItem: Namhlanje ebusuku xa ubushushu behla ngaphantsi kwabangaphakathi, vula iifestile ngokuhamba komoya ngeendlela ezimbini, uze uzivale kwangoko ekuseni.

p-170.title: Isizathu sokungxola kwepayipi yamanzi amdaka kukutshintsha koxinzelelo lomoya
p-170.summary: Xa onke amanzi ehla kunye, uxinzelelo lomoya ngaphakathi kwepayipi luyatshintsha, amanzi etrap ayafunxwa, umoya uyangena uphume utsho ingxolo.
p-170.principle: Uxinzelelo lwekholamu yamanzi yi-$P=\rho g h$, ngoko uxinzelelo olungafanelekanga $\Delta P$ lutsala amanzi ubude $h=\Delta P/(\rho g)$.
p-170.example: Uxinzelelo olungafanelekanga lwe-100Pa lulingana ne-$100/(1000\times9.8)\approx10$ mm, oko kukuthi ikholamu yamanzi yobu bude. Ubunzulu bamanzi okuvala bomgibe we-50mm okanye ngaphezulu ngokuqhelekileyo buyamelana.
p-170.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ipayipi yamanzi amdaka ingxola, yeka amanzi ehle kancinci, kwaye ukuba kuphindaphinda cela ukuhlolwa kwi-ofisi yolawulo okanye umplombi.

p-171.title: Umoya wefeni uthintela iimosquito
p-171.summary: Iimosquito ziyabhabha kancinci, ngoko kunzima ukusondela kwindawo enomoya wefeni.
p-171.principle: Isantya sokubhabha seemosquito sisezantsi okanye malunga ne-1.5m/s, ngoko ukuba $v_{wind} > v_{mosq}$ likhulu kunzima ukusondela, kwaye umoya ubuyisa nokusasaza ikholamu ye-carbon dioxide.
p-171.example: Ifeni ene-3m/s yimaxesha angama-2 esona santya siphezulu seemosquito. Ukuba uthumela umoya emilenzeni, ukusondela kokuluma kuyancipha.
p-171.actionItem: Qhuba ifeni ijonge ekuphakameni komlenze kwiveranda okanye ngaphandle.

p-172.title: Xa udlula ecaleni kwemoto enkulu kwindlela enkulu, lungiselela umoya osecaleni
p-172.summary: Umoya osecaleni ovuthuza ngequbuliso kwilori okanye ebhulorho utyhala imoto ukuya kwicala elinye.
p-172.principle: Amandla omoya kwimoto yi-$F=\tfrac12\rho C A v^2$, alingana nesikwere sesantya somoya $v$.
p-172.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba kukho uqikelelo lwemvula nomoya onamandla, bamba isiphekepheke ngezandla zombini uze unciphise isantya kumabhulorho nakwindawo yokuphuma kwitoni.

p-173.title: Khetha indwangu yokupholisa ngexabiso lokuchukumisa ukubanda (Q-max)
p-173.summary: Izinto zokupholisa zithatha ubushushu ngokukhawuleza xa zichukumisa isikhumba kwaye ziyavakala zibanda, kwaye ubukhulu boko bubonakaliswa nge-Q-max.
p-173.principle: Ukuhamba kobushushu ngexesha lokuchukumisa yi-$q\propto\dfrac{b\,\Delta T}{\sqrt{t}}$ kwaye ukufunxa ubushushu $b=\sqrt{k\rho c}$ xa kukhulu, kuvakala kubanda ngakumbi.
p-173.example: Ngokuchukumisa $\Delta T=5$ K, indwangu ene-Q-max ye-0.25 $\mathrm{W/cm^2}$ ithatha ubushushu ngokukhawuleza malunga namaxesha ayi-1.7 kunaleyo ye-0.15 (umzekelo).
p-173.actionItem: Xa ukhetha impahla yehlobo namacuba, jonga ixabiso le-Q-max kwileyibhile (ngokuqhelekileyo i-0.2 okanye ngaphezulu ibhaliwe njengokupholisa).

p-174.title: Umgama webhayisikile yombane ubalwa nge-Wh yebhetri nokusetyenziswa
p-174.summary: Ukwahlula umthamo webhetri (Wh) ngobungakanani bamandla asetyenziswa ngekhilomitha enye (Wh/km), ungaqikelela umgama.
p-174.principle: Umgama yi-$d=E/e$ kwaye ukumelana komoya yi-$F\propto v^2$, ngoko xa isantya siphezulu $e$ iyakhula.
p-174.example: Ibhetri ye-500Wh, 15Wh/km malunga ne-33km. Isantya se-25km ngeyure sinokurhuqa $(25/20)^2\approx1.56$ amaxesha kunesantya se-20km ngeyure, ngoko umgama uyafutshane.
p-174.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ukhwela ibhayisikile yombane, gcina isantya malunga ne-20km ngeyure uze ujonge uxinzelelo lomoya lweetayara.

p-175.title: Umthwalo we-100kg ekwibhuti utshisa ioyile engaphezulu kwi-100km
p-175.summary: Xa imoto inzima, amandla okumelana nokujikeleza nokukhawulezisa ayanda, ngoko ukuthwala imithwalo engasetyenziswayo kulahla ioyile.
p-175.principle: Ukumelana nokujikeleza yi-$F_r=C_{rr}mg$ kwaye umsebenzi yi-$W=F_r d$.
p-175.example: $C_{rr}=0.01$, $m=100$ kg, $F_r\approx9.8$ N, kwaye kwi-100km $W\approx0.27$ kWh. Ukusebenza kwenjini i-25%, ipetroli 9kWh/L malunga ne-0.12L, kwaye amandla okukhawulezisa ahlukile.

p-176.title: Kutheni umgangatho wendlu yokuhlamba omanzi utyibilika
p-176.summary: Umaleko wamanzi unciphisa kakhulu i-coefficient yokungqubana, ngoko beka imati engatyibilikiyo kwindlu yokuhlamba.
p-176.principle: Umda wokungqubana okumileyo $F \le \mu N$. Ukuba i-coefficient yokungqubana iphantsi kunexabiso elifunekayo ekuhambeni (malunga ne-0.3–0.4), iyatyibilika.
p-176.example: Itayile eyomileyo $\mu \approx 0.6$, itayile ethambileyo emanzi $\mu \approx 0.2$, kwaye imati yerabha nokuba imanzi malunga ne-0.6.
p-176.actionItem: Beka imati engatyibilikiyo kumgangatho wendlu yokuhlamba nakwindawo yokuhlamba.

p-177.title: I-UV idlula nangosuku olunelifu
p-177.summary: Amafu anciphisa ukukhanya okubonakalayo kodwa avumela inxalenye enkulu ye-UV ukuba idlule, ngoko ukhuseleko lufuneka nangosuku olunelifu.
p-177.principle: Isalathiso se-UV $UVI = 40 \int E_\lambda\, s(\lambda)\, d\lambda$ (i-spectrum yesenzo se-erythema $s$). Ilifu elibhityileyo alinciphisi kakhulu i-UV.
p-177.example: Ilifu elibhityileyo livumela malunga ne-80–90% ye-UV ukuba idlule. Isalathiso se-UV se-8 emini kaJuni, isikhumba sinokutshiswa ngaphakathi kwemizuzu engama-20.
p-177.actionItem: Nangosuku olunelifu, jonga isalathiso se-UV ngaphambi kokuphuma uze usebenzise i-sunscreen.

p-178.title: Emva kokudlula kumachibi, cinezela ibhreyiki ngobunono ukuze yome
p-178.summary: Iipadi zebhreyiki neediski ezimanzi ziyancipha ngokungqubana kwaye ukubophelela kuyaphuza. Ukuzicinezela ngobunono, ubushushu bokungqubana buyakhabisa amanzi.
p-178.principle: Umgama wokubophelela yi-$d=\dfrac{v^2}{2\mu g}$. Ukungqubana kwebhreyiki kuncipha, $d$ iba likhulu.
p-178.example: Kwi-60km/h (16.7m/s), $\mu=0.4$ malunga ne-35.5m, kwaye ukuba kumanzi $\mu=0.25$ malunga ne-56.7m, oko kukuthi malunga namaxesha ayi-1.6 (ngokucinga).
p-178.actionItem: Namhlanje ngexesha lemvula, emva kokudlula emachibini anzulu, xa indawo ikhuselekile, cinezela ibhreyiki ngobunono amaxesha ambalwa ukujonga imeko.

p-179.title: Khetha imbiza ngobukhulu besiseko nezinto
p-179.summary: Imbiza enesiseko esityebileyo nolwakhiwo lwe-aluminium okanye ubhedu isasaza ubushushu ngokulinganayo kwaye inciphisa ukutshiswa ezantsi.
p-179.principle: Umthetho kaFourier $q = k\frac{\Delta T}{d}$. Isinyithi esingenazimbe $k \approx 16$, i-aluminium $\approx 237$ W/(m·K).
p-179.example: Ubukhulu 3mm, ΔT 10K, isinyithi esingenazimbe malunga ne-53kW/m² kunye ne-aluminium malunga ne-790kW/m², oko kukuthi ubushushu obuhambayo busondele kumaxesha ali-15 ngaphezulu.
p-179.actionItem: Xa ukhetha imbiza, jonga ukuba isiseko sithe tye nesityebileyo, kwaye kwi-induction ukuba isiseko semagnethi.

p-180.title: Fudumeza ibhakethi ngelanga ukonga amanzi okuhlamba
p-180.summary: Ilanga linika ukuya kuthi ga kwi-1kW yamandla kwi-m² nganye, ngoko ungawafudumeza amanzi ebhakethini emnyama ngaphandle kwexabiso.
p-180.principle: Ubushushu obufunxiweyo yi-$Q=\alpha I A t$ kwaye ukunyuka kobushushu bamanzi yi-$\Delta T=Q/(mc)$.
p-180.example: Ibhakethi emnyama ye-20L ($\mathrm{m^2}$) ene-$I=700\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$, injalo ukufunxa 0.9, $0.9\times700\times0.25\approx158$ W, kwaye ngeeyure ezi-2 kungena malunga ne-1.1MJ yaye amanzi anyuka malunga ne-13°C.
p-180.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ilanga linamandla, gcwalisa ibhakethi emnyama okanye ipayipi ngamanzi uwashiye elangeni iiyure ezi-2–3, uze uwasebenzise kwizityalo okanye ukuhlamba imoto.

p-181.title: Ucango olurhabayo, ukungqubana kokubambeka-nokutyibilika
p-181.summary: I-hinge ibhoboza kuba ukungqubana okumileyo kukhulu kunokungqubana kokushukuma, ngoko kubambeka kutyibilike.
p-181.principle: Ukubambeka-nokutyibilika: $F_s = \mu_s N > F_k = \mu_k N$. Ukuthambisa kunciphisa ii-$\mu$ zombini.
p-181.example: Isinyithi esomileyo $\mu \approx 0.5$ xa sinciphiswa ukuya kuma-0.1 emva kokuthambisa, ukungqubana kuyancipha malunga ne-80% kwaye isandi siyanyamalala.
p-181.actionItem: Beka ithontsi elinye leoyile ye-silicone okanye eyomgubo kwi-pin yehinge uze ucoce ekugqitheleyo.

p-182.title: Ingxolo yongeza i-3dB, iifeni ezimbini
p-182.summary: Ukuba uvula izixhobo ezibini ezinengxolo efanayo, isandi asiyi kuba kabini kodwa sikhula nge-3dB kuphela. Ngexesha lokulala ingxolo encinci ibalulekile.
p-182.example: Iifeni ezimbini ze-40dB zi-$10\log_{10}(2\times10^4) \approx 43\ \mathrm{dB}$ dB. I-WHO icebisa ingxolo yasebusuku yegumbi lokulala malunga ne-30dB okanye ngaphantsi.
p-182.actionItem: Qhathanisa iimpawu zengxolo (dB) zezixhobo zegumbi lokulala uze usebenzise nje eyodwa ethule kakhulu ngexesha lokulala.

p-183.title: Elunxwemeni emini ngaphandle kwezihlangu: kutheni isanti eyomileyo ishushu kodwa eyimanzi ibanda
p-183.summary: Isanti eyomileyo yasemini ifudumala lula kwaye inokutshisa iinyawo, kwaye isanti emanzi ephethe amanzi ishushu kancinci kakhulu.
p-183.principle: Xa kufunyanwa ubushushu obufanayo $Q$, ukunyuka kobushushu yi-$\Delta T=\frac{Q}{mc}$. Ubushushu obuthile besanti eyomileyo yi-$c\approx0.8\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$, kwaye ubamanzi yi-$4.18\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$, kukhulu kakhulu, ngoko kunyuka kancinci, kwaye amanzi akhanda ubushushu xa ebhanga.
p-183.example: Isanti ye-1kg namanzi e-1kg ngalinye lifumana i-50kJ, isanti inyuka malunga ne-$+62\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ kwaye amanzi malunga ne-$+12\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Ngoko umphezulu wesanti eyomileyo emini ufikelela kwi-50–60°C, kodwa isanti emanzi ichukunyiswa ngamaza ihlala malunga ne-30°C.
p-183.actionItem: Emini xhoma amasandali xa uhamba, uze utshintshele kwisanti emanzi ecaleni kwamanzi.

p-184.title: Amanzi olwandle akuxhasa ngcono kunamanzi amatsha
p-184.summary: Umntu omnye untywila kancinci phezulu elwandle kunasechibini okanye emlanjeni.
p-184.principle: Ukuntywila kulingana nobunzima bolwelo olufudukisiweyo: $F_b=\rho g V$. Amanzi olwandle anee-$\rho\approx1025\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ xa kuthelekiswa ne-$1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ yamanzi amatsha, malunga nama-2.5% ngaphezulu.
p-184.example: Umntu oyi-70kg kufuneka afudukise i-70L yamanzi amatsha ukuze antywile ngokupheleleyo, kodwa i-$70/1.025\approx68.3$ L kuphela yamanzi olwandle, malunga ne-1.7L ngaphantsi komthamo ongaphantsi kwamanzi. Kwi-Dead Sea enetyuwa ngakumbi (malunga ne-1240kg/m³) ukuntywila kulula kakhulu.
p-184.actionItem: Qhelisa ukuntywila ngomhlana emanzini olwandle angekho nzulu ngemiphunga izele ngokukhululekileyo, kwaye hlala unxibe ijezi yokuhlangula xa kufuneka.

p-185.title: Gcina iipayipi ze-snorkel zimfutshane, ungaze udlule kwi-30cm ngaphezu kwamanzi
p-185.summary: Ipayipi ende ye-snorkel yenza ukuphefumla kube nzima kakhulu ngenxa yoxinzelelo lwamanzi, kwaye iligcina umoya ophelelayo.
p-185.principle: Uxinzelelo lwamanzi lukhula njenge-$\Delta P=\rho g h$, malunga ne-0.1atm (9.8kPa) kwimitha nganye yobunzulu. Isifuba sakho simele sisebenze ngokuchasene noko ukuze uphefumlele ngaphakathi, kwaye ipayipi ende yongeza indawo efileyo apho umoya ophelelayo uhlala khona.
p-185.example: Ngaphezulu kwepayipi kusemphezulu wamanzi, i-30cm yobunzulu inika i-$\Delta P\approx2.9\ \mathrm{kPa}$, kodwa kwimitha e-1 ibingu-9.8kPa, ekufutshane nomda woxinzelelo lokuphefumla komntu, ngoko ukuphefumla kuba nzima kangangokuba akunakwenzeka. Ipayipi eyi-18mm ububanzi kunye ne-30cm ubude iqulathe malunga ne-75mL yendawo efileyo.
p-185.actionItem: Khangela ubude be-snorkel yakho namhlanje kwaye ungaze usebenzise ipayipi ende okanye ihosi eyongezelelweyo ekupheleni.

p-186.title: Umgangatho webhavu ubonakala ungenzulu kunokuba unjalo
p-186.summary: Ezantsi kwamanzi kubonakala kunzulu malunga neekota ezintathu kuphela zobunzulu bokwenyani, ngoko amanzi anzulu kunokuba ebonakala.
p-186.principle: Ukukhanya kuyagoba xa kuphuma emanzini kuye emoyeni, ngoko ubunzulu obubonakalayo bu-$d'=\frac{d}{n}$. Amanzi aneyi-$n\approx1.33$, ngoko $d'\approx0.75\,d$.
p-186.example: Umgangatho webhavu ongaphantsi kwe-2.0m ubonakala kwi-$2.0/1.33\approx1.5$ m xa ujongwa ngaphezulu. Ubunzulu be-3m bubonakala bunga-2.3m, umahluko we-0.7m.
p-186.actionItem: Funda uphawu lobunzulu kudonga lebhavu ngaphambi kokungena, kwaye ungaze ntywile ngentloko kwindawo ongayaziyo ubunzulu bayo.

p-187.title: Kutheni uthi ngequbuliso uhlangane nomnqantsa wamanzi abandayo elwandle
p-187.summary: Iilwandle neechibi zasehlotyeni zenza umnqantsa ofudumeleyo ngaphezu kwamanzi abandayo, ngoko amanyathelo ambalwa angaphantsi anokuvakala ebanda kakhulu ngequbuliso.
p-187.principle: Amanzi asemphezulu afudunyezwe lilanga anoxinano $\rho(T)$ olwehlileyo kwaye ayantywila, ngelixa amanzi abandayo esuka ezantsi, enza umnqantsa ozinzileyo (i-thermocline). Umnqantsa ozinzileyo uyachasa ukuxutywa, ngoko ubushushu butshintsha kakhulu emngceleni.
p-187.example: Uxinano lwamanzi lungu-997.0kg/m³ kwi-25°C kunye ne-999.1kg/m³ kwi-15°C, zahlukile nge-0.2% kuphela, kodwa kwanele ukugcina imiqolo ihlukile. Ukwehla kwe-5-10°C kwimitha embalwa kuqhelekile kwiichibi nakwiilwandle, kwaye umoya ovela elwandle ongcangcazelisa amanzi asemphezulu unokutsala amanzi abandayo aye elunxwemeni.
p-187.actionItem: Phambi kokuya enzulwini, yehlisa imilenze yakho kancinci ukuvakalelwa kukutshintsha kobushushu, kwaye ngeentsuku zamanzi abandayo ungabuki kude ngexesha elinye.

p-188.title: Ijubane lokungena emanzini: ukusuka kwi-3m ubetha amanzi malunga ne-28km/h
p-188.summary: Ukutsiba ukusuka kwi-3m kuthetha ukubetha amanzi malunga ne-28km/h, ngoko ukungena ngaphandle kokujonga ubunzulu kuyingozi.
p-188.principle: Ukuhoya ukuxhathisa komoya, ukugcinwa kwamandla kunika ijubane emva kokuwa ubude $h$: $v=\sqrt{2gh}$.
p-188.example: Kwi-$h=3\ \mathrm{m}$, $v=\sqrt{2\times9.8\times3}\approx7.7\ \mathrm{m/s}\approx27.6\ \mathrm{km/h}$. Ukusuka kwi-10m yi-14m/s (malunga ne-50km/h): ubude obungaphezu kwamaxesha ama-3 bunika ijubane eliphindwe malunga nama-1.8.
p-188.actionItem: Khangela uphawu lobunzulu ngaphambi kwaso nasiphi na isitsiba okanye intywilo, kwaye ungaze ngena ngentloko apho ubunzulu bungaziwa.

p-189.title: Thenga iimpahla zasehlotyeni ngokubonisa ukukhanya, hayi ngombala kuphela
p-189.summary: Indlela impahla yasehlotyeni ebandayo ngayo ixhomekeke kwindlela ebonisa ngayo ilanga nendlela ephefumla ngayo, hayi kuphela kwigama lombala.
p-189.principle: Amandla afunxwayo yi-$q=(1-\alpha)\,I$, apho i-$\alpha$ yi-albedo (ukubonisa) kwaye i-$I$ yi-solar irradiance. Imibala eqaqambileyo ibonisa ukukhanya okubonakalayo okungakumbi, ngoko ifunxa ngaphantsi.
p-189.example: Kwi-$I=1000\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$, impahla emhlophe ene-albedo 0.7 ifunxa malunga ne-300W/m², ngelixa emnyama ene-albedo 0.1 ifunxa malunga ne-900W/m², umahluko wamaxesha amathathu. Ezinye iimpahla ezimnyama zivala i-UV ngcono, ngoko khangela nenqanaba le-UPF.
p-189.actionItem: Xa uthenga iimpahla zasehlotyeni, khetha imibala eqaqambileyo ngomluko ophefumlayo kwaye ujonge ileyibhile ye-UPF.

p-190.title: Ibhotile ecacileyo yamanzi okanye ibhola yeglasi yeentlanzi inokuqala umlilo
p-190.summary: Ibhotile ejikelezileyo ecacileyo okanye isitya samanzi sinokugxila ukukhanya kwelanga njengelensi size sitshise izinto ezivuthayo.
p-190.principle: Ilensi ye-convex ilandela i-$\frac{1}{f}=\frac{1}{u}+\frac{1}{v}$, kwaye ukukhanya okuvela kwinto ekude kakhulu efana nelanga ($u\to\infty$) kugxila kwi-$v=f$. Ibhola ezele ngamanzi inobude bokugxila $f\approx\frac{nD}{4(n-1)}$.
p-190.example: Ibhotile enobubanzi $D=8\ \mathrm{cm}$ inika i-$f\approx1.33\times8/(4\times0.33)\approx8\ \mathrm{cm}$. Kwi-1000W/m², ukusikwa kwe-50cm² kuqokelela malunga ne-5W, kucinezelwe kwindawo yee-mm² ezimbalwa, kushushu ngokwaneleyo ukutshisa iphepha okanye indwangu.
p-190.actionItem: Susa iibhotile zamanzi, izitya zeentlanzi nezihombiso zeglasi kwiisilili zefestile, kwiibhalkoni nakwiimoto ezinelanga, okanye uzigubungele ngendwangu engadluli kukhanya.

p-191.title: Khetha i-watermelon ngesandi sokungqonga
p-191.summary: I-watermelon evuthiweyo ihlala inika isandi esiphantsi, esiqhumayo, ngoko ukungqonga luphawu oluluncedo, kodwa dibanisa nobunzima nombono.
p-191.principle: Ubuninzi bokungcangcazela bento ngokwayo yi-$f\propto\sqrt{k/m}$. Njengoko inyama ivuthwa ukuqina kwayo $k$ kuyehla, kwehlisa ukuphakama kwesandi, ngelixa iselon engavuthwanga ivakala iphezulu kwaye inzima.
p-191.example: Ngobunzima obufanayo, ukuba ukuqina $k$ kwehla nge-36% kuye kwi-$0.64k$, ubuninzi buba yi-$\sqrt{0.64}=0.8$ amaxesha, ukuhla kwe-20%. Phakathi kweeselon zobukhulu obufanayo, khetha neyona inzima kunye nenemvelaphi eyellow.
p-191.actionItem: Xa uthenga i-watermelon, ngqonga uphulaphule isandi esiphantsi, esiqhumayo kwaye ukhethe eyona inzima phakathi kwezo zobukhulu obufanayo.

p-192.title: Phefumlela iityhubhu zebhavu nebhola yasebhitshini kuphela ukuya kuma-80%
p-192.summary: Phantsi kwelanga elishushu umoya ongaphakathi uyandiswa, ngoko ityhubhu okanye ibhola ezele ngokupheleleyo inokuqhuma; i-80% igcwele ikhuselekile ngakumbi.
p-192.principle: Kwigesi ekufanelekileyo $PV=nRT$, kuxinzelelo olungatshintshiyo $V\propto T$ (umthetho kaCharles), kwaye kumthamo ongatshintshiyo $P\propto T$. Sebenzisa ubushushu obuphelele nge-kelvin.
p-192.example: Ukunyuka ukusuka kwi-25°C (298K) ukuya kwi-50°C (323K) kuphindaphinda umthamo nge-$323/298\approx1.084$, ukunyuka kwe-8.4%. Ityhubhu egcwaliswe kuma-95% idlulile umda wayo, kwaye kwibhutsi yemoto eshushu eyi-60°C (333K) ukukhula kungangama-12%.
p-192.actionItem: Phefumlela iityhubhu nebhola yasebhitshini kuphela kuma-80-90% kwaye ungazishiyi kwimoto eshushu okanye elangeni ngqo ixesha elide.

p-193.title: Kutheni iinconcwana zemvula zingenzi ntlungu: ijubane lokugqibela elingama-9m/s
p-193.summary: Nezinconcwana ezisuka kwii-kilomitha ezimbalwa ngaphezulu ziyayeka ukukhawuleza malunga ne-30km/h ngenxa yokuxhathisa komoya, ngoko imvula ayenzi ntlungu, kodwa isichotho sikhawuleza kwaye siyingozi.
p-193.principle: Ijubane lifikelela kwinqanaba xa ubunzima buthelekiswa nokuxhathisa: $mg=\tfrac{1}{2}\rho v^2C_dA$ inika ijubane lokugqibela $v_t=\sqrt{\frac{2mg}{\rho C_dA}}$.
p-193.example: Inconcwana yemvula eyi-5mm iwa malunga nama-9m/s (32km/h) kwaye inconcwana eyi-2mm malunga nama-6.5m/s. Kwi-vacuum ukuwa kwe-1km kuya kufikelela malunga nama-140m/s. Isichotho esingu-2cm siwa malunga nama-20m/s (72km/h), kwanele ukuthoba imoto.
p-193.actionItem: Ngeentsuku apho isichotho sixelwa, khangela uqikelelo kwaye uparke imoto yakho phantsi kwesithuthi.

p-194.title: Jolisa umoya wesixhobo sokupholisa phezulu
p-194.summary: Xa upholisa, thumela umoya phezulu ukuze umoya obandayo uwe kwaye igumbi lonke lipholile ngokulinganayo.
p-194.principle: Uxinano lwegesi ekufanelekileyo lu-$\rho=\frac{PM}{RT}$, luphezulu kubushushu obuphantsi. Umoya obandayo unzima kwaye uyawa ngelixa umoya oshushu unyuka, ukuqhuba ukuhamba ngokwemvelo.
p-194.example: Kwi-1atm, umoya kwi-18°C (291K) ngu-1.21kg/m³ malunga kwaye kwi-28°C (301K) malunga no-1.17kg/m³, ngoko umoya obandayo unoxinano oluphezulu ngama-3.4%. Ukujolisa phezulu kuphepha ukuqhwanyaza ngqo kubantu, ngoko isetingi ephezulu nge-1-2°C ingaqhubeka ivakala ikhululekile, ongeza amandla.
p-194.actionItem: Xa upholisa namhlanje, misela iilouvre zijonge phezulu okanye ngokuthe tye, kwaye ezantsi xa ufudumeza.

p-195.title: Ukubukela amaza kwindawo yokuthintela: ukuphindwa kabini kobude bamaza, kane amandla
p-195.summary: Ukuphinda kabini ubude bamaza kuphinda kane amandla amaza, ngoko ukubukela amaza kwindawo yokuthintela okanye ematyeni kuyingozi ngakumbi kunokuba kubonakala.
p-195.principle: Kumaza aqhelekileyo, amandla kwindawo nganye yi-$E=\frac{1}{8}\rho g H^2$, alingana nesikwere sobude bamaza $H$.
p-195.example: Ngo-$\rho=1025\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, ilaza eyi-1m ithwala malunga ne-1.26kJ/m² kunye nelaza eyi-2m malunga ne-5.0kJ/m², amaxesha amane. Amaza adlula phezulu anokuthabatha umntu ngokubetha kanye.
p-195.actionItem: Ngeentsuku zolwandle olunzima, ungahlali kwindawo yokuthintela okanye ematyeni, kwaye khangela uqikelelo lolwandle lobude bamaza ngaphambi kokuya.

p-196.title: Ifowuni ishushu kakhulu ehlotyeni: susa ikesi ukukhusela ubomi bebhetri
p-196.summary: Ubushushu busenza ubomi bebhetri bube mfutshane ngokukhawuleza, ngoko ehlotyeni susa ikesi kwaye uphephe ilanga ngqo ukuvumela ubushushu bubaleke.
p-196.principle: Ukuxhathisa kobushushu bokuqhuba yi-$R=\frac{L}{kA}$, kwaye ngobushushu obuvelisiweyo $P$ umahluko wobushushu yi-$\Delta T=PR$. Ikesi eshinyeneyo engasebenzisiyo enobunzima $L$ obukhulu yongeza i-$R$ kwaye iligcina ubushushu.
p-196.example: Ikesi ye-silicone eyi-2mm ene-$k\approx0.2\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$ kwi-70cm² inika i-$R\approx1.4\ \mathrm{K/W}$. Kwi-3W, njengakwi-navigation, ifowuni ishisa malunga ne-4°C ngaphezulu. Iiseli ze-lithium-ion ziguga ngokukhawuleza ngaphezu kwe-35°C, ziphinda ngokungqongqo isantya sokuguga kwi-10°C nganye.
p-196.actionItem: Xa usebenzisa i-navigation okanye ukutshaja elangeni, susa ikesi kwaye ugcine ifowuni emthunzini okanye kwindawo ephefumlayo.

p-197.title: Idiski ebhabhayo ibhabha kude nangqo ngokujikeleza
p-197.summary: Ukuphakamisa isihlahla sakho ukunika idiski ukujikeleza kuyigcina izinzile kwaye iyithumele kude, kwaye ukuphosa kukwangumthambo ophuculayo womzimba wonke.
p-197.principle: Ngaphandle kwe-torque yangaphandle, i-angular momentum $L=I\omega$iyagcinwa. Idiski ejikelezayo iyachasa utshintsho kwindlela ejonge ngayo, umphumo we-gyroscopic ozinzisa isimo sayo.
p-197.example: Idiski eyaphoswa ngama-5-8 ejikeleza ngesekhondi ibhabha izinzile ama-30-40m, ngelixa leyo iphoswe tyaba ngaphandle kokujikeleza iyajika okanye iwa kwimitha embalwa. Ngejubane elifanayo, ukuphinda kabini ukujikeleza kuphinda kabini i-$L$, ngoko kufuneka i-torque eyi-2 ukuyiphazamisa.
p-197.actionItem: Chitha imizuzu eyi-10 epakini uphosa idiski ngokubetha isihlahla, kwaye khulula amahlombe nezihlahla zakho kuqala.

p-198.title: Amanzi e-microwave angabonakali ebilisa, aze aqhume ngequbuliso
p-198.summary: Ukufudumeza amanzi kwikomityi egudileyo ixesha elide kunokuwadlulisa ekubiliseni ngaphandle kwamaqamza, aze aqhume ngamandla xa ephazanyiswa kwaye ashise.
p-198.principle: Amaqamza adinga iindawo zokuqala ezifana neengxaki okanye amasuntswana. Ikomityi egudileyo namanzi acocekileyo awanazo, ngoko amanzi anokuba superheated ngaphezu kwe-100°C. Ukunyikima okanye ukongeza impuphu kwenza ukuba aphume abe ngumphunga ngoko nangoko.
p-198.example: Ukufudumeza i-250mL ukusuka kwi-20°C ukuya kwi-100°C kudinga i-$Q=0.25\times4.18\times80\approx84\ \mathrm{kJ}$, malunga nama-105 s kwi-microwave ye-800W. Ukufudumeza ixesha elide kunokushiya amanzi athile ngaphezu kwe-100°C, ngoko nokuba ngumsipha wempuphu unokuwenza ukuba aphuphume.
p-198.actionItem: Xa ufudumeza amanzi, yongeza induku yomthi okanye isixhobo sokuxuba esikhuselekileyo kwi-microwave, wayeke aphumle imizuzwana engama-30 ngaphambi kokuwakhupha, kwaye gcina ubuso bakho kude nekomityi.

p-199.title: Fudumeza ipani ude amathontsi amanzi ajikeleze njengamaso
p-199.summary: Fudumeza ipani ye-stainless kuphela ude amathontsi amanzi ajikeleze njengamaso: ukutya kunamathela kancinci, kwaye ukufudumeza okongezelelweyo kuchitha igesi.
p-199.principle: Ngaphezu kwe-200°C malunga, ifilimu yomphunga yenza ngaphantsi kwethontsi lamanzi, ngoko liyantywila kwaye lijikeleze endaweni yokubila (umphumo we-Leidenfrost). Olo luphawu oluhle lokongeza ioyile.
p-199.example: Ukufudumeza ipani ye-stainless eyi-1.2kg (ubushushu obuthile malunga ne-0.5kJ/(kg·K)) ukusuka kwi-20°C ukuya kwi-200°C kuthatha i-$Q=1.2\times0.5\times180\approx108\ \mathrm{kJ}$ (malunga ne-0.03kWh). Ukuba ithontsi liyakhala kwaye liphele ngoko nangoko, ipani isakwi-150-190°C.
p-199.actionItem: Gqumisa ithontsi lamanzi epanini; xa lijikeleza njengeso, yongeza ioyile kwaye wehlise ilangatye.

p-200.title: Sebenzisa ii-anchor kwi-drywall ukusasaza umthwalo
p-200.summary: I-drywall ibuthathaka kwaye ibhulukhwe engenanchor ikhutshwa lula, ngoko sebenzisa i-anchor evulekayo ngasemva kwebhodi ukusasaza umthwalo kwindawo ebanzi.
p-200.principle: Uxinzelelo lwenkxaso yi-$p=\frac{F}{A}$. Ngokukhula kwendawo yokunxibelelana $A$, ngokuncinci uxinzelelo kwibhodi kumthwalo ofanayo. Ii-anchor ze-expansion kunye ne-toggle ziyavuleka ngasemva kodonga ukwandisa indawo.
p-200.example: Ifreyimu eyi-10kg ($F\approx98\ \mathrm{N}$) ibanjwe yisikulufu esinenkxaso engu-1cm² inika malunga ne-0.98MPa, kodwa i-toggle anchor ene-8cm² inika malunga ne-0.12MPa, isitshiyagalombini. I-anchor nganye inomthwalo wayo olinganisiweyo, ngoko khangela ipakethe.
p-200.actionItem: Xhoma izinto ezinzima kwi-stud, okanye khetha i-anchor enomthwalo olinganisiweyo odlula ngokukhululekileyo ubunzima bento.

p-201.title: Ubushushu bombala webhalbhu: 3000K kwigumbi lokuhlala, 5000K kwigumbi lokufunda
p-201.summary: Okukhona ubushushu bombala webhalbhu buphezulu, kokukhona ukukhanya kwayo kuba luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka nokubandayo. Khetha i-K ephantsi kwiindawo zokuphumla kunye ne-K ephezulu kwezokufunda nomsebenzi.
p-201.principle: I-blackbody eshushu ikhupha ngamandla amakhulu kwi-$\lambda_{max}=\frac{b}{T}$ (umthetho kaWien), $b=2.898\times10^{-3}\ \mathrm{m\cdot K}$. Ubushushu obuphezulu buya kwihlaza okwesibhakabhaka, kwaye ubushushu bombala webhalbhu bubizwa ngokuthelekiswa nombala we-blackbody.
p-201.example: I-blackbody ye-3000K inyuka ekufutshane nama-966nm, i-5000K ekufutshane nama-580nm kunye ne-6500K ekufutshane nama-446nm, ngoko ophezulu uvakala uluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ngakumbi. Amagumbi okuhlala adla ngokusebenzisa i-2700-3000K (emhlophe efudumeleyo) kunye namagumbi okufunda i-4000-5000K (imini).
p-201.actionItem: Xa uthenga iibhalbhu, khangela umlinganiselo we-K ebhokisini kwaye ukhethe malunga ne-3000K kwigumbi lokuhlala kunye nama-5000K kwigumbi lokufunda.

p-202.title: Khangela ukungqiqa kwe-LED ngemowudi ye-slow-motion yefowuni yakho
p-202.summary: Izibane ze-LED zingangqiqa ngokungabonakali, kwaye ezibiza kancinci zingqiqa ngokunzulu ngakumbi, oko kunokudinisa amehlo akho. Ividiyo ye-slow-motion ikubonisa ngokulula.
p-202.principle: I-LED ye-AC elungisiweyo itshintsha ngokuphindwe kabini kwi-mains frequency: 120Hz kwiigridi ze-60Hz kunye ne-100Hz kwiigridi ze-50Hz. Ixesha lithi $T=\frac{1}{f}$, malunga nama-8.3 ms kwi-120Hz.
p-202.example: Ukuthatha isibane kwi-slow motion ye-240 fps kunika umsantsa wefreyimu wama-4.2 ms malunga, ngoko iifreyimu ezi-2 malunga zifaneleka kumjikelo ngamnye kwaye imigca okanye amanyathelo okukhanya ayabonakala. Iimveliso ezingqiqa ngokunzulu zingabangela ukudinwa kwamehlo okanye intloko ebuhlungu kwabanye abantu.
p-202.actionItem: Thatha ividiyo yezibane zekhaya lakho nge-slow motion, kwaye ukuba ubona imigca, cinga ngokutshintshela kwimveliso engangqiqiyo.

p-203.title: Sebenzisa ukunqanda kwenjini ezantsi ukuphepha iibhrekhi ezishushu kakhulu
p-203.summary: Ekwehleni okude, ukusebenzisa iibhrekhi kuphela kuqokelela ubushushu kwaye kulahlekelwe ngamandla okumisa, ngoko sebenzisa nokunqanda kwenjini kwigiya ephantsi, nako oko kunokonga ipetroli.
p-203.principle: Amandla okuma $mgh$ alahlekileyo, kunciphisiwe ngotshintsho kumandla okuhamba $\frac{1}{2}mv^2$, aba bushushu kwiipads zebhrekhi. Ukuba zishushu kakhulu, ukuxhathisa kuyawa kwinto ebizwa ngokuba yi-brake fade.
p-203.example: Imoto eyi-1500kg ehla i-500m itshintsha malunga ne-$1500\times9.8\times500\approx7.4\ \mathrm{MJ}$ (malunga ne-2kWh) ibe bubushushu. Ukumisa ukusuka kwi-100km/h (27.8m/s) kuphela kuyi-580kJ malunga. Ukusebenzisa igiya ephantsi kuvumela ukuxhathisa kwenjini kwabelane ngomthwalo.
p-203.actionItem: Phambi kokuqala kokwehla okude, tshintshela kwigiya ephantsi ukuze kufuneke ubhreke maxa wambi kuphela.

p-204.title: Ukuzamazamisa iingalo xa uhamba kugcina amandla
p-204.summary: Ukuhamba ngokuzamazamisa iingalo ngokwemvelo kuthatha amandla angaphantsi kunokubamba iingalo zimile, kwaye kugcina umzimba uzinzile ngakumbi.
p-204.principle: Ingalo ezamazama ukusuka egxalabeni yipendulum enexesha lemvelo $T=2\pi\sqrt{L/g}$. Xa ukuzamazama kuhambelana nesigaba sakho, umzamo uyehla, kwaye iingalo ezizamazamayo ziyisusa ukujijeka komzimba okubangelwa yimilenze.
p-204.example: Ngobude bengalo obusebenzayo $L\approx0.35\ \mathrm{m}$, $T\approx1.2\ \mathrm{s}$, ekufutshane nexesha lesigaba elingama-1.1 s. Uphando lufumanisa ukuba ukuthintela ukuzamazama kweengalo kukhulisa iindleko zamandla okuhamba nge-10% malunga.
p-204.actionItem: Ekuhambeni kwakho namhlanje, khulula amahlombe kwaye uvumele iingalo zakho zizamazame ngokwemvelo imizuzu eyi-10.

p-205.title: Kutheni ukucula kuvakala kamnandi kwishawa: ukuvakala kwakhona
p-205.summary: Iithayile neglasi egumbini lokuhlambela zifunxa kancinci isandi, ngoko siyahlala size senze ukucula kuvakale kugcwele, kodwa kwikholi yevidiyo loo mvakalelo iyaphazamisa.
p-205.principle: Ixesha lokuvakala kwakhona lilandela ifomula kaSabine $T=\frac{0.161\,V}{A}$, apho i-$V$ ngumthamo wegumbi (m³) kwaye i-$A$ kukufunxa okupheleleyo (m²), isixa sendawo nganye ngokuphindaphindwa kwekoefisiyenti yayo yokufunxa.
p-205.example: Ngomthamo we-7.2m³, malunga ne-23m² yomphezulu nekoefisiyenti yokufunxa yethayile ekufutshane no-0.02, $A\approx0.46\ \mathrm{m^2}$ kwaye $T\approx2.5\ \mathrm{s}$. Igumbi lokuhlala elineekhaphethi neentsimbi lingama-0.4-0.6 s malunga, ngoko isandi sinyamalala ngokukhawuleza kakhulu.
p-205.actionItem: Ukuba kufuneka wenze ikholi okanye urekhode egumbini lokuhlambela, xhoma iitawuli okanye umata ukunciphisa ukuvakala kwakhona, okanye uye kwigumbi elineempahla ezithambileyo.

p-206.title: Gcina ihosi yokukhupha amanzi ye-AC ithe nkqi ezantsi yonke indlela
p-206.summary: Amanzi e-AC agcwala ngegravity kuphela, ngoko ihosi kufuneka ithambekele ezantsi ubude bayo bonke, okanye ukuhlala nokugoba kunokuyivala kwaye kudale ukuvuza ngaphakathi.
p-206.principle: Amanzi agcwala asuka phezulu aye ezantsi ngegravity, ngoko ihosi ifuna ukwehla okungephantsi kwe-1cm kwimitha nganye (ithambeko le-1/100 okanye ngaphezulu). Amanzi ahlukeneyo aholela kwingxinano, ukuvaleka nokuvuza.
p-206.example: Ngeentsuku ezinomswakama, isixhobo se-AC senza malunga ne-1L yamanzi ngeyure. Ihosi eyi-5m kufuneka iphele ubuncinci i-5cm ngaphantsi kunokuba iqale. Ukuvuza okufaka udonga nomgangatho kunokubiza ukulungiswa.
p-206.actionItem: Khangela ukuba ihosi yokukhupha ihamba ezantsi ukuya ekupheleni kwayo, ayinazo izigobo okanye ukuhlala, kwaye ukuphela kwayo akutshonile emanzini.

p-207.title: Kunzima ukwazi ukuba isandi sivela phi phantsi kwamanzi
p-207.summary: Isandi sihamba ngokukhawuleza emanzini kangangokuba umahluko wexesha phakathi kweendlebe zakho unyamalala, kunzima ukwazi ukuba isikhephe okanye umntu uvela kweyiphi icala.
p-207.principle: Isandi sihamba malunga nama-343m/s emoyeni kunye nama-1500m/s emanzini. Sigweba isalathiso ngomahluko wexesha lokufika phakathi kweendlebe, $\Delta t=\frac{d\cos\theta}{v}$, apho xa i-$v$ inkulu i-$\Delta t$ iba ncinci kakhulu.
p-207.example: Ngeendlebe ezikude ngo-$d\approx0.2\ \mathrm{m}$, umahluko wexesha ophezulu ngama-0.58 ms emoyeni kodwa malunga nama-0.13 ms phantsi kwamanzi, amaxesha ama-4.4 ngaphantsi. Ubuchopho bunzima ukuwahlula, ngoko awukwazi ukwazi ukuba imoto ikuphi.
p-207.actionItem: Xa uhlamba, hlala ngaphakathi kwindawo enamabuyisi kwaye uphakamise intloko rhoqo ukujonga izikhephe ngamehlo akho.

p-208.title: Umpu wamanzi udubula kude kakhulu kwii-degrees ezingama-45
p-208.summary: Xa ukuxhathisa komoya kuncinci, ijethi yamanzi eyadutyulwa kwii-degrees ezingama-45 iya kude kakhulu. Zama xa ukhuphisana ngomgama epakini yamanzi.
p-208.principle: Kwiprojectile eqaliswe kwaye yehla kubude obufanayo, uluhlu lu-$R=\frac{v^2\sin2\theta}{g}$, olukhulu xa i-$\sin2\theta$ iphezulu, kwi-$\theta=45^\circ$. Ekusebenzeni ukuxhathisa komoya kunokwehlisa i-engile ebalaseleyo kancinci.
p-208.example: Ijethi eyi-10m/s ifikelela kwi-$R=10^2/9.8\approx10.2\ \mathrm{m}$ kwii-degrees ezingama-45. Kwii-30 okanye ii-60 degrees, i-$\sin60^\circ\approx0.866$ inika malunga nama-8.8m, i-86% yomgama.
p-208.actionItem: Xa usebenzisa umpu wamanzi, tshintsha i-engile ukufumana ukuphosa okuphezulu, kodwa ungaze ujolise ebusweni okanye emehlweni omntu.

p-209.title: Kutheni ibhola igoba: ukujikeleza kunye namandla kaMagnus
p-209.summary: Ibhola ejikelezayo igoba ngecala ekubhabheni kuba ukujikeleza kwenza uxinzelelo lomoya lwahluke kumacala ayo amabini.
p-209.principle: Ibhola ejikelezayo ehamba emoyeni iva amandla athe tye kuzo zombini ijubane layo $\vec v$ kunye ne-axis yokujikeleza $\vec\omega$: $\vec F=S(\vec\omega\times\vec v)$ (amandla kaMagnus). Umoya uhamba ngokukhawuleza kwelinye icala, wenza umahluko woxinzelelo.
p-209.example: Ukukhaba ibhola yebhola ngokukhululekileyo kwi-108km/h (30m/s) ijikeleza malunga namaxesha ama-8 ngesekhondi inokugoba ngecala malunga nama-3-4m kwi-25m. Ngaphandle kokujikeleza ibhabha phantse ngqo.
p-209.actionItem: Kwixesha elilandelayo uqhwaba ibhola epakini, yenza ukujikeleza kwecala ngaphakathi kwonyawo lwakho uze ubone indlela igoba ngayo.

p-210.title: Umbono welwandle usekunxweni ukude kuphela malunga ne-4.7km
p-210.summary: Ukusuka kubude bamehlo obungu-1.7m umbono welwandle ukude kuphela malunga ne-4.7km, ngoko ulwandle olusemaphandleni olubonayo ukusuka elunxwemeni lusondele kunokuba lubonakala.
p-210.principle: Ngenxa yokuba iMhlaba ijikeleze, umgama ukuya kumbono ukusuka kubude bamehlo $h$ (m) yi-$d\approx3.57\sqrt{h}$ km. Eli xabiso sele liquka ukulungiswa kokukhukuliswa komoya.
p-210.example: Kubude bamehlo obungu-1.7m, $d\approx3.57\times\sqrt{1.7}\approx4.65$ km, kwaye ukusuka kwisakhiwo esiphakamileyo esi-10m kungama-11.3km malunga. Inqanawa ekude ilahlekelwa kuqala ngumzimba wayo, kushiyeke kuphela i-mast ebonakalayo.
p-210.actionItem: Elunxwemeni, jonga inqanawa ekude uqaphele indlela umzimba wayo unyamalala ngaphantsi komda welwandle kushiyeke kuphela i-mast.

p-211.title: Cinezela iqhosha lovavanyo le-RCD nyanga nganye ngexesha lemvula
p-211.summary: Umngcipheko wokuvuza uyanda emoyeni onomswakama wexesha lemvula, ngoko khangela nyanga nganye ukuba i-breaker yakho yesiseko isebenza ngokucinezela iqhosha layo lovavanyo.
p-211.principle: I-RCD iva umahluko phakathi kwangoku okungenayo nokuphumayo, $I_\Delta=|I_{in}-I_{out}|$, kwaye idla ngokunqumla umbane kwi-0.03 s xa ifikelela kuvakalelo olulinganisiweyo, rhoqo i-30mA. Iqhosha lovavanyo lenza loo ngxaki ngabom.
p-211.example: Ukuvuza kwangoku kwe-30mA kunokuba yingozi komntu othinta inxalenye eneqhuba, ngoko kufuneka ihlekele ngoko nangoko kuloo nqanaba. Xa ucinezela iqhosha lovavanyo i-lever kufuneka iwe kwaye umbane unqunyulwe.
p-211.actionItem: Gcina nawuphi na umsebenzi ovulekileyo, cinezela iqhosha lovavanyo le-RCD ukujonga ukuba iyahlekela, kwaye biza i-electrician ukuba ayihlekeli.

p-212.title: Khangela i-infrared yeremoti ye-AC ngekhamera yefowuni yakho
p-212.summary: Ukuba isixhobo sakho se-AC asiphenduli kwiremoti, sebenzisa ikhamera yefowuni ukubona ukuba iremoti ithumela uphawu kwaye uphephe ukutyelelwa kokulungisa okungeyomfuneko.
p-212.principle: I-LED ye-infrared yeremoti ithumela iimpawu kwi-940nm malunga, ezingabonakaliyo ngeliso, ngamandla e-photon $E=\frac{hc}{\lambda}\approx\frac{1240\ \mathrm{eV\cdot nm}}{940\ \mathrm{nm}}\approx1.32\ \mathrm{eV}$. Isenzi se-CMOS sekhamera siyabona oku kukhanya kwaye siyakubonisa njengokukhanya okukhanyayo esikrinini.
p-212.example: Jolisa iremoti kwilensi yekhamera uze ucinezele iqhosha: ukunyaniseka okuthambileyo okuluhlaza okanye okumhlophe esikrinini kuthetha ukuba iremoti iyasebenza. Ukuba akukho nto ibonakalayo, tshintsha iibhetri (ngokuqhelekileyo ezimbini ze-AAA) okanye jonga iremoti kuqala. Amanye amakhamera angaphambili anezihluzi ze-infrared ezibuthathaka kwaye ayibonisa ngcono.
p-212.actionItem: Vula ikhamera engaphambili yefowuni yakho, cinezela iqhosha leremoti uze ujonge ukuba ungakubona ukukhanya.

p-213.title: Kutheni ubunzima bakho butshintsha xa i-elevator iqala kwaye iyama
p-213.summary: Uyavakala ulemele xa i-elevator iqala ukunyuka kwaye ulula xa iyama, kodwa ubunzima bakho abutshintshanga: kutshintshe ukutyhala komgangatho kuwe.
p-213.principle: Kwi-elevator ikhawulezayo ukunyuka nge-$a$, umgangatho ukutyhala ngamandla aqhelekileyo $N=m(g+a)$. Isikali sifunda eli xabiso, ngoko ubunzima obubonakalayo buyatshintsha.
p-213.example: Kumntu oyi-70kg onokukhawuleza okuphezulu kwe-1m/s², $N=70\times(9.8+1)\approx756\ \mathrm{N}$, ngoko isikali sifunda malunga ne-77kg. Xa i-elevator enyukayo iyama ngokukhawuleza ezantsi kwe-1m/s², ivakala ngathi ingama-63kg.
p-213.actionItem: Njengoko i-elevator iqala kwaye iyama, goba amadolo kancinci uze ubambe i-handrail ukuhlala ulinganisiwe.

p-214.title: Icala langasekunene lendlela yesaqhwithi lilingozi ngakumbi
