p-214.summary: Kwi-Northern Hemisphere imimoya yesaqhwithi inamandla ngakumbi ngasekunene kwendlela yayo, ngoko iindawo ezisekunene kwendlela kufuneka zilungiselele umonakalo omkhulu.
p-214.principle: Isaqhwithi sine-counter-clockwise rotating wind $v_{rot}$ kunye nejubane lokuya phambili lesaqhwithi $v_{move}$. Ngasekunene kwendlela ziyadibana kwaye ngasekhohlo ziyasuswa: $v_{wind}=v_{rot}\pm v_{move}$.
p-214.example: Ngomoya ojikelezayo we-40m/s kunye nejubane lokuya phambili le-8m/s, icala langasekunene libona malunga nama-48m/s kwaye langasekhohlo ama-32m/s, kwaye ekubeni uxinzelelo lomoya lukhula ngesikwere sejubane, umlinganiselo yi-$(48/32)^2=2.25$. Icala langasekunene libizwa ngokuba yi-dangerous semicircle.
p-214.actionItem: Ngexesha lesaqhwithi, khangela indlela eqikelelwayo, kwaye ukuba ukwicala langasekunene, rhoxisa okanye usindise uhambo nohambo lonxweme.

p-215.title: Phinda kabini ijubane lomoya wesaqhwithi, kane umthwalo womoya
p-215.summary: Xa ijubane lomoya liphindwa kabini, amandla kwiifestile nakwiimpawu aphindwa kane, ngoko awunakugweba isaqhwithi ngokuvakalelwa komoya oqhelekileyo.
p-215.principle: Amandla omoya kwindawo $A$ ngu-$F=\frac{1}{2}\rho v^2A$ (ucinga ikoefisiyenti yokuxhathisa ekufutshane ne-1), alingana nesikwere sejubane. Uxinano lomoya lu-$\rho\approx1.225\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$.
p-215.example: Kwifestile ye-1m², umoya we-20m/s unika i-$F\approx245\ \mathrm{N}$ kunye ne-40m/s malunga ne-980N (malunga ne-100 kgf), amaxesha amane. Iiglasi ezinkulu zithwala okungakumbi kakhulu.
p-215.actionItem: Phambi kwesaqhwithi, khangela ukuba iilatches zefestile zivalwe, kwaye ngexesha laso uhlale kude neefestile.

p-216.title: Ukuba iifestile ziyangcangcazela emoyeni onamandla, faka i-cushioning yeemfunxeko
p-216.summary: Ifestile ekhwaza ithetha ukuba umoya uhambelana nobuninzi bayo bemvelo, ngoko ukucushion kweemfunxeko kunciphisa ingxolo nomoya.
p-216.principle: Ubuninzi bemvelo be-sash yefestile yi-$f=\frac{1}{2\pi}\sqrt{\frac{k}{m}}$. Xa ubuninzi bemimoya busondele kwi-$f$ i-sash iyaphinda ngokunyikima kakhulu. I-cushioning yongeza ukuncitshiswa kwaye itshintshe ukuqina $k$ ukuphepha ukuphindaphinda.
p-216.example: I-sash eyi-8kg ibanjwe nge-$k=80\ \mathrm{kN/m}$ inayo i-$f=\frac{1}{2\pi}\sqrt{80000/8}\approx15.9\ \mathrm{Hz}$. Ukuba i-cushioning iphinda kabini i-$k$, inyuka ukuya kuma-22.5Hz malunga kwaye ukuncitshiswa kuyanda, ngoko ukukhwaza kuyancipha. Ukutywina iimfunxeko kunciphisa nomoya wasebusika kwaye konga amandla okufudumeza.
p-216.actionItem: Namathisela i-weatherstrip cushioning engu-5-10mm ecaleni kweemfunxeko zeefreyimu zefestile uze ubone ukuba ukukhwaza kuyancipha na.

p-217.title: Kutheni ithenti lenkampu liphapha kwaye liphakama emoyeni
p-217.summary: Umoya osukuma ngokukhawuleza ngaphezu kwethenti wehlisa uxinzelelo kwaye uphakamisa indwangu, ngoko indlela oyibophela ngayo ibhetha ukhuseleko ngeentsuku ezinomoya.
p-217.principle: Ngokomgaqo kaBernoulli, uxinzelelo luyehla apho ijubane loluwelo liphezulu, kwaye umahluko woxinzelelo phakathi kwamacala omabini ungama-$\Delta P\approx\frac{1}{2}\rho v^2$ malunga. Lo mahluko kukunyuka kwendwangu.
p-217.example: Kwi-10m/s, $\Delta P\approx\frac{1}{2}\times1.225\times10^2\approx61\ \mathrm{Pa}$, ngoko ithenti eyi-4m ngama-4m (16m²) inokubona ukuya kuma-980N (malunga ne-100 kgf). Kwi-20m/s kuphindwe kane.
p-217.actionItem: Xa uthenga ithenti jonga inani lee-eyelet nendlela ezomelezwe ngayo, kwaye xa uyimisa jonga unqenqema olusezantsi emoyeni kwaye ushayele iinduku nzulu ngeengile.

p-218.title: Sebenzisa ifeni ye-AC imizuzu eyi-10 phambi kokuyivala
p-218.summary: Ukusebenzisa i-AC kwimowudi yefeni malunga nemizuzu eyi-10 phambi kokuyivala kumisa ngaphakathi kwaye kunciphisa ivumba lenkunkuma, phantse ngaphandle kwebala lombane.
p-218.principle: Emva kokupholisa, amathontsi anyibilikisiweyo asala kwi-evaporator coil. Isantya sokuphuma silingana ne-vapour pressure deficit $(p_s-p)$, ngoko ukuvuthela umoya onomswakama kude kuyimisa ngokukhawuleza.
p-218.example: Imowudi yefeni itsala malunga nama-40W, ngoko imizuzu eyi-10 isebenzisa nje i-$40\times\frac{10}{60}\approx6.7\ \mathrm{Wh}$. Ukufuma okushiyekileyo kuvumela inkunkuma nebacteria ukuba zikhule, kubangele ivumba kwaye kukhokelele kwiindleko zokucoca nokuncipha kokusebenza.
p-218.actionItem: Namhlanje, phambi kokuvala i-AC, yisebenzise kwimowudi yefeni okanye yomisa imizuzu eyi-10, okanye vula umsebenzi wokomisa ngokuzenzekelayo ukuba unawo.

p-219.title: Gcina ibhanti yesihlalo ibotshelelwe ngexesha lokubhabha, nanini ukuhleli
p-219.summary: I-turbulence ibetha ngaphandle kwesilumkiso, ngoko ukugcina ibhanti yesihlalo ibotshelelwe nanini ukuhleli yeyona ndlela ethembekileyo yokuthintela ukwenzakala.
p-219.principle: NgoMthetho wesibini kaNewton $F=ma$, xa inqwelomoya ikhawuleza kakhulu nkqo, umzimba wakho uvakalelwa kukukhawuleza okufanayo. Ngokukhawuleza kwe-nkqo kwe-$\pm1\,g$, ubunzima bakho obubonakalayo buba ziro okanye buphindwa kabini.
p-219.example: Umntu oyi-70kg uvakalelwa kutshintsho lwamandla malunga ne-$\pm0.5\,g$ nakwi-turbulence ephakathi ye-$0.5\times70\times9.8\approx343\ \mathrm{N}$. Kwi-turbulence enzima engaphezu kwe-1g, umntu ongabotshelelwanga angaphakanyiswa esihlalweni abethe uphahla.
p-219.actionItem: Ngelixa uhleli ngexesha lokubhabha, gcina ibhanti yesihlalo ibotshelelwe ngokuqinileyo ezantsi kakhulu ngaphezu kwamathambo akho omqolo.

p-220.title: Isango lemoto etshonileyo emanzini alinakuvulwa
p-220.summary: Iingcango zemoto etshonileyo azivuleki ngokuchasene noxinzelelo lwamanzi, ngoko baleka ngokukhawuleza ngefestile endaweni yengcango.
p-220.principle: Amandla amanzi engcango ngoxinzelelo lobunzulu obuphakathi ngokuphindwe yindawo: $F=\rho g\frac{h}{2}A$. Kude kube amanzi angaphakathi nangaphandle elingana, kufuneka utyhale ngokuchasene naloo mandla.
p-220.example: Ngengcango ebanzi eyi-1.0m namanzi anzulu angama-0.5m (indawo ye-0.5m²), $F=1000\times9.8\times0.25\times0.5\approx1225\ \mathrm{N}$, malunga ne-125 kgf. Iifestile zamandla zinokuyeka ukusebenza kungekudala. Kufuneka wenze ngokukhawuleza ukuba imoto iqala ukutshona, phambi kokuba igcwale.
p-220.actionItem: Gcina isiqhekeza-festile songxamiseko esifikelelekayo emotweni yakho, kwaye ungaze ushayele kwindlela efunxeleyo.

p-221.title: Khupha izixhobo ezifakwe kumbane xa kuduma
p-221.summary: Umbane unokubangela i-voltage ephezulu kakhulu yoomzuzwana (i-surge) kwiintambo enokonakalisa ii-TV neekhompyuter, ngoko zikhuphe phambi kokuba isaqhwithi sifike.
p-221.principle: Xa umbane we-lightning utshintsha ngokukhawuleza, ubangela i-voltage $V=-M\frac{dI}{dt}$ kwiluphu zentambo ezisondeleyo ($M$ yi-mutual inductance). Okukhona utshintsho lukhawuleza, kokukhona kuvela ii-kilovolts ezininzi.
p-221.example: Ngo-$M=1\ \mathrm{\mu H}$ kunye no-$dI/dt=6\times10^9\ \mathrm{A/s}$, $V\approx6\ \mathrm{kV}$, ngaphezu kwama-1.5-2.5kV izixhobo zasekhaya ze-220V ezinokumelana nazo. Kodwa ungasondeli kwii-plugs ukuzikhupha xa umbane uphezu kwakho.
p-221.actionItem: Phambi kokuba isaqhwithi sifike, khupha i-TV yakho, ikhompyuter ne-router okanye usebenzise i-surge-protector strip, kwaye ungachukumisi iintambo okanye izixhobo xa kuduma.

p-222.title: Ngenisa iimbiza zeeplanti zebhalkoni ngaphakathi phambi kwesaqhwithi
p-222.summary: Imbiza yeplanti ephekwe okanye ehlutyelwe sisaqhwithi inokubulala umntu osezantsi, ngoko ngenisa iimbiza nezinto zebhalkoni ngaphakathi ngaphambili.
p-222.principle: Into ewayo ukusuka ebudeni $h$ ithwala amandla $mgh$, kwaye ngaphandle kokuxhathisa komoya ijubane layo li-$v=\sqrt{2gh}$. Ingozi ikhula ngobunzima nobude.
p-222.example: Imbiza ye-5kg ewa ukusuka kuma-30m malunga (umgangatho we-10) ifikelela kwi-$v\approx24\ \mathrm{m/s}$ (malunga nama-87km/h) ngamandla amalunga ne-$5\times9.8\times30\approx1470\ \mathrm{J}$, ngokufanayo nento eyi-3.8kg ehamba malunga nama-100km/h.
p-222.actionItem: Xa isaqhwithi sixelwa, ngenisa iimbiza ezisuka kumqolo webhalkoni, iirakhi zokomisa nefanitshala encinci ngaphakathi uze ukhiye iifestile.

p-223.title: Ukugula ngenxa yolwandle kuncinci kwindawo esezantsi, esembindini yenqanawa
p-223.summary: Iidekhi eziphakathi, ezisezantsi zenqanawa ziyahamba kancinci, ngoko ukugula ngenxa yolwandle kuncinci apho. Khetha igumbi okanye isihlalo kuloo ndawo.
p-223.principle: Inqanawa iyazamazama malunga nendawo ekufutshane nembindi yayo, ngoko ubungakanani bentshukumo kwindawo bukhula ngomgama wayo ukusuka kumbindi wokujikeleza ($s\approx r\theta$). Intshukumo oyibonayo ngamehlo ehambelana nokuvakalelwa yi-vestibular system yendlebe yangaphakathi ibangela ukugula ngenxa yolwandle.
p-223.example: Ukuzamazama kwe-$\pm2^\circ$ (0.035 rad), ingaphambili elikude nama-40m ukusuka kumbindi lihamba malunga ne-$\pm1.4\ \mathrm{m}$, ngelixa indawo eyi-5m ukusuka kumbindi ihamba malunga ne-$\pm0.17\ \mathrm{m}$ kuphela, umahluko wamaxesha ama-8. Iidekhi eziphezulu ziyazamazama ngakumbi.
p-223.actionItem: Xa ubhukisha inqanawa, khetha igumbi elisezantsi nelisembindini, kwaye xa ungenile jonga umbono welwandle.

p-224.title: Iinkwenkwezi ezisiwayo zibonakala emva kokuba amehlo akho ejikelezwe kubumnyama imizuzu engama-20
p-224.summary: Ukuvela kwindawo ekhanyayo, amehlo akho adinga imizuzu engama-20-30 ukuvana nobumnyama, kwaye kude kube ngoko iimeteor ezibuthathaka kunzima ukuzibona.
p-224.principle: Ebumnyameni, iiseli zeerod ziba novakalelo ngakumbi njengoko i-photopigment yazo ivuselelwa, kwaye inqanaba lokukhanya lomgangatho wokubona liyehla kakhulu ngokuhamba kwexesha. Ukuvana ngokupheleleyo kwerod kuthatha imizuzu engama-20-30, kwaye ukukhanya kwesikrini sefowuni kuyabuyisa.
p-224.example: Ukuba sele uvanile nobumnyama, uvakalelo lokukhanya luphezulu malunga namaxesha ayi-10,000 okanye ngaphezulu kunasekukhanyeni. Imvula yeemeteor yePerseid inyuka malunga nowe-12-13 Agasti qho ngonyaka, kwaye phantsi kwamazulu amnyama ngokukhanya kwenyanga okuncinci okanye kwesixeko amashumi eentlobo angabonwa ngeyure.
p-224.actionItem: Xa uphuma ukuze ubukele imvula yeemeteor, hlala kwindawo emnyama kakhulu enokwenzeka, ungasebenzisi ifowuni imizuzu engama-20 uze ujonge ngokubanzi ezulwini.

p-225.title: Kutheni isikrini singafundeki ngaphandle emini: ukukhanya kunye nokukhanya okubonisiweyo
p-225.summary: Isikrini asifundeki ngaphandle ekukhanyeni kungenxa yokuba ukukhanya kwelanga okubonisiweyo ngaphandle komphezulu wayo kuthoba ukukhanya okukhutshwa yiyo, hayi kuba kuphantsi kancinci.
p-225.principle: Umlinganiselo wokuthelekisa yi-$CR=\frac{L+L_a}{L_a}$, apho i-$L$ kukukhanya kwesikrini (nit) kwaye i-$L_a=\frac{RE}{\pi}$ kukukhanya kokukhanya kwendawo okubonisiweyo ngumphezulu ($R$ ukubonisa, $E$ illuminance). Ukubonisa okunamandla kutyhalela umlinganiselo wokuthelekisa kufutshane ne-1.
p-225.example: Kwilanga eliqinileyo ngo-$E=100{,}000\ \mathrm{lx}$ kunye nokubonisa $R=2\%$, $L_a\approx637\ \mathrm{nit}$. Isikrini se-800 nit sinika i-$CR\approx(800+637)/637\approx2.3$:1, phantse singafundeki, ngelixa kwigumbi le-300 lx i-$L_a\approx1.9\ \mathrm{nit}$ kwaye i-$CR$ ikumakhulu.
p-225.actionItem: Ngeentsuku ezikhanyayo, misela ukukhanya kwesikrini kubungakanani obuphezulu okanye ngokuzenzekelayo, kwaye mthunzise isikrini ngomzimba okanye isandla sakho.

p-226.title: Kutheni i-app yekhompasi yemephu ibonisa icala elingalunganga ngexesha lohambo
p-226.summary: Ikhompasi yefowuni ifunda inkalo ebuthathaka yemagnethi yoMhlaba, ngoko iimagnethi okanye isinyithi esikufutshane ziyayiphosa icala lula.
p-226.principle: Inkalo yoMhlaba yi-$50\ \mu\mathrm{T}$ kuphela (eKorea), ngoko xa iinkalo zemagnethi ezingenelelayo $B_{int}$ ezivela kwizinto zemagnethi ezikufutshane ziyongezwa, impazamo yekhosi yi-$\theta\approx\arctan\frac{B_{int}}{B_{earth}}$.
p-226.example: Nokuba i-$10\ \mu\mathrm{T}$ eyongezelelweyo evela kwikesi yemagnethi okanye kwi-car mount inika impazamo ye-$\arctan(10/50)\approx11^\circ$. IKorea inayo nokuphambuka kwemagnethi malunga ne-8°, ngoko umahluko phakathi kwemantla yemagnethi neyokwenyani kufuneka uqwalaselwe.
p-226.actionItem: Ukuba i-app yakho yemephu ibonisa ikhosi engaqhelekanga, hambisa ifowuni ngendlela ye-8 ukuphinda ukulungisa ikhompasi kwaye uyigcine kude neemagnethi nesinyithi.

p-227.title: Kwi-100m nganye oyinyukayo, umoya upholile malunga ne-0.65 degrees
p-227.summary: Intaba ephakamileyo ipholile kakhulu kunamathafa ngolu suku lunye, ngoko ukunxiba ngobushushu bentlambo kukushiya uhlile ngaphezulu.
p-227.principle: Ubushushu bomoya buyehla ngokunyuka kobude ngomlinganiselo ophakathi we-lapse rate $\Gamma\approx6.5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C/km}$. Kumahluko wobude $\Delta z$ ubushushu butshintsha nge-$\Delta T=-\Gamma\Delta z$.
p-227.example: Ukuba yi-30°C ekuqaleni kwe-100m, incopho yeCheonwangbong yeJirisan (1915m) yi-$30-0.65\times18.15\approx18.2\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Umoya wenza ukuvakala kubanda ngakumbi.
p-227.actionItem: Phambi kohambo lwasentabeni, khangela ubushushu obuqikelelwayo kubude bencopho uze upakishe umnqantsa okhanyayo ochasa umoya.

p-228.title: Iobusuku ezishushu: ubushushu bodonga obugcinwe emini bephuma ebusuku
p-228.summary: Iobusuku ezishushu zivakala zishushu kuba ubushushu obugcinwe ngodonga nemigangatho emini bukhutshwa ebusuku, ngoko vala ilanga emini kwaye uvuthuze ebusuku.
p-228.principle: Into yobuninzi bobushushu efana nekhonkrithi igcina $Q=mc\Delta T$ yobushushu njengoko ubushushu bayo bunyuka kwaye ibukhulule xa igumbi lipholile. Ubunzima nobushushu obuthile obukhulu kuthetha ukugcina okungakumbi.
p-228.example: Udonga lwekhonkrithi olunobubanzi obuyi-20cm, olunobukhulu be-10m² (malunga nama-4800kg, ubushushu obuthile malunga ne-0.88kJ/(kg·K)) olufudumala nge-5°C lugcina i-$Q\approx4800\times0.88\times5\approx21\ \mathrm{MJ}$ (malunga nama-5.9kWh). Obo bushushu buvuza kancinci egumbini ubusuku bonke.
p-228.actionItem: Emini, vala iikhethini okanye iiblinds kwiifestile ezinelanga, kwaye xa kuba bandayo ngaphandle kunangaphakathi ebusuku, vula iifestile ukuvuthuza, uze umisele i-AC kwi-26-27°C.

p-229.title: Ishawa efudumeleyo kancinci iyure eli-1-2 phambi kokulala
p-229.summary: Ishawa efudumeleyo iyure eli-1-2 phambi kokulala ibuyisa umzimba ubushushu, yenza ukwehla kobushushu okukhuthaza ukulala.
p-229.principle: Amanzi afudumeleyo andisa imithambo yegazi esemphethweni, ngoko ubushushu buphuma ngolusu kwaye ubushushu bomzimba obuphakathi buyehla: $q = hA(T_s - T_a)$.
p-229.example: Ishawa yemizuzu eyi-10 kwi-40°C malunga eyathathwa iyure eli-1-2 phambi kokulala ixelwa kuphando ukuba inciphisa ixesha lokulala malunga nemizuzu eyi-10 ngokomyinge.
p-229.actionItem: Ngobu busuku, thatha ishawa yemizuzu eyi-10 kwi-40°C malunga, iyure eli-1-2 phambi kokuba ulale.

p-230.title: I-plunger isebenza ekutsaleni, hayi ekutyhaleni kuphela
p-230.summary: I-plunger isebenza ngcono xa indebe itywiniwe phantsi kwamanzi kwaye itsalwa ngokukhawuleza, kukhulula ukuvaleka.
p-230.principle: Umahluko woxinzelelo kwindebe udala amandla: $F = \Delta P \cdot A$. Amanzi, hayi umoya, athumela olo xinzelelo ngokupheleleyo.
p-230.example: Ngendawo yendebe ye-$0.01\ \mathrm{m^2}$ kunye ne-$\Delta P = 5\ \mathrm{kPa}$, malunga ne-50N (malunga ne-5 kgf) isebenza kwindawo evaliweyo.
p-230.actionItem: Namhlanje, gubungela indebe ye-plunger ngamanzi, yityiwe, uze ucinezele kancinci utsale ngokukhawuleza amaxesha ayi-10 (ungaze udibanise neekhemikhali zepayipi).

p-231.title: Imitya yezikrufu ezicolekileyo ifakwa ngamandla amancinci
p-231.summary: Ngokuncinci umgama womtya (pitch), kokukhona isikrufu siphindaphinda amandla, ngoko imitya ecolekileyo ifanelekile kumthi onzima.
p-231.principle: I-ideal mechanical advantage yesikrufu yi-$MA = \dfrac{2\pi r}{p}$ ($r$: i-radius yesixhobo, $p$: pitch).
p-231.example: Ngo-$r = 2\ \mathrm{mm}$, pitch ye-1.0mm inika i-$MA \approx 12.6$ kwaye pitch ye-0.5mm inika i-$MA \approx 25$, isiqingatha samandla (ngaphandle kokuhoya ukungqubana).
p-231.actionItem: Namhlanje, khetha isikrufu se-pitch ecolekileyo komthi onzima kwaye uqale ngokugxotha umngxuma wokukhokela.

p-232.title: Iibhendi zokuxhathisa zitshintsha ukuxhathisa ngobude bokolula
p-232.summary: Ibhendi yokuxhathisa itsala emva ngokulinganayo nomgama olulwa ngawo, ngoko ubude bokolula obungatshintshiyo bugcina amandla omthambo wakho engatshintshi.
p-232.principle: Umthetho kaHooke: $F = kx$ (uqikelelo, kuba irabha iba nonlinear xa ikolulwa kakhulu).
p-232.example: Ibhendi ene-$k = 100\ \mathrm{N/m}$ inika malunga nama-30N kwi-0.3m yokolula kunye namalunga nama-60N kwi-0.6m.
p-232.actionItem: Kumthambo wakho webhendi wanamhlanje, phawula umgama wezandla zakho ukuze ukolule ubude obufanayo ngalo lonke ixesha.

p-233.title: Umoya obandayo ngequbuliso phambi kwemvula kuthetha ukukhosela
p-233.summary: Ukuvuthuza kokubanda ngequbuliso phambi nje kwesaqhwithi yi-cold downdraft yesaqhwithi samagqabaza, esilumkisa ukuba umbane nemimoya enamandla isondele.
p-233.principle: Umoya obandayo unoxinano oluphezulu, ngoko uyawa kwaye usasazeke: $\rho = \dfrac{P}{R_s T}$.
p-233.example: Kwi-1atm, uxinano lomoya lu-$1.165\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ malunga kwi-30°C kunye ne-$1.204\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ kwi-20°C, malunga nama-3% ngokunzima ngakumbi, kwaye imimoya inokufikelela kuma-60-90km/h.
p-233.actionItem: Ukuba uvakalelwa ngumoya obandayo ngequbuliso ngaphandle uze uve ukuduma, yiya kwisakhiwo okanye emotweni ngoko nangoko.

p-234.title: I-AC yemoto: umoya wangaphandle kuqala, phinda uwusebenzise xa upholile
p-234.summary: Vuthuza igumbi lemoto elishushu ngeefestile ezivulekileyo kuqala, uze utshintshele ekuphindeni uwusebenzise xa ipholile ukunciphisa umthwalo wokupholisa.
p-234.principle: Umthwalo wokupholisa ulingana nomsinga womoya kunye nomahluko wobushushu: $\dot{Q} = \dot{m}\, c_p\, \Delta T$.
p-234.example: Ngo-$\dot{m} = 0.1\ \mathrm{kg/s}$ kunye no-$c_p = 1.005\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$, ukupholisa umoya wangaphandle ukusuka kwi-35°C ukuya kwi-22°C kuthatha malunga ne-1.3kW, ngelixa umoya ophinda usetyenziswa we-25°C uthatha malunga ne-0.3kW.
p-234.actionItem: Namhlanje, vula iifestile umzuzu we-1 emva kokungena, uze utshintshele ekuphindeni usebenzise xa ipholile (vuselela ngomoya wangaphandle maxa wambi kuhambo olude).

p-235.title: Imifanekiso yasebusuku izinzile ngomthetho we-1/focal-length
p-235.summary: Xa uthatha ngesandla, ukugcina ixesha le-shutter lifutshane kune-reciprocal ye-focal length kunciphisa kakhulu ukungabikho kwesibhakabhaka sesandla.
p-235.principle: Umthetho wesithupha: $t \le \dfrac{1}{f}$ (kunye ne-$f$ i-full-frame equivalent focal length ngo-mm, $t$ ngemizuzwana).
p-235.example: Ilensi ye-50mm ihlala ikhuselekile kwi-1/50 s okanye ngokukhawuleza ngakumbi kunye nelensi ye-200mm kwi-1/200 s okanye ngokukhawuleza ngakumbi; ekukhanyeni okuphantsi, nyusa i-ISO okanye ziqinise.
p-235.actionItem: Ngobu busuku, qinisa ii-elbows zakho emzimbeni okanye eludongeni kwaye usebenzise i-timer yemizuzwana emi-2 kumfanekiso wasebusuku.

p-236.title: Umlilo wenkampu utsha ngcono ngamaxhonti emi nkqo
p-236.summary: Ukuthambeka amaxhonti emi nkqo kwi-teepee kutsala umoya ukusuka ezantsi ngomphumo wetshimini, ngoko umlilo uqala kakuhle.
p-236.principle: Uxinzelelo lwedrafti ukusuka kwikholamu yegesi eshushu: $\Delta P \approx \rho g h \dfrac{\Delta T}{T}$.
p-236.example: Ngo-$h = 0.5\ \mathrm{m}$, igesi yecala lelangatye kwi-600K nomoya kwi-300K, $\Delta P \approx 1.2 \times 9.8 \times 0.5 \times \dfrac{300}{600} \approx 3\ \mathrm{Pa}$.
p-236.actionItem: Kumlilo wenkampu olandelayo, thambeka amaxhonti amancinci kwi-teepee, gcina amanzi ekufutshane, kwaye ungaze uvuthele apho imililo ingavumelekanga.

p-237.title: Ukunyibilika kweqhwa akwenzi ukuba iglasi iphuphume
p-237.summary: Iqhwa elintywilayo alitshintshi kangako umgangatho wamanzi njengoko linyibilika, ngoko iglasi egcwele ngokupheleleyo ayiphuphumi.
p-237.principle: Iqhwa elintywilayo lifudukisa ubunzima baso bamanzi: $V_{\mathrm{d}} = \dfrac{m}{\rho_w}$, kwaye amanzi anyibilikileyo nawo athatha i-$\dfrac{m}{\rho_w}$.
p-237.example: I-90g yeqhwa ifudukisa i-90mL yamanzi (malunga ne-$98\ \mathrm{cm^3}$ kuphela yeyona malunga ne-$8\ \mathrm{cm^3}$ ephumayo), kwaye inyibilika ibe yi-90mL, ngoko umgangatho uhlala unjalo.
p-237.actionItem: Namhlanje, gcwalisa iglasi ngokupheleleyo ngeqhwa namanzi uze ubukele umgangatho njengoko linyibilika (ungalicinezeli iqhwa).

p-238.title: Khangela ukuba igeyiji ye-extinguisher yakho isemagqabini
p-238.summary: I-extinguisher ene-stored-pressure ilungele ukusetyenziswa kuphela xa inaliti yegeyiji ikwindawo eluhlaza (eqhelekileyo 0.7-0.98MPa).
p-238.principle: Uxinzelelo lungamandla kwindawo nganye: $P = \dfrac{F}{A}$. Ukuba igesi iyavuza, uxinzelelo lwesitya luyehla kwaye isitshizi siyabuthathaka.
p-238.example: I-0.7-0.98MPa eqhelekileyo ingama-7-9.8bar malunga (amaxesha ama-7 ukuya kwayi-10 uxinzelelo lomoya); inaliti ebomvu okanye kufutshane nezero ithetha ukuba kufuneka itshintshwe okanye iphinde igcwaliswe.
p-238.actionItem: Namhlanje, khangela ukuba igeyiji kwi-extinguisher yakho yasekhaya okanye yemoto isemagqabini, kwaye jonga ipini yokhuseleko nehosi nayo.

p-239.title: I-seesaw ilinganisa xa umntu onzima ehlala kufuphi ne-pivot
p-239.summary: Abantu abanobunzima obahlukeneyo banokulinganisa i-seesaw ukuba onzima ahlala kufutshane ne-pivot.
p-239.example: Umntwana oyi-30kg obe yi-2m ukusuka kwi-pivot ulinganisa umntwana oyi-60kg ongama-1m kude, kuba $30 \times 2 = 60 \times 1$.
p-239.actionItem: Kwindawo yokudlala namhlanje, zama ukutshintsha izikhundla zezihlalo ukufumana indawo yokulinganisa, kwaye behle ngamnye ngokukhuselekileyo.

p-240.title: Kutheni iibhulorho neendlela zinemiqathango kumanqanaba azo
p-240.summary: Isinyithi nekhonkrithi ziyanda xa zishushu, ngoko iibhulorho neendlela zishiya imiqathango yokwanda kwiindawo zazo zokudibanisa.
p-240.example: I-span yentsimbi eyi-100m ($\alpha \approx 12 \times 10^{-6}\ \mathrm{/K}$) isuka kwi--10°C ukuya kwi-40°C iba ide nge-$\Delta L \approx 0.06\ \mathrm{m}$, malunga nama-60mm.
p-240.actionItem: Namhlanje, funa imiqathango yokwanda xa uwela ibhulorho okanye indlela yabahambi, kwaye ungaze ufake amatye okanye inkunkuma kuyo.

p-241.title: Iibhetri zetotshi: uthotho lukhanya ngakumbi, ukuhambelana kuhlala ixesha elide
p-241.summary: Iibhetri ezikuthotho zongeza i-voltage ukuze ukukhanya kube ngakumbi; ekuhambelaneni, i-voltage ihlala injalo kwaye umthamo uyongezwa, kodwa amandla apheleleyo afana.
p-241.principle: Uthotho: $V = V_1 + V_2$. Ukuhambelana: $Q = Q_1 + Q_2$. Amandla $E = VQ$.
p-241.example: Iiseli ezimbini ze-1.5V, 2500 mAh zinika i-3V kwi-2.5 Ah kuthotho okanye i-1.5V kwi-5 Ah ekuhambelaneni, zombini malunga nama-7.5Wh.
p-241.actionItem: Namhlanje, tshintsha iibhetri zetotshi zonke kunye ngohlobo olufanayo nenqanaba lokutshaja, kwaye ungaze udibanise ezindala nezintsha.

p-242.title: I-windscreen inciphisa ingxolo yomoya kwiividiyo zonxweme
p-242.summary: I-windscreen enoboya phezu kwemayikhrofowuni yaphula i-turbulence kwaye inciphisa kakhulu ingxolo yomoya.
p-242.principle: Ukuqala kwe-turbulence kulawulwa yinani likaReynolds: $\mathrm{Re} = \dfrac{\rho v D}{\mu}$.
p-242.example: Kumoya we-5m/s kunye nemayikhrofowuni ye-1cm, $\mathrm{Re} \approx 3{,}300$, kwaye isigqubuthelo esinoboya sinciphisa ingxolo yomoya malunga nama-10-20dB.
p-242.actionItem: Namhlanje elunxwemeni, faka i-windscreen enoboya kwimayikhrofowuni yakho kwaye uyijolise kude nomoya.

p-243.title: Kutheni iiskrini zokuchukumisa zenza kakubi ngezandla ezimanzi
p-243.summary: Amathontsi amanzi aqhuba kwaye asasazeka kwisikrini, etshintsha i-capacitance kwii-electrodes ezininzi kwaye abangela ukuchukumisa okungekho.
p-243.principle: I-capacitance: $C = \dfrac{\varepsilon A}{d}$ (i-relative permittivity yamanzi malunga ne-80, umoya malunga ne-1).
p-243.example: Ithontsi linokuvelisa utshintsho lwe-capacitance olufana nolwentende yomnwe, ngoko ukungasebenzi okuninzi kwesikrini esimanzi akuyonto yokwenyani.
p-243.actionItem: Ukuba isikrini sakho senza kakubi namhlanje, oma izandla nesikrini ngendwangu ngaphambi kokucinga ukuba kufuneka silungiswe.

p-244.title: Khusela isitovu senkampu emoyeni, kodwa ungaze ugqibelele isilinda segesi
p-244.summary: I-windscreen inciphisa ukulahleka kobushushu kwisitovu nembiza, kodwa ukugqiba isilinda segesi kunokusishushisa kakhulu kwaye kuyingozi.
p-244.principle: Ukulahleka kobushushu be-convective: $q = hA\Delta T$ ($h$ inyuka ngomoya).
p-244.example: Kwindawo yembiza ye-$0.05\ \mathrm{m^2}$ kunye ne-$\Delta T = 80\ \mathrm{K}$, ukunyusa i-$h$ ukusuka kwi-10 ukuya kwi-30 $\mathrm{W/(m^2\cdot K)}$ kwandisa ilahleko ukusuka kuma-40W ukuya kuma-120W (umzekelo).
p-244.actionItem: Xa upheka ngaphandle namhlanje, misela i-windscreen ejikeleze imbiza nesitovu kuphela, gcina isilinda ngaphandle kwayo, kwaye ungaze usebenzise isitovu ngaphakathi kwethenti.

p-245.title: Kutheni kubakho umbilini ekuseni kwexesha lasekwindla elicwebileyo
p-245.summary: Ebusuku obucwebileyo obungenawo umoya umhlaba uyaphola ngerediyeshini, umoya ufikelele kwindawo yombilini kwaye kwenziwe umbilini.
p-245.principle: Ukuqikelela indawo yombilini: $T_d \approx T - \dfrac{100 - \mathrm{RH}}{5}$ (°C, i-RH ngepesenti).
p-245.example: Ukuba emini kunge-20°C kwaye ukufuma kungama-70%, $T_d \approx 14$°C, kwaye ukuba ekuseni ihla ukuya kwi-12°C, umoya uyaxhama kwaye kubakho umbilini.
p-245.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba uqhuba imoto ekuseni kunomnbilini, vula izibane ezisezantsi nezemvula kwaye wandise umgama phakathi kwakho nemoto engaphambili kunesiqhelo.

p-246.title: Beka iigiya zebhayisikile ngokwe-cadence, hayi ngamandla
p-246.summary: Ukuba amandla ayafana, igiya ejikelezisa ipedal ngokukhanyayo malunga ne-70~90 ngomzuzu inciphisa umthwalo wedolo.
p-246.example: Xa kukhutshwa amandla angama-210W, ku-60 rpm kufuneka ithorque ye-33N·m kwaye ku-90 rpm i-22N·m.
p-246.actionItem: Kuhambo lwebhayisikile lwanamhlanje, tshintsha iigiya uze ugcine ukujikeleza kwepedal kuma-70~90 ngomzuzu.

p-247.title: Amanzi asemanxweme avuleka emva kwemizuzu engama-50 yonke imihla
p-247.summary: Inyanga ithatha ixesha elingakumbi elimalunga nemizuzu engama-50 ngosuku ukujikeleza umhlaba, ngoko amaza nawo ahlala emva ngemizuzu engama-50 yonke imihla.
p-247.principle: Usuku lwenyanga $T_{\mathrm{lunar}} \approx 24\ \mathrm{h}\ 50\ \mathrm{min}$ kwaye ukuphakama nokuhla kwamanzi kwenzeka kabini ngosuku, ngoko ixesha eliphakathi malunga neeyure ezili-12 nemizuzu engama-25.
p-247.example: Ukuba namhlanje ukuhla kwamanzi ngo-10:00, ngomso kuyakuba malunga no-10:50, kwaye emva kweentsuku ezi-6 kuyakuba malunga no-15:00, emva ngemizuzu engu-$6 \times 50 = 300$.
p-247.actionItem: Namhlanje phambi kokuya kumanxweme, jonga itheyibhile yamaza ubeke ixesha lokuphuma phambi kokuba amanzi anyuke.

p-248.title: Umatshini wokupakisha ovuthuza umoya ngamandla acinezelayo ephakamileyo
p-248.summary: Umatshini wokupakisha ovuthuza umoya ukhupha umoya ephakheji, kwaye ukucinezelwa komoya ongaphandle kucinezela ukutya kunamathele.
p-248.example: Kummandla wephakheji $0.03\ \mathrm{m^2}$ umahluko wokucinezela we-80kPa, malunga ne-2.4kN (malunga ne-240 kgf) yamandla asasazeka kwiyonke.
p-248.actionItem: Namhlanje pakisha ngovuthuzo izithako ezomileyo okanye ukutya okwahlulwe ukuze kufriziwe, kodwa ukutya okonakala lula kusafuneka kugcinwe efrijini okanye kufriziwe.

p-249.title: Isitima sipheka ngokukhawuleza ngobushushu bokucinezela komphunga
p-249.summary: Umphunga ujika ube ngamanzi kumphezulu wokutya kwaye ukhupha ubushushu obufihlakeleyo obuninzi, uhambisa ubushushu ngokukhawuleza kunamanzi abilayo.
p-249.example: Ukuba umphunga we-50g ucinezela, ukhupha malunga ne-113kJ, oko kukhulu ngama-6.8 amaxesha kunokuphola kwamanzi e-100°C e-50g ukuya kwi-20°C (malunga ne-16.7kJ).
p-249.actionItem: Namhlanje xa upheka ngesitima, gcina isiciko sivaliwe kwaye xa sisiphakamisa phakamisa icala elikude nobuso ukuthintela ukutshiswa ngumphunga.

p-250.title: Ngokuvakala kweenkumbi ungabala ubushushu
p-250.summary: Iinkumbi zibhomboloza ngokukhawuleza xa kushushu, ngoko ngokubala inani lokubhomboloza ungazi ubushushu ngokuqikelela.
p-250.principle: Umthetho ka-Dolbear: $T_{\mathrm{F}} \approx 40 + \dfrac{N_{60}}{4}$ ($N_{60}$: inani lokubhomboloza ngomzuzu omnye).
p-250.example: Ukuba kuyi-100 ngomzuzu, malunga ne-65°F (malunga ne-18°C), kwaye ukuba i-160, malunga ne-80°F (malunga ne-27°C), uqikelelo oluneempazamo ngokweentlobo.
p-250.actionItem: Namhlanje ngokuhlwa bala ukuvakala kweenkumbi kwisekhondi ezili-15 uphindaphinde ngo-4 uze uqikelele ubushushu ngefomula engentla.

p-251.title: Kutheni ukutshona kwelanga kuba bomvu
p-251.summary: Xa ilanga lisezantsi, ukukhanya kuhamba kude kumoya, ukukhanya okubhlowu kuqala ukusasazeka kwaye okubomvu kuhlala, ngoko ukutshona kwelanga kuba bomvu.
p-251.example: Ubhlowu (450nm) busasazeka ngamandla angama-$(700/450)^4 \approx 5.9$ amaxesha ngaphezu kobomvu (700nm) kwaye buyanyamalala kuqala.
p-251.actionItem: Namhlanje xa kutshona ilanga, jonga utshintsho lwemibala yesibhakabhaka, kodwa ungalijongi ilanga ngqo okanye ulijonge ngekhamera okanye ithelesikopu.

p-252.title: Inyanga epheleleyo ibonakala ngobukhulu beqhekeza elinye elibekwe kude
p-252.summary: Inyanga epheleleyo incinci kunokuba ucinga, kwaye kumgama wecala lingenziwe unokuyigquma ngenkozo yerayisi.
p-252.example: Ukuba ibekwa ikhoyini ye-24mm ububanzi kumgama we-2.7m, ubungakanani be-engile buyafana, kwaye kubude bengalo obumalunga ne-60cm into engama-5mm ububanzi igquma inyanga.
p-252.actionItem: Namhlanje xa inyanga epheleleyo ivele, olule ingalo yakho ngokupheleleyo uze ugquqhe inyanga ngenkozo enye yerayisi.

p-253.title: Ubuninzi bezithuthi ngexesha lomhla wokubuya bususela kukubhrekha kwemoto engaphambili kanye
p-253.summary: Kwindlela eninzi izithuthi, xa imoto enye ibhrekha, ukulibaziseka kokusabela kweemoto ezingasemva kuyadibana kwaye iza yenyuka iwave yokuma ngasemva.
p-253.principle: Umgama wokumisa: $d = v\,t_r + \dfrac{v^2}{2a}$, iwave yokuma isasazeka ngasemva ngesantya esiqhelekileyo se-15~20km ngeyure.
p-253.example: Kwi-100km ngeyure (malunga ne-27.8m/s), ngesekhondi enye yokusabela uhamba nje i-27.8m, kwaye ukuba ugcina umgama weesekhondi ezi-3 ukhwela ngokuthuleleyo, ioyile inokonga malunga ne-5~10%.
p-253.actionItem: Kuhambo lwanamhlanje, gcina isithuba seesekhondi ezi-2~3 kwimoto engaphambili kwaye ukhuphe iingalo zakho kwi-gas pedal kwangaphambili ukunciphisa ukusebenzisa ibrake.

p-254.title: Umgama okhuselekileyo wokuphuma kwamatye kumatshini wokusika ingca ngama-15m okanye ngaphezulu
p-254.summary: Isiphelo seblade yomatshini wokusika ingca sikhawuleza kakhulu, ngoko amatye aphuma njengesixhobo sokudubula, kwaye akufuneki kubekho umntu kwiradiyasi yomsebenzi ye-15m.
p-254.principle: Isantya sesiphelo seblade: $v = \omega r$, umgama wokuphuma: $R = \dfrac{v^2 \sin 2\theta}{g}$.
p-254.example: Ukuba iradiyasi yeblade yi-0.115m, ku-6,500 rpm ($\omega \approx 681\ \mathrm{rad/s}$), $v \approx 78\ \mathrm{m/s}$, oko kukuthi malunga ne-280km ngeyure.
p-254.actionItem: Namhlanje phambi kokusika ingca, qinisekisa ukuba akukho bantu nezithuthi kwiradiyasi ye-15m kwaye unxibe iiglasi zokukhusela nesikhuselo sobuso.

p-255.title: Kwibhegi yokulala jonga ubushushu be-comfort, kwimati jonga ixabiso le-R
p-255.summary: Ubusuku obubanda bunobushushu obuphuma bugqithisa emhlabeni ngaphezu kwasezulwini, ngoko jonga ubushushu be-comfort bebhegi yokulala kunye nexabiso le-R lemati kunye.
p-255.example: Imati yefoam enobukhulu be-2cm, $k = 0.035\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$ yi-$R \approx 0.57\ \mathrm{m^2K/W}$ (ixabiso le-R laseMelika malunga ne-3.2), kwaye kwikampu yasekwindla ixabiso le-R le-3 okanye ngaphezulu liyinqaku eliqhelekileyo.
p-255.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ukhetha izixhobo zekampu, jonga ukuba ubushushu be-comfort bebhegi yokulala buphantsi kunobushushu obuphantsi obulindelekileyo kwaye ixabiso le-R lemati li-3 okanye ngaphezulu.

p-256.title: Ngokusebenzisa isensa yoxinzelelo lomoya yefowuni unokufunda utshintsho lokuphakama
p-256.summary: Iifowuni ezininzi zineesensa zoxinzelelo lomoya, ngoko ngokutshintsha koxinzelelo unokuqikelela ukuphakama okunyukayo nokuhlayo.
p-256.principle: $\Delta P \approx -\rho g\,\Delta h$, kufutshane nomphezulu wolwandle ukuncipha kwe-1hPa malunga = ukunyuka kwe-8m.
p-256.example: Ukuba $\rho = 1.2\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, kwi-8m nganye $1.2 \times 9.8 \times 8 \approx 94\ \mathrm{Pa} \approx 0.94\ \mathrm{hPa}$, ngoko kumgangatho wama-30 (malunga ne-90m) iyaphantsi malunga ne-11hPa.
p-256.actionItem: Namhlanje vula i-app ye-barometer uthelekise amaxabiso kumgangatho wokuqala nokumgangatho ophezulu wesitepsi (ixabiso litshintsha nangotshintsho lwemozulu, ngoko linganisa ngexesha elifutshane).

p-257.title: Gcina iishelufu zeencwadi nefriji kumbhobho ngenxa yenyikima
p-257.summary: Ifenitshala ende nenobubanzi obuncinci iwa nakwi-shake encinci, ngoko ukuyiqinisa lodongeni kuyakhusela.
p-257.principle: Imeko yokuwa: $mg\,\dfrac{b}{2} < m a\, h_c$, oko kukuthi $a > g\,\dfrac{b}{2 h_c}$ ($b$: ububanzi, $h_c$: ukuphakama kweziko lobunzima).
p-257.example: Ishelufu ephakame ngama-1.8m ($h_c = 0.9\ \mathrm{m}$), ububanzi be-0.3m iwa kwi-$a > 0.3/1.8\, g \approx 0.17\,g$.
p-257.actionItem: Namhlanje qinisa ifenitshala ende kwisiqwenga sodonga ngebracket eyimilo ye-L kwaye ubeke izinto ezinzima kumgangatho ongezantsi.

p-258.title: Kutheni ithoni yeguitar itshintsha xa umahluko wobushushu uphakathi kwemini nobusuku ube mkhulu kwisizini yenguqu
p-258.summary: Ukuba ubushushu butshintsha, ukuqina kwentambo kutshintsha kwaye ithoni iyahluka, ngoko kufuneka uyilungelelanise kwakhona phambi kokudlala.
p-258.example: Ukuba ukuqina kuncipha nge-1%, ingqokelela ihla malunga ne-0.5%, ithoni ye-440Hz yehla malunga ne-2.2Hz (malunga neesenti ezi-9) kwaye isenokungathandeki ngeendlebe.
p-258.actionItem: Namhlanje phambi kokudlala lungelelanisa iintambo ngetuner (kanye nje ngakumbi xa utshintsho lwezinzile emva kokudlala).

p-259.title: Kwindlela egobileyo yebala lemidlalo, tyekela umzimba ngaphakathi
p-259.summary: Xa ujikeleza igophe, ukutyekela umzimba ngaphakathi kuvumela amandla okukhuhlana enze amandla e-centripetal kwaye ujikeleze ungashukumi.
p-259.example: Ukuba ujikeleza igophe elineradiyasi ye-20m ngesantya se-14.4km ngeyure (4m/s), $\tan\theta \approx 16/196 \approx 0.082$, utyekela malunga ne-4.7°.
p-259.actionItem: Namhlanje kwicandelo eligobileyo, nciphisa isantya kwangaphambili kwaye ujikeleze utyekela kancinane ngaphakathi ukusuka kwimilenze.

p-260.title: Ukuba ilifu lenqwelomoya lihlala ixesha elide, luphawu lokuba isibhakabhaka sifumile
p-260.summary: Ukuba ilifu lenqwelomoya alinyamalali ngokukhawuleza kodwa lisasazeka, lithetha ukuba isibhakabhaka esiphezulu sifumile ngokwaneleyo ukugcwala ngokwemikhenkce.
p-260.principle: Ukufuma okuhambelana nomkhenkce: $\mathrm{RH}_i = \dfrac{e}{e_i} \times 100\%$, xa $\mathrm{RH}_i > 100\%$, umkhondo we-contrail uyahlala.
p-260.example: Kwi- -40°C malunga, uxinzelelo lomphunga ogcweleyo ngokwomkhenkce lumalunga nama-68% okugcwala kwamanzi, ngoko nokuba ukufuma okuhambelana namanzi kuyi-70% kuphela, $\mathrm{RH}_i > 100\%$ iyenzeka.
p-260.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga ixesha elingakanani umkhondo wenqwelomoya uhlala esibhakabhakeni, kwaye ukuba usasazeka kakhulu, thatha oko njengophawu kuphela lokuba umaleko ophezulu ufumile (akuyiyo ingqikelelo yemozulu).

p-261.title: Ukufaka iintonga ebhokisini yerayisi kuphakamisa ibhokisi yerayisi
p-261.summary: Ukuba ugcwalisa irayisi uyicinezele uze ufake iintonga, iinkozo zibamba iintonga ngokuqinileyo kwaye unokuphakamisa yonke ibhokisi yerayisi.
p-261.principle: Uxinzelelo phakathi kweenkozo zerayisi luqinisa iintonga kwaye lubangela ukukhuhlana: $f = \mu N$.
p-261.example: Njengomzekelo ukuba amandla acinezela ecaleni $N = 50\ \mathrm{N}$, $\mu = 0.4$, ukukhuhlana kumalunga ne-20N kwaye unokuphakamisa ibhokisi yerayisi ye-1kg (malunga ne-9.8N).
p-261.actionItem: Namhlanje gcwalisa ibhotile yeglasi ensundu ngerayisi uyicinezele uze ufake iintonga nzulu uziphakamise (etafileni ukuze ibhotile ingaqhekeki).

p-262.title: Xa iziqhamo zinobungakanani obufanayo, khetha ezinzima ngakumbi
p-262.summary: Xa ubungakanani buyafana, isiqhamo esinzima ngakumbi ngokubanzi sinamanzi amaninzi kwaye asomanga kangako.
p-262.example: Ukuba iiorenji ezimbini ezinomthamo ofanayo zi-220g ($\rho \approx 1.10\ \mathrm{g/cm^3}$) kunye ne-190g ($\rho \approx 0.95\ \mathrm{g/cm^3}$), eyona inzima ngokubanzi inejusi eninzi.
p-262.actionItem: Namhlanje xa uthenga iziqhamo, bamba ezo zinobungakanani obufanayo ngezandla zombini uthelekise ubunzima kwaye uqinisekise ukuba azinamanxeba.

p-263.title: Kwi-moving walkway yesikhululo seenqwelomoya, ukuhamba kongeza isantya
p-263.summary: Ukuhamba kwi-moving walkway kongeza isantya se-walkway kwisantya sokuhamba, ngoko uhamba ngokukhawuleza kakhulu.
p-263.example: Ukuba i-walkway yi-0.75m/s kwaye ukuhamba kongezwa nge-1.4m/s, kuba ngu-2.15m/s, kwaye i-200m ukuma kuthatha malunga neesekhondi ezili-267, ukuhamba kuthatha malunga ne-93, ngoko ngokukhawuleza malunga nemizuzu emi-3.
p-263.actionItem: Namhlanje xa uhamba kwi-moving walkway, lalela icala elinye ubambe isibambo kwaye ugcine imithwalo isondele emzimbeni.

p-264.title: Isitikha esibonisa ukukhanya sebhayisikile sibuyisela ukukhanya
p-264.summary: Isitikha se-retroreflective sibuyisela ukukhanya kwemoto ngendlela eyavela ngayo, senze ibhayisikile ibonakale ngokucacileyo endleleni emnyama.
p-264.principle: I-corner cube ibuyisela ukukhanya kwicala eliphikisayo ngeembonakalo ezintathu ezime nkqo omnye komnye: $\vec{r}_{out} = -\vec{r}_{in}$.
p-264.example: Izixhobo ezibonisa ukukhanya zihlala zibonakala nakwi-150m kude, ngelixa iimpahla ezimnyama zihlala zibonakala kwi-30~50m kuphela.
p-264.actionItem: Namhlanje namathisela izitikha zokubonisa kwiivili, kwisakhelo nakwiipedal zebhayisikile kwaye uvule namabhalbhu angaphambili nangasemva.

p-265.title: Ungawafaki amanzi abilayo ebhlenda ngqo
p-265.summary: Ukuba ufaka isuphu eshushu kwibhlenda evaliweyo uyijikelezise, umphunga uyaqhumisa isiciko sibe sikutshise.
p-265.principle: I-ideal gas: $PV = nRT$. Xa i-1g yamanzi iba ngumphunga, kwi-100°C nakoxinzelelo lwe-1atm umthamo ungama-1.7L malunga.
p-265.example: Ukuba $n = \dfrac{1}{18} \approx 0.056\ \mathrm{mol}$, $V = \dfrac{nRT}{P} \approx 1.7\ \mathrm{L}$, iyaqina ukuya malunga nama-1,700 amaxesha omthamo wolwelo.
p-265.actionItem: Namhlanje phola isuphu eshushu imizuzu eyi-10 okanye ngaphezulu uze ugcwalise ngaphantsi kwesiqingatha somthamo, vula umngxuma wesiciko uzigubungele ngethawula ngoko ujikeleze.

p-266.title: Kutheni imini nobusuku zilingana ngokuphantse kwenziwe kwi-autumn equinox
p-266.summary: Kwi-autumn equinox ilanga likwi-equator ngqo, ngoko naphi na emhlabeni imini nobusuku ziphantse zibe ziiyure ezili-12 nganye.
p-266.example: I-declination ku-summer solstice (malunga nomhla we-21 kuJuni) +23.4°, kwi-autumn equinox (malunga nomhla wama-22 kuSeptemba) 0°, kwi-winter solstice (malunga nomhla we-21 kuDisemba) -23.4°.
p-266.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga amaxesha okuphuma nokutshona kwelanga uze ubale ukuba ubude bemini bungaphezulu kweeyure ezili-12.

p-267.title: Ukukhupha umoya kwiboiler neeradiator ngexesha lenguqu yeemini
p-267.summary: Xa imibhobho yokufudumeza igcwele ngumoya, amanzi awajikeleli kakuhle kwaye icandelo eliphezulu leradiator liyabanda. Ukukhupha umoya kufudumeza ngakumbi ngerhasi enye.
p-267.principle: Ubushushu obunikezelwayo bulingana nomthamo wokujikeleza: $Q = \dot{m}\, c\, \Delta T$.
p-267.example: Iradiator ye-1kW xa $\Delta T = 15\ \mathrm{K}$ amanzi kufuneka asebenze malunga ne-$1\ \mathrm{L/min}$, kwaye icandelo elinomoya alikhuphi bushushu.
p-267.actionItem: Cima ukufudumeza uvumele kubande, uze uvule ivalvu yomoya yeradiator ephezulu ebandayo ukukhupha umoya, kwaye ujonge uxinzelelo lweboiler njengoko kuchaziwe kwincwadana.

p-268.title: Ukupaka ethambekeni, jika ivili ulibeke kumda wendlela
p-268.summary: Xa upaka ethambekeni, ukongeza kwibrake yesandla nakwigiya, ukumisela ivili ngakumda wendlela kuthintela ukuhamba, kuba umda wendlela uyayivala xa ihamba.
p-268.principle: Amandla ecaleni lethambeka: $F = mg\sin\theta$, ukukhuhlana: $f = \mu N$.
p-268.example: Imoto yama-1,500kg xa imi kwithambeka le-10% ($\theta \approx 5.7^\circ$) idonswa phantsi ngamandla amalunga ne-1.46kN (malunga ne-150 kgf).
p-268.actionItem: Namhlanje xa upaka elundini elisezantsi, jika amavili ngakumda wendlela, kwaye xa upaka kumda wendlela elundini elisezantsi jika ngokuphikisana, uze ufake ibrake yesandla ne-P (okanye igiya yokuqala).

p-269.title: Ukujonga ngefestile yeqonga lenqanawa, imibono esondeleyo idlula ngokukhawuleza
p-269.summary: Nokuba kuhanjwa ngesantya esifanayo, izinto ezisondeleyo zidlula ngokukhawuleza kuba ukujonga kujika ngokukhawuleza kunye nemiqolo ekude ibonakala icotha.
p-269.example: Kwi-100km ngeyure (27.8m/s), umthi okumgama we-20m $\omega \approx 1.39\ \mathrm{rad/s} \approx 80^\circ/\mathrm{s}$, kwaye intaba ye-5km malunga ne-$0.3^\circ/\mathrm{s}$.
p-269.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba uziva ukugodola ngexesha lohambo, jonga intaba ekude okanye isibhakabhaka endaweni yemibono esondeleyo.

p-270.title: Kukhuphiswano lokurhuqa intambo ophumelela ngokukhuhlana kwezandla zeenyawo, hayi ngobunzima
p-270.summary: Kukhuphiswano lokurhuqa intambo, intambo ikhuliswa ngamandla alinganayo kumacala omabini kwaye ukuphumelela kuncitywe ngamandla aphezulu okukhuhlana apho umhlaba uxhasa iinyawo.
p-270.principle: Ukukhuhlana okumileyo: $f \le \mu N$ ($N = mg$), uxinzelelo lwentambo luyafana kumacala omabini (isenzo nokusabela).
p-270.example: Xa ubunzima bungama-70kg, emhlabeni owomileyo $\mu = 0.8$ ubuninzi malunga ne-550N, emhlabeni onoshicilelo $\mu = 0.4$ malunga ne-270N.
p-270.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba udlala ukurhuqa intambo okanye umdlalo ofanayo, unxibe izihlangu ezinokubamba kakuhle uze ulayishe umzimba ngasemva, kodwa ungayiboleki intambo engalweni.

p-271.title: Ukusika ityuwa yenyama yaba yisiqingatha kupheka ngamaxesha amane ngokukhawuleza
p-271.summary: Ukusika inyama ibe yisiqingatha sobukhulu kuncitha ixesha lokufikelela kobushushu embindini malunga nesiqingatha sesine, kwaye ukonga amafutha.
p-271.principle: Ixesha lokusasazeka kobushushu: $t \propto \dfrac{L^2}{\alpha}$ ($L$: ubukhulu, $\alpha$: ukusasazeka kobushushu).
p-271.example: Ukuba isiqwenga esiyi-6cm ubukhulu sithatha malunga nemizuzu engama-60, esi-3cm siqikelelwa kwimizuzu engu-$60 \times \left(\dfrac{3}{6}\right)^2 = 15$.
p-271.actionItem: Namhlanje sika inyama enkulu ibe zizilayi ezibhityileyo uze uyigcobe, kwaye uqinisekise ngethemometha ukuba ubushushu bomhlaba bungaphezulu kwe-75°C.

p-272.title: Betha ibhola kwisweet spot yebhathi ukuze izandla zingabi buhlungu
p-272.summary: Ibhathi inayo indawo yokuqhuba apho xa ubetha ibhola izandla azifumani kuxhatshazwa ngaphandle kwemfutshane (isweet spot).
p-272.principle: Umgama weziko lokubetha ukusuka esibambeni: $q = \dfrac{I}{m d}$ ($I$: umzuzu we-inertia ojikeleze i-axis yokujikeleza, $d$: umgama ukusuka kwi-axis ukuya kweziko lobunzima).
p-272.example: Ukuba ubamba intonga efanayo ye-0.84m ekupheleni kwesibambo, $q = \dfrac{2}{3} L \approx 0.56\ \mathrm{m}$, kwaye kwibhathi yokwenyani isiphelo sinzima, ngoko indawo ihluke kancinane.
p-272.actionItem: Namhlanje kuqeqesho lokubetha, zama ukubetha ibhola kwisweet spot esembindini hayi esiphelweni sebhathi.

p-273.title: Ukuntlonta intambo kwipholo kathathu kunciphisa amandla
p-273.summary: Ukuntlonta intambo kwipholo amatyeli aliqela kwandisa ukukhuhlana kwaye unokubamba umthwalo onzima ngamandla amancinci kakhulu.
p-273.example: $\mu = 0.3$, kwiimijikelezo ezi-3 ($\varphi = 6\pi \approx 18.85\ \mathrm{rad}$) ngama-$e^{5.65} \approx 285$ amaxesha, ubamba umthwalo we-1,000N ngamandla amalunga ne-3.5N (ixabiso elifanelekileyo).
p-273.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ubopha imithwalo ntlonta intambo kwipholo amatyeli ama-2~3, kodwa ungayintloni esandleni okanye emzimbeni kwaye ungayisebenzisi kwimithwalo enxulumene nobomi.

p-274.title: Ubusi nesiraphu ziyakhululeka kakhulu xa zifudumele
p-274.summary: Ubusi nesiraphu ziyancipha ngamandla kubumhlophe xa ubushushu bunyuka, ngoko isixa esihlala ebhotileni siyancipha.
p-274.example: Ubusi obunobunzima obumalunga ne-10Pa·s kwi-20°C buba ne-1~2Pa·s kwi-40°C, buyancipha ngamaxesha angama-5~10.
p-274.actionItem: Namhlanje faka ibhotile yobusi evaliweyo emanzini ashushu angama-40°C imizuzu emi-5 uze uyisebenzise, kwaye uphephe amanzi abilayo okanye imicrowave.

p-275.title: Gcina i-kimchi yokwenza kwibhokisi yeStyrofoam kwibalcony engenalanga
p-275.summary: IStyrofoam ayidluliseli bushushu kwaye umthunzi uvala ubushushu berediyeshini yelanga. Ngokudibanisa zombini, i-kimchi igcina ubushushu obuncinci obungatshintshiyo ixesha elide.
p-275.principle: Ukulahleka kobushushu ngokuqhuba $q=\frac{kA\Delta T}{L}$, kwaye ukuqhuba ubushushu kweStyrofoam $k\approx0.035\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$ kuphantsi kunomthi (malunga $0.12$). Ukukhanya kwelanga ngqo kufudumeza umphezulu wesikhongozeli ngerediyeshini, ngoko umthunzi uyadingeka.
p-275.example: Kwibhokisi yobukhulu $3\ \mathrm{cm}$, ummandla $1\ \mathrm{m^2}$, xa umahluko wobushushu phakathi kwangaphakathi nangaphandle $10\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, $q=0.035\times1\times10/0.03\approx12\ \mathrm{W}$. Ibhokisi yomthi yobukhulu obufanayo ilahlekelwa malunga ne-$40\ \mathrm{W}$, ngaphezulu kwamaxesha amathathu.
p-275.actionItem: Namhlanje faka isikhongozeli se-kimchi kwibhokisi yeStyrofoam ecaleni elinomthunzi lebalcony, ugcwalise izithuba ngephepha lephephandaba uze uvale isiciko.

p-276.title: Ukukhupha amagqabi kumbhobho wokuhlambulula, phambi kokuba amanzi acoce
p-276.summary: Xa amagqabi egquma indawo yombhobho wokuhlambulula, isixa samanzi ahamba emvuleni efanayo siyancipha kakhulu kuze kubakho ukubuyela umva nokuzaliswa kwamanzi. Ukucoca umzuzu omnye phambi kwemvula yeyona ndlela yokuthintela eshibhileyo.
p-276.principle: Ukuqukuqela $Q=Av$, ngoko xa indawo yemigaqo esebenzayo apho amanzi edlula khona $A$ iyancipha, ukuhambisa amanzi kuyancipha ngokulinganayo. Amagqabi avala izithuba zegrile kwaye anciphisa $A$ kakhulu.
p-276.example: Indawo yombhobho wobubanzi $10\ \mathrm{cm}$ imalunga ne-$79\ \mathrm{cm^2}$. Ukuba amagqabi agquma isiqingatha, $A\approx39\ \mathrm{cm^2}$, kwaye xa isantya sokuhamba siyafana, ukuhambisa amanzi kuyehla ukuya malunga ne-$50\%$.
p-276.actionItem: Namhlanje susa amagqabi kwiicover zeembobho ebalconyini, ezintlalweni nangaphambi komnyango ngesandla esinoglavu okanye ngamagobolondo.

p-277.title: Imizuzu eyi-10 yelanga lasekuseni inokukhanya okuphindwe amashumi okukhanya kwesibane sasekhaya
p-277.summary: Ngelanga elinamafu ngokuhlwa ngaphandle ikhanya ngaphezulu kakhulu kunesibane sasekhaya, kwaye oku kukhanya okukhanyayo kunceda ukulungelelanisa isingqisho somzimba yonke imihla. Ukuphuma okufutshane ekuseni yeyona ndlela ilula yokunyanga ngokukhanya.
p-277.principle: I-illuminance yinani lokukhanya elingena ngeyunithi yendawo $E=\frac{\Phi}{A}$ kwaye iyunithi yi-lux ($\mathrm{lm/m^2}$). Ngaphandle ngemini ecacileyo malunga ne-$10{,}000\sim100{,}000\ \mathrm{lux}$, ngaphakathi kwendlu eqhelekileyo $100\sim500\ \mathrm{lux}$.
p-277.example: Ngaphandle ekuseni okucacileyo malunga ne-$10{,}000\ \mathrm{lux}$ kuphindwe malunga nama-20 xa kuthelekiswa nehhovisi $500\ \mathrm{lux}$, kunye nama-70 xa kuthelekiswa negumbi lokuhlala $150\ \mathrm{lux}$. Nangelanga elinamafu ngokuqhelekileyo kungaphezulu kwe-$1{,}000\ \mathrm{lux}$, ngoko kukhanya ngaphezu kwangaphakathi.
p-277.actionItem: Namhlanje ekuseni hamba imizuzu eyi-10 ngaphandle hayi efestileni. Ungalijongi ilanga ngqo.

p-278.title: Ukuhamba intaba ngexesha lamagqabi, ilanga litshona kwangethuba kunemephu ngenxa yomthunzi wentaba
p-278.summary: Itafile yexesha lokutshona kwelanga isekelwe kuthambeka olucaba, ngoko ukuba kukho umqolo entshona, ilanga ligqunywa kwangethuba kakhulu. Entabeni ixesha apho ilanga lichukumisa umqolo lixesha lokwenyani lokutshona.
p-278.principle: Ukuba i-engile yokugquma yomqolo wasentshona $h$, ixesha apho ilanga lisihla kuloo bude lixesha lokwenyani lokutshona, kwaye ilanga ligqunywe kwangethuba $\Delta t\approx\frac{h}{\omega}$. Ekwindla kwindawo ephakathi, isantya sokuhla kwelanga ngokuthe nkqo malunga $\omega\approx12^\circ/\mathrm{h}$.
p-278.example: Ukuba i-engile yokugquma yomqolo wasentshona $10^\circ$, umthunzi uwela kwangethuba $\Delta t\approx10^\circ/12^\circ\mathrm{/h}\approx50\ \mathrm{min}$. Ukudibanisa ixesha elide lokuba mnyama emva kokutshona kwelanga, ukuhla kunciphisa ixesha elingaphezulu kweyure enye.
p-278.actionItem: Namhlanje kwiplani yokuhamba intaba, beka ixesha lokugqiba ukuhla kwiiyure ezi-1.5~2 ngaphambi kwexesha lokutshona kwelanga elikwitafile kwaye ufake isibane sentloko kwibhegi.

p-279.title: Xa uthenga ijacket ye-down jonga inani le-fill power nesixa solwakhiwo kunye
p-279.summary: I-fill power ilinganiselo lokuba i-down iyayilwa kakuhle kangakanani ukubamba umoya. Inani eliphezulu linokwenza ukufudumala okufanayo ngokukhaphukhaphu ngakumbi, kodwa ukufudumala okupheleleyo kunqunywa kwakunye nesixa solwakhiwo.
p-279.principle: I-fill power ngu-$\mathrm{FP}=\frac{V\,(\mathrm{in^3})}{m\,(\mathrm{oz})}$ ngumthamo odumbileyo ngeyunithi yobunzima. Ukufudumala kuxhomekeke kubukhulu bomaleko womoya ongashukumiyo ovaleleke ($k\approx0.026\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$), ngoko ubunzima obufunekayo ukuzalisa umthamo ofanayo $m\propto\frac{1}{\mathrm{FP}}$.
p-279.example: Ekuzaliseni ubukhulu obufanayo, i-fill power ye-600 $100\ \mathrm{g}$, i-fill power ye-800 $600/800\times100=75\ \mathrm{g}$ iyaneliseka. Ukuba ukufudumala kuyafana, yakhaphukhaphu malunga ne-$25\%$.
p-279.actionItem: Namhlanje xa uthenga ijacket ye-down, jonga zombini i-fill power nobunzima bolwakhiwo (g) kwileyibhile uze uthelekise.

p-280.title: Ikhalkhuleyitha ye-solar isebenza nangaphantsi kwesibane sasekhaya
p-280.summary: Ikhalkhuleyitha isebenzisa amandla ambalwa kuphela e-microwatts, ngoko isebenza ngokwaneleyo nangesibane sasekhaya esibuthathaka kakhulu kunelanga. Into ebalulekileyo ayikuko ukuqina kokukhanya, kodwa ukuba amandla e-photon adlula umda.
p-280.principle: Amandla e-photon ngu-$E=h\nu=\frac{hc}{\lambda}\approx\frac{1240\ \mathrm{eV\cdot nm}}{\lambda}$. Ukuba lo mbulalo mkhulu kune-bandgap ye-semiconductor, ii-elektroni ziyakhutshwa kwaye umsinga uyahamba, kwaye xa ukukhanya kuthambile, umsinga kuphela uyancipha.
p-280.example: I-photon yokukhanya okubonakalayo kobude bamaza $550\ \mathrm{nm}$ ngu-$E\approx2.25\ \mathrm{eV}$ mkhulu kune-bandgap yesilicon ye-amorphous malunga ne-$1.7\ \mathrm{eV}$. Isibane sasekhaya $500\ \mathrm{lux}$ sibonakala ngama-$1/200$ amalunga elanga elicwebileyo (malunga ne-$100{,}000\ \mathrm{lux}$) kodwa sanele kwikhalkhuleyitha yezimbalwa ze-$\mu\mathrm{W}$.
p-280.actionItem: Namhlanje vula ikhalkhuleyitha ye-solar phantsi kwesibane sasekhaya uze ugquqhe iphaneli ngesandla ukujonga ukuba amanani ayafiphala.

p-281.title: Kwifowuni ye-OLED imo emnyama igcina ibhetri
p-281.summary: I-OLED ipixel nganye izikhanyisela ngokwayo, ngoko amapixel amnyama awasebenzisi mandla ngokuphantse. Okukhona kukho umva omnyama, amandla escreen ayancipha.
p-281.principle: Amandla escreen yisamba samandla ama-pixel $P=\sum_i P_i$ kwaye ipixel emnyama $P_i\approx0$. I-LCD enebacklight ihlala ivuliwe inamandla afanayo ngokungakhathali umxholo wescreen, ngoko ayinasiphumo.
p-281.example: Ukuba sicinga ukuba amandla escreen kumva omhlophe $1.0\ \mathrm{W}$, kumva omnyama $0.5\ \mathrm{W}$, ngeyure ezi-3 ngosuku konga $0.5\ \mathrm{W}\times3\ \mathrm{h}=1.5\ \mathrm{Wh}$. Oku kulingana nama-$10\%$ amalunga ebhetri $15\ \mathrm{Wh}$.
p-281.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba ifowuni yakho yi-OLED, vula imo emnyama kwiisetingi. Ukuba yi-LCD, isiphumo sincinci, ngoko nciphisa ubuqaqawuli.

p-282.title: Kuhambo emnbilini, sebenzisa izibane ezisezantsi nezemvula
p-282.summary: Xa uvula izibane eziphezulu emnbilini, ukukhanya kubuyela kumathontsi amanzi kwaye ngokwenene ukubona phambili kuyabi kubi ngakumbi. Izibane ezisezantsi nezemvula zinika ukubona okungcono.
p-282.principle: Amathontsi omnbilini (ububanzi malunga $1\sim20\ \mu\mathrm{m}$) afana nobude bamaza okukhanya, ngoko ukusasazeka kuka-Mie kusasaza ukukhanya ngamandla macala onke, ingakumbi phambili nasemva. Ukukhanya kuyancipha ngo-$I=I_0e^{-\beta x}$, kwaye ukukhanya kwezibane eziphezulu okusondele kubude bamehlo kuyabuya kwenza ukuthuthuzela kwamehlo.
p-282.example: Kumbilini apho ukubonakala kungaphakathi kwe-$50\ \mathrm{m}$, ngokomthetho wezithuthi isantya esiphezulu kufuneka sinciphe ngama-$50\%$ okanye ngaphezulu, kwaye kwindlela ene-$100\ \mathrm{km/h}$ umda, $50\ \mathrm{km/h}$ okanye ngaphantsi.
p-282.actionItem: Ukusuka namhlanje kwiintsuku zombilini vula izibane ezisezantsi nezemvula, cima ezi ziphezulu, kwaye wandise umgama kwimoto engaphambili kunesiqhelo.

p-283.title: Isibane sokufunda sikhanyise ukusuka kwicala elichasene nesandla ubhala ngaso
p-283.summary: Kuba ukukhanya kuhamba ngqo, isithunzi sesandla nesipheni siguqula oonobumba. Ukukhanyisa ukusuka phambili kwicala elichasene nesandla ubhala ngaso kuyenza isithunzi siye ngasemva kwesandla kwaye amehlo ayadinwa kancinci.
p-283.principle: Xa kukho umthombo wenqaku ukuphakama $H$, ukuphakama kwento $h$, umgama othe tye $d$, isithunzi sisabela ngasemva kwento nge-$s=\frac{dh}{H-h}$. Ukuba umthombo ukwicala elinye nesandla obhala ngaso, esi sithunzi siwa phezu koonobumba.
p-283.example: Ukuba ukuphakama kwesibane $H=40\ \mathrm{cm}$, ukuphakama kwesandla $h=3\ \mathrm{cm}$, umgama othe tye $d=30\ \mathrm{cm}$, kwenziwa isithunzi se-$s=\frac{30\times3}{37}\approx2.4\ \mathrm{cm}$. I-illuminance yokufunda $300\sim500\ \mathrm{lux}$ iyaqhelekileyo.
p-283.actionItem: Namhlanje abo basebenzisa isandla sasekunene mababeke isibane etafileni ngakwesobunxele phambili, abo basebenzisa isandla sasekhohlo ngakwesokunene phambili.

p-284.title: Khwela ithambeka eliqatha ngokuzigzag
p-284.summary: Ukuba ukuphakama okunyukayo kuyafana, umsebenzi uyafana, kodwa ukujikeleza indlela ngokutyekelayo kunciphisa amandla kwisinyathelo ngasinye kwaye ukuphefumla kuba lula. Endaweni yoko, umgama wokuhamba uyonyuka.
p-284.principle: Umsebenzi odingekayo kwithambeka ngu-$W=mgh$ ongaxhomekekanga kwindlela, kodwa amandla ecaleni lethambeka $F=mg\sin\theta=mg\frac{h}{L}$ ngoko akhula ukuncipha njengoko ubude bendlela $L$ bunyuka.
p-284.example: Umntu we-$70\ \mathrm{kg}$ ekhwela $100\ \mathrm{m}$ $W\approx69\ \mathrm{kJ}$. $30^\circ$ ukukhwela ngqo $F\approx343\ \mathrm{N}$ $200\ \mathrm{m}$, $15^\circ$ zigzag $F\approx178\ \mathrm{N}$ malunga ne-$386\ \mathrm{m}$.
p-284.actionItem: Namhlanje xa udibana necandelo eliqatha, khetha indlela ejikelezayo ngaphakathi kwendlela yabahambi kwaye ungadluli kwindlela emfutshane.

p-285.title: Amatayara eqhwa agcina ubunyoba ngaphantsi kwe-7°C
p-285.summary: Irabha iba nzima xa kubanda, ukubamba kuyancipha, kodwa amatayara eqhwa asebenzisa ingxube ethambileyo kubushushu obuphantsi. Nokuba kungekho qhwa, ukuba ubushushu bumalunga ne-7°C, umahluko uyabonakala.
p-285.principle: Irabha igcina ukuguquguquka ngaphezulu kobushushu be-glass transition $T_g$ kwaye iba nzima xa isondela kuyo. Amandla okukhuhlana $F=\mu N$ nomgama wokubhrekha $d=\frac{v^2}{2\mu g}$, ngoko xa $\mu$ ehla, kuyanda.
p-285.example: Ku-$80\ \mathrm{km/h}$ ($22.2\ \mathrm{m/s}$), xa $\mu=0.8$ malunga ne-$31\ \mathrm{m}$, itayara ebandayo xa $\mu=0.6$ malunga ne-$42\ \mathrm{m}$. Amaxabiso ayinkcazo kuphela.
p-285.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga kwingqikelelo yemozulu ukuba ubushushu obuphantsi bemihla ngemihla buqhubeka malunga ne-7°C, uze ubeke ixesha lokutshintsha amatayara eqhwa.

p-286.title: Izibane ze-sensor ezikwintendelezo zibona i-infrared yokushisa komzimba womntu
p-286.summary: Izibane ze-sensor ziyavuleka ngokuvakalisa utshintsho kwi-infrared evela kubushushu bomzimba xa umntu ehamba. Ziyavuleka ngexesha elifunekayo kuphela, zinciphisa kakhulu amandla esibane sentendelezo.
p-286.principle: Ubude bamaza obuphezulu bemitha bento kumthetho ka-Wien $\lambda_{\max}=\frac{b}{T}$, $b\approx2898\ \mu\mathrm{m\cdot K}$. Ukuba ulusu $33\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ($306\ \mathrm{K}$), $\lambda_{\max}\approx9.5\ \mu\mathrm{m}$, kwaye i-sensor ye-PIR ibona utshintsho lwale-infrared.
p-286.example: Ukuba i-LED yentendelezo $10\ \mathrm{W}$ ivuliwe iiyure ezingama-24, $240\ \mathrm{Wh}$. Ukuba ngokusebenzisa i-sensor ivulwa iiyure ezi-2 kuphela ngosuku kwaye amandla e-sensor yokulinda $0.5\ \mathrm{W}$, $20+12=32\ \mathrm{Wh}$, kuncipha malunga ne-$87\%$.
p-286.actionItem: Namhlanje tshintsha isibane sentendelezo okanye sendlu yokungena sibe sisibane se-sensor, okanye misela ixesha lokuhlala sivuliwe kwimizuzu eyi-1~2.

p-287.title: Cima umnyango wegumbi elingasetyenziswa ukuze unciphise umthamo ofudumezwayo
p-287.summary: Xa umoya nendawo yodonga ekufuneka zifudunyezwe ziyancipha, kufuneka ubushushu obuncinci ukwenza ubushushu obufanayo. Nangona kunjalo, ukuyivala ngokupheleleyo kuvelisa ukunwebeka kwamanzi, ngoko gcina ubushushu obuncinci.
p-287.principle: Ubushushu bokufudumeza umoya ngu-$Q=mc\Delta T$ kwaye $m=\rho V$, ngoko bulingana nomthamo ofudumezwayo $V$. Umoya $\rho\approx1.2\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, $c\approx1005\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$.
p-287.example: Ukuze uphakamise umoya wegumbi elingenanto $25\ \mathrm{m^3}$ nge-$5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ kuthatha $Q=1.2\times25\times1005\times5\approx151\ \mathrm{kJ}\approx0.04\ \mathrm{kWh}$. Ukudibanisa ukufudumeza udonga nefenitshala kunye nobushushu obuhlala bubaleka, ngokwenene kuba kokufaneleyo amaxesha amaninzi.
p-287.actionItem: Namhlanje vala umnyango wegumbi elingasetyenziswa kwaye uthobise ivalvu yokufudumeza yelo gumbi ukuya kubushushu obuphantsi, ungayivali ngokupheleleyo.

p-288.title: Xa ukuvutha kweentloko zesibane kuvela ngasemva, jonga kwicala lendlela yasekunene
p-288.summary: Ngokujika amehlo kude nomthombo wokukhanya, inani lokukhanya okusasazekileyo ngaphakathi kweretina elikugubungelayo liyancipha kakhulu. Ukubeka ukujonga kumda wendlela yasekunene kunciphisa ukuthuthuzela kwaye indlela iyabonakala.
p-288.principle: Ukukhanya kokugquma okubangelwa kukukhanya okusasazekileyo ngaphakathi kwamehlo ngokuqikelela $L_v\approx\frac{10E}{\theta^2}$. Apha $E$ yi-illuminance efikayo emehlweni ($\mathrm{lux}$) kwaye $\theta$ yi-engile phakathi komthombo nokujonga ($^\circ$).
p-288.example: Ukujonga okumgama we-$5^\circ$ ukusuka kumthombo $L_v\propto1/25$, ku-$10^\circ$ $1/100$, ngoko ukukhanya kokugquma kuyancipha ukuya kwi-$1/4$. Ipupili nayo iyancipha xa kukhanya kwaye inceda ngakumbi.
p-288.actionItem: Namhlanje ebusuku xa udibana nezibane eziphezulu ezisondela, ungavali amehlo, beka ukujonga kumgca omhlophe wendlela yasekunene uze unciphise isantya.

p-289.title: Kutheni amehlo edinwa xa kuvulwa isikrini kuphela egumbini elimnyama
p-289.summary: Egumbini elimnyama ipupili inkulu kwaye isikrini sikhanya kakhulu, ngoko amehlo kufuneka alungelelanise umahluko wobuqaqawuli rhoqo. Ukukhanyisa kancinci iindawo ezijikelezileyo kunciphisa umahluko kwaye amehlo ayasonwabela.
p-289.principle: Indawo yepupili $A=\frac{\pi d^2}{4}$ kwaye ububanzi butshintsha malunga $2\sim8\ \mathrm{mm}$, i-illuminance yeretina $E_r\propto L\,A$. Xa umlinganiselo wobuqaqawuli phakathi kwesikrini neendawo ezijikelezileyo mkhulu, amehlo atshintsha imeko yokuziqhelanisa rhoqo.
p-289.example: Xa ububanzi bepupili bukhula ukusuka kwi-$2\ \mathrm{mm}$ ukuya kwi-$8\ \mathrm{mm}$, indawo iba yi-16 amaxesha. Ukuba izinto ezijikelezileyo $0.5\ \mathrm{cd/m^2}$, isikrini $200\ \mathrm{cd/m^2}$, umlinganiselo wobuqaqawuli $400:1$, mkhulu kakhulu kuneyokucetyiswa ngokubanzi malunga ne-$3:1\sim10:1$.
p-289.actionItem: Namhlanje ebusuku xa ujonga isikrini, vula isibane esingekho ngqo okanye isibane esincinci ngasemva kwesikrini ukukhanyisa kancinci iindawo ezijikelezileyo.

p-290.title: Umgca wokhuseleko webhodi yasetreyini yaphantsi mhlaba ungenxa yomoya wetreyini
p-290.summary: Xa itreyini ekhawulezayo idlula, umoya osecaleni kwetreyini uyakhawuleza kwaye uxinzelelo luyancipha, kwaye umntu angatsalwa ngakwitreyini. Ukuma ngasemva komgca wokhuseleko yeyona ndlela ithembekileyo yokuzilungiselela.
p-290.principle: Ngokomgaqo ka-Bernoulli $p+\frac12\rho v^2=\mathrm{const}$, xa isantya somoya $v$ siyanda, uxinzelelo $p$ luyehla. Ukuncipha koxinzelelo $\Delta p=\frac12\rho v^2$.
p-290.example: Ukuba umoya osecaleni kwetreyini uhamba ngo-$10\ \mathrm{m/s}$, $\Delta p=0.5\times1.2\times10^2=60\ \mathrm{Pa}$, kwaye kwindawo esecaleni yomzimba $0.6\ \mathrm{m^2}$ kusebenza i-$F\approx36\ \mathrm{N}$ (malunga ne-$3.7\ \mathrm{kgf}$). Ngokwenene i-turbulence iyongezwa kwaye iyatshintsha.
p-290.actionItem: Namhlanje xa itreyini isondela kwibhodi, yenza enye inyathelo emva komgca wokhuseleko.

p-291.title: Itreyi yokubhaka emnyama ibhaka ngokukhawuleza
p-291.summary: Itreyi emnyama ifunxa ubushushu berediyeshini yeovini ngakumbi, kwaye itreyi yesilivere ibonisa ubuninzi. Ngokweresiphi enye, ngokwemibala yetreyi, ezantsi ziba mdaka ngokukhawuleza.
p-291.principle: Amandla erediyeshini afunxwa ngumphezulu alingana nokufunxa (= emissivity) $\varepsilon$ kwaye amandla akhutshwayo $P=\varepsilon\sigma AT^4$. Umphezulu omnyama $\varepsilon\approx0.95$, i-aluminium ekhazimlayo malunga ne-$0.1$.
p-291.example: Kwindawo yerediyeshini efanayo, itreyi emnyama ifunxa ubushushu berediyeshini obungama-$0.95/0.1\approx9$ amaxesha ngaphezu kwetreyi yesilivere ekhazimlayo. Ngoko ngokufuthi kucetyiswa ukunciphisa ubushushu beovini malunga ne-$10\sim15\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ngetreyi emnyama.
p-291.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ubhaka ngetreyi emnyama, nciphisa ubushushu beovini nge-$10\sim15\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ uze ujonge umbala wokubhaka kwangethuba.

p-292.title: Ukulawula ubushushu bebhulanki yombane yenziwa yi-bimetal
p-292.summary: Ipleyiti ebhityileyo enamatshelisiweyo yezinye iintsimbi ezahlukeneyo, xa ifumana ubushushu, igoba ngecala elinye ivule kwaye ivale unxibelelwano lombane. Le yithermostat elula ecima umbane kubushushu obuthile.
p-292.principle: Ukwanda ngokomgca $\Delta L=\alpha L\Delta T$, kwaye ngenxa yomahluko wesalathisi sokwanda kweentsimbi ezimbini $\Delta\alpha$ ipleyiti iyagoba kwaye ukufuduka komphetho $\delta=\frac{3\Delta\alpha\Delta T L^2}{4t}$ ($t$: ubukhulu obupheleleyo).
p-292.example: Ukuba $L=50\ \mathrm{mm}$, $t=1\ \mathrm{mm}$, $\Delta\alpha=7\times10^{-6}\ \mathrm{/K}$, $\Delta T=40\ \mathrm{K}$, $\delta\approx0.5\ \mathrm{mm}$ iyashukuma kwaye unxibelelwano luyahlukana.
p-292.actionItem: Namhlanje sebenzisa ibhulanki yombane ityandiwe, ungayiboli okanye uyibumbe, kwaye xa ulala yibeke kwinqanaba eliphantsi.

p-293.title: Umthombo wobushushu osecaleni kwethermostat yeboiler uyalulukisa ukufudumeza
p-293.summary: Ithermostat ilinganisa kuphela ubushushu bendawo ebekwe kuyo kwaye ivula nokucima iboiler. Ukuba kukho isitovu okanye ilanga ecaleni, indlu yonke ibanda kunesetingi, kwaye ecaleni kodonga olubandayo kukho ukufudumeza ngokugqithisileyo.
p-293.principle: Ithermostat isebenza kuphela xa ubushushu $T_{\mathrm{sensor}}$ kwindawo ye-sensor buphantsi kwexabiso elisetiweyo $T_{\mathrm{set}}$, ngoko kubushushu obuphakathi begumbi $T_{\mathrm{room}}=T_{\mathrm{sensor}}+\epsilon$ impazamo yendawo $\epsilon$ yimpazamo yokufudumeza.
p-293.example: Ngenxa yomthombo wobushushu osecaleni kwe-sensor ufundwa njenge-$23\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ kodwa ixabiso eliphakathi legumbi $20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, ngesetingi $22\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ iboiler iyacima kwaye $2\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ kubanda. Ngokuphambene, $2\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ukufudumeza ngokugqithisileyo kwandisa iindleko zokufudumeza malunga ne-$14\%$ (malunga ne-$7\%$ nge-1°C ngokuqikelela).
p-293.actionItem: Namhlanje susa izitovu zombane, iiTV nezinye iimithombo yobushushu kunye nefenitshala ecaleni kwethermostat, nakwicala lezigquma zelanga.

p-294.title: Ukuba iphoyilithi yelungu elinye lesipikha itshintshiwe, i-bass iyanyamalala
p-294.summary: Ukuba utshintsha ukuqhagamshelwa kwe-+ nge-− kwisipikha esinye, izipikha ezimbini ziyadlala ngesigaba esiphikisana, kwaye i-bass yobude obude bamaza iyacinywa. Ukuba isandi sibhityile kwaye imvakalelo yesithuba iyaphela, jonga uqhagamshelwano kuqala.
p-294.principle: Amaza amabini ahluke nge-$\pi$ kwisigaba enza ukuphazamiseka okucimayo apho isamba siyancipha. Ukuba ubude bamaza $\lambda=\frac{v}{f}$ bude kakhulu kunomgama wezipikha, ucimeka phantse ngokupheleleyo naphi na.
p-294.example: Ubude bamaza be-$100\ \mathrm{Hz}$ bu-$\lambda=343/100=3.4\ \mathrm{m}$ bude kunomgama wezipikha $2\ \mathrm{m}$, ngoko buncipha kakhulu kufutshane nomnyango. $5\ \mathrm{kHz}$ yi-$\lambda\approx6.9\ \mathrm{cm}$, ngoko nokuba ushukumisa ii-cm ezimbalwa ubuqaqawuli buyanyuka buhle kwaye ivakala ngathi i-bass kuphela ilahlekile.
p-294.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga ukuba izinto zesipikha ze-+ (obomvu) zihlanganiswe kwi-terminal ye-+ kunye ne-− (emnyama) kwi-terminal ye-−, kuzo zombini izipikha ngokufanayo.

p-295.title: Ukwenza i-push-up ngamadolo kunciphisa i-lever yomzimba
p-295.summary: Ukuba ubeka amadolo emhlabeni, ubude be-lever buncipha kwaye umthwalo ongalweni uyancipha. Ukuba i-push-up esemgangathweni inzima, unokuqala ngempushup yamadolo ngokungenisa ngokufanelekileyo.
p-295.principle: Ukuba umzimba ubonwa njenge-lever, kwi-torque balance $F_{\mathrm{hand}}\,L=mg\,d$, amandla afunyanwa ngesandla ngu-$F_{\mathrm{hand}}=mg\frac{d}{L}$. Indawo yenkxaso ifuduka ukusuka ezinzwini zeenyawo ukuya emadolweni kwaye $L$ ne-$d$ zitshintsha kwaye umlinganiselo womthwalo uyancipha.
p-295.example: Kuphando umthwalo ofunyanwa ngesandla kuxelwa ukuba umalunga ne-$64\%$ kwi-push-up esemgangathweni kunye ne-$49\%$ kwi-push-up yamadolo. Ukuba ubunzima $70\ \mathrm{kg}$, kuba $45\ \mathrm{kg}$ ngokuchasene ne-$34\ \mathrm{kg}$, ngokukhaphukhaphu malunga ne-$23\%$.
p-295.actionItem: Namhlanje gcina umzimba kumgca othe ngqo (intloko-ihafu-idolo) wenze i-push-up yamadolo amatyeli ama-8 ngeeseti ezi-2. Yeka ukuba kukho intlungu.

p-296.title: Ukufumana ubhelekazi ngewotshi ye-analog nangelanga
p-296.summary: Ukuba ujonisa isalathisi seyure ngakwilanga, icala eliphakathi kwesalathisi seyure ne-12 liyakuba malunga nobhelekazi. Ngumgaqo wokuqikelela olusetyenziswa emntla we-hemisphere ngaphandle kwekhampasi.
p-296.principle: Ilanga lihamba $\omega_\odot=15^\circ$ ngeyure kwaye isalathisi seyure sihamba $\omega_h=30^\circ$ ngeyure. Ngoko isiqingatha se-engile yesalathisi seyure $\frac{\omega_\odot}{\omega_h}=\frac12$ sihambelana notshintsho lwe-azimuth yelanga kwaye i-bisector ibonisa ubhelekazi.
p-296.example: Ngo-4 emva kwemini, ukuba ujonisa isalathisi seyure (ukusuka kwi-12 $120^\circ$) ngakwilanga, isiqingatha sayo yicala lexesha elingu-$2$, elingubhelekazi. EyaseKorea imeridian yexesha elisemgangathweni (ubude basempuma $135^\circ$) neSeoul (malunga ne-$127^\circ$) ziyahluka, ngoko kukho umahluko wemizuzu emalunga ne-$30$ kwixesha lelanga kwaye impazamo ingama-$\pm15^\circ$.
p-296.actionItem: Namhlanje ngosuku olucwebileyo ngaphandle, qikelela ubhelekazi ngewotshi ye-analog uze uthelekise nekhampasi yefowuni.

p-297.title: Iglasi yokukhulisa, okukhona idiopter (D) inkulu, kokukhona indawo yokugxila ifutshane
p-297.summary: Amandla eglasi yokukhulisa ayinto ephikisanayo yobude bokugxila, ngoko inani elikhulu lithetha ukugxila okufutshane nokukhulisa okukhulu. Okukhona ukukhulisa kuphezulu, kokukhona umhlaba ubonakala mncinci kwaye ilenzi kufuneka ibe kufutshane nelihlo nento.
p-297.principle: Amandla okukhukhula kwelenzi $D=\frac{1}{f}$ ($f$ iyunithi yi-m, $D$ iyunithi yi-diopter), kwaye i-angular magnification ngokuthatha indawo esondeleyo yamehlo $25\ \mathrm{cm}$ ngu-$M\approx\frac{25\ \mathrm{cm}}{f}=\frac{D}{4}$.
p-297.example: $5\ \mathrm{D}$ ngu-$f=20\ \mathrm{cm}$ malunga ne-$1.25$ amaxesha, $10\ \mathrm{D}$ ngu-$f=10\ \mathrm{cm}$ malunga ne-$2.5$ amaxesha, $20\ \mathrm{D}$ ngu-$f=5\ \mathrm{cm}$ malunga ne-$5$ amaxesha.
p-297.actionItem: Namhlanje xa uthenga iglasi yokukhulisa, khetha idiopter ehambelana nokusetyenziswa kwakho, kwaye ungayibeki ngaphantsi kwelanga kuba inokuqokelela ukukhanya kwelanga yenze umlilo.

p-298.title: Ukulibaziseka kokuphindiselwa kobushushu kwiventilesheni kubuyisela ubushushu obuphumayo
p-298.summary: Sisixhobo esinikezela ubushushu begumbi obulahlwayo ngexesha lokuventilesha kumoya obandayo ongenayo. Umoya uyatshintshwa kodwa inxalenye enkulu yobushushu bokufudumeza iyagcinwa.
p-298.principle: Ukusebenza kokubuyisela ubushushu $\eta=\frac{T_{\mathrm{supply}}-T_{\mathrm{out}}}{T_{\mathrm{in}}-T_{\mathrm{out}}}$, kwaye ukulahleka kobushushu ngokuventilesha $P=\rho c\,\dot V\,\Delta T$ ($\rho c\approx1200\ \mathrm{J/(m^3\cdot K)}$).
p-298.example: Ukuba ngaphakathi $22\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, umoya ongaphandle $0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, umthamo wokuventilesha $150\ \mathrm{m^3/h}$, ukulahleka $1200\times\frac{150}{3600}\times22\approx1100\ \mathrm{W}$. Ukuba $\eta=70\%$, kuyancipha ukuya malunga ne-$330\ \mathrm{W}$ kwaye umoya ongenayo uba malunga ne-$15.4\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
p-298.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba unesixhobo sokubuyisela ubushushu (iventilesha), coca ifilitha ngokwexesha elikwincwadana.

p-299.title: Irafu yomgangatho yongeza umaleko omnye wokumelana nobushushu
p-299.summary: Irafu yongeza umaleko omnye wokuphelisa ubushushu phakathi komgangatho neenyawo. Nangona kunjalo, ukuba ufudumeza umgangatho, irafu eqinileyo ivala nobushushu obuza egumbini, ngoko sebenzisa ebhityileyo.
p-299.principle: Ukuba imialeko ilandelelana, ukumelana nobushushu $R=\sum\frac{L_i}{k_i}$ kwaye ukuhamba kobushushu $q=\frac{\Delta T}{R}$. Xa kongezwa umaleko omnye, $R$ iyanda kwaye $q$ iyancipha.
p-299.example: Irafu yobukhulu $1\ \mathrm{cm}$, $k\approx0.05\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$ ngu-$R=0.2\ \mathrm{m^2K/W}$. Xa umgangatho $R=0.5$, $\Delta T=10\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, $q=20\to14.3\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$ kuncipha malunga ne-$29\%$.
p-299.actionItem: Namhlanje beka irafu kwindawo yomgangatho obandayo apho uhlala okanye umi rhoqo, kwaye ukuba igumbi linomgangatho ofudumezayo khetha irafu ebhityileyo.

p-300.title: Ukuba umnyango uwile, qala ukuqinisa iibholithi zebhengile ezingaphezulu
p-300.summary: Ubunzima bomnyango batsala ibhengile engaphezulu kwaye bucinezela esezantsi, ngoko iibholithi eziphezulu ziqala ukuhlaba. Ukuqinisa iibholithi zebhengile engaphezulu kuphela kuhlala kulungisa ukuwa.
p-300.principle: Umnyango omileyo ukwi-torque balance $\sum\tau=0$. Ukuba ubunzima $W$ busebenza kwiziko lomnyango ($\frac{w}{2}$ ukusuka kwibhengile), kumgama webhengile $h$ amandla athe tye $F=\frac{W\,w/2}{h}$.
p-300.example: Ukuba ubunzima bomnyango $20\ \mathrm{kg}$ ($W\approx196\ \mathrm{N}$), ububanzi $0.9\ \mathrm{m}$, umgama webhengile $1.6\ \mathrm{m}$, $F=\frac{196\times0.45}{1.6}\approx55\ \mathrm{N}$ itsala ibhengile engaphezulu kwaye icinezela esezantsi.
p-300.actionItem: Namhlanje ngomnyango ovuliweyo qinisa iibholithi zebhengile engaphezulu ngescrewdriver esisiphambano, uzalise imingxuma etyhutyhayo ngothinti lwamazinyo nogundo lomthi, uze uqinise kwakhona.

p-301.title: Xa uvuka esitulweni, tyekela umzimba ongaphezulu phambili kuqala
p-301.summary: Iziko lobunzima ekuhlaleni likhona emva kweenyawo, ngoko kufuneka utyekele umzimba ongaphezulu phambili uze ususe iziko lobunzima phezu kweenyawo ukuze kungathathi amandla amaninzi kwaye uvuke ngokuzinzileyo.
p-301.principle: Ukuze umntu ame, uqikelelo oluthe nkqo lweziko lobunzima (COM) kufuneka lube ngaphakathi kwendawo yenkxaso eyenziwa zizinyawo. Ukuba iziko likumgama othe tye $x$ ukusuka kwiinyawo, i-torque eyenziwa ngumxhuzulane $\tau=mg\,x$.
p-301.example: Xa i-COM ekuhlaleni imalunga ne-$15\ \mathrm{cm}$ emva kweenyawo, ukuba utyekela umzimba ongaphezulu phambili malunga ne-$30^\circ$, i-COM iza phambili malunga ne-$10\ \mathrm{cm}$ kwaye $x$ ininzi iyanyamalala (ixabiso eliqikelelweyo).
p-301.actionItem: Namhlanje xa uvuka esitulweni, tyekela impumlo kwicala lezinzwane zeenyawo, tsala iinyawo zisondele esitulweni ngoko uvuke. Ukuba ukukhawuleza kuphindaphindeka, xoxa nengcali.

p-302.title: Ebusuku basebusika ukuphakama kwePolaris kulingana nokuphakama kwakho kwendawo
p-302.summary: IPolaris ikufutshane nesibhakabhaka esisentla, ngoko ukuphakama kwayo kuphantse kulingane nokuphakama komgama wombukeli. Ngenkwenkwezi enye unokuqikelela ubude bendawo yakho.
p-302.principle: I-engile yokuphakama yesibhakabhaka esisentla ilingana nobude bokuqwalasela $\varphi$, kwaye iPolaris ikude malunga ne-$0.7^\circ$ kwisibhakabhaka, ngoko $h_{\mathrm{Polaris}}\approx\varphi$.
p-302.example: ESeoul (malunga ne-$37.5^\circ$ N) iPolaris ikwi-$37.5^\circ$ malunga phezu komphetho we-horizon, eJeju (malunga ne-$33.5^\circ$ N) malunga ne-$33.5^\circ$. Ingqeqesha enye ukulula ingalo imalunga ne-$10^\circ$, ngoko eSeoul ikumgama weengqeqesha ezingama-3.75 malunga.
p-302.actionItem: Namhlanje ebusuku obucwebileyo fumana iPolaris ngeBig Dipper okanye ngo-W weCassiopeia, uze ulinganise ukuphakama ngempuku yakho.

p-303.title: Kutheni ikhowuti yokulwa nokubonakalisa kweeglasi inemibala eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka
p-303.summary: Ikhowuti yokulwa nokubonakalisa yenzelwe ukuba ukukhanya okubonakaliswe kwifilimu ebhityileyo kucinane. Ngokungqamana nobude bamaza obuluhlaza embindini, ubhlowu nobomvu bushiyeka kancinci kwaye umbala wokubonakalisa uyabonakala.
p-303.principle: Xa ubukhulu befilimu $d$ bu-$\frac{\lambda}{4n}$, umahluko wendlela yamaza abonakaliswe emphezulu nasezantsi uba $\frac{\lambda}{2}$ kwaye kwenzeka ukuphazamiseka okucimayo. Isalathisi sokuphambuka esifanelekileyo sefilimu $n_c=\sqrt{n_s}$.
p-303.example: Ifilimu $\mathrm{MgF_2}$ ($n=1.38$) kwi-$\lambda=550\ \mathrm{nm}$ $d=\frac{550}{4\times1.38}\approx100\ \mathrm{nm}$. Iglasi engenayo ikhowuti ibonakalisa malunga ne-$4\%$ kwicala ngalinye, kodwa xa ikhowutiwe iyancipha ukuya ngaphantsi kwe-$1\%$.
p-303.actionItem: Namhlanje coca iilenzi zeeglasi ngomcocisi osebenzayo ngokukhethekileyo nelaphu le-microfiber, kwaye uphephe ukuzimosha ngelaphu elomileyo okanye amanzi ashushu.

p-304.title: Ikhebula yokuhlawula ebhityileyo ihlawula ngokucotha
p-304.summary: Ucingo olubhityileyo lunokumelana okukhulu, ngoko umbane uyehla kwikhebula kwaye ulahleka njengobushushu. Nangona kusetyenziswa itshaja efanayo, ikhebula eqinileyo ithumela umsinga ongakumbi.
p-304.principle: Ukuhla komdlalo $V=IR$, kunye nokumelana kocingo $R=\frac{\rho L}{A}$. Amandla alahleka njengobushushu kwikhebula $P=I^2R$.
p-304.example: Ukuba kuhlawulwa $2\ \mathrm{A}$ ngocingo lobhedu olujikeleza $2\ \mathrm{m}$ ($\rho=1.7\times10^{-8}\ \Omega\mathrm{m}$), indawo yocingo $0.08\ \mathrm{mm^2}$ (28 AWG) kunye ne-$R\approx0.42\ \Omega$ $0.84\ \mathrm{V}$, ukulahleka $1.7\ \mathrm{W}$. $0.2\ \mathrm{mm^2}$ (24 AWG) $0.17\ \Omega$ $0.34\ \mathrm{V}$, $0.7\ \mathrm{W}$.
p-304.actionItem: Namhlanje tshintsha ikhebula ebhityileyo ehlawula ngokucotha okanye eshushu ngekhebula eqinileyo enomsinga olinganisiweyo obhaliweyo.

p-305.title: Ifriji ye-kimchi enesiciko ayilahlekelwa ngumoya obandayo xa ivuliwe
p-305.summary: Umoya obandayo uxinene kakhulu ngoko usinda uze uhlangane ezantsi. Kwiindidi ezivuleka ukusuka phezulu, umoya obandayo uhlala ngaphakathi ekhonteyini kwaye awuphumi kakhulu xa uvula.
p-305.principle: Ukuxinana komoya $\rho=\frac{p}{R_sT}$ kuba kukhulu xa ubushushu buphantsi. Amandla okuphakamisa abangelwa ngumahluko wokuxinana $\Delta\rho\,g\,V$ kwaye umoya obandayo uhlangana ezantsi ngokuzinzileyo.
p-305.example: Umoya we-$4\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ungu-$1.27\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ malunga, umoya we-$25\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ungu-$1.18\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ malunga, onzima ngakumbi malunga ne-$7\%$. Kwifriji yomnyango osecaleni, lo moya obandayo onzima uthululwa ngomnyango ovulekileyo.
p-305.actionItem: Namhlanje phambi kokuba uvule ifriji ye-kimchi, linganisa izinto ofuna ukuzikhupha kwangaphambili uze uvule isiciko kanye nje ngexesha elifutshane.

p-306.title: Beka induku yokhuni phezu kwebhodlo elibilayo
p-306.summary: Xa ibhabhulu ichukumisa induku ize iqhume, ukuphuphuma kuhlala kulibaziseka. Kodwa asisisombululo esipheleleyo, ngoko umgaqo osisiseko kukunciphisa umlilo uze ujonge.
p-306.principle: Umahluko woxinzelelo kwi-layer yebhabhulu enye yifomula kaLaplace $\Delta p=\frac{2\gamma}{r}$ ($\gamma$: uxinzelelo lomphezulu, $r$: irediyasi yokugoba). Xa i-membrane yebhabhulu ichukumisa umphezulu womthi ongalingananga, iba nqabileyo ize iqhume lula.
p-306.example: Ngamanzi $100\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ i-$\gamma\approx0.059\ \mathrm{N/m}$, ize ibhabhulu yerediyasi $1\ \mathrm{mm}$ i-$\Delta p=\frac{2\times0.059}{0.001}\approx118\ \mathrm{Pa}$. Amanzi okupheka i-noodle okanye i-pasta anesitatshi esininzi enza i-membrane yebhabhulu ibe nokuqina.
p-306.actionItem: Namhlanje ngexesha lokupheka i-noodle, beka induku yokhuni ephambeneyo phezu komlomo webhodlo, ize umlilo uwugcine usesona esiphakathi. Qinisekisa ukuba induku ayichukumisi umlilo.

p-307.title: Kuyo yonke i-1m/s yomoya, ubushushu obuvakalayo buyehla malunga ne-1°C
p-307.summary: Xa kuvuthuza umoya, umaleko wamoya oshushu ongaphantsi kwesikhumba uyasuswa, ngoko nokuba ubushushu bunjalo kuvakala kubanda ngakumbi. Ebusika khetha impahla ujonge ubushushu nomoya kunye.
p-307.principle: Ukulahleka kobushushu ngokuhanjiswa-moya okunyanzelweyo kunjani $q=h(v)\,A\,(T_{\mathrm{skin}}-T_{\mathrm{air}})$ kwaye ngokunyuka komoya $v$, i-coefficient yokudlulisa ubushushu $h$ iyanda. Isalathiso sobushushu obuvakalayo $T_{wc}=13.12+0.6215T-11.37v^{0.16}+0.3965Tv^{0.16}$ ($v$ kwi-$\mathrm{km/h}$).
p-307.example: Kubushushu $0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ nomoya $1.4\ \mathrm{m/s}$ ($5\ \mathrm{km/h}$) buvakala malunga ne-$-1.6\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, kwaye kwi-$5\ \mathrm{m/s}$ ($18\ \mathrm{km/h}$) malunga ne-$-4.9\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, ngoko xa umoya unyuka malunga ne-$3.6\ \mathrm{m/s}$, buyehla malunga ne-$3.3\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
p-307.actionItem: Namhlanje ngosuku olunomoya, gquma ulusu olubonakalayo ngejakethi ekhusela umoya nesikhafu entanyeni.

p-308.title: Isangqa ngeenyanga sinokuba luphawu lwemvula
p-308.summary: Isangqa seenyanga senziwa xa iikristali zomkhenkce kwii-cloud eziphezulu ziphula ukukhanya kwenyanga zibe sisangqa. Ii-cloud ezinjalo zibonakala rhoqo xa i-front isondela, ngoko imvula inamathuba amaninzi kodwa ayiqinisekanga.
p-308.principle: I-angle ephantsi yokuphambuka kwe-prism yekristali yomkhenkce ye-hexagonal yi-$D_{\min}=2\arcsin\left(n\sin30^\circ\right)-60^\circ$. Kumkhenkce $n\approx1.31$ kufunyanwa $D_{\min}\approx22^\circ$, ize ijikeleze inyanga kwenziwe isangqa se-$22^\circ$.
p-308.example: Ukusuka kwi-$n=1.31$ kufunyanwa $\arcsin(0.655)\approx40.9^\circ$, ngoko $D_{\min}\approx2\times40.9-60\approx21.8^\circ$. Ububanzi besandla sakho esoluliweyo ngumgama oyi-$20^\circ$, ngoko isangqa sisuka enyangeni sibe sesandla esinye.
p-308.actionItem: Ukuba ubona isangqa ngeenyanga ngobu busuku, jonga isibhengezo sezulu seni yangomso uze uthathe ingqayi.

p-309.title: I-9H kwi-tempered glass film yobunzima bepensile
p-309.summary: I-9H ithetha ukuba nokuba iipensile eqinileyo ayishiyi mvuthuluka, ayiyobunzima beMohs 9. Isanti esebhegini inokuba yeyona ikrwelayo ibe qinile ngakumbi.
p-309.principle: Ukuze umphezulu ukrwelwe, ihlokondiba kufuneka libe liqinile ngakumbi kumphezulu $H_{\mathrm{particle}}>H_{\mathrm{surface}}$. Isikali sobunzima bepensile nesikali seMohs zahlukile.
p-309.example: I-quartz (into ephambili yesanti) inobunzima beMohs $7$ iqina kunegilasi (malunga ne-$5.5\sim6$). Nokuba yifilimu ye-9H, ukuba ingaphantsi kweMohs 7 inokukrwelwa yisanti.
p-309.actionItem: Namhlanje gcina i-foni ngaphandle kweezitshixo nemali, uze unyuse isanti ebhegini.

p-310.title: Ebusika, vula iikhethini ngemini kwifestile ejonge ukuthuba
p-310.summary: Ebusika, nokuba ilanga liphantsi, ifestile ejonge ukuthuba ifumana ilanga phantse ngqo ize ifumane ubushushu obuninzi. Ukuvula iikhethini emini nokuzivala emva kokutshona kokufudumeza simahla.
