p-310.principle: Ukwanda kobushushu belanga ngefestile yi-$Q=A\,I\,\mathrm{SHGC}\cos\theta$ ($I$: ukuqina kwemitha yelanga, SHGC: i-coefficient yokwanda kobushushu belanga, $\theta$: i-angle yokwehla). Ebusika, ifestile ejonge ukuthuba ine-angle encinci, ngoko ukuhamba kukhulu.
p-310.example: Kwifestile $2\ \mathrm{m^2}$, imitha yelanga yasemini kumphezulu ovundlileyo $I\approx500\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$ kunye ne-$\mathrm{SHGC}=0.6$ kufunyanwa $600\ \mathrm{W}$. Ukuba kuthathelwe ngqondweni ngokomndilili $400\ \mathrm{W}$ iiyure ezi-4, kufunyanwa malunga ne-$1.6\ \mathrm{kWh}$ (ixabiso eliqikelelweyo) yobushushu.
p-310.actionItem: Namhlanje ngosuku olucacileyo, vula iikhethini nee-blind kwifestile ejonge ukuthuba, uze uzivale phambi kokutshona kwelanga ukunciphisa ukulahleka kobushushu ebusuku.

p-311.title: Ucango olongezelelweyo lwangaphakathi lunjenge-buffer yomoya
p-311.summary: Indawo encinci phakathi kocango oluphambili nolwangaphakathi isebenza njenge-buffer ize ithintele umoya obandayo ungene ngqo endlini. Eyona nto ibalulekileyo kukungavuli iingcango zombini ngaxeshanye.
p-311.principle: Utshintshiselwano lomoya ngocango oluvulekileyo lwenzeka ngokuhamba-moya ize ukulahleka kobushushu kube yi-$Q=\rho cV\Delta T$ ($V$: umthamo womoya otshintshisiweyo). Ucango lwangaphakathi lulinganisa umthamo wotshintshiselwano kwindawo yangaphambili.
p-311.example: Ukuba i-$3\ \mathrm{m^3}$ yomoya wangaphambili itshintshiselwa ngomahluko we-$20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, kufunyanwa $Q=1.2\times1005\times3\times20\approx72\ \mathrm{kJ}\approx0.02\ \mathrm{kWh}$. Ngaphandle kocango lwangaphakathi, umphumo omkhulu kwigumbi lokuhlala le-$60\ \mathrm{m^3}$ ngoku-ngu-$0.4\ \mathrm{kWh}$.
p-311.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ubuya ekhaya, vala uluvula ucango oluphambili ukuze uvule olwangaphakathi, ize xa uphuma, uvale olwangaphakathi ngaphambi kokuvula oluphambili.

p-312.title: Ukuba ngumphezulu kuphela womlilo we-oven otshayo, ngumsebenzi wendawo ye-rack
p-312.summary: Xa usondele ekufudumezeni okungaphezulu, ukukhanya kobushushu kuyakhula, ngoko umphezulu utsha kuqala. Ukuba wehlisa i-rack ngenqanaba elinye, umphezulu nezantsi ziphekwa ngokulinganayo.
p-312.principle: Kwi-approximation yomthombo wepoyinti, ubukhulu bemitha yi-$I=\frac{P}{4\pi r^2}$, ungqamene ngokuphambeneyo nesikwere somgama. Isifudumezi sokwenyani yimthombo womphezulu, ngoko utshintsho lungqongqo kodwa lunyuka ngokusondela.
p-312.example: Kuyalula, i-rack ekumgama we-$5\ \mathrm{cm}$ kwisifudumezi ifumana, xa ithelekiswa ne-rack ekwi-$10\ \mathrm{cm}$, imitha enamandla ngamaxesha angama-$(10/5)^2=4$. Ngokwenyani, ngenxa yesifudumezi somphezulu, umahluko ngamaxesha angama-2 ukuya kwangama-3.
p-312.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba ngumphezulu utsha kuqala, wehlise i-rack ngenqanaba elinye, ize ukuba kuyimfuneko gubungela umphezulu ngokukhululekileyo nge-foil.

p-313.title: Ukunxiba iisokisi ezimbini kunciphisa amathumba ezinyaweni
p-313.summary: Amathumba avela ekukhuhlaneni kwesikhumba nesokisi, kwaye ngeesokisi ezimbini ukukhuhlana kwenzeka phakathi kwee-layer zeesokisi, ngoko isikhumba asitsalwa kangako. Ukuba izihlangu zincinci kakhulu isiphumo siyaphambana, ngoko shiya indawo.
p-313.principle: Amandla okukhuhlana yi-$F=\mu N$ kwaye uxinzelelo lokusikwa olufunyanwa sisikhumba yi-$\tau=\frac{F}{A}$. Ukuba i-coefficient yokukhuhlana phakathi kwee-layer incinci kuneyakusikhumba-nesokisi, ukushelela kwenzeka phakathi kwee-layer yaye uxinzelelo lwesikhumba luyancipha.
p-313.example: Cinga ukuba xa ulayini unyawo olunye lufumana $N\approx700\ \mathrm{N}$ ize indawo yokunxibelelana yi-$A\approx100\ \mathrm{cm^2}$; kwi-$\mu=0.5$ yi-$\tau\approx35\ \mathrm{kPa}$, kwaye ukuba phakathi kwee-layer yi-$\mu=0.3$, ngoko yi-$\tau\approx21\ \mathrm{kPa}$, ukuncipha okuyi-$40\%$ (amaxabiso aqikelelweyo).
p-313.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba uza kuhamba ixesha elide, nxiba i-layer enye engaphezulu kwesokisi esibhityileyo esifunxa ukubila uze uqinisekise ukuba izihlangu azincinci kakhulu.

p-314.title: Kutheni iifoto zekhephu ziphuma zigreyi zimnyama
p-314.summary: I-auto-exposure yekhamera ilungisa umndilili wesiganeko ukuya kwigreyi ephakathi, ngoko ikhephu elimhlophe lifotwa ligreyi. Ukunyusa i-exposure kwenza ikhephu liphume limhlophe.
p-314.principle: I-auto-exposure ilungisa i-reflectance yomndilili kwigreyi yee-$18\%$. Ukuba i-reflectance yekhephu yi-$\rho$, uhlengahlengiso oluyimfuneko yi-$\Delta\mathrm{EV}=\log_2\frac{\rho}{0.18}$.
p-314.example: Ukuba i-reflectance yekhephu yi-$\rho\approx0.8$, kufunyanwa $\Delta\mathrm{EV}=\log_2\frac{0.8}{0.18}\approx2.1$. Ngoko ngokubanzi kwenziwa uhlengahlengiso lwe-$+1\sim+2\ \mathrm{EV}$.
p-314.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ufota imbonakalo yekhephu, cofa indawo yekhephu kwiscreen uze unyuse isilayida sokukhanya ku-$+1\sim+2$.

p-315.title: Ngeumbrella ekhokelayo khetha eneendlela zomoya
p-315.summary: Xa umoya utyhala ngamandla umphezulu we-umbrella, ukuba ilaphu elingaphezulu linendlela yomoya, umahluko woxinzelelo uyehla ize i-umbrella ingagobi kakhulu. Ungasebenzisi nayiphi i-umbrella emoyeni onamandla.
p-315.principle: Amandla okutsala yi-$F_D=\frac12\rho C_DAv^2$ ngoko angqamene nesikwere sesantya somoya. Ukuba ulwakhiwo olunomoya lunciphisa umahluko woxinzelelo ize i-$C_D$ yehle, amandla ayancipha ngomlinganiselo ofanayo.
p-315.example: Ngesantya somoya $15\ \mathrm{m/s}$, ububanzi $100\ \mathrm{cm}$ ($A\approx0.79\ \mathrm{m^2}$) kunye ne-$C_D=1.2$ kufunyanwa $F_D\approx127\ \mathrm{N}$ (malunga ne-$13\ \mathrm{kgf}$). Ukuba i-$C_D$ iyehla ukuya ku-$0.9$, amandla ayancipha ukuya kuma-$95\ \mathrm{N}$, kwi-$25\%$ ukuncipha (amaxabiso aqikelelweyo).
p-315.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ukhetha i-umbrella, jonga ukuba inemfumba ephindiweyo okanye ulwakhiwo lomoya, nokuba ineempondo zeglasi fibre.

p-316.title: I-heater ye-1kW ifudumeza i-1kW kuphela
p-316.summary: I-heater yombane iguqula phantse yonke ibhatri esetyenzisiweyo ibe bubushushu. Ngoko umbane odingekayo kubushushu obufanayo ufunyanwa ngokuphindaphinda kwamandla obushushu nexesha.
p-316.principle: Ukusebenza kakuhle kokufudumeza ngokuxhathisa yi-$100\%$ ize ukusetyenziswa kwamandla kube yi-$E=Pt$. I-heat pump (ukufudumeza nge-air conditioner) inomlinganiselo wokusebenza $\mathrm{COP}=\frac{Q}{W}$ ongama-3, ngoko ivelisa ubushushu obufanayo ngo-$\frac13$ wombane.
p-316.example: Ukuba i-heater ye-$1\ \mathrm{kW}$ isebenza iiyure ezi-3 yi-$3\ \mathrm{kWh}$; ngexabiso lombane $200$ ngeedola/kWh njengomzekelo, yi-$600$ yeedola (malunga ne-USD 0,45). I-heat pump ene-$\mathrm{COP}=3$ isebenzisa $1\ \mathrm{kWh}$ kubushushu obufanayo, malunga ne-$200$ yeedola.
p-316.actionItem: Namhlanje xa usebenzisa i-heater, jonga amandla ayo (W) uze useta i-timer ukuze isebenze ixesha elifunekayo kuphela.

p-317.title: Ingubo yamadolo ithatha indawo ye-1 ukuya kwi-2°C yokufudumeza
p-317.summary: Ubushushu obuvakalayo bunyuka ngokulingana nokunciphisa kobushushu obushiya umzimba, ngoko ingubo yamadolo enye inika isiphumo sokunyusa ubushushu begumbi nge-1 ukuya kwi-2°C. Unganciphisa ukufudumeza kancinci uhlale uphumle.
p-317.principle: Ukulahleka kobushushu yi-$q=\frac{T_{\mathrm{skin}}-T_{\mathrm{air}}}{R_{\mathrm{clo}}+R_{\mathrm{air}}}$, kwaye kwimisebenzi yokuhlala, impahla ye-$1\ \mathrm{clo}$ ($0.155\ \mathrm{m^2K/W}$) inciphisa ubushushu bokuphumla ngokumalunga ne-$5.5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
p-317.example: Ukuba ingubo yamadolo ingaba yi-$0.3\ \mathrm{clo}$, inciphisa ubushushu bokuphumla ngokumalunga ne-$1.7\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Xa ufudumeza kuncitshiswa nge-$1\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, ukonga kumalunga ne-$7\%$, ngoko ukuya kwi-$1.5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ngumalunga ne-$10\%$.
p-317.actionItem: Namhlanje nciphisa ukuseta kokufudumeza kwigumbi lokuhlala nge-1°C uze ushiye ingubo yamadolo kwisofa.

p-318.title: Iintlantsi ze-foil kwi-microwave zisuka kwiindawo ezibukhali
p-318.summary: Kwimiphetho ebukhali yesinyithi, i-field yombane iyahlangana kwindawo enye, ize umoya ube nomgodi kwaye iintlantsi zibe nokuphuma. Musa ukufaka i-foil, izitya ezinemiphetho yegolide nezihombiso zesinyithi.
p-318.principle: Kwesona sibukhali esinerediyasi encinci yokugoba i-field yombane inyuka njenge-$E\approx\frac{V}{r}$. Umoya ophuka ukuxhathisa malunga ne-$E_b\approx3\ \mathrm{MV/m}$, ngoko i-corona nokukhutshwa kweentlantsi kwenzeka.
p-318.example: Ukuba kucingelwa ukuba irediyasi yomphetho we-foil yi-$r=0.1\ \mathrm{mm}$ kwaye umbane ofumanekayo yi-$V=300\ \mathrm{V}$, kufunyanwa $E=\frac{300}{10^{-4}}=3\ \mathrm{MV/m}$ kwinqanaba lokuphuka kwe-insulation (amaxabiso aqikelelweyo). I-foil enkulu ethe tyaba ayingozi kangako njengesona sibukhali, kodwa isisengozi.
p-318.actionItem: Namhlanje musa ukufaka izikhongozeli zesinyithi, i-foil okanye izitya ezinemiphetho yegolide kwi-microwave. Ukuba kuvela iintlantsi, yeka ngoko nangoko uze ukhuphe xa kubanda.

p-319.title: Kutheni ukuhlala ecaleni kwefestile ebandayo kuvakala kubanda kuneqondo lobushushu begumbi
p-319.summary: Umzimba ulahleka bubushushu ngokukhanya hayi nje kumoya kodwa nakwimiphezulu ebandayo ejikelezileyo. Ecaleni kwefestile umphezulu ubanda, ngoko kuvakala kubanda nangona umoya unobushushu obufanayo.
p-319.principle: Ukulahleka kobushushu okungumthamo ngokukhanya yi-$q=\varepsilon\sigma\left(T_{\mathrm{skin}}^4-T_s^4\right)\approx h_r\left(T_{\mathrm{skin}}-T_s\right)$ kwaye ecaleni kobushushu begumbi $h_r\approx5\ \mathrm{W/(m^2\cdot K)}$.
p-319.example: Ukuba umphezulu wempahla $28\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, umphezulu wefestile $8\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, ngoko $q\approx5\times20=100\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$, kwaye ukuba umphezulu wodonga $18\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, ngoko $50\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$. Ukuba umphezulu ojongene nawe $0.5\ \mathrm{m^2}$, umahluko ngumalunga ne-$25\ \mathrm{W}$ (amaxabiso aqikelelweyo).
p-319.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba ubanda ecaleni kwefestile, shenxisa isitulo kunye nemitha emi-1 kude nefestile okanye ubeke ikhethini okanye ishiti ye-insulation.

p-320.title: Ebusika, beka itende kwithambeka, hayi emsipheleni
p-320.summary: Ebusuku obucacileyo nobungenamoya, umoya obandayo uyatshona uze uqokelele emsipheleni nasezintolongweni. Incopho yentaba inomoya, ngoko indawo ethe tyaba ephakathi kwethambeka eneminya yomoya imhle ngakumbi.
p-320.principle: Umoya obandayo uxinene ngakumbi, ngoko ngokukhawuleza kwe-buoyancy $a\approx g\frac{\Delta T}{T}$ ugungqa uye kwiindawo ezisezantsi wenze echibini lobuqaba. Ngokunyuka kwenqanaba, ubushushu buyehla ngokomndilili nge-$0.65\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}/100\ \mathrm{m}$, kodwa kwi-inversion yasebusuku kuyaphambana.
p-320.example: Kwi-$\Delta T=5\ \mathrm{K}$ ne-$T=278\ \mathrm{K}$ kufunyanwa $a\approx9.8\times\frac{5}{278}\approx0.18\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$. Ebusuku obucacileyo nobungenamoya, umgangatho wesikhephe unokubanda ngokumalunga nama-$^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ambalwa kuneendawo eziphakathi kwethambeka.
p-320.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba uceba ukukampa, hlala ngaphakathi kwekampu ebekiweyo, uphephe iindawo ezingentsunguzi uze ukhethe indawo ethe tyaba eneminya yomoya.

p-321.title: Izifudumezi zombane ze-radiant kunye ne-convective zahlukile
p-321.summary: I-heater ye-radiant ifudumeza ngqo abantu nezinto ize ifudumale ngoko nangoko, ize i-convective ifudumeze umoya ize ifudumeze igumbi lonke kancinci. Khetha ngokwendawo oyisebenzisayo.
p-321.principle: Ukukhanya kudlulisela ubushushu kwimiphezulu ngaphandle komoya ngo-$q=\varepsilon\sigma(T_h^4-T_s^4)A$, ize ukuhamba-moya kudlulise ubushushu ngokujikeleza komoya ofudumeleyo ngo-$q=hA\,\Delta T$.
p-321.example: I-heater ye-radiant ye-1kW ifudumeza isikhumba ngasemva kwe-1m ngoko nangoko, kodwa i-convective idinga $Q=mc\Delta T\approx0.18\ \mathrm{MJ}$ ukufudumeza umoya (malunga ne-36kg) wegumbi le-30m³ nge-5°C, ize ukufudumeza iindonga nefenitshala kuthathe ixesha elide.
p-321.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje uceba ukuthenga i-heater, nquma uluhlu lokusetyenziswa kuqala: i-radiant kwindawo enye efana netafile, i-convective kwigumbi lonke.

p-322.title: Kwimoto yombane ebusika, sebenzisa izihlalo ezifudumezayo endaweni yomoya
p-322.summary: I-heater efudumeza umoya wekhabhini isebenzisa ibhatri enkulu yemoto yombane, ngoko ngokufudumeza ngqo umzimba ngezihlalo ezifudumezayo nesikhokelo nokunciphisa ubushushu bekhabhini, ubude bohambo buyagcinwa.
p-322.principle: Ukufudumeza ngqo ngokuchukumisa umzimba kudinga ubushushu obuncinci kakhulu. Ukufudumeza umoya kudinga $Q=mc\Delta T$ kwaye kufuneka kuqhubeke ukuhlaziywa nobushushu obuphunyayo ngomzimba newindows.
p-322.example: Ukuba endaweni ye-heater yekhabhini ye-3kW usetha ngaphantsi uze usebenzise izihlalo ezifudumezayo ze-60W, kugcinwa malunga ne-1,4kWh ngeyure enye, kwaye kwimoto ye-6km/kWh yimilinganiselo emalunga ne-8km yobude.
p-322.actionItem: Namhlanje xa uqhuba, qala ngokuvula izihlalo ezifudumezayo nesikhokelo uze unciphise ubushushu bekhabhini nge-1 ukuya kwi-2°C.

p-323.title: Ukufudumeza kwasebusika kwimoto kukungcola kwe-engine, ngokwenene simahla
p-323.summary: I-heater yemoto ene-engine yangaphakathi isebenzisa ubushushu obulahlekayo be-engine obuqokelelwe kwi-coolant, ngoko ukuyivula akwandisi kakhulu uxabiso lwepetroli. Esebenzisa ipetroli yi-compressor ye-air conditioning (A/C).
p-323.principle: Malunga ne-60% yamandla epetroli alahleka njengobushushu obulahlekayo ($Q_\mathrm{waste}\approx 0.6\,Q_\mathrm{fuel}$), kwaye i-heater core ibuyisela inxalenye yawo kwigumbi. I-compressor ye-A/C ithatha umsebenzi owongezelelweyo $W$ kwi-engine.
p-323.example: Ubushushu obusetyenziswa yi-heater malunga ne-2 ukuya kwi-4kW yinxalenye nje yobushushu obulahlekayo be-engine ngexesha lohambo, kodwa i-compressor ye-A/C ithatha malunga ne-1 ukuya kwi-3kW ngaphezulu kwamandla e-engine.
p-323.actionItem: Ukuba akukho mfuthe, namhlanje ngexesha lokuqhuba ebusika cima iqhosha le-A/C usebenzise i-heater kuphela.

p-324.title: Ibhotile ye-ketchup ayishukunyiswa, iguqulwa phantsi kwaye ibethwe ngamandla
p-324.summary: I-ketchup ihlala imi ngokungathi iqinile, uze ixhopha ngokukhawuleza xa ifumana amandla. Guqula ibhotile uze uyibethe ngamandla ngaphantsi kube kanye ukunika amandla ngokukhawuleza.
p-324.principle: I-ketchup yinto engeyiyo i-Newtonian ene-shear thinning: xa isantya se-shear $\dot\gamma$ siyanda, i-viscosity ebonakalayo $\eta=\tau/\dot\gamma$ iyehla kwaye ihamba xa idlula uxinzelelo lokuvelisa.
p-324.example: Ekuphumleni i-viscosity ingaphezulu kwe-50Pa·s, kodwa phantsi kwe-shear enamandla inokuncipha amaxesha angamashumi. Isasoloko ishinene kakhulu kunamanzi (malunga ne-0,001Pa·s).
p-324.actionItem: Namhlanje, guqula ibhotile ye-ketchup uze ubethe ngesandla senkqayi ngaphantsi kobunzima bomlomo kube kanye ngamandla.

p-325.title: I-treadmill kufuneka ibe ne-incline ye-1% ukuze ifane nangaphandle
p-325.summary: Kwi-treadmill akukho kuxhathisa komoya, ngoko ngesantya esifanayo kulula kunangaphandle. Ukunyusa i-incline ku-1% lo mahluko uyalungiswa.
p-325.principle: Umsebenzi osetyenziselwa ukuxhathisa umoya uzaliswa ngamandla okubonakalayo e-incline: $P=mgv\sin\theta\approx mgv\times(\text{i-incline})$.
p-325.example: Xa umntu we-70kg ebaleka ngesantya se-10km/h (malunga ne-2,78m/s), i-incline ye-1% inika amandla ongezelelweyo e-$70\times9.81\times2.78\times0.01\approx19\ \mathrm{W}$.
p-325.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba usebenzisa i-treadmill, seta i-incline ku-1% uze ubaleke.

p-326.title: Ukufota ngefestile yebhasi okanye yootreyini, beka ilensi ecaleni kweglasi
p-326.summary: Ukubonakaliswa kwangaphakathi kwekhabhini efestileni kudibana nefoto, kwaye kuyancipha kakhulu ukuba ubeka ilensi ecaleni kweglasi. Kungcono ngakumbi ukuba ugquma ukukhanya okujikelezileyo ngesandla okanye nge-hood.
p-326.principle: Ukubonakaliswa kwiglasi yi-Fresnel reflection, malunga ne-4% kumphezulu ngamnye ($R=\left(\frac{n-1}{n+1}\right)^2,\ n\approx1.5$), kwaye ukuba ilensi ibekwe ecaleni kweglasi, i-angle apho ukukhanya okubonakalisiweyo kungena kwilensi iyancipha.
p-326.example: Imiphezulu emibini yeglasi ibonakalisa malunga ne-4% nganye, ngoko kubonakaliswa malunga ne-8% yokukhanya kwekhabhini kwifestile. Xa kunzima ngaphandle, le nxalenye iyaphawuleka ngakumbi kwifoto.
p-326.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ufota ngefestile, beka ilensi kancinci eglasini uze ugquma ukukhanya okujikelezileyo ngesandla esinye. Kodwa musa ukucinezela ngamandla kwiindawo ezishukumayo kakhulu.

p-327.title: Ii-earphones zihambelana ne-foni ngokwe-impedance (Ω)
p-327.summary: Kwizixhobo ezinombane omncinci wokukhupha, njenge-smartphone, ii-earphones ze-impedance encinci zinika isandi esikhulu. Iimveliso ze-impedance ephezulu zinika amandla amancinci kumbane ofanayo.
p-327.principle: Amandla afunyanwa ii-earphones yi-$P=\frac{V^2}{R}$, ngoko kumbane ofanayo $V$ xa i-impedance $R$ inkulu, i-$P$ iba nciniyo.
p-327.example: Kumbane we-0,5V (ixabiso elisebenzayo) i-earphone ye-16Ω ifumana malunga ne-15,6mW, ize eye-300Ω malunga ne-0,83mW, umahluko omalunga namaxesha ayi-19.
p-327.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga i-impedance kwitheyibhile yeenkcukacha ye-earphones uze ukhethe imveliso ye-16 ukuya kwi-32Ω ukuba uyidibanisa ngqo kwi-foni.

p-328.title: I-1kWh yi-3,6MJ, malunga ne-860kcal
p-328.summary: I-kWh kwi-bhili yombane, i-kcal ekutyeni ne-joule (J) kwisayensi zonke ziiyunithi zamandla kwaye ziguqulwa ngokuchanekileyo.
p-328.example: Ukutya okuyi-2.000kcal ngosuku kuyi-8,4MJ, okanye malunga ne-2,3kWh, ize amandla omndilili abe malunga ne-97W. Nge-1kWh isibane se-100W sinokukhanya iiyure ezili-10.
p-328.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga ukusetyenziswa kwenyanga yale (kWh) kwi-bhili yombane okanye kwi-app.

p-329.title: Ngasinye isihlandla sokuvula umnyango we-oven, ubushushu buyehla nge-25°C
p-329.summary: Xa uvula umnyango we-oven kube kanye, umoya oshushu uyaphuma ize umoya obandayo ungene, ubushushu bangaphakathi buyehla kakhulu kwaye kufuneka amandla ukuwabuyisela.
p-329.principle: Xa uvula umnyango, umoya utshintshiselana ngokuhamba-moya ngenxa yomahluko wobushushu, kwaye ukubuyisela kufuna ubushushu $Q=C\Delta T$ ubuyiswe. Iindonga zigcina ubushushu, ngoko ukwehla kwahluka phakathi kwee-oven.
p-329.example: Kwaziwa ukuba i-oven ye-180°C xa ivulwa kube kanye iyehla malunga ne-20 ukuya kwi-30°C kwaye ukubuyisela kuthatha imizuzu embalwa. Ixesha lokupheka liyanda nombane uyanda.
p-329.actionItem: Namhlanje ngexesha lokupheka kwi-oven, musa ukuvula umnyango, jonga imeko ngeglasi nokukhanya kwe-oven.

p-330.title: Iqanda eliluhlaza neliphekiweyo lahlulwa ngokujikeleza
p-330.summary: Xa ujikelezisa iqanda etafileni, iqanda eliphekiweyo ljikeleza ngokugudileyo ixesha elide, ize eliluhlaza lishukume lize lime ngokukhawuleza.
p-330.principle: Iqanda eliphekiweyo yinto enye eqinileyo ize ijikeleze ngokulinganayo ngo-$L=I\omega$. Kwiqanda eliluhlaza, ulwelo olungaphakathi lushukuma ngokwahlukileyo kwigobolondo, amandla ayasasazeka, ize nokuba limile, ulwelo luqhubeka lujikeleza ize iqanda libuye lijikeleze kancinci.
p-330.example: Xa kujikelezwa iqanda elinobunzima obumalunga ne-60g, eliphekiweyo lijikeleza ngokuzinzileyo imizuzwana embalwa, ize eliluhlaza limise kwangaphambili ngokucacileyo. Xa lixhaswa ngesandla ixesha elifutshane uze ulikhuphe, ngeliluhlaza kuphela elibuyela kujikeleza kancinci.
p-330.actionItem: Namhlanje jikelezisa amaqanda amabini avela kwifriji etafileni uze ujonge elijikeleza ngokugudileyo.

p-331.title: Khohlela esandleni sengubo okanye ngasekhonkxeni, amathontsi aya kuthi ukuya kwimitha embalwa
p-331.summary: Ukukhohlela nokuthimla kwenza umoya ohamba ngokukhawuleza othumela amathontsi ukuya kwimitha embalwa. Ukugquma ngaphakathi kwekhonkxeni okanye isandla sengubo kunciphisa kakhulu umgama wokusasazeka.
p-331.principle: Ukugalela okuvela emlonyeni kunamandla okushukuma $p=mv$, kusasazeka phambili, isantya siyehla kancinci kwaye kusasazeke emoyeni.
p-331.example: Isantya sokuqala somoya wokukhohlela sibikwa ukuba singamalunga ne-10m/s, ize amasuntswana amancinci enokubhabha emoyeni abe nefuthe ukuya kwimitha embalwa.
p-331.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba ukhohlela, gquma umlomo nempumlo ngaphakathi kwekhonkxeni okanye ngesandla sengubo, hayi ngesandla.

p-332.title: Khetha umbala wegogo yokucima ngokwemozulu
p-332.summary: Ngezinsuku ezicacileyo khetha ilensi emnyama ukunciphisa ukukhanya okubuhlungu, ize ngezinsuku ezinamafu okanye zekhephu khetha ilensi etyheli okanye orenji ukubonisa umahluko wokugquma.
p-332.principle: Iilensi zinomlinganiselo ohlukileyo wokudlulisa ngobude bamaza ohlukeneyo, ize ukukhanya kwehlwa kumiselwe yi-transmittance yokukhanya okubonakalayo $\mathrm{VLT}=I/I_0$. Etyheli norenji zihluza ukukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka zandise umahluko ngezinsuku ezinamafu.
p-332.example: Ngezinsuku ezicacileyo, ukhetho oluqhelekileyo lweelensi ezimnyama eziqhelekileyo zegreyi okanye emirror ezine-VLT ye-10 ukuya kwi-20%, ngezinsuku ezinamafu iilensi zetyheli okanye ezirose ezine-VLT ye-40 ukuya kwi-60%.
p-332.actionItem: Namhlanje xa uqaphela amagogo okucima, jonga ukuqikelela kwemozulu uze unqume umbala wewelensi (okanye ilensi yokutshintshana).

p-333.title: Hlala ubeka isipikha ubuncinci kwi-20cm ukusuka eludongeni
p-333.summary: Xa uzisondeza ngokuthe ngqo eludongeni isipikha, i-bass iyanda, amanothi athile ayanyamalala, ize isandi sibe buthathaka nesingacaci.
p-333.principle: Kufutshane nodonga, umphumo womda unyusa i-bass (malunga ne-3 ukuya kwi-6dB), kwaye kwi-frequency $f=\frac{c}{4d}$ apho isandi esibonakaliswe sisuka eludongeni singakwisigaba esichaseneyo nesandi ngqo, isandi siyancipha.
p-333.example: Kumgama we-20cm ukusuka eludongeni, kuncipha malunga ne-$f=\frac{343}{4\times0.2}\approx430\ \mathrm{Hz}$, ize kwi-50cm kuncipha malunga ne-170Hz, ngoko uluhlu lwe-bass luyatshintsha. Kuxhomekeke kwimeko yegumbi.
p-333.actionItem: Namhlanje shenxisa isipikha ubuncinci kwi-20cm ukusuka eludongeni uze uphinde umamele iculo elifanayo.

p-334.title: I-inverter yemoto inamandla amakhulu e-12V
p-334.summary: Ukuba kwimoto udibanisa isixhobo esinamandla amakhulu njenge-laptop charger kwi-inverter, ikhaya le-12V linamandla amakhulu kakhulu ize i-fuse yesokethi inokutshiswa.
p-334.principle: Amandla yi-$P=VI$, ngoko ngamandla afanayo xa umbane uphantsi, amandla $I=P/V$ makhulu.
p-334.example: Isixhobo se-150W ngokwethiyori sidinga i-$150/12=12.5\ \mathrm{A}$, kwaye ngokuthatha ukusebenza kwe-inverter ye-90% yi-13,9A malunga, esondele kumda we-fuse yesokethi eqhelekileyo ye-10 ukuya kwi-15A.
p-334.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga amandla e-fuse yesokethi yemoto (A) uze wahlule amandla esixhobo osidibanisayo nge-12V.

p-335.title: Amandla okufudumeza i-oven yimali emisiweyo, kungcono ukupheka konke kunye
p-335.summary: Amandla adingekayo ukufudumeza i-oven ngamaxesha onke olivulayo ayafana nokuba uphekwa kangakanani. Ukuba upheka izinto ezininzi kunye, ukufudumeza kuncipha.
p-335.principle: Ubushushu bokufudumeza bumiselwa ngumthamo wobushushu we-oven nokunyuka kobushushu: $Q=C_\mathrm{oven}\Delta T$. Akubalulekanga ngobuninzi bokutya.
p-335.example: Ukufudumeza i-oven yombane ukuya kwi-180°C kudinga malunga ne-0,3 ukuya kwi-0,4kWh, kwaye ukuba upheka kunye endaweni yokuphinda kabini, unganceda malunga ne-70 won (malunga ne-0,05 yeedola).
p-335.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba usebenzisa i-oven, qokelela konke okufuneka kuphekwe uze upheke kunye kumanqanaba amabini.

p-336.title: Fumana i-stud edongeni ngokukhwaza
p-336.summary: Xa ukhwaza udonga lwe-drywall ngomnwe, iindawo ezingenanto zivakala zinesandi esiphantsi esivakalayo, ize ngaphezu kwe-stud (isakhelo) isandi siqinile siphezulu.
p-336.principle: Umphezulu okhwaziweyo uyashukuma unike i-frequency ye-resonance $f\propto\sqrt{k/m}$, kwaye ngaphezu kwesakhelo ukuqina $k$ kukhulu, ngoko isandi siphezulu nesifutshane.
p-336.example: Ii-studs zihlala zihlukene nge-400 ukuya kwi-600mm, ngoko ukuba ukhwaza uhamba ecaleni kodonga malunga ne-10cm, iindawo apho isandi sitshintsha zivela rhoqo.
p-336.actionItem: Namhlanje ngaphambi kokubethelela isikhonkwane, khwaza udonga ufumane i-stud, uze ujonge ukuba kuhamba ucingo okanye umbhobho.

p-337.title: Ndiyakwazi ukuhlala kwi-sauna ye-80°C, kodwa hayi emanzini e-80°C
p-337.summary: Umoya awudluliseli bushushu kakuhle, ngoko sinokunyamezela i-sauna ye-80°C, kodwa kumanzi abushushu obufanayo siyatshiswa ngoko nangoko.
p-337.principle: Ubushushu obuya esikhumbeni bungqamene ne-thermal conductivity nomthamo wobushushu. I-thermal conductivity yamanzi imalunga ne-$0.6\ \mathrm{W/m\,K}$, malunga namaxesha angama-25 kuneyomoya ($0.026$), kwaye umthamo wobushushu ngevolumu nawo mkhulu kakhulu.
p-337.example: Amanzi ane-thermal conductivity emalunga namaxesha angama-25 kuneyomoya, nomthamo wobushushu ngevolumu emalunga namaxesha angama-3.500, ngoko amanzi angaphezulu kwe-60°C anokubangela ukutsha ngemizuzwana embalwa.
p-337.actionItem: Namhlanje phambi kokuhlamba okanye ukuhlamba, jonga ubushushu bamanzi kuqala ngengalo yangaphakathi.

p-338.title: Umkhenkce kwichibi elikhenkcezileyo ukhuselekile kuphela xa ungu-10cm okanye ngaphezulu
p-338.summary: Amandla omkhenkce okuthwala umthwalo anda ngokungqamene nesikwere sobukhulu, kodwa umkhenkce obhityileyo uyingozi. Jonga ubukhulu ulandele isikhokelo selali.
p-338.principle: Isakhono sokuxhasa se-ice plate yi-$P\propto h^2$, ngoko ukuba ubukhulu $h$ buphindwe kabini, ixhasa malunga namaxesha angama-4.
p-338.example: Ngokubanzi, i-5cm ixhasa umntu omnye ohamba ngenyameko, kwaye i-10cm okanye ngaphezulu ikhuselekile ebantwini abaninzi, kwaye xa ubukhulu bunyuka ukusuka kwi-5cm ukuya kwi-10cm, amandla okuxhasa angama-4 amaxesha.
p-338.actionItem: Namhlanje ngaphambi kokuya emkhenkceni, jonga uluhlu lwelali nobukhulu bomkhenkce kuqala, kwaye ukuba uyathandabuza, musa ukuphuma.

p-339.title: Iilambu zijongwa ngee-lumens, ixesha lokuhlala ngee-Wh
p-339.summary: Thelekisa ukukhanya kwelambu nge-lumens (lm), nexesha lokukhanya ngomthamo webhetri (Wh) ohlulwe ngamandla asetyenziswayo.
p-339.principle: Ukusebenza kakuhle yi-$\eta=\mathrm{lm}/\mathrm{W}$ ize ixesha lokusebenzisa libe yi-$t=\frac{E}{P}$.
p-339.example: Ukuba i-300 lm inikwa ngokusebenza kwe-100 lm/W, yi-3W. Ibhetri ye-3,7V 5.000 mAh (malunga ne-18,5Wh) ngokwethiyori ikhanya malunga neeyure ezi-6.
p-339.actionItem: Namhlanje kwiinkcukacha zelambu jonga i-lumens ne-Wh yebhetri (okanye i-mAh×V) uze ubale ixesha lokusebenzisa.

p-340.title: Imini apho ilanga litshona kwangoko akulontsasa yasebusika
p-340.summary: Ilanga litshona kwangoko ekuqaleni kukaDisemba, malunga neeveki ezimbini phambi kwesolstice sasebusika (malunga nowama-21 kuDisemba), xa imini ibhityile. Ngokuchaseneyo, lingaphuma kade kakhulu ekuqaleni kukaJanuwari.
p-340.principle: Umzuzu apho ilanga likwindawo yasemazantsi uhlengahlengiswa ngexabiso le-equation of time $E$, ngoko ii-extremes zexesha lokutshona nokuphuma zahlukile kwisolstice.
p-340.example: ESeoul ilanga litshona kwangoko ekuqaleni kukaDisemba malunga ne-17:16 ize malunga nesolstice libe malunga ne-17:20, malunga nemizuzu emi-4 kamva, kodwa ubude bemini bubufutshane kwisolstice.
p-340.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga ixesha lokutshona kwelanga uze ubone ukuba ngexesha lomhla wokuphakathi kukaDisemba ixesha lokutshona liba kamva kwakhona.

p-341.title: Isikali sasekhitshini sinciphisa ukulahlwa kwezithako kunokukala ngekomityi
p-341.summary: Umgubo ohlanjiweyo ngekomityi uyahluka kakhulu ngobuninzi ngokwendlela ecinezelwe, kodwa isikali sikala ngokuchanekileyo nge-g sinciphise ukulahla izithako.
p-341.principle: Ubunzima bu-$m=\rho V$ kodwa kwi-powder ukuxinana $\rho$ kutshintsha ngaphezulu kwe-20% ngokwendlela ecinezelwe, ngoko nangomthamo ofanayo ubunzima buyahluka.
p-341.example: Ikomityi enye yomgubo (malunga ne-240mL) iyi-100 ukuya kwi-150g ngokwendlela yokuthatha, umahluko ophantse ube yi-50%, ngoko intlama iba nzima okanye ibe lilanga ngaphezulu.
p-341.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba wenza isonka okanye ibhiskithi, linganisa izithako ngesikali nge-g endaweni yekomityi.

p-342.title: I-foni kwindebe yeglasi yenza isandi sikhule
p-342.summary: Ukuba ubeka i-foni kwindebe yeglasi engenanto, isandi siyaqokelelana siye phambili siyivuthuze ngaphakathi ngoko sivakala sikhulu ngakumbi. Isiphumo yi-dB embalwa.
p-342.principle: Umbhobho ovaliweyo kwesinye isiphelo uyavuthuza malunga ne-$f=\frac{c}{4L}$, kwaye indebe iqokelela isandi kwicala elinye inyusa i-directionality.
p-342.example: Kwindebe enobunzulu be-10cm, ixhaphake malunga ne-$f=\frac{343}{4\times0.1}\approx860\ \mathrm{Hz}$, kwaye inokukhula nge-3 ukuya kwi-6dB (amandla esandi aphindwe kabini ukuya kwamane), kuxhomekeke kwimveliso.
p-342.actionItem: Namhlanje faka i-foni kwindebe ngecala lesipikha ngaphakathi uze uthelekise ivolumu yesandi.

p-343.title: Ukutsha kobushushu obuphantsi kwenzeka nge-44°C emva kweeyure ezimbalwa
p-343.summary: Nabo ubushushu obungashushu kakhulu, njengebhlanki yombane okanye i-hot pack, xa buchukumisa indawo enye ixesha elide, buyonakalisa isikhumba nzulu. Intlungu incinci, ngoko kulula ukungabi nankathalo.
p-343.principle: Ukonakala kwesikhumba kwenzeka ngokuqhuba ubushushu ngokuchukumisa apho ubushushu nexesha lokuvezwa kuqokelelana, ngoko nangobushushu obuphantsi ixesha elide libangela ukonakala okukhulu.
p-343.example: Kwaziwa ukuba ukuchukumisa malunga ne-44°C iiyure ezingaphezu kwezi-6 kunokubangela ukutsha, kwaye i-hot packs ezikufutshane ne-60°C ziyingozi ngexesha elifutshane kakhulu.
p-343.actionItem: Namhlanje ungazibeki iihot packs nebhlanki yombane ngqo esikhumbeni, zibeke phezu kwempahla okanye ilaphu uze uzicime phambi kokuba ulale.

p-344.title: Iziyaluka zomkhenkce zenzeka kakhulu kwi-slope ye-30 ukuya kwi-45°
p-344.summary: Iziyaluka zenzeka kakhulu kwithambeka elineqhwa lisondeleyo xa i-slope iphakathi kwama-30 nama-45°. Ukuba ithe tyaba kakhulu ikhephu liyahlala, ize ukuba ithe nkqo kakhulu likhephu lithuthuzele ngaphambi kokuqokelelana.
p-344.principle: Xa uxinzelelo lwe-shear $\tau=\rho g h\sin\theta\cos\theta$ ezantsi kwe-layer yekhephu lugqitha ukuxhathisa kokukhuhlana, kuyashelela, kwaye ngokukhula kwe-slope $\theta$, $\tau$ ikhula yaye ibe ngaphezulu malunga ne-45°.
p-344.example: Ukuba ikhephu elinokuxinana kwe-300kg/m³ nobukhulu be-1m lisethambekeni le-38°, kufunyanwa $\tau\approx300\times9.81\times1\times0.485\approx1.4\ \mathrm{kPa}$, kwaye ukuba eli xabiso lingaphezu kwamandla e-layer yekhephu, kwenzeka iziyaluka.
p-344.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje uya kwiintaba ezinekhephu, ngaphambi kokuhamba jonga uqikelelo lweziyaluka ne-slope yethambeka, uphephe amathambeka angaphezulu kwe-30°.

p-345.title: Ngetripod elula, beka isinqunu
p-345.summary: I-tripod elula iwa lula ngomoya. Ukuba ubeka umthwalo njengebhegi esiphakathini ngaphantsi uphulukanisa isikhungo sobunzima, iba nzinzile kakhulu.
p-345.principle: I-tripod iyawa xa amandla angaphezulu kwe-restoring moment $mgr$ ebekwe kwi-height $h$ ejikeleze umphetho wonyawo. Amandla adingekayo ukuyiwisa yi-$F=\frac{mgr}{h}$, ngoko xa isikhungo sobunzima siphantsi, adinga amandla amakhulu.
p-345.example: Ukuba kwi-tripod ye-1,5kg (isikhungo sobunzima 1,2m, irediyasi yonyawo 0,4m) uxhoma ibhegi ye-3kg kwi-height ye-0,3m, isikhungo sobunzima siyehla ukuya kwi-0,6m, ize amandla adingekayo ukuyiwisa anyuke ukusuka kwi-4,9N ukuya kwi-14,7N, malunga namaxesha angama-3.
p-345.actionItem: Namhlanje xa usebenzisa itripod, xhoma ibhegi kwi-hook engaphantsi kwekholamu emaphakathi yehle isondele kodwa ingachukumisi umhlaba.

p-346.title: Umntu omnye uyi-heater ye-100W
p-346.summary: Umntu naxa ephumle uvelisa ubushushu obumalunga ne-100W, ngoko igumbi elinabantu abaninzi lifudumala ngokukhawuleza ngaphandle kokufudumeza.
p-346.principle: Amandla okutya anokuphela angumthombo wobushushu, kwaye i-metabolism ye-basal imalunga ne-$P=E/t\approx80\text{-}120\ \mathrm{W}$.
p-346.example: Ukutya okuyi-2.000kcal ngosuku kuyi-$\frac{8.37\ \mathrm{MJ}}{86400\ \mathrm{s}}\approx97\ \mathrm{W}$. Igumbi elinabantu abangama-20 livelisa malunga ne-2kW, elilingana ne-heater encinci yombane enye.
p-346.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje unendibano yabantu, nciphisa ukuseta kokufudumeza nge-1 ukuya kwi-2°C.

p-347.title: Cima uqala ugcine isiseko sepani esimanzi phambi kokuyibeka emlilweni
p-347.summary: Amanzi asezantsi kwepani avuka emlilweni aphume ubushushu obuninzi, ephazamisa ixesha negesi, ize amathontsi athi shwaka abe yingozi.
p-347.principle: Xa amanzi evuka kudingeka ubushushu obufihlakeleyo $Q=mL$, kwaye ubushushu bokuvuka kwamanzi yi-$L\approx2.26\ \mathrm{kJ/g}$.
p-347.example: Ukuba kukho i-10g yamanzi ezantsi, kudingeka $Q=10\times2.26=22.6\ \mathrm{kJ}$, kwaye kwamandla asebenzayo e-2kW ngamanzi obushushu emalunga nemizuzwana eyi-11.
p-347.actionItem: Namhlanje phambi kokubeka ipani emlilweni, cima amanzi esiseleni ngelaphu.

p-348.title: Kutheni xa isibane esinye sityatyazile intambo yonke icima
p-348.summary: Kwiintambo ezinezibane ezidityanisiweyo ngokuzilandelanayo, ukuba enye iyaphuka umbane awusenandlela yokuhamba, ngoko yonke icima.
p-348.principle: Umbane kwiseriyes ofana kuzo zonke iindawo kwaye yi-$I=\frac{V}{R_1+R_2+\cdots}$. Ukuba kuphukile kwindawo enye, ukuxhathisa kuba yinkcazelo nje ize $I=0$.
p-348.example: Ukuba kudityaniswe izibane ezingama-50 ezi-2,4V ngokuzilandelanayo, zahlulahlula malunga ne-120V. Ukuba enye iyasuswa, umbane kwezi-49 eziseleyo uba yi-0.
p-348.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba intambo yezibane icima, khupha i-plug uze ucinezele isibane esixegayo okanye utshintshe ngesinye esikhoyo.

p-349.title: Kutheni ukuphefumla ‘ha’ nokuphefumla ‘hu’ kunobushushu obahlukileyo
p-349.summary: ‘Ha’ ephefumlelwa ngomlomo ovulekileyo kuvakala kufudumele, ‘hu’ ephefumlelwa ngolomo lutyibileyo kuvakala kubandayo.
p-349.principle: Xa uqinisa umlomo, kwenziwa ijethi ekhawulezayo etsala umoya osondeleyo (ukuxuba). Ubushushu bomxube buyehla ngo-$T=\frac{m_1T_1+m_2T_2}{m_1+m_2}$, kwaye kongezwa kancinci ukupholisa ngokwandiswa.
p-349.example: Ukuba ukuphefumla okumalunga ne-34°C kuxutywe 1:1 nomoya wegumbi we-20°C, kufunyanwa malunga ne-27°C, ngoko umoya ofikayo esandleni uvakala ubanda ngakumbi ngamalunga ne-7°C.
p-349.actionItem: Namhlanje phefumla ‘ha’ nokuphefumla ‘hu’ ngokutshintshana ngasemva kwesandla uze uvakalise umahluko wobushushu.

p-350.title: Isantya se-sled sixhomekeke kuphela kubude
p-350.summary: Ngaphandle kokukhuhlana, isantya se-sled esiphantsi sixhomekeke kuphela kubude bokuhla kwaye alixhomekekanga kubunzima. Ngokwenyani kuhamba kancinci ngenxa yokukhuhlana nokuxhathisa komoya.
p-350.principle: Amandla okubonakaliswa aguquka abe ngamandla okushukuma, ngoko ukusuka ku-$mgh=\frac12mv^2$ kufunyanwa $v=\sqrt{2gh}$.
p-350.example: Kubude be-5m kufunyanwa $v=\sqrt{2\times9.81\times5}\approx9.9\ \mathrm{m/s}$, okanye malunga ne-36km/h, kwaye isantya sokwenyani siphantsi kunoko.
p-350.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje uhla nge-sled, khetha indawo ethambileyo engenazithintelo ize unxibe i-helmet.

p-351.title: Kwimatrasi, lala imizuzu eli-10 uze ujonge isithuba esiqongeni
p-351.summary: Xa uthenga imatrasi, lala imizuzu eli-10 uze ujonge ukuba intende yesandla ingena lula phakathi kweqolo nematrasi. Ukuba isithuba sikhulu, iqolo liyalengisa ize uxinzelelo luqokelelane.
p-351.principle: Uxinzelelo lu-$P=\frac{F}{A}$, kwaye luyancipha xa indawo yenkxaso $A$ inkulu. Imatrasi isasaza umthwalo nge-spring constant $k$ ne-layers.
p-351.example: Ukuba ubunzima bomzimba we-70kg (malunga ne-686N) bubekwe kuphela kwi-0,1m², malunga ne-6,9kPa, kwaye ukuba busasazwe kwi-0,3m², malunga ne-2,3kPa, ingena-thathu.
p-351.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ukhetha imatrasi, lala nangaphandle emacaleni imizuzu eli-10 uze uqinisekise ukuba amagxa, ibunzi nesinqe zixhaswe ngokulinganayo.

p-352.title: I-fan ephezu kwesitovu isebenza ngaphandle kombane
p-352.summary: I-fan ebekwe phezu kwesitovu ijikeleza ngobushushu besitovu kuphela, ngaphandle kwentambo nebhetri, yasasaza ubushushu egumbini.
p-352.principle: Ngokwempembelelo ye-Seebeck umahluko wobushushu $\Delta T$ phakathi kweendawo ezimbini zokudibana wenza umbane $V=S\Delta T$, kwaye lo mbane ujikelezisa i-motor.
p-352.example: Ngemodyuli ye-thermoelectric ene-Seebeck coefficient emalunga ne-0,05V/K, kumahluko wobushushu we-100K kuvela umbane ovulekileyo wemalunga ne-5V, ize imveliso ibe yi-W embalwa okanye ngaphantsi.
p-352.actionItem: Namhlanje beka i-fan ephezu kwesitovu kwindawo ngaphakathi kobushushu obuvunyelweyo obubhalwe kwimveliso, uze uyigcine kude nabantwana.

p-353.title: I-heater yetealight nesitya sentyatyambo ayikwazi ukufudumeza igumbi
p-353.summary: I-heater eyenziwe ngeetealights ezimbalwa nesitya sentyatyambo ayinikezeli ubushushu obaneleyo ukufudumeza igumbi, kwaye yongeza nje umngcipheko womlilo ne-carbon monoxide.
p-353.principle: Ikhandlela livelisa ubushushu kuphela obulingana ne-calorific value yamafutha $P=\dot m\,\Delta H$, kwaye itealight enye ivelisa malunga ne-40W.
p-353.example: Itealight enye itshisa malunga ne-14g yoboya (malunga ne-0,6MJ) kwiiyure ezi-4 ize ivelise malunga ne-40W, kwaye ezi-4 zivelisa malunga ne-160W, ngamaphesenti ambalwa nje ye-1 ukuya kwi-3kW edingekayo ukufudumeza igumbi.
p-353.actionItem: Namhlanje endaweni ye-heater yesitya sentyatyambo, vala imiqathango yefestile ukunciphisa ukuvuza kobushushu.

p-354.title: Isitoper se-champagne siyaphuma ngesantya se-50km/h
p-354.summary: Ngaphakathi kwebhotile ye-champagne kukho uxinzelelo olumalunga ne-6 atmospheres, ngoko ukuba isitoper sikhululwe, siphuma ngesantya esimalunga ne-50km/h kwaye sinokonzakalisa iliso.
p-354.principle: Umahluko woxinzelelo ukhawulezisa isitoper ngamandla $F=\Delta P\cdot A$, kwaye umsebenzi owenziwa yigesi ngexesha lokwanda uba ngamandla okushukuma $\frac12mv^2$.
p-354.example: Kumahluko woxinzelelo we-5bar malunga, ngokuqukumbela kwesitoper malunga ne-$2.5\times10^{-4}\ \mathrm{m^2}$ kufunyanwa $F\approx127\ \mathrm{N}$, kwaye ukuba isitoper siphuma ngesantya esimalunga ne-14m/s (50km/h), amandla okushukuma angamalunga ne-0,9J.
p-354.actionItem: Namhlanje xa uvula i-champagne, tsalela ibhotile malunga ne-45°, cinezela isitoper ngesithupha uze uyijikeleze ibhotile kancinci, ungayijongisi ebantwini.

p-355.title: Ingxolo emhlophe ngexesha lokulala igquma izandi ezingalindelekanga
p-355.summary: Ingxolo emhlophe ethambileyo iyancitshiswa umahluko phakathi kwesandi esingalindelekanga nesandi sangasemva, ngoko inokunceda ukuba ungavuki ngokukhawuleza. Isiphumo sahluka ngomntu nomntu.
p-355.principle: Ukugquma kokuviwa: ingxolo ebanzi inyusa umda wokuviwa kwezinye izandi. Umahluko wesandi uchazwa ngo-$\Delta L=L_\mathrm{sound}-L_\mathrm{bg}$.
p-355.example: Kwingxolo yangasemva ye-30dB, isandi sokuvala umnyango se-70dB singumahluko we-40dB, kodwa ngengxolo emhlophe ye-45dB umahluko uyancipha ube yi-25dB ize ingaphazamisi kangako.
p-355.actionItem: Namhlanje ebusuku dlala ingxolo emhlophe ngevolumu encinci malunga ne-40dB esiseleni ngetaymari, uze uyigcine kude nendlebe yosana.

p-356.title: Ii-crampons ziyabambelela ngokwesimiso emkhenkceni
p-356.summary: Ii-crampons azandisi kukhuhlana, kodwa iinzipho ezibukhali ezixhonywe emkhenkceni zibambelela ngokwasemzimbeni zithintele ukushelela.
p-356.principle: Isihlangu emkhenkceni sinomda wokushelela $\tan\theta=\mu$ one-friction coefficient $\mu$ encinci kakhulu, kodwa iikhonkxo ezibukhali ziyabambelela zisebenzisa ukuxhathisa kwe-shear yomkhenkce.
p-356.example: Ukukhuhlana okungatshintshiyo kwesihlangu esiqhelekileyo nomkhenkce kumalunga ne-0,1, ngoko kuqala ukushelela nge-5,7° ($\tan^{-1}0.1$) kuphela, kodwa iinzipho ze-crampons zinokubamba nasethambekeni lomkhenkce eliphezulu ngakumbi.
p-356.actionItem: Namhlanje phambi kokunyuka ntaba, jonga ukuba iinzipho ze-crampons azigugile kwaye amabhanti anqandwe ngokwaneleyo.

p-357.title: Khetha i-laser pointer ene-1mW okanye ngaphantsi
p-357.summary: I-laser pointer ekhuselekileyo kwamehlo yi-Class 2 ene-1mW okanye ngaphantsi. Xa amandla ephezulu, nokuvala amehlo ngokuzenzekela akuvikeli ngokwaneleyo.
p-357.principle: Ukuvalwa kweliso ngokuzenzekela kumalunga ne-0,25 s kwaye amandla angena eliso yi-$E=P\,t$. Xa ububanzi bomsebe buncinci, ukukhanya $I=P/A$ kuphezulu.
p-357.example: I-1mW kwi-0,25 s yi-$E=0.25\ \mathrm{mJ}$. Umsebe wobubanzi be-3mm unika $I=1\ \mathrm{mW}/7.1\times10^{-6}\ \mathrm{m^2}\approx140\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$. Iimveliso ezizijezi ngamanye amaxesha zinamandla aphezulu kunalawo abhaliweyo.
p-357.actionItem: Namhlanje kwi-laser pointer jonga uphawu ‘Class 2, 1mW okanye ngaphantsi’ uze ungajongisi ebantwini, ezilwaneni nasemotweni.

p-358.title: Isitovu seenkuni okanye ilitye lamalahle ludla kakuhle xa ityhimini iphakame
p-358.summary: Xa ityhimini iphakame ize umoya ngaphakathi ushushu, amandla okutsala phezulu (draught) ayanda, umlilo uthi gqi ize intuthu iphume kakuhle.
p-358.principle: Ngenxa yempembelelo yetyhimini uxinzelelo lwe-draught yi-$\Delta P=gh(\rho_\mathrm{out}-\rho_\mathrm{in})$ kwaye ngqamene nobude $h$ nomahluko wokuxinana.
p-358.example: Kubude be-5m, umoya wangaphandle we-0°C (1,29kg/m³) nomoya wokukhupha we-200°C (malunga ne-0,75kg/m³) kufunyanwa $\Delta P\approx9.81\times5\times0.54\approx27\ \mathrm{Pa}$.
p-358.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje usebenzisa isitovu, jonga iindawo zokudibana zombhobho wetyhimini uze ujonge ibhetri ye-carbon monoxide alarm.

p-359.title: Nangaphantsi kwe-zero, impahla yokuhlamba iyoma ikhenkcezile
p-359.summary: Impahla ebekwe ngaphantsi kwe-zero iyakhenkceza, kodwa iyoma kancinci nge-sublimation, apho umkhenkce uba ngumphunga ngaphandle kokuphuma kulwelo. Akukho mfuneko yomatshini wokomisa.
p-359.principle: Ukuba umkhenkce uba yigesi ngqo $\mathrm{H_2O(s)\rightarrow H_2O(g)}$ kudingeka $L_s\approx2.83\ \mathrm{kJ/g}$, kwaye ngokukhawuleza xa kumile nomoya.
p-359.example: Ukuba i-1kg yamanzi ibe ngumphunga ngokwe-sublimation kudingeka malunga ne-2,83MJ. Nangona kuthatha ixesha elide kunomjikelo omnye womatshini wokomisa (malunga ne-2 ukuya kwi-3kWh), akusetyenziswa mbane.
p-359.actionItem: Namhlanje ngosuku olucacileyo nolomileyo olungaphantsi kwe-zero, xhoma impahla uze uyiqhwabe, uyigqibe ngaphakathi endlini xa isomile.

p-360.title: Susa ikhephu elisophulweni lemoto phambi kokuqhuba
p-360.summary: Ikhephu elisophulweni xa uqhuba lithi lilahleke ngokweengqungquthela lize lihlasele imoto elandelayo okanye ligubungele i-windscreen. Phambi kokuhamba susa ikhephu kophahla, kwi-bonnet nakwiiglasi.
p-360.principle: Ngenxa yesantya sokuqhuba, iqhekeza lekhephu lixhatshazwa ngasemva lize lidibane nemoto elandelayo ngamandla okushukuma $E=\frac12mv^2$.
p-360.example: Ukuba kuphahla lwe-2m² likhona ikhephu elingu-5cm (kucingelwa ukuxinana kwe-100kg/m³), malunga ne-10kg. Xa lidibana ngesantya esinxulumeneyo se-80km/h (22,2m/s), malunga ne-2,5kJ.
p-360.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje ibe nekhephu, phambi kokuqhuba susa ngokupheleleyo ikhephu kophahla, kwi-bonnet nakwiiglasi ngebrashi ethambileyo.

p-361.title: Kutheni sithetha ngokuphakamisa ilizwi kwi-restaurant enengxolo
p-361.summary: Xa ingxolo inyuka, abantu baphakamisa ilizwi ngokungazi, nto ebizwa ngokuba ngumphumo we-Lombard. Ukuba wonke umntu uyayenza, ingxolo iyanda ngakumbi.
p-361.principle: Ngenxa yempembelelo ye-Lombard, ukuxinezeleka kwesandi kunyuka ngengxolo, kwaye ukuze ilizwi livakale kufuneka kugcinwe umlinganiselo wesandi-ngengxolo $\mathrm{SNR}=L_s-L_n$.
p-361.example: Kwaziwa ukuba xa ingxolo inyuka ukusuka kwi-60dB ukuya kwi-80dB, okanye nge-20dB, intetho iba nkulu nge-6 ukuya kwi-10dB. Ii-restaurant ngamanye amaxesha zifikelela kwi-70 ukuya kwi-80dB.
p-361.actionItem: Namhlanje kwindibano, khetha ikona kude nesipikha uze uthambekele kumntu ophambili uthethe ngelizwi eliphantsi.

p-362.title: Ukuphuma kwelanga loNyaka oMtsha kokuqala kwiindawo ezingasempuma
p-362.summary: Ilanga liphuma kuqala empuma. Kwi-latitude efanayo, kwi-longitude nganye ye-1° ngakwimpuma, ukuphuma kwelanga kukhawuleza malunga nemizuzu emi-4.
p-362.principle: Umhlaba ujikeleza $15^\circ$ ngeyure enye, ngoko umahluko we-longitude $1^\circ$ yi-$\frac{60\ \mathrm{min}}{15}=4\ \mathrm{min}$.
p-362.example: I-Homigot kwi-longitude 129,6°E ingaphezulu kweSeoul (127°E) ngama-2,6° empuma, ngoko ukuphuma kwelanga kukhawuleza malunga nemizuzu eli-10, ize umahluko wokwenyani utshintshe kancinci ngokwe-latitude.
p-362.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje uya kubona ukuphuma kwelanga loNyaka oMtsha, jonga kuqala ixesha lokuphuma kwelanga kwindawo oya kuyo.

p-363.title: Iiyunithi zoxinzelelo lwethayi i-bar, i-psi ne-kPa, guqula zonke kunye
p-363.summary: Uxinzelelo lwethayi lubhalwa nge-bar, i-psi, i-kPa, njl. Ukuba ukhumbula ixabiso elinye lokuguqula, unokutshintsha nayiphi na iyunithi.
p-363.example: I-2,3bar yi-230kPa kwaye $2.3\times14.5\approx33\ \mathrm{psi}$. I-35psi yimalunga ne-2,41bar.
p-363.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga itheyibhile yoxinzelelo olucetyiswayo kwifreyimu yomnyango womqhubi uze ujonge ixabiso lokwenyani ngegeji yoxinzelelo lwethayi.

p-364.title: Ukutshaja imoto yombane ekhaya, bala ixesha nge-kWh÷kW
p-364.summary: Ixesha lokutshaja libalwa ngokwahlula amandla afuneka ukuzalisa (kWh) ngamandla e-charger (kW). Ngenxa yokulahleka, ngokwenyani kuthatha ixesha elide kancinci.
p-364.principle: $t=\frac{E}{P}$, kwaye ukuba kukho ukusebenza kakuhle kokutshaja $\eta$ kuba $t=\frac{E}{\eta P}$.
p-364.example: Ukuzalisa ibhetri ye-60kWh ukusuka kwi-10% ukuya kwi-80% yi-$E=42\ \mathrm{kWh}$, kwaye nge-charger ye-7kW (ukusebenza kakuhle 90%) yi-$t=\frac{42}{0.9\times7}\approx6.7$ iiyure.
p-364.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga umthamo webhetri yemoto yakho (kWh) namandla e-charger (kW) uze ubale ixesha lokutshaja.

p-365.title: Xa wenza amanzi ngekhephu, qala ngokufaka ikomityi yamanzi
p-365.summary: Ikhephu linezikhewu zomoya ezininzi ize lingadluliseli bushushu kakuhle, ngoko ukuba ulifaka ngqo epanini engenanto, isiseko sitsha lula. Ukuba ufaka amanzi amancinci kuqala, ukudibana kobushushu kuyaphucula ize inyibilike ngokukhawuleza.
p-365.principle: Ukuqhuba ubushushu kwekhephu kuphantsi kwaye ii-pores zinkulu, ngoko indawo yokudibana nepani incinci. Ukunyibilika kudinga ubushushu bokunyibilika $L_f=334\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$.
p-365.example: Ukwenza amanzi eelitha ezi-1 kudinga malunga ne-334kJ, elingana nobushushu bokunyusa ngamashumi asibhozo ama-°C. Ikhephu liyi-10% kuphela ngevolumu yamanzi, ngoko kuyadingeka malunga ne-10L yekhephu.
p-365.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje kufuneka wenze amanzi ngekhephu, fudumeza kuqala ikomityi yamanzi uze ufake ikhephu elicocekileyo kancinci kancinci (kufuneka ubilise ngaphambi kokusela).

p-366.title: Kwithambeka lekhephu, khawuleza kancinci uze ugcine uqhubeka ungami
p-366.summary: Kwithambeka lekhephu, ukuba uyema kunzima ukuqala kwakhona, ize ukuba ukhawuleza kakhulu amavili ayajikeleza. Phambi kwethambeka shiya umgama uze unyuke ngesantya esingatshintshiyo nangokucothayo.
p-366.principle: Ekubeni ukukhuhlana okumileyo $F\le\mu_sN$ kukhulu kunokukhuhlana okushukumayo $F=\mu_kN$ ($\mu_s>\mu_k$), xa amavili ejikeleza, ukubamba kuyehla ngokukhawuleza.
p-366.example: Kwindlela yekhephu ecinezelweyo ene-$\mu\approx0.2$ kwi-slope ye-10% ($\theta\approx5.7^\circ$) ingxenye yomxhuzulane imalunga ne-$0.1\,mg$ kwaye ukukhuhlana kumalunga ne-$0.2\,mg$, ngoko ukhuseleko lumalunga nje ne-$0.1\,mg$.
p-366.actionItem: Namhlanje phambi kwethambeka lekhephu shiya umgama ofanelekileyo kwimoto engaphambili uze unyuke ngesantya esingatshintshiyo ngaphandle kokuma phakathi.

c-001.title: Isoda yokubhaka nesirkile mazingaxutywa, zisebenzise ngokwahlukeneyo
c-001.summary: Ukuba uzixuba, kuphuma amagwebu kuphela kwaye amandla okucoca ayacinezelana. Kububanzi ukusebenzisa isoda yokubhaka kwigrisi, nesirkile kumanzi aqinileyo.
c-001.principle: I-alkali ebuthathaka ($\mathrm{NaHCO_3}$) ne-asidi ebuthathaka ($\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$) iyayilinganisa ibe sisisombululo se-sodium acetate esiphantse singanyamezeli: $\mathrm{NaHCO_3 + CH_3COOH \to CH_3COONa + H_2O + CO_2\uparrow}$
c-001.example: Ukuba uxuba itispuni enkulu ye-1 yesoda yokubhaka (malunga ne-12g) nekomityi ye-1/2 yesirkile, emva kokuba amagwebu enyamalele i-pH yehla ibe ngaphantsi kwe-8 kwaye ayisazichithi kakuhle igrisi neesikali. Ukuba isetyenziswa ngokwahlukeneyo, ngesixa esifanayo kuphathwa zombini ukungcola.
c-001.actionItem: Namhlanje kwigrisi yesinki sebenzisa umgubo wesoda yokubhaka kuphela, nakwisikali setephu sebenzisa ityhubhu yasekhitshini efakwe isirkile kuphela.

c-002.title: Ungaze usebenzise i-bleach nesicoci esine-asidi kunye
c-002.summary: Ukuba uxuba i-sodium hypochlorite (i-bleach) nesicoci setoyilethi esine-asidi, kuveliswa irhasi ye-chlorine enetyhefu. Sebenzisa enye ngexesha elinye uze uhlambulule kakuhle ngamanzi phakathi.
c-002.principle: Ukudibana ne-asidi kuguqula i-hypochlorite ibe yi-chlorine: $\mathrm{NaOCl + 2HCl \to NaCl + Cl_2\uparrow + H_2O}$
c-002.example: I-chlorine ityhafisa amehlo nomphunga ukususela kwi-3ppm, kwaye kwi-30ppm okanye ngaphezulu ibangela ukukhohlela okubi nobunzima bokuphefumla. Kwigumbi elincinci lokuhlamba, ingqwalasela eyingozi inokufikelelwa kwimizuzu embalwa.
c-002.actionItem: Hlula i-bleach nezicoci ezine-asidi (i-hydrochloric, i-citric) kwishelufu yetoyilethi uzibeke kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo, kwaye ngaphambi kokusebenzisa jonga amagama athi 'ungaxuthi' kwileyibhile.

c-003.title: I-bleach nesicoci seglasi esine-ammonia nayo ayilunganga ukuxuba
c-003.summary: Ukuba uxuba i-bleach nesicoci seglasi esine-ammonia, kuveliswa irhasi enetyhefu ebizwa ngokuba yi-chloramine. Nika umoya uze ungazisebenzisi iimveliso ezimbini ngosuku olunye ngokulandelelana.
c-003.principle: Nge-$\mathrm{NaOCl + NH_3 \to NH_2Cl + NaOH}$ i-chloramine ($\mathrm{NH_2Cl}$) iyenziwa kwaye ityhafisa imigudu yokuphefumla.
c-003.example: Nokuba uxuba isicoci esine-ammonia ezimalunga ne-5% ne-bleach encinci, kwigumbi elivaliweyo ukukhohlela nokutshaya kwamehlo kunokuvela kwimizuzu embalwa. Xa usebenzisa i-bleach kwindawo enomchamo, irhasi enuka kakubi iyenziwa ngomgaqo ofanayo.
c-003.actionItem: Khangela i-'ammonia' kuluhlu lwezithako zesicoci uphawule ukuba ungayisebenzisi ngosuku olunye ne-bleach, kwaye xa ucoca vula ifestile.

c-004.title: Kuhambo khetha isicoci sezandla esine-ethanol engama-60% okanye ngaphezulu
c-004.summary: Apho kungekho manzi, isicoci sezandla se-alcohol silungisa, kodwa ukuba ukuxinana kwe-ethanol kungaphantsi kwe-60%, ukusebenza kuyancipha kakhulu. Ukungena ngenqwelomoya, yahlula kwizikhongozeli ezingama-100mL okanye ngaphantsi.
c-004.principle: I-ethanol idenatura iiproteni zemicro-organisms ize inyibilikise imembrane yelipid. Iyatsha, ngoko impendulo yokutsha $\mathrm{C_2H_5OH + 3O_2 \to 2CO_2 + 3H_2O}$.
c-004.example: Imveliso ye-ethanol engama-60–80% isebenza xa ixutywa malunga nemizuzwana engama-20 ize ishiywe de yome ngokupheleleyo. Ezandleni ezinodaka obubonakalayo, amanzi nesepha kungcono kunesicoci.
c-004.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga ukuxinana kwe-ethanol (%) kwileyibhile yesicoci somkhosi wohambo uze uyahlule kwisikhongozeli esingama-100mL okanye ngaphantsi.

c-005.title: Xa ukhetha isepha, jonga i-pH kwileyibhile
c-005.summary: Izicoci zasekhitshini nezasendlini yokuhlambela zinee-pH ezahlukileyo ngokwesetyenziso. Ukuba ukhetha i-alkaline kwigrisi nenesidi kwiisikali, ngemali efanayo kucoceka ngcono.
c-005.principle: $\mathrm{pH = -\log[H^+]}$ kwaye xa i-pH yehla nge-1 ukuxinana kwe-$\mathrm{H^+}$ kuba kamashumi. Amafutha asaponifayiwa kwi-alkali: $\mathrm{RCOOR' + NaOH \to RCOONa + R'OH}$
c-005.example: Izicoci ze-alkaline ze-pH 11–12 zisebenza kwigrisi nezicoci ze-asidi ze-pH 2–3 kumatye omlambo. Izicoci zokuhlamba izitya ezingathathi cala (pH 6–8) zithambile ezandleni kodwa zithatha ixesha elide kwigrisi enzima.
c-005.actionItem: Kwiintengiso ezizayo jonga uphawu lwe-pH 'nokusetyenziswa' kwileyibhile yesicoci uze uphawule i-pH yezicoci ezi-3 ekhaya.

c-006.title: Ukuhlamba ngamanzi abandayo e-30 ℃ kunciphisa amandla okufudumeza
c-006.summary: Izicoci zanamhlanje zisebenza kakuhle malunga ne-30 ℃, ngoko impahla yemihla ngemihla ayifuni ukunyuselwa ukuya kwi-60 ℃. Njengoko kufudumezwa amanzi amancinci, umbane uncipha ngolo mlinganiselo.
c-006.principle: Ubushushu bokufudumeza amanzi yi-$Q = mc\Delta T$ ($c = 4.18\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$) kwaye ii-enzyme ezophula iiproteni zisebenza kwi-30–40 ℃.
c-006.example: Ukufudumeza i-10L yamanzi ukusuka kwi-15 ℃ ukuya kwi-30 ℃ kufuna malunga ne-627kJ kwaye ukuya kwi-60 ℃ malunga ne-1,881kJ, amaxesha ama-3. Ukuba ihlanjwa kane evekini, impembelelo yokonga yenyuka kumaxesha angaphezu kwama-200 ngonyaka.
c-006.actionItem: Namhlanje setha ubushushu bomatshini wokuhlamba kwi-30 ℃ (okanye amanzi abandayo) uze unyuse kuphela ukuya kwi-40 ℃ kwimpahla enokubila okuninzi.

c-007.title: Susa isikali setephu yekettle yombane ngecephe le-citric acid
c-007.summary: Ilitye elimhlophe ngaphakathi kwekettle linyibilika nge-citric acid. Inuka kancinci kunesirkile kwaye ayibizi, ngoko kufaneleke ukuyizama ngaphambi kokuthenga ikettle entsha.
c-007.principle: Isikali se-calcium carbonate sinyibilika kwi-asidi: $\mathrm{3CaCO_3 + 2C_6H_8O_7 \to Ca_3(C_6H_5O_7)_2 + 3H_2O + 3CO_2\uparrow}$
c-007.example: Ukuba ubeka itispuni enkulu ye-1 ye-citric acid (malunga ne-10g) kwi-500mL yamanzi, uyibilise uyishiye imizuzu engama-20, isikali esiyi-1mm ubukhulu sihlala sinyibilike. I-1kg ye-citric acid malunga ne-5,000 won inokusetyenziswa amashumi amaxesha.
c-007.actionItem: Namhlanje galela amanzi netispuni enkulu ye-1 ye-citric acid kwikettle, bilisa, shiya imizuzu engama-20, ulahle amanzi uhlambulule kabini okanye kathathu.

c-008.title: Yintoni ububelo obumhlophe obushiyekileyo kwimpahla nakwindlu yokuhlambela
c-008.summary: Emanzini aqinileyo, ii-fatty acids zesepha zidibana nekhalsiyam zenze inkunkuma engenakunyibilika. Ingancitshiswa ngezicoci ezenziweyo okanye ngokuhlamba ngesirkile.
c-008.principle: Imvula yenziwa $\mathrm{Ca^{2+} + 2C_{17}H_{35}COO^- \to Ca(C_{17}H_{35}COO)_2\downarrow}$ kwaye amagwebu nawo ayancipha.
c-008.example: Kwiindawo ezinobunzima obumalunga ne-200mg/L (ngokwe-CaCO₃) okanye ngaphezulu, amagwebu esixa sesepha esifanayo anganciphela ngaphantsi kwesiqingatha. Ifilimu emhlophe kwiitayile zendlu yokuhlambela inyibilika nge-asidi.
c-008.actionItem: Namhlanje fafaza isirkile okanye amanzi e-citric acid kwifilimu emhlophe yeetayile zendlu yokuhlambela uyisule emva kwemizuzu emi-5.

c-009.title: Ibhlitshi eseleyo emanzini ombhobho inganciphiswa ngokuyiyeka okanye ngokubilisa
c-009.summary: Amanzi ombhobho aneebhlitshi ezincinci ezishiyekileyo zokucoca. Ikhuselekile, kodwa ukuba awuyithandi inkunkuma, iyancipha ukuba uyayeka kwisiciko sivulekile okanye uyayibilisa.
c-009.principle: I-hypochlorous acid iyaphuka ngexesha okanye ngokukhanya: $\mathrm{2HOCl \to 2HCl + O_2\uparrow}$
c-009.example: Ibhlitshi eseleyo kwitephu ngokuqhelekileyo yi-0.1–0.5mg/L. Ukuba ugcina amanzi ebhotileni uwayeke iiyure ezimbalwa okanye ubilise imizuzu emi-5 isiciko sivulekile, ivumba liyancipha ngokubonakalayo.
c-009.actionItem: Ngobu busuku gcina amanzi kwikettle, uwayeke isiciko sivulekile uze uthelekise ivumba ngomso ngaphambi kokuwatya.

c-010.title: Kutheni iinwele zinzima emva kokuhlamba emanzini aqinileyo phesheya
c-010.summary: Amanzi kwiindawo ezineminqweno emininzi yelitye lomlambo (umzekelo iYurophu) anekhalsiyam nemagnesium emininzi, ngoko ishampu inamagwebu amancinci kwaye iinwele zibe nzima. Unyango lwe-asidi ngexesha lokuhlamba luyanceda.
c-010.principle: Ii-ion ze-$\mathrm{Ca^{2+}, Mg^{2+}}$ emanzini aqinileyo zidibana ne-surfactant ye-anionic yeshampu zenze imvula. Ubunzima bubonakaliswa njenge-$\mathrm{mg/L\ CaCO_3}$.
c-010.example: Ubunzima obu-300mg/L okanye ngaphezulu bufakwa kuhlobo 'lwamanzi aqinileyo kakhulu', ngaphezulu kwamaxesha ama-3 amanzi ombhobho waseKoreya (ngokuqhelekileyo i-50–100mg/L). Ukuba uxuba isirkile ye-apile itispuni enkulu ye-1 kwilitha nganye ye-1 yamanzi ukuhlamba okokugqibela, ubunzima buyancipha.
c-010.actionItem: Kuhambo olulandelayo thatha umgubo we-citric acid okanye ibhotile encinci yesirkile uze ubuze indawo yokuhlala ngobunzima bamanzi asekuhlaleni.

c-011.title: I-resin yokutshintshisa ion yesihluzi sokuthambisa ibuyiselwa ngetyuwa
c-011.summary: Izihluzi zokuthambisa zeshawa nezinye izihluzi zamanzi zibamba ikhalsiyam nge-resin yokutshintshisa ion. I-resin ibuyiselwa ngamanzi etyuwa okanye itshintshwe, ngoko jonga uhlobo ngaphambi kokuthenga.
c-011.principle: I-resin ibamba ikhalsiyam ikhuphe i-sodium: $\mathrm{2R\text{-}Na + Ca^{2+} \to R_2Ca + 2Na^+}$. Emva kokuzaliswa ibuyiselwa ngamanzi etyuwa agxilileyo.
c-011.example: Ukuba isihluzi esitshintshwayo sixabisa i-10,000 won kwaye sitshintshwa kanye ngenyanga, i-120,000 won ngonyaka. Uhlobo olubuyiselwayo lungasetyenziswa iminyaka ngexabiso letyuwa yee-kg ezimbalwa.
c-011.actionItem: Thelekisa 'ixesha lokutshintsha' kunye 'nokuba ingabuyiselwa' kwesihluzi onenjongo yokusithenga uze ubale iindleko zonyaka.

c-012.title: Isifudumezi esinesikali sisebenzisa amandla amaninzi kwaye siphelelwa lixesha ngokukhawuleza
c-012.summary: Ukuba ilitye lamachibi liqokelelana kwipleyiti yokufudumeza yekettle okanye ye-humidifier, ubushushu abufiki emanzini kakuhle, ixesha lokufudumeza liyanda kwaye amalungu afudumala kakhulu. Ukususa rhoqo kulungile kumandla nakwixesha lokuphila.
c-012.principle: Ukudluliselwa kobushushu $q = \dfrac{kA\Delta T}{d}$ kwaye isikali ($k \approx 1\text{-}3\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$) yingubo yokugquma ubushushu esivala ubushushu ngakumbi kunesinyithi.
c-012.example: Ukuba isikali esingu-2mm okanye ngaphezulu siqokelelana, ixesha lokufudumeza kwiqondo elifanayo linganyuka ngepesenti ezimbalwa kwaye ubushushu belungu lokufudumeza buyanyuka bunciphise ubomi. Ukuhlamba nge-citric acid kanye ngenyanga kwanele.
c-012.actionItem: Bhalisa kwikhalenda umsebenzi ophindaphindayo othi 'ngeCawa yokuqala yenyanga hlamba ikettle ne-humidifier nge-citric acid'.

c-013.title: Ukunyibilikisa umkhenkce ngetyuwa, fafaza kancinci ngaphambi kokuba kube ngumkhenkce
c-013.summary: Ukuba ufafaza ityuwa encinci ngaphambi kokuba kuphume ikhephu okanye kungekuhle kuphela ngaphambi kokuba kube ngumkhenkce, ifuna ngaphantsi kakhulu kunokunyibilikisa umkhenkce osele ukhona. Isizathu kukwehla kwendawo yokuqhwala.
c-013.principle: Ukwehla kwendawo yokuqhwala $\Delta T_f = i K_f m$ ($K_f = 1.86\ \mathrm{K\cdot kg/mol}$, $i \approx 2$ ye-NaCl).
c-013.example: Isisombululo setyuwa esiyi-10% ubunzima sine-$m \approx 1.9\ \mathrm{mol/kg}$, ngoko $\Delta T_f \approx 7\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, oko kukuthi siqala ukuqhwala malunga ne-−7 ℃. Ngaphantsi kwe-−10 ℃ impembelelo iyehla kakhulu, ngoko usebenzise isanti.
c-013.actionItem: Ukuba kuqikelelwa ukuqhwala ngobu busuku, fafaza iqhekeza elincinci letyuwa kwizitepsi zomnyango wangaphambili.

c-014.title: I-calcium chloride okanye ityuwa, yeyiphi apho
c-014.summary: I-calcium chloride isebenza kumaqondo aphantsi, kodwa ishiya umonakalo omkhulu kwikhonkrithi nakwintsimbi. Khetha ngobushushu nendawo.
c-014.principle: I-calcium chloride iyashushu xa inyibilika emanzini: $\mathrm{CaCl_2 \to Ca^{2+} + 2Cl^-}$, $\Delta H \approx -82\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$
c-014.example: Impembelelo ebonakalayo ye-NaCl ukuya kuthi ga kwi-−10 ℃ nokwe-$\mathrm{CaCl_2}$ ukuya kuthi ga kwi-−25 ℃. Kufutshane nekhonkrithi entsha okanye iirelingi zentsimbi, nciphisa ii-chloride usebenzise isanti.
c-014.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga izithako zebhegi yetyuwa yokunyibilikisa umkhenkce (i-sodium/calcium chloride) uphawule ukuba ingasetyenziswa kufutshane neerelingi zentsimbi emnyango.

c-015.title: Hlamba iinyawo zezilwanyana zasekhaya nezandla ngetyuwa yekhephu
c-015.summary: Ityuwa ye-chloride esasazwe endleleni yomisa iinyawo kwaye ukuba ivuthwa ingabangela ukuhlanza. Emva kohambo hlamba ngamanzi afudumeleyo.
c-015.principle: I-Chloride itsala amanzi esikhumbeni iyomise. Ngomgaqo ofanayo wokwehla kwendawo yokuqhwala $\Delta T_f = i K_f m$ amanzi etyuwa anyibilikileyo ayashiyeka.
c-015.example: I-calcium chloride iyashushu xa inyibilika, ngoko inganxila kwisikhumba esimanzi. Emva kohambo hlamba iinyawo imizuzwana engama-30 ngamanzi afudumeleyo uzomise, uninzi lusonjululwa.
c-015.actionItem: Namhlanje emva kohambo hlamba iinyawo zesilwanyana ngamanzi afudumeleyo, kwaye abantu nabo basule iisoli zeembatyi ngelaphu elimanzi.

c-016.title: Ngaphambi kohambo olude lobusika jonga indawo yokuqhwala yolwelo lwewayipha
c-016.summary: Ulwelo lwewayipha lwamanzi kuphela luqhwala kwi-0 ℃ lugquma umbono. Ulwelo lobusika lunedaladala eliyehlisa indawo yokuqhwala.
c-016.principle: Ngo-$\Delta T_f = K_f m$ indawo yokuqhwala iyehla xa ukuxinana kwedaladala kuphezulu, kodwa nayo iyatsha ($\mathrm{C_2H_5OH + 3O_2 \to 2CO_2 + 3H_2O}$).
c-016.example: Iimveliso eziphawulwe ngo-−20 ℃ okanye −30 ℃ aziqhwali ukuya kuloo bushushu, kodwa ukuba zinyibilikisiwe ngamanzi indawo yokuqhwala iyanyuka. Umphunga weemveliso ze-methanol unetyhefu, ngoko ugcine umoya.
c-016.actionItem: Phambi kokuhamba jonga isixa esishiyekileyo etankini yewayipha nophawu lwendawo yokuqhwala kwileyibhile.

c-017.title: Thenga i-antifreeze ngokujonga umlinganiselo wokuxubana nokucaciswa
c-017.summary: Ukuxuba i-antifreeze (i-ethylene glycol) nolwelo lokupholisa kuyehlisa indawo yokuqhwala kwaye inyusa indawo yokubila. Umlinganiselo nenkcazelo kufuneka zilandelwe kwaye ungaxuthi iintlobo ezahlukeneyo.
c-017.principle: $\Delta T_f = i K_f m$ kwaye nge-ethylene glycol (malunga ne-50 vol%) indawo yokuqhwala malunga ne-−37 ℃, indawo yokubila malunga ne-106 ℃.
c-017.example: Ukuba usebenzisa kuphela ulwelo olugxininisiweyo, indawo yokuqhwala iyanyuka kunokuba yehle kwaye ukuhanjiswa kobushushu kuyonakala. I-ethylene glycol imnandi kwaye ibulala izilwanyana zasekhaya, ngoko susa kwangoko ukuba inkcenkceshele.
c-017.actionItem: Kwincwadi yemoto jonga inkcazelo ye-antifreeze enconywayo nomlinganiselo wokuxuba uze ubuze xa uthatha isicaphulo kwindawo yokusebenza.

c-018.title: Ukufumana kwefestile ebusika kunokuqikelelwa ngendawo yombethe
c-018.summary: Xa umoya ofumileyo wangaphakathi uchukumisa iglasi ebandayo, amathontsi amanzi ayenziwa abe sisizathu somlambo nelahleko yobushushu. Ukulungelelanisa ukufuma kwangaphakathi ngokufanelekileyo kunciphisa ukulahlwa kokufudumeza.
c-018.principle: Indawo yombethe malunga ne-$T_d \approx T - \dfrac{100-\mathrm{RH}}{5}$ ($\mathrm{RH}>50\%$) kwaye ukufumana $\mathrm{H_2O(g) \to H_2O(l)}$.
c-018.example: Ngaphakathi 22 ℃, ukufuma kwe-60% indawo yombethe malunga ne-14 ℃. Ukuba umphezulu ongaphakathi wefestile yi-10 ℃, ukufumana kuyenzeka, ngoko ukuba ukufuma kwehliswa kube yi-40–50% indawo yombethe malunga ne-10–12 ℃ kwaye ikakhulu iyavalwa.
c-018.actionItem: Namhlanje setha ukufuma ekujoliswe kuko kwe-humidifier kwi-40–50% uze ujonge ixabiso le-hygrometer ngokuhlwa.

c-019.title: Kwi-silicone yendlu yokuhlambela, sebenzisa i-bleach exutywe ngokukhuselekileyo kumoya
c-019.summary: Umdlavuza omnyama kwi-silicone ubhaliswa yi-bleach ye-oxidising. Qiniseka ngokuvula umoya ungayisebenzisi kunye neemveliso ze-asidi.
c-019.principle: Ukuxutywa kwe-hypochlorite: $\mathrm{NaOCl \to Na^+ + OCl^-}$ kwaye $\mathrm{OCl^-}$ ixutywa i-pigment neeseli zomdlavuza.
c-019.example: Imveliso ye-bleach yorhwebo (malunga ne-4–5%) ixutywe namanzi 1:10 ifakwe, kwaye emva kwemizuzu eli-10 yihlambe ngamanzi kakuhle. Umdlavuza uzala kwi-60–70% yokufuma okuncitshisiweyo okanye ngaphezulu, ngoko ukuvula umoya emva kokuhlamba kuthintela ukubuya.
c-019.actionItem: Namhlanje vula ifestile yendlu yokuhlambela, xhoma iiglavu, ucoce umdlavuza we-silicone nge-bleach exutywe 1:10 uze uhlambe emva kwemizuzu eli-10.

c-020.title: Susa umdlavuza namabala aphuzi ngokukhuselekileyo nge-sodium percarbonate
c-020.summary: I-sodium percarbonate njenge-bleach ye-oxygen ithuthuzela kancinci kune-bleach ye-chlorine, ayinabungozi bokuveliswa kwerhasi ye-chlorine kwaye kulula ukuyisebenzisa nakwimpahla enemibala. Kwamanzi afudumeleyo isebenza ngakumbi.
c-020.principle: I-sodium percarbonate ikhuphela i-hydrogen peroxide iphuke: $\mathrm{2Na_2CO_3\cdot 3H_2O_2 \to 2Na_2CO_3 + 3H_2O_2}$, $\mathrm{2H_2O_2 \to 2H_2O + O_2\uparrow}$
c-020.example: Ukuba ityhidwa itispuni enkulu ye-1 (malunga ne-10g) kwilitha eli-1 lamanzi e-40–50 ℃ ize ifakwe imizuzu engama-30 ukuya kweyure e-1, amabala okubila nomdlavuza ayasuswa. Musa ukusebenzisa kwi-wool nasilika.
c-020.actionItem: Namhlanje faka iikawusi ezimhlophe ezityheli okanye ilaphu lasekhitshini emanzini e-40–50 ℃ ane-sodium percarbonate yetispuni enkulu ye-1 imizuzu engama-30.

c-021.title: Isomisi sokufuma sekloseti sihlala ixesha elide kwindawo encinci
c-021.summary: Isomisi sokufuma se-calcium chloride sifunxa umphunga wamanzi emoyeni siphenduke amanzi. Endaweni yegumbi elikhulu, kungcono kwindawo encinci evaliweyo efana neklosethi okanye ikhabhathi yezihlangu.
c-021.principle: $\mathrm{CaCl_2(s) + 6H_2O(g) \to CaCl_2\cdot 6H_2O}$ ifunxa ukufuma kwaye ukuba iqhubeka ifunxa inyibilike iphenduke amanzi.
c-021.example: I-calcium chloride ifunxa amaxesha amaninzi ubunzima bayo bokufuma. Ukuba ibekwe apho ucango luvulwa rhoqo, igcwala ngokukhawuleza, ngoko ilunge ukusetyenziswa kwindawo encinci evaliweyo ngaphezulu kwenyanga. Lahla amanzi aqokelelweyo ukuze angachukumisi kwisikhumba okanye isinyithi.
c-021.actionItem: Namhlanje beka isomisi sokufuma esinye ezantsi kweklosethi uzame ukunciphisa amaxesha okuvula nokuvala ucango.

c-022.title: Isingxobo esincinci ekutyeni okukhanyayo: i-silica gel kunye ne-quicklime zahlukile
c-022.summary: Kwipakethi yokutya kukho izomisi ezimbini eziqhelekileyo, i-silica gel kunye ne-quicklime, kwaye zombini azifanele zityiwe. I-quicklime iyashushu ngamanzi, ngoko jonga amehlo nomlomo.
c-022.principle: I-quicklime: $\mathrm{CaO + H_2O \to Ca(OH)_2}$ (i-exothermic, $\Delta H \approx -64\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$). I-silica gel ifunxa iimolekyuli zamanzi kumphezulu.
c-022.example: I-silica gel inokusetyenziswa kwakhona emva kokomiswa iiyure ezi-1–2 kwi-oven ye-100–120 ℃. Isingxobo se-quicklime xa simanzi siba sisisombululo se-alkali esomeleleyo, ngoko silahle ukuze singachukumisi manzi.
c-022.actionItem: Khupha izingxobo zezomisi kwidrowa yasekhitshini, jonga uphawu 'lwe-silica gel/quicklime' uze uzigcine kude nabantwana.

c-023.title: Ukungcolisa kweeglasi namagogga kuthintelwa ngethontsi le-surfactant
c-023.summary: Xa uvela ngaphandle ukuya kwindlu efudumeleyo ebusika, ilensi iyafuma ngamathontsi amancinci amanzi. Ifilimu ye-surfactant yenza amathontsi asasazeke abe yifilimu ebhityileyo kwaye umbono uhlala ucacile.
c-023.principle: Ikona yokunxibelelana yokukhula, amathontsi enziwa lula. I-surfactant inciphisa uxinzelelo lomphezulu $\gamma$ amathontsi asasazeke.
c-023.example: Ukuba usasaza ithontsi elinye kuphela lesepha yokuhlamba izitya kumandlelo ngokuncinci uze usule ngelaphu elomileyo, ukufuma kuyancipha iiyure ezimbalwa. Ilensi enoqweqwe, uqweqwe lunokonakala, ngoko landela imiyalelo yomenzi.
c-023.actionItem: Namhlanje phambi kokuphuma cinezela inxalenye ephezulu yemaski ebunzini uze usasaze usule ithontsi elinye lesepha kwiiglasi.

c-024.title: Sasaza ukutya kancinci kwaye ukubambe ngokukhawuleza ukuze kuncitshiswe umonakalo
c-024.summary: Ukuqhwala kancinci, ii-crystal ezinkulu zomkhenkce zixabhisa iiseli kwaye emva kokunyibilika amanzi ayaphuma kwaye ukutya kuqina. Ukusasaza kancinci nokuqhwala ngokukhawuleza, ii-crystal ezincinci ziyenziwa kwaye umgangatho ugcinwa.
c-024.principle: Ubungakanani be-crystal buxhomekeke kwisantya sokupholisa. Kufuneka kususwe ubushushu bokutshintsha kwesigaba $\mathrm{H_2O(l) \to H_2O(s)}$, $\Delta H_{fus} = 6.01\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$.
c-024.example: Ukuba usasaza isobho okanye inyama eseleyo kubukhulu obuyi-2cm kwibhegi ye-zipper uyiqhwale kwitreyi yesinyithi, iqhwala iiyure ezimbalwa ngokukhawuleza kunokuba kuqhwalwa isiqwenga esinye kwaye ilahleko yejusi iyancipha xa inyibilika. Ukugcinwa kwe-reference −18 ℃ okanye ngaphantsi.
c-024.actionItem: Namhlanje sasaza ukutya okushiyekileyo kancinci kwibhegi ye-zipper, bhala umhla uze uqhwale.

c-025.title: Indlela yokuphatha amazambane aqhambile okanye aluhlaza
c-025.summary: Ukuqhambuka nenxalenye eluhlaza yamazambane ine-solanine enetyhefu eninzi. Ngokubilisa okanye ngokuthosa akuphuki lula, ngoko kufuneka usike ngobunzima.
c-025.principle: I-solanine imelana nobushushu kwaye iphuka kuphela malunga ne-$290\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Xa ukhanya kunye ne-chlorophyll, ukuveliswa kwe-solanine kuyanda.
c-025.example: Ukuba usika ukujikeleza kokuqhambuka nenxalenye eluhlaza ubuncinane i-1cm, uninzi lususwa. Ukuba lonke ixolo luluhlaza okanye lunencasa ekrakra, lilahle. Ukuba ugcina kwindawo emnyama ebandayo (8–10 ℃) liqhamba kancinci.
c-025.actionItem: Namhlanje songa amazambane ngephepha lephephandaba uwagcine kwindawo emnyama ebandayo, uze usike okanye ulahle anqhambileyo.

c-026.title: Ukujika kombala kwe-apile ne-avocado kulibaziseka ngethontsi lejusi yelemon
c-026.summary: Isiqhamo esisikiweyo siba mdaka ngenxa yempendulo ye-enzyme ne-oxygen. Ukuba wongeza i-asidi, impendulo iyacotha kwaye ukutya kukhuselekile.
c-026.principle: I-polyphenol oxidase: $\mathrm{2\,catechol + O_2 \to 2\,o\text{-}benzoquinone + 2H_2O}$. I-ascorbic acid (i-vitamin C) iphinda yehlise i-quinone.
c-026.example: Kwi-pH 4 okanye ngaphantsi umsebenzi we-enzyme uyehla kakhulu. Ukuba usika i-apile enye uyifafaze ngetispuni encinci ye-1 yejusi yelemon, ukujika kombala kulibaziseka iiyure ezi-2–3. Inxalenye ejike yamdaka nayo ayinangxaki enkulu kwi-nutrition okanye ukhuseleko.
c-026.actionItem: Namhlanje xa usika i-apile okanye i-avocado, ncancisa amathontsi ambalwa ejusi yelemon okanye utshone ngokufutshane emanzini etyuwa.

c-027.title: Isitofu sokucinezela sinyusa indawo yokubila senciphise ixesha lokupheka nerhasi
c-027.summary: Kwimbiza evaliweyo uxinzelelo luyanyuka kwaye amanzi abila kubushushu obungaphezulu kwe-100 ℃. Kokukhona ubushushu buphezulu, kokukhona iimpendulo zekhemikhali zikhawuleza.
c-027.principle: Ngolwalamano lwe-Clausius–Clapeyron amanzi kwi-2atm (ngokupheleleyo) abila kwi-$120\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Isantya sempendulo $k = Ae^{-E_a/RT}$.
c-027.example: Xa ubushushu bunyuka nge-10 ℃ isantya sempendulo sibe kabini, ngoko xa kunyuka nge-20 ℃ malunga namaxesha ama-4. Iimbotyi okanye inyama enzima eyi-60 yemizuzu embizeni eqhelekileyo igqitywa malunga nemizuzu engama-20 kwisitofu sokucinezela, ngoko ukusetyenziswa kwerhasi kuyancipha kakhulu.
c-027.actionItem: Namhlanje zama ukupheka ukutya okuthatha ixesha elide (iimbotyi, i-shank yenkomo, njl.) ngesitofu sokucinezela uze uthelekise ixesha.

c-028.title: Kutheni i-jam enoshukela omninzi ihlala ngaphandle komdlavuza
c-028.summary: Ushukela ubamba amanzi ukuze iintsholongwane zibe namanzi amancinci anokusetyenziswa. Ukuba ibhotile iyacocwa kwaye umlinganiselo woshukela uyalandelwa, ingagcinwa ixesha elide efrijini.
c-028.principle: Ukuba umsebenzi wamanzi $a_w = \dfrac{p}{p_0}$ uyehla ngaphantsi kwe-0.85, uninzi lwebhaktheriya aluzali kwaye umdlavuza uyakhula ukuya kuma-0.80.
c-028.example: I-jam enoshukela omalunga ne-60% inayo $a_w \approx 0.80$, ngoko ibhaktheriya ithintelwa kodwa umdlavuza uyakwazi. Ukuba ifakwe kwibhotile ecociweyo ngamanzi abilayo, igcinwe efrijini phambi kokuvulwa kwaye iyityiwe ngeveki ezi-2–3 emva kokuvulwa, ilahleko iyancipha.
c-028.actionItem: Namhlanje pheka isiqhamo esishiyekileyo ngoshukela we-40–50% wenze i-jam uyifake kwibhotile ecociweyo ngomhla.

c-029.title: Igrisi yetawa kuqala yisule, emva koko uhlambe ngamanzi afudumeleyo
c-029.summary: Igrisi epholileyo iyaqina kwaye ayinakuhlanjwa kakuhle ngesepha namanzi. Ukuba uyisula kuqala ngetawula yasekhitshini kwaye usebenzisa amanzi afudumeleyo nesepha, isepha namanzi kuyonga.
c-029.principle: Amafutha asabela nge-alkali ne-surfactant abe yisepha ehlambekayo lula: $\mathrm{C_3H_5(OOCR)_3 + 3NaOH \to C_3H_5(OH)_3 + 3RCOONa}$
c-029.example: Amafutha eenkomo aqala ukunyibilika malunga ne-30–40 ℃, ngoko amanzi malunga ne-40 ℃ ayakhulula igrisi. Ukuba uyisula kuqala, amanzi okuhlamba ayehla ngesiqingatha kwaye ukuvala kwemibhobho nako kuthintelwa.
c-029.actionItem: Namhlanje phambi kokuhlamba, sula igrisi kwitawa ngetawula yasekhitshini uze uhlambe ngamanzi afudumeleyo.

c-030.title: Ukuthosa/ukubhaka kuma kumbala wegolide okhanyayo, i-acrylamide iyancipha
c-030.summary: Ukuba amazambane okanye isonka zipheka kubushushu obuphezulu ngokufikelela kumdaka omnyama, i-acrylamide iyanda. Ukuma kumbala wegolide kugcina incasa kwaye kunciphisa uveliso.
c-030.principle: I-asparagine neeshukela ezinciphisayo zingena kwimpendulo ye-Maillard ngaphezulu kwe-$120\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ kwaye i-acrylamide iyenziwa ($\mathrm{C_3H_5NO}$).
c-030.example: Ukuba amaqhekeza amazambane athosiweyo apheka kwi-175 ℃ okanye ngaphantsi aze ame kumbala wegolide kwaye amazambane engagcinwa efrijini, ushukela awanyuki kwaye uveliso lunganciphisa kakhulu. Iindawo ezimnyama kunye nezitshisiweyo kungcono zingatyiwa.
c-030.actionItem: Namhlanje khupha isonka esitshisiweyo okanye amazambane abhakiweyo phambi kokuba abe mdaka omnyama uze usike iindawo ezitshisiweyo.

c-031.title: Iphedi yezandla yokuphosa yobushushu bokuthomalala kwentsimbi
c-031.summary: Umgubo wentsimbi kwiphedi yezandla uxinezeleka ne-oxygen yomoya ukhuphe ubushushu. Kuyasebenza kuhambo lobusika, kodwa ukuba inamathela ixesha elide esikhumbeni kukho ingozi yokutsha kobushushu obuphantsi.
c-031.principle: $\mathrm{4Fe + 3O_2 + 6H_2O \to 4Fe(OH)_3}$ impendulo ye-exothermic nekhabhoni esebenzayo netyuwa ikhawulezisa impendulo.
c-031.example: Ubushushu obuphezulu malunga ne-50–60 ℃ nokuhlala iiyure ezimbalwa. Yinamathelise ngaphezu kwempahla yangaphakathi uyisuse xa ulala ukuthintela ukutsha kobushushu obuphantsi. Phambi kokuvula, ipakethi evaliweyo ithintela umoya.
c-031.actionItem: Namhlanje xa usebenzisa iphedi yezandla, yinamathelise kwimpahla uze ujonge imeko yesikhumba ngeyure nganye.

c-032.title: Isicoci sevumba lamalahle sifunxa, asiphuli
c-032.summary: Amalahle nekhabhoni esebenzayo ibamba iimolekyuli zevumba kumphezulu inciphise ivumba. Xa igcwele, ayisasebenzi, ngoko landela ixesha lokutshintsha okanye lokuvuselela.
c-032.principle: I-adsorption kukunamathela kweemolekyuli kumphezulu kwaye indawo ethile yekhabhoni esebenzayo ifikelela ku-$500\text{-}1500\ \mathrm{m^2/g}$.
c-032.example: I-100g yekhabhoni esebenzayo inokuba nomphezulu ofana nenkundla yebhola kwaye ibamba ivumba leshelufu enye yefriji. Amalahle xa omiswa elangeni kanye ngenyanga abuyiselwa ngokuyinxalenye kwaye atshintshwa rhoqo ngeenyanga ezi-3–6.
c-032.actionItem: Bhala umhla wokutshintsha isicoci sevumba lefriji kwileyibhile uze useth isikhumbuzo seenyanga ezi-3 kamva.

c-033.title: Ukurhabula irayisi imizuzu engama-30 kunciphisa amandla okupheka
c-033.summary: Irayisi erhabuliweyo sele ifunxe amanzi, ngoko ixesha lokufudumeza lifutshane kwaye isidlo siphekwa ngokulinganayo. Ukusetyenziswa kwe-rice cooker okanye irhasi kuyancipha kancinci.
c-033.principle: Isitatshi sifunxa amanzi sijike sibe ligel: $\mathrm{(C_6H_{10}O_5)_n + nH_2O \to}$ igel evuvukileyo. Ukujika ligel kwenzeka malunga ne-$60\text{-}70\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
c-033.example: Irayisi erhabuliweyo imizuzu engama-30 ifunxa malunga ne-20–25% yamanzi ngobunzima kwaye amanzi afika ngaphakathi. Ixesha lokupheka liyancipha ngemizuzu emibalwa kunokungarhabuli kwaye ukuba upheka mihla le, ngenyanga kugcinwa amashumi emizuzu. Ebusika amanzi afudumele ngokufutshane akhawuleza.
c-033.actionItem: Namhlanje hlamba irayisi uyirhabule imizuzu engama-30 uze upheke uthelekise ixesha lokupheka.

c-034.title: Imizuzwana engama-20 yokuhlamba izandla lixesha elifunekayo ukuze isepha ijikeleze ukungcola
c-034.summary: Icala elinye lemolekyuli yesepha liyayithanda ioli nelinye liyawathanda amanzi, ngoko lijikeleza ukungcola neentsholongwane liziye lizihlambe. Le nkqubo ifuna ukungqubana nexesha.
c-034.principle: Isepha yenza ii-micelles ngaphezulu kokuxinana okubalulekileyo kwe-micelle (CMC) ijikeleze amafutha: $\mathrm{RCOONa \to RCOO^- + Na^+}$
c-034.example: Ukuba ucofa ngesepha ngaphakathi kweminwe, ngasemva kwesandla, phakathi kweminwe nangaphantsi kwezikhonkwane uyisonge imizuzwana engama-20 (ingoma yomhla wokuzalwa kabini), ibhaktheriya eqhelekileyo iyancipha kakhulu. Ubushushu bamanzi bufanelwe kukhuseleko lwesikhumba kunempembelelo.
c-034.actionItem: Namhlanje xa uhlamba izandla, bala imizuzwana engama-20 ngetayima okanye ingoma uze ucofe ngaphantsi kwezikhonkwane.

c-035.title: Isikhuseli selebhu ebusika senza ifilimu, asiphathi manzi
c-035.summary: I-lip balm ye-hydrocarbon efana ne-vaseline yenza ifilimu ye-hydrophobic ethintela ukuphuma kwamanzi kwiilebhu. Isebenza ngakumbi ukuba ifakwe kwiilebhu ezimanzi okanye esikhumbeni esifileyo.
c-035.principle: Isantya sokubhanga silingana nomahluko woxinzelelo lomphunga wamanzi kumphezulu wesikhumba kwaye ifilimu ye-petroleum hydrocarbon $\mathrm{C_nH_{2n+2}}$ ayixuthi namanzi ngoko icothisa ukubhanga.
c-035.example: Kwindlu eyomileyo yasebusika (ukufuma okuncitshisiweyo malunga ne-20%), amanzi eelebhu ezingenanto abhanga ngokukhawuleza. Ukuba usasaza i-vaseline ngokubhityileyo, ukubhanga kuyancipha ngokubonakalayo kwaye ukuqhekeka kuyancipha.
c-035.actionItem: Namhlanje phambi kokulala manzisa iilebhu ngamanzi uze usasaze ungqimba olunye olubhityileyo lwe-lip balm.

c-036.title: I-hand cream ihlala ixesha elide ukuba ifakwe iseyimanzi
c-036.summary: Xa ifakwe ezandleni ezimanzi, impembelelo yokuvala amanzi iyanda. Ngesixa esifanayo kuba manzi ngakumbi, ngoko ikhrimu iyancipha.
c-036.principle: Ukulahleka kwamanzi esikhumbeni kulandela umthetho wokusasazeka $J = -D\dfrac{dC}{dx}$. I-glycerin itsala amanzi kwaye i-vaseline ithintela ukubhanga.
c-036.example: Ngaphakathi kwemizuzu emi-3 emva kokuhlamba okanye ukuhlamba izandla, sula kancinci kuphela ngetawula ufake isixa esingangeembotyi, ngoko nasebusika obomileyo inani lokufaka kabini okanye kathathu ngosuku lingancitshiswa. Ukuba ulala unxibe iiglavu impembelelo inkulu.
c-036.actionItem: Namhlanje emva kokuhlamba izandla, phambi kokuba ome ngokupheleleyo, faka ikhrimu yezandla ngesixa esingangeembotyi.

c-037.title: Isicoci sobuso kufuneka sibe yi-asidi ebuthathaka efana nesikhumba (malunga ne-pH 5.5)
c-037.summary: Umphezulu wesikhumba unomaleko wokukhusela we-asidi ebuthathaka kwaye isepha ephezulu ye-pH inokuwonakalisa. Ebusika obomileyo, isicoci se-asidi ebuthathaka sithuthuzela kancinci.
c-037.principle: $\mathrm{pH = -\log[H^+]}$. Umphezulu wesikhumba yi-pH 4.5–5.5 kwaye isepha eqhelekileyo yi-pH 9–10, ngoko $\mathrm{[H^+]}$ iphantsi malunga namaxesha ayi-10,000.
c-037.example: I-pH 5.5 ne-pH 9.5 zahluke ukuxinana kwe-hydrogen ion ngamaxesha $10^4$. Isicoci sobuso esibhalwe 'i-asidi ebuthathaka' singathandani nokutsala emva kokuhlamba kwaye sinciphisa ukusetyenziswa kwe-moisturizer.
c-037.actionItem: Xa uthenga isicoci sobuso esilandelayo, jonga ixabiso le-pH kwinkcazelo yemveliso uze uphawule indlela esiziva ngayo isikhumba emva kokuhlamba.

c-038.title: Kutheni umthamo we-powerbank uyancipha xa kubanda
c-038.summary: I-lithium-ion cell kwiqondo eliphantsi iimpendulo zekhemikhali nokushukuma kwee-ion ziyacotha, ngoko umthamo osetyenziswayo uyancipha. Ukuba uyigcina epokothweni yangaphakathi, ukukhupheleka kuyancipha.
c-038.principle: Kwisantya sempendulo $k = Ae^{-E_a/RT}$ xa $T$ yehla $k$ iba mncinci kwaye ukumelana kwangaphakathi kwebhetri kuyanda.
c-038.example: Kufuphi ne-0 ℃ umthamo unganciphisa i-20–30% kwaye kwi-−10 ℃ ngaphezulu koko. I-powerbank ye-10,000 mAh ngaphandle ebusika inokufikelela kwi-7,000 mAh kuphela, ngoko ukutshaja kuvakala rhoqo.
c-038.actionItem: Namhlanje xa uphuma, gcina i-powerbank nefowuni epokothweni yangaphakathi yejekethi ukugcina ubushushu ngomzimba.

c-039.title: I-powerbank ngenqwelomoya ibalwa nge-Wh
c-039.summary: Iibhetri zelithium zivumeleke kwiphotheli yesandla kuphela, hayi kwiphotheli yekhabhini, kwaye umda womthamo ubalwa nge-Wh. Ukujonga nje i-mAh kudidekile, ngoko bala ngokwakho.
c-039.principle: $\mathrm{Wh = V \times Ah}$ (i-lithium-ion enomgaqo we-3.7V). I-100Wh okanye ngaphantsi ivumelekile, i-100–160Wh ifuna imvume yenkampani yenqwelomoya.
c-039.example: I-20,000 mAh = 20 Ah × 3.7V = 74Wh akukho ngxaki kwaye i-27,000 mAh yi-99.9Wh kufuphi nomda. I-30,000 mAh (111Wh) ifuna imvume.
c-039.actionItem: Namhlanje ndandisa i-mAh ye-powerbank yakho nge-3.7V ibe yi-Wh uze ujonge ukuba i-Wh ikhona kwileyibhile.
