c-040.title: Ukuthintela ityhefu ye-carbon monoxide ngokufudumeza nangamalahle ebusika
c-040.summary: Xa amafutha atshisa ngokungagqibekanga kwindawo engenamoya, i-carbon monoxide engenavumba iyenziwa. Musa ukusebenzisa amalahle, iibriquette, okanye izitovu zekampu ngaphakathi endlini.
c-040.principle: Xa i-oxygen ingonelanga, $\mathrm{2C + O_2 \to 2CO}$ i-carbon monoxide iyenziwa kwaye i-CO ibophelela i-hemoglobin ngamandla angama-200 ngaphezu kwe-oxygen.
c-040.example: Kwi-200ppm ye-CO emoyeni, iiyure ezimbalwa zibangela ubuhlungu beentloko, kwaye i-800ppm okanye ngaphezulu iyingozi kwiyure enye. Jonga ukudibaniswa kwemibhobho yokukhupha yebhoyila nomoya, kwaye ufake i-alarm ye-CO.
c-040.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga imeko yokudibanisa kwemibhobho yokukhupha yebhoyila uze ujonge ibhetri ye-alarm ye-CO.

c-041.title: Ukuba ilangatye lerhasi liphuzi, ioyile iyalahleka
c-041.summary: Ilangatye lerhasi eliqhelekileyo lisibhakabhaka kwaye ukuba liphuzi okanye i-orenji, ukutsha okungagqibekanga kuyenzeka kwaye ubumnyama nenyani ye-carbon monoxide ziyanda. Ukucoca i-burner kubuyisa ukusebenza.
c-041.principle: Ukutsha ngokupheleleyo: $\mathrm{CH_4 + 2O_2 \to CO_2 + 2H_2O}$. Xa i-oxygen ingonelanga $\mathrm{CH_4 + \tfrac{3}{2}O_2 \to CO + 2H_2O}$.
c-041.example: Ukuba ilangatye liphuzi nesiseko sembiza simnyama ngobumnyama, ubushushu abudluliselwa kakuhle kwaye amafutha ayafana okanye ngaphezulu. Ukuba ususa inkunkuma yokutya kwimingxuma ye-burner ngokucofa kwamazinyo, ngokuqhelekileyo ilangatye libuyela kwisibhakabhaka.
c-041.actionItem: Namhlanje coca imingxuma ye-burner yesitovu serhasi ngokucofa kwamazinyo uze ujonge umbala welangatye.

c-042.title: Ibhetri yemoto ye-lead-acid, thintela ukukhutshwa ebusika ukonga iindleko zokutshintsha
c-042.summary: Ngokuphindaphinda kokubanda nohambo olufutshane, ibhetri ye-lead-acid iyakhutshwa kwaye ubomi buyancipha. Kwimeko ekhutshiweyo, i-electrolyte iyalutha kwaye inokuqhwala ngexesha lemozulu engaphantsi kwe-zero.
c-042.principle: Ukukhutshwa: $\mathrm{Pb + PbO_2 + 2H_2SO_4 \to 2PbSO_4 + 2H_2O}$. I-sulfuric acid iyasetyenziswa kwaye indawo yokuqhwala ye-electrolyte iyanyuka.
c-042.example: I-electrolyte yebhetri epheleleyo iqhwala malunga ne-−60 ℃ kodwa ukuba ikhutshiwe inokuqhwala malunga ne-−7 ℃. Ukuba uqhuba ngaphezu kwemizuzu engama-30 kanye ngeveki okanye utshaje ngejaji, iindleko zokutshintsha malunga ne-100,000 won zingalibaziswa.
c-042.actionItem: Namhlanje phambi kokuqalisa injini cima ihita, ihita yeglasi nomsindo, uze ucwangcise ukuqhuba imizuzu engama-30 kanye ngeveki.

c-043.title: Ukulungisa ipani yentsimbi eyenziwe ngemoto yimpendulo ye-polymerization yeoli enyibilikayo
c-043.summary: Ukuba ipani entsha yentsimbi ebhakwayo ngeoli encinci kubushushu obuphezulu ide yenze umaleko oqinileyo, ukuthomalala nokunamathela kuyancipha. Ukuba iqinile, iba nonamathela.
c-043.principle: Ii-fatty acid ezingenasatshurayithi zibeka i-oxygen kwaye zenza i-polymer. Ukuthomalala kwenziwa nge-$\mathrm{4Fe + 3O_2 + 6H_2O \to 4Fe(OH)_3}$.
c-043.example: Ukuba ufaka ioli yokupheka encinci kakhulu uze usule ngetawula yasekhitshini ubhake kwi-oven ye-220 ℃ iyure e-1, umaleko uyenziwa. Emva kokusetyenziswa omisa amanzi kwangoko kwaye ipani esele ilungisiwe ingasetyenziswa iminyaka ngoko ixabisa kancinci.
c-043.actionItem: Namhlanje emva kokuhlamba ipani yentsimbi okanye yentsimbi, yibeke elangatyeni ukususa amanzi uze usule ioli ebhityileyo.

c-044.title: Ukucoca amacephe esilivere aguqukayo ngefoyile ye-aluminium nesoda yokubhaka
c-044.summary: I-silver sulfide emnyama kumphezulu wesilivere ibuyiselwa kwisilivere ngempendulo ye-electrochemical. Ayixabhi, ngoko isilivere ixabhisa kancinci. Inuka isalfa, ngoko vula umoya.
c-044.example: Tyhubela itispuni enkulu ye-1 yesoda yokubhaka kwi-500mL yamanzi ashushu uze utshone imizuzu emi-2–5 ukuze isilivere ichukumise ifoyile. Musa ukusebenzisa kwimveliso eneeperile, amatye anqabileyo, okanye izibambo ezinamathele.
c-044.actionItem: Namhlanje tshonisa icephe elinye lesilivere eguqukileyo kumanzi ashushu enefoyile nesoda yokubhaka.

c-045.title: Iluhlaza obuluhlaza kwimbiza yobhedu akufanele ityiwe
c-045.summary: Xa ubhedu luchukumisa i-asidi nokufuma, i-patina eluhlaza iyenziwa kwaye inetyhefu. Musa ukushiya ukutya okune-asidi ixesha elide ngaphakathi kobhedu uze ujonge imeko yoqweqwe lwangaphakathi.
c-045.principle: I-oxide yobhedu inyibilika kwisirkile: $\mathrm{CuO + 2CH_3COOH \to Cu(CH_3COO)_2 + H_2O}$. I-patina eluhlaza yi-$\mathrm{Cu_2(OH)_2CO_3}$.
c-045.example: Imbiza yobhedu ene-tin okanye i-stainless ngaphakathi ikhuselekile. I-patina yangaphandle ingacocwa ngokutyibilika ngomxube wesirkile 1: ityuwa 1 imizuzu emi-5 kwaye ihlanjwe. Ukuba uqweqwe lwangaphakathi luyaphela, ungapheki.
c-045.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga imeko yoqweqwe lwangaphakathi lwembiza yobhedu kwaye ukuba luyaphela ungapheki.

c-046.title: Ukubilisa imbiza etshisiweyo ngesoda yokubhaka kuyonga amandla
c-046.summary: Endaweni yokucoca kade ngamandla amakhulu namanzi ashushu, ukuba ubilisa ngesisombululo se-alkali ebuthathaka, iimpawu ezitshisiweyo ziyasuka ngamandla amancinci. Imbiza ye-aluminium iguquka umbala, ngoko ungayisebenzisi.
c-046.principle: Xa ifudunyezwa, $\mathrm{2NaHCO_3 \to Na_2CO_3 + H_2O + CO_2\uparrow}$ i-sodium carbonate iyenziwa kwaye i-pH inyuka malunga ne-11.
c-046.example: Ukuba ubilisa i-2 yamacephe amakhulu esoda yokubhaka kwi-500mL yamanzi ngomlilo omncinci imizuzu eli-10, iimpawu ezitshisiweyo ziyasuka. Amanzi nesepha ziyancipha kunokuba ugcine amanzi ombhobho ebaleka ixesha elide ucoca nokufudumeza amanzi nako kuyonga.
c-046.actionItem: Namhlanje galela amanzi namacephe amakhulu ama-2 esoda yokubhaka embizeni etshisiweyo, bilisa imizuzu eli-10, upholise uze ucoce.

c-047.title: Impahla enegazi icocwe kuqala ngamanzi abandayo
c-047.summary: Amabala egazi asuka xa ucocwa kuqala ngamanzi abandayo e-20 ℃ okanye ngaphantsi, hayi amanzi afudumeleyo.
c-047.principle: Iiproteni zegazi ezifana ne-hemoglobin ne-fibrinogen ziyadenatura zibe kwiqina ngobushushu zinamathele kwintsontsi. I-hydrogen peroxide iphuka nge-catalase egazini: $\mathrm{2H_2O_2 \xrightarrow{catalase} 2H_2O + O_2\uparrow}$
c-047.example: I-hemd yekotoni ehlanjwe ngamanzi ashushu e-60 ℃ ibala legazi liqina libe mdaka, kodwa ukuba itshonelwa imizuzu emi-5 kumanzi abandayo e-15 ℃ ize ifakwe amathontsi ambalwa e-hydrogen peroxide e-3%, amagwebu (i-oxygen) ayavela kwaye uninzi luyasuka. Sebenzisa kwimpahla emhlophe kuphela, kwaye kwiimpahla ezinemibala vavanya kuqala kwindawo engabonakaliyo.
c-047.actionItem: Namhlanje xa kuvela ibala, endaweni yamanzi ashushu yenza amanzi abandayo ahambe uze uhlambe ukusuka ngasemva ukuya ngaphambili.

c-048.title: Isepha ibe nesixa esifanelekileyo ngokwenzima yamanzi
c-048.summary: Nokuba wongeza isepha ngaphezu kwesicetyiswayo, amandla okucoca ahlala efana, kodwa amanzi okuhlamba nexabiso lesepha kuyanda.
c-048.principle: I-surfactant yesepha ngaphezulu kokuxinana kwe-micelle ebalulekileyo (CMC) ayisakwazi ukususa ukungcola ngakumbi. Ii-ion zekhalsiyam emanzini aqinileyo zimisa isepha: $\mathrm{Ca^{2+} + 2C_{17}H_{35}COO^- \to Ca(C_{17}H_{35}COO)_2\downarrow}$
c-048.example: Kumatshini wokuhlamba we-2kg, isepha encomelwa ye-40mL ukuba wongeza i-80mL, impembelelo yokuhlamba iyafana kodwa isepha eseleyo ifuna ukuhlamba kwakhona kanye. Ukuba ngenyanga uhlamba amaxesha angama-20 ukonga i-40mL ngalinye, i-9.6L ngonyaka, kuphantse kube ne-20,000 won.
c-048.actionItem: Namhlanje phambi kokuhlamba jonga isikali kwisiciko sesepha uze uphawule isixa esicetyiswayo kuphela.

c-049.title: Iinkunkuma ezincinci ze-PM2.5 ziyenziwa emoyeni
c-049.summary: Inxalenye enkulu ye-PM2.5 ayisuki ezitshimini kodwa kwiimpendulo zekhemikhali emoyeni, ngoko xa ingxinano iphezulu ebusika, imaski ye-KF94 iyasebenza.
c-049.principle: Ii-oxides zesalfa ne-nitrogen zisabela ne-ammonia zenze iinkunkuma zesibini: $\mathrm{NH_3 + HNO_3 \to NH_4NO_3}$, $\mathrm{2NH_3 + H_2SO_4 \to (NH_4)_2SO_4}$
c-049.example: Kwi-PM2.5 ephezulu eKoreya, i-ammonium nitrate ne-ammonium sulfate ngamanye amaxesha zikhona phantse isiqingatha. I-KF94 ihluza i-94% okanye ngaphezulu yeenkunkuma ze-0.4μm kwaye isebenza xa inamathele ebusweni.
c-049.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba uqikelelo lwe-PM lubi, phambi kokuphuma cinezela iklipi yempumlo yemaski ukuze inamathele ngaphandle kwezikhewu.

c-050.title: Iqweqwe elinqanda amanzi legilasi yemoto lilungiselelo le-silane elirhoxisa amanzi
c-050.summary: Iqweqwe elinqanda amanzi lenza imolekyuli ye-siloxane/fluorine kumphezulu wegilasi ukuze imvula nekhephu ziqengqeleke. Umbono uba mhle ngoko ukuqhuba ebusika kukhuseleke ngakumbi.
c-050.principle: Iqela le-$\mathrm{Si{-}OH}$ legilasi lidibanisa ne-silane lenze ifilimu ye-$\mathrm{Si{-}O{-}Si}$, kwaye ityathanga le-hydrophobic langaphandle likhulisa ikona yokunxibelelana $\theta$ yethontsi ukuya ku-$100^\circ$ okanye ngaphezulu.
c-050.example: Ikona yokunxibelelana yegilasi engabekwanga malunga ne-$30^\circ$ kwaye amanzi asasazeka, kodwa igilasi eneqweqwe $100^\circ$ okanye ngaphezulu iba ngamathontsi aqhuba umoya we-60–80km/h. Iqweqwe ngokuqhelekileyo liphela ngeenyanga ezimbalwa.
c-050.actionItem: Kule veki coca iglasi yangaphambili ukususa ifilimu yeoli, faka iqweqwe elinqanda amanzi ngokubhityileyo uze usule ngelaphu elomileyo.

c-051.title: Kutheni ikotoni ne-polyester zomiswa ngeesantya ezahlukileyo
c-051.summary: Ukukhetha impahla yokuzilolonga ye-polyester nempahla yangaphantsi neetawuli zekotoni kwenza ukulawula ukubila nokufuma kube lula.
c-051.principle: I-cellulose yekotoni inamaqela amaninzi e-OH ngoko idibanisa i-hydrogen namanzi ifunxe ukuya kuma-25% okufuma, kodwa i-polyester i-hydrophobic ngokuhlangana kwe-ester ngoko ifunxa malunga ne-0.4% kuphela. $\mathrm{HO{-}R + H_2O \rightleftharpoons HO{-}R{\cdots}H_2O}$
c-051.example: I-T-shirt efanayo ye-100g ixutywe kububilo, ikotoni iphatha ububilo kwaye ithatha iiyure ezingaphezu kwe-2 ukomiswa, kodwa i-polyester yomisa malunga neyure e-1. Kuphela ukuba iimolekyuli zevumba ze-polyester zihlala ngokulula kwintsontsi, ngoko ifuna ukuhlanjwa.
c-051.actionItem: Xa uthenga impahla elandelayo jonga umxube wentsontsi kwileyibhile uze ujonge ukuba umgangatho we-polyester uphezulu kwezokuzilolonga.

c-052.title: Ibhili yerhasi yesixeko ibalwa ngokubaleka ukunyuka kobushushu, hayi umthamo
c-052.summary: Irhasi yesixeko ibhaliselwa ngobushushu obubalwa ngomthamo osetyenzisiweyo (m³) uphindaphindwe ngomlinganiselo wokuguqula ubushushu (MJ/m³). Ukuba uyazi iyunithi yobushushu kwibhili, kulula ukuthelekisa ukusetyenziswa kokufudumeza.
c-052.principle: Ukutsha kwemethane: $\mathrm{CH_4 + 2O_2 \to CO_2 + 2H_2O}$, $\Delta H \approx -890\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$. I-1m³ yerhasi yesixeko malunga ne-$42\ \mathrm{MJ}$.
c-052.example: Ukuba ukusetyenziswa kwerhasi kwenyanga yi-50m³ $50 \times 42 = 2100\ \mathrm{MJ}$. Ukuba useto lwebhoyila luncitshiswa ukusetyenziswa kwehle nge-10%, malunga ne-210MJ ziyalondolozwa.
c-052.actionItem: Namhlanje funa ukusetyenziswa kwale nyanga (m³) kwibhili yerhasi uze uphawule ukuthelekiswa nenyanga edlulileyo.

c-053.title: Ukususa uthuthu ngeasidi ye-citric
c-053.summary: Uthuthu olubomvu kwizixhobo ezincinci zentsimbi luyanyamalala ngokuyinxalenye enkulu ukuba zitshonisiwe kwisisombululo se-citric acid.
c-053.principle: I-iron(III) oxide inyibilika ngokwenza i-chelate ne-citric acid: $\mathrm{Fe_2O_3 + 6H^+ \to 2Fe^{3+} + 3H_2O}$, emva koko $\mathrm{Fe^{3+}}$ idibanisa nee-ion ze-citrate.
c-053.example: Ukuba unyibilikisa i-25g ye-citric acid (5%) kwi-500mL yamanzi uze utshonise isikere esinothuthu iiyure ezi-4–6 uze usule ngebrashi, uthuthu luyasuka. Musa ukuxuba ne-cleaner ye-chlorine, kwaye emva kokucoca yomise kwangoko uze ufake ioli ebhityileyo.
c-053.actionItem: Namhlanje tshonisa isixhobo esinye esincinci esinothuthu kwi-citric acid e-5% uze uyomise uyifake ioli ngomso.

c-054.title: I-bleach ye-oxygen isebenza kumanzi afudumeleyo
c-054.summary: I-sodium percarbonate isebenza ngakumbi kumanzi alingana ne-40 ℃ kwaye ibuyisela impahla emhlophe ngexabiso eliphantsi.
c-054.principle: I-sodium percarbonate yahlulwa emanzini ibe yi-hydrogen peroxide ne-sodium carbonate: $\mathrm{2Na_2CO_3\cdot 3H_2O_2 \to 2Na_2CO_3 + 3H_2O_2}$, emva koko $\mathrm{H_2O_2 \to H_2O + \tfrac12 O_2}$
c-054.example: Ukuba unyibilikisa i-25g ye-sodium percarbonate kwi-5L yamanzi e-40 ℃ uze utshonise iikawusi ezimhlophe ezityheli iyure e-1, ziba mhlophe. Ixabiso liphantsi kune-bleach yorhwebo, ayinaso ivumba le-chlorine, kwaye ungayisebenzisi kwi-wool okanye isilika.
c-054.actionItem: Namhlanje rhabula kanye impahla emhlophe kumanzi e-40 ℃ ane-sodium percarbonate e-5g/L.

c-055.title: Ixesha lomdlavuza wentyatyambo, hlamba impumlo ngeslayini
c-055.summary: Kwi-allergy yentwasahlobo, ukuba uhlamba impumlo nge-saline e-0.9%, umdlavuza wentyatyambo onamathele kwi-mucosa uyahlanjwa.
c-055.principle: I-0.9% NaCl enoxinzelelo lwe-osmotic olufanayo nolwamanzi omzimba (isotonic) ayiyomeli okanye iyancitshisa iiseli ze-mucosa. Uxinzelelo lwe-osmotic: $\Pi = iMRT$
c-055.example: Nyibilikisa i-4.5g yetyuwa (0.9%) kwi-500mL yamanzi abilisiweyo nasezipholile, kwaye uphephe ukusebenzisa amanzi ombhobho ngqo. Amanzi acocekileyo yi-hypotonic ngoko ayahlaba.
c-055.actionItem: Namhlanje emva kokubuya, hlamba umngxuma ngamnye wempumlo kanye ngesprayi ye-saline yorhwebo.

c-056.title: Ivumba leziko alivela kububilo, kodwa kwiibhaktheriya ezityile ububilo
c-056.summary: Ububilo ngokwabo abunavumba kwaye iibhaktheriya ezisezihlangwini zophula amafutha neeproteni zobubilo zenze ii-fatty acid ezinukayo. Isoda yokubhaka ityumbuza ivumba le-asidi ize inciphise nokufuma.
c-056.principle: I-fatty acid enamatyathanga amafutshane (umzekelo i-isovaleric acid) isabela nge-base ebuthathaka: $\mathrm{RCOOH + NaHCO_3 \to RCOONa + H_2O + CO_2}$.
c-056.example: Ukuba ubeka i-1–2 yamacephe amancinci esoda yokubhaka kwipheya enye yezihlangu ubusuku bonke, ivumba le-asidi nokufuma kuyancipha. Ngosuku olulandelayo yishukumise uze uyinxibe.
c-056.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ususa izihlangu, fafaza icephe elinye lesoda yokubhaka ngaphakathi uze uyishiye ubusuku bonke.

c-057.title: Inani elingezantsi kweplastiki, ingasetyenziswa ngemicrowave okanye hayi
c-057.summary: Ngenani lokuphinda kusetyenziswa kwisikhongozeli elingezantsi kuyaziwa ukuba ingasetyenziswa kwi-microwave nasekutyeni okushushu okanye hayi.
c-057.principle: I-PP (inani 5) ineqondo eliphezulu lokunyibilika malunga ne-160 ℃ ngoko isetyenziselwa i-microwave, kwaye isikhongozeli sesifuthe se-PS (inani 6) siguquka ngobushushu obumalunga ne-80 ℃. I-polymerization: $\mathrm{n\,CH_2{=}CHCH_3 \to [-CH_2{-}CH(CH_3)-]_n}$
c-057.example: Ibhokisi yesidlo se-PP ayiguquki kakhulu nokuba ibamba isobho esingaphezu kwe-100 ℃, kodwa ukuba utshisa ukutya okushushu okunamafutha kwisikhongozeli se-PS se-instant noodle esisetyenziswa kanye, sinokunyibilika. Jonga nophawu 'olunokusetyenziswa ngemicrowave' kwileyibhile.
c-057.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga amanani angezantsi kwezikhongozeli ezi-3 ozisebenzisa rhoqo uze ususe ezo ezingeyonanani 5 kwimicrowave.

c-058.title: Iivithamini A, D, E, K zifunxwa xa zityiwa neoli
c-058.summary: Iivithamini ezinyibilika emafutheni azinyibiliki emanzini, ngoko zifuna amafutha ukuthwalwa kwii-micelle kwisibeleko esincinci zifunxwe. Ukuba isaqathe okanye ezongezelelweyo zityiwa esiswini esingenanto, ukufunxwa kunganciphisa.
c-058.principle: Iimolekyuli ezingenasikhululo zinyibilika zihambe kwii-micelle ezenziwa ziintsini ze-bile. Ukuba akukho mafutha, ii-micelle azenziwa kancinci kwaye isantya sokufunxwa siyancipha.
c-058.example: Kwaziwa ukuba kwisaqathe esithoswe ngetispuni encinci ye-1 yeoli ye-olive, ukufunxwa kwe-beta-carotene kuphezulu amaxesha amaninzi kunesaqathe esingapheki. Izongezelelo ze-vitamin D nazo zingcono zityiwe ngexesha lesidlo.
c-058.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba usela i-vitamin D okanye izongezelelo ezinyibilika emafutheni, zisele ngexesha lesidlo esinamafutha.

c-059.title: Amabala ekomityi asuswa ngesoda yokubhaka
c-059.summary: Amabala etiyi nekofi ngaphakathi kwekomityi aya kunyamalala ukuba atyhulwa ngomxube wesoda yokubhaka ngokuxhabhisa okuthambileyo nesenzo se-alkali.
c-059.principle: Ii-tannin nee-polyphenol zinyibilika kangcono emanzini kwi-alkali. $\mathrm{NaHCO_3 \rightleftharpoons Na^+ + HCO_3^-}$, i-alkali ebuthathaka i-pH malunga ne-8.3
c-059.example: Ukuba uxuba i-1 yecephe elikhulu lesoda yokubhaka netispuni encinci ye-1 yamanzi uzitshubele ngesipuni imizuzu eli-1, nefilimu emdaka yekomityi yeminyaka emi-5 ngokuyinxalenye enkulu iyasuka. Akukho ndleko yokuthenga isicoci esahlukileyo.
c-059.actionItem: Namhlanje coca i-mug enye ene-limescale ngomxube wesoda yokubhaka.

c-060.title: Inkunkuma yekofi ayiyomfumba ngqo
c-060.summary: Inkunkuma yekofi kufuneka yomiswe ngokwaneleyo ixutywe kancinci, kwaye ukuba ifafazwa kakhulu ibangela umdlavuza nokunqanda ukukhula.
c-060.principle: Ukusebenza kwekhompost kulungile xa umlinganiselo we-carbon:nitrogen (C/N) ungama-25–30:1. Inkunkuma yekofi malunga ne-20:1 kwaye inenitrogen eninzi kwaye intsalela ye-caffeine inokunqanda ukuhluma.
c-060.example: Ukuba uxuba kuphela i-10% okanye ngaphantsi komthamo womhlaba wehlobo (100mL yenkunkuma kwilitha nganye ye-1 yomhlaba) isomile, ikhuselekile ukuyisebenzisa. Ukuba ubeka ubukhulu obumanzi, umdlavuza uyakhula.
c-060.actionItem: Namhlanje sasaza inkunkuma yekofi oyisele kwiphephandaba uyomise.

c-061.title: Ukuba i-aspirin inuka isirkile
c-061.summary: Ukuba ibhotile ye-aspirin inuka isirkile, iphukile ngokufuma, ngoko ungayisebenzisi uze uyilahle.
c-061.principle: I-acetylsalicylic acid iphuka ngokuphendula namanzi: $\mathrm{C_9H_8O_4 + H_2O \to C_7H_6O_3 + CH_3COOH}$ (i-salicylic acid + i-acetic acid)
c-061.example: Ukuba ibekwe kwindawo enokufuma okungaphezu kwe-80% efana neshelufu yendlu yokuhlambela, i-hydrolysis iqhubeka ngeenyanga ezimbalwa. Yigcine kwidrowa ebandayo eyomileyo isiciko sivaliwe, kwaye kulungile ukubeka isingxobo esinye se-silica gel kunye.
c-061.actionItem: Namhlanje hambisa amayeza nezongezelelo ebezigcinwe endlini yokuhlambela kwidrowa eyomileyo.

c-062.title: Ibhatyi engangeni manzi, ubushushu buphilisa ingubo ekhuselayo
c-062.summary: Xa amanzi engenzi amaconsi kwibhatyi engangeni manzi, emva kokuhlamba ungaphilisa ingubo ekhuselayo ngokomisa kubushushu obuphantsi.
c-062.principle: Ingubo ye-DWR inemisetyana ye-fluorine·ye-hydrocarbon engangeni manzi emi phezu komphezulu wentsimbi, amanzi enza amaqhekeza ngenxa yoxinzelelo lomphezulu. I-engile yoqhagamshelwano $\theta>90^\circ$, ukulingana kukaYoung: $\cos\theta=\dfrac{\gamma_{SV}-\gamma_{SL}}{\gamma_{LV}}$
c-062.example: Intsalela yesepha nodaka kulalisa imisetyana, ngoko emva kokuhlamba ngesepha engathathi hlangothi, komisa kwi-dryer ye-temperature ephakathi (malunga ne-40~60℃) imizuzu engama-20 okanye uyayoyisa ngobunono, imisetyana iphinde yime amaconsi enze amaqhekeza. Ukuba akukho siphumo, sebenzisa isitshizi sokuthintela amanzi esithengiswayo.
c-062.actionItem: Namhla, fafaza amanzi kwibhatyi engangeni manzi ujonge ukuba amaqhekeza enza na.

c-063.title: Okuthethwa yi-20-10-10 kwingxowa yomgquba
c-063.summary: Amanani e-N-P-K kwingxowa yomgquba ayinto yomxholo we-nitrogen·phosphorus·potassium (%), ngoko khetha umlinganiselo ofanelekileyo kwezityalo.
c-063.principle: Izityalo zikhulisa amagqabi nge-nitrogen (NO3−, NH4+), iingcambu·iintyatyambo nge-phosphorus ($\mathrm{H_2PO_4^-}$), iziqu neziqhamo nge-potassium ($\mathrm{K^+}$). I-hydrolysis ye-urea: $\mathrm{CO(NH_2)_2 + 2H_2O \to 2NH_4^+ + CO_3^{2-}}$
c-063.example: Umgquba we-20-10-10 we-1kg uqulethe i-200g ye-nitrogen, i-100g ye-phosphoric acid, i-100g ye-potassium. Imifuno yamagqabi ifuna umgquba one-nitrogen eninzi, iintyatyambo neziqhamo ifuna ephezulu ngephosphorus·potassium. Ukudlula ngaphezu kwexabiso elibhalwe kwileyibhile kutshisa iingcambu.
c-063.actionItem: Namhla, khangela kanye umlinganiselo we-N-P-K ofanelekileyo kwizityalo ozikhuliselayo.

c-064.title: I-alkaline neLithium AA, zisetyenziswa phi
c-064.summary: Kwi-remote i-alkaline, kwiindawo ezibandayo okanye izixhobo ezifuna umbane ophezulu iibhetri eziphambili ze-lithium zihlala ixesha elide.
c-064.principle: I-alkaline: $\mathrm{Zn + 2MnO_2 + H_2O \to ZnO + 2MnO(OH)}$. Ebusika i-electrolyte yamanzi iyacotha, kodwa ibhetri ephambili ye-lithium isebenza ukuya kwi--40℃ nge-electrolyte engeyiyo yamanzi.
c-064.example: Kwikhamera yedijithali ii-alkaline AA ezi-2 zihlala zithatha malunga neefoto ezingama-300, i-lithium AA zingaphezulu kwama-800. Kwelinye icala, kwizixhobo ezinomoya omncinci njengeremote nekliki yodonga, i-alkaline ishibhile kakhulu kwaye iluncedo.
c-064.actionItem: Namhla, bhala phantsi ukuba isixhobo ngasinye silungele i-alkaline okanye i-lithium.

c-065.title: Umbala we-hydrangea ugqitywa yi-acidity yomhlaba
c-065.summary: Ubuhlaza obuluhlaza nobupinki be-hydrangea bugqitywa yi-pH yomhlaba, ngoko ukulungisa umhlaba ukwenza umbala owufunayo.
c-065.principle: Kumhlaba one-asidi (pH malunga ne-5.5 nangaphantsi) i-aluminium inyibilika $\mathrm{Al^{3+}}$ ibophe ne-anthocyanin ibe luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, kwi-neutral~alkaline iqokelela $\mathrm{Al(OH)_3}$ ibe pinki: $\mathrm{Al^{3+} + 3OH^- \to Al(OH)_3\downarrow}$
c-065.example: Ukunika i-hydrangea epinki i-aluminium sulfate malunga ne-3g ngelitha ngalinye lamanzi ngenyanga, emva kweenyanga ezimbalwa ukubaluhlaza kuyanda. Ngokuchaseneyo, ukunyusa i-pH ibe ngaphezu kwe-6.5 ngekalika kwenza ibe pinki. Ukugqitha kulimaza iingcambu.
c-065.actionItem: Namhla, tyela iphepha lovavanyo lwe-pH emhlabeni wombhobho uze ubeke umbala ofunayo we-hydrangea.

c-066.title: Isizathu sokuba iswetha yoboya incitshe
c-066.summary: Iswetha yoboya incipha ngamanzi ashushu nokungqubana, ngoko yihlambe ngesandla ngamanzi afudumeleyo nesepha engathathi hlangothi.
c-066.principle: Uboya yiprotheyini i-keratin kwaye umphezulu onjengamaxolo (scales) ubambana ngokungqubana kwenza i-felting. I-alkali nobushushu zihydrolyze iibhondi ze-peptide: $\mathrm{R{-}CO{-}NH{-}R' + H_2O \to RCOOH + R'NH_2}$
c-066.example: Hlamba ngamanzi angaphantsi kwe-30℃ ngesepha engathathi hlangothi imizuzu emi-2~3 ucinezela, ungaphoti, susa amanzi ngethawula uze uyomise ilele ityaba, ukucuthwa phantse akukho. Umjikelo ophakathi we-washing machine we-40℃ ungenza incitshe ubungakanani obunye ngexesha elinye, ulahlekelwe yiswetha ebizayo.
c-066.actionItem: Namhla, jonga uphawu lokuhlamba kwileyibhile yempahla yoboya uze ulungiselele isepha engathathi hlangothi ngokwahlukileyo.

c-067.title: Vitamin C ibuthathaka kukukhanya nomoya
c-067.summary: Izongezo ze-vitamin C kufuneka zigcinwe ebotileni emnyama enesiciko esivaliweyo kakuhle, kude nelanga nokufuma.
c-067.principle: I-ascorbic acid iyaoksidayiza xa idibana neoksijini: $\mathrm{C_6H_8O_6 \rightarrow C_6H_6O_6 + 2H^+ + 2e^-}$ (dehydroascorbic acid), ubushushu nokukhanya kukhawulezisa isantya.
c-067.example: I-vitamin C yomgubo ishiyiwe ebotileni evulekileyo kwi-25℃, ukufuma kwe-70%, inyanga ezimbalwa iba mdaka kwaye amandla ayehla. Ukuyigcina kwindawo epholileyo kuvumela ukusebenzisa imveliso efanayo ide ifike kumhla wokuphelelwa.
c-067.actionItem: Namhla, tshintshela izongezo ukusuka efestileni·kwishelufu yekhitshi ukuya kwidrowa epholileyo.

c-068.title: Ukukhetha i-DEET ne-icaridin kwizibaleki zeentsholongwane
c-068.summary: Phambi kwemisebenzi yangaphandle, ukusebenzisa imveliso ye-DEET yama-20~30% okanye i-icaridin yama-10~20% kukhusela iiyure ezimbalwa.
c-068.principle: I-DEET (N,N-diethyl-m-toluamide, $\mathrm{C_{12}H_{17}NO}$) ishiya ii-receptors zevumba zeengcongconi, kwenza kube nzima ukufumana umntu. Ukuxinana okuphezulu kwandisa ixesha lokukhuselwa, kodwa isiphumo siyagcwala kwinqanaba elithile.
c-068.example: I-DEET ye-30% ikhusela malunga neeyure ezi-6, i-10% malunga neeyure ezi-2, kwaye ngaphezulu kwe-50% ukwanda komphumo kuncinci. Ungayifafazi ngqo ebusweni, yithulule esandleni uze uyifake, ungayisebenzisi kubantwana abangaphantsi kweenyanga ezi-2.
c-068.actionItem: Namhla, jonga izithako nokuxinana kwileyibhile yesibaleki uze ubeke kwisingxobo sakho sangaphandle.

c-069.title: Insimbi engenatsimbi ye-304 ne-316, indlela yokufunda ileyibhile
c-069.summary: Kwimiphunga yolwandle okanye iikhontena zokutya ezinetyuwa, insimbi engenatsimbi ye-316 equlethe i-molybdenum ixhathisa ukugqwesa ngcono.
c-069.principle: Insimbi engenatsimbi iqulethe i-chromium engaphezu kwe-10.5% yenza ngaphezulu $\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$ ifilimu ye-passive: $\mathrm{4Cr + 3O_2 \to 2Cr_2O_3}$. I-316 yongeza i-molybdenum ye-2~3% ixhathisa ukugqwesa kwee-ion ze-chloride (Cl−).
c-069.example: I-304 (18-8) yanele kwiikhitshi eziqhelekileyo, kodwa kwiindawo ezinetyuwa eninzi kuvela i-pitting corrosion (imingxuma). Kwifleksi efanayo, nokuba i-316 ibiza ngama-20~30% ngaphezulu, ubomi bayo bude ngakumbi ekusetyenzisweni elunxwemeni.
c-069.actionItem: Namhla, khangela uphawu lwe-304 okanye i-316 ezantsi kwemveliso yentsimbi engenatsimbi oyisebenzisayo.

c-070.title: I-fluoride kwi-toothpaste iguqula umphezulu wamazinyo ube yikristali eqinileyo
c-070.summary: Ii-ion ze-fluoride ziguqula i-hydroxyapatite ye-enamel yamazinyo ibe yi-fluoroapatite eyomeleleyo ngakumbi kwi-asidi. Ukuba awuhlambululi kakhulu ngamanzi emva kokuhlamba amazinyo, i-fluoride ihlala ixesha elide.
c-070.principle: $\mathrm{Ca_{10}(PO_4)_6(OH)_2 + 2F^- \to Ca_{10}(PO_4)_6F_2 + 2OH^-}$. I-fluoroapatite iqala ukunyibilika kwi-pH engama-4.5 malunga yaye ixhathisa i-asidi ngakumbi kune-hydroxyapatite (pH engama-5.5 malunga).
c-070.example: Sebenzisa i-toothpaste ye-fluoride ye-1000~1500ppm ngobungakanani bepea, hlambulula kanye kuphela ngamanzi emva kokuhlamba amazinyo ukuze usebenzise ngokufanelekileyo impembelelo yokuhlala kwe-fluoride.
c-070.actionItem: Ngobu busuku, emva kokuhlamba amazinyo, ungahlambululi umlomo kaninzi ngamanzi, hlambulula kanye kuphela ngobunono.

c-071.title: Isizathu sokuba ibhodlo le-aluminium libe mnyama
c-071.summary: Ukushiya ukutya okunesiasidi ixesha elide kwibhodlo le-aluminium kuyalimnyama, ngoko sebenzisa ezinye iikhontena ukugcina.
c-071.principle: Ifilimu ye-$\mathrm{Al_2O_3}$ yomphezulu we-aluminium inyibilika kwi-asidi: $\mathrm{Al_2O_3 + 6H^+ \to 2Al^{3+} + 3H_2O}$, $\mathrm{2Al + 6H^+ \to 2Al^{3+} + 3H_2}$. Ilimaza nasezibeni ze-alkali, ngoko kufuneka unyamezele.
c-071.example: Isosi yetumato (pH malunga ne-4.5) eshiywe ebhodleni le-aluminium imini enye ingatshintsha umbala womphezulu kwaye ibe nencasa yesinyithi. Ukutshintsha umbala kunokuthi kuphele ngokubilisa i-1L yamanzi ne-2 tablespoons ye-citric acid okanye i-cream of tartar imizuzu eli-10.
c-071.actionItem: Namhla, ungashiyi isosi nesobho eseleyo ebhodleni, yitshintshele kwikhontena yeglasi okanye yentsimbi engenatsimbi.

c-072.title: Into ebangela amabala ayintsholongwane ezandleni
c-072.summary: Amabala aphuzi ezandleni zehempe emhlophe adalwe yityhefu nama-aluminium e-deodorant, ngoko i-bleach esekwe kwioksijini isebenza kakuhle.
c-072.principle: Iiprotheyini·iiasidi zamafutha zomjuluko zidibana netyuwa ye-aluminium zenze ukuqokelela okungenakunyibilika, kwaye i-bleach esekwe kwioksijini ioksidayiza izithako zendalo: $\mathrm{H_2O_2 \to H_2O + [O]}$
c-072.example: Xuba i-sodium percarbonate i-1 tablespoon namanzi e-40℃ ekomityi i-1 ube mkhulu, uyibeke ebaleni imizuzu engama-30 uze uhlambe, umbala uyahamba kakhulu. I-bleach ye-chlorine inokwenza amabala eprotheyini abe luhlaza.
c-072.actionItem: Namhla, sebenzisa ngaphambili umxube we-bleach esekwe kwioksijini kwihempe emhlophe oyinxibileyo.

c-073.title: Ivumba lefenitshala entsha liphawu le-formaldehyde
c-073.summary: Ivumba lefenitshala entsha okanye iphepha lodonga libangelwa zi-volatile organic compounds (VOC), ngoko vula iifestile iintsuku ezimbalwa ukuze zihambe.
c-073.principle: I-urea resin yegluu ye-plywood iyaqhawuka yakhuphe i-formaldehyde: $\mathrm{HCHO}$. Ukukhutshwa kunyuka njengoko ubushushu nokufuma kunyuka.
c-073.example: Emva kokuzisa ifenitshala entsha, kwiiveki ezi-2 zokuqala sebenzisa umoya amaxesha amathathu ngemini imizuzu engama-30 uze ufudumeze igumbi ukuya kwi-25~30℃ (bake-out), ukuxinana kuyehla kakhulu. Umda ocetyiswayo we-formaldehyde ngaphakathi yi-0.1ppm okanye ngaphantsi.
c-073.actionItem: Namhla, sebenzisa umoya amaxesha amathathu ngemini imizuzu eli-10 okanye ngaphezulu ngokuvula iifestile ezichaseneyo.

c-074.title: Amanzi ohambo, ukubilisa nokusebenzisa iipilisi zokucoca
c-074.summary: Amanzi angakhuselekanga angatshabalalisa uninzi lwezifo ngokubilisa imizuzu eli-1 okanye ngaphezulu okanye ngokuhlambulula ngeepilisi ze-chlorine.
c-074.principle: Iipilisi zokucoca ezisekwe kwi-chlorine zenza i-hypochlorous acid emanzini ioksidayize iintsholongwane: $\mathrm{NaDCC + H_2O \to HOCl + \cdots}$, $\mathrm{HOCl \rightleftharpoons H^+ + OCl^-}$
c-074.example: Faka ipilisi enye kwilitha enye yamanzi acacileyo uyiyeke imizuzu engama-30 (ixesha elide ngakumbi kwi-Cryptosporidium). Amanzi athulu kufuneka ahluzwe ngelaphu kuqala, kwaye ngaphezulu kwe-2,000m yokuphakama yonyusa ixesha lokubilisa libe yimizuzu emi-3.
c-074.actionItem: Namhla, beka ipilisi yokucoca okanye isihluzi esithwalekayo kwisingxobo sohambo.

c-075.title: Inethi yokuhlamba ye-fleece, ukunciphisa i-microplastics
c-075.summary: Ukufaka iimpahla ze-synthetic kwinethi yokuhlamba uzihlambe ngamanzi abandayo kunciphisa kakhulu ukukhutshwa kweemicrofibers.
c-075.principle: I-polyester yi-polymer ye-ester engaqhekeki kodwa yaphuka ngokungqubana: $\mathrm{n\,HOOC{-}C_6H_4{-}COOH + n\,HOCH_2CH_2OH \to [-OC{-}C_6H_4{-}COO{-}CH_2CH_2O-]_n + 2n\,H_2O}$
c-075.example: Ukuhlamba ibhatyi ye-fleece enye ngexesha elinye kuvelisa amawaka~amashumi amawaka eemicrofibers. Ukusebenzisa inethi yokuhlamba nesihluzi kuhluza ubuninzi, kunciphisa ukungena emilanjeni, kwaye ukuhlamba kubushushu obuphantsi kusindisa nombane.
c-075.actionItem: Namhla, tywina i-zipper yeempahla ze-fleece·ze-polyester uze uzifake kwinethi yokuhlamba uzihlambe ngamanzi abandayo.

c-076.title: Khetha iibhetri ezitshajwayo ze-nickel-metal hydride ezinokuzikhupha kancinci
c-076.summary: Iibhetri eziqhelekileyo ze-nickel-metal hydride zizikhupha malunga nama-20% ngenyanga nokuba azisetyenziswa. Ezikhupha kancinci zisala ama-70~85% emva konyaka, zilungele iiremote neewotshi.
c-076.principle: Impendulo yebhetri ye-nickel-metal hydride: $\mathrm{NiOOH + MH \rightleftharpoons Ni(OH)_2 + M}$. Ukuzikhupha kwenzeka njengoko i-hydrogen ihamba kancinci phakathi kwe-electrolyte ne-electrode.
c-076.example: Ibhetri enye ye-AA etshajwayo ekhupha kancinci (malunga ne-2000 mAh) ukuba isetyenziswa amaxesha angama-500 inokuthatha indawo yamakhulu ambalwa eebhetri ze-alkaline zokusebenzisa kanye, ngoko iindleko zexesha elide ziyancipha kakhulu.
c-076.actionItem: Namhla, ukuba unamabhetri eeremote okanye iiwotshi, yenza isicwangciso sokutshintshela kwiibhetri ezitshajwayo ezikhupha kancinci.

c-077.title: Amabala e-inki ye-ballpoint asuswa nge-alkoholi, hayi ngamanzi
c-077.summary: I-inki ye-ballpoint yi-inki eneoli apho idayi inyibilike kwi-solvent eyi-organic, ngoko ayisasazeki emanzini. Ukuthi qhu ngelaphu elinesifaki-ngenelo se-ethanol yokuthomalalisa, idayi iyanyibilika ivele.
c-077.principle: Izinto ezifana ngokungathathi hlangothi ziyaxubana ngokulula. I-oil-based dye inyibilika kakhulu kwi-ethanol ($\varepsilon \approx 25$) kuneminye emanzini ($\varepsilon \approx 80$).
c-077.example: Beka ithawula lephepha elomileyo ngezantsi kwebala uze ugqitse nge-cotton swab enokukhuphela i-ethanol ye-70% ukusuka ngaphandle ukuya ngaphakathi, i-inki ayisasazeki kodwa iyahamba iye ethaweleni. Zama kuqala kwindawo encinci.
c-077.actionItem: Namhla, ukuba kukho amabala e-ballpoint kwimpahla okanye kwifenitshala, zama i-alkoholi kuqala kwindawo engabonakaliyo.

c-078.title: Imifuno eyomileyo ibuyela ebomini xa uyifaka emanzini abandayo
c-078.summary: Ilettuce nesipinatshi esomileyo zomile kuba amanzi angaphakathi kweeseli ancipha. Ukuzifaka emanzini abandayo imizuzu engama-20~30, amanzi aphinda angene nge-osmosis zibe crunchy, ukulahlwa kuncipha.
c-078.principle: Xa ukuxinana kwezinto ezinyibilikileyo ngaphakathi kweeseli kuphezulu kunamanzi angaphandle, amanzi ahamba angene. Uxinzelelo lwe-osmotic $\Pi = iMRT$ lwenza uxinzelelo lwe-turgor ekhulisa iiseli.
c-078.example: Isandla sesiletyuce esomileyo emva kosuku esifakwe emanzini abandayo imizuzu engama-30 sinyusa ubunzima nge-5~10% kwaye ukubaleka kuyabuya. Kodwa amagqabi asele ethambile okanye onakeleyo akangeni.
c-078.actionItem: Namhla, faka imifuno yamagqabi eyomileyo efrijini emanzini abandayo imizuzu engama-30 uze unyakazise amanzi uze uyitye.

c-079.title: Ii-allergens zeentsholongwane zothuli lwendlu zincipha ngokuhlamba ngamanzi angaphezu kwe-60℃
c-079.summary: Iintsholongwane nama-allergens eprotheyini kwizingxobo zokulala azincipha kakuhle ngokuhlamba ngamanzi abandayo. Kumanzi ashushu malunga ne-60℃, iiprotheyini ziyatshintsha ukwakheka, iintsholongwane ziyafa kwaye ama-allergens ayancipha.
c-079.principle: Ubushushu bukhulula ulwakhiwo lwe-tertiary lweeprotheyini, kwenze i-enzymes·ama-allergens alahlekelwe yimisebenzi (thermal denaturation). Ngokuqhelekileyo kwi-55~60℃ iintsholongwane ziyafa kwimizuzu embalwa.
c-079.example: Ukuhlamba iishiti zebhedi nezigqoko zomoff kwi-60℃ kunciphisa kakhulu ama-allergens, kodwa ukuhlamba kwi-30℃ akusebenzi kakhulu. Ukuba ileyibhile yentsimbi ayivumeli, ungatshintsha ngokomisa kwi-dryer ngobushushu obuphezulu.
c-079.actionItem: Namhla, hlamba izigqoko zomoff okanye iishiti zebhedi ngemijikelo eshushu kakhulu evunyelwe yileyibhile yokuhlamba.

c-080.title: Igesi yokukamba, ebusika i-butane ayikhuphi
c-080.summary: Iikani ze-isobutane zibuthathaka kufutshane ne-0, ngoko kwikhempu yasekupheleni kwebusika sebenzisa igesi exutywe ne-propane.
c-080.principle: Igesi ene-liquefied ayiguquki ibe ngumphunga ngaphantsi kwendawo yokubilisa. I-butane malunga ne-$-1^\circ\mathrm{C}$, i-isobutane $-12^\circ\mathrm{C}$, i-propane $-42^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Ukutshisa: $\mathrm{C_4H_{10} + \tfrac{13}{2}O_2 \to 4CO_2 + 5H_2O}$
c-080.example: Ngaphantsi kwe-0℃ ikani ye-butane inoxinzelelo oluphantsi nelangatye liyabuthathaka, kwaye ixesha lokubilisa amanzi lingaphindwa kabini. Beka ikani ngaphakathi kwebhegi yokulala okanye kufutshane nomzimba ukuyigcina ifudumele, kwaye ukuba isetyenziswa ngaphakathi etendeni kukho ingozi yetyhefu ye-CO, ngoko vula umoya.
c-080.actionItem: Namhla, jonga itheyibhile yezithako (umlinganiselo we-butane·propane) kwikani yegesi yekhempu.

c-081.title: Ukufunda izithako ze-sunscreen
c-081.summary: Ngaphambi kokuba imitha ye-UV yentwasahlobo inyuke, yazi umahluko phakathi kwe-sunscreen engeyiyo i-organic (zinc oxide) nokhetho lwe-organic.
c-081.principle: I-zinc oxide ($\mathrm{ZnO}$) ibonisa·isasaza i-UV, ii-organic filters ezifana ne-avobenzone zifunxa zikhuphe njengobushushu: ⟦$h\nu + \text{isihluzi} \to \text{isihluzi}^* \to \text{ubushushu}$⟧
c-081.example: I-SPF 50 ivala i-UVB malunga ne-98%, i-SPF 30 malunga ne-97%, umahluko mncinci. Ebusweni, kufuneka umlinganiselo we-0.5g malunga (imigca emibini yobude bomunwe wesalathisi·womnwe ophakathi) ongezelelwa rhoqo emva kweeyure ezi-2~3.
c-081.actionItem: Namhla, phambi kokuphuma, cinezela i-sunscreen ubude beminwe emibini uze uyifake.

c-082.title: Ukucwenga amanzi kwinkunkuma yokutya kunciphisa ivumba nobungakanani
c-082.summary: Ivumba elibi lenkunkuma yokutya yimpuma efana ne-hydrogen sulfide eveliswa ziintsholongwane ngokwahlula iiprotheyini. Ukucinezela amanzi kuqala phambi kokulahla kucotha ukwanda kweentsholongwane, ivumba liyancipha kwaye nobunzima buyancipha.
c-082.principle: Ukwahlulwa kwe-amino acids ene-sulfur kwiiprotheyini: $\mathrm{R{-}SH \to H_2S}$. Isantya sokwanda kweentsholongwane siyacotha xa umsebenzi wamanzi $a_w$ uphantsi.
c-082.example: I-70~80% yenkunkuma yokutya ngamanzi. Nokuba ucinezela ukunciphisa amanzi nge-20% kuphela, ubunzima buyancipha malunga nama-15%, iindleko zokulahla nevumba ziyancipha kunye.
c-082.actionItem: Namhla, phambi kokulahla inkunkuma yokutya, yibeke kwisihluzo uze ucinezele amanzi ngokuqinileyo.

c-083.title: Umhla wokuphelelwa umiselwa yi-temperature dependence yesantya sempendulo
c-083.summary: Ukutya kuyonakala ngokukhawuleza ngamaxesha angama-2 xa ubushushu bunyuka nge-10℃. Ngoko kufuneka ulandele ubushushu bokugcina obubhalwe ukuze umhla wokuphelelwa ube nentsingiselo.
c-083.principle: Ukulingana kuka-Arrhenius: $k = A e^{-E_a/RT}$. Kwimpendulo yokonakala eneenjini eziqhelekileyo ze-activation, isantya siba ngamaxesha angama-2~3 ngokunyuka kwe-10℃ ngasinye.
c-083.example: Ukuba ubisi lwefriji kwi-4℃ lugcinwa iintsuku ezi-7, kwi-14℃ lunokonakala emva kweentsuku ezi-3~4 malunga. Kungcono ukubeka ngaphakathi kunakwishelufu yomnyango (apho ubushushu buguquguquka kakhulu).
c-083.actionItem: Namhla, jonga ubushushu befriji ukuze ubone ukuba bungaphakathi kwe-0~4℃.

c-084.title: Ihlamba soda endaweni ye-percarbonate, yamafutha anamathelayo
c-084.summary: Kumafutha amadala e-fan yekhitshi·yegesi, i-washing soda (sodium carbonate) enamandla ngakumbi e-alkali kune-baking soda iyawasusa kakuhle.
c-084.principle: Amafutha (triglycerides) afumana i-saponification kwi-alkali: $\mathrm{RCOOR' + OH^- \to RCOO^- + R'OH}$. I-washing soda $\mathrm{Na_2CO_3}$ ine-pH engama-11 malunga.
c-084.example: Chitha i-1 tablespoon ye-washing soda kwilitha enye yamanzi ashushu uyiyeke imizuzu eli-10 uze ucoce, amafutha amadala ayakhululeka. Iyacaphukisa ulusu, ngoko nxiba iiglavu zerabha, kwaye ungayisebenzisi kwiipani ze-aluminium·ezigqunyiweyo.
c-084.actionItem: Namhla, cwilisa isihluzi esinye se-range hood kwisisombululo se-washing soda.

c-085.title: I-PM2.5 evela ekuphekeni ukutya okuthosiweyo
c-085.summary: Ukupheka ukuthosa nokugcoba kunyusa kakhulu i-PM2.5 yangaphakathi, ngoko ngexesha lokupheka vula i-hood uvule neefestile.
c-085.principle: Ngaphezu kobushushu obungama-180℃ amafutha ayaqhekeka abe zizinto ezincinci ne-acrolein: $\mathrm{C_3H_5(OH)_3 \to CH_2{=}CHCHO + 2H_2O}$ (glycerol dehydration)
c-085.example: Kukho imilinganiselo ebonisa ukuba xa kugcotywa ifeshi ye-mackerel epanini i-PM2.5 yangaphakathi inyuka ukuya kumakhulu e-μg/m³, kwaye ukuvula i-hood kuyincitshisa kakhulu. Shiya i-hood isebenza eminye imizuzu eli-10 emva kokupheka.
c-085.actionItem: Namhla, phambi kokuqala ukupheka vula i-hood kuqala uze uyishiye isebenza eminye imizuzu eli-10 emva kokupheka.

c-086.title: Emva kohambo lolwandle, hlambulula ibhayisikili nemoto
c-086.summary: Ityuwa yomoya wolwandle igqwesa isinyithi ngokukhawuleza, ngoko emva kohambo lolwandle hlambulula izithuthi neebhayisikili ngamanzi acocekileyo.
c-086.principle: Isisombululo samanzi se-sodium chloride siba yi-electrolyte senze iseli yokugqwesa yentsimbi: $\mathrm{Fe \to Fe^{2+} + 2e^-}$, $\mathrm{O_2 + 2H_2O + 4e^- \to 4OH^-}$
c-086.example: Kwindawo emanzi enetyuwa isantya sokugqwesa kwentsimbi siphezulu ngamaxesha aliqela kunakwindawo eyomileyo. Ngaphakathi kweeyure ezingama-24 emva kokuqhuba elunxwemeni, hlamba ingaphantsi nentsimbi yebhayisikili ngamanzi uze ugcobe ioli yentsimbi, kuthintela kakhulu ukugqwesa.
c-086.actionItem: Ukuba ubuye elunxwemeni, namhla hlambulula ingaphantsi yemoto nentsimbi yebhayisikili ngamanzi.

c-087.title: Indlela yokuhlamba ichiza, kuqala amanzi emva koko i-baking soda
c-087.summary: Iziqhamo·imifuno kufuneka zihlanjwe ngamanzi ahambayo, kwaye kukho uphando oluthi ukucwilisa imizuzu eyi-12 emanzini e-baking soda kuncipha ngakumbi ezinye zeechiza zomphezulu.
c-087.principle: Ezinye iichiza (i-thiabendazole njl.njl.) ziqhekeka ngokulula kwi-alkali ebuthathaka. Isisombululo se-baking soda se-1% ($\mathrm{NaHCO_3}$) sine-pH engama-8.1 malunga.
c-087.example: Kuvavanyo apho kwafakwa iiapile kwisisombululo se-baking soda se-1% (10g kwilitha enye yamanzi) imizuzu eyi-12, intsalela yeechiza zomphezulu yancipha ngakumbi kunokuhlamba ngamanzi. Iziqhamo ezidliwa nangaphandle uzihlambulule kwakhona ngamanzi ahambayo emva kokucwiliswa.
c-087.actionItem: Namhla, cwilisa iiapile okanye amaphela emanzini e-baking soda e-10g/L uze uwahlambulule.

c-088.title: Umgquba wentaka namabala eenambuzane yiprotheyini, ngoko kufuneka ucwiliswe ngokukhawuleza ucocwe
c-088.summary: Umgquba wentaka noketshezi lweenambuzane unezinto ze-asidi neeprotheyini, kwaye xa zomile zinamathela kumphezulu wokupeyinta zisasazeke. Ukuba ucwilisa kakuhle ngelaphu elimanzi uze ucoce ngobunono, umonakalo wepeyinti uncinci.
c-088.principle: Iiprotheyini zibambana xa zomile zomelele zenze iibhondi ze-hydrogen nomphezulu. Amanzi nesepha ebuthathaka ye-alkali (pH 8~9) ziyaqhawula ezi bhondi.
c-088.example: Umgquba wentaka oshiywe ngaphezu kosuku olunye unokonakalisa umphezulu wepeyinti ngokubonakalayo ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezi-1~2, ngoko kukhuselekile ukubeka ithawula le-microfiber elimanzi imizuzu emi-5 uze ucoce.
c-088.actionItem: Namhla, ukuba kukho umgquba wentaka owomileyo kwimoto okanye kwifestile, beka ilaphu elimanzi imizuzu emi-5 uze ucoce.

c-089.title: I-baking powder ne-baking soda ziyizinto ezahlukeneyo
c-089.summary: I-baking soda yi-sodium bicarbonate kuphela ngoko ifuna i-asidi ukuze ivuke, kwaye i-baking powder sele iqulathe izinto ze-asidi ngoko ivuka nje xa idibana namanzi. Ukuzitshintsha kunokwenza incasa ibe krakra okanye ungavuki kakuhle.
c-089.principle: $\mathrm{NaHCO_3 + H^+ \to Na^+ + H_2O + CO_2\uparrow}$. I-baking soda i-1 teaspoon (malunga ne-5g) inokuvelisa i-carbon dioxide ekufutshane ne-1L.
c-089.example: Ukuba iresiphi ineqhekeza le-1/2 teaspoon ye-baking soda ne-yoghurt (i-asidi), i-asidi ibangela i-soda iphendule. Ukufaka i-soda kuphela kwintlama engenasidi kushiya i-soda engaphenduleli ibe necasa ekrakra efana nesepha.
c-089.actionItem: Namhla, jonga iileyibhile ze-baking soda ne-baking powder kwishelufu yekhitshi uze uzibeke ngokwahlukileyo kwiikhontena ezahlukeneyo.

c-090.title: I-apile nebhanana kufuneka zigcinwe ngokwahlukileyo
c-090.summary: I-ethylene gas ekhutshwa yi-apile ivuthisa ibhanana ngokukhawuleza, ngoko gcina iziqhamo zahlukene.
c-090.principle: I-ethylene $\mathrm{CH_2{=}CH_2}$ yi-plant hormone esebenzisa ii-enzymes zokuqhawula udonga lweseli ukukhawulezisa ukuvutha. Ukwenziwa: $\mathrm{C_2H_4}$ ukukhutshwa kunyuka kakhulu xa iziqhamo ziqala ukuvutha.
c-090.example: Ibhanana engekavuthi ukuba ibekwe ebhegini enye ne-apile ivuthisa usuku olunye okanye ezimbini ngaphambili, ngoko unokuyisebenzisa ngabom. Ngokuchaseneyo, ukuba ufuna ukugcina ixesha elide, beka i-apile ngokwahlukileyo, ixesha lokugcina lonyuka ngosuku olunye okanye ezimbini, inkunkuma yokutya iyancipha.
c-090.actionItem: Namhla, beka i-apile nebhanana kwiindawo okanye iikhontena ezahlukeneyo.

c-091.title: I-tannin yetiyi nekofu ithintela ukufunxwa kwezongezo ze-iron
c-091.summary: I-tannin ne-polyphenols zetiyi nekofu zibophelela kwii-ion ze-iron zenze indibaniselwano engafunxeki lula. Kungcono ukushiya ubuncinci iiyure ezi-1~2 phakathi kwayo nezongezo ze-iron okanye ukutya okune-iron eninzi.
c-091.principle: I-tannin yenza i-chelate ne-iron: $\mathrm{Fe^{2+} + tannin \to Fe{-}tannin\ complex}$. Le ndibaniselwano ayifunxwa lula emathunjini.
c-091.example: Kuxelwa ukuba itiyi eselwa kunye nokutya inokunciphisa ukufunxwa kwe-non-heme iron ukuya kuma-40~60%. Ukuba usela iyure e-1 emva kokutya, impembelelo incinci kakhulu.
c-091.actionItem: Namhla, ukuba uthathe izongezo ze-iron okanye wadla isipinatshi·iimbotyi, dlulisela itiyi·ikofu iyure e-1 kamva.

c-092.title: Iinyembezi xa usika itswele zingancitshiswa ngokubeka efrijini
c-092.summary: Ukusika itswele kwenza iiseli ziqhekeke ii-enzymes zenze igesi ecaphukisa amehlo. Ukubeka itswele efrijini imizuzu engama-30 kucotha impendulo ye-enzyme, iinyembezi ziyancipha.
c-092.principle: I-alliinase iguqula i-sulfoxides ibe zizinto ezicaphukisayo: i-propanethial S-oxide ($\mathrm{C_3H_6OS}$) icaphukisa imithambo yamehlo ikhuphe iinyembezi. Isantya sempendulo ye-enzyme siyehla ngokulinganayo nobushushu.
c-092.example: Kwitswele elipholiswe ku-4℃ imizuzu engama-30 kunelo kwiqondo lobushushu legumbi (25℃), isantya sokwenziwa kwezinto ezicaphukisayo sincipha ngaphantsi kwesiqingatha. Icala lengcambu line-enzymes ezininzi, ngoko lisike ekugqibeleni.
c-092.actionItem: Namhla, faka itswele efrijini imizuzu engama-30 ngaphambi kokulisebenzisa.

c-093.title: Ukuqhuma kwempahla kukukwenziwa kwakhona kweebhondi ze-hydrogen
c-093.summary: Iintsimbi ezifana nekotoni xa zifumana amanzi nobushushu, iibhondi ze-hydrogen phakathi kwemisetyana yeemolekyuli ziyakhululeka zize zomelele kwakhona kwimo entsha zipholile. Ukuzikhulula ngomphunga nobushushu kwaye uzolule ngaphambi kokupholisa kususa iintshukumo.
c-093.principle: Amaqela e-$\mathrm{{-}OH}$ eekhetyiti ze-cellulose abophelela ngee-hydrogen bonds. Ukufuma nobushushu kuqhawula ezi bhondi, kwaye ngexesha lokupholisa zibophelela kwakhona kwimo elolulweyo.
c-093.example: Ubushushu be-iron obufanelekileyo yi-200℃ malunga kwikotoni, kwaye ngaphantsi kwe-110℃ kwiintsimbi ze-synthetic. Ukulengisa iimpahla ebhafini emva kwe-shower eshushu, ukufuma nobushushu kungasusa iintshukumo ezincinci ngokwazo.
c-093.actionItem: Namhla, jonga ileyibhile yokuhlamba yehempe oza kuyinxiba uze ususe iintshukumo ngomphunga ngokuhambelana nobushushu obuvunyiweyo.

c-094.title: Ngeentsuku zothuli lwaseTshayina·lwe-PM, hlamba ubuso imizuzwana engama-30 nge-surfactant
c-094.summary: Uthuli oluncinci lunamathele kumafutha olusu (sebum), ngoko alususeki kakuhle ngamanzi kuphela. Isitshixo kukuhlamba ubuso ngomfovu ukuhlamba amafutha nothuli kunye.
c-094.principle: I-surfactant inomsila othanda amafutha nentloko ethanda amanzi, ngaphezu kwe-critical micelle concentration ivalela i-sebum nothuli ngaphakathi kwe-micelle ize ihlanjwe ngamanzi. $c>\mathrm{CMC}\;\Rightarrow\;\text{micelle}\ (\text{sebum + dust trapped inside})$
c-094.example: Ukuxuba i-foam cleanser emanzini afudumeleyo e-30~35°C imizuzwana engama-30 uze uhlambulule kususa uninzi lothuli lobuso. I-pH yomphezulu wolusu yi-4.7~5.5 malunga, ngoko iimveliso ezine-asidi encinci (pH 5~6) zilungile.
c-094.actionItem: Namhla, emva kokuphuma, nika ubuso umfovu owaneleyo ngamanzi afudumeleyo uze uhlambe ngobunono imizuzwana engama-30 (phepha amanzi ashushu).

c-095.title: Emoyeni owomileyo wenqwelomoya, kufuneka i-moisturizer nokusela amanzi
c-095.summary: Ukufuma okuhlobene kwekhabhini yenqwelomoya kudla ngokuba yi-10~20% njengasentlango, ngoko ukufuma kolusu nakwi-mucous membrane yempumlo kuphela ngokukhawuleza. Ukusebenzisa i-moisturizer nokusela ikomityi yamanzi rhoqo kuyanceda.
c-095.principle: Ukufuma okuhlobene $RH = \dfrac{p_{\mathrm{H_2O}}}{p^{*}_{\mathrm{H_2O}}} \times 100\%$. Ikhabhini ifudumeza umoya wangaphandle ungene, ngoko uxinzelelo lomphunga olugcwele luphezulu kodwa uxinzelelo lomphunga lwenyani luphantsi, ngoko $RH$ liphantsi.
c-095.example: Xa ukufuma kwangaphakathi okuqhelekileyo kuyi-40~60%, kwi-10~20% yekhabhini ilahleko yamanzi iphantsi ngamaxesha angama-2~3 ngokukhawuleza. Kuhambo olude, kucetyiswa ukusela i-100~200mL yamanzi iyure nganye.
c-095.actionItem: Kuhambo olulandelayo, thatha ikhrimu ye-moisturizer kwikhontena engaphantsi kwe-100mL.

c-096.title: Imifuno yasentwasahlobo iqhekeke emanzini abilayo imizuzwana engama-30 kuphela
c-096.summary: Ukuyibilisa ngokufutshane kumisa ii-enzymes, umbala uyacaca kwaye ukukrakra nevumba elinobuhlaza kuyancipha. Ukubilisa ixesha elide kuguqula i-chlorophyll yaba ngumbala we-olive ophuzi.
c-096.principle: Ubushushu bususa umoya ngaphakathi kwemithambo yesicubu kwaye bwenza ii-enzymes zokutshintsha umbala zingasebenzi. Ngokufudumeza·asidi i-magnesium ye-chlorophyll itshintshwa ziiion ze-hydrogen yenze i-pheophytin emdaka. $\mathrm{Chl\text{-}Mg}+2\,\mathrm{H^+}\rightarrow \mathrm{Pheophytin}+\mathrm{Mg^{2+}}$
c-096.example: Ukufaka i-10g (1%) yetyuwa kumanzi abilayo e-1L, ubilise isipinatshi se-100g imizuzwana engama-30 uze uhlambulule ngamanzi abandayo, ubuhlaza buyagcinwa. Ukubilisa ngaphezu kwemizuzu emi-5 kuguqula umbala ube yi-olive.
c-096.actionItem: Namhla, ukuba uthenga imifuno yasentwasahlobo, yibilise kumanzi abilayo e-1% yetyuwa imizuzwana engama-30 uze uyipholise ngokukhawuleza ngamanzi abandayo.

c-097.title: Iinkuni zinika ubushushu obuhle xa ukufuma kungaphantsi kwe-20%
c-097.summary: Iinkuni ezimanzi zisebenzisa ubushushu kuqala ukutshabalalisa amanzi ngaphambi kokutsha, ngoko zinomsi omninzi nobushushu obuncinci. Iinkuni ezigcinwe emvuleni zomiswe iinyanga ezingaphezu kwesi-6 zisebenza ngakumbi.
c-097.principle: Ubushushu be-evaporation bamanzi yi-$\Delta H_{vap} \approx 2.26\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$. Kubushushu bokutsha beenkuni (malunga ne-$18\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$ kwisiseko esomileyo), ubushushu obulinganayo nokufuma buyasuswa.
c-097.example: Umthi ongekomi onokufuma kwe-40% unobushushu obusebenzayo obungaphantsi ngama-30% okanye ngaphezulu kunenkuni ezomileyo (15~20%) kwaye uvelisa umsi omninzi. Yahlula iinkuni ujonge ukuba umbindi womile.
c-097.actionItem: Namhla, ukuba unezinkuni zokusetyenziswa ngaphandle, zibeke kwindawo enomoya engafikelelwa yimvula.

c-098.title: Itiyi eluhlaza ithanjiswe kumanzi e-70~80℃ ukuze ingakrakri kakhulu
c-098.summary: I-catechin yetiyi eluhlaza inyibilika kakhulu kwiqondo eliphezulu lobushushu yenze ukukrakra nokuqina, kwaye i-amino acid ethanda i-theanine iphuma nakubushushu obuphantsi. Amanzi apholisiwe ukuya kwi-70~80℃ anokulinganisela okuhle.
c-098.principle: Ukunyibilika kudla ngokunyuka ngobushushu. I-catechin epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) ikhutshwa ngokukhawuleza ngaphezu kwe-80℃, ukwenza ukuqina kube kukhulu.
c-098.example: Itiyi ephekwe ngamanzi e-90℃ imizuzu emi-3 ine-catechin ekhutshiweyo ngokubonakalayo ngaphezu kwetiyi ephekwe ngamanzi e-70℃, ngoko ivakala ikrakra ngakumbi. Ukuthulula amanzi abilayo kwikomityi kanye kuwehlisa malunga ne-10℃.
c-098.actionItem: Namhla, xa uthanjisa itiyi eluhlaza, thulula amanzi abilayo kwikomityi kanye uyipholise uze uyithanjise imizuzu emi-2.

c-099.title: I-glacial acetic acid ayisiyiviniga, yi-acetic acid ye-99%
c-099.summary: Iviniga yisisombululo samanzi se-acetic acid se-4~8%, kodwa i-glacial acetic acid yi-acetic acid ecocekileyo malunga ne-99% enokutshisa ulusu namehlo. Ukuyisebenzisa ekutyeni, jonga uphawu lwenqanaba lokutya uze uyigqithise ngokunciphisa kakhulu.
c-099.principle: Iviniga: $\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ malunga ne-$0.7\ \mathrm{mol/L}$ (4~5%). I-glacial acetic acid malunga ne-$17\ \mathrm{mol/L}$ ngamaxesha angama-20 okanye ngaphezulu ngobunzima. I-acetic acid ecocekileyo iba nzima njengomkhenkce ngaphantsi kwe-16.6℃, ngoko ibizwa ngokuba yi-glacial.
c-099.example: Kwiresiphi esebenzisa iviniga eqhelekileyo ye-5%, ukusebenzisa i-glacial acetic acid ye-99% ngomlinganiselo ofanayo kufaka i-asidi enzima ngamaxesha angama-20. Ukuba ileyibhile ayinayo indlela yokunciphisa ekutyeni, kukhuselekile ukungayithengi.
c-099.actionItem: Namhla, jonga i-acidity (%) nezithako kwileyibhile yeviniga yasekhaya.

c-100.title: Utywala butshintsha ngaphakathi esibindini bube yi-acetaldehyde, bubangela i-hangover
c-100.summary: I-alcohol yaqhawulwa yaba yi-acetaldehyde esibindini, kwaye ide iguquke ibe yi-acetic acid, ibangela intloko ebuhlungu nokucaphuka. Ukusela amanzi akwenzi ukuba isantya sokwaqhawula sesibindi sikhawuleze.
c-100.principle: $\mathrm{CH_3CH_2OH \xrightarrow{ADH} CH_3CHO \xrightarrow{ALDH} CH_3COOH}$. Isibindi sesikhulu esiqhelekileyo sinokwaqhawula kuphela malunga ne-$7\ \mathrm{g}$ yotywala obucocekileyo ngeyure.
c-100.example: Ukwaqhawula ibhotile enye ye-soju (malunga ne-360mL, utywala malunga ne-50g) kuthatha isibindi ngaphezu kweeyure ezi-7. Amanzi anciphisa kuphela ukuphelelwa ngamanzi, akakhawulezisi ukwaqhawula.
c-100.actionItem: Namhla, ukuba unomsitho wotywala, sela ikomityi yamanzi kunye uze umisele umlinganiselo wotywala.

c-101.title: Umlilo wekhempu kufuneka ucinywe ngamanzi ngokupheleleyo
c-101.summary: Ukuze kubekho umlilo kufuneka ipetroli, ioksijini nobushushu, kwaye ukususa nje enye kuyawucima. Thulula amanzi anele phezu kweenkuni uze uvuselele, ujonge ukuba umlotha uyabanda ukuthintela ukuvutha kwakhona.
c-101.principle: Ezintathu zomlilo, amanzi ayawucima ngokususa ubushushu. Ubushushu be-evaporation bamanzi $\approx 2.26\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$ bufunxa kakhulu ubushushu beenkuni ezivuthayo.
c-101.example: Isiqwenga esinye sengeqolo (malunga ne-100g) sikhupha ubushushu obungamanani e-MJ, kwaye ukuthulula amanzi e-1L kufunxa ubuninzi malunga ne-2.3MJ njengobushushu be-evaporation. Thulula de ungabi nabushushu xa usondeza umva wesandla.
c-101.actionItem: Xa usebenzisa umlilo ngaphandle, nyusa ibhakethi yamanzi kwangaphambili ngaphambi kokucoca.

c-102.title: I-sodium kwitheyibhile yesondlo × 2.54 = ubungakanani betyuwa
c-102.summary: Inani le-sodium ayiyiyo ityuwa (sodium chloride), kodwa bubunzima be-ion ye-sodium. Ukuyiguqula ibe yityuwa kwenza isixa sosuku sivakale ngakumbi.
c-102.principle: Ukwahlula ubunzima be-molar ye-NaCl 58.44g/mol nge-22.99g/mol ye-Na kunika malunga ne-2.54, ngoko ukuphindaphinda i-sodium nge-2.54 kunika ubungakanani betyuwa. $m_{\mathrm{NaCl}}=m_{\mathrm{Na}}\times\frac{58.44}{22.99}\approx 2.54\,m_{\mathrm{Na}}$
c-102.example: Ipakethe enye ye-ramen enesodium engama-1,800mg ilingana netyuwa malunga ne-4.6g, ethatha uninzi lwe-WHO elicetyiswayo letyuwa yemihla ngemihla engaphantsi kwe-5g (sodium 2,000mg).
c-102.actionItem: Namhla, phindaphinda i-sodium mg yokutya okukodwa okucutshungulweyo ekhaya nge-2.54 ukuyiguqula ibe yi-g yetyuwa.

c-103.title: Ii-noodles zinokupheliswa ngokucima umlilo nokusebenzisa ubushushu obusele
c-103.summary: Emva kokubilisa ii-noodles emanzini abilayo imizuzu emi-2~3, ukucima umlilo nokugquma ibhodlo kusavumela isitatshi ukuba siqhubeke sivuthwa. Yindlela yokunciphisa ukusetyenziswa kwegesi.
c-103.principle: I-gelatinization yesitatshi iqala kwi-60~70℃ malunga kwaye iqhubeka ngelixa ubushushu bamanzi bugcinwa ngaphezu kwe-90℃. Isantya sempendulo sikhawuleza ngakumbi xa ubushushu buphezulu.
c-103.example: Emva kokucima umlilo, amanzi ebhodleni elinesigqubuthelo ehla kuphela malunga ne-5~8℃ kwimizuzu emi-5 ngoko i-gelatinization yesitatshi iyaqhubeka. Unokunciphisa ixesha lokusebenzisa igesi ngemizuzu emi-3~4.
c-103.actionItem: Namhla, xa ubilisa i-pasta okanye ii-noodles, cima umlilo emva kwesibini kwezintathu zexesha elibhalwe kwiphakheji uze ugqume ibhodlo.

c-104.title: Ukujonga iintyatyambo ezintsha ixesha elide ngeswekile neviniga encinci emanzini evazi
c-104.summary: Iintyatyambo ezisikiweyo ziphefumla zitshise iswekile. Ukunika iswekile ebuthathaka ne-asidi kuzalisa isondlo kwaye kunciphisa iintsholongwane emanzini.
c-104.principle: Iintyatyambo ezisikiweyo zisebenzisa i-glucose njengamandla ngokuphefumla, kwaye amanzi e-asidi ebuthathaka (pH malunga ne-3.5~4) acothisa ukuvaleka kwemisesane ngokwanda kweentsholongwane. $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}+6\,\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow 6\,\mathrm{CO_2}+6\,\mathrm{H_2O}$
c-104.example: Ukuxuba i-10g (1%) yeswekile ne-5mL yeviniga kwilitha enye yamanzi kwenza i-pH ibe malunga ne-3.7, kwaye ukutshintsha amanzi rhoqo ngeentsuku ezi-2 kudla ngokunyusa iintsuku ezimbalwa.
c-104.actionItem: Namhla, tshintsha amanzi evazi abe yi-1L yamanzi acocekileyo, i-10g yeswekile, i-5mL yeviniga uze usike isiphelo sesiqu ngokutyibilika.

c-105.title: Susa ukunamathela kwesitikha ngeoli yokupheka
c-105.summary: Umkhondo onamathelayo osalayo emva kokususa ileyibhile awususeki ngamanzi kodwa unyibilika ngeoli. Uninzi luyasonjululwa ngaphandle kwesinyibilikisi esinamandla.
c-105.principle: Iglu yi-polymer engeyiyo i-polar, ngoko ayinyibiliki emanzini e-polar, kodwa ixuba kakuhle neoli engeyiyo i-polar (okufanayo kunyibilikisa okufanayo). $\delta_{\text{oil}}\approx\delta_{\text{adhesive}}\;\Rightarrow\;\text{like dissolves like}$
c-105.example: Ukufaka amaconsi ambalwa eoli yokupheka kumkhondo, ulinde imizuzu emi-5 uze ucoce, uze ususe amafutha ngesepha yeendishi kususa uninzi lweemikhondo zeleyibhile zeglasi·zeceramic.
c-105.actionItem: Namhla, faka ioli yokupheka kumkhondo onamathelayo webhotile okanye isitya, ulinde imizuzu emi-5 uze ucoce (i-acetone inokonakalisa iplastiki).

c-106.title: Amantongomane ahlala eqala ukuvunda ngenxa ye-oxidation yamafutha angaphelelanga
c-106.summary: Iiasidi zamafutha ezingapheleleyo zamantongomane neoli yesesame ziyaoksidayiza xa zidibana nomoya zenze ivumba elibi. Ukuvala nokuqhwaba kucotha ukuvunda iinyanga ezimbalwa.
c-106.principle: I-autoxidation ye-lipid: iqala nge-$\mathrm{RH + O_2 \to ROOH}$ kwaye kuvela ii-aldehydes zibangele ivumba. Isantya sempendulo sincipha malunga nesiqingatha xa ubushushu buhla nge-10℃ ngasinye.
c-106.example: Kwi-25℃ yobushushu begumbi iinkozo zeewalnuts ziqala ukuba nencasa evundileyo emva kweeveki ezimbalwa~iinyanga ezimbalwa, kodwa ngokugcina kwifriza e--18℃ kwikhontena evaliweyo kunokuba yiinyanga ezi-6~12. Ukuba kukho ukukrakra·ivumba elibi, yilahle.
c-106.actionItem: Namhla, faka amantongomane aseleyo kwibhegi ye-zip okanye kwikhontena evaliweyo uze uwabeke kwifriza.

c-107.title: Ubushushu bunciphisa ukucaphuka kwendawo ehlatywe yingcongconi
c-107.summary: Xa isitshisi singena emzimbeni, impendulo yomzimba ikhupha i-histamine yenze ukudumba nokuqaqanjelwa. Ukubeka ubushushu be-50℃ imizuzwana embalwa kwenza iiprotheyini zesitshisi zitshintshe kwaye uphawu lokuqaqanjelwa luyancipha.
c-107.principle: I-histamine $\mathrm{C_5H_9N_3}$ icaphukisa iziphelo zemithambo yemizwa, kwaye ubushushu bukhulula ulwakhiwo lwe-tertiary lweeprotheyini zesitshisi, kunciphisa impendulo (thermal denaturation).
c-107.example: Kuxelwa ukuba ukubeka i-heat patch ye-50℃ malunga nemizuzwana eli-10 kunciphisa ukuqaqanjelwa iiyure ezimbalwa. Ukuthintela ukutshiswa, ungabeki into eshushu ngqo kulusu ixesha elide.
c-107.actionItem: Kolu hambo, thatha i-anti-itch relief okanye i-cooling gel yokusetyenziswa xa uhlatywa yingcongconi.

c-108.title: I-potassium sorbate kwileyibhile yokutya yi-preservative ethintela imolds
c-108.summary: I-potassium sorbate yi-preservative ethintela imolds nentlaka kwindawo ene-asidi, esetyenziswa kwi-cheese, iziselo, nesonka. Ngaphakathi komda ovunyelweyo kuvavanywa njengokukhuselekileyo, kodwa abantu abakrokrelayo bangakujonga izithako.
c-108.principle: I-sorbic acid ($\mathrm{C_5H_7COOH}$, $pK_a = 4.76$) ixhomekeke kwi-pH ephantsi, kuba i-non-dissociated form inyuka ingene kwi-cell membrane yenze isiphumo.
c-108.example: Kwi-pH 4.8, malunga ne-50% ye-sorbic acid yi-non-dissociated form esebenzayo, kodwa kwi-pH 6.8 yi-1% kuphela. Ngoko isebenza kakuhle kwiindawo zokutya ezine-asidi.
c-108.actionItem: Namhla, fumana uphawu lwe-preservatives kuluhlu lwezithako zokutya ezibini ozityayo rhoqo.

c-109.title: Iibhetri ezisetyenzisiweyo azilahlwa njengenkunkuma eqhelekileyo, ziya kwibhokisi yokuqokelela
c-109.summary: Iibhetri ziqulathe isinyithi esifana ne-zinc, i-manganese, ne-nickel, ngoko ukuba zingcwatyelwa njengenkunkuma eqhelekileyo zingangena emhlabeni. Ngokuzibuthelela kwibhokisi yokuqokelela iibhetri ezisetyenzisiweyo, izinyithi zinokubuyiselwa.
c-109.principle: Impendulo yebhetri ye-alkaline: $\mathrm{Zn + 2MnO_2 + H_2O \to ZnO + 2MnOOH}$. Ezi zinyithi xa zibuyiselwa ziba zizibonelelo ezintsha.
c-109.example: Ibhetri enye ye-AA ibhetri enobunzima be-23g malunga kwaye ngaphezu kwe-20% yazo yizinyithi ezifana ne-zinc ne-manganese. Ukuqokelela i-100 kunokubuyisela kwi-2.3kg yeebhetri inani elikhulu lezinyithi.
c-109.actionItem: Namhla, buthelela iibhetri ezisetyenzisiweyo ekhaya kwikhontena enye uze uzise kwibhokisi yokuqokelela yangakuni.

c-110.title: Iswekile emdaka eqinileyo ibuyiselwa ngesilayi sesonka
c-110.summary: Iswekile emdaka iqina kuba amanzi ngaphakathi kwe-molasses ayaphuma kwaye iikristali zinamathelana. Ukuyivala kunye nesilayi sesonka okanye ithawula lekhitshi elimanzi kubuyisa amanzi ize ithambe.
c-110.principle: Iswekile ifunxa ukufuma, ngoko itsala umphunga $\mathrm{H_2O(g)}$ kwaye ifilimu ye-molasses ephezu komphezulu iphinde ithambe. Ukulingana kufezekiswa phakathi koxinzelelo lomphunga emoyeni nomphezulu weswekile.
c-110.example: Ukuba ufaka isilayi esinye sesonka kwi-500g yeswekile emdaka eqinileyo uze uyivale, idla ngokuthamba ngaphakathi kosuku olunye. Ukuba uphangile, gquma ngethawula lephepha elimanzi uze ufudumeze kwi-microwave imizuzwana engama-20.
c-110.actionItem: Namhla, ukuba unayo iswekile eqinileyo, yifake kwikhontena evaliweyo kunye nesilayi sesonka.

c-111.title: I-kelp ifaka incasa ye-umami ngakumbi ngokuthanjiswa ixesha elide emanzini abandayo
c-111.summary: I-glutamic acid ye-kelp iphuma kancinci nakwamanzi abandayo, kwaye ukubilisa kakhulu kukhupha i-mucilage yenze isitokhwe sibe mdaka nesinamathelayo. Ukuyithanjisa emanzini abandayo imizuzu engaphezu kwe-30 uze uyikhuphe ngaphambi kokubila kubangela isitokhwe esicacileyo.
c-111.principle: I-glutamic acid $\mathrm{HOOC{-}CH_2CH_2{-}CH(NH_2){-}COOH}$ inyibilika emanzini, kwaye ii-polysaccharides ze-mucilage ezifana ne-alginic acid zinyibilika kakhulu xa zibiliswa ixesha elide.
c-111.example: Ukuba ufaka iziqwenga ezi-2 ze-kelp ye-10cm kwilitha enye yamanzi imizuzu engama-30 uze uzikhuphe xa amanzi eqala ukubila (malunga ne-90℃), incasa ye-umami iphuma ngokwaneleyo. I-kelp ekhutshiweyo inokusetyenziswa kwakhona kwisitya esibhukiweyo.
c-111.actionItem: Namhla ngokuhlwa, xa wenza isitokhwe, cwilisa i-kelp emanzini abandayo imizuzu engama-30 uze ubilise.

c-112.title: Umbala wesilwa ubonisa ukuba usele amanzi anele na
c-112.summary: Umbala obhlowu wesilwa ubangelwa yipigment ebizwa ngokuba yi-urochrome kwaye iba mnyama xa amanzi encinci. Ukuba umbala ophuzi okhanyayo, ngokuqhelekileyo kuthetha ukuba usela ngokwaneleyo.
c-112.principle: Ekuxineni $c = \dfrac{n}{V}$, xa ukusela amanzi kuncipha $V$ kuba mncinci, i-urochrome enexabiso elifanayo $n$ ibonakala ibe mnyama ngakumbi.
c-112.example: Ukuba ubungakanani besilwa ngemini yi-1.5L malunga kwaye umbala ukhanya njengomququ, ngokuqhelekileyo kwanele. Umbala we-amber omnyama uphawu lokusela amanzi amaninzi, kodwa xa uthatha i-vitamin B okanye amayeza umbala unokutshintsha.
c-112.actionItem: Namhla, jonga umbala wesilwa kanye, kwaye ukuba mnyama, sela ikomityi yamanzi.

c-113.title: Amanqanaba epetroli yi-octane, sebenzisa efanelekileyo kwimoto yakho
c-113.summary: I-octane yinani lokuba ipetroli inyamezela kangakanani ukukhomba (knocking) xa icinezelwa. Ukuba incwadi yemoto inenqanaba elicetyiswayo, ukugalela ipetroli ebizayo ngaphezu kwalo akusebenzi.
c-113.principle: I-octane yixabiso lokuthelekisa ukumelana ne-knocking ngomgangatho apho i-isooctane ($\mathrm{C_8H_{18}}$) ithathwa njengo-100 ne-heptane njengo-0.
c-113.example: Ukuba incwadi yemoto icebisa i-octane 91 (eqhelekileyo) kwaye ugalela i-94 (ephezulu), ibiza kuphela amawon amakhulu ambalwa ngelitha ngalinye kwaye ukusebenza akunyuki. Sebenzisa eyona ephezulu kuphela xa kufunwa, njengakwiinjini ezicinezelwa kakhulu.
c-113.actionItem: Namhla, jonga i-octane ecetyiswayo kwincwadi yemoto okanye kwileyibhile engaphakathi kwesiciko sepetroli.

c-114.title: Izithako ezipheleleyo zezinto zokuzenzela ziyabhalwa ngokulandelelana kwenani
c-114.summary: Izithako ezipheleleyo kwileyibhile yezinto zokuzenzela ezingaphezu kwe-1% zibhalwe ngokulandelelana kwenani elininzi, ezingaphantsi kwe-1% zingabhalwa kungekho ndlela ethile. Izithako ezimbalwa zokuqala zenza uninzi lwemveliso, ngoko ukuba isithako sentengiso sisemva, umxholo uncinci.
c-114.principle: Uninzi lweemveliso lunamanzi ($\mathrm{H_2O}$) njengesithako sokuqala. Ukuba ukuxinana ⟦$w = \dfrac{m_{\text{isithako}}}{m_{\text{iyonke}}} \times 100\%$⟧ kungaphantsi kwe-1%, ukubhala kungabi nalandelelwano kuyavunyelwa.
c-114.example: Ukuba izithako ezipheleleyo ze-toner zilandelelana kumanzi, i-glycerin, i-butylene glycol, izithako ezintathu zokuqala zinokwenza ngaphezu kwe-90% yemveliso. Ukuba isithako sentengiso sisekugqibeleni, ngokuqhelekileyo singaphantsi kwe-1%.
c-114.actionItem: Namhla, funda izithako ezintlanu zokuqala kuluhlu lwezithako ezipheleleyo zento yokuzenzela oyisebenzisayo.

c-115.title: Ukutya kwekhempu kufuneka kudlule ngokukhawuleza kwi-4~60℃
c-115.summary: Iintsholongwane zandile ngokukhawuleza kwi-4~60℃ malunga, oku kubizwa ngokuba yi-danger zone. Ekukhempeni, ukutya kwenyama neqanda kufuneka kugcinwe kwibhokisi yeqhwa ngaphantsi kwe-4℃ kwaye xa upheka kufuneka kufudunyezwe ngokwaneleyo kude kube sembindini.
c-115.principle: Inani leentsholongwane lonyuka $N = N_0 \cdot 2^{t/t_d}$. I-E. coli kufutshane ne-37℃ ngamanye amaxesha iphindwe kabini rhoqo ngemizuzu engama-20.
c-115.example: Ekutyeni okushiywe iiyure ezi-2 kwi-30℃ yobushushu begumbi ebusika, iintsholongwane zinokuba malunga ne-$2^{6} = 64$ amaxesha. Pheka inyama kubushushu bomgubo we-75℃ okanye ngaphezulu imizuzu eli-1 okanye ngaphezulu.
c-115.actionItem: Kule khempu, zalisa ibhokisi yeqhwa ngeqhwa uze uthathe nethemometha.

c-116.title: Ukongeza ityuwa emanzini e-noodles akuvusi kakhulu indawo yokubila
c-116.summary: Ukuthi ityuwa yenza amanzi ashushu ngakumbi yingqondo engeyiyo. Ukuze usindise igesi, isigqubuthelo nomlilo omncinci ziyasebenza endaweni yetyuwa.
c-116.principle: Kukho i-'boiling point elevation' apho izinto ezinyibilikileyo ezininzi zenyusa indawo yokubila, kodwa inani lincinci kakhulu. $\Delta T_b=i\,K_b\,m=2\times0.512\times0.171\approx0.17\ \mathrm{K}$
c-116.example: Nokuba ufaka i-10g yetyuwa kwilitha enye yamanzi, indawo yokubila inyuka kuphela malunga ne-0.17°C, ngoko ixesha lokupheka alitshintshi, incasa kuphela ilungiswa.
c-116.actionItem: Namhla, xa ubilisa ii-noodles, sebenzisa ityuwa kuphela ukulungisa incasa, kwaye xa ibilile gquma uze unciphise umlilo.

c-117.title: Amabala engca, kuqala i-alcohol emva koko isepha ene-enzyme
c-117.summary: Ibala legqabi lixube i-chlorophyll (isithako samafutha) neprotheyini, ngoko alihambi ngamanzi kuphela. Ukulandela uluhlu lonyango kuphela kwenza lihambe kakuhle.
c-117.principle: I-chlorophyll inyibilika kwi-ethanol, kwaye amabala eprotheyini aqhekezwa yi-protease yesepha ene-enzyme abe ziipeptides. Amanzi ashushu enza iiprotheyini zibe nzima zingasuki. $\text{protein stain}+\mathrm{H_2O}\xrightarrow{\ \text{protease}\ }\text{peptides}$
c-117.example: Ukufaka i-ethanol ye-70% kwibala imizuzu emi-5 uze uhlambe ngesepha ene-enzyme kumanzi e-30~40°C kwenza amabala engca ancipha kakhulu.
c-117.actionItem: Namhla, faka i-ethanol yokuthomalalisa kwibala lengca imizuzu emi-5 uze uhlambe kwi-30~40°C (jonga utshintsho lombala kuqala kwindawo engabonakaliyo).

c-118.title: I-iron yesipinatshi ifunxwa ngakumbi xa itshiwe nelamuni
c-118.summary: I-iron yezityalo (non-heme iron) ayifunxwa kakuhle, kodwa i-vitamin C iyiguqula ibe yifom enokufunxwa. I-tannin yetiyi·ikofu iyathintela ukufunxwa.
c-118.principle: I-non-heme iron ikho kakhulu $\mathrm{Fe^{3+}}$ ngelixa emathunjini $\mathrm{Fe^{2+}}$ kuphela ifunxwa, kwaye i-vitamin C inciphisa i-iron ye-3+ ibe yi-2+ yenze i-chelate ne-iron. $\mathrm{Fe^{3+}}+\text{ascorbate}\rightarrow\mathrm{Fe^{2+}}+\text{dehydroascorbate}$
c-118.example: Ukudibanisa i-vitamin C engama-100mg malunga (ngamaqhekeza elamuni enye) ekutyeni kunokwandisa ukufunxwa kwe-non-heme iron ngamaxesha angama-2~3.
c-118.actionItem: Namhla, fafaza ijusi yelamuni kwisitya sesipinatshi okanye iimbotyi, kwaye usele itiyi okanye ikofu iyure e-1 emva kokutya.

c-119.title: Ukupholisa iziselo ngokukhawuleza ngaphandle ngeqhwa netyuwa
c-119.summary: Ukuxuba ityuwa neqhwa kwehlisa ubushushu kakhulu ngaphantsi kwe-0°C, iziselo ziyabanda ngaphakathi kwemizuzu embalwa. Ungayisebenzisa endaweni yefriji kwi-picnic.
c-119.principle: Ngokuhla kwendawo yokunyibilika, amanzi anyibilike ngetyuwa aqhwaba kuphela kubushushu obungaphantsi kwe-0°C, iqhwa linyibilika lifunxa ubushushu ngaphandle bunciphe (indawo ye-eutectic -21°C). $\Delta T_f=i\,K_f\,m,\quad K_f=1.86\ \mathrm{K\,kg\,mol^{-1}}$
c-119.example: Ukuxuba iqhwa netyuwa ngobunzima be-3:1 kwehlisa ukuya malunga ne--15~-20°C, kwaye ukufaka ikani uyijikeleze kuyipholisa ukuya malunga ne-5°C ngaphakathi kwemizuzu embalwa.
c-119.actionItem: Kwi-picnic yanamhla, xuba iqhwa 3 : ityuwa 1 kwibhokisi yeqhwa uqengqeleke ikani yesiselo imizuzu emi-3~5 (jonga ukuba ikani ayiqhwabi iqhume).

c-120.title: Nokuba inyama imdaka, ayizange ibolile ngoko nangoko
c-120.summary: Umbala wenyama ugqitywa yimeko ye-iron ye-myoglobin kwaye awuhambelani rhoqo nokutsha. Jonga umhla nevumba kunye.
c-120.principle: I-oxymyoglobin edibene neoksijini ibomvu, kwaye xa i-iron ioksidayiza iba yi-metmyoglobin emdaka. Ngaphakathi kwephakheji ye-vacuum·eqiqileyo ioksijini incinci ngoko ibomvu obumnyama. $\mathrm{Mb}(\mathrm{Fe^{2+}})+\mathrm{O_2}\rightleftharpoons\mathrm{MbO_2}$ (obomvu), $\mathrm{Mb}\rightarrow\mathrm{metMb}(\mathrm{Fe^{3+}})$ (obumdaka)
c-120.example: Inyama yenkomo egayiweyo xa idibana nomoya iba bomvu ngaphakathi kwemizuzu eli-15~30, kwaye emva kweentsuku ezimbalwa efrijini inokuba mdaka, kodwa umbala kuphela awuyanele ukugweba ukuba ibolile.
c-120.actionItem: Namhla, xa uthenga inyama, jonga hayi umbala kuphela kodwa umhla wokuphelelwa, imeko yephakheji, ivumba elimuncu kunye nokunamathela.

c-121.title: Igalikhi kufuneka ipheke imizuzu eli-10 emva kokusikwa ukuze i-allicin ihlale
c-121.summary: Xa usika okanye utyumza igalikhi, i-enzyme alliinase iguqula i-alliin ibe yi-allicin, kwaye le allicin yisiseko sezithako zegalikhi ezilwa neentsholongwane nezempilo. Ukuyifudumeza ngoko nangoko kuyayeka i-enzyme, ngoko i-allicin incinci.
c-121.principle: I-alliin ⟦$\xrightarrow{\text{alliinase}}$⟧ i-allicin ($\mathrm{C_6H_{10}OS_2}$). I-enzyme iguqulwa kakhulu ngokukhawuleza ngaphezu kwe-60~70℃.
c-121.example: Kuxelwa ukuba igalikhi egayiweyo ishiywe imizuzu eli-10 ngaphambi kokupheka ihlala izithako ezivela kwi-allicin ezininzi ngamaxesha aliqela kunokuba ipheke ngoko nangoko. Nciphisa umlinganiselo wexesha elinye ube ngama-1~2 ezigalikhi.
c-121.actionItem: Namhla, ukuba usebenzisa igalikhi ekuphekeni, yisike uyishiye imizuzu eli-10 ngaphambi kokufudumeza.

c-122.title: Ioli yokuthosa ehluziweyo egcinwe kwindawo emnyama ixesha elide
c-122.summary: Ioli ivunda xa ichaphazeleka bubushushu·ukukhanya·ioksijini yenze ivumba elibi. Ukugcina kuphela ngokufanelekileyo kuthintela ukonakalisa ioli.
c-122.principle: Iiasidi zamafutha ezingapheleleyo ziyaoksidayiza ngempendulo yekhonkco le-radical zenze ii-peroxides nee-aldehydes. Ukufudumeza neentsalela zokutya kukhawulezisa impendulo. $\mathrm{R}\cdot+\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow\mathrm{ROO}\cdot,\ \ \mathrm{ROO}\cdot+\mathrm{RH}\rightarrow\mathrm{ROOH}+\mathrm{R}\cdot$
c-122.example: Ioli yokupheka ene-unsaturation ephezulu isetyenziswe ngaphakathi kweenyanga ezi-3 emva kokuvula, kwaye ioli yokuthosa ihluzwe iintsalela kwaye isetyenziswe kuphela amaxesha angama-2~3.
c-122.actionItem: Namhla, hluza ioli yokuthosa oyisebenzisileyo ngesihluzi sekofu uze uyigcine ebotileni emnyama kwindawo epholileyo, kwaye ukuba kukho ivumba lepeyinti, yilahle.

c-123.title: Nesitainless steel iyabhibha xa isuphu enetyuwa ishiywe ixesha elide
c-123.summary: I-stainless steel ayibhibhi ngenxa yomaleko omncinci we-chromium oxide, kodwa xa ii-chloride ions zidlula kuwo, kwenziwa imingxuma emincinci neendawo zomhlwa.
c-123.principle: Xa i-chromium ingaphezu kwe-10.5%, kwenziwa umaleko $\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$ phezu komphezulu, kwaye ukuba kukho i-oxygen uyazilungisa, kodwa $\mathrm{Cl^-}$ ibhubhisa umaleko kwiindawo ezithile, idale ukukhukhuleka (pitting). $\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}\ (1\text{-}5\ \mathrm{nm\ film})\ +\ \mathrm{Cl^-}\rightarrow\text{pitting}$
c-123.example: I-316 equlethe i-molybdenum eyi-2% inamandla kakhulu emanzini anetyuwa kune-304 (i-chromium malunga ne-18%, i-nickel 8%). Ukushiya amanzi anetyuwa iiyure ezimbalwa kunokubangela ukubhibha okunamachaphaza.
c-123.actionItem: Namhlanje hlamba ngoko nangoko ipoti ye-stainless steel obuyisebenzisele isuphu okanye ukutya okunetyuwa, uze usule uyomise.

c-124.title: Ikofu yangokuhlwa isashiyeka ngaphezu kwesiqingatha ebusuku
c-124.summary: I-caffeine ishiya umzimba kancinci, ngoko ikofu yasemva ixesha ichaphazela ukulala ebusuku. Ukuphakamisa ixesha lekofu yokugqibela kuphela kuyanceda.
c-124.principle: I-caffeine inesiqingatha sobomi malunga neeyure ezi-5 (3~7), kwaye inciphisa ngomlinganiselo ofanayo njengempendulo yokuqala. $C(t)=C_0\left(\tfrac12\right)^{t/t_{1/2}},\quad t_{1/2}\approx5\ \mathrm{h}$
c-124.example: Ukuba usela i-150mg yecaffeine ngentsimbi yesi-3 emva kwemini, emva kweeyure ezi-8 ngentsimbi yeye-11 ebusuku kusashiyeka malunga nama-50mg (1/3). Isixa esipheleleyo sosuku esicetyiswayo siphantsi kwama-400mg.
c-124.actionItem: Namhlanje phawula isiselo sokugqibela esine-caffeine ukuba sibe zii-8 iiyure phambi kokulala, emva koko usele i-decaf okanye iti yebhali.

c-125.title: Entabeni ephakamileyo amanzi abila kwi-95°C, ukupheka kuyacotha
c-125.summary: Ngokunyuka kokuphakama, uxinzelelo lomoya luyehla ngoko amanzi abila kubushushu obuphantsi. Esi sesona sizathu sokuba i-noodle yekomityi okanye irayisi ingaphekwa kakuhle.
c-125.principle: Xa uxinzelelo lwemo yomoya luyehla, indawo yokubilisa iyehla (malunga ne-3.3°C ngemitha eyi-1,000). Ukusebenzisa umgaqo wamava wokuba isantya sempendulo siphindwa kabini ngamanqanaba ali-10°C, ixesha lokupheka liyanda. $\Delta T_b\approx -3.3\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}\ \text{per}\ 1000\ \mathrm{m};\quad \frac{t'}{t}\approx 2^{\Delta T/10}$
c-125.example: Kwi-1,500m ngaphezu komgangatho wolwandle, amanzi abila malunga nama-95°C, isantya siba ngu-$2^{-0.5}\approx0.7$ amaxesha, ngoko ixesha lokupheka landa malunga nama-40%.
c-125.actionItem: Ukuba unecebo lokunyuka intaba namhlanje, bhala phantsi ukuba ixesha lenoodle yekomityi libe malunga nama-1.4 amaxesha, nerayisi ipheke ixesha elide ngesigqubuthelo.

c-126.title: Musa ukufudumeza ipani enengubo engenanto ngomlilo omkhulu
c-126.summary: Ingubo ye-Teflon (PTFE) izinzile kude kube malunga ne-260°C, kodwa ngaphezulu kwaloo nto iyahlukana ize ikhuphe umphunga owenzakalisayo. Ekhaya, ukufudumeza ipani engenanto ngomlilo omkhulu sesona sizathu sixhaphakileyo.
c-126.principle: I-PTFE izinzile kuba iibhondi ze-C-F zinamandla kakhulu, kodwa ngaphezulu kwe-300°C malunga iyahlukana ikhuphe irhasi enefluorine ebulalayo kwiintaka. $-(\mathrm{CF_2\text{-}CF_2})_n-,\quad E_{\mathrm{C\text{-}F}}\approx485\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$
c-126.example: Ipani engenanto kumlilo omkhulu ngamanye amaxesha ifikelela ngaphezu kwama-300°C kwimizuzu emi-2~5. Ukuba usebenzisa umlilo ophakathi ngeoli okanye izithako, uninzi lugcinwa ngaphantsi kwama-200°C.
c-126.actionItem: Namhlanje sebenzisa ipani enengubo ngomlilo ophakathi okanye ophantsi, tshiza ioli kuqala, ungayifudumezi ingenanto, kwaye ungasebenzisi izixhobo zentsimbi.

c-127.title: Ukusela iviniga engadityaniswanga kunyibilikisa i-enamel yamazinyo
c-127.summary: I-pH yeviniga malunga ne-2.5, iphantsi kakhulu kune-pH 5.5 apho i-enamel yamazinyo iqala ukunyibilika. Ukuba uyasela, ihlambulule kakhulu uze uhlambe ngamanzi emva kokusela, kukhuselekile.
c-127.principle: Ukunyibilika kwe-enamel yamazinyo: $\mathrm{Ca_{10}(PO_4)_6(OH)_2 + 14H^+ \to 10Ca^{2+} + 6H_2PO_4^- + 2H_2O}$. Xa $\mathrm{pH} = -\log[\mathrm{H^+}]$ iphantsi, ikhawuleza ukunyibilika.
c-127.example: Iviniga ene-pH 2.5 ine-hydrogen ion concentration ephezulu ngamaxesha angama-1000 kune-pH 5.5. Xuba ipunu enkulu yeviniga kwi-200mL yamanzi okanye ngaphezulu, usele ngomququ, kwaye ugcobe amazinyo emva kwemizuzu engama-30.
c-127.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba usela iviniga okanye isiselo esimuncu, hlamba ngamanzi kanye uze ugcobe amazinyo emva kwemizuzu engama-30.

c-128.title: Gcina isonka sesliced efrizeni, hayi kwifriji
c-128.summary: Isonka siba lukhuni hayi ngokoma, kodwa kuba i-starch iphinda ikristali, kwaye oku kwenzeka ngokukhawuleza kakhulu kwifriji.
c-128.principle: Ukuguga kwe-starch (retrogradation), apho i-amylose ne-amylopectin iphinda ihlengahlengiswe ngokufanelekileyo, kwenzeka ngokukhawuleza kwi-0~5°C kwaye kuphantse kuyeke ngaphantsi kwe--18°C. $\text{amylose/amylopectin recrystallization (retrogradation)},\ \text{fastest at }0\text{-}5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$
c-128.example: Isonka sobushushu begumbi sihlala iintsuku ezi-2~3, isonka sefriji siqina ngokukhawuleza, kodwa ukukhenkceza kwi--18°C kugcina malunga neenyanga ezi-3, kwaye ukufudumeza ngaphezulu kwama-60°C kunyibilikisa iikristali isonka sithambe.
c-128.actionItem: Namhlanje hlula isonka esishiyekileyo sibe ngamaqhekeza ngamaqhekeza uze uwakhenkceze, uze uwafudumeze kwakhona ngetosta okanye isitimu.

c-129.title: Iindawo ezibomvu zetamatisi kwisitya sepulasitiki kukhululwa ngelanga neoli
c-129.summary: Umbala obomvu wesosi yetamatisi uxubeka kakuhle neoli uze ungene kwipulasitiki. Ioli ne-ultraviolet isebenza ngcono kunamanzi.
c-129.principle: I-lycopene ngumbala ongenapolarity ongena kwipulasitiki, kwaye iibhondi ezili-11 ezidityanisiweyo zifunxa ukukhanya zibonakale zibomvu, kodwa i-ultraviolet iqhawula ezi bhondi iyenze ingabi nambala. $\text{lycopene (11 conjugated C=C)}\xrightarrow{h\nu}\text{colourless fragments}$
c-129.example: Hlikihla ithonsi leoli, ulihlambe ngesepha yokuhlamba izitya, uze ulibeke elangeni iiyure ezi-2~3, uninzi lunciphisa.
c-129.actionItem: Namhlanje yenza ithonsi leoli yokupheka kwisitya sepulasitiki esichithelweyo, usule, uhlambe ngesepha, uze usibeke efestileni elangeni iiyure ezi-2~3 (ukusebenzisa iglasi ukususela ekuqaleni kuyakuthintela).

c-130.title: Kuhudo nokuphelelwa ngamanzi, i-oral rehydration solution ene-ityuwa neswekile
c-130.summary: Xa i-glucose ne-sodium zifunxwa kunye, amanzi ayalandela. Isebenza kakhulu ekubuyiseleni amanzi kunokusela amanzi kuphela.
c-130.principle: Isithuthi se-SGLT1 sezicubu zomsipha sithwala imolekyuli enye ye-glucose ne-sodium ezimbini kunye, kwaye amanzi alandela ngokufunxwa nge-osmosis. $\mathrm{SGLT1}:\ 1\ \text{glucose}+2\ \mathrm{Na^+}\rightarrow\text{water uptake}$
c-130.example: Iresiphi yekhaya ye-WHO yi-1L yamanzi abilisiweyo abandayo kunye nezipunu ezincinci ezi-6 zeswekile (malunga nama-25g) kunye nesiqingatha sepunu encinci yetyuwa (malunga nama-3g). Ukuba ukuphelelwa ngamanzi kukhulu, ngabantwana abancinci, okanye kunomkhuhlane, yiya esibhedlele.
c-130.actionItem: Namhlanje lungiselela ipakethi enye okanye ezimbini ze-ORS ezithengiswayo kwibhokisi yamayeza asekhaya.

c-131.title: Ukutsha kwamehlo echibini lokuqubha kubangelwa yi-chloramine, hayi i-chlorine
c-131.summary: Amehlo abomvu akubangelwa yimpawu eyomeleleyo yechibini, kodwa yi-chloramine eyenzeka xa idibana nokubila nomchamo. Ukuhlamba ngaphambili sesona sithintelo sikhulu.
c-131.principle: I-chlorine emanzini iba yi-hypochlorous acid (HOCl) ukwenza i-disinfect, kwaye xa idibana ne-ammonia nitrogen yenza i-chloramine ebangela ukucaphuka. Kwi-pH 7.5, i-HOCl ingama-50% malunga. $\mathrm{Cl_2}+\mathrm{H_2O}\rightleftharpoons\mathrm{HOCl}+\mathrm{H^+}+\mathrm{Cl^-},\quad \mathrm{HOCl}\rightleftharpoons\mathrm{H^+}+\mathrm{OCl^-}\ (\mathrm{p}K_a\approx7.5)$
c-131.example: Iipharamitha ezicetyiswayo zechibini yi-pH 7.2~7.8 kunye ne-free chlorine ye-1~3ppm. Ukuhlamba ngesepha umzuzu omnye phambi kokuqubha kunciphisa kakhulu izinto eziphilayo.
c-131.actionItem: Namhlanje phambi kokuya echibini, hlamba ngesepha umzuzu omnye, kwaye ungakhi umchamo ngexesha lokuqubha.

c-132.title: Bala ukuqina kwamanzi usebenzisa i-calcium ne-magnesium kwilebheli yamanzi enkonkxiweyo
c-132.summary: Nakumanzi enkonkxiweyo afanayo, ukuqina kuyahluka, ngoko incasa yekofu neti, kunye nenkunkuma yamanzi, ziyahluka. Iinombolo zelebheli kuphela zinokubonisa ukuba lamanzi athambileyo okanye aqinileyo.
c-132.principle: Ukuqina kuyixabiso lesixa se-calcium ne-magnesium ions oluguqulelwe kubunzima be-calcium carbonate. Kucetyiswa malunga ne-50~175mg/L ekwenzeni ikofu. $H=2.497\,[\mathrm{Ca}]+4.118\,[\mathrm{Mg}]\ (\mathrm{mg\,L^{-1}}\text{ as }\mathrm{CaCO_3})$
c-132.example: Amanzi ane-calcium eyi-80mg/L ne-magnesium eyi-26mg/L, $2.497\times80+4.118\times26\approx307$ mg/L, angamanzi aqinileyo kakhulu (ngaphezu kwe-180), ngoko inkunkuma yamanzi yenzeka lula kwikettle yombane.
c-132.actionItem: Namhlanje bala ukuqina usebenzisa amanani e-Ca ne-Mg kwilebheli yamanzi enkonkxiweyo oyiselayo.
