c-133.title: Ikhalori ngumshushu wokutsha, i-carb, i-protein, ne-fat zi-4, 4, 9kcal/g
c-133.summary: Ikhalori yokutya yaphawulwa ngobushushu obuphuma xa kutshiswa ngaphandle komzimba. Unokubala ikhalori ngqo kwi-g kwitheyibhile yesondlo.
c-133.principle: Xa imol e-1 ye-glucose itsha, ikhupha ama-2,803kJ (malunga nama-15.6kJ/g, 3.7kcal/g). Iimpawu zika-Atwater ziyi-4kcal/g kwi-carbohydrate ne-protein, ne-9kcal/g kwi-fat. $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}+6\,\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow6\,\mathrm{CO_2}+6\,\mathrm{H_2O},\ \Delta H=-2803\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}\approx3.7\ \mathrm{kcal\,g^{-1}}$
c-133.example: Isnack esine-carbohydrate eyi-50g, i-fat eyi-20g, ne-protein eyi-10g sineekhalori ezingama-$50\times4+20\times9+10\times4=420$ kcal.
c-133.actionItem: Namhlanje bala ngokwakho ikhalori yesnack enye usebenzisa i-g ye-carb, i-protein ne-fat kwitheyibhile yesondlo.

c-134.title: Ukomisa impahla elangeni kunefuthe lokuyenza ibe mhlophe
c-134.summary: I-ultraviolet yelanga ifaka i-oxidation kwaye iqhawule iindawo zombala ezishiyekileyo kwimicu, yenze iimpahla ezimhlophe zibe mhlophe ngakumbi. Nangaphandle kwe-sodium percarbonate, iindawo ezincinci zinokuncitshiswa ngelanga.
c-134.principle: Photo-oxidation: iifotoni ze-ultraviolet ziqhawula iibhondi $\pi$ zombala zenze iimpendulo ne-oxygen zenze izinto ezingenambala. Amandla e-photon $E = h\nu$ kufuneka abe mkhulu kuneenxalenye zamandla ebhondi.
c-134.example: Ukuba usasaza i-T-shirt emhlophe enamabala ngelixa imanzi elangeni ngqo iiyure ezi-4~6, amabala angaphantsi anciphisa ngokubonakalayo. Kodwa iimpahla ezinemibala zinokuphela ngokwaloo mgaqo, ngoko zomise zitshintshiwe.
c-134.actionItem: Namhlanje asasaze impahla emhlophe enamabala ngelixa imanzi kwindawo enelanga.

c-135.title: Ukuba i-super glue inamathele esandleni, cwiliswa emanzini anesepha
c-135.summary: I-super glue iqina ngenxa yokufuma kolusu, kodwa inokukhululwa kancinci ngamanzi anesepha afudumeleyo. Ukuyiqhawula ngenkani kuqhekeza ulusu.
c-135.principle: I-cyanoacrylate ihlala iqhutywa yi-polymerization ngamanzi (OH⁻) ibe yi-polymer eqinileyo kwimizuzwana embalwa~umzuzu omnye. Amanzi anesepha nokuhlikihla kuyanyuka kwaye kutyhale umaleko wegundane. $n\,\mathrm{CH_2{=}C(CN)COOR}\xrightarrow{\ \mathrm{OH^-}\ (\text{moisture})\ }\left[\mathrm{CH_2\text{-}C(CN)(COOR)}\right]_n$
c-135.example: Ngokucwilisa emanzini anesepha afudumeleyo imizuzu eyi-10~15 uze utyhale ngomthupha, uninzi luyaphuma. Ukuba inamathele emehlweni okanye emilebeni, ungahlikihli, yiya esibhedlele.
c-135.actionItem: Namhlanje xa usebenzisa i-super glue, vulela umoya, kwaye ukuba iminwe inamathele, cwilisa emanzini anesepha afudumeleyo imizuzu eyi-15 uze uyiqhekeze ngokuyiqukulela.

c-136.title: Iphunga lentlanzi liyancipha xa ufaka i-acid
c-136.summary: Isizathu esikhulu seqondo lentlanzi yi-trimethylamine, into esisiseko. Ukutshiza i-acid enjenge-lemon juice okanye iviniga kuyayi-neutralize ukuze iphunga lingakhwezi.
c-136.principle: $\mathrm{(CH_3)_3N + H^+ \to (CH_3)_3NH^+}$. I-amine eyenziwe i-ion ayiphumi ngomphunga, ngoko iphunga liyancipha.
c-136.example: Ukutshiza ipunu encinci ye-lemon juice (malunga ne-5mL) kwintlanzi uze ulinde imizuzu emi-5 kunciphisa iphunga ngokubonakalayo. Ukucwiliselwa ubisi imizuzu engama-20 nayo isebenza ngomgaqo ofanayo apho iprotheyini ibamba iimolekyuli ezinuka.
c-136.actionItem: Namhlanje xa uqhotsa intlanzi, qala utshize i-lemon juice okanye iviniga kanye.

c-137.title: Ngokuphakama, uxinzelelo lwe-oxygen luyehla, ngoko umoya uyasilela
c-137.summary: Umlinganiselo we-oxygen emoyeni uhlala ungama-21% naphi na, kodwa ngokuphakama uxinzelelo lomoya luyehla, ngoko uxinzelelo lwe-oxygen luyancipha. Kwi-3000m ngaphezu komgangatho wolwandle, unokuphefumla malunga nama-70% eqondo lolwandle.
c-137.principle: Umthetho kaDalton wexinzelelo lwengxenye: $p_{\mathrm{O_2}} = x_{\mathrm{O_2}} \times P_{\mathrm{total}}$. $x_{\mathrm{O_2}} \approx 0.21$ ihlala imi, kodwa $P_{\mathrm{total}}$ iyehla.
c-137.example: Kwimgangatho wolwandle (101kPa) uxinzelelo lwe-oxygen malunga nama-21kPa, kwaye kwi-3000m (malunga nama-70kPa) malunga nama-14.7kPa. Ukunyuka kancinci ungaphezulu kwe-500m ngosuku kunciphisa ingozi yesifo sasezintabeni.
c-137.actionItem: Ukuba unecebo lohambo lwasezindaweni eziphakamileyo, cwangcisa ixesha lakho ukunyuka kancinci.

c-138.title: Ulahle iitoti ezivuthayo okanye ezigoso kakhulu
c-138.summary: Itoti evuthayo luphawu lokuba kukho iintsholongwane ezenza irhasi ngaphakathi, kwaye zinokuba ziintsholongwane ezinobungozi ezinjenge-botulinum. Ungayivuli itoti evuthayo, yilahle.
c-138.principle: Irhasi ye-fermentation yeentsholongwane: ngempendulo enjenge-$\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6 \to 2C_2H_5OH + 2CO_2}$ uyenza $\mathrm{CO_2}$ uxinzelelo lwangaphakathi ye-canister inyuke.
c-138.example: Iitoti eziqhelekileyo ziphantse zibe yi-vacuum ngaphakathi, ngoko isigqubuthelo siphantse sibe sithe tyaba okanye siphantsi kancinci. Ukuba ivuthile, okanye xa kuvulwa kukho isandi esikhulu sokukhazimla okanye ioyile, ungayityi.
c-138.actionItem: Namhlanje khupha iitoti ezikhaya uqinisekise ukuba akukho ezivuthayo okanye ezigqwethekileyo.

c-139.title: Ioli esikoweni sosinki iba lukhuni xa ipholile kwaye iyatshixa
c-139.summary: Ioli eshushu ingamanzi, kodwa xa ipholile i-saturated fat iyaqina inamathele kudonga lombhobho, ixube nenkunkuma. Musa ukuthulula ioli kwimijelo, yisule ngephepha uyilahle kwizibi eziqhelekileyo.
c-139.principle: Indawo yokunyibilika ye-saturated fat malunga nama-30~60℃, kwaye xa ioli yokupheka ipholile ibe nolwakhiwo $\mathrm{liquid \to solid}$. Xa idibana ne-calcium ions, yenza ne-fatty acid calcium salts (inkunkuma yesepha).
c-139.example: Ukuthulula i-200mL yeoli yokuqhotsa kwisikoweni kuyaqina kwidonga lombhobho ngobukhulu be-1~2mm, ize ityibilike emva kwamaxesha amaninzi. Phambi kokuhlamba izitya, qala usule izitya ezineoli ngetawuli yephepha.
c-139.actionItem: Namhlanje, qala usule iipani ezineoli ngetawuli yephepha uze uhlambe izitya.

c-140.title: Amanzi ebhotile ye-PET emotweni ngexesha lasehlotyeni, ingaba ayasela?
c-140.summary: Ibhotile ye-PET eshiywe ixesha elide emotweni eshushu inokukhulula amacandelo amancinci njenge-antimony ngokungakumbi. Iintsuku ezinye okanye ezimbini ingozi iphantsi, kodwa ngcono ukunqanda amanzi ashiyeke ixesha elide.
c-140.principle: Ukukhutshwa kunyuka ngobushushu: $k = A\,e^{-E_a/RT}$ (ifomula ye-Arrhenius, xa $T$ inyuka $k$ iyanda)
c-140.example: Ubushushu emotweni ngenkulungwane yehlobo bunokunyuka ukuya kuma-60~70°C, kwaye isantya sokukhutshwa siba nezihlandlo ezininzi ngaphezulu kunakwi-20°C.
c-140.actionItem: Namhlanje ungasele amanzi eshiyekile kwibhotile ye-PET emotweni, kwaye kuhambo sebenzisa i-tumbler ye-stainless steel.

c-141.title: Izinto ezilungileyo ze-refrigerant ye-aircon i-R-32
c-141.summary: I-R-32 ifuna isixa esincinci se-refrigerant kunokuba i-R-410A ukuvelisa amandla okupholisa afanayo, kwaye i-global warming potential (GWP) yayo ingama-1/3 malunga. Yinto efanelekileyo ukuyijonga xa ukhetha i-aircon entsha.
c-141.principle: I-R-32: $\mathrm{CH_2F_2}$, xa ubushushu bokuphuma $q = h_{\mathrm{g}} - h_{\mathrm{f}}$ bukhulu, isixa se-refrigerant esijikelezayo siyancipha.
c-141.example: I-GWP ye-R-410A malunga ne-2088, ye-R-32 malunga ne-675. Isixa se-refrigerant esifakwayo sincipha nge-20~30%, ukusebenza kunyuka kancinci.
c-141.actionItem: Xa uthenga okanye ujonga i-aircon, jonga uhlobo lwe-refrigerant (R-32 okanye R-410A) kwilebheli yemveliso.

c-142.title: Isizathu sokuba isiselo se-soda sibe flat
c-142.summary: I-carbonation inyibilika kakuhle kuxinzelelo nasebushushwini obuphantsi, kwaye iyaphuma xa ifudumele okanye uxinzelelo lukhululwe. Ukugcina ibanda nokuvala isigqubuthelo ngokukhawuleza kugcina i-carbonation ixesha elide.
c-142.principle: Umthetho kaHenry: $C = k_{\mathrm{H}}\,P_{\mathrm{CO_2}}$, $k_{\mathrm{H}}$ iyancipha xa ubushushu bunyuka.
c-142.example: Uxinzelelo ngaphakathi kwebhotile malunga ne-3~4atm, kwaye kwi-25°C ukunyibilika kwe-$\mathrm{CO_2}$ kuye kwehle ukuya kwisiqingatha malunga nakwi-4°C.
c-142.actionItem: Namhlanje emva kokusela isiselo se-soda, ngoko nangoko vala isigqubuthelo ucime efrijini emile mpo.

c-143.title: I-baking soda yokususa iphunga efrijini
c-143.summary: I-baking soda isisiseko esibuthathaka, ngoko i-neutralize izinto ezinuka ezine-acid efrijini (umzekelo, ii-fatty acids). Kodwa umthamo wokufunxa mncinci, ngoko kufuneka itshintshwe rhoqo kwiinyanga ezi-2~3.
c-143.example: Ukufaka malunga nama-100g (1/2 yekomityi) ye-baking soda kwisitya esinye kwanele ukunciphisa iphunga elibuthathaka kwifriji encinci enye.
c-143.actionItem: Beka ikomityi ye-baking soda kwisitya esingenzulu kwishelufu yefriji, ubhale umhla, uze uyitshintshe emva kweenyanga ezi-3.

c-144.title: Iitapile ezimnandi ezosiwe kancinci kwi-70~75℃ zimnandi kakhulu
c-144.summary: I-enzyme ye-beta-amylase kwi-sweet potato iqhawula i-starch ibe yi-maltose emnandi, ngoko isebenza kakhulu kwi-70~75℃ kwaye iyayeka ngaphezulu kwe-90℃. Ukosa kancinci kwandisa ixesha lokumnandi.
c-144.principle: $\mathrm{(C_6H_{10}O_5)_n + n/2\,H_2O \xrightarrow{\beta\text{-amylase}} n/2\,C_{12}H_{22}O_{11}}$. I-enzyme inobushushu obulungileyo bokusebenza.
c-144.example: Kunokuba uyosa kwi-oven ye-180℃ imizuzu emi-5 kuphela, ukuyosa ngaphantsi kwe-150℃ imizuzu engama-50 okanye ngaphezulu kugcina iqondo lobushushu ngaphakathi kwe-70~75℃ ixesha elide, ngoko kwenziwa i-maltose eninzi kakhulu. Yingako iitapile ezosiweyo zimnandi.
c-144.actionItem: Namhlanje xa uyosa iitapile ezimnandi, zosa ngobushushu obuphantsi ixesha elide kancinci.

c-145.title: Isizathu sokuba iqanda libe soft-boiled kwi-62~65℃ kukwahluka kwe-protein
c-145.summary: Iiprotheyini zomhlophe nenkqayi yeqanda ziqina kubushushu obahlukileyo. Umhlophe uqala ukuqina kwi-62~65℃, inkqayi kwi-65~70℃, ngoko kwahlulwa i-soft-boiled kunye ne-hard-boiled.
c-145.principle: Ukuguquka kobushushu kuvula ulwakhiwo lwe-tertiary lweprotheyini kwaye ibangele ukuba zidibane. I-ovotransferrin iguquka malunga ne-62℃, i-ovalbumin malunga ne-80℃.
c-145.example: Ukubilisa imizuzu emi-6 emanzini abilayo kwenza umhlophe uqine kwaye inkqayi ihamba, ngokusondele kwi-soft-boiled, kwaye ngaphezulu kwemizuzu eyi-10 iba yi-hard-boiled. Ngenxa yengozi ye-Salmonella, abantu abadala nabasetyhini abakhulelweyo bakutye kuphekiwe ngokupheleleyo.
c-145.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ubilisa amaqanda, setha itayimari kwimizuzu emi-6 neyi-10 ujonge umahluko.

c-146.title: Iivithamini ezinyibilika emanzini ziphuma ngomchamo nokuba uyatya ezininzi
c-146.summary: Ivithamini C neqela B zinyibilika emanzini, ngoko ngaphezu kwesixa esifunekayo azibuthelwa emzimbeni, ziphuma ngomchamo. Amanyathelo asele kwi-supplements ezinexabiso eliphezulu ahlala eyinkcitho.
c-146.principle: Iimolekyuli ezinyibilika emanzini zine-polarity, ngoko zinyibilika kakuhle egazini nasemchamo, zihluzwa ziintso. Ngokwahlukileyo, iivithamini ezinyibilika kwi-fat zibuthelwa kwizicubu ze-fat.
c-146.example: Isixa esicetyiswayo sosuku sevithamini C kubantu abadala malunga nama-100mg, kwaye ukuba usela i-1000mg kanye, ukufunxwa kuyehla ngaphantsi kwama-50%, ngoko inxalenye enkulu iyaphuma. Isiqhamo esinye sinikezela malunga nama-50mg.
c-146.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba usela i-supplement yevithamini, jonga ukuba xa wongeza isixa esivela ekutyeni asigqithi kwisixa esicetyiswayo.

c-147.title: Ityuwa yelanga neyecoliweyo zahlukile kumlinganiselo we-sodium chloride nakwiiminerali
c-147.summary: Ityuwa ecoliweyo inayo i-sodium chloride (NaCl) engaphezu kwama-99%, ityuwa yelanga malunga nama-80~90% ixutywe ne-magnesium, i-calcium namanzi. Nokuba yeyiphi, incasa yetyuwa ne-sodium ziyafana, ngoko kubalulekile ukutya kancinci.
c-147.principle: Umlinganiselo we-sodium $\dfrac{M_{\mathrm{Na}}}{M_{\mathrm{NaCl}}} = \dfrac{23}{58.5} \approx 0.39$. Ukuba isixa setyuwa sifanayo, ngokunyuka komlinganiselo we-NaCl, kunyuka ne-sodium.
c-147.example: Kwi-5g yetyuwa, ukuba yi-NaCl ecocekileyo kukho malunga nama-1.97g e-sodium, kwaye ukuba ityuwa yelanga ine-NaCl ye-85%, malunga nama-1.67g. I-WHO icebisa ukungatyi ngaphezulu kwama-5g etyuwa ngosuku.
c-147.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga umxholo we-sodium (mg/100g) kwitheyibhile yesondlo yetyuwa yasekhaya.

c-148.title: Iilensi zeeglasi ezitshintsha umbala ngokukhanya
c-148.summary: Iilensi ze-photochromic zine-silver halide eyahlulwa ibe zi-silver particles xa ifumana i-ultraviolet, ukwenza kube mnyama, kwaye ibuyela xa ukukhanya kuphela. Emotweni, i-ultraviolet ivaleleke yiglasi, ngoko ayiba mnyama kangako.
c-148.example: Iilensi ze-photochromic zehla ukusuka kwi-transmission ye-85% ukuya kuma-20% ngaphakathi komzuzu omnye elangeni, kwaye kuthatha imizuzu emi-5~15 ukubuyela kwesiqhelo ngaphakathi.
c-148.actionItem: Xa uqhuba imini enelanga elinamandla, thatha iiglasi zelanga eziqhelekileyo ezivala i-ultraviolet ngokwahlukileyo kwiilensi ze-photochromic.

c-149.title: Iimoto zombane zilahla amandla ambalwa kunemoto yepetroli
c-149.summary: Injini yepetroli ijikelezisa amavili ngeenxalenye ezingama-20~30% kuphela zamandla elindle, ize ilahle ebuthathaka ngobushushu. Imoto yombane idlulisela malunga nama-80~90% eamandla ombane emavilini, ngoko ifuna amandla ambalwa kumgama ofanayo.
c-149.principle: I-1L yepetroli inobushushu obuyi-$32\ \mathrm{MJ}$ ($\approx 8.9\ \mathrm{kWh}$), kwaye xa ukusebenza $\eta = \dfrac{W_{\text{out}}}{E_{\text{in}}}$ kungama-25% malunga, umsebenzi owusizo malunga ne-2.2kWh.
c-149.example: Imoto yepetroli ehamba malunga ne-12km nge-1L yepetroli ihamba i-12km nge-2.2kWh, kwaye imoto yombane idinga malunga ne-2kWh (ukusebenza malunga ne-6km/kWh) ukuhamba i-12km. Xa kubalwa ilahleko yesigaba sokuvelisa, umahluko uyancipha.
c-149.actionItem: Namhlanje, kuhambo olufutshane hamba ngeenyawo okanye usebenzise ithrafikhi yoluntu ukonga ipetroli.

c-150.title: Indawo yokutshaya yeoli yokupheka neoli yokuqhotsa
c-150.summary: Ioli xa idlula indawo yokutshaya yenza umphunga ne-acrolein ecaphukisa amehlo nomqala. Ekuphekeni ngomlilo omkhulu, ioli ene-smoke point ephezulu ikhuselekile.
c-150.example: Iindawo zokutshaya yi-olive oil (extra virgin) malunga nama-190°C, i-canola oil malunga nama-240°C, i-sunflower oil ehluziweyo malunga nama-230°C.
c-150.actionItem: Khetha ioli ehluziweyo enendawo yokutshaya ephezulu yokuqhotsa nokosa, kwaye ukuba kukho umphunga, nciphisa umlilo ngoko nangoko uvulele umoya.

c-151.title: Isizathu sokuba i-iced tea ibe nomsi
c-151.summary: Xa iti emnyama enamandla ipholile, i-caffeine ne-tannin ziyadibana zibe ziinqununu, ngoko iti iba nomsi. Ukongeza amanzi ashushu kuyicacisa, kwaye ukwenza i-cold brew akuyi kuyenza ibe nomsi kangako.
c-151.principle: I-caffeine + i-tannin (theaflavin) $\rightleftharpoons$ ikhompleksi: xa ubushushu buphantsi, ukunyibilika kuyehla kwaye kuyashwabana.
c-151.example: Iti emnyama eyenziwe kwi-100°C ipholiswa ukuya kwi-4°C iba nomsi ngaphakathi kwemizuzu embalwa, kwaye i-cold brew (4°C, iiyure ezi-8) inomsi omncinci kakhulu.
c-151.actionItem: Namhlanje yenza i-iced tea ngokufaka ibhegi yeti kwi-500mL yamanzi abandayo, uyishiye efrijini iiyure ezi-8.

c-152.title: I-amygdalin esembewini yesiqhamo se-ume iyingozi xa itywa iluhlaza
c-152.summary: Iziqhamo ze-ume ezingekavuthwa nembewu zine-amygdalin, ehlukana ukuze ikhuphe i-hydrogen cyanide. Kwi-ume syrup, susa imbewu okanye ucofe emva kokuvuthwa iinyanga ezingaphezu kwezi-6, kwaye ungayityi imbewu.
c-152.principle: $\mathrm{C_{20}H_{27}NO_{11} + 2H_2O \xrightarrow{\text{i-enzyme}} C_6H_5CHO + HCN + 2C_6H_{12}O_6}$. Xa i-enzyme ifikelela, kwenziwa i-hydrogen cyanide.
c-152.example: I-amygdalin embewini yesiqhamo se-ume esinye incinci kakhulu, kodwa ukuhlafuna kakhulu iluhlaza kunokuba yingozi. Kwii-ume eziluhlaza ezingavuthwanga, susa imbewu uziqhube ngeswekile 1:1 uzishiye iinyanga ezi-6, uze ususe inyama yesiqhamo.
c-152.actionItem: Namhlanje xa wenza i-ume syrup, ungayityi imbewu kwaye ubhale kwikhalenda ixesha lokukhupha.

c-153.title: Iikani ze-spray zinokuqhuma xa zibekwe kwindawo eshushu
c-153.summary: Ngaphakathi kwekani ye-aerosol kukho irhasi ecinezelweyo kunye ne-propellant evuthayo, ngoko uxinzelelo lunyuka xa ubushushu bunyuka. Ukuzishiya emotweni yehlobo okanye kufutshane nomlilo kunokubangela ukuqhuma, ngoko landela ukugcinwa ngaphantsi kwama-50℃ kwilebheli.
c-153.principle: Uxinzelelo lwerhasi lulingana nobushushu: $\dfrac{P_1}{T_1} = \dfrac{P_2}{T_2}$ ($T$ kwi-Kelvin). Uxinzelelo lomphunga we-propellant echitywayo lunyuka ngokukhawuleza ngobushushu.
c-153.example: Ikani ene-5atm kwi-20℃ (293K) xa iba yi-60℃ (333K), ngokubala okulula ibe malunga ne-5.7atm, kwaye xa kudityaniswa nokunyuka koxinzelelo lomphunga we-propellant, iba phezulu kakhulu. Imoto ngenkulungwane yehlobo kunokudlula kwi-60℃.
c-153.actionItem: Namhlanje qokelela iimveliso ze-spray ezikhaya uziyise kwindawo ebandayo engafikelelwa bubushushu.

c-154.title: Isizathu sokuba i-jelly ingaqini xa ufaka i-pineapple okanye i-kiwi
c-154.summary: Kungenxa yokuba ii-enzymes ezihlukanisa iiprotheyini kwi-pineapple eluhlaza ne-kiwi zinqunyulwa i-gelatin. Ukushushubeza kanye okanye ukusebenzisa itoti kuyayeka i-enzyme kwaye i-jelly iyaqina.
c-154.principle: I-bromelain ne-actinidin zihydrolyze iibhondi ze-peptide: $\mathrm{R{-}CO{-}NH{-}R' + H_2O \to R{-}COOH + H_2N{-}R'}$. Ii-enzymes ziyaguquka ngaphezulu kwe-$70\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
c-154.example: I-100mL ye-gelatin enepineapple eluhlaza ayiqini nakwiiyure ezimbalwa, kodwa i-pineapple eshushubezwe ngaphezulu kwama-80℃ umzuzu omnye okanye eyetoti iyaqina ngokuqhelekileyo. I-enzyme enye isetyenziswa nasekufudumezeni inyama.
c-154.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ufaka iziqhamo eziluhlaza kwi-jelly okanye i-pudding, qala ubilise i-pineapple ne-kiwi emanzini abilayo umzuzu omnye.

c-155.title: Iphunga elinukayo letawuli eyomileyo
c-155.summary: Iphunga lempahla engomanga ngokupheleleyo libangelwa ziiasidi ezinamafutha ezenziwa yintsholongwane ye-Moraxella njenge-4-methyl-3-hexenoic acid. Eyona nto ibalulekileyo kukomisa ngokukhawuleza phambi kokuba iintsholongwane ziphindaphindeke.
c-155.principle: I-metabolism yeentsholongwane: i-lipid yolusu $\rightarrow$ $\mathrm{C_7H_{12}O_2}$ (4-methyl-3-hexenoic acid) njl. ii-fatty acids ezinyibilikayo ngomphunga
c-155.example: Ukuba impahla emanzi engomi ngaphakathi kweeyure ezi-5 ngaphakathi, iphunga liqala, kwaye umatshini wokomisa ngaphezulu kwe-60°C unciphisa kakhulu iintsholongwane.
c-155.actionItem: Emva kokuhlamba, yasasaze ngoko nangoko uvule ifeni okanye i-dehumidifier uyomise ngaphakathi kweeyure ezi-5.

c-156.title: Yintoni inkunkuma epinki yegumbi lokuhlamba
c-156.summary: Inkunkuma epinki enamathelayo ayiyiyo imolds kodwa yimaleko yombala obomvu owenziwa ziintsholongwane ezinjenge-Serratia. Ukufuma nenkunkuma yesepha zilutya, ngoko ukomisa yeyona ndlela ingcono yokuthintela.
c-156.principle: Ukukhula kweentsholongwane $N = N_0\,2^{t/t_d}$ (ukuba ixesha lokwahlukana $t_d$ malunga nemizuzu engama-30, ngosuku linyuka amakhulu amawaka amaxesha)
c-156.example: Kwigumbi lokuhlamba elifumileyo le-25~35°C, inani leentsholongwane lonyuka malunga namawaka amane xa kudlule iiyure ezi-6 nganye. Ukomisa kuyayeka ukukhula.
c-156.actionItem: Emva kokuhlamba, sebenzisa i-squeegee ukutyhala amanzi ngaphandle kodonga nomgangatho, uze uvule ifeni yokuvula umoya imizuzu engama-30.

c-157.title: Indlela yokugcina i-watermelon esikiweyo
c-157.summary: I-watermelon ilahlekelwa ngamanzi neswekile kumphezulu osikiweyo, kwaye iintsholongwane ziyaphindaphindeka. Ukugquma umphezulu osikiweyo ngeplastiki nokuyigcina efrijini nokuyitya ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezi-2 kukhuselekile.
c-157.principle: Ukuphuma komphunga kulingana nobukhulu bomphezulu obuvelisiweyo nobushushu. Kwi-4°C isantya sokukhula kweentsholongwane yehla ibe malunga ne-1/20 yaleyo ye-25°C.
c-157.example: I-watermelon esikiweyo kubushushu begumbi (30°C) inani leentsholongwane landa ngamashumi amaxesha emva kweeyure ezi-2, kwaye efrijini (4°C) ikhuselekile malunga neentsuku ezi-2.
c-157.actionItem: I-watermelon eshiyekileyo yigcine inebala, ibe nkulu, uze ucinezele iplastiki ngokuthe nca kumphezulu osikiweyo uyibeke efrijini.

c-158.title: Isidlo sasemini sehlobo, irayisi enesiviniga nokutya okukhuphe kakuhle kukhuselekile
c-158.summary: Kwindawo ene-asidi (pH engaphantsi kwe-4.6) uninzi lweentsholongwane zokutya zinzima ukukhula. Ukongeza ipunu yeviniga kwirayisi yesidlo sasemini okanye ukubeka isidlo esipholileyo kuyawondla ukukhuselekile ixesha elide.
c-158.principle: Ngenxa yokulingana kwe-dissociation ye-asidi ebuthathaka $\mathrm{CH_3COOH \rightleftharpoons CH_3COO^- + H^+}$, $[\mathrm{H^+}]$ iyanda, i-pH iyehla, kwaye isantya sokukhula kweentsholongwane siyancipha.
c-158.example: Ukufaka ipunu enkulu yeviniga (15mL) kwi-2 yamakomityi erayisi (malunga nama-300g) kunciphisa i-pH yerayisi ukuya malunga ne-5, kwaye ukukhula kweentsholongwane kuyancipha. Vala isidlo sasemini emva kokupholisa ngokupheleleyo uze usifake kunye ne-ice pack.
c-158.actionItem: Namhlanje kwisidlo sasemini, vala emva kokuphola kakuhle irayisi uze ufake i-ice pack.

c-159.title: Isizathu sokuba izixhobo zibhibhe ngemini efumileyo
c-159.summary: Intsimbi iba yi-iron oxide (ukubhibha) xa kukho amanzi ne-oxygen, kwaye ikhawuleza xa ukufuma kungaphezulu kwama-60%. Umaleko weoli okanye i-desiccant ukucotha ukubhibha.
c-159.example: Kumswakama onxulumeneyo ongama-60% okanye ngaphezulu, umphezulu wentsimbi engenanto ububhibha ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezimbalwa, kwaye ngaphantsi kwama-40% uphantse uyeke.
c-159.actionItem: Sula izixhobo ngelaphu elinomxholo weoli yomatshini, kwaye faka i-silica gel kwibhokisi yezixhobo.

c-160.title: Izinto zokuqwalasela xa usebenzisa i-naphthalene yengubo
c-160.summary: I-mothball ihlala ukusuka kwisolidi isiya kwirhasi (sublimation) ukugxotha izinambuzane. Umphunga ulimaza kwiindlela zokuphefumla, ngoko kufuneka ivulelwe umoya kwaye igcinwe kude.
c-160.principle: I-sublimation: $\mathrm{C_{10}H_8(s) \rightarrow C_{10}H_8(g)}$, xa ubushushu bunyuka uxinzelelo lomphunga luyanda.
c-160.example: Uxinzelelo lomphunga we-naphthalene kwi-25°C malunga ne-11Pa, kwaye kwi-40°C luyanda malunga namaxesha amane. Ungayivumeli idibane ngqo neengubo.
c-160.actionItem: Iimpahla ezisebenzise i-mothball ziyeke ebalkonini iiyure ezi-2~3 emoyeni phambi kokunxiba, uze uzigcine kude nabantwana.

c-161.title: Ukuhlikihla iphunga legalikhi nentlanzi kwi-stainless steel kuyalinciphisa
c-161.summary: Kuyaziwa ukuba iphunga lezinto eziqulathe isalfure zegalikhi neanyanisi liyancipha xa uhlikihla izandla kwi-stainless steel. Ukuhlamba ngesepha kususa amacandelo asaleyo esalfure.
c-161.principle: Izinto zesalfure $\mathrm{R{-}SH}$ zifunxwa kumaleko we-oxide ($\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$) wesinyithi, zinciphise ukuphuma ngomphunga.
c-161.example: Emva kokusika igalikhi, abaninzi baye babona ukuba ukuhlikihla izandla kwitephu ye-stainless steel imizuzwana engama-30 kunciphisa iphunga, kodwa ubungqina bezenzululwazi ngobukhulu bomphumo bunqongophele. Ungasebenzisa i-lemon juice neviniga kunye.
c-161.actionItem: Namhlanje emva kokusika igalikhi, hlikihla izandla kwi-stainless sink imizuzwana engama-30 uze uhlambe ngesepha.

c-162.title: Kutheni imolds yesonka iqala ngokukhawuleza kwixesha lemvula
c-162.summary: Isonka sine-water activity ephezulu, ngoko imolds ikhula ngokukhawuleza kumswakama ongaphezu kwama-70%. Imisonto yemolds ifikelela ngaphakathi kwesonka, ngoko ukususa inxalenye ebonakalayo kuphela kuyingozi.
c-162.principle: I-water activity $a_w = \dfrac{p}{p_0}$ (isonka esisikiweyo malunga ne-0.95, imolds ikhula ngaphezulu kwe-0.80 malunga)
c-162.example: Ngemini efumileyo isonka sasekhaya kwi-25°C sibhibha ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezi-3~4, kwaye ukukhenkceza (-18°C) kusigcina iiveki ezininzi.
c-162.actionItem: Namhlanje isonka ongasityi sisonge kumaleko weplastiki enye nganye uze usikhenkceze, uze usitshise nge-toaster xa usitya.

c-163.title: Isizathu sokuba imvula ibe nesidi ebuthathaka
c-163.summary: Amanzi emvula anyibilikisa i-carbon dioxide emoyeni, ngoko aba ne-asidi ebuthathaka ene-pH malunga ne-5.6, kwaye imvula ene-asidi iphantsi kwe-pH 5.6. Oku akonzakalisi ulusu, kodwa kutshabalalisa ngokuthe ngcembe isinyithi nelitye.
c-163.example: Xa $[\mathrm{H^+}] \approx 2.5\times10^{-6}\,\mathrm{mol/L}$, i-pH $= -\log[\mathrm{H^+}] \approx 5.6$. Amanzi acocekileyo anayo i-pH 7.
c-163.actionItem: Emva kwemvula sula amanzi kwitsheyini yebhayisikili eme ngaphandle uze ufake ithonsi leoli.

c-164.title: Irayisi epholileyo inyusa i-resistant starch, ngoko iswekile efunxwayo iyancipha
c-164.summary: Xa irayisi ipholiswa, inxalenye ye-starch iguquka ibe yi-resistant starch enzima ukwetyiswa. Nokuba iphinda ifudumezwe emva kokuhlaba efrijini, inxalenye ye-resistant starch ihlala, ngoko ukunyuka kweswekile egazini kunokuba lula kancinci.
c-164.principle: Ukuguga kwe-starch yinto apho i-amylose egelatinized iphinda yenze ulwakhiwo lwekristali xa ipholile. La makristali ahlala engahlukanisi kakuhle yi-enzyme ye-amylase yokwetyisa.
c-164.example: Irayisi efudumezwe emva kweeyure ezili-12~24 efrijini kuthiwa ine-resistant starch ngezihlandlo ezininzi ngaphezu kwerayisi ebisandula ukuphekwa, kodwa isixa esiyandayo siyi-percentage emalunga nembalwa kuphela ye-starch epheleleyo. Ungayishiyi irayisi kubushushu begumbi, yibeke efrijini ngokukhawuleza.
c-164.actionItem: Namhlanje irayisi eshiyekileyo yibeke efrijini ngaphakathi kweyure enye.

c-165.title: Ifuthe le-fabric softener kwiitawuli emva kokuhlamba
c-165.summary: I-fabric softener ingenisa ingubo kwimicu nge-cationic surfactant ukuyenza ithambe, kodwa inciphisa ukufunxa kwamanzi. Kwiitawuli kungcono ukunciphisa inani lamaxesha okanye ukusebenzisa iviniga endaweni.
c-165.principle: I-cationic surfactant $\mathrm{R_2N^+(CH_3)_2}$ ifunxwa kwimicu ene-charge engeyiyo $\mathrm{{-}COO^-}$ yenze umaleko we-hydrophobic.
c-165.example: Iitawuli ezisebenzise i-fabric softener zinokuncipha ngama-20~30% ekufunxeni. Xa uhlamba iitawuli ezili-10, nciphisa ukusebenzisa i-softener kube kanye kwiintathu.
c-165.actionItem: Namhlanje hlamba iitawuli ngaphandle kwe-fabric softener uzishukumise kakuhle phambi kokuzomisa.

c-166.title: Ukuphinda usebenzise iikani ze-aluminium kudinga kuphela malunga nama-5% amandla okwenza intsha
c-166.summary: Ukwenza i-aluminium entsha kwi-ore kusebenzisa umbane omninzi kakhulu, kodwa ukuyinyibilikisa ukuyisebenzisa kwakhona kugcina malunga nama-95%. Ukuhlamba iikani kakuhle nokuzahlula kwenza umphumo ube mkhulu.
c-166.principle: I-electrolysis ye-bauxite: $\mathrm{2Al_2O_3 \to 4Al + 3O_2}$. Ukwenza i-1kg ye-aluminium entsha kufuna malunga $14\ \mathrm{kWh}$, kwaye i-aluminium eyenziwe kwakhona malunga $0.7\ \mathrm{kWh}$.
c-166.example: Ukuphinda usebenzise ikani enye ye-aluminium (malunga nama-14g) kugcina malunga ne-0.2kWh. Iikani eziyi-100 ziyi-20kWh malunga, efana namandla e-aircon eyiyure ezi-5.
c-166.actionItem: Namhlanje, emva kokusela, khupha okuphakathi kwekani, uhlambe uze uyifake kwibhokisi yokuzahlula i-aluminium.

c-167.title: Ukusika kuphela indawo ebonakalayo yokutya okune-mold akukhuselekile
c-167.summary: I-mold iyandisa i-mycelia efana nentambo ngaphantsi kwendawo ebonakalayo, kwaye ezinye zivelisa ityhefu. Ekutyeni okunemethi njengesonka, iziqhamo nejam, xa i-mold ibonakala, kukhuselekile ukulahla yonke into.
c-167.principle: I-aflatoxin $\mathrm{B_1}$ yi-$\mathrm{C_{17}H_{12}O_6}$ ekhuselekileyo kubushushu, ngoko ifuna ngaphezulu kwe-$270\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ukuze ihlukane. Ayinyamalali nangokubilisa okanye ukosa.
c-167.example: Kukho isikhokelo sokuba ukutya okuxinene njenge-cheese eqinileyo okanye isanqante, usike i-2.5cm ujikeleze indawo ene-mold, kodwa ukutya okuthambileyo okunamanzi amaninzi njengesonka, ijam netofu kufuneka kulahlwe lonke.
c-167.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga isonka nejam efrijini ukuba azinayo i-mold.

c-168.title: Iphunga legesi yasezidolophini yinto eyongezwa ngabom
c-168.summary: Igesi yasezidolophini (methane) ayinuki ngokwemvelo, ngoko kongezwa isixa esincinci sezinto ezifana ne-thioether ne-mercaptan ezinuka 'njengamaqanda abolileyo' ukuze ukuvuza kwaziwe. Ukuba uva iphunga, ungasebenzisi lilangatye okanye iswitshi yombane, qala uvulele umoya.
c-168.principle: I-methane iqhuma xa ingama-5~15% emoyeni: $\mathrm{CH_4 + 2O_2 \to CO_2 + 2H_2O}$. Izinto ezinuka ezongezwa kwi-methane engenaphunga zibandakanya $\mathrm{CH_3SH}$ njl.
c-168.example: Ukuba i-0.4~1.2m³ ye-methane (5~15%) ivuza kwindawo yegumbi ye-8m³, ingaphakathi kwebanga lokuqhuma. Ukuba uva iphunga legesi, vala ivalvu, vula iifestile, ungachukumisi iswitshi yezibane okanye ifeni, uze wazise ngaphandle.
c-168.actionItem: Namhlanje yazi apho ivalvu yegesi ikhona uze wenze umkhwa wokuyivala emva kokusetyenziswa.

c-169.title: Ii-optical brighteners kwi-detergent yempahla emhlophe zenza ukumhlophe 'kubonakale' kukhulu
c-169.summary: Ii-optical brighteners zifunxa i-ultraviolet ziyikhuphe njengokukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, zifihle umbala ophuzi zenze iimpahla zibonakale zimhlophe ngakumbi. Akususi ubumdaka kodwa linefuthe lokubona, kwaye akukho mfuneko yokuzisebenzisa kwiimpahla ezinemibala.
c-169.principle: I-fluorescence ikhupha i-ultraviolet efunxiweyo (malunga ne-350nm) njengokukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka (malunga ne-430nm), kwaye amandla $E = \dfrac{hc}{\lambda}$ aphuma ngobude bamaza obuncinci kancinci.
c-169.example: I-T-shirt emhlophe esebenzise i-optical brightener kwakanye ikhupha ukukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ngakumbi elangeni, ibonakale ikhanya ngama-5~10% ngaphezulu. Kwiimpahla ezinemibala, i-detergent eqhelekileyo engenalebheli yanele.
c-169.actionItem: Namhlanje xa uhlamba, jonga iilebheli ze-detergent zeempahla ezimhlophe nezinemibala ukuze ubone ukuba zine-optical brightener.

c-170.title: Ukufaka ifowuni ewileyo emanzini kwibhokisi yerayisi kuphantse kungabi nampembelelo
c-170.summary: Irayisi inamandla amancinci okufunxa ukufuma, ngoko isantya sokukhupha amachaphaza amanzi kwifowuni asiyohlukile kakhulu kunokomisa emoyeni. Kungcono ukucima ifowuni, ungatshaji, uyomise kwindawo enomoya.
c-170.principle: Isantya sokomisa silingana nomahluko woxinzelelo lomphunga. Amandla okufunxa e-rice ayabuthathaka kakhulu kune-silica gel, kwaye ixesha lokuqhubeka kwempendulo yokubhibha ye-short-circuit liyabalulekile.
c-170.example: I-silica gel ifunxa ukuya kuma-40% ebunzima bayo, kodwa irayisi ifunxa kancinci kakhulu. Cima ifowuni uyomise iiyure ezili-24~48 okanye ngaphezulu phambi kokuyivula. Ukuba iwele emanzini anetyuwa, qala ubuze kwiziko lenkonzo.
c-170.actionItem: Ukuba ifowuni ifumile, endaweni yebhokisi yerayisi, cima ifowuni uyibeke kwindawo enomoya.

c-171.title: Ukutshiswa kufuneka kuqale kupholiswe ngamanzi abandayo asebenzayo imizuzu engama-20
c-171.summary: Ngoko nangoko emva kokutshiswa, ukupholisa ngamanzi abandayo asebenzayo (15~25℃) imizuzu eyi-10~20 kususa ubushushu obusasazeka ngaphakathi kolusu kwaye kunciphisa umonakalo. Ungasebenzisi ice, i-toothpaste okanye i-doenjang.
c-171.principle: Ubushushu bento eshushu bubuyiselwa kwizicubu nge-$q = mc\Delta T$ butshabalalise iiprotheyini. Amanzi asebenzayo asusa ubushushu ngokukhawuleza.
c-171.example: Amanzi angama-60℃ abangela ukutshiswa okukhulu kwimizuzwana emi-5. Imizuzu engama-20 yamanzi abandayo inciphisa ubunzulu bokutshiswa nokuthomalalisa intlungu, kwaye ice ebandayo kakhulu inciphisa imithambo yegazi ize ilimaze izicubu.
c-171.actionItem: Yazi ngokuhlala ukulandelelana kokuba ukuba utshiswa ekhitshini namhlanje, ngoko nangoko pholisa ngamanzi abandayo asebenzayo imizuzu engama-20.

c-172.title: Yintoni 'i-oxygen absorber' ekutyeni
c-172.summary: Ingxowa encinci kwiphakheji ye-laver okanye i-jerky inentsimbi ekhuphe impendulo ne-oxygen ukususa i-oxygen ephakathi kwephakheji. Xa i-oxygen incipha, ukufakwa kwe-oxidation yamafutha nemolds kuyacotha.
c-172.example: Ingxowa enye ye-oxygen absorber (malunga nama-2g entsimbi) ifunxa malunga ne-200mL ye-oxygen, phantse isusa i-21% ye-oxygen kwiphakheji ye-1L yomoya.
c-172.actionItem: Ungayityi i-oxygen absorber ekwingxowa, kwaye kwiphakheji zokutya ezintsha yiyeke njengoko injalo.

c-173.title: Ubutsha beqanda, jonga ngokuliqhuba emanzini
c-173.summary: Igobolondo leqanda linemingxuma emincinci, ngoko ngokuhamba kwexesha amanzi ne-carbon dioxide ziyaphuma, kwaye isingxobo somoya siyanda. Ukuba litshona liyintsha, ukuba lidada lidala.
c-173.principle: Ubuxoki $F_{\mathrm{b}} = \rho_{\mathrm{water}}\,V g$, xa isingxobo somoya sikhula sinciphise ukuxinana okuphakathi $\rho < \rho_{\mathrm{water}}$, liyadada.
c-173.example: Ukuxinana kweqanda emva kokubekwa malunga ne-1.09g/mL, kwaye emva kweeveki ezi-3~4 lehla ibe malunga ne-1.02g/mL, liqala ukudada emanzini angenatyuwa.
c-173.actionItem: Phambi kokuqhekeza iqanda elisolisayo, gcwalisa isitya ngamanzi uze ulidadise. Ukuba lidada phezulu, ungalityi.

c-174.title: Kutheni ubusi buqina bube mhlophe
c-174.summary: Xa i-glucose ebusini idlula umda wokunyibilika emanzini, iba yikristali iqine. Yinto eqhelekileyo hayi ukonakala, kwaye inokubuyiselwa ngokushushubeza ngamanzi.
c-174.example: Ubusi bune-glucose malunga nama-31%, i-fructose malunga nama-38%, namanzi malunga nama-17%, kwaye ikristalisation ikhawuleza ngaphantsi kwe-14°C. Ukushushubeza emanzini angama-40°C kuyabuyisa.
c-174.actionItem: Ubusi obuqinileyo bususe ngokuntywilisela ibhotile ephelele emanzini angaphantsi kwe-40°C, hayi kwi-microwave.

c-175.title: Kutheni ioli yokupheka kunye ne-supplements zibekwa kwiibhotile ezinguBrown
c-175.summary: Ukukhanya, ngakumbi i-ultraviolet nokukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, kwenza i-oxidation yamafutha neevithamini zonakale. Iglasi emdaka ivala kakhulu ukukhanya okungaphantsi kobude bamaza obumalunga ne-450nm.
c-175.principle: Photo-oxidation: $\mathrm{RH + O_2} \xrightarrow{h\nu} \mathrm{ROO\cdot}$ (i-chain oxidation), amandla e-photon $E = hc/\lambda$
c-175.example: Iglasi emdaka ivala ngaphezulu kwama-90% okukhanya kufutshane ne-400nm, kwaye ioli kwibhotile ecacileyo ingaqala ukonakala elangeni ngaphakathi kweeveki ezimbalwa.
c-175.actionItem: Gcina ioli ye-sesame neoli ye-perilla kwikhabhathi emnyama, hayi efestileni ekhanyisayo.

c-176.title: Umgaqo wokubanda kwephakethi yokupholisa ekhawulezayo
c-176.summary: Xa i-ammonium nitrate okanye i-urea ephakheji inyibilika emanzini, ifunxa ubushushu, ngoko ubushushu buyehla. Yimpendulo ye-endothermic oyisebenzisa ngokukhawuleza emva kokuyiqhekeza nokuyixuba.
c-176.example: I-1 mol (80g) ye-ammonium nitrate ifunxa i-25.7kJ xa inyibilika emanzini, inokunciphisa ubushushu be-100mL yamanzi malunga ne-15~20°C ngaphantsi kobushushu begumbi.
c-176.actionItem: Thatha iiphakethi zokupholisa ekhawulezayo xa ukhempa okanye uzilolonga, ungazibeki ngqo kulusu, uzisonge ngetawuli uze uzisebenzise imizuzu eyi-15 kuphela.

c-177.title: Kutheni ibhetri ye-lithium-ion ingayinyamezeli ubushushu
c-177.summary: Ubushushu obuphezulu bukhawulezisa ukuhlukana kwe-electrolyte nokukhula komaleko we-SEI ngoko kunciphisa umthamo ngokusisigxina. Ungayishiyi ifowuni ephathekayo kunye ne-power bank emotweni ngexesha lehlobo.
c-177.principle: Isantya sokonakala $k = A\,e^{-E_a/RT}$: xa ubushushu bunyuka malunga ne-10°C, isantya siphindwa kabini malunga (umgaqo wamava ka-Arrhenius)
c-177.example: Ukuba umthamo unciphisa malunga nama-20% emva konyaka kwi-25°C, kwi-45°C unokuncipha malunga nama-35~40% ngexesha elifanayo.
c-177.actionItem: Ngehlobo, ungashiyi izixhobo ezinebhetri emotweni, zithwale ngebhegi.

c-178.title: Kutheni i-kimchi ibola ngokukhawuleza ehlotyeni
c-178.summary: I-lactic acid bacteria ephakathi kwi-kimchi iphindaphindeka ngokukhawuleza xa ubushushu buphezulu, ize yenze i-lactic acid eninzi. Ngaphantsi kwe-10°C iyavuthwa kancinci, ngoko incasa ihlala ixesha elide.
c-178.principle: I-fermentation ye-lactic acid: $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6 \rightarrow 2\,CH_3CH(OH)COOH}$ (xa i-pH iyehla, ukubaba kuyanda)
c-178.example: Kwi-20°C, ngeentsuku ezi-3~4 i-pH yehla ukuya malunga ne-4.2 ibe nkulu iasidi, kodwa kwi-4°C efrijini iyaguquka kancinci ngeeveki ezininzi.
c-178.actionItem: Lahla kuphela oza kutya kwisitya esincinci, uze usigcine esinye kwigumbi elibandayo kakhulu lefriji.

c-179.title: I-sunscreen ineoli, ngoko ayihlambulukanga kakuhle ngamanzi kuphela
c-179.summary: Amacandelo e-sunscreen avala i-UV neoli azinyibiliki emanzini, ngoko amanzi kuphela ashiya ukuhlala. I-oil cleanser okanye i-cleansing balm inyibilikisa iinxalenye zeoli, uze ugqibezele nge-foam cleanser ukuze ihlanjululeke kakuhle.
c-179.principle: Umgaqo 'ofanayo unyibilika ofanayo': izinto ezifana nepolarity ziyaxubana. Ioli engenapolarity inyibilika kwi-cleanser engenapolarity, kwaye emanzini kufuneka i-surfactant (micelle).
c-179.example: I-sunscreen ekhuseleke ngamanzi yenzelwe ukuba ihlale ngaphezulu kwama-80% nakwiiyure ezintathu emanzini. Ukuhlikihla nge-cleansing oil imizuzwana engama-30, wenze i-emulsion ngamanzi uze uhlambe kusebenza kakuhle.
c-179.actionItem: Ukuba ufake i-sunscreen namhlanje, sebenzisa qala i-oil cleanser uze uhlambe ngokulandelayo nge-foam cleanser.

c-180.title: Ukuvuza kwebhetri okuphenduke umgubo omhlophe yialkaline, ngoko sula ugqokile iiglavu
c-180.summary: Umgubo omhlophe ovuza kwiibhetri ze-alkaline ezindala yi-potassium carbonate eyenziwe yi-potassium hydroxide ephendula ne-carbon dioxide emoyeni. Icaphukisa ulusu namehlo, ngoko sula ugqokile iiglavu usebenzisa i-cotton swab enomxholo weviniga okanye i-lemon juice.
c-180.principle: $\mathrm{2KOH + CO_2 \to K_2CO_3 + H_2O}$ kwenza iikristali ezimhlophe, kwaye iviniga, i-asidi ebuthathaka, iyayi-neutralize ngendlela $\mathrm{K_2CO_3 + 2CH_3COOH \to 2CH_3COOK + H_2O + CO_2}$.
c-180.example: Ukuvuza kune-pH 13~14, i-alkali eyomeleleyo, ngoko ukuyichukumisa ngesandla esingenanto kucaphukisa. Sula nge-swab enomxholo weviniga uze ugqibezele ngelaphu elomileyo. Kukhuselekile ukukhupha iibhetri kwizixhobo ezingasetyenziswayo.
c-180.actionItem: Namhlanje khupha iibhetri kwii-remote okanye kwizinto zokudlala ezingasetyenziswanga ixesha elide.

c-181.title: Kutheni umkhenkce ungacacanga
c-181.summary: Umoya nezinto ezingahlambulukanga ezinyibilikileyo emanzini zibanjwa embindini womkhenkce xa uqinisa, ngoko kubonakala kumhlophe. Ukusebenzisa amanzi abilisiweyo abandayo kuyenza icace ngakumbi, kodwa ayiyi kucaca ngokupheleleyo.
c-181.principle: Ukunyibilika kwerhasi $C = k_{\mathrm{H}}\,P$: xa amanzi eqhweba, ukunyibilika kuphantse kubengu-0 ngoko amaqamza abanjwa
c-181.example: Umkhenkce owenziwe ngamanzi abilisiweyo abandayo ucaca ngokubonakalayo ngenxa yamaqamza ambalwa, kwaye ukuqhweba ukusuka kwicala elinye (directional freezing) kwenza umkhenkce ocacileyo.
c-181.actionItem: Namhlanje yenza umkhenkce ngokuthulula amanzi abilisiweyo abandayo kwi-tray yomkhenkce uze uwaqhwebise.

c-182.title: Indlela yokugcina i-hydrogen peroxide
c-182.summary: I-hydrogen peroxide ihlukana ibe yi-oxygen namanzi xa idibana nokukhanya, ubushushu okanye isinyithi. Yigcine kwibhotile emdaka ibandayo, kwaye ibhotile endala ayisebenzi kakuhle.
c-182.example: I-hydrogen peroxide ye-3% emva kokuvulwa malunga neenyanga ezi-6 inokuncipha kakhulu kumxholo, kwaye ngaphezulu kwe-30°C ukuhlukana kukhawuleza.
c-182.actionItem: Bhala umhla wokuvula kwibhotile ye-hydrogen peroxide oyithenge evenkileni yamayeza, uze uyibeke kwindawo emnyama ebandayo.

c-183.title: Emva kokubila, ukusela amanzi kuphela amaninzi kukhokelela kwingozi ye-hyponatremia
c-183.summary: Emva kokubila ixesha elide, ukusela amanzi kuphela amaninzi kuhlambulula i-sodium egazini, ngoko inokubangela intloko ebuhlungu nokucaphuka. Sela kunye isiselo okanye isnack enetyuwa.
c-183.principle: Ngenxa yokubila, amanzi kunye ne-$^+$ aphuma. Ukuzalisa ngamanzi kuphela kwenza ukuba kwi-plasma sodium concentration $C_{\mathrm{Na}}=\frac{n_{\mathrm{Na}}}{V}$ kuphela $V$ inyuke, ngoko ukuhlala kuyehla, kwaye amanzi ayasuka angene kwiiseli ngenxa ye-osmosis. Uluhlu oluqhelekileyo malunga ne-135~145 mmol/L.
c-183.example: Kwihlobo, xa ubila malunga nama-2L kwi-3 iiyure zokuhamba intaba, kuphuma i-sodium malunga nama-2g (ilingana nama-5g etyuwa). Ukongeza kwi-3L yamanzi asele kanye, i-$^+$ egazini inokuhla ngaphantsi kwe-135 mmol/L.
c-183.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ulolonga okanye uhamba ixesha elide, thatha isnack enetyuwa (amantongomane, ii-crackers) okanye isiselo se-ionic esihlanjululweyo kunye namanzi, uze ungasele ngaphezu kwe-500mL ngexesha elinye.

c-184.title: I-bleach etyhidwe emanzini ashushu ilahlekelwa kukukwazi kokulawula iintsholongwane kuphela
c-184.summary: Ukuba utyhila i-bleach emanzini ashushu, isithako sokukhupha iintsholongwane siyaqhekeka ngokukhawuleza kwaye kuyanda kuphela ivumba elinamandla le-chlorine. Yityhile emanzini abandayo okanye ashushu kancinci uze uyisebenzise ngoko nangoko.
c-184.principle: I-HOCl, isithako esisebenzayo se-sodium hypochlorite (NaOCl), ayinamandla ekushiseni kwaye iqhekeka ngokwefomula $2\mathrm{HOCl}\rightarrow 2\mathrm{HCl}+\mathrm{O_2}$. Ngokwandisa ubushushu ngama-10℃, isantya sokuqhekeka sikhawuleza ngokuphindwe kabini okanye ngaphezulu.
c-184.example: Xa kutyhiliwe i-bleach yasekhaya (malunga ne-4~5% NaOCl) ngobuninzi obuncinci kwi-500mL yamanzi, kwi-20℃ isebenza iiyure ezimbalwa, kodwa emanzini angama-60℃ inxalenye enkulu iyanyamalala ngemizuzu embalwa kwaye irhasi eyenzakalisayo ibaleka ngakumbi.
c-184.actionItem: Namhlanje xa uhlambulula nge-bleach, yityhile ngamanzi abandayo uze uyisebenzise ngoko nangoko, venkcisa umoya kwaye ungayixubi neziyilo ezine-asidi.

c-185.title: Ukutshisa ii-oyster nee-clam zasemanxweni ngama-85℃ umzuzu omnye ukukhusela i-Vibrio
c-185.summary: Ii-oyster nee-clam ezityiwa emanxweni ehlobo, ukuba zipheka ngaphakathi ngaphezulu kwama-85℃ ngaphezulu komzuzu omnye, kunciphisa kakhulu ukoyika iintsholongwane zeVibrio. Ukutya kuluhlaza kuyingozi ngakumbi kubantu abanomzimba obuthathaka wokuzikhusela.
c-185.principle: Iiproteni zeVibrio ziyabhidaniswa ngobushushu kwaye ziphulukana nomsebenzi wazo. Inani leentsholongwane lehla njenge-$N=N_0\,10^{-t/D}$, kwaye okukhona ubushushu buphezulu, $D$ (ixesha lokuncipha ngokwamaxesha angama-10) liba mfutshane.
c-185.example: IVibrio ikhula ngokukhawuleza emanzini olwandle angama-25~35℃. Nasemva kokuba iqokobhe livulekile, ukupheka ezinye imizuzu emi-3~5 kugcina ubushushu bangaphakathi ngaphezulu kwama-85℃ umzuzu omnye, nto leyo yandisa umda wokhuseleko.
c-185.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba utya ukutya kolwandle, ungatyi okuluhlaza, kodwa kupheke ngokwaneleyo ngeqokobhe kwaye uhlambe ngoko nangoko iimela kunye namabhodi okusika athe achukumisa ukutya okuluhlaza.

c-186.title: Amaqhuma emva kokutyiba ijusi ye-lime okanye yemon uze ume elangeni
c-186.summary: Ukuba ijusi ye-lime okanye yemon ithe yatshiza esikhumbeni uze uphume elangeni, kunokuba nobomvu obufana nokutshiswa kwaye kuvele amaqhuma. Ukuba kuchukumisile, geza ngesepha uze uphephe ilanga.
c-186.principle: Ii-furocoumarin kwiqokobhe nejusi yeziqhamo ezi-citrus zifunxa i-ultraviolet A (320~400nm) kwaye zenze impendulo yobuthi bokukhanya ebophelela kwi-DNA nakwiiproteni zesikhumba. Amandla $E=h\nu=\frac{hc}{\lambda}$, akhula njengoko ubude bamaza bufutshane.
c-186.example: Emva kwe-cocktail yangaphandle okanye ukucofa i-lime, ukuba awuhlambi izandla uhlale elangeni iiyure ezi-1~2, emva kweeyure ezingama-24~72 kuvela iimpawu ezibomvu namaqhuma ngokwemilo yejusi kwaye ukubonakala kwepigment kunokuhlala iinyanga ezininzi.
c-186.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba uchukumise iziqhamo zecitrus, geza izandla ngesepha namanzi ngoko nangoko kwaye gubungela isikhumba esivezwe elangeni phambi kokuhlamba.

c-187.title: Xa uhlatywa yijellyfish, geza ngamanzi olwandle hayi amanzi amtsha
c-187.summary: Xa uhlatywa yijellyfish, ukuhlamba ngamanzi amtsha kunokwenza ukuba iingcambu ezisele ziqhume ngakumbi. Hlamba ngamanzi olwandle uze ususe imitentacle ngesixhobo kunokuba ngesandla esingenanto.
c-187.principle: Ii-nematocyst zejellyfish ziqhuma ngoxinzelelo lwe-osmotic nangokuvuselelwa kweekhemikhali. Amanzi amtsha anoxinzelelo lwe-osmotic oluphantsi kunamanzi olwandle (malunga ne-35g/L yetyuwa), ngoko ngomahluko we-$\Pi=iMRT$ amanzi angena kwi-nematocyst abangele ukuqhuma.
c-187.example: Ukuba uhlatywe kwisiqithi sokuqubha, hlamba ngamanzi olwandle imizuzwana engama-30 okanye ngaphezulu, ukrwele imitentacle ngomphetho wekhadi, emva koko ukuba intlungu inkulu, ukuntywilisela emanzini angama-45℃ imizuzu engama-20 kucetyiswa ngokubanzi. Ukunyangwa kuyahluka ngokweentlobo, ngoko ukuba kukho ukuphefumla kunzima ucele uncedo lwabantu abaphuthumayo ngoko nangoko.
c-187.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba uya elwandle, jonga isilumkiso sejellyfish kwaye ulungiselele ukuhlamba ngamanzi olwandle nekhadi enye yekhredithi xa uhlatywa.

c-188.title: Kutheni isuti yokuqubha inwebeka emva kokuya epuleni nendlela yokukhetha
c-188.summary: Isuti yokuqubha inwebeka emva kokuya epuleni amatyeli ambalwa kuba i-chlorine iqhekeza izinto ezinokwanda. Khetha izinto ezimelana ne-chlorine kwaye uhlambe ngoko nangoko emva kokuyisebenzisa.
c-188.principle: Iintambo ze-spandex (polyurethane) ziyakhutshwa kwi-oxidation yi-HOCl yamachiza epulu. Ubude bentambo buyancipha kwaye ukuguquguquka kuyehla, kwaye i-spandex eqhelekileyo ibola ngokukhawuleza kakhulu kunezinto zokuqubha ze-PBT ezimelana ne-chlorine.
c-188.example: Isuti yokuqubha eqhelekileyo ye-nylon/spandex iyabonakala inwebekile emva kokusetyenziswa epuleni kangama-30~50, ngelixa ingxube ye-PBT ihlala amaxesha amaninzi. I-chlorine eseleyo epuleni ngokuqhelekileyo i-1~3mg/L.
c-188.actionItem: Namhlanje emva kokuqubha hlamba isuti yokuqubha ngamanzi abandayo ngoko nangoko, ungayikhama, ize yomiswe emthunzini.

c-189.title: Kutheni i-ayisikrimu eyanyibilika yaza yafriza kwakhona ikhwaza
c-189.summary: Xa i-ayisikrimu inyibilika yaza yafriza kwakhona, kwenziwa iikristali zomkhenkce ezikhulu neziqatha kwaye ikhwaza. Ukuba ithe yanyibilika kanye, ukuyidla ngoko nangoko kungcono kunokuyifriza kwakhona.
c-189.principle: Iikristali ezincinci zomkhenkce zinamandla amakhulu omphezulu, ngoko ziyanyibilika kwaye amanzi afudukela kwiikristali ezikhulu ziqhubeke zikhula (i-Ostwald ripening). Ubudlelwane bokuba okukhona irediyasi yeqhekeza $r$ incinci, kokukhona ukunyibilika kuphezulu yi-$\ln\frac{S_r}{S_\infty}=\frac{2\gamma V_m}{rRT}$.
c-189.example: Iikristali zomkhenkce kwi-ayisikrimu eyenziwe kakuhle zingaphantsi kwe-50μm, ngoko ithambile, kodwa ukuba inyibilika ize ifriza kwakhona, zikhula ngaphezulu kwe-100μm zize zikhwaze emlonyeni. Kwenzeka okufanayo xa ubushushu befriza buyanyuka buhle rhoqo.
c-189.actionItem: Namhlanje beka i-ayisikrimu ngaphakathi kwefriza hayi ecaleni komnyango ukunciphisa utshintsho lobushushu, kwaye uvale isiciko ngoko nangoko emva kokuyitya.

c-190.title: Ungayishiyi i-dry ice emotweni evaliweyo
c-190.summary: I-dry ice ayinyibiliki kodwa iba yirhasi, kwaye inokunyusa ukuxinana kwe-CO$_2$ emotweni evaliweyo ukuya kwinqanaba eliyingozi. Xa uyithutha, vula iifestile kwaye uyibeke kwibhutsi okanye kwindawo enomoya.
c-190.principle: I-CO$_2$ eqinileyo iguqulwa ibe $\mathrm{CO_2(s)}\rightarrow \mathrm{CO_2(g)}$ (-78.5℃). I-1kg iba malunga ne-500L yerhasi, kwaye xa ukuxinana kwe-CO$_2$ kudlula kwi-4%, kuza intloko ebuhlungu nokungxama, kwaye ngaphezulu kuyingozi.
c-190.example: I-2kg ye-dry ice ikhupha malunga ne-1,000L ye-CO$_2$. Ukuba ibetha ngokupheleleyo kwindawo yangaphakathi yemoto emalunga ne-3,000L, ukuxinana kunokunyuka ukuya malunga nama-25%, oko kuyingozi kakhulu.
c-190.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba kufuneka uhambise i-dry ice, yenze ngomoya ophumayo, uyiphathe ngeeglavu kwaye ungayifaki kwisikhongozeli esivaliweyo.

c-191.title: Umbona uphulukana nobumnandi ngokokukhula kwexesha emva kokuvunwa
c-191.summary: Umbona ukususela ekuvunweni kwawo ushukela uguqulwa ube yistatshi, ubumnandi buyancipha kwaye uba sele. Ukuba uwubilisa ngosuku lokuthenga okanye uwugcina efrijini, ubumnandi bugcinwa ixesha elide.
c-191.principle: Ii-enzyme kwintsimbi yombona ziguqula iishukela ezifana negluukozi zibe yistatshi: $n\,\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}\rightarrow(\mathrm{C_6H_{10}O_5})_n+n\,\mathrm{H_2O}$. Impendulo ye-enzyme icotha kwiqondo eliphantsi kwaye ukugcinwa efrijini kuyalibazisa.
c-191.example: Umbona omtsha ophakanyisiweyo ukuba uhlala ngosuku lunye kwiqondo lengingqi, malunga nama-40% eeshukela anokuguqulwa abe yistatshi, kodwa kwi-0~4℃ efrijini kuhamba ngokucotha kakhulu. Ukugcina ngamaqokobhe kunciphisa nokulahleka kwamanzi.
c-191.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba uthenge umbona, ungayishiyi kwiqondo lengingqi, yigcine efrijini ngamaqokobhe kwaye ukuba kunokwenzeka uyibilise ngaphakathi kosuku.

c-192.title: Kutheni ivumba lehla xa utamatisi egcinwe efrijini
c-192.summary: Utamatisi ovuthiweyo kakuhle xa ugcinwa efrijini, ivumba liyathamba kwaye ukuxineka kuyaphela. Beka utamatisi ovuthiweyo ngokupheleleyo kwiqondo lengingqi uze uwutye ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezimbalwa.
c-192.principle: Utamatisi umosha ngokubandayo ngaphantsi kwe-12℃, ngoko umsebenzi wee-enzyme zokwenza izithako zevumba (umzekelo i-cis-3-hexenal) uyehla kwaye ulwakhiwo lwe-membrane luyonakala. Isantya se-enzyme siyatshintsha ngobushushu ngokwe-$k=Ae^{-E_a/RT}$.
c-192.example: Nokuba utamatisi ugcinwe efrijini ye-5℃ iintsuku ezi-3 kuphela, izithako zevumba ezivuthayo zinokuncipha kakhulu. Xa ugcinwa kwiqondo lengingqi, utamatisi ovuthiweyo ngokupheleleyo kungcono ukuwutya ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezi-3~5.
c-192.actionItem: Namhlanje beka utamatisi ovuthiweyo ngokupheleleyo ngesiqu esiphantsi kwindawo epholileyo, kwaye ukuba uyigcinile efrijini, yikhuphe imizuzu engama-30 phambi kokuyitya.

c-193.title: Indlela yokubuyisela i-mayonnaise eyahlukanisayo
c-193.summary: Ungayilahli i-mayonnaise ehlukene kwioli neqanda, kodwa yiphose kancinci kwiqanda elitsha elimthubi ngelixa uxuba uze uyibuyisele. I-lecithin kwiqanda elitsha elimthubi iphinda ibambe i-emulsion.
c-193.principle: I-mayonnaise yi-emulsion apho ioli isasazeke emanzini, kwaye i-lecithin yeqanda elimthubi inciphisa uxinzelelo lomphezulu $\gamma$ phakathi kwamanzi neoli ukuze amathontsi angadibani. Ukuba ioli ingena ngokukhawuleza okanye ubushushu abufanelekanga, amathontsi adibana kwaye izigaba ziyahlukana.
c-193.example: I-mayonnaise ehlukene malunga ne-200g, ukuba iphoswa kancinci kakhulu kwiqanda elitsha elimthubi eli-1 kunye nesipuni esincinci esi-1 samanzi, iyabuya ibe lulwelo oluthambileyo. Ioli ingenziwa i-emulsion malunga ne-200mL ukuya kwi-1 yeqanda elimthubi.
c-193.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba wenza i-mayonnaise, qala ngethontsi elinye lioli uze unyuse kancinci, sebenzisa amaqanda amatsha kwaye emva kokwenza yigcine efrijini.

c-194.title: Iimveliso ze-menthol ezipholisayo azihlisi ubushushu bomzimba
c-194.summary: Imveliso ye-menthol ezipholisayo ezinje ngee-spray okanye iishiti zenza uzive ubanda kuphela, azihlisi ubushushu bomzimba bokwenene. Ukuncedisa ubushushu, ukunatha amanzi nokuphumla emthunzini kuyeyona nto iphambili.
c-194.principle: I-menthol isebenzisa i-receptor yokubanda yesikhumba i-TRPM8 ithumele umqondiso wokubanda kwiintsholongwane. Ukushukuma kobushushu bokwenene kwenzeka kuphela xa kukho utshintsho lobushushu $Q=mc\Delta T$, kwaye i-menthol ngokwayo ayithathi bushushu bomzimba.
c-194.example: Nokuba ufaka imveliso ye-menthol ye-1%, ubushushu besikhumba abutshintshi kangako ngaphezulu kwe-0.5℃, kodwa imvakalelo yokubanda ihlala imizuzu emininzi. Kwimozulu eshushu engaphezulu kwama-33℃ apho kukho ingozi yokubetha ngobushushu, ukukholelwa kwimvakalelo kuphela kuyingozi.
c-194.actionItem: Namhlanje ngosuku olushushu ungazithembeli kwimveliso ezipholisayo kuphela, nathe amanzi uze uphumle emthunzini ukuze ukhuphe ngokwenene ubushushu bomzimba.

c-195.title: Emlonyeni otshisayo, ndaweni yamanzi, sela isiphuzo sobisi
c-195.summary: Xa umlomo uvutha emva kokutya ukutya okubabayo, amanzi awancedi kakhulu kwaye ubisi okanye iyogathi kungcono. I-capsaicin inamathela kakuhle kwiicandelo zamafutha nakwiiproteni.
c-195.principle: I-capsaicin ($\mathrm{C_{18}H_{27}NO_3}$) yimolekyuli enyibilika ngamafutha engenyibiliki emanzini. Amafutha ebisi ayinyibilikisa kwaye iprotheni yekasein iyabophelela, inceda ukuyisusa kwi-receptor.
c-195.example: Emva kokutya i-ramyun ebabayo, i-200mL yamanzi ikhupha kancinci nje, kodwa ikomityi yobisi (200mL, malunga ne-7g yamafutha, malunga ne-6g yeprotheni) inciphisa ukutshisa ngokucacileyo ngaphakathi kwemizuzu embalwa.
c-195.actionItem: Namhlanje xa utya ukutya okubabayo, thatha ubisi okanye iyogathi ecacileyo kunye, kwaye xa umlomo utshisa, bamba ukutshaya kancinci uze ugwebe.

c-196.title: Indawo etshisiweyo yenyama ebhakwe ngamalahle yenza i-benzopyrene
c-196.summary: Kwiindawo ezimnyama ezitshisiweyo xa kubhakwa inyama ngqo emalahleni, kunokwenzeka i-benzopyrene, into enokubangela umhlaza. Sika indawo etshisiweyo uze ubhake ukuze amalangatye angachukumisi.
c-196.principle: Amafutha enyama atshiza emalahleni aphuphume, kwenziwa ii-polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAH) ezinamathela kwinyama ngomsi. Into emele yile i-benzopyrene ($\mathrm{C_{20}H_{12}}$).
c-196.example: Xa ubhaka isisu senkomo esinamafutha amaninzi ngqo emlilweni, i-benzopyrene iyanda emsini nasezindaweni ezitshisiweyo. Ukucoca igrill rhoqo nokusebenzisa i-foyile okanye iplate endaweni yegrill kunciphisa kakhulu ii-PAH.
c-196.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ubhaka inyama, phepha amalangatye amafutha atshizayo, ubhake ngomlilo omncinci, uze usike indawo emnyama enamathelayo ngaphambi kokutya.

c-197.title: Kumngxuma wesitshixo, endaweni yeoli, sebenzisa umgubo wegraphite
c-197.summary: Kumngxuma wesitshixo onzima, umgubo wegraphite (umgubo wesikhokelo senkomishi) kungcono kuneoli eqhelekileyo. Ioli yenza uthuli lunamathele kwaye ngokuhamba kwexesha iba nzima ngakumbi.
c-197.principle: I-graphite yimateriyali eqinileyo yokuthambisa enomaleko wecarbon ongatyibilika ngokulula. Ngamandla okukhuhlana $F=\mu N$ inciphisa ikhoyefishenti yokukhuhlana $\mu$ kwaye ayinamathelani ngoko ayiqokeleli thuli.
c-197.example: Ukuba uvuthela umgubo wegraphite kumngxuma wesitshixo kanye okanye kabini, ukukhuhlana kuyancipha kwaye isitshixo siyajikeleza kakuhle. Ioli eqhelekileyo, kwelinye icala, idibana nothuli kwaye emva kweenyanga ezimbalwa iyaqina kwaye inokuvala umngxuma wesitshixo.
c-197.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba isitshixo sinzima, fafaza umgubo wegraphite kancinci emngxunyeni wesitshixo okanye umbala iigrooves zesitshixo ngepensile uze ufake uthathe amatyeli amaninzi.

c-198.title: Kwitsheyini yebhayisikile, hayi i-WD-40, kodwa ioli yetsheyini
c-198.summary: I-WD-40 inobunzima bokucoca nokususa umhhlwa, ngoko ayihlali ixesha elide njengeoli yetsheyini yebhayisikile. Emva kokuhlamba, faka ioli ekhethekileyo yetsheyini.
c-198.principle: I-WD-40 yenziwe ngesinyibilikisi esinyibilikayo nefilimu yeoli ebhityileyo, ngoko iyabhonga okanye ihlanjwe ngokukhawuleza. Iioli zokuthambisa zinobunzima obuphezulu, ngoko zigcina ifilimu kumphezulu wokudibana zize zinciphise ukulahleka kokukhuhlana $P_{\mathrm{loss}}=F_f\,v$.
c-198.example: Itsheyini ecocekileyo neyithambisiwe kakuhle ineempumelelo malunga nama-98~99%, ngelixa itsheyini eyomileyo nengcolileyo inokwehla nge-3~5 amanqaku eepesenti okanye ngaphezulu. Xa uhamba ngamandla angama-150W, i-3% ilahleko ye-4.5W malunga.
c-198.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba itsheyini yenza ingxolo, yisule ngelaphu elomileyo, faka ithontsi elinye leoli kwilink nganye, uze usule ioli eseleyo.

c-199.title: Xa i-aluminium nentsimbi engenanto zichukumisana, enye iyabola kuqala
c-199.summary: Xa iintsimbi ezahlukeneyo zichukumisana emanzini, intsimbi esebenza ngakumbi iyabola kuqala. Xa udibanisa i-aluminium nesteyinless ngebholithi, faka iwasha yokucoca phakathi.
c-199.principle: Ukuba kukho iintsimbi ezimbini ezineempotentiyali ezahlukeneyo kunye ne-electrolyte, kwenziwa iselula encinci kwaye i-aluminium inyibilika ngo-$\mathrm{Al}\rightarrow \mathrm{Al^{3+}}+3e^-$ kwi-anode. Ipotentiyali esemgangathweni yi-Al malunga ne--1.66V, isteyinless (uhlobo lweFe) malunga ne--0.44V okanye ngaphezulu, umahluko mkhulu.
c-199.example: Ukuba usebenzisa iscrew yesteyinless ngqo kwirayili ye-aluminium kwiterasi yasekuhlaleni olwandle, ngaphakathi kweenyanga ezimbalwa~unyaka omnye kuvela umgubo omhlophe wokubola kwindawo yokudibana. Kungenxa yokuba umahluko wepotentiyali mkhulu kwaye amanzi olwandle asebenza njenge-electrolyte.
c-199.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga iindawo apho iintsimbi ezahlukeneyo zidibana, kwaye ukuba amanzi aqokelelana, sebenzisa iwasha yokucoca okanye ipeyinti ukuthintela iintsimbi ezimbini ukuba zingachukumisani ngqo.

c-200.title: Ungafaki ukutya kwibhakethi ene-galvanized zinc
c-200.summary: Ukuba ufaka ukutya okuyi-acidic (iviniga, iziqhamo ezigcinwe, i-kimchi) kwibhakethi ene-galvanized zinc okanye kwiplate yentsimbi, i-zinc iyanyibilika kwaye ingabangela ukugabha nesisu esibuhlungu. Sebenzisa isikhongozeli sokutya.
c-200.principle: Umaleko we-zinc plating uphendula nge-asidi kwaye unyibilike nge-$\mathrm{Zn}+2\mathrm{H^+}\rightarrow \mathrm{Zn^{2+}}+\mathrm{H_2}$. Ukutya okune-asidi kune-pH engaphantsi kwe-4, ngoko impendulo ikhawuleza.
c-200.example: Ekampini, ukuba ushiya i-lemonade okanye iviniga ene-pH malunga ne-3 kwibhakethi ene-zinc iiyure ezimbalwa, i-zinc inokunyibilika ukuya kumashumi e-mg/L kwaye kukho ingozi yokugabha nokuziva ugula. Isixa esicetyiswayo semihla ngemihla sabantu abadala malunga ne-8~11mg.
c-200.actionItem: Namhlanje ekampini okanye ekuphekeni ngaphandle, sebenzisa kuphela izikhongozeli ezineempawu zokutya, kwaye usebenzise ibhakethi ene-zinc kuphela ukuthatha amanzi.

c-201.title: Ikomityi ye-ceramic ekhutshelwe phesheya, jonga ukuphuma kwe-lead ekugalelweni
c-201.summary: Iikomityi ze-ceramic ezikhutshelwe ngaphandle ezinoogaleliso olukhazimlayo zinokukhulula i-lead kwizisele ezine-asidi. Jonga uphawu lokutya neziphumo zovavanyo lwe-lead kwaye ungayigcini iziselo ezine-asidi ixesha elide.
c-201.principle: Iikhompawundi ze-lead kwigalelo zinyibilika nge-asidi ngo-$\mathrm{PbO}+2\mathrm{H^+}\rightarrow \mathrm{Pb^{2+}}+\mathrm{H_2O}$. Okukhona i-pH iphantsi njengakwiviniga okanye ijusi yeziqhamo, nokukhona ixesha lide, ukuphuma kuyanda.
c-201.example: Xa uvavanya ngokuntywilisela kwi-4% yeasidi ye-acetic iiyure ezingama-24, umgangatho waseKorea weekomityi yi-lead engaphantsi kwe-0.4mg/L. I-ceramic yokuhombisa engenayo ingxelo yovavanyo inokugqitha kulo mgangatho.
c-201.actionItem: Namhlanje ngekomityi ye-ceramic ekhutshelwe phesheya, jonga uphawu lokutya neziphumo zovavanyo lokhuseleko kwaye ungafaki iziselo ezine-asidi njengejusi okanye iwayini kwiikomityi zokuhombisa ezingaqinisekiswanga.

c-202.title: Ivumba lenyibilikisi litshintsha xa liseshiyeke emotweni
c-202.summary: Ukuba ushiya iperfume emotweni eshushu, ivumba litshintsha kwaye ubutsha buyanyamalala. Yigcine kwindawo epholileyo emnyama.
c-202.principle: Iimolekyuli zetop note ezikhaphukhaphu zeperfume zinokuthuthuzela okuphezulu, ngoko xa ubushushu bunyuka uxinzelelo lomphunga lukhawuleza lube ngumphunga. Uxinzelelo lomphunga $\ln P=-\frac{\Delta H_{\mathrm{vap}}}{RT}+C$ luyanda ngokwe-exponential ngobushushu, kwaye ubushushu, ukukhanya ne-oksijini ziyaoksida izithako zevumba.
c-202.example: Ukuba imoto iqhotyoshelwe ehlotyeni, ngaphakathi kunokuba ngaphezulu kwama-60℃, kwaye ukuphuphuma kukhawuleza amaxesha amaninzi kunegumbi le-20℃. Emva kweeveki ezimbalwa, ii-citrus top notes ziyancipha kwaye umbala uba mnyama.
c-202.actionItem: Namhlanje gcina iperfume kwiqokobhe elipholileyo elimnyama endaweni yemoto okanye indlu yokuhlambela, kwaye uvale isiciko ngokuqinileyo emva kokusebenzisa.

c-203.title: Iimveliso zomhlaba zokuthambisa kunye neekhrimu ziyahlukana xa zishiywe emotweni ehlotyeni
c-203.summary: Ukuba ushiya umhlaba okanye ikhrimu emotweni ehlotyeni, amanzi neoli ziyahlukana kwaye izithako zitshintsha, nto leyo inciphisa ukusebenza. Gcina amayeza kubushushu obubhalwe kwimveliso (ngokuqhelekileyo ngaphantsi kwama-30℃).
c-203.principle: Ikhrimu yi-emulsion yamanzi neoli kwaye i-emulsifier izinzisa indawo yokudibana. Xa ubushushu bunyuka, ukusebenza kwe-emulsifier nokuxinana kuyehla, amathontsi adibana kwaye izigaba ziyahlukana. Isantya sempendulo $k=Ae^{-E_a/RT}$ sibuthathaka ebushushwini.
c-203.example: Ngaphakathi kwemoto eqhotyoshelweyo ebusika behlobo ubushushu bunyuka ngaphezulu kwama-60℃, kwaye ikhrimu inokuba ngamanzi okanye ioli ibe sentla ngeeyure ezimbalwa. Imveliso eyahlukanisiweyo kanye, nokuba iphinda ixutywe, ayibuyeli kwimeko yokuqala.
c-203.actionItem: Namhlanje xa uphuma, ungayishiyi imiyalezo yomhlaba, isunscreen namayeza emotweni, kodwa uwafake ebhegini uhambe nawo.

c-204.title: Isitovu se-alcohol sekampu, i-methanol ne-ethanol ziyahluka
c-204.summary: Njengepetroli yesitovu se-alcohol sekampu, i-methanol inobuthi kwaye amalangatye ayo ayabonakali, ngoko iyingozi, kwaye i-ethanol edenature ukhetho olukhuselekileyo ngakumbi. Jonga ukuba umlilo uvuliwe kwaye cima umlilo xa wongeza ipetroli.
c-204.principle: Ukutshisa kwe-ethanol $\mathrm{C_2H_5OH}+3\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow 2\mathrm{CO_2}+3\mathrm{H_2O}$, ukutshisa kwe-methanol $2\mathrm{CH_3OH}+3\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow 2\mathrm{CO_2}+4\mathrm{H_2O}$. Amalangatye e-methanol phantse abonakala ngokucacileyo kwaye emzimbeni ayajika abe yi-formic acid nezinye, ngoko ubuthi bukhulu.
c-204.example: Ubushushu bokutshisa be-ethanol malunga ne-27kJ/g, kwaye i-methanol malunga ne-20kJ/g, ngoko kwisixa esifanayo i-ethanol ikhupha ubushushu obungakumbi. I-methanol, nokuba utshiswa kancinci, inobungozi bobumfama nobuthi.
c-204.actionItem: Namhlanje xa usebenzisa isitovu se-alcohol, jonga uhlobo lepetroli kwaye wongeze ipetroli kuphela emva kokuba umlilo ucinile wabanda.

c-205.title: Ungayigcini ipetroli yomatshini wokusika ingca ngaphezulu kweenyanga ezintathu
c-205.summary: Ipetroli esetyenziswa kumatshini wokusika ingca okanye ijenereyitha, ukuba igcinwa ngaphezulu kweenyanga ezintathu iyonakala, ukuqala kuba nzima kwaye ikhabhureta iyavaleka. Thenga kuphela oko ukusebenzisayo kwaye ukuba kuseleyo, sebenzisa isizinzisi sepetroli.
c-205.principle: Izithako ezikhaphukhaphu zepetroli ziyabhonga kwaye i-oxidation yenza i-gum encangathayo evala umbhobho wepetroli. Ipetroli equlethe i-ethanol ifunxa ubumanzi kwaye izigaba ziyahlukana. I-oxidation iqhubeka nge-$\mathrm{RH}+\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow$ peroxides nokunye.
c-205.example: Kwisikhongozeli esivaliweyo, ipetroli ngokuqhelekileyo emva kweenyanga ezi-3~6, kunye nepetroli exubileyo ne-ethanol emva kweenyanga ezi-1~3, inokuba neengxaki. Ukugcwalisa isikhongozeli nokuyigcina ipholile kunciphisa ukudibana nomoya kwaye iyahlala ixesha elide.
c-205.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba awucwangcisi ukusebenzisa umatshini wokusika ingca ixesha elide, yenza ukuba ipetroli ize ize emva okanye ufake isizinzisi, kwaye ugcine ipetroli eseleyo evaliweyo kwindawo epholileyo.

c-206.title: Ukuba ufake ipetroli kwimoto yedizili, yiyeke ukuqala kuqala
c-206.summary: Ukuba ufake ipetroli ngempazamo kwimoto yedizili, ungayifaki, lixa ucele ukutsalwa ngoko nangoko. Ipompo yepetroli neenjektha zinokonakala.
c-206.principle: Injini yedizili isebenzisa ukutshisa ngoxinzelelo (ukucinezela umoya osondeleyo ngoxinzelelo oluphezulu ukwenza ukuba utshise ngokwawo), kodwa ipetroli ayitshisi lula kwaye ayinaso isiqholo sokuthambisa. Umlinganiselo woxinzelelo wenjini yedizili malunga ne-$\varepsilon=15\sim 20$.
c-206.example: Xa ipetroli ixutywa, ukuthambisa kwepompo yoxinzelelo oluphezulu kuyathamba kwaye kunokubakho ukuguga kwentsimbi kwaye iindleko zokulungisa zinokufikelela kumawaka amaninzi eewon. Ukuba awuyiqali injini uze ucime itanki yepetroli, ukonakala kuhlala kuthintelwa.
c-206.actionItem: Namhlanje xa ufaka ipetroli, jonga umbala wesibambo sepompo nohlobo lwepetroli, kwaye ukuba ufake ngempazamo, ungajiki isitshixo uze uqhagamshelane nenkampani yokulungisa.

c-207.title: I-urea solution iyonakala ehlotyeni kubushushu obuphezulu
c-207.summary: Ukuba i-urea solution ishiywa kubushushu obuphezulu ixesha elide, i-urea iyaqhekeka kwaye ukuxinana kuyehla kwaye kuvela ivumba le-ammonia. Yigcine kwindawo epholileyo emthunzini kwaye ungasebenzisi eyindala.
c-207.principle: I-urea solution (32.5% yesisombululo samanzi se-urea) iyahydrolysa ikhuphe i-ammonia nge-$\mathrm{(NH_2)_2CO}+\mathrm{H_2O}\rightarrow 2\mathrm{NH_3}+\mathrm{CO_2}$, kwaye kwisixhobo se-SCR inciphisa i-nitrogen oxides nge-$4\mathrm{NH_3}+4\mathrm{NO}+\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow 4\mathrm{N_2}+6\mathrm{H_2O}$.
c-207.example: I-urea solution ihlala malunga nonyaka omnye ngaphantsi kwama-25℃, kodwa ngaphezulu kwama-30℃ ncipha ukuya kwiinyanga ezimbalwa, kwaye kwibhutsi yemoto kwindawo ye-50℃ umgangatho unokwehla ngeeveki ezimbalwa. Ukuxinana kuphambuka kumgangatho we-32.5%.
c-207.actionItem: Namhlanje beka i-urea solution kwindawo epholileyo ngaphandle kwelanga elicacileyo, kwaye ibhotile eshiywe ixesha elide kwibhutsi yemoto jonga imeko yayo phambi kokuyisebenzisa.

c-208.title: Ioli yenjini ijongwa ngokuhlala komzimba nokusetyenziswa kwezongezelelo, hayi umgama oqhutyiweyo
c-208.summary: Ixesha lokutshintsha ioli yenjini lichaphazelekile ngumgama kunye nexesha, inani lohambo olufutshane nemozulu eshushu. Sebenzisa umjikelo omiselwe ngumenzi, kodwa uwenze kwangethuba kwiimeko ezinzima.
c-208.principle: Ioli yenjini iyaoksida kubushushu obuphezulu, ukuxinana kuyanda kwaye kwenziwa isludge, kwaye izongezelelo ezifana ne-detergent-dispersants ziyasetyenziswa, ngoko amandla okubamba iasidi nomlotha ancipha. Isantya se-oxidation $k=Ae^{-E_a/RT}$ siphindwe kabini malunga nokunyuka kobushushu ngama-10℃.
c-208.example: Ukuba umenzi ucebisa i-10,000km okanye unyaka omnye, kwiimeko ezinzima ezifana nokuhamba imigama emifutshane kuphela okanye ukuqhuba kwimozulu eshushu kakhulu, kungcono ukutshintsha ngaphakathi kwe-5,000~7,500km okanye iinyanga ezi-6. Nokuba uhamba i-5,000km ngonyaka, tshintsha emva konyaka.
c-208.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga umjikelo wokutshintsha kwisitikha sokukhonza okanye kwincwadana yemoto kwaye uthelekise nomhla wokugqibela wokutshintsha.

c-209.title: Ingaba ukufaka i-nitrogen kumatayara kunengeniso
c-209.summary: Ukufaka i-nitrogen kumatayara kuthintela uxinzelelo ukuba lwehle kancinci, kodwa isiphumo asisikhulu. Okona kubalulekileyo akukhona uhlobo lwerhasi kodwa ukujonga uxinzelelo lomoya kanye ngenyanga.
c-209.principle: Irabha ivumela i-oksijini idlule ngamaxesha angama-3~4 ngaphezu kwe-nitrogen. Umoya yi-N$_2$ malunga nama-78%, O$_2$ 21%, ngoko ukufaka i-nitrogen kunciphisa ukungena kwe-O$_2$ kwaye kulibazisa ukwehla koxinzelelo. Kumthamo ongatshintshiyo uxinzelelo $P=\frac{nRT}{V}$ lulingana nenani lee-mole nobushushu.
c-209.example: Itayara yomoya oqhelekileyo ilahlekelwa malunga ne-1~2psi (malunga ne-7~14kPa) ngenyanga kwaye i-nitrogen ilahlekelwa ngokungaphantsi kunoko. Xa ubushushu behla nge-10℃, uxinzelelo lwehla malunga ne-1psi ukukhuphela ku-nitrogen nomoya.
c-209.actionItem: Namhlanje linganisa uxinzelelo lomoya xa itayara ibandile uze ulungelelanise noxinzelelo olubhaliweyo kuphawu lomnyango.

c-210.title: Ibhokisi yesidlo sasemini esishiywe kwiqondo lengingqi ngoba isabilisa itshiphu yobuthi iyahlala
c-210.summary: Ibhokisi yesidlo sasemini okanye i-kimbap eshiywe kwiqondo lengingqi ehlotyeni, ukuba iqala ukonakala, nokuba iyaphinda yanyaniswa okanye yabiliswa, ubuthi buyahlala kwaye bunokubangela ukutya okonakeleyo. Ukuba kukho ukuthandabuza, yilahle.
c-210.principle: I-enterotoxin eyenziwe yi-Staphylococcus aureus ngelixa ikhula kwiqondo lengingqi iyamelana nobushushu, ngoko nokuba ushisa ngaphezulu kwe-100℃ ngaphezulu kwemizuzu engama-30, esona sixa sihlala. Nokuba iintsholongwane ziyafa, ulwakhiwo lweprotheni yobuthi aluchithwa lula ngoko iimpawu ziyavela.
c-210.example: Iintsholongwane zikhula ngokukhawuleza kwi-20~37℃ kwaye zinokwenza ubuthi ngeeyure ezimbalwa, kwaye emva kokutya ngaphakathi kweeyure ezi-1~6 kunokuza ukugabha nesisu esibuhlungu. Ukutya okushiywe kwiqondo lengingqi ngaphezulu kweeyure ezi-2 emva kokupheka (iyure enye ngaphezulu kwama-30℃) kuyingozi.
c-210.actionItem: Namhlanje faka ibhokisi yesidlo sasemini ngepakethe yomkhenkce kwibhegi ebandayo, kwaye ungatyi ukutya okushiywe kwiqondo lengingqi ngaphezulu kweeyure ezi-2 emva kokupheka.

c-211.title: Ungahlambi izitya ngesepha emlanjeni nasolwandle
c-211.summary: Ukuba uhlamba izitya ngesepha emlanjeni okanye emanxweni, amanzi ayangcola kwaye iintlanzi zinokufa nezityalo zamanzi zikhule. Hlamba izitya kwindawo ebekelwe yona yekampu.
c-211.principle: Ii-surfactants zesepha zonakalisa ii-gill membranes zezilwanyana zasemanzini, kwaye ii-phosphates zandisa ukutya kwenitrojeni nefosfore ukubangela ukukhula okuphezulu kwezityalo zamanzi (eutrophication). Xa izityalo zamanzi zifa, i-oksijini isetyenziselwa ukubola kwaye i-oksijini enyibilikileyo (DO) iyancipha.
c-211.example: Ithontsi elinye lesepha yokuhlamba izitya (malunga ne-0.05mL) linokuchaphazela izidalwa zasemanzini kumashumi eelitha zamanzi. Xa i-DO yomlambo ehla ngaphantsi kwe-5mg/L, iintlanzi ziyaphila nzima.
c-211.actionItem: Namhlanje ngaphandle, qokelela intsalela yokutya uthathe, uze uhlambe izitya kwindawo yokukhupha amanzi amdaka yekampu.

c-212.title: Iimosquito zilandela ukuphefumla nevumba lomgqugqisi
c-212.summary: Iimosquito zilandela i-carbon dioxide ephefumlelwa ngabantu nevumba le-lactic acid yomgqugqisi ukufumana indawo yokufunxa igazi. Ukusula umgqugqisi nokufaka i-repellent kunciphisa ithuba lokulunywa.
c-212.principle: Ii-receptors zeentloko zeemosquito zilandela igradient yokuxinana ukuya kwicala eliphezulu le-CO$_2$ ne-lactic acid ($\mathrm{C_3H_6O_3}$). I-CO$_2$ yokuphefumla ingama-4% malunga, amaxesha ali-100 ngaphezu komoya (malunga ne-0.04%).
c-212.example: Umntu uphefumla malunga ne-1kg ye-CO$_2$ ngosuku, kwaye emva kokuzilolonga i-lactic acid yomgqugqisi iyanda, ngoko iimosquito zinokufika zisuka kumashumi eemitha. Iimveliso ze-DEET ze-10~30% ngokuqhelekileyo zinika ukhuseleko iiyure ezininzi.
c-212.actionItem: Namhlanje phambi kokuphuma, sula umgqugqisi, faka i-repellent kwisikhumba esivulekileyo nakwimpahla, uze ukhuphe amanzi amile.

c-213.title: Ivumba lomsele wokukhupha amanzi lisuka xa i-water seal yomile
c-213.summary: Ukuba ivumba lomsele wokukhupha amanzi liphuma kumsele wokukhupha, kunokwenzeka ukuba amanzi etrap (i-water seal) omile. Galela isitya samanzi uzalise i-water seal ukuvala ivumba.
c-213.principle: Amanzi ahlala kwicandelo elimile ngolu U letrap (i-water seal) avala irhasi yomsele. Xa i-water seal ibhonga, i-hydrogen sulfide ($\mathrm{H_2S}$) eyenziwe zii-microbe zomsele iyanyuka. Ubunzulu be-water seal buqhelekile malunga ne-50mm.
c-213.example: Kwimisele yomgangatho wendlu yokuhlambela engasetyenziswa, i-water seal yomile ngaphakathi kweeveki ezi-1~2 kwaye ivumba linokuvela. Ukugalela malunga ne-500mL yamanzi kuzalisa i-water seal. Ehlotyeni ukubhonga kukhawuleza ngoko yomile rhoqo.
c-213.actionItem: Namhlanje galela isitya samanzi kwimisele yendlu yokuhlambela ne-balcony engasetyenziswa uzalise i-water seal uze uphindaphinde kanye ngenyanga.

c-214.title: Kutheni i-air conditioner inevumba elimuncu
c-214.summary: Ivumba elimuncu kwi-air conditioner livela kwiintsholongwane nokungunda okukhulileyo emanzini ahlalayo nothulini ngaphakathi. Ukomisa ngaphakathi ngofan ngaphambi kokucima kunciphisa oku.
c-214.principle: Amanzi acinezelwe emphezulu wee-fins zokupholisa ahlala njenge-$\mathrm{H_2O(g)}\rightarrow \mathrm{H_2O(l)}$, kwaye ii-microbes zikhula kuthuli nakwizinto eziphilayo, kwaye ii-metabolites ezibhongayo (ii-fatty acids, utywala nokunye) zivelisa ivumba elimuncu.
c-214.example: Ukuba ucima ngoko nangoko emva kokusebenza kokupholisa, ukufuma kwangaphakathi kuhlala ngaphezulu kwama-80% kwaye iintsholongwane zikhula lula. Ukusebenzisa ifan imizuzu eyi-10~30 phambi kokucima, ngaphakathi kuyoma kakhulu kwaye ivumba liyancipha kakhulu.
c-214.actionItem: Namhlanje phambi kokucima i-air conditioner, yisebenzise kwimodi ye-fan imizuzu eyi-15 ize ukhuphe ifilitha uyiqhume uthuli uyomise.

c-215.title: Into emhlophe ekhulile kwi-chocolate ayiyongunda
c-215.summary: Indawo emhlophe ekhulile kumphezulu we-chocolate ayiyongunda, kodwa i-fat bloom eyenziwe ngoku-nyibilika nokuqina kwakhona kwe-cocoa butter. Incasa iba nzima kancinci, kodwa iyakhuseleka ukuyitya.
c-215.principle: I-cocoa butter inazo iifomu ezininzi zekristali (i-polymorphs), kwaye iFomu V ezinzileyo itshintshela kwiFomu VI ezinzileyo ngakumbi ngotshintsho lobushushu ize ivele ngaphezulu ibonakale imhlophe. Ubushushu bokunyibilika beFomu V malunga nama-34℃.
c-215.example: Ukuba igcinwa ngaphezulu kwama-28℃ okanye ubushushu buyahla buyanyuka rhoqo, i-bloom inokuvela ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezimbalwa~iiveki ezimbalwa. Ubushushu obufanelekileyo bokugcina i-chocolate malunga nama-15~18℃, ukufuma okuhambelana ngaphantsi kwama-50%.
c-215.actionItem: Namhlanje gcina i-chocolate kwindawo epholileyo ngaphandle kwelanga elicacileyo, kwaye xa uyikhuphe efrijini, yishiye kwiqondo lengingqi ngaphakathi kwephakheji ukuthintela ukunciphisa.

c-216.title: I-mackerel netuna zenza i-histamine ukuba zishiywe kwiqondo lengingqi
c-216.summary: Iintlanzi ezinenyama ebomvu ezifana ne-mackerel, netuna nenye zenza i-histamine xa zishiywe ixesha elide kwiqondo lengingqi, nokubangela ukubomvu kobuso, intloko ebuhlungu neengcambu. Ayinyamalali nangobushushu, ngoko zigcine zitsha.
c-216.principle: I-histidine decarboxylase yeentsholongwane iguqula i-histidine yentlanzi ibe yi-histamine: $\mathrm{C_6H_9N_3O_2}\rightarrow \mathrm{C_5H_9N_3}+\mathrm{CO_2}$. I-histamine izinzile kubushushu kwaye phantse ayonakaliswa ngokutshisa.
c-216.example: I-histamine inokwenzeka ngeeyure ezimbalwa kwiqondo lengingqi (25℃) kwaye ngokucotha kakhulu efrijini ye-4℃. Umgangatho wokutya ngokuqhelekileyo ungaphantsi kwe-200mg/kg kwaye ukutya ngaphezulu kwe-100mg kunokubangela iimpawu.
c-216.actionItem: Namhlanje faka iintlanzi ezinenyama ebomvu efrijini okanye efrizeni ngokukhawuleza emva kokuzithenga, kwaye ungazityi iintlanzi ezishiywe kwiqondo lengingqi ngaphezulu kweeyure ezi-2.

c-217.title: Kutheni iintente neekoti zemvula ezindala ziba nokunamathela
c-217.summary: Ukuba ukhuseleko lwamanzi olungaphakathi lweentente okanye iikoti zemvula ezindala luba nokunamathela noku-flake, kungenxa yokuba i-polyurethane iye yahydrolysa ngenxa yokufuma nobushushu. Ukuyigcina eyomileyo ngokupheleleyo kuyalibazisa.
c-217.principle: Iibhondi ze-ester zekoti ye-polyurethane (PU) ziphendula ngamanzi zaqhekeka nge-$\mathrm{R{-}COO{-}R'}+\mathrm{H_2O}\rightarrow \mathrm{R{-}COOH}+\mathrm{R'{-}OH}$, iintambo ziba mfutshane kwaye ziba nokunamathela. Kukhawuleza ukuba kukho ubushushu ukufuma.
c-217.example: Iintente ezineekoti ze-PU zihydrolysa emva kweminyaka emi-3~5. Ukuba zisongelwa zifumile zigcinwe ngaphezulu kwama-30℃, zinokunamathela ngexesha elinye.
c-217.actionItem: Namhlanje beka intente nekoti yemvula emva kokuba zomile ngokupheleleyo kwindawo epholileyo, kwaye ukuba ziqala ukunamathela, cinga ukutshintshela kwiimveliso ezintsha.

c-218.title: Kutheni isepha yeekapsule yokuhlamba iguquka ibe ziziqhuma
c-218.summary: Isepha yeekapsule ayinyibiliki ihlala iziqhuma ngenxa yamanzi abandayo, amanzi amancinci okanye ukugcwalisa ngokugqithisileyo. Beka ikapsule ngaphantsi kwedrum kuqala uze ubeke impahla phezulu kwayo.
c-218.principle: Ifilimu ye-PVA (polyvinyl alcohol) ejikeleze ikapsule inyibilika emanzini kwaye isantya sokunyibilika sixhomekeke kakhulu kubushushu bamanzi. Isantya $k=Ae^{-E_a/RT}$ sicotha xa ubushushu buphantsi, ngoko ayinyibiliki kakuhle emanzini abandayo.
c-218.example: Ifilimu ye-PVA inyibilika ngemizuzu eyi-1~3 emanzini angama-40℃, kodwa emanzini abandayo angaphantsi kwama-15℃ inokuthatha ngaphezulu kwemizuzu eyi-10. Ukuba ugcwalisa impahla kakhulu, ikapsule icinezelwa yimpahla kwaye amanzi awafikeleli.
c-218.actionItem: Namhlanje ungayichukumisi isepha yeekapsule ngezandla ezimanzi, yibeke kuqala kwidrum emva koko ubeke impahla phezulu, kwaye usebenzise isepha engamanzi kwimodi yamanzi abandayo.

c-219.title: Intonga yokukhanya yekampu ikhanya ngempendulo yekhemikhali
c-219.summary: Intonga yokukhanya yekampu ukuba ijojiswa, ulwelo lubini ngaphakathi luyaxubana kwaye ukhanya ngempendulo yekhemikhali. Ikhanya ngaphandle kombane okanye ubushushu, kwaye xa ishushu ikhanya ngakumbi kwaye ixesha lifutshane, xa ibanda ikhanya kancinci kwaye ixesha lide.
c-219.principle: I-hydrogen peroxide nesi-oxalate ester ngaphakathi kombhobho weglasi ziyaphendula zivelise i-intermediate yamandla aphezulu, kwaye la mandla avusa udayi we-fluorescent akhuphe ukukhanya (i-chemiluminescence). Isantya sempendulo $k=Ae^{-E_a/RT}$ sibuthathaka ebushushwini.
c-219.example: Intonga yokukhanya ikhanya ngokuqhelekileyo iiyure ezi-6~12 kwi-20℃, kodwa kwi-40℃ ikhanya ngakumbi kwaye inokucima ngaphakathi kweeyure ezi-1~2, kwaye ukuba uyifaka efrizeni ukukhanya kuyathamba kodwa xa uyifudumeza iphinda ikhanye. Ubushushu abuvelisi kangako, ngoko ingozi yomlilo iphantsi.
c-219.actionItem: Namhlanje ukulungiselela ikampu yasebusuku okanye ukucima kombane, faka iintonga ezi-1~2 zokukhanya ebhegini, kwaye ukuba ulwelo lwangaphakathi luvuza, lungachukumisi isikhumba.

c-220.title: Imibala yeerokhethi zomlilo yimpendulo yelangatye yeeelementi zentsimbi
c-220.summary: Imibala yeerokhethi zomlilo ngukukhanya okukhutshwa zii-elements zentsimbi ezixutywe kwi-gunpowder. I-strontium ikhupha ubomvu, ubhedu ubhlowu, kwaye i-barium luhlaza.
c-220.principle: Ubushushu belangatye buvusa ii-elektroni zee-athom zentsimbi, kwaye xa ii-elektroni zibuyela kumanqanaba aphantsi amandla zikhupha ukukhanya okuhambelana ne-$E=h\nu=\frac{hc}{\lambda}$. Ii-element nganye inamanqanaba amandla ahlukileyo, ngoko kuvela umbala wayo ngokuthe ngqo.
c-220.example: I-Sr ikhupha ubomvu be-650nm malunga, i-Ba ubuluhlaza be-520nm, i-Cu ubhlowu be-450nm, i-Na ubugolide be-589nm. Ubhlowu yeyona nto inzima ukwenza kuba iikhompawundi zobhedu ziqhekeka lula ngaphezulu kwama-1,200℃ malunga.
c-220.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba ubukela iirokhethi zomlilo, zama ukuqikelela ukuba yintsimbi yeyiphi ngokubona umbala, kwaye ungasondeli kuba kukho intsalela yomsi we-gunpowder.

c-221.title: Ukucoca amanzi ngebhotile ye-PET ecacileyo nangelanga
c-221.summary: Ukufaka amanzi acacileyo kwibhotile ye-PET ecacileyo uyishiye elangeni iiyure ezi-6 yindlela yokucoca yaxhaswa ngexesha lengxakeko (i-SODIS) yokunciphisa iintsholongwane. Amanzi anobumdaka kufuneka ahluzwe kuqala kwaye ayiyiyo indlela epheleleyo yokucoca amanzi okuselwayo.
c-221.principle: I-ultraviolet A (320~400nm) nobushushu zonakalisa i-DNA neeproteni zeentsholongwane ziyenze zingasebenzi. Impumelelo ilingana nobuninzi be-ultraviolet $H=I\,t$ (i-illuminance×ixesha), kwaye xa ubushushu bamanzi bungaphezulu kwama-50℃ impumelelo inyuka kakhulu.
c-221.example: Ngosuku olucacileyo ukuba ufaka amanzi kwibhotile ye-PET ecacileyo eyi-1~2L uyishiye iiyure ezi-6, iintsholongwane ezininzi ziyancipha, kwaye ukuba isibhakabhaka sinamafu kufuneka iintsuku ezi-2. Ukuba ububumdaka budlula kwi-30 NTU, impumelelo iyehla.
c-221.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba uzama oku njengesilungiso sexesha lengxakeko, sebenzisa amanzi acocekileyo kuphela uze ubeke ibhotile ilele elangeni iiyure ezi-6, kodwa ngokuqhelekileyo okwangoku khetha amanzi abilisiweyo okanye acocekileyo.

c-222.title: I-wrap yokutya iyahluka phakathi kwe-PVC ne-PE
c-222.summary: I-wrap yokutya ineentlobo ezimbini, i-PVC kunye ne-PE (polyethylene), kwaye ngokwemathiriyeli umda wokhuseleko wokusetyenziswa kwi-microwave nokuchukumisa ukutya okunamafutha uyahluka. Jonga imathiriyeli kunye nobushushu obumelana nabo kwiphakheji.
c-222.principle: I-PVC wrap ineeplasticizers ukuze ibe ngathi iyanwebeka, kwaye xa ichukumisa ukutya okunamafutha okanye ishushu, ii-plasticizers zinokufudukela ekutyeni. I-PE wrap ayidingi plasticizers kwaye ubushushu obumelana nabo malunga nama-110℃, bohluke kwi-PVC (ezinye iimveliso zibhalwe ngaphezulu kwama-130℃).
c-222.example: Xa ushisa ukutya ngemicrowave, ukuba i-wrap ichukumisa ukutya, ukutya okunamafutha kuba nobushushu obungaphezulu kwama-100℃ kwaye i-wrap inokunyibilika okanye ii-plasticizers zifudukele ekutyeni. Shiya isithuba esi-2~3cm phakathi kwe-wrap nokutya.
