c-222.actionItem: Namhlanje phambi kokusebenzisa i-wrap, jonga imathiriyeli nophawu lobushushu obumelana nabo, kwaye kwi-microwave yisebenzise phezulu ukuze ingachukumisi ukutya.

c-223.title: Xa ioli eshushu ichukumisa isitya se-ramyun se-Styrofoam
c-223.summary: Ukuba ufaka ukutya okushushu okunamafutha kwisitya se-Styrofoam (polystyrene), isitya siyathamba kwaye i-styrene ikhutshwe kancinci. Landela ubushushu obumelana nabo obubhalwe kwisitya.
c-223.principle: I-polystyrene iyathamba malunga nobushushu be-glass transition obumalunga nama-100℃, kwaye inyibilika kakuhle emafutheni, ngoko i-styrene monomer ($\mathrm{C_8H_8}$) inokufudukela ekutyeni. Isixa sokufuduka siyanda ngobushushu nexesha lokudibana.
c-223.example: Isitya se-ramyun malunga nama-90℃ siphantsi kwamanqaku okuthamba kwe-polystyrene, ngoko ngokubanzi kuvumelekile, kodwa ioli eshushu engaphezulu kwama-100℃ okanye ukutya okunamafutha amaninzi kunokunyibilikisa isitya. Isitya esisetyenziswa kanye sisebenzise kanye nje.
c-223.actionItem: Namhlanje ukutya okushushu okunamafutha kuhambisele kwisitya seglasi okanye i-ceramic eyamelana nobushushu endaweni yesitya se-Styrofoam.

c-224.title: Iingxowa zeplastiki ezibolayo azibolisi ekhaya
c-224.summary: Uninzi lweengxowa zeplastiki ezibolayo ngokwendalo ziqhekeka kuphela kubushushu obuphezulu bezakhiwo zekhompost kwaye ngokwenene azibolisi egadini okanye kwindawo yokulahla inkunkuma yasekhaya. Landela uphawu lokwahlula inkunkuma.
c-224.principle: I-PLA (polylactic acid) iphendula namanzi ihydrolysa ibe $(\mathrm{C_3H_4O_2})_n+n\,\mathrm{H_2O}\rightarrow n\,\mathrm{C_3H_6O_3}$ (i-lactic acid). Le mpendulo ikhawuleza ngaphezulu kwe-glass transition temperature malunga nama-58℃, ngoko kudingeka iimeko zekhompost yoshishino (malunga nama-58℃, ubumanzi).
c-224.example: Kwizakhiwo zekhompost yoshishino (58℃, ubumanzi) i-PLA iqhekeka ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezingama-90~180, kodwa kwimeko yasekhaya ye-20℃ ithatha iminyaka emininzi okanye ayiqhekeki. Ayiqhekeki kakuhle nasolwandle.
c-224.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba ufumana ingxowa enophawu lokubola ngokwendalo, yahlule njengenkunkuma eqhelekileyo kwaye xa kunokwenzeka, sebenzisa ingxowa yokuthenga ephinda isetyenziswe.

c-225.title: Kutheni umbhobho wengadi ucinga ulinyaniswa kwaye uqhekeke ngelanga
c-225.summary: Umbhobho wengadi ushiyeke ngaphandle uba nzima kwaye uqhekeke ngokukhula kweminyaka ngenxa yokuba i-ultraviolet yelanga ithanda ukuqhekeza iintambo zepolymer. Xa ungasebenzisi, uwuthinte emthunzini.
c-225.principle: Amandla e-photon ye-ultraviolet $E=\frac{hc}{\lambda}$ aqhekeza iibhondi ze-C–Cl, C–H zepolymer ezifana ne-PVC aze enze ii-radicals, ziphendula ne-oksijini, kwaye iintambo ziyaqhekeka. Iintambo ziba mfutshane zibe lulwakhiwo olubuthathaka.
c-225.example: Umbhobho wengadi onezinzisi ze-ultraviolet uhlala iminyaka eyi-3~5, ngelixa ukushiywa ngaphantsi kwelanga rhoqo ngaphakathi kweminyaka eyi-1~2 i-plasticizer iphuma kwaye iqhekeka. Imini yehlobo ephakathi ene-UV index ephezulu yeyona ingenampumelelo.
c-225.actionItem: Namhlanje emva kokusebenzisa umbhobho, khupha amanzi uwuqokelele emthunzini okanye ngaphakathi kwebhokisi yeroli yombhobho ukuphepha ilanga.

c-226.title: Kutheni ibhanti yerabha neeglavu zerabha ziqhekeka
c-226.summary: Ibhanti yerabha okanye iiglavu zerabha ziqhekeka zaphuke ngelinye ilanga kuba i-ozone emoyeni ihlasela ibhondi ephindwe kabini yerabha. Ukuzigcina zinwetyiwe kuzenza ziqhekeke ngokukhawuleza.
c-226.principle: I-ozone ibophelela kwibhondi ephindwe kabini C=C yerabha yendalo (polyisoprene) yenze i-ozonide $\mathrm{C{=}C}+\mathrm{O_3}\rightarrow$ kwaye ibhondi iyaqhekeka. Kumphezulu onwetyiwe, iintanda ezijikeleze ngqo zivela lula.
c-226.example: Ukuxinana kwe-ozone emoyeni ngokuqhelekileyo kungu-0.02~0.06ppm, kwaye nakuloo nqanaba irabha enwetyiwe inokuqhekeka ngaphakathi kweeveki ezimbalwa~iinyanga ezimbalwa. Ukuyigcina kwindawo epholileyo kwandisa kakhulu ubomi.
c-226.actionItem: Namhlanje gcina amabhanti erabha neeglavu zerabha zityandiwe kungwenyelwanga kwidroyi epholileyo emnyama evaliweyo.

c-227.title: Kutheni izihlangu ezimhlophe zibe mfusa
c-227.summary: Izihlangu ezimhlophe zibe mfusa nokuba zigcinwe kuphela kungenxa yokuba i-polyurethane yezantsi i-oxidize ngokukhanya ne-oksijini kwaye i-antioxidant ye-phenol iyatshintsha. Zigcine kwindawo epholileyo emnyama.
c-227.principle: Izithako ze-aromatic ze-polyurethane zi-oxidize nge-ultraviolet ne-oksijini zivelise ii-chromophores ezimfusa, kwaye i-antioxidant ye-phenol iphendula ne-nitrogen oxides ibe zizinto ezimfusa zohlobo lwe-quinone. Isantya se-photo-oxidation sikhula ngokulingana ne-UV dose.
c-227.example: Ukuba zishiywe efestileni ekhanyayo, zibe mfusa ngokucacileyo ngaphakathi kweeveki ezimbalwa~iinyanga ezimbalwa, ngamaxesha amaninzi ngokukhawuleza kunakwishelufu yezihlangu emnyama. Ubumfusa buvela kumaleko obhityileyo womphezulu, ngoko bunokunciphiswa ngenxalenye nge-bleach esekelwe kwi-oksijini.
c-227.actionItem: Namhlanje beka izihlangu ezimhlophe kwishelufu yezihlangu emnyama enomoya kunokuba efestileni enelanga, kwaye uzifake kwingxowa yekotoni endaweni yeplastiki.

c-228.title: Kutheni umbala weejini ezintsha uphuma ekuhlambeni kokuqala
c-228.summary: Ukuba iblue iphuma kwiejini ezintsha ekuhlambeni kokuqala, kungenxa yokuba udayi we-indigo unamathela kuphela kumphezulu we-fiber njengamaqhekeza. Ekuqaleni zihlambe zijijwe ngaphakathi kumanzi abandayo ngokwahlukeneyo.
c-228.principle: I-indigo ngudayi ongenyibiliki emanzini odayiwe ngohlobo olunciphisiweyo (olunyibilikayo emanzini), emva koko i-oxidize emoyeni ibe ngamaqhekeza angenyibiliki anamathela kumphezulu we-fiber. Ayibophelelwanga ngokwekhemikhali kwi-fiber, ihleli ngaphandle, ngoko ihlanjwa ngokukhuhlana namanzi.
c-228.example: Ijini entsha enye (malunga ne-600g) ekuhlambeni kokuqala inokukhupha malunga ne-1~2g yodayi, ngoko ukuba ihlanjwe nempahla emhlophe, iya kuba blue. Emanzini abandayo (angaphantsi kwama-30℃) ukuphuma kodayi kuncinci.
c-228.actionItem: Namhlanje hlamba iijini ezintsha ngokuzijija ngaphakathi emanzini abandayo ngokwahlukeneyo okokuqala, ungazixuboli nempahla emhlophe kwaye uzomise emthunzini.

c-229.title: Isamente esimanzi sine-alkali, ngoko sitshisa isikhumba
c-229.summary: Isamente esimanzi nekonkrithi zine-alkali ngamandla, ngoko ukuba ungazi ukuba kuchukumisile uzishiye ixesha elide, kwenzeka ukutshiswa kwekhemikhali kwesikhumba.
c-229.principle: Isithako se-calcium sesamente xa ihlangana namanzi senza $\mathrm{Ca(OH)_2}$ kwaye i-pH ibe malunga ne-12.5, kwaye i-alkali ihydrolysa iiproteni namafutha esikhumba inyibilikise izicubu. $\mathrm{CaO + H_2O \to Ca(OH)_2}$
c-229.example: Ukuba usebenza iiyure ezi-1~2 ugobile phezu kwekonkrithi emanzi, kuxelwe iimeko zokutshiswa kwenqanaba lesi-2 ngaphandle kobuhlungu. I-pH 12.5 iphezulu ngamaxesha angama-300,000 ngaphezulu kwe-pH 7 kwi-$[\mathrm{OH^-}]$.
c-229.actionItem: Ukuba isamente sichukumisile, shukumisa umgubo owomileyo uze uhlambe ngamanzi asemileyo imizuzu eyi-15 okanye ngaphezulu, kwaye namhlanje xa usebenza unxibe iiglavu ezikhusela amanzi nepantyisi ende.

c-230.title: Xa usebenzisa imveliso yokuvula imisele, lumka ubushushu nerhasi
c-230.summary: Isicoci semisele se-caustic soda siyashisa xa sinyibilika emanzini, kwaye xa sihlangana ne-aluminium kuphuma irhasi ye-hydrogen.
c-230.principle: I-NaOH inyibilika emanzini ikhupha ubushushu obumalunga ne-44.5kJ/mol, kwaye kunye ne-aluminium yenza i-hydrogen. $2\mathrm{Al} + 2\mathrm{NaOH} + 6\mathrm{H_2O} \to 2\mathrm{Na[Al(OH)_4]} + 3\mathrm{H_2}$
c-230.example: Xa i-100g ye-NaOH (2.5 mol) inyibilika, ikhupha malunga ne-111kJ, enokunyusa i-1L yamanzi malunga nama-26℃. Kwimibhobho emxinwa kuhambe ngokukhethekileyo ngakumbi ishushu kwaye inokubila ityhale.
c-230.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba usebenzisa isicoci semisele, venkcisa umoya, unxibe iiglasi ezikhuselayo neeglavu, kwaye ungaxuboli nezinye izicoci okanye izikhongozeli ze-aluminium.

c-231.title: Iglue ye-epoxy iqina kuphela xa ixutywa 1 ku-1 ngokuchanekileyo
c-231.summary: I-epoxy iqina kuphela xa isiseko kunye nesiqinisi zihlangana ngomlinganiselo omiselweyo, kwaye ukuba umlinganiselo uphosakele, ihlala inamatha.
c-231.principle: Iqela le-epoxy ne-hydrogen esebenzayo ye-amine ziphendula nge-1:1 equivalent zenze ulwakhiwo lwesihlungu. Isixa sesiqinisi sinqunywa yi-$m_{\mathrm{hardener}} = \frac{\mathrm{AHEW}}{\mathrm{EEW}} \times m_{\mathrm{resin}}$.
c-231.example: Xa uxuba i-5mL yesiseko kunye ne-5mL yesiqinisi (1:1), ukuba umlinganiselo uphambuka ngaphezulu kwama-20%, ukunamatha kuhlala lula. Ukuqina ngokupheleleyo kuthatha malunga neeyure ezingama-24, kwaye ukuze ithwale amandla kufuneka ulinde usuku olunye.
c-231.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba usebenzisa i-epoxy, linganisa ngomlinganiselo kwincwadana yemveliso uze uxube ngaphezulu kwemizuzu emi-2 ukhuhle ezantsi, uze uyigcobe ibhityile.

c-232.title: Amanzi e-aquarium azinza ngokuba i-ammonia iguqulwa ibe yi-nitrate
c-232.summary: Kwi-aquarium entsha, i-ammonia ne-nitrite ziqokelelana de iintsholongwane zenitrification zikhule, kwaye iintlanzi ziyingozini.
c-232.principle: Iintsholongwane zenitrification ziguqula i-ammonia enobuthi ibe yi-nitrite, emva koko ibe yi-nitrate engenabuthi kangako. $\mathrm{NH_4^+ + 1.5\,O_2 \to NO_2^- + 2H^+ + H_2O}$, $\mathrm{NO_2^- + 0.5\,O_2 \to NO_3^-}$
c-232.example: I-aquarium entsha ithatha ngokuqhelekileyo iiveki ezi-4~6 ukuzinza, kwaye ukwandisa iintlanzi emva kokuba i-ammonia ne-nitrite zingu-0ppm kuyakhuseleka. Gcina i-nitrate ngaphantsi kwe-40ppm ngokutshintsha amanzi angama-20~30% kanye ngeveki.
c-232.actionItem: Namhlanje linganisa i-ammonia, i-nitrite ne-nitrate ngeestrip zovavanyo lwamanzi e-aquarium, kwaye xa utshintsha amanzi ungayihlambi i-filter media ngamanzi epompo, uyihlambe emanzini e-aquarium akhutshiweyo.

c-233.title: Ungayifaki amanzi kumlilo weoli, vala ngesiciko
c-233.summary: Ukuba ufaka amanzi emlilweni weoli, ioli evutha itshiza ngomphunga kuzo zonke iindawo.
c-233.principle: Umlilo udinga uphawu, i-oksijini nobushushu zonke, ngoko kufuneka usike i-oksijini ngesiciko. Amanzi ayantywila phantsi kweoli abile ngokukhawuleza kwaye umthamo uyanda malunga namaxesha ayi-1,700. $\mathrm{H_2O(l) \to H_2O(g)}$
c-233.example: Ukuba ikomityi eyi-1 yamanzi (200mL) ichukumisa ioli engaphezulu kwama-300℃, malunga ne-340L yomphunga wenziwa ngoko nangoko kwaye unokutshiza ioli evuthayo ukuya kumphezulu wendlu.
c-233.actionItem: Namhlanje beka isiciko esihambelana nobungakanani bepani kufutshane nesitovu serhasi ekhitshini kwindawo ofikelela kuyo, kwaye ukhumbule ukulandelelana: xa kukho umlilo, cima umlilo uze uvale ngesiciko.

c-234.title: Kutheni ulala xa uqhuba umgama omde ngokuvula kuphela ukujikeleza komoya wangaphakathi
c-234.summary: Ukuba uvula ukujikeleza komoya wangaphakathi kuphela ixesha elide, i-carbon dioxide iqokelelana emotweni kwaye kunokwenzeka ukulala nokuncipha kwengqondo.
c-234.principle: Kwindawo evaliweyo, i-CO2 ekhutshwa ngokuphefumla ayikhupheki ngokuventilesha, ngoko ukuxinana kunyuka ngokulinganayo nexesha. $\Delta C \approx \frac{G}{V}\,t$ ($G$: isantya sokuveliswa, $V$: umthamo wegumbi)
c-234.example: I-CO2 yangaphandle imalunga ne-420ppm, kodwa kwimoto enabantu abaninzi ukusebenzisa ukujikeleza komoya wangaphakathi kuphela imizuzu eyi-30~iyure enye, kuye kwalinganiswa iimeko ezidlula kwi-2,000ppm. Ngokuqhelekileyo ukulala kuxelwa ukususela kwi-1,000ppm.
c-234.actionItem: Namhlanje xa uqhuba, tshintshela kwimodi yomoya wangaphandle imizuzu emi-20~30 yonke okanye uvule ifestile ixesha elifutshane ukuventilesha.

c-235.title: Yeka amanzi epompo okuqala ekuseni ahambe kancinci
c-235.summary: Amanzi ahlala ebhobhoni ubusuku bonke anokuba nee-ions zentsimbi ezinyibilikileyo, ngoko kungcono ukuwayeka ahambe kancinci phambi kokuwasebenzisa.
c-235.principle: Ubhedu, i-lead nezinye zomba nee-tap ziyaoksida kancinci emanzini zinyibilike. $\mathrm{Pb \to Pb^{2+} + 2e^-}$, $\mathrm{Cu \to Cu^{2+} + 2e^-}$ okukhona ixesha lokuma lide, ukuxinana kuyanda.
c-235.example: Amanzi ahlala ngaphezulu kweeyure ezi-6, ukuba uwayeka ahambe imizuzwana engama-30~umzuzu omnye ade abe nabandayo, unokuwasebenzisa. Kumlinganiselo we-6L ngomzuzu, umzuzu omnye ngu-6L malunga, kwaye ukuba la manzi uwasebenzisela izityalo okanye ukucoca, akusiyo ilahleko.
c-235.actionItem: Namhlanje ekuseni phambi kokubeka ikomityi, vula amanzi imizuzwana engama-30~umzuzu omnye uze uwaqokelele ukuwasebenzisa kwizityalo okanye ekuhluzeni.

c-236.title: Nokuba usela amanzi e-alkaline, ayaneutralize ngokukhawuleza esiswini
c-236.summary: Nokuba usela amanzi e-alkaline, i-asidi esisiswini iyaneutralize ngokukhawuleza, ngoko ayitshintshi i-pH yomzimba kwaye isizathu sokuhlawula imali eninzi sincinci.
c-236.principle: Umhluzo wesisu uyi-HCl malunga ne-0.01~0.1 M, i-pH ye-1.5~3.5, kwaye i-$\mathrm{OH^-}$ yamanzi e-alkaline iphendula ne-asidi yesisu ngoko nangoko. $\mathrm{HCl + OH^- \to H_2O + Cl^-}$
c-236.example: I-1L yamanzi e-alkaline ene-pH 9 ine-$\mathrm{OH^-}$ ye-$10^{-5}$ mol kuphela, ngoko ineutralize kuphela i-1% ye-100mL yomhluzo wesisu we-pH 2 (H+ $10^{-3}$ mol). I-pH yegazi igcinwa kuma-7.35~7.45 yindlela yokuphefumla nezintso.
c-236.actionItem: Phambi kokuthenga imveliso yamanzi e-alkaline, jonga amabango asempilweni angenabungqina, kwaye namhlanje sebenzisa amanzi epompo eqhelekileyo okanye acociweyo ukuphinda uzalise ngokwaneleyo.

c-237.title: Ukugcina iibhetri efrijini akunamsebenzi mkhulu
c-237.summary: Iibhetri ze-alkaline zale mihla ngokuzenzekelayo zingena kancinci kakhulu nakwiqondo lengingqi, ngoko inzuzo yokugcina efrijini incinci kwaye kukho ingozi yokunciphisa.
c-237.principle: Ukuzikhupha kwebhetri yimpendulo yekhemikhali, ngoko xa ubushushu bunyuka ikhawuleza ngokwefomula ka-Arrhenius. $k = A\,e^{-E_a/RT}$ Ngokuphambene, ukunciphisa ubushushu kuyancipha, kodwa ibhetri ye-alkaline sele icotha kakhulu.
c-237.example: Ibhetri ye-alkaline kwi-20℃ izikhupha malunga ne-2~3% ngonyaka kuphela kwaye ixesha lokugcina li-5~10 iminyaka. Nokuba ugcina efrijini, ukonga malunga ne-1% ngonyaka kuphela, kwaye amathontsi amanzi enziwe xa uyikhupha anokukhula kwii-terminals.
c-237.actionItem: Namhlanje gcina iibhetri kwidroyi epholileyo eyomileyo ngohlobo olufanayo, kwaye ungaxubi ezintsha nezindala kwisixhobo esinye.

c-238.title: Amalahle ekampu: i-briquette, i-white charcoal ne-black charcoal ayahluka
c-238.summary: Amalahle ayahluka ngokwenqanaba le-carbonization ngesantya sokubasa, umsi nexesha lokuqhubeka, ngoko khetha ngokuhambelana nokusetyenziswa.
c-238.principle: Okukhona i-carbonization iphezulu, iziqulatho ezibhonxayo ziyancipha kwaye umlinganiselo wekhabhoni uphezulu, ngoko umsi uncinci kwaye utshisa ixesha elide. $\mathrm{C + O_2 \to CO_2}$ ($\Delta H \approx -394$ kJ/mol), xa i-oksijini ingenanga, $2\mathrm{C + O_2 \to 2CO}$.
c-238.example: I-1kg yamalahle ikhupha malunga ne-29MJ (malunga ne-8kWh) yobushushu, kwaye ilahle elimhlophe elibhakwe malunga nama-1,000℃ linomsi omncinci kwaye litshisa ixesha elide, kodwa kunzima ukulibasa. Ilahle elimnyama libasa lula, kodwa linomsi neziqulatho ezibhonxayo ezininzi, nebriquette inomlotha omninzi ngenxa yesinamathelisi.
c-238.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba uthenga amalahle ekampu, khetha ngokuhambelana nenjongo kwaye ungatshisi amalahle ngaphakathi kwentente okanye kwindawo evaliweyo (ingozi yokuthotywa yi-carbon monoxide).

c-239.title: Isizathu sokutya ii-carbohydrates kamsinya emva kokuzilolonga
c-239.summary: Iyure ye-1~2 emva kokuzilolonga imisipha yamkela ishukela kakuhle, ngoko ukutya ii-carbohydrates ngoku kuzalisa i-glycogen ngokukhawuleza.
c-239.principle: I-glycogen yemisipha engenanto ngokuzilolonga iphinda yakhiwe ngenxa ye-insulin nabathutha beglucose bemisipha. $(\mathrm{Glucose})_n + \mathrm{Glucose} \to (\mathrm{Glucose})_{n+1}$
c-239.example: Imisipha igcina malunga ne-400g ye-glycogen, kwaye emva kokuzilolonga kakhulu ukutya ibhanana eyi-1 (malunga ne-27g ye-carbohydrates) nekomityi yobisi kwanele kumntu oqhelekileyo. Ekuzilolongeni okuqhelekileyo ngokuphumla ngaphezulu kosuku olunye, ayiyomfuneko ukunamathela eli xesha.
c-239.actionItem: Namhlanje ukuba uzilolonga, ngaphakathi kweyure enye emva kokugqiba, zama ukutya ii-carbohydrates neeproteni kunye ezifana nebhanana, isitya serayisi, ubisi.

c-240.title: Umbala ocacileyo wee-apricot ezomisiweyo ngenxa ye-sulfites
c-240.summary: Ii-apricot ezomisiweyo ezingqamene noorenji zikhuselwe ekuguquleni ngokumdaka nge-sulfites, kwaye ezintsundu luphawu lokungabikho kwezongezelelo, kwaye abantu abane-asthma kufuneka balumke.
c-240.principle: $\mathrm{SO_2}$ inyibilika emanzini ibe yi-ion ye-bisulfite ithintele i-enzyme yokumdaka kunye ne-oxidation. $\mathrm{SO_2 + H_2O \rightleftharpoons HSO_3^- + H^+}$
c-240.example: Ii-apricot ezomisiweyo ezisetyenziswe i-sulfur zihlala zinemizuzu ye-$\mathrm{SO_2}$ yamakhulu~2,000mg/kg, kwaye ngaphezulu kwe-10mg/kg amazwe amaninzi afuna ukuphawulwa. Izigulana ze-asthma ezibuthathaka kwi-sulfite zinokuba nobunzima bokuphefumla.
c-240.actionItem: Namhlanje xa uthenga iziqhamo ezomisiweyo, jonga 'i-sulfite (sulfur dioxide)' kuphawu lweziqulatho, kwaye ukuba uzive ubuthathaka, khetha imveliso entsundu engenasulfur.

c-241.title: Ityuwa ephantsi ye-sodium ine-potassium eninzi, izigulana zezintso mazilumke
c-241.summary: Ityuwa ephantsi ye-sodium yenziwe ngokutshintsha inxalenye ye-sodium nge-potassium, ngoko abo banesifo sezintso okanye abatya amayeza akhupha i-potassium kufuneka bahlale bexoxa nGqirha.
c-241.principle: Inxalenye ye-$\mathrm{NaCl}$ itshintshwa ngo-$\mathrm{KCl}$ ukunciphisa i-sodium, kodwa ukutya i-potassium kuyanda. Ngobunzima i-Na ingama-39.3% ye-NaCl, i-K ingama-52.4% ye-KCl.
c-241.example: Kwimveliso ye-sodium ye-70% ne-potassium ye-30% ye-5g kukho i-sodium malunga ne-1.4g (30% ngaphantsi kwe-2.0g yetyuwa eqhelekileyo ye-5g), i-potassium malunga ne-0.79g. Xa umsebenzi wezintso wehla, i-potassium iyaqokelelana kwaye kukho ingozi ye-arrhythmia.
c-241.actionItem: Namhlanje phambi kokuthenga ityuwa ephantsi ye-sodium, jonga umlinganiselo we-potassium chloride kuluhlu lweziqulatho, kwaye ukuba unesifo sezintso okanye utya amayeza ahambelanayo, buza kuqala kugqirha.

c-242.title: Igolide ye-14K nesi-18K ayiyonyani yegolide ecocekileyo
c-242.summary: Inani le-K (carat) liziqulatho zegolide ecocekileyo, ngoko i-18K yigolide engama-75%, i-14K malunga nama-58% kwaye intsalela zezinye iintsimbi.
c-242.principle: Ucoceko lubonakaliswa ngamashumi amabini anesine. $\text{тозалик} = \frac{K}{24}$ Xa kudityaniswa ngokwenza i-alloy iba nzima kwaye umbala utshintsha, kwaye i-24K igolide ecocekileyo ithambile malunga ne-99.9%.
c-242.example: Kwindandatho ye-18K ye-10g kukho igolide ecocekileyo ye-7.5g, kwi-14K malunga ne-5.8g. Kuphawu lwaseKorea, i-18K ngokuqhelekileyo inophawu lwe-750 kwaye i-14K i-585.
c-242.actionItem: Namhlanje xa uthenga imveliso yegolide, jonga uphawu (750, 585 nokunye) nobunzima uze ubale ngokwakho isixa segolide ecocekileyo.

c-243.title: Iinkozo zekofu ziyaoksida emva kokuthosa njengoko irhasi iphuma
c-243.summary: Iinkozo zekofu zikhupha i-carbon dioxide ngoko nangoko emva kokuthosa kwaye emva koko ziya ziyaoksida, ngoko kungcono ukuzisela ngaphakathi kweeveki ezi-1~4 ukusuka kumhla wokuthosa.
c-243.principle: I-$\mathrm{CO_2}$ eyenziwe kukuthosa iphuma kancinci, kwaye izithako zevumba namafutha ziphendula ne-oksijini ziyonakale. $\mathrm{RH + O_2 \to ROOH}$
c-243.example: I-1g yenkozo yekofu ikhupha ii-mL ezimbalwa ze-CO2 emva kokuthosa, kwaye ukuba uyayila indawo iyanda kwaye ivumba liyancipha kakhulu ngaphakathi kwemizuzu embalwa~iiyure ezimbalwa. Iinkozo ezigciniweyo kwiqondo lengingqi emva kokuvula ngokuqhelekileyo zehla ngokucacileyo kwincasa emva kweeveki ezi-2~4.
c-243.actionItem: Namhlanje xa uthenga iinkozo zekofu, khetha imveliso enomhla wokuthosa obhaliweyo, uyayile kwangoko phambi kokuyisela, kwaye uyigcine ivaliwe kwindawo epholileyo engenakukhanya (ukugcina efrijini kukhona ingozi yokufuma).

c-244.title: Kutheni ukhuseleko lweoli kwiscreen sefowuni lususeka
c-244.summary: Ikhowuti elwa nezigxina zeminwe kwiscreen sefowuni yifilimu ebhityileyo yee-nm ezimbalwa~amashumi, ngoko iyagugeleka ngokucocwa nokukhuhlana ize iphele.
c-244.principle: Ifilimu ye-fluoropolymer inciphisa amandla omphezulu ukuze amathontsi eoli angasasazeki kodwa abe ngamathontsi. I-angle yokudibana inqunywa yi-$\cos\theta = \frac{\gamma_{SV} - \gamma_{SL}}{\gamma_{LV}}$ kwaye xa ifilimu iguga, i-$\theta$ iyancipha.
c-244.example: Ubukhulu befilimu yokulwa neoli bumalunga ne-nm ezimbalwa~amashumi, oko kungu-1/10,000 wobukhulu bomncili (malunga ne-80,000nm). Ukuba uphindaphinda ukukhuhlana nentlabathi nezitshixo ezipokothweni nokucoca nge-alcohol, iguga ngokucacileyo ngaphakathi kweenyanga ezimbalwa~iminyaka emi-2.
c-244.actionItem: Ukususela namhlanje coca iscreen ngelaphu le-microfiber elomileyo kwaye ungasebenzisi iiwipes ezinealcohol eninzi okanye ilaphu elibhedini.

c-245.title: Susa impahla ehlanjwe ngokomileyo kwingxowa yeplastiki uze uyivuthise umoya
c-245.summary: Ngokukhawuleza emva kokuhlanjwa ngokomileyo, impahla inokuba nokushiyeka kwesinyibilikisi, ngoko phambi kokuyinxiba okanye ukuyigcina, yisuse engxoweni uze uyivuthise umoya.
c-245.principle: Isinyibilikisi sokuhlamba i-perchloroethylene sine-boiling point ye-121 ℃ nenkcinezelo ye-vapor kwi-20 ℃ ephantse ibe yi-1,9kPa, ngoko iyavuka kancinci. $\mathrm{C_2Cl_4(l) \to C_2Cl_4(g)}$ Ukuba uyivalela engxoweni yeplastiki, umphunga awunakuphuma.
c-245.example: Ukuba ushiya impahla engxoweni kwikhabhathi, umphunga uyalalanisa kwaye ivumba nokuvezwa kuyanda. Ukuba uyixhoma kwindawo enomoya iiyure ezimbalwa ukuya kusuku olunye, uninzi luyaphuma. Ezinye iindawo zokuhlamba zisebenzisa izinyibilikisi zepetroliyam.
c-245.actionItem: Namhlanje impahla oyifumene kwindawo yokuhlamba isuse ngoko nangoko engxoweni uze uyixhome kwi-balcony okanye kwindawo enomoya iiyure ezimbalwa.

c-246.title: I-boiler ye-condensing ifumana ubushushu obubuyela kumphunga wamanzi weegesi ezikhutshiweyo
c-246.summary: I-boiler ye-condensing ijika umphunga wamanzi weegesi ezikhutshiweyo ube ngamanzi, ngoko nobushushu obufihlakeleyo obulahlekayo busetyenziselwa ukufudumeza.
c-246.principle: Xa kutshiswa igesi yendalo, kuveliswa amanzi, $\mathrm{CH_4 + 2O_2 \to CO_2 + 2H_2O}$ ngoko lo mphunga wamanzi xa ujika ube ngamanzi ukhulula ubushushu obufihlakeleyo obumalunga ne-2,26MJ/kg. Ukufumana kwakhona obu bushushu, amanzi abuyayo ekufudumezeni kufuneka abe ngaphantsi kwe-55 ℃.
c-246.example: Ukutshisa i-1m³ yegesi yendalo kuvelisa malunga ne-1,6kg yamanzi, nto ethi inike ubushushu obufihlakeleyo obongezelelweyo obumalunga ne-3,6MJ (malunga ne-10% yobushushu bonke). Ngoko unokonga malunga ne-10 ukuya kwi-15% yamandla xa kuthelekiswa ne-boiler eqhelekileyo.
c-246.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje usebenzisa i-boiler ye-condensing, ncinci ubushushu obusetiweyo bokufudumeza (amanzi abuyayo ngaphantsi kwe-55 ℃) ukuze ukujika kube lulwelo kwenzeke lula.

c-247.title: Ikhandlela alitshi njengoboya obunyibilikileyo, kodwa njengoboya obuphumeyo ngumphunga
c-247.summary: Ilangatye lekhandlela alingobo boya obunyibilikileyo, kodwa ngumphunga woboya otshatyalaliswa nguthambo uze uphume.
c-247.principle: Uboya obunyibilikileyo bunyuka ngamandla okutsala kwe-capillary kuthambo buze buphume ngobushushu, ize umphunga usabele nge-oksijini. $\mathrm{C_{25}H_{52} + 38\,O_2 \to 25\,CO_2 + 26\,H_2O}$
c-247.example: Ikhandlela eliqhelekileyo litshisa malunga ne-7g yoboya ngeyure enye lize livelise malunga ne-80W yobushushu. Ukuba uthambo lude kakhulu, ukutsha akupheleli ize kwenzeke umlilo omninzi.
c-247.actionItem: Namhlanje phambi kokubasa ikhandlela, nqumla uthambo lube malunga ne-5mm ukunciphisa umlilo, uze ungashiyi ikhandlela elivuliweyo lingajongwa.

c-248.title: Ukuba upheka i-pasta ngamanzi amancinci, usebenzisa amandla amancinci
c-248.summary: Kwi-pasta, malunga ne-1L yamanzi kwi-100g ngokwaneleyo, ngoko ngokuyeka umkhwa wokupheka ngamanzi ama-3L, amandla anciphisa kakhulu.
c-248.principle: Ubushushu bokufudumeza amanzi bu-$Q = mc\Delta T$, ize isitatshi se-pasta siqale ukufunxa amanzi nokuguqula ibe yi-gel kwi-60 ukuya kwi-70 ℃, ngoko akunyanzelekanga kube namanzi amaninzi.
c-248.example: Ukufudumeza i-1L yamanzi ukusuka kwi-20 ℃ ukuya kwi-100 ℃ kudinga malunga ne-334kJ (0,093kWh) yaye ukuba unciphisa isixa ukusuka kwi-3L ukuya kwi-1L, ugcina malunga ne-0,19kWh ngokupheka. Ngesiqhoboshelo kuncipha ngakumbi.
c-248.actionItem: Namhlanje xa upheka i-pasta, sebenzisa malunga ne-1L yamanzi kwi-100g kuphela, upheke ngesiqhoboshelo uze uxube rhoqo ukuze ingananeleki.

c-249.title: Xa iphula inyibilike, vuthisa umoya kuqala ngenxa ye-mercury
c-249.summary: Iilambu ze-fluorescent ziqulethe i-mercury encinci, ngoko xa iqhuma, khupha abantu nezilwanyana ezifuyiweyo kuqala uvuthise umoya, ize ucoce emva koko.
c-249.principle: I-mercury sisinyithi esiphuma nokubushushu begumbi. $\mathrm{Hg(l) \to Hg(g)}$ Uxinzelelo lomphunga kwi-20 ℃ lumalunga ne-0,16Pa kwaye kwigumbi elivaliweyo umphunga uqokelela.
c-249.example: Ilambu ye-fluorescent ephekiweyo (CFL) ihlala iqulethe ii-mg ezimbalwa ze-mercury. Emva kokuqhuma, vuthisa umoya ubuncinane imizuzu emi-5 ukuya kwi-10, uze ungazihluthi iziqwenga nge-vacuum, kodwa uzithathe ngephepha eliqinileyo netheyiphu, uzivalele engxoweni uze uzilahle kwindawo yokuqokelela.
c-249.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga iilambu ze-fluorescent ezisele nezisetyenzisiweyo ekhaya, uzigcine ebhokisini yazo yokuqala uze ufune indawo yokuqokelela iilambu ezilahliweyo eyondeleyo.

c-250.title: Ngelayisi entsha galela amanzi amancinci kunelayisi endala
c-250.summary: Irayisi entsha inobumanzi obuninzi, ngoko amanzi okupheka ongeza kuphela malunga ne-90% yesixa esiqhelekileyo ukuze ingabi mpuluswa.
c-250.principle: Kokukhulu ukuguga kwerayisi, kokuncinci ubumanzi bayo kwaye ifunxa amanzi amaninzi. Isixa samanzi simalunga ne-$m_{\mathrm{water}} = m_{\mathrm{rice}} \times r$, ize i-$r$ ibe malunga ne-1,1 kwirayisi entsha nje-1,2 kwendala.
c-250.example: Kwiikomityi ezi-2 zerayisi (malunga ne-360mL) amanzi aqhelekileyo ayi-400mL, kodwa kwirayisi entsha nciphisa ube malunga ne-360mL, okukuthi malunga ne-40mL. Ukumanzi kwerayisi entsha kumalunga ne-15 ukuya kwi-16%, endala 13 ukuya kwi-14%.
c-250.actionItem: Namhlanje xa upheka irayisi entsha, ongeze kuphela malunga ne-90% yamanzi aqhelekileyo, ize ukuba impuluswa kakhulu, ngomso nciphisa ngakumbi.

c-251.title: Intlama ye-jeon yixube ngokukhawuleza emanzini abandayo ukuze iqhekeke
c-251.summary: Intlama ye-jeon (i-pancake yemifuno) yixube kancinci ngamanzi abandayo ukuze kwenziwe i-gluten encinci ize iqhekeke.
c-251.principle: I-glutenin ne-gliadin kumgubo zenza inethiwekhi (i-gluten) ngamanzi nokuxuba: $\text{i-glutenin} + \text{i-gliadin} + \mathrm{H_2O} \xrightarrow{\text{ukuxuba}} \text{i-gluten}$ Amanzi abandayo acothisa lo mhlaba.
c-251.example: Kwikomityi enye yomgubo (malunga ne-120g) galela ikomityi enye yamanzi abandayo uze uxube kuphela malunga namaxesha ayi-10, kulungile nokuba kushiyeka amaqhuma amancinci. Ukuba utshintsha malunga ne-20% yomgubo ngesitatshi, i-gluten iyancipha ize ibe yi-crispy ngakumbi.
c-251.actionItem: Namhlanje xa uthosa i-pancake, yixube ngamanzi abandayo kwaphela imizuzwana eyi-10 ukuya kweyi-15 ungaxuba intlama ngaphezulu kwemizuzu eli-10.

c-252.title: Emva kokubilisa i-bracken, yifake emanzini ukunciphisa ityhefu
c-252.summary: I-bracken eluhlaza iqulethe i-ptaquiloside evelisa umhlaza, ngoko kufuneka ihlala ibilisiwe ize ifakwe emanzini, kodwa nangaloo ndlela ungayidli rhoqo.
c-252.example: Emva kokubilisa imizuzu emi-5 ukuya kwi-10 emanzini abilayo, yifake emanzini abandayo malunga nosuku olunye, ize ukuphulwa kube ngcono ukuba ongeza malunga ne-5g (0,5%) yesoda yokubhaka kwi-1L yamanzi. Nangaloo ndlela ayinciphi ngokupheleleyo ibe zero, ngoko ungayidli rhoqo nangobuninzi.
c-252.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje usebenzisa i-bracken, yibilise kakuhle emanzini abilayo, uyifake emanzini abandayo ize uyilungiselele emva koko.

c-253.title: Kutheni i-taro ikrwitha xa uyichukumisa nokuba wenze njani
c-253.summary: Ulusu nomsi we-taro uqulethe iikristali ezibukhali ze-calcium oxalate ezikrwitha ziqhwabhe xa ziqhagamshelana nesandla esingenanto.
c-253.principle: Iikristali ze-calcium oxalate (i-raphides) zivula isikhumba ukwenza ukukrwitha, nge-asidi okanye ubushushu ziyanyibilika okanye zilahlekelwe sisiphumo sazo. $\mathrm{CaC_2O_4 + 2H^+ \rightleftharpoons Ca^{2+} + H_2C_2O_4}$
c-253.example: Iikristali zinobude beemicrometres ezilishumi ukuya kwi-100 (0,02 ukuya kwi-0,2mm) kwaye zibukhali ngokwaneleyo ukuqhaqha umaleko ongaphandle wesikhumba. Xa kukrwitha, ukuhlamba ngamanzi afudumeleyo ane-viniga encinci kuyanceda, kwaye ukubilisa kunciphisa kakhulu ukukrwitha.
c-253.actionItem: Namhlanje xa uhlamba i-taro, xhoma iiglavu zerabha uze ulwebe phantsi kwamanzi asebenzayo.

c-254.title: Amagqabi e-pine yi-preservative yendalo enceda ikeyiki yerayisi ukuba ihlale ixesha elide
c-254.summary: Ii-terpenes ezisemagqabini e-pine ezisecaleni kwe-songpyeon zinesiphumo esibuthathaka se-antimicrobial, kodwa azizizo i-preservative, ngoko ukugcinwa kufuneka kulungiswe ngokwahlukileyo.
c-254.principle: Ii-terpenes ($\mathrm{C_{10}H_{16}}$) ezifana ne-alpha-pinene kumagqabi e-pine ziphazamisa ulwelo lwesilwanyana ukuze zinciphise ukuzaliswa. Isiphumo sibuthathaka sinceda kuphela iiyure ezimbalwa ukuya kusuku olunye.
c-254.example: I-songpyeon ngokubanzi iyahlala usuku olunye kubushushu begumbi obubandayo, kwifriji intlama yerayisi iyaqina (ukuguga), ize ngokukhenkcezisa inokugcinwa malunga nenyanga enye. Ukuba ubambelela kumagqabi e-pine kuphela uze ushiye ebusika kubushushu begumbi, inokonakala.
c-254.actionItem: Namhlanje i-songpyeon eseleyo yipholise, uyisonge nganye ngefoyile uze uyikhenkcise, ize phambi kokuyidla uyibhaqe ngomphunga.

c-255.title: I-ginseng ebomvu iphekwa ngomphunga ize ibe nolwakhiwo lwe-saponin olutshintshiweyo
c-255.summary: I-ginseng ebomvu yi-ginseng entsha ephekiweyo yaza yomiswa, apho iswekile zeesaponin (ii-ginsenosides) zikhutshwa ukwenza izinto ezifumaneka kuphela kwi-ginseng ebomvu.
c-255.principle: Ngobushushu nomswakama wokupheka, amatyathanga eswekile ye-ginsenosides ayahydrolyze. $\text{Rb}_1 \xrightarrow{\text{umphunga, H}^+} \text{Rg}_3 + 2\ \text{i-glucose}$
c-255.example: I-ginseng ebomvu yenziwa ngokupheka i-ginseng entsha ngomphunga iiyure ezimbalwa kwi-95 ukuya kwi-100 ℃ yaza yomiswa, ize kwenzeke izinto ezifana ne-Rg3, i-Rg5 ne-Rk1. Impumelelo ayinakuqinisekiswa kwaye umxholo we-ginsenoside uyahluka kwiimveliso.
c-255.actionItem: Xa uthenga i-ginseng ebomvu, thelekisa ubudala beengcambu (iminyaka eyi-6) nomxholo we-ginsenoside obhaliweyo (isiphumo se-Rg1+Rb1+Rg3).

c-256.title: Umgubo omhlophe kwiidiliya awuyiyo ipestiside
c-256.summary: Umgubo omhlophe ongacacanga kwiidiliya yi-wax yendalo (i-bloom) eyenziwa yiidiliya ngokwazo kwaye ikwaluphawu lokutsha.
c-256.principle: I-bloom yi-wax ye-hydrophobic yeekristali ezifana ne-oleanolic acid ($\mathrm{C_{30}H_{48}O_3}$), ethintela ukuphuma kwamanzi ize ikhusele kumda nakwimvula njengomaleko wendalo ongangeni manzi.
c-256.example: Umaleko we-bloom ubhityile kakhulu, ububanzi beemicrometre ezimbalwa okanye ngaphantsi, kwaye ungasuswa lula ngokuchukumisa. Iidiliya ezinesilwanyana se-bloom esigcinwe ngokulinganayo zibe zincinci ukubonakala emva kokukhethwa, nto enceda ekuvavanyeni ukutsha.
c-256.actionItem: Namhlanje hlamba iidiliya phantsi kwamanzi asebenzayo imizuzwana eyi-30 kuphela phambi kokuzidla, ungazihlambi kwangaphambili.

c-257.title: Imibala yamagqabi ekwindla ibe bomvu kuba igqabi lenza i-pigment entsha
c-257.summary: Amagqabi etyheli ekwindla abonisa umbala owawuvele ukhona, kodwa abomvu avela kuba igqabi lenza i-anthocyanins ngokutsha ekwindla.
c-257.principle: Xa imini inciphisa kwaye ibanda, i-chlorophyll ($\mathrm{C_{55}H_{72}O_5N_4Mg}$) iyabola, umbala otyheli we-carotenoids uyavela, kwaye xa iswekile ziqokelelana, ii-anthocyanins zenziwa ngokutsha ize igqabi libe bomvu.
c-257.example: Amagqabi abomvu abhetele xa imini icacile ukuvelisa iswekile eninzi nakwi-minimum yekuseni ukuya kwi-5 ukuya kwi-10 ℃. Ngokuchasene, ekwindla enemvula nefudumele imibala ibuthathaka.
c-257.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje uceba uhambo lokubona imibala yekwindla, jonga imaphu yokuqikelela imibala yamagqabi malunga neveki enye ukuya kwezimbini emva kokuqala kobushushu obuphantsi be-5 ℃.

c-258.title: Musa ukukha izithelo ze-ginkgo ngezandla ezingenanto
c-258.summary: Inyama yangaphandle yesithelo se-ginkgo inokubangela i-dermatitis njenge-poison ivy xa kuchukunyiswa ngesandla esingenanto, ize ivumba libe yi-butyric acid.
c-258.principle: I-ginkgolic acid (i-alkylphenol) enyameni ye-ginkgo ibangela i-dermatitis yokunxibelelana, ize ivumba elingemnandi livele kwi-butyric acid. $\mathrm{CH_3CH_2CH_2COOH}$
c-258.example: Ukuba umsi wenyama ye-ginkgo uchukumisa isikhumba, emva kweeyure ezimbalwa ukuya kusuku olunye kunokubakho ukubomvu nokukrwitha. I-butyric acid yinto ekwi-family enye nevumba lebhotolo elonakeleyo okanye ukugabha.
c-258.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje uhamba ekwindla uze ufumane izithelo ze-ginkgo ezonakeleyo, musa ukuzikha, kwaye ukuba kuyimfuneko kakhulu, xhoma iiglavu zokusebenzisa kube kanye uze uzilungise engxoweni.

c-259.title: Iibhovu ezinobuthi azihlambululeki nokuba ziyaphekwa okanye ziyomiswa
c-259.summary: Ityhefu yeembhovu ezinobuthi ayisuswa ngokubilisa, ukomisa okanye ukuvavanya ngecephe lesilivere, ngoko ungadli iibhovu zasendle ezingavavanywanga ngumchwephesha.
c-259.principle: I-amatoxin (i-alpha-amanitin) kwi-Amanita phalloides yi-cyclic peptide ezinzileyo ngobushushu evala i-RNA polymerase II yaye yonakalisa iiseli zesibindi nezezintso. $\text{i-amatoxin} + \text{i-RNA polymerase II} \to \text{i-complex engasebenzi}$
c-259.example: Idosi eyingozi imalunga ne-0,1mg/kg kwaye isigqubuthelo esinye se-Amanita (malunga ne-50g) sinokubulala nomntu omdala. Iimpawu ziqala emva kweeyure ezi-6 ukuya kwi-24, ngoko ngokuqhelekileyo kuba kudeles.
c-259.actionItem: Xa ufumana iibhovu zasendle ehlathini, musa ukuzikha, kwaye ukuba emva kokuzidla kuvela ukugabha okanye ukuhlala, yiya kwi-emergency ngoko nangoko uze uthabathe ibhovu oyidlileyo.

c-260.title: Kutheni singatshisi amagqabi ekwindla nobutshantliziyo
c-260.summary: Ukutshisa amagqabi nobutshantliziyo ngaphandle kubangela ukutsha okungapheleleyo, amasuntswana amaninzi amancinci nezinto ezinobungozi, kwaye ukutshisa iplastiki ne-PVC kuvelisa ii-dioxins.
c-260.principle: Ukutshisa ngaphandle ngaphandle kwe-oksijini eyaneleyo kubangela ukutsha okungapheleleyo nokuvelisa i-PAH ne-carbon monoxide. $2\mathrm{C} + \mathrm{O_2} \to 2\mathrm{CO}$ I-PVC $(\mathrm{C_2H_3Cl})_n$ inokuvelisa i-hydrogen chloride nee-dioxins xa itshiswa.
c-260.example: I-PVC ineshlorini engama-57% ngokobunzima, ngoko i-1kg iqulethe malunga ne-570g yeshlorini. Ukutshisa intsalela yezolimo ngaphandle kunokukhulula malunga ne-5 ukuya kwi-15g yamasuntswana amancinci nge-1kg.
c-260.actionItem: Namhlanje musa ukutshisa amagqabi, kodwa uwaqokelele ukuze wenze i-compost okanye uwanikele ngokwenkqubo yokuqokelela yomasipala wakho.

c-261.title: Umgubo omhlophe ecaleni kwe-humidifier yimineral evela emanzini epompo
c-261.summary: Umgubo omhlophe ecaleni kwe-ultrasonic humidifier yimineral njenge-calcium ne-magnesium eyayinyibilike emanzini epompo.
c-261.principle: I-ultrasonic humidifier ayibilisi amanzi, kodwa iwafafaza abe ngamathontsi amancinci, ize xa amathontsi ephuma, ityuwa enyibilikileyo ishiyeke njengamasuntswana aqinileyo. Ekubiliseni, inxalenye yobunzima iyahlala. $\mathrm{Ca(HCO_3)_2 \to CaCO_3 + CO_2 + H_2O}$
c-261.example: Ukuba amanzi epompo aneminerali emalunga ne-80mg/L kwaye ngobusuku bonke iiyure eziyi-8 ufafaza i-2,4L, malunga ne-190mg yamasuntswana inokusasazeka emoyeni. La masuntswana amancinci ngokwaneleyo ukungena emhlathini.
c-261.actionItem: Namhlanje ityanki ye-humidifier yenze ize ihlambe ize uyigcwalise ngamanzi amatsha ngemihla yonke, ngokukhethekileyo ngamanzi acocwayo, okanye usebenzise i-humidifier eshushu okanye evukayo.

c-262.title: Kutheni iincwadi ezindala zibe kutyheli
c-262.summary: Iincwadi ezindala ziba kutyheli zize zivuthuze kuba izinto ezine-asidi ne-lignin kwiphepha ziyaoksidayizeka ziyabola.
c-262.principle: I-lignin kwiphepha elinasidi iyaoksidayizeka ekukhanyeni nakwioksijini ibe kutyheli, ize i-asidi ihydrolyze i-cellulose yenze iphepha libe buthathaka. $(\mathrm{C_6H_{10}O_5})_n + n\mathrm{H_2O} \xrightarrow{\mathrm{H^+}} n\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}$
c-262.example: Iphepha elinelignin enkulu, njengephepha lezindaba (i-lignin malunga ne-25%), liba kutyheli kwiinyanga ezimbalwa, ize iincwadi zephepha elingathathi cala ngaphandle kwe-asidi zinokuhlala amawaka eminyaka. Umswakama nobushushu obuphezulu bukhawulezisa impendulo.
c-262.actionItem: Namhlanje gcina iincwadi ezixabisekileyo kwithala elibandayo nelomileyo ngaphandle kokukhanya kwelanga okuthe ngqo, ungazifakeli iindaba zamaphepha phakathi kweencwadi.

c-263.title: Umphezulu omnyama wetumato ongaphantsi kokubola ngenxa yokunqongophala kwekalsiyam
c-263.summary: Ukubola okumnyama ezantsi kwesithelo setumato (i-blossom end rot) akubangelwa kukunqongophala kwekalsiyam emhlabeni, kodwa kukuba ikalsiyam ayifikeleli esithelweni.
c-263.principle: Ii-ion zekalsiyam zihamba nokuhamba kwamanzi okwenziwa kukuhamba komphunga, ize incopho yesithelo ifumane kamva kuba ayihambi kangako. Ukuba ukuhamba kungenasantya, ukubonelelwa kuncinci. $J = C \times \dot{V}$ ($C$: ukuxinana kwekalsiyam, $\dot{V}$: ukuhamba kwamanzi)
c-263.example: Ukuba ukunkcenkceshela akulingani, ukuhanjiswa kwekalsiyam kuyaphazamiseka ize kwenzeke iimpawu. Ukunkcenkceshela ngokulingana malunga ne-25mm (2,5cm) yamanzi ngeveki kuyacetyiswa. Ukulawula amanzi kusebenza ngakumbi kunokongeza umgquba wekalsiyam omkhulu emhlabeni.
c-263.actionItem: Namhlanje nkcenkceshela itumato ngamaxesha amalungelelanisiweyo ngaphambi kokuba umhlaba womise, hayi kwangaxeshanye emva kweentsuku ezimbalwa, uze uzigubungele ngomaleko.

c-264.title: Umlotha wamalahle ngumgquba wepotassium wasimahla ongasegadini, kodwa lumkela
c-264.summary: Umlotha wamalahle ayesele atshile ngumgquba oneakalayi onika i-potassium ne-calcium, kodwa uyabaphosa abantu bezityalo ezithanda i-asidi, ize musa ukusebenzisa umlotha wamalahle onezongezo okanye ukhuni oluqaqambileyo.
c-264.principle: $\mathrm{K_2CO_3}$ emlothweni iyanyibilika ize ikhuphe ii-ion ze-potassium nee-ion ze-hydroxide, ezinyusa i-pH yomhlaba. $\mathrm{K_2CO_3 + H_2O \rightleftharpoons 2K^+ + HCO_3^- + OH^-}$
c-264.example: I-pH yomlotha wokhuni yi-10 ukuya kwi-13 kwaye iqulethe malunga ne-3 ukuya kwi-10% ye-potassium (K₂O). Isixa esicetyiswayo ubuninzi malunga ne-100g nge-m² ngonyaka (isandla esinye okanye ezimbini) kwaye ungasetyenzisi kwii-blueberry okanye iitapile.
c-264.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje unomlotha wokhuni ococekileyo opholileyo ngokupheleleyo, wuhluze uze ulinganise i-pH yomhlaba, emva koko uwusasaze kancinci kuphela kwimibhedesho engathathi cala ukuya kuma-alkali.

c-265.title: Ukuba i-compost inuka kakubi, yongeze ikhabhoni
c-265.summary: Ukuba i-compost inuka i-ammonia okanye ukubola, kunenitrogen eninzi kakhulu, ngoko xuba izinto ezineekhabhoni ezifana namagqabi omileyo.
c-265.principle: Ukuze izilwanyana ezincinci zisebenze kakuhle, umlinganiselo wekhabhoni kunye nenitrogen kufuneka ube malunga ne-30 : 1. $\mathrm{C/N} = \frac{m_C}{m_N} \approx 30$ Ukuba kunenitrogen eninzi, ivumba le-ammonia livela ku-$\mathrm{NH_4^+ + OH^- \to NH_3 + H_2O}$.
c-265.example: Umlinganiselo we-C/N wentsalela yokutya yi-15 ukuya kwi-20, amagqabi omileyo 50 ukuya kwi-80 ize ukhuni oluqhekekileyo ube malunga ne-400. Ukuba uxuba amahlandla ama-2 ukuya kwama-3 ezinto ezinemibala ebrown ezifana namagqabi omileyo kwinxalenye enye yokutya, ivumba liyancipha kakhulu.
c-265.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje i-compost inuka, yongeze ingxowa yamagqabi omileyo okanye iibhokisi zekhadibhodi ezidiniweyo, uxube kakuhle uze unike umoya.

c-266.title: Iimbotyi ezingaphekwanga kakuhle zinetyhefu ye-lectin
c-266.summary: Iimbotyi eziluhlaza okanye ezipheke kuphela malunga ne-80 ℃ zingabangela ukugabha nokuhlwa ngenxa ye-lectin, ngoko zihlala zibilisiwe kakuhle.
c-266.principle: I-lectin (i-phytohemagglutinin) ezimbotyini yiprotheyini ephuphuma kuphela xa ifudunyezwa ngokwaneleyo kwi-100 ℃. $\text{i-lectin esebenzayo} \xrightarrow{100^\circ\mathrm{C},\ \ge 10\ \text{imizuzu}} \text{i-lectin ephuphumileyo}$ Kwi-80 ℃ ityhefu inokuthi inyuke amaxesha amaninzi.
c-266.example: Nokuba iimbotyi ezi-4 ukuya kwezi-5 ezibomvu eziluhlaza zinokubangela isicaphucaphu nokugabha kwi-1 ukuya kwiiyure ezi-3, kwaye kuxelwa ukuba ukupheka kubushushu obuphantsi be-80 ℃ kunokuba kunobungozi ngokuphindwe kane-5 kuneentswela eziluhlaza. Iimbotyi ezikwindawo ezidikiweyo sele ziphekiwe.
c-266.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje usebenzisa iimbotyi ezomileyo, ziqhumise ubuncinane iiyure ezi-5, ulahle amanzi, uzibilise ngamandla ubuncinane imizuzu eli-10 uze uzigqibe ngomlilo omncinci.

c-267.title: Musa ukuvala isivalo sesitya se-plum syrup ngokupheleleyo
c-267.summary: I-plum syrup (i-maesil-cheong) ivelisa ikhabhon diokside ngokuvundiswa kwegwele, ngoko kwisitya esivaliweyo ngokuqinileyo uxinzelelo lunokuqokelelana lize isitya siqhume.
c-267.principle: Igwele lophula iswekile libe yi-alkohol nekhabhon diokside. $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6 \to 2\,C_2H_5OH + 2\,CO_2}$
c-267.example: Ukuvundiswa kwe-10g ye-glucose (malunga ne-0,056 mol) kukhulula malunga ne-2,7L ye-CO2, ize kwisitya esine-3L uxinzelelo lunyuke ngokukhawuleza. Oku kwenzeka lula ukuba iswekile ayinyibilikanga ngokupheleleyo okanye ubushushu buphezulu.
c-267.actionItem: Namhlanje vala isivalo sesitya se-plum syrup ngokukhululekileyo okanye usigubungele ngelaphu likakotini, uze xa kuvela ibhabhulu uvule isivalo kube kanye ngosuku ukukhulula igesi.

c-268.title: Kutheni ibala le-curry liba bomvu xa lihlanjwa ngesepha
c-268.summary: Umbala otyheli we-curry (i-curcumin) uba bomvu kwi-alkali, ngoko ibala xa lihlanjwa ngesepha ene-alkali liba nzulu ngakumbi libe bomvu.
c-268.principle: I-curcumin yi-pH indicator, kwi-asidi nakwi-neutral ityheli, ize ngaphezulu kwe-pH engama-8,6 ibe bomvu-bomvu. $\mathrm{HCur \rightleftharpoons H^+ + Cur^-}$ (ityheli ⇌ bomvu)
c-268.example: Isisombululo sesepha eqinileyo sine-pH ye-9 ukuya kwi-10 ize sidlule loo mda wotshintsho lombala. Ukuba ubalo ulunyanga ngesepha ye-neutral yezitya (i-pH malunga ne-7), umbala awutshintshi, kwaye ngokomisa elangeni i-curcumin ibola ngokukhanya ize ibhitye.
c-268.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje kuvela ibala le-curry, lihlambe emanzini abandayo, ulinyange ngesepha ye-neutral, ungasebenzisi isepha uze ulomise elangeni.

c-269.title: Kutheni i-yolk yeqanda eliphekwe kakhulu inomnqantsa oluhlaza
c-269.summary: Isangqa esiluhlaza ejikeleze i-yolk yeqanda elipheke kakhulu yimixube ye-iron sulfide engenabungozi ebangelwa kukupheka ixesha elide.
c-269.principle: I-hydrogen sulfide evela kwii-amino acids ze-sulfur kwi-albumen idibana ne-iron kwi-yolk yenze i-iron sulfide. $\mathrm{Fe^{2+} + H_2S \to FeS + 2H^+}$
c-269.example: Iqanda elikhulu liphekwe kakuhle imizuzu eli-10 ukuya kwe-12 emva kokuqala kokubilisa, ize ukuba lipheke ngaphezulu kwemizuzu eli-15, umnqantsa oluhlaza uvela rhoqo. Ukuba uliphosa emanzini abandayo imizuzu emi-5 ngoko nangoko emva kokupheka, impendulo iyema.
c-269.actionItem: Namhlanje pheka iqanda imizuzu eli-10 ukuya kwe-12 kuphela emva kokuqala kokubilisa uze uliphole emanzini abandayo imizuzu emi-5 ngoko nangoko.

c-270.title: Ukudla ibhetri ye-coin kuvelisa ukutsha kwiiyure ezi-2
c-270.summary: Ukuba uginya ibhetri yobhontsi ye-coin, ukutsha okukhulu kunokwenzeka kwi-esophagus kwiiyure ezi-2, ngoko kufuneka uye kwi-emergency ngoko nangoko nokuba akukho mpawu.
c-270.principle: Xa ibhetri ifikelela kwi-esophagus ichukumisa isalivha, umbane uyahamba kwaye amanzi ayelektrolayizeka, kwicala elingalunganga ii-ion ze-hydroxide zenziwa zibangele ukutsha okunamandla kwe-alkali. $2\mathrm{H_2O} + 2e^- \to \mathrm{H_2} + 2\mathrm{OH^-}$
c-270.example: Ibhetri ye-lithium ye-coin ye-3V ene-diameter ye-20mm (i-CR2032) ihlala lula kwi-esophagus yomntwana, i-pH yethishu inokunyuka ibe yi-12 ukuya kwi-13. Ukonakala kuqala kwiiyure ezi-2 kwaye akufuneki ubangele ukugabha okanye ulinde.
c-270.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga ukuba amagumbi ebhetri ye-coin kwi-remote control, i-smart key nakwizinto zokudlala avikelwe ngesikhonkwane, uze ugcine iibhetri eziseleyo kude nabantwana.

c-271.title: Dla i-tuna ne-swordfish kube kanye okanye kabini ngeveki ngenxa yemekyuri
c-271.summary: Kwiintlanzi ezinkulu ezizingelayo njenge-tuna ne-swordfish, i-methylmercury iqokelelana, ngoko kungcono ukunciphisa isixa kube kanye okanye kabini ngeveki.
c-271.principle: Imekyuri iguqulwa zizilwanyana ezincinci ibe yi-methylmercury, ekhula emnatheni wokutya. $\mathrm{Hg^{2+} \xrightarrow{\text{izilwanyana ezincinci}} CH_3Hg^+}$ I-European Food Safety Authority imisela ukulinganiswa kweveki okuvumelekileyo kwe-1,3 μg nge-kg yobunzima bomzimba.
c-271.example: Kubunzima bomzimba be-60kg, isixa seveki esivumelekileyo yi-78 μg. I-100g ye-swordfish eneemekyuri ze-1,0ppm iqulethe malunga ne-100 μg, ngoko ukutya kokunye kunokugqitha umda, ize i-tuna ekhanyayo ye-100g enemalunga ne-0,1ppm ibe malunga ne-10 μg. Abasetyhini abakhulelweyo nabantwana kufuneka babe nobunono ngakumbi.
c-271.actionItem: Namhlanje dla i-tuna, i-swordfish ne-shark malunga ne-100g kube kanye, uze ngeli veki uceba iintlanzi ezinkulu ezifanayo kube kanye okanye kabini kuphela.

c-272.title: Iimbovane nee-lobster zijika zibe bomvu emva kokupheka
c-272.summary: Iimbovane nee-lobster zijika zibe bomvu emva kokupheka kuba iprotheyini iyatshintsha ize ikhulule i-pigment ebomvu ebanjiweyo, nto eyimpawu elungileyo yokuba iphekiwe.
c-272.principle: Xa zisaphila, i-astaxanthin ibotshelelwe kwiprotheyini (i-crustacyanin) kwaye ngumbala oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka-ngwevu, kodwa ubushushu buyayiphulukanisa iprotheyini bukhulule i-astaxanthin ebomvu. $\text{i-astaxanthin-iprotheyini (luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka-ngwevu)} \xrightarrow{\Delta} \text{i-astaxanthin (ebomvu)} + \text{iprotheyini ephuphumileyo}$
c-272.example: Imbovane iphekiwe xa ubushushu bangaphakathi bungu-63 ℃ (145 ℉) okanye ngaphezulu yaye ijika ibe pinki engacacanga, emanzini abilayo imizuzu emi-2 ukuya kwemi-3 ngokwaneleyo. Ukuba uyipheka ixesha elide, inyama iba nzima.
c-272.actionItem: Namhlanje xa upheka iimbovane, zikhuphe emanzini ngoko nangoko xa umzimba ujike ube pinki engacacanga nenye imo ye-C, ukuze zingabi nzima.

c-273.title: Ulwelo lwebhrekhi endala lunciphisa ukubhrekha
c-273.summary: Ulwelo lwebhrekhi lufunxa umswakama emoyeni, ngoko indawo yokubilisa iyehla kwaye ixesha lokubhrekha ngamandla njengasezantsi ethambekeni ingabila, ize amandla ebhrekhi athathe.
c-273.principle: Ulwelo lwebhrekhi olusekelwe kwi-glycol lunomswakama ize xa amanzi exutywa, indawo yokubilisa iyehla, kwenzeke umphunga othi utyunyuzeleke ungadluliseli amandla ebhrekhi. $\ln\frac{P_2}{P_1} = -\frac{\Delta H_{vap}}{R}\left(\frac{1}{T_2} - \frac{1}{T_1}\right)$
c-273.example: Indawo yokubilisa eyomileyo ye-DOT 4 ayiphantsi kwe-230 ℃, kodwa xa ifunxa amanzi iyehla ukuya kwi-155 ℃, okukuthi malunga ne-75 ℃. Ngokuqhelekileyo ifunxa malunga ne-2 ukuya kwi-3% yamanzi ngonyaka, ngoko kucetyiswa ukutshintsha nyaka ngamnye wesibini okanye kwi-40 000km.
c-273.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga kwincwadi yenkonzo umhla wokugqibela wokutshintsha ulwelo lwebhrekhi, ize ukuba lukhulu kunemiyaka emi-2, bhukisha uvavanyo kwindawo yenkonzo.

c-274.title: Umbala opinki wehem kwipakethe yesipho yenxalenye ye-nitrite
c-274.summary: Umbala opinki wehem uhlala emva kokupheka ngenxa ye-nitrite, kodwa inyama ecutshungulweyo ayicetyiswa ukuba idliwe ngobuninzi.
c-274.principle: I-nitrite kwi-asidi iguquka ibe yi-nitric oxide (NO), edibana ne-iron ye-myoglobin, i-pigment yenyama, yenza i-nitrosomyoglobin epinki. $\mathrm{NO + Mb(Fe^{2+}) \to Mb(Fe^{2+})\text{-}NO}$
c-274.example: Isixa esisalayo se-nitrite esivumelekileyo kwiimveliso zenyama eKorea ngu-70mg/kg ubuninzi. I-World Health Organization ihlela inyama ecutshungulweyo njengesinye sevelisa-mhlaza seqela 1 kwaye iqikelela ukuba i-50g ngosuku inyusa umngcipheko womhlaza wekholoni ngama-18% malunga.
c-274.actionItem: Gcina i-hem esuka kwipakethe yesipho kwifriji, dla malunga ne-50g kube kanye uze uyidibanise nemifuno.

c-275.title: Umgubo omhlophe kwiipersimon ezomileyo ayingombola, ngamakristali eswekile
c-275.summary: Umgubo omhlophe onjengobisi kwiipersimon ezomileyo (i-gotgam) ubukhulu becala ngamakristali eswekile (i-glucose, i-fructose) aqinileyo emphezulwini, ayingombola. Ukuba kukho amabala anoboya obuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka okanye obumnyama, yimbola uze uyilahle.
c-275.principle: Ngexesha lokomisa, umswakama uyehla ize ukuxinana kweswekile kunyuke, ize xa kugqithiswa ukunyibilika okugcweleyo, iswekile ikhutshwe ngohlobo lweekristali. Imeko yokugcwala yi-$C > C_{\mathrm{sat}}(T)$, kwaye isiphumo kukuba xa amanzi ephuma, umqondo $C=\frac{m_{\mathrm{iswekile}}}{V_{\mathrm{amanzi}}}$ uyancipha.
c-275.example: Ipersimon entsha inamanzi malunga ne-80% neswekile malunga ne-15%, ize eyomileyo inciphise umswakama ube malunga ne-25 ukuya kwi-30%, ngoko iswekile ixinaniswe ukuya kuma-60% okanye ngaphezulu. Yiyo loo nto umgubo omhlophe uvela emphezulwini.
c-275.actionItem: Xa uthenga iipersimon ezomileyo, khetha umgubo ofanayo, oqinileyo nomphezulu omileyo, uphephe amabala anoboya obuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka okanye amabala anamathelayo.

c-276.title: Ivumba lokutsha xa uvula i-heater okokuqala yimfumbi ephyrolyzed
c-276.summary: Xa uvula i-heater okokuqala emva kwehlobo, ivumba lento endala etshileyo livela rhoqo kwimfumbi ephezu kwe-heater ephyrolyze. Vuthisa umoya ushiye isebenze imizuzu embalwa, ngokuqhelekileyo iyanyamalala, kodwa ukuba iqhubeka kufuneka uvavanyo.
c-276.principle: Impahla ye-organic emfumbini (iintsinga, isikhumba njl.) iyaphyrolyze xa ifudunyezwa ikhuphe izinto ezifulayo nekhabhoni. Iqala malunga ne-$T \approx 150\text{~}250\,^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$, ize umphezulu wesixhobo sokufudumeza ube shushu kakhulu.
c-276.example: Umphezulu wesixhobo sokufudumeza sombane ngokuqhelekileyo ufikelela kwi-300 ukuya kwi-800°C ize imfumbi itshe lula. I-heater ye-1 ukuya kwi-2kW inuka emva kwemizuzu eyi-30, ize emva kokucocwa ivumba phantse lilahleke.
c-276.actionItem: Namhlanje phambi kokuvula i-heater, khupha i-plug uze usiphinde imfumbi kwiindawo zokutsala nasemhlabeni, uze uvule iifestile uvavanye imizuzu eli-10. Ukuba ivumba lokutsha liqhubeka okanye kuvele intuthu, yicime ngoko nangoko uze ucele uvavanyo.

c-277.title: I-cabbage yaseTshayina kufuneka ifakwe ityuwa ukuze ithambe ize ifunxe incasa ye-kimchi
c-277.summary: Ukuba ufaka ityuwa kwi-cabbage yaseTshayina, amanzi aphuma nge-osmosis, i-cabbage iyathamba, izinongo zifunxeka kakuhle kwaye ukuqhekeka kuhlala. Ukuba ityuwa incinci, i-kimchi inetyuwa kakhulu ize ithambe kakhulu.
c-277.principle: Iinwebu zeeseli zinesiqingatha sokudlula kwaye xa ukuxinana kwetyuwa ngaphandle kuphezulu, amanzi aphuma kwiseli. Uxinzelelo lwe-osmotic luchazwa ngo-$\Pi = iCRT$, ize ikalsiyam idibanise i-pectin igcine ulwakhiwo lwethishu.
c-277.example: Ukuba ufaka ityuwa kwintloko enye ye-cabbage (malunga ne-2,5kg) iiyure ezi-4 ukuya kwezi-6 ngetyuwa emalunga ne-200g (malunga ne-8%), ubunzima buyancipha malunga ne-20 ukuya kwi-25%, okukuthi kuphuma malunga ne-0,5 ukuya kwi-0,6kg yamanzi. Ityuwa efanelekileyo ye-cabbage efakwe ityuwa imalunga ne-2%.
c-277.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje wenza i-kimchi, jika i-cabbage kube kanye ngexesha lokufaka ityuwa uze uyihlambe uyihlahle xa iziqu zigoba kodwa zingaqhekeki.

c-278.title: Iipersimon ezikrwitha zilahlekelwa kukukrwitha xa ii-tannin ezinyibilikayo ziqina
c-278.summary: Ukukrwitha kwepersimon kuvela kwi-tannin enyibilikayo emanzini, ize xa iqina ibe ngohlobo olungenyibiliki, ayisakrwithi. Lo ngumgaqo wokomisa okanye wokususa ukukrwitha.
c-278.principle: I-tannin enyibilikayo idibana neeprotheyini kulwimi inike ukukrwitha. Xa ipersimon icolile, iyomiswe okanye ivalwe, i-acetaldehyde ($\mathrm{CH_3CHO}$) eyenziwayo yenza i-tannin ibe ngamaqhekeza angenyibiliki angaphindi anyibilike kwisalivha.
c-278.example: Ipersimon ekrwithayo inemalunga ne-1% yee-tannins ezinyibilikayo, ngoko yomisa ukhakhayi, kodwa ukuba uyigcina iintsuku ezi-3 ukuya kwezi-5 kwindawo evaliweyo kwi-20 ukuya kwi-25°C, uninzi luyaqina ize ukukrwitha kuphantse kulahleke.
c-278.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje unamapersimon akrwithayo, ubeke kwibhokisi okanye ingxowa evaliweyo iintsuku ezi-2 ukuya kwezi-3 kunye ne-apile okanye ibhanana, okanye uzixobule uzomise elangeni. Phambi kokuzidla, zama ucezu ujonge ukukrwitha.

c-279.title: Ijusi yegrapefruit itshintsha isiphumo seminye imithi
c-279.summary: I-grapefruit ithintela ukuphulwa kweminye imithi inyusa ukuxinana kwemithi egazini. Ukuba uthatha amayeza, buza i-pharmacist ngokunxibelelana ne-grapefruit.
c-279.principle: I-furanocoumarins kwi-grapefruit ithintela i-enzyme ye-CYP3A4 eyaphula amayeza emathunjini. Xa ukuphuka kuncinci, amayeza amaninzi afunxwa kwaye $AUC=\int_0^\infty C(t)\,dt$ iyanda kwaye nomngcipheko wezenzo ezingathandekiyo uyanda.
c-279.example: Kwezinye ii-statins (amayeza e-cholesterol), xa usela ikomityi enye (malunga ne-250mL) yejusi yegrapefruit, ukuvezwa egazini (i-AUC) kunokunyuka amaxesha amaninzi kwaye isiphumo sihlala ngaphezu kosuku. Impembelelo ihluka kakhulu phakathi kwamayeza.
c-279.actionItem: Namhlanje kwincwadi yemiyalelo yamayeza okanye kwi-pharmacist jonga ukuba ingaba kukho isilumkiso se-grapefruit, ize ukuba ikhona, phepha ijusi nesithelo esitsha. Musa ukuyeka amayeza ngokwesigqibo sakho.

c-280.title: Kutheni ulwelo ngenqwelomoya luthathwa kwiingqayi ze-100mL
c-280.summary: Kwiinqwelomoya zamazwe ngamazwe, unokuthatha ulwelo neejeli kwizikhongozeli ezifikelela kwi-100mL kwingxowa ecacileyo enesipili. Umda wevolumu ngumthetho owenza kube nzima ukwenza isixa esiyingozi kwisikhongozeli esinye.
c-280.principle: Umda wobungakanani besikhongozeli uvela kwinto yokuba ulwelo olubuhlungu luba ngozi kuphela kwisixa esithile. Isixa esipheleleyo esivumelekileyo yi-$V_{\mathrm{iyonke}}=\sum V_i$, ize nganye $V_i \le 100\,\mathrm{mL}$ ihlala ilinganiselwe kwingxowa enye ye-1L.
c-280.example: Ukuba izikhongozeli ezili-10 ze-100mL zifakwa kwingxowa ye-1L, isixa esipheleleyo esikhulu yi-1L. Isikhongozeli se-200mL, nokuba sigcwele isiqingatha, ngokuqhelekileyo asidluli kuvavanyo ngenxa yomthamo wesikhongozeli.
c-280.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje uceba uhambo, tshintshela i-shampoo, i-lotion namayeza olwelo kwiingqayi ezifikelela kwi-100mL uzifake kwingxowa enye ecacileyo enesipili uze uyibeke phezulu kwempahla. Imithetho ihluka ngenkampani yenqwelomoya nesizwe, ngoko jonga kwakhona ngaphambi kokuhamba.

c-281.title: Khetha isosi yentlanzi ngokwengqolowa yee-amino acids, hayi ngetyuwa kuphela
c-281.summary: Incasa ye-umami kwisosi yentlanzi ivela kwii-amino acids ezenziwe ngexesha lokuvuthwa ngokuphulwa kweeprotheyini. Jonga ukuba ayinatyuwa kuphela nokuba iinkcukacha zokuveliswa nokuvuthwa zicacile.
c-281.principle: Ii-enzymes eziphula iiprotheyini kwizibilini zentlanzi ziyi-hydrolyze iiprotheyini zibe ngamapeptides nee-amino acids: $\text{iprotheyini} + n\,\mathrm{H_2O} \to n\,\text{i-amino acid}$. Kuloo nkqubo i-glutamic acid inika incasa ye-umami.
c-281.example: Ukuba ityuwa ye-saeujeot (iinkala ezifakwe ityuwa) ngokuqhelekileyo imalunga ne-20% kwaye emva kokuvuthwa kweenyanga ezi-3 ukuya kwezi-6, i-amino nitrogen iyanda ize incasa ibe nzulu. Ngetyuwa efanayo, ngokuvuthwa okufutshane ivumba lentlanzi netyuwa ziyaphawuleka.
c-281.actionItem: Xa uthenga isosi yentlanzi, jonga umhla wokwenziwa, izithako netyuwa kwipakethe, kwaye ukuba unokuyizama, khetha leyo eshiya incasa emnandi nephilileyo emva kwetyuwa.

c-282.title: Jonga amalungu egesi ngamanzi esepha, hayi ngevumba
c-282.summary: Ukuba kuthandabuzeka ukuvuza kwegesi, tshiza amanzi esepha kwindawo yokudibanisa uze ujonge ukuba iibhabhulu zenzeka na. Ukujonga ngomlilo okanye ngokukhanyisa kuyingozi kwaye kuyalelwe.
c-282.principle: Igesi ephumayo inyusa ifilimu ye-surfactant emanzini esepha yenze iibhabhulu. Uxinzelelo kwibhabhulu yi-$\Delta P = \frac{4\gamma}{r}$ (kwibhabhulu yesepha), ngoko nokuvuza okuncinci kuyabonakala.
c-282.example: Kwindawo yokudibanisa yombhobho wesitovu segesi, tshiza umxube wamanzi ayi-100mL ne-detergent yezitya emalunga ne-1mL, ize ukuba iibhabhulu ziyakhula okanye zivela rhoqo, igesi iyavuza. Igesi yendalo ilula kunomoya iqokelelana phezulu, ize igesi ye-LPG inzima iqokelelana emhlabeni.
c-282.actionItem: Namhlanje ngevalvu yegesi ivaliwe, tshiza amanzi esepha kwindawo yokudibanisa embhobho uze ujonge ukuba iibhabhulu ziyenzeka. Ukuba iibhabhulu ziqhubeka zikhula, vala ivalvu, vuthisa umoya uze ucele uvavanyo kumchwephesha.

c-283.title: Amakhesenati ayamnandi ngakumbi ebusika kuba isitatshi siguquka sibe yiswekile
c-283.summary: Ukuba ugcina amakhesenati amatsha iiveki ezimbalwa kwi-0 ukuya kwi-4°C, isitatshi siyaguquka sibe yiswekile ize amakhesenati abe mnandi. Kubushushu begumbi aba mbi ngokukhawuleza, ngoko ukugcina kwifriji yindlela eqikelelweyo.
c-283.principle: Kubushushu obuphantsi i-amylase nezinye ii-enzymes ziyaphula isitatshi sibe yi-maltose ne-glucose: $(\mathrm{C_6H_{10}O_5})_n + n\,\mathrm{H_2O}\to n\,\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}$. Izityalo ziqokelela iswekile ukuthintela ukukhenkceza nokuzikhusela nge-osmosis.
c-283.example: Amakhesenati asandula ukukhethwa aneswekile engu-5 ukuya kwi-8%, ize ukuba uwagcina iiveki ezi-4 ukuya kwezi-8 kwi-0 ukuya kwi-2°C, umxholo weswekile unyuka malunga namaxesha angu-1,5 ukuya kwama-2 yaye incasa emnandi inokuba nzima ngakumbi. Kubushushu begumbi iinyokana nombola zinokuvela ngokulula ngeentsuku ezili-15.
c-283.actionItem: Namhlanje songa amakhesenati amatsha ngamaqokobhe ephepheni lokuqhubela, uwafake engxoweni ene-zip kwifriji (malunga ne-1 ukuya kwi-4°C) uze uwabilise ngomphunga okanye uwabhake kwiiveki ezi-1 ukuya kwezi-2.

c-284.title: Ukhuseleko lwe-canning luxhomekeke kumda we-asidi ye-pH 4,6
c-284.summary: Kwi-canning yasekhaya, kufuneka wahlule ukutya okuneasidi ene-pH 4,6 okanye ngaphantsi kokunye okuneasidi ephantsi kunoko. Kwimpahla ene-asidi ephantsi, ukubilisa kuphela emanzini abilayo akukhuseli ingozi yetyhefu ye-botulinum.
c-284.principle: Ii-spores zebhaktheriya ye-botulism zinokuvelisa ityhefu kwi-pH engaphezulu kwe-4,6 nakwiimeko ezivaliweyo ngaphandle kweoksijini. I-asidi yi-$\mathrm{pH}=-\log_{10}[\mathrm{H^+}]$, ize i-pH ye-4,6 ibe yi-$[\mathrm{H^+}]\approx 2.5\times10^{-5}\,\mathrm{mol/L}$.
c-284.example: Iijam neekompot zeziqhamo zine-pH emalunga ne-3 ukuya kwi-4 ngoko ziyi-asidi, ngoko ukubilisa emanzini abilayo kukhuselekile ngokuthe ngqo, kodwa imifuno, inyama neembotyi zine-pH ye-5 ukuya kwi-7 kwaye zifuna ukufudunyezwa phantsi koxinzelelo oluphezulu kwi-116 ukuya kwi-121°C. Amanzi abilayo awakwazi ukugqitha kwi-100°C.
c-284.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje uceba i-canning, jonga i-asidi yezithako (iziqhamo okanye ezifakwe iviniga) uze ukhethe ukugcina ukutya kwe-asidi ephantsi ekhaya kwifriji okanye kwi-freezer ngaphandle kwe-canning. Ukuba isivalo siyavuvukala okanye kuvele iibhabhulu okanye ivumba elingaqhelekanga, ungadli, ulahle.

c-285.title: Itshokolethi inokuba ngumthi wetyhefu ezintsheni
c-285.summary: I-theobromine yetshokolethi iphuka kancinci ezintsheni yaye inokubangela ityhefu. Kokukhulu ukuxinana kwe-cocoa, kokukhulu ubungozi, ngoko ukuba inja idle itshokolethi, jonga isixa nohlobo uze utsalele i-veterinarian.
c-285.principle: I-theobromine ($\mathrm{C_7H_8N_4O_2}$) ezintsheni inexesha lesiqingatha lobomi elimalunga neeyure ezi-17, elide kunakubantu (malunga neeyure ezi-6 ukuya kwezi-10), ngoko iqokelelana emzimbeni. Umngcipheko wetyhefu uvavanywa nge-dose kubunzima bomzimba $D=\frac{m_{\mathrm{theobromine}}}{m_{\mathrm{ubunzima\ bomzimba}}}$.
c-285.example: Itshokolethi emnyama (i-cocoa engama-70%) iqulethe malunga ne-5 ukuya kwi-8mg/g ye-theobromine, ngoko inja enobunzima obuyi-10kg edla malunga ne-50g (malunga nesiqingatha setabhulethi eqhelekileyo) ifumana malunga ne-250 ukuya kwi-400mg (malunga ne-25 ukuya kwi-40mg/kg), ekuyindawo yomngcipheko weempawu ezinzima. Itshokolethi yobisi inomxholo ophantsi.
c-285.actionItem: Namhlanje gcina itshokolethi neemveliso ze-cocoa phezulu okanye kwikhabhathi evaliweyo apho inja ingasifikeleli. Ukuba iyidlile, ungalindi, bhala uhlobo, isixa nexesha uze utsalele i-veterinarian ngoko nangoko.

c-286.title: Ukutya kwenqwelomoya akunantsini ngenxa yoxinzelelo nokoma kwenqwelomoya
c-286.summary: Uxinzelelo kwinqwelomoya luphantsi kwaye umoya womile kakhulu, ngoko ivumba nencasa ziyancipha ize ukutya kubonakale kungenatyuwa. Yiyo loo nto ukutya kwenqwelomoya kuqulethe ityuwa eninzi ngabom.
c-286.principle: Uxinzelelo lwekhabhini lulingana nokuphakama kwe-2000 ukuya kwi-2400m ngaphezu kolwandle (malunga ne-0,75 ukuya kwi-0,8atm), ize ukumanzi okuhlobene kube yi-10 ukuya kwi-20%. Kuxinzelelo olusezantsi nokoma, ukuvakala kwabamkeli beevumba nencasa kuyehla kakhulu, kuxelwa ukuba ubumnandi netyuwa ziyancipha malunga ne-30%. Umlinganiselo woxinzelelo yi-$\frac{P_{\mathrm{ikhabhini}}}{P_0}\approx0.8$.
c-286.example: Nokuba ukutya okuqhelekileyo emhlabeni, kwiinqanaba zohambo kuncinci ubumnandi netyuwa ngama-20 ukuya kuma-30%, ngoko ukutya kwenqwelomoya rhoqo kuqulethe ityuwa nezinongo ezininzi. Ingxelo efanayo ichaza ukuba kutheni ijusi yetumato inencasa kakhulu kwinqwelomoya.
c-286.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje uhamba ngenqwelomoya, sela amanzi rhoqo ukuze umlomo ungomi, kwaye nokuba ukutya kubonakala kungenatyuwa, musa ukufaka ityuwa, khetha ukutya okunevumba elikhulu okanye iziselo ezine-asidi.

c-287.title: Khetha umgubo wokubhaka ngokwekhonteyini yeprotheyini: owomeleleyo, ophakathi okanye obuthathaka
c-287.summary: Ukwahlulwa komgubo ube mandla, ophakathi nobuthathaka kuyimbonakalo yeprotheyini. Kwisonka khetha umgubo onamandla onamaprotheyini amaninzi, kwiikeyiki namabhiskithi obuthathaka onamaprotheyini amancinci ukuze ukuthungwa kulunge.
c-287.principle: Iiprotheyini zengqolowa i-gliadin ne-glutenin ngamanzi zenza inethiwekhi ye-gluten: $\text{i-gliadin}+\text{i-glutenin}+\mathrm{H_2O}\to\text{i-gluten}$. Kokukhulu iprotheyini, kokukhulu ukuqina nokuguquguquka kwenethiwekhi.
c-287.example: Umgubo onamandla onemalunga ne-11 ukuya kwi-13% yeprotheyini ufanelekile kwisonka esiqinileyo nakwi-bagel, ophakathi onemalunga ne-9 ukuya kwi-10% kwii-noodles nakwii-pancakes, ize obuthathaka onemalunga ne-7 ukuya kwi-9% kwiikeyiki ezithambileyo namabhiskithi. I-100g yomgubo obuthathaka iqulethe malunga ne-8g yeprotheyini.
c-287.actionItem: Namhlanje xa uthenga umgubo, funda umxholo weprotheyini ngasemva kwepakethe uze ngokwesidlo ozakuphekile ukhethe umgubo onamandla, ophakathi okanye obuthathaka.

c-288.title: Ukuxuba iibhetri ezintsha nezindala kunyusa kakhulu umngcipheko wokuvuza
c-288.summary: Ukuba uxuba iibhetri ezintsha nezisetyenzisiweyo okanye iibhetri zeentlobo ezahlukeneyo, ibhetri ebuthathaka iyalahlekelwa kakhulu ngamandla ize ivuze. Kwisixhobo, hlala utshintsha zonke iibhetri zohlobo olufanayo nolwebhetshi enye.
c-288.principle: Kwindibaniselwano ye-series umbane ofanayo uyahamba, kodwa xa umbane webhetri ebuthathaka uqala ukuya ku-0V, ezinye iibhetri ziyayitshaja ngokuchasene. Kweso sihlandla, ngempendulo efana ne-$2\,\mathrm{H_2O}+2e^-\to \mathrm{H_2}+2\,\mathrm{OH^-}$, i-hydrogen iyavela, uxinzelelo lwangaphakathi luyanda ize kwenzeke ukuvuza.
c-288.example: Ngeebhetri ezintathu ezintsha ze-1,5V kwi-series (4,5V), apho enye isondele kuvuthwa (isondele kwi-0V), ezinye ezimbini ziqhubeka zitsala malunga ne-3V ize ibhetri leyo itshajwe kwicala eliphikisanayo. I-potassium hydroxide evuzayo yi-base eqinileyo (i-pH malunga ne-14) eyonakalisa isikhumba nesixhobo.
c-288.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga iibhetri kwii-remote controls, kwiiwotshi nakwizinto zokudlala uze xa uzitshintsha, tshintsha zonke iibhetri kwisixhobo esinye zibe zintsha zorhwebo olufanayo. Musa ukuchukumisa umgubo omhlophe ovuzayo ngezandla ezingenanto.

c-289.title: Bilisa amathambo enkomo kunye uze uwahlulele ngamaxabiso
c-289.summary: Ukuba ubilisa amathambo enkomo ixesha elide, i-collagen iguquka ibe yijelatini kwaye kwenziwe isuphu eshinyeneyo eqina ibe yijeli xa ibanda. Ukuba uyibilisa kube kanye uyikhenkcise ngokwamaxabiso, ugcina igesi nexesha.
c-289.principle: I-collagen inyibilika ibe yijelatini xa ifudumeziwe ize ijike ibe yi-gel isuka kwi-sol xa ibanda. I-hydrolysis ngokufudumeza yi-$\text{i-collagen}\xrightarrow{\Delta,\ \mathrm{H_2O}}\text{ijelatini}$ kwaye ngokuqhelekileyo iqina ngaphantsi kwe-35°C.
c-289.example: Ukuba ubilisa i-1kg yamathambo enkomo kwi-6L yamanzi iiyure ezi-6 ukuya kwezi-8, ufumana malunga ne-4 ukuya kwi-5L yesuphu. Endaweni yokubasa isitovu ngamaxesha onke, yibilise kube kanye uyahlule ibe ngamaxabiso angama-15 e-300mL, nto enciphisa kakhulu ukusetyenziswa kwegesi.
c-289.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje ubilisa amathambo enkomo, yipholise isuphu ngokupheleleyo, uyahlule ngokwamaxabiso kwiingxowa ezine-zip okanye izikhongozeli uze uyikhenkcise, ize xa usebenzisa uyikhuphe uze ufudumeze isixa esifunekayo kuphela.

c-290.title: Umgubo omhlophe emhlabeni wesitya asingombola, kunokuba yityuwa
c-290.summary: Umgubo omhlophe emhlabeni wesitya okanye emphethweni wesitya akusoloko ingombola, kodwa kunokuba yintsalela yetyuwa evela kumgquba okanye kumanzi epompo. Ngokunkcenkceshela ngokwaneleyo unokuhlamba uncipha.
c-290.principle: Xa amanzi ephuma emphezulwini, ityuwa enyibilikileyo ishiyeka ize iphume ngohlobo lweekristali. Ukuxinana kwetyuwa yi-$C=\frac{m_{\mathrm{ityuwa}}}{V_{\mathrm{amanzi}}}$ ize inyuke kuba i-$V_{\mathrm{amanzi}}$ iyancipha, ize xa igqitha ukugcwala, iikristali ziyenziwa. Kushiyeka umzekelo wezinto zamanzi anzima ezifana ne-$\mathrm{CaCO_3}$.
c-290.example: Ukuba ubunzima bamanzi epompo bumalunga ne-100mg/L (kwi-CaCO3), xa i-1L yamanzi iphuma ishiya malunga ne-100mg ye-calcium carbonate. Nokuba unkcenkceshela i-200mL ngeveki, kwiinyanga ezimbalwa kuvela umaleko omhlophe ocacileyo emphezulwini womhlaba.
c-290.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje ubona umgubo omhlophe, susa i-1 ukuya kwi-2cm yomhlaba ongaphezulu, yongeza umhlaba omtsha uze emva koko unkcenkceshele kancinci ngamanzi anomthamo wesitya ukuze igalele ngokwaneleyo ngombhobho wokukhupha.

c-291.title: I-chewing gum ene-xylitol iyingozi ezintsheni
c-291.summary: I-xylitol, ekhuselekileyo kubantu, iyingozi kakhulu ezintsheni kwaye nakwisixa esincinci ibangela i-hypoglycemia nokonakala kwesibindi. Gcina i-chewing gum, iilekese ezingenaswekile neebhotolo ezithile zamandongomane kude nenja.
c-291.principle: I-pancreas yenja ijonga i-xylitol njenge-glucose yaye ikhulula i-insulin ngamandla. Emva koko iswekile yegazi iyehla kakhulu, ize idosi eyingozi $\mathrm{C_5H_{12}O_5}$ (ye-xylitol) iqikelelwe nge-$D=\frac{m}{m_{\mathrm{ubunzima\ bomzimba}}}$.
c-291.example: Kwinja enobunzima obuyi-10kg, nokuba i-0,1g/kg ye-xylitol (malunga ne-1g) inokubangela i-hypoglycemia, ize kwi-0,5g/kg (malunga ne-5g) okanye ngaphezulu umngcipheko wokonakala kwesibindi mkhulu. I-chewing gum enye engenaswekile iqulethe malunga ne-0,2 ukuya kwi-1g ye-xylitol, ngoko ezimbalwa nje sele zisendaweni eyingozi.
c-291.actionItem: Namhlanje susa i-chewing gum neelekese ezingenaswekile kwiingxowa, iipokotho nakwiidrower uzibeke kwiindawo apho inja ingasifikeleli. Ukuba iyidlile, thatha ipakethe enezithako uze utsalele i-veterinarian ngoko nangoko.

c-292.title: Kutheni amanzi eentaba ashushu ane-alkali ethambileyo
c-292.summary: Xa untywila kumanzi eentaba ashushu ane-alkali, ayatyibilika kuba amafutha esikhumba aguquka abe yisepha. Ukuba unesikhumba esibuthathaka, ungantywili ixesha elide uze usebenzise i-moisturizer emva kokuhlamba.
c-292.principle: I-alkali (i-pH 8,5 okanye ngaphezulu) i-saponify amafutha esikhumba (ii-triglycerides) abe yisepha ne-glycerol: $\text{amafutha} + 3\,\mathrm{OH^-}\to 3\,\text{i-fatty acid (isepha)}+\text{i-glycerol}$. Le sepha iyakhethisa emphezulwini ize ityibilike.
c-292.example: Ukuba ugezela imizuzu eli-20 emanzini eentaba ashushu ane-alkali ane-pH malunga ne-9 ukuya kwi-10 kwi-40°C, umaleko we-keratin neoli yesikhumba iyanyibilika ize isikhumba sithambe. Kodwa kwi-pH 10 ukuxinana kwe-$[\mathrm{OH^-}]$ kuphezulu ngamaxesha angama-1000 kune-neutral pH (7).
c-292.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje ugezela emanzini eentaba okanye kwi-spa, gezela emanzini e-alkali kuphela imizuzu eli-10 ukuya kwengama-20 ngexesha elinye, womise emva kokugezela uze usebenzise i-moisturizing cream ngoko nangoko.

c-293.title: ‘Extra virgin’ yeoli ye-olive yimpawu yomgangatho ene-acidity ukuya kwi-0,8%
c-293.summary: I-extra virgin yiklasi yeoli ye-olive evela ekucinezeleni i-olive enamafutha e-acid asimahla angu-0,8% okanye ngaphantsi aze adlule uvavanyo lwe-sensory. I-acidity ephantsi ayithethi sisoloko incasa engcono, ngoko jonga nomhla wokuvuna nowokuzalisa.
c-293.principle: I-acidity yingxenye yee-free fatty acids (ezibalwa njenge-oleic acid) kwioli: $\text{i-acidity(\%)}=\frac{m_{\mathrm{i-fatty\ acid\ esimahla}}}{m_{\mathrm{ioli}}}\times100$. Ngokutsha kwee-olive, ngokuncinci ukuphuka kwee-triglycerides nangokuncinci i-acidity, kwaye ii-polyphenols zicothisa ioksidasi.
c-293.example: I-acidity engu-0,8% okanye ngaphantsi ithetha i-extra virgin, ize i-2% okanye ngaphantsi ibe yi-virgin. Kwibhotile ye-1L, kwi-extra virgin ii-free fatty acids zimalunga ne-8g okanye ngaphantsi. Ioli ibuthathaka ekukhanyeni nobushushu, ngoko ibhotile emnyama ilungile.
c-293.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje uthenga ioli ye-olive, jonga uphawu ‘extra virgin’ nonyaka wokuvuna nomhla wokuzalisa kwibhotile, khetha ibhotile emnyama endaweni yocacileyo uze ugcine ioli kwindawo ebandayo.

c-294.title: Gubungela iitheminali zebhetri ye-9V ngetheyiphu xa uyigcina
c-294.summary: Iitheminali zebhetri ye-9V zikwicala elinye ukusondelelana, ngoko xa zichukumisa isinyithi zinokuba short-circuit zifudumale. Ngokugcina kwidrower, gubungela iitheminali ngetheyiphu okanye uzigcine ngokwahlukeneyo.
c-294.principle: Xa iitheminali zichukumisa isinyithi njengesitshixo okanye ingqekembe zibe short-circuit, ukuxhathisa kuncinci kakhulu, umbane omkhulu $I=\frac{V}{R}$ uyahamba kwaye ubushushu bakwaJoule $P=I^2R$ buyakhululwa. Umzekelo, ukuba $R=0.5\,\Omega$, ngoko $I=18\,\mathrm{A}$.
c-294.example: Ukuba ibhetri ye-9V enokuxhathisa kwangaphakathi okumalunga ne-1,5Ω ibe short-circuit, ngokwethiyori inokufikelela kwi-$I\approx6\,\mathrm{A}$ nakumandla obushushu amalunga ne-54W, ngoko ifudumala ngemizuzu embalwa. Iibhetri ze-alkaline zihlala ngaphantsi kwexabiso eli, kodwa umngcipheko wokutsha nomlilo uhlala.
c-294.actionItem: Namhlanje gubungela iitheminali zeebhetri ze-9V ezisaliweyo kwidrower ngetheyiphu ecacileyo okanye uzigcine kwipakethe yazo yokuqala okanye kwibhokisi yeplastiki. Musa ukuzigcina kunye neengqekembe nezitshixo.

c-295.title: I-tofu ihlala ixesha elide ukuba uyifaka emanzini ize utshintshe amanzi yonke imihla
c-295.summary: I-tofu evuliweyo efakwe emanzini acocekileyo yaze yagcinwa kwifriji ngokutshintsha amanzi yonke imihla ihlala intsha ngeentsuku ezi-2 ukuya kwezi-3. Ukuba kuvele ivumba lasenzimbileni okanye ukunamathela, yilahle.
c-295.principle: I-tofu yi-gel yeeprotheyini ze-soya eqinisiweyo nge-coagulant kwaye iqulethe malunga ne-85% yamanzi, ngoko iibhaktheriya zandisa ngokukhawuleza. Xa ifakwe emanzini, utshintsho lomsebenzi wamanzi $a_w=\frac{p}{p_0}$ womphezulu nokudibana neoksijini kuyancipha, ize ngenguqulelo nganye yamanzi iibhaktheriya ezandisiweyo neemetabolites zihlanjwa.
c-295.example: Ukuba i-tofu evuliweyo ekwifriji kwi-4°C ifakwe emanzini ize amanzi atshintshwe yonke imihla, ihlala iintsuku ezi-3 ukuya kwezi-5, ngaphandle koko umphezulu rhoqo uyanamathela emva kweentsuku ezi-1 ukuya kwezi-2. Ngokungalahli icandelo elinye le-tofu (300g, malunga ne-2000 won), ukonga kukhulu.
c-295.actionItem: Namhlanje faka i-tofu eseleyo kwisikhongozeli esivaliweyo, uyigalele ngamanzi acocekileyo (aqulathiweyo okanye abilisiweyo aze apholiswe) ngokwaneleyo ukuyigubungela, uyifake kwifriji, uze ukususela ngomso utshintshe amanzi kube kanye ngosuku.

c-296.title: Hlamba ijaketi ye-down nge-detergent ethathe cala uze uyomise ngokupheleleyo
c-296.summary: Kwiijaketi ze-down (isikhova, ihanti), i-detergent eyi-alkali eyomeleleyo isusa amafutha endalo eentsiba ize inciphise ukuguquguquka. Hlamba nge-detergent ethathe cala uze uyomise de kube kupheleleyo ukuthintela ivumba nembola.
c-296.principle: Amafutha (ii-lipid) eentsibeni ayasaponify kwiimeko ze-alkali aze ahlanjwe: $\text{amafutha}+3\,\mathrm{OH^-}\to\text{isepha}+\text{i-glycerol}$. Xa amafutha elahlekile, iintsiba ziyawa ize ubunzima bomaleko womoya ongasenzi i-insulation buyancipha.
c-296.example: Isisombululo se-detergent yempuphu eqhelekileyo ine-alkali ene-pH malunga ne-10 ukuya kwi-11, ize i-detergent ethathe cala ibe ne-pH malunga ne-7 ukuya kwi-8. Kwijaketi ene-fillpower ye-800 nobunzima obuyi-500g, nokuba kusaleyo i-100g yomswakama emva kokomisa kunokubangela ivumba elimanzi nembola.
c-296.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje uhlamba ijaketi, sebenzisa i-detergent ethathe cala (ekhethekileyo kwiwul ne-down), yihlambe kakuhle uze uyomise ngokupheleleyo kumatshini wokomisa kubushushu obuphantsi ngeebhola zetenisi ezi-2 ukuya kwezi-3, okanye uyomise kumthunzi iintsuku ezimbalwa de ibe yomile nangaphakathi.

c-297.title: Thatha izongezelelo zekalsiyam nezentsimbi ngamaxesha ahlukeneyo
c-297.summary: Ukuba uthatha izongezelelo zekalsiyam nezentsimbi ngaxeshanye, zinokuphazamisa ukufunxwa komnye nomnye. Ukuba uthatha zombini, shiya umda wexesha ubuncinane iiyure ezi-2.
c-297.principle: Ii-cations ze-divalent ezifana ne-$\mathrm{Ca^{2+}}$ ne-$\mathrm{Fe^{2+}}$ zikhuphisana kumthwali omnye wokufunxa (i-DMT1 njl.) emathunjini amancinci. Xa ukuxinana kwenye kuphezulu, ukufunxwa kwenye kuyehla, ize ngaphezulu kwe-500mg yekalsiyam ukufunxwa kwentsimbi kunokunciphisa ngokubonakalayo.
c-297.example: Kuxelwa ukuba xa uthatha i-600mg yekalsiyam kunye nama-18mg entsimbi kunye, ukufunxwa kwentsimbi kuyehla kube malunga ne-40 ukuya kwi-50%. Rhoqo intsimbi ithathwa ekuseni ngesisu esilambileyo nge-vitamin C, ize ikalsiyam ithathwe kwisidlo.
c-297.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje uthatha zombini, thatha intsimbi ekuseni ngesisu esilambileyo okanye ngokuhlwa kwakusasa, ize ikalsiyam kwisidlo sakusihlwa. Ukuba unamayeza onyangelwayo, buza i-pharmacist kuqala.

c-298.title: Kukho imithetho ngeelayitha kwinqwelomoya
c-298.summary: Imithetho yeelayitha ihluka ngokwesizwe nenkampani yenqwelomoya, kodwa ngokubanzi umkhweli ngamnye angathatha ilayitha enye emzimbeni kwaye rhoqo akavumelekanga ukuyibeka kwingxowa edluliswayo. Iilayitha zomlilo (i-turbo) zinqatshelwe ubukhulu becala. Jonga phambi kokuhamba.
c-298.principle: Amafutha kwilayitha, i-butane ($\mathrm{C_4H_{10}}$), enolwelo phantsi koxinzelelo kwaye iyatsha kakhulu, ukutsha $2\,\mathrm{C_4H_{10}}+13\,\mathrm{O_2}\to8\,\mathrm{CO_2}+10\,\mathrm{H_2O}$. Xa uxinzelelo lwekhabhini luyehla, umahluko woxinzelelo $\Delta P$ phakathi kwangaphakathi nangaphandle kwesikhongozeli uyanda.
c-298.example: I-butane inoxinzelelo lwe-vapor olumalunga ne-2atm kwi-20°C. Kwikhabhini (malunga ne-0,8atm) umahluko ngokuchasene noxinzelelo lwangaphandle mkhulu kunasemhlabeni, ngoko kwiilayitha ezithile amafutha anokuvuza okanye ilangatye libe likhulu. Ilayitha eqhelekileyo yokusetyenziswa kube kanye ihlala iqulethe i-g embalwa ye-butane.
c-298.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje uhamba, jonga imithetho yeelayitha yenkampani yenqwelomoya nelizwe oya kulo, uze ukuba awuyidingi, shiya ilayitha ekhaya. Ukuba uyithatha, thatha enye kuphela epokothweni ukuze uyibonise kwi-security check.

c-299.title: I-soy sauce evuthisiweyo ne-hydrolyzed nge-asidi yenziwa ngeempendulo ezahlukeneyo
c-299.summary: I-soy sauce evuthisiweyo yenziwa ngokuvundiswa kwe-microbiological nokuvuthwa kwe-soya nengqolowa, ize ihydrolyzed nge-asidi yenziwe ngokuphulwa ngokukhawuleza kweeprotheyini ze-soya nge-hydrochloric acid. Umahluko ubonakala kuphawu ‘vuthisiweyo’ nakwizithako kwilebula.
c-299.principle: Kwezozibini iiprotheyini ziyahydrolyze zibe ziiamino acids, kodwa i-catalyst ihlukile. Ekuvundisweni yi-enzyme $\text{iprotheyini}\xrightarrow{\text{enzyme},\ \text{iinyanga ezininzi}}\text{i-amino acid}$, kwi-hydrolysis ye-asidi yi-$\text{iprotheyini}\xrightarrow{\mathrm{HCl},\ \Delta}\text{i-amino acid}$ ize igqitywe kwiiyure ukuya kwiintsuku.
c-299.example: I-soy sauce evuthisiweyo ngokuqhelekileyo ivuthwa iinyanga ezi-6 ukuya kwiminyaka emininzi, ize i-hydrolyzed ngee-asidi yenziwe ngeentsuku ezimbalwa, ngoko ishibhile, kodwa ivumba lilodwa. I-soy sauce exutyiweyo yorhwebo yimixube yazo zombini kwaye umlinganiselo ubhalwe kwilebula.
c-299.actionItem: Xa uthenga i-soy sauce, jonga kuluhlu lwezithako ukuba ‘i-100% evuthisiweyo’ okanye ‘ixutywe ne-hydrolyzed nge-asidi’, uze ukhethe ngokokusetyenziswa, umzekelo evuthisiweyo kwisuphu nakwi-stew, ixutyiweyo kwi-stir-fry nakwi-stew.

c-300.title: I-diesel kumakhephu makhulu, i-wax ye-paraffin iyaqina ize injini ingaqali
c-300.summary: I-wax ye-paraffin kumafutha e-diesel ngaphantsi kwe-zero iyakristalayiza itshixa isihluzi samafutha, ngoko injini ayiqali. Xa kuqikelelwa ubuqaba obukhulu, zalisa i-diesel yasebusika ugcine ityanki igcwele kakuhle.
c-300.principle: Ii-n-paraffins kumafutha e-diesel (umzekelo $\mathrm{C_{20}H_{42}}$) ziyakristalayiza xa ubushushu buyehla ngaphantsi kwe-cloud point $T_{\mathrm{cp}}$. Xa $T<T_{\mathrm{cp}}$, iikristali ze-wax ziyanda ize kwindawo ephantsi yokutshixa isihluzi, isihluzi sitshixeke.
c-300.example: I-diesel yasehlotyeni inendawo yeqhwa emalunga ne-0°C, ize eyasebusika iyehliswe ibe malunga ne-−15 ukuya kwi-−20°C. Ukuba ngokuhlwa kwebusika kuba ne-−10°C, umngcipheko wengxaki yokuqala uyanda ukuba kwitanki kusaseleyo i-diesel yasehlotyeni.
c-300.actionItem: Ukuba namhlanje kuqikelelwe ubuqaba obukhulu, jonga ukuba imoto ifumene i-diesel yasebusika kwisiteshi sepetroli uze ugcine ityanki ubuncinane iyisiqingatha igcwele. Ukuba injini ayiqali, musa ukuzama kaninzi, utsalele inkonzo okanye uncedo lwe-insurance.

c-301.title: Iinkozo ezimbalwa zelayisi kwisaltshaker ziyakuthintela ityuwa ukuba iqine
c-301.summary: Xa ityuwa iqina ngenxa yomswakama, iinkozo zelayisi zifunxa umswakama kuqala, ngoko ityuwa inamathela kancinci. Akuphelelanga, ngoko ukugcinwa okuvaliweyo kungcono.
c-301.principle: I-sodium chloride kumswakama ohlobene ongaphezulu kwe-75% ifunxa umswakama emoyeni inyibilike (i-deliquescent). Lo mswakama obalulekileyo yi-$\mathrm{RH}_{\mathrm{c}}\approx75\%$ ize ngaphezulu kwawo iinkozo zinamathelane zenze amaqhuma.
c-301.example: Ukuba umswakama ngexesha lemvula ungama-80% okanye ngaphezulu, isaltshaker evuliweyo inokuqina ngosuku olunye okanye ezimbini. Ukuba ufaka iinkozo zelayisi ezingama-10 ukuya kuma-20, ziyafunxa inxalenye ye-g zomswakama nge-100g yetyuwa zicothise ukwenza amaqhuma.
c-301.actionItem: Namhlanje faka iinkozo zelayisi ezingama-10 ukuya kuma-20 kwisaltshaker uvale isivalo ngokuqinileyo uze uyibeke kwindawo ebandayo nomileyo, hayi kwikona enomswakama ecaleni kwesitovu.

c-302.title: Kwiwul nasesilika, musa ukusebenzisa ii-detergent ze-enzymatic
c-302.summary: Iwul nesilika zii-fibre zeeprotheyini, ngoko i-detergent ye-enzymatic ene-protease inyibilikisa ii-fibre iziyonakalise. Sebenzisa i-detergent ethathe cala ekhethekileyo ye-wool ne-silk.
c-302.principle: I-protease kwi-detergent ye-enzymatic i-hydrolyze iibhondi ze-peptide zeeprotheyini: $\mathrm{R{-}CO{-}NH{-}R'}+\mathrm{H_2O}\to\mathrm{R{-}COOH}+\mathrm{H_2N{-}R'}$. I-keratin yewul ne-fibroin yesilika nazo ziiprotheyini, ngoko impendulo efanayo iyazibuthathisa.
