c-302.example: I-enzyme ye-protease isebenza kakhulu kwi-30 ukuya kwi-50°C yaye isebenza kubushushu obuqhelekileyo bokuhlamba. Ukuba utshisa isweta yewul iyure enye kuphela kwi-detergent ye-enzymatic kwi-30°C, ii-fibre zinokuba tyaba, ukukhanya kuyancipha okanye imingxuma ivele.
c-302.actionItem: Namhlanje jonga ilebula yokuhlamba yempahla yewul okanye yesilika, kwaye ukuba kwizithako ze-detergent kubhalwe ‘enzyme (protease)’, ungayisebenzisi, kodwa uhlambe ngesandla emanzini abandayo nge-detergent ethathe cala ekhethekileyo yewul nesilika.

c-303.title: Kwii-probiotics, jonga ubushushu bokugcina
c-303.summary: Ii-probiotics zizilwanyana ezincinci eziphilayo ezibuthathaka kubushushu nomswakama, ngoko landela ubushushu bokugcina obuboniswe. Ukuba kuphawulwe ukupholisa, ngehlobo ungazithumeli ngeposi ize ungazishiyi kwimoto.
c-303.principle: Xa ubushushu bunyuka, isantya sokufa kweebhaktheriya eziphilayo siyanda ize sincipha ku-$N(t)=N_0\,e^{-kt}$, kokuphezulu ubushushu, kokukhulu $k$. Izinto ezinezinto ze-spore (umzekelo uhlobo lwe-Bacillus) neemveliso ezigqunyiweyo okanye ze-lyophilized zizinzile kancinci nakubushushu begumbi.
c-303.example: Ukuba imveliso enophawu lokupholisa ishiywe kwi-25 ukuya kwi-30°C, inani leebhaktheriya eziphilayo linokuhla ngokubonakalayo kwiiveki ezimbalwa, nakwimoto kwi-40°C okanye ngaphezulu ngokukhawuleza. Inani leebhaktheriya eliqinisekisiweyo ngokuqhelekileyo likhona kwiibhaktheriya eziphilayo ukuya kumhla wokuphelelwa, hayi ekuveliseni.
c-303.actionItem: Namhlanje kwilebula yee-probiotics jonga ukuba kufuneka zigcinwe kwifriji okanye kubushushu begumbi, ize ukuba kuphawulwe ukupholisa, zibeke kwifriji, ize ngehlobo ungazishiyi kwimoto okanye ecaleni kwefestile. Ukuba unengxaki yempilo, buza ugqirha.

c-304.title: Kwindawo yamayeza yangaphandle ucele amayeza ngegama lesithako esisebenzayo
c-304.summary: Iyeza elifanayo linamagama orhwebo ahlukeneyo kumazwe ahlukeneyo, ngoko kwi-pharmacy yangaphandle kuchaneke ngakumbi ukuthi igama lesithako esisebenzayo (ngesiNgesi). Umzekelo, i-acetaminophen ibizwa nangokuba yi-paracetamol phesheya.
c-304.principle: Igama lamazwe ngamazwe elingenamnini (i-INN) lesithako esisebenzayo liyafana kumazwe, kodwa amagama orhwebo ahluka ngomenzi. Isithako esisebenzayo esifanayo $\mathrm{C_8H_9NO_2}$ sibizwa ngokuba yi-acetaminophen (i-USA, eKorea) nangokuba yi-paracetamol (eYurophu, eAsia njl.).
c-304.example: Iimveliso ezine-500mg ye-acetaminophen ngokwelizwe zithengiswa njenge-‘Tylenol’, i-‘Panadol’, i-‘Paracetamol’ nezifanayo, kodwa isithako esisebenzayo sifanayo. Idosi yemini ephezulu kubantu abadala ngokuqhelekileyo akufuneki idlule kwi-4g (iitafile ezi-8 ze-500mg).
c-304.actionItem: Namhlanje ngexesha lokulungiselela uhambo, bhala okanye ugcine kwi-foni amagama ezithako ezisebenzayo (ngesiNgesi) zamayeza oqhele ukuwathatha. Kwi-pharmacy xela iimpawu, amayeza owathathayo nokungabikho kwemfuza, ize kumayeza onyangelwayo uthathe isatifikethi sezonyango.

c-305.title: Umahluko phakathi kwetiye emnyama, eluhlaza nekaoolong yidigri yokuoksidiza kwamagqabi etiye
c-305.summary: Itiye emnyama, i-oolong neluhlaza zivela kumagqabi omthi omnye wetiye, kodwa zahluka ngedigri yokuoksidiza (ukuvundiswa), ngoko incasa nombala zahlukile. Itiye eluhlaza ithintela ioksidasi, ize emnyama ioksidize ngokupheleleyo.
c-305.principle: I-polyphenol oxidase (PPO) emagqabini etiye iguqula ii-catechins nge-oksijini zibe zii-theaflavins nezinye: $\text{i-catechin}+\mathrm{O_2}\xrightarrow{\mathrm{PPO}}\text{i-theaflavin}$. Itiye eluhlaza ibulala i-enzyme kuqala ngobushushu ithintele ioksidasi.
c-305.example: Itiye eluhlaza ine-oksidasi malunga ne-0%, i-oolong malunga ne-10 ukuya kwi-80%, kwaye itiye emnyama phantse i-100%. Itiye eluhlaza ngokuqhelekileyo ixutyiwe ngamanzi malunga ne-70 ukuya kwi-80°C imizuzu emi-1 ukuya kwemi-2, ize emnyama ngamanzi malunga ne-90 ukuya kwi-95°C imizuzu emi-3 ukuya kwemi-5.
c-305.actionItem: Namhlanje xa uthenga itiye, jonga kwipakethe ulwazi ‘ayioksidanga (eluhlaza) · ioksidizwe ngokuyinxalenye (i-oolong) · ioksidizwe ngokupheleleyo (emnyama)’ uze uyilungiselele kubushushu bamanzi nexesha elifanelekileyo.

c-306.title: Gcina itanki yamafutha ingaphezu kwesiqingatha ebusika
c-306.summary: Ebusika, itanki yamafutha engenanto yenza umphunga wamanzi emoyeni ukuba udibane kumafutha, kwaye ungakhenkceza kumapayipi ngaphantsi kwe-zero. Ukugcina itanki ingaphezu kwesiqingatha kuyakunciphisa oku.
c-306.principle: Umphunga wamanzi kwisithuba esingenanto udibana kudonga lwetanki elibandayo. Ukudibana kwenzeka xa ubushushu behla ngaphantsi kwe-dew point $T_d$, kwaye ngokuphangaleleyo umoya otankini, kokukhona umphunga unokudibana. Amanzi akhenkceza kwi-$0^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ okanye ngaphantsi kwaye avale ukuhamba kwamafutha.
c-306.example: Itanki engenanto ye-50L iqulathe malunga ne-50L yomoya onomswakama, ngoko kwi-80% yomswakama ohambelanayo kunye ne-10°C, ama-gram ambalwa amanzi anokudibana ngokwethiyori. Itanki egcweleyo inomoya ongaphantsi nanjalo amanzi angaphantsi, inciphisa ithuba lokuba amapayipi amafutha akhenkceze ekuseni kwe--10°C kwaye avale ukuqala.
c-306.actionItem: Namhlanje, khangela inqanaba lamafutha emoto yakho okanye itanki yokufudumeza uze ugcwalise ukuba ingaphantsi kwesiqingatha. Ukugcina ngaphezu kwesiqingatha yinto elula yasebusika kunokulinda ukugcwalisa ngokupheleleyo.

c-307.title: Ukuba iKofu Inencasa Ekrakra, Nciphisa Ukukhutshwa Endaweni Yokongeza Ubhontshisi Obuninzi
c-307.summary: Ukuba ikofu inencasa ekrakra, yenza i-grind ibe nzima okanye nciphisa ukukhutshwa endaweni yokongeza ubhontshisi obuninzi. Ukukhutshwa ngokugqithisileyo kubangela ukukrakra, ngoko unokulungisa incasa ngaphandle kokuchitha ubhontshisi.
c-307.principle: I-extraction yield yi-$\text{yield (\%)}=\frac{m_{\mathrm{dissolved\ solids}}}{m_{\mathrm{coffee}}}\times100$, nge-18-22% ngokuqhelekileyo ilungile. Ngaphaya koko, izinto ezikrakra ezifana ne-chlorogenic acid lactones ne-phenylindanes ziyakhutshwa kakhulu.
c-307.example: Nge-20g yekofu, ukudlula kwi-22% yield kunyibilikisa ngaphezu kwe-4.4g kwaye iyakrakra yaye inzima. Ukujolisa kwi-20% kwii-20g ezifanayo kunyibilikisa malunga ne-4g, inencasa emnandi nelinganisiweyo. Kwi-1,000 KRW malunga (malunga ne-USD 0.70) kwi-20g yobhontshisi, ukunciphisa inkunkuma kuyadibana.
c-307.actionItem: Ukuba ikofu yakho ikrakra namhlanje, ungongezi ubhontshisi obuninzi. Yenza i-grind ibe nzima nge-step enye okanye unciphise ixesha lokuvelisa nge-20-30 seconds, kwaye ugcine amanzi kwi-90-94°C.

c-308.title: Imvubelo Ifa Emanzini Ashushu Ngaphezu Kwe-55°C Malunga
c-308.summary: Imvubelo yesonka ifa emanzini ashushu kakhulu, ngoko intlama ayiyi kuvuleka. Gcina amanzi efudumele ekuchukumiseni, malunga ne-30-38°C.
c-308.principle: Imvubelo (Saccharomyces) ifa ngokukhawuleza ngaphezu kwe-55°C malunga apho iiprotheni zayo ziguquka. Umsebenzi uphezulu malunga ne-28-35°C, kwaye ukubila $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}\to2\,\mathrm{C_2H_5OH}+2\,\mathrm{CO_2}$ kwenza i-carbon dioxide ephakamisa intlama.
c-308.example: Nge-7g yemvubelo kwi-500g yefulawa, amanzi e-35°C avumela intlama iphindwe kabini ngaphakathi kweyure, kodwa amanzi e-60°C abulala uninzi lwemvubelo kwaye intlama ayivuleki kakhulu. Kukwakonga iphakethe lemvubelo (malunga ne-500 KRW, malunga ne-USD 0.35).
c-308.actionItem: Ukuba ubhaka isonka namhlanje, khangela ubushushu bamanzi ngethemometha okanye ngaphakathi kwesihlahla ukuze afudumele kwi-30-38°C, hayi ashushu, kwaye ubhuqe ityuwa nemvubelo ngokwahlukileyo ukuze zingachukumani ngqo.

c-309.title: Ukudibanisa Amachiza Okubanda Kunokuphinda Kabini I-Acetaminophen
c-309.summary: Ukuthatha ichiza elidibeneyo lokubanda, ichiza lentlungu kunye ne-Tylenol ngokwahlukeneyo kunokuphinda i-acetaminophen kwaye kudlule umda wemihla ngemihla. Yongeza umxholo we-acetaminophen (paracetamol) kuwo onke amalebula.
c-309.principle: I-acetaminophen ihlala ityiwa esibindini, kodwa xa kugqithiswa isixa se-metabolite enetyhefu i-NAPQI iyaqokelela, yehlisa i-glutathione kwaye yonakalise iiseli zesibindi. Yongeza isixa semihla ngemihla $D_{\mathrm{total}}=\sum D_i$ kwaye uyigcine kwi-4g okanye ngaphantsi kubantu abadala (ihlala icetyiswa i-3g okanye ngaphantsi).
c-309.example: Iipilisi ezine ze-Tylenol ezingama-500mg (2g) kunye neesachet ezintathu zechiza eliyinxubevange lokubanda nge-325mg nganye (malunga ne-1g) sele zifikelela kwi-3g ngosuku. Kufuneka ubale ukuze enye iTylenol ingakudluliseli ngaphezu kwe-4g.
c-309.actionItem: Ukuba uthatha ichiza lokubanda namhlanje, khangela onke amalebula emveliso ukufumana umxholo we-acetaminophen, bhala isixa semihla ngemihla kwaye uhlale ngaphakathi komda. Ukuba awuqinisekanga, buza i-pharmacist.

c-310.title: Iibhari Ezomeleleyo Zeshampu Nekhondishina Ziphepha Umda Wolwelo Xa Uhamba
c-310.summary: Iibhari ezomeleleyo zeshampu nekhondishina azizizo ulwelo okanye ijeli, ngoko ziphepha umda we-100mL wekhabhini kwaye zikhulula ibhegi yakho yohambo. Iinqwelo-moya ezininzi namazwe awasithathi isepha eqinileyo njengolwelo.
c-310.principle: Zenziwa ngokomeleza ii-surfactant (ezifana ne-sodium cocoyl isethionate) ngaphandle kwamanzi, ngoko ziqulathe phantse akukho. Umthetho wolwelo ulinganisa umthamo ukuya kwi-$V\le100\,\mathrm{mL}$, ngoko ezomeleleyo azifakwanga, nangona isigqibo sokugqibela sisekwiofisa yokhuseleko.
c-310.example: Ishampu yolwelo ye-250mL ayinakuya kwikhabhini ngenxa yobukhulu bekhonteyina, ngelixa ibhari enye yeshampu (malunga ne-50g) ihlala ixesha elilinganayo nama-50-80 okuhlamba kwaye inobunzima obuyinxalenye yesihlanu yebhotile yolwelo. Oku kufanelekile kuhambo olude.
c-310.actionItem: Ukuba uhamba namhlanje, pakisha iibhari zeshampu nekhondishina ezomeleleyo kwitin ekhuphela amanzi, kwaye uzomise ngokupheleleyo phambi kokupakisha kunokuzifaka zimanzi. Imithetho ayifani ngenqwelo-moya nelizwe, ngoko khangela phambi kokuhamba.

c-311.title: Khangela Ilebula Yamafutha Ase-Trans Kwibhotolo Nakwi-Margarine
c-311.summary: Ibhotolo ne-margarine zahluke ngohlobo lwamafutha, ngoko thelekisa amafutha agcweleyo ne-trans kwilebula yezondlo. I-margarine ayiyiyo ngokuzenzekelayo engcono okanye embi ngakumbi, kuba iyahluka ngemveliso.
c-311.principle: Ukongeza i-hydrogen kwii-fatty acids ezingagcwaliswanga zeoyile yemifuno kuyayomeleza, kwaye ezinye ii-double bonds ziba yii-trans isomers: $\mathrm{C{=}C}+\mathrm{H_2}\xrightarrow{\mathrm{Ni}}\mathrm{C{-}C}$. Le partial hydrogenation inokwenza amafutha e-trans.
c-311.example: Ibhotolo ineamafutha angama-80% malunga, uninzi lugcweleyo (malunga nama-50%), kunye nesixa esincinci samafutha e-trans endalo. Ii-margarine ezindala ezenziwe ngeoyile ene-partial hydrogenation zazine-trans fat eninzi, kodwa uninzi lweemveliso zangoku zingaphantsi kwe-0.5g ngokuphaka kunye nokuba nesilinganiso esiphantsi samafutha agcweleyo.
c-311.actionItem: Xa uthenga ibhotolo okanye i-margarine namhlanje, thelekisa amafutha agcweleyo ne-trans ngokuphaka ngalinye kwilebula yezondlo kwaye ujonge ukuba izithako ziyidweliswa 'partially hydrogenated oil'.

c-312.title: Funda Okwenziwa Zizithako Zezongezelelo Zamafutha Phambi Kokukholelwa Kwizaziso
c-312.summary: Kwizongezelelo zamafutha, jonga ukuba isithako sisiphi senza ntoni kunokujonga iibango zentengiso. Iidetergent-dispersants zicoca izinto ezidibeneyo kodwa azinikeli isiqinisekiso sokonga kakhulu amafutha.
c-312.principle: Iimolekyuli ze-detergent-dispersant surfactant, ezinamacala amabini ahlukeneyo, zijikeleza izinto ezidibeneyo (ikhabhoni) kwaye zizisasaze kumafutha. Ukonga amafutha kulinganiswa nge-$\eta=\frac{\text{distance}}{\text{fuel}}$, kwaye kwinjini ecocekileyo inzuzo incinci kakhulu.
c-312.example: Iimveliso ezininzi zifuna ii-mL ezimbalwa nge-litre, kodwa inzuzo yokonga amafutha ilinganiswa malunga ne-1-2% kwaye idla ngokulinganiswa. Kwimoto ye-12km/L, i-2% inika i-12.24km/L, kwaye ibhotile ye-additive ye-5,000 KRW (malunga ne-USD 3.50) isenokungabuyiselwa ekonganeni kwamafutha.
c-312.actionItem: Ukuba ucinga ukuthenga i-fuel additive namhlanje, khangela inkcazo yezithako (detergent-dispersant, cetane improver njalo njalo) kunye nohlobo lwamafutha nemoto, uze ubone ukuba inzuzo yokonga eboniswayo ihamba neemeko.

c-313.title: Nikela Izihlangu Zesikhumba Ngekhrimu Endaweni Yokuzipolisha Nje
c-313.summary: Izihlangu zesikhumba zidinga ikhrimu ukuzaliswa kweeoyile, hayi ukucwebezela nje, ukuthintela ukomisa nokuqhekeka. Zihlala ixesha elide, zonga iindleko zezihlangu ezintsha.
c-313.principle: Ii-lipids zizalisa izithuba phakathi kwee-collagen fibres kwaye zigcina isikhumba sithambile. Xa ezi lipids ziphuma okanye zihlanjwa, iifibre ziyakrazulana kwaye isikhumba siyomisa siqhekeke. Ikhrimu iphinda izalise ezo zithuba ngeeoyile namaxolo.
c-313.example: Ukuba isibini sezihlangu zesikhumba sibiza malunga ne-150,000 KRW (malunga ne-USD 105), ukuzinyamekela ngekhrimu kanye ngenyanga kunokolula ubomi bazo ukusuka kwi-2-3 iminyaka ukuya kwi-5 okanye ngaphezulu. Ngonyaka, oko kunqumla indleko zezihlangu phantse kwisiqingatha. Itin enye yekhrimu yezihlangu (malunga ne-5,000 KRW, malunga ne-USD 3.50) igubungela amashumi ezibini.
c-313.actionItem: Namhlanje, sula uthuli lwezihlangu zakho zesikhumba ngendwangu eyomileyo, faka umaleko omncinci wekhrimu yezihlangu, kwaye emva kwemizuzu emi-5 bhrasha ngebhrashi okanye indwangu ethambileyo.

c-314.title: Imifuno Eluhlaza Iba Mthubi Xa Ufaka Iviniga
c-314.summary: Xa uphekela imifuno eluhlaza efana ne-spinach okanye i-broccoli ngokukhawuleza emanzini abilayo, ukongeza i-asidi efana neviniga okanye ijusi yelamuni kuguqula uhlaza oluqaqambileyo lube yi-olivi engenakukhanya. Yongeza i-asidi ekugqibeleni okanye phambi nje kokutya.
c-314.principle: I-$\mathrm{H^+}$ evela kwi-asidi ithatha indawo ye-$\mathrm{Mg^{2+}}$ ephakathi ye-chlorophyll, yenze i-pheophytin: $\text{chlorophyll}+2\,\mathrm{H^+}\to\text{pheophytin}+\mathrm{Mg^{2+}}$. I-pheophytin imthubi-mdaka, ngoko umbala uyaphela.
c-314.example: Ukubilisa i-100g ye-spinach emanzini aneespuni enkulu (15mL) yeviniga kwehlisa i-pH ukusuka kuma-7 malunga ukuya kuma-4, kwaye umbala uqala ukutshintsha ngaphakathi kwemizuzu emi-5. Ngokuchaseneyo, ukuphekela ngokukhawuleza emanzini abilayo anetyuwa encinci kugcina uhlaza ixesha elide.
c-314.actionItem: Ukuba uphekela imifuno eluhlaza namhlanje, yiphekele ingagqunyiwe emanzini abilayo imizuzu eyi-1-2 kuphela, hlamba ngamanzi abandayo, kwaye utshise iviniga okanye ijusi yelamuni phambi nje kokutya.

c-315.title: Sebenzisa I-Retinol Ebusuku Kwaye Unxibe I-Sunscreen Emini
c-315.summary: I-retinol iyaqhekeka ekukhanyeni kwaye inokwenza isikhumba sibe nobuntununtunu ilanga, ngoko yisebenzise ebusuku kwaye unxibe i-sunscreen ngemini. Ukuba ukumitha okanye unesifo sesikhumba, thetha nengcali kuqala.
c-315.principle: I-retinol iyonakala phantsi kwe-UV: $\text{retinol}\xrightarrow{h\nu}\text{degradation products}$. Kwakhona, i-stratum corneum iyancipha kwaye isikhumba esitsha siyavela, ngoko i-UV dose enye inokubangela ububomvu lula.
c-315.example: Kuqhelekile ukuqala nge-retinol strength ephantsi (0.1-0.3%) amaxesha amabini okanye amathathu evekini kwaye usebenzise i-sunscreen ye-SPF 30 okanye ngaphezulu ngemini nge-2mg/cm² malunga. I-SPF 30 ivala malunga nama-97% e-UVB.
c-315.actionItem: Ngobu busuku, sebenzisa i-retinol emva kokuhlamba ubuso bakho, kwaye ngomso ekuseni faka i-sunscreen ye-SPF 30 okanye ngaphezulu. Ukuba ukuxabana okanye ububomvu bunamandla, nciphisa kwaye uthethe nogqirha.

c-316.title: Kutheni Irayisi Ekhawulezileyo Ye-Retort Ihlala Kubushushu Begumbi
c-316.summary: Irayisi ekhawulezileyo ihlala kubushushu begumbi kuba itywiniwe emva koko yenziwa i-sterilization kubushushu nonxinzelelo oluphezulu, ibulala phantse onke amagciwane. Inokugcinwa ngaphandle kwefriji ide ivulwe, yenza ukutya okulungileyo kwexesha lenkxwaleko ngexesha lohambo.
c-316.principle: I-retort sterilization isebenzisa uxinzelelo kwi-120°C malunga ukubulala nee-spores zebhaktheriya ezixhathisa ubushushu. Ixesha le-sterilization libalwa nge-$F=D_T\,\log\frac{N_0}{N}$, kwaye isitywina esingenaoksijini sivimba ukukhula kwebhaktheriya ye-aerobic.
c-316.example: Iphakethe elinye lerayisi ekhawulezileyo (210g) liyahlanjululwa kwi-120°C malunga nemizuzu engama-20-30 kwaye ihlala imiyinga eyi-6-12 kubushushu begumbi. Inokuhlala ngaphandle kwefriji phambi kokuvulwa, kodwa emva kokuvula kufuneka itye ngoko nangoko okanye igcinwe efrijini.
c-316.actionItem: Xa upakisha iibhegi zohambo namhlanje, quka irayisi ekhawulezileyo njengokutya kwexesha lenkxwaleko, kwaye ulahle nawaphi na amaphakethe anesigqubuthelo esiqumbileyo okanye ukuvuza. Fudumeza kwi-microwave njengoko kuqondiswe kwikhonteyina.

c-317.title: Izithako Zeswekile Ezifana Ne-Allulose Ne-Erythritol Ngasinye Sihluke Ngokuthamisa Neempawu
c-317.summary: Izithako ezifana ne-allulose, i-erythritol ne-xylitol zahluke ngokumnandi, iikhalori nempembelelo yokugaya, ngoko khetha ngokusetyenziswa. Ukugqithisa kunokubangela ukuphazamiseka kwesisu, ngoko qala kancinci.
c-317.principle: Iziselo zeswekile ezinxilisayo kunye needlala ezinqabileyo zahluke ngolwakhiwo lwemolekyuli, ngoko ukufunxwa nezicalori ziyahluka. I-Erythritol ($\mathrm{C_4H_{10}O_4}$), umzekelo, ifunxwa kakhulu kwaye ikhutshwa kwinyongo, inika iikhalori ezisondele kwi-zero, kwaye ifunxa ubushushu xa inyibilika ($\Delta H_{\mathrm{sol}}>0$), idala ukuvakalelwa kokupholisa.
c-317.example: Iswekile inee-kcal ezi-4 malunga nge-gram nganye, ngelixa i-erythritol ineyi-0-0.2kcal/g kunye ne-allulose malunga ne-0.4kcal/g. Ngeswekile njenge-1, ukumnandi kuyi-0.7 malunga kwazo zombini i-erythritol ne-allulose. Izixa kufuneka zilungiswe xa kuthathelwa indawo iswekile.
c-317.actionItem: Xa uthenga isithako seswekile namhlanje, khangela uhlobo (allulose, erythritol njalo njalo) neekhalori ngokuphaka ngalinye kwilebula, kwaye uqale ngeg-10g ngosuku ukubona indlela umzimba wakho owenza ngayo.

c-318.title: Amanzi Amnyama Kumapayipi Okufudumeza Yi-Sludge Evela Kwintsimbi Eyi-Oxidized
c-318.summary: Ukuba amanzi akhutshwe kumapayipi okufudumeza amnyama, anokuba yi-sludge (magnetite) evela kwintsimbi eyi-oxidized, kwaye njengoko iqokelela, ukudlula kobushushu kuyaphuphuma. Cinga ngokuhlamba nguchwephesha we-boiler kunye nokukhangela i-corrosion inhibitor.
c-318.principle: Emanzini ashushu angenaoksijini phantse, intsimbi ihlala i-oxidize kancinci: $3\,\mathrm{Fe}+4\,\mathrm{H_2O}\to\mathrm{Fe_3O_4}+4\,\mathrm{H_2}$. I-magnetite ($\mathrm{Fe_3O_4}$) eyenziwayo yimpuphu emnyama eqokelelayo kwaye ikhulisa ukuxhathisa kobushushu.
c-318.example: Umaleko we-sludge we-1mm emapayipini nakwii-radiators unokunciphisa ukudlula kobushushu ngeepesenti ezimbalwa, wenze i-boiler isebenze ixesha elide kwaye inyuse iindleko zamafutha malunga nama-5-10%. Ukuhlamba ngokuqhelekileyo kubiza amakhulu amaninzi amawaka e-KRW (amakhulu ambalwa e-USD), kodwa ukonga kunye nobomi obude bezixhobo kunokuyibuyisa.
c-318.actionItem: Namhlanje, khangela ukuba amapayipi akho okufudumeza ahlanjwe nini ngokugqibela, kwaye ukuba kudlule iminyaka emininzi, cela uvavanyo kuchwephesha we-boiler. Ungazihlanjululi amapayipi okanye ungachukumisi amanzi akhutshiweyo wena.

c-319.title: I-Freezer Burn Yindawo Apho Ukufuma Kushiye Umphezulu Ovezwe Kumoya
c-319.summary: Iindawo ezimhlophe, ezomileyo kwinyama okanye imifuno egciniwe ixesha elide efrizeni yi-freezer burn. Ayiyingozi ukuyitya kodwa inzima kwaye ilahlekelwa yincasa, kwaye ukucinezela umoya ngaphandle nokutywina kuyayithintela.
c-319.principle: Efrizeni, umkhenkce osemphezulu uyabila ube ngumphunga ngokuthe ngqo ngaphandle kokudlula ekuwoluweni, ngoko ukufuma kuyahamba: $\mathrm{H_2O(s)}\to\mathrm{H_2O(g)}$. Umphezulu owomileyo udibana nomoya, ngoko amafutha ayi-oxidize anike iincasa ezingafunekiyo.
c-319.example: Inyama engagoqwanga kwifriji ye--18°C ilahlekelwa ziipesenti ezimbalwa zokufuma okusemphezulu ngaphakathi kweeveki kwaye ome mhlophe. Ukucinezela umoya ngaphandle nge-vacuum okanye iibhegi ze-zip kugcina umgangatho iinyanga ezi-3-6 okanye ngaphezulu kwaye kunciphisa ukutya okulahliweyo (amawaka ambalwa e-KRW ngenyanga okanye ngaphezulu).
c-319.actionItem: Namhlanje, pakisha inyama nemifuno efrizeni ngeendawo ezinye kwiibhegi ze-zip, cinezela umoya ongaphandle kangangoko, tywina kwaye ubhale umhla. Kwiindawo ezisele zine-freezer burn, zinqumle okanye uzisebenzise kwiisuphu nasezitshiwini.

c-320.title: Nyibilikisa Impuphu Yekhari Nesosi Kuqala Emanzini Abandayo Ukuphepha Izithsaba
c-320.summary: Ukongeza impuphu yekhari okanye yesosi ngqo kulwelo olushushu kuphekela ngaphandle kuphela kwaye kwenza izithsaba. Yinyibilikise kuqala emanzini abandayo okanye afudumeleyo, okanye vala ubushushu uze uyixube kancinci.
c-320.principle: Xa iigranule zesitatshi zidibana namanzi ashushu, umphezulu wazo uba yi-gel kuqala yenze ifilimu ye-gel ncangathi evimba amanzi ukuba afikelele kwimpuphu engaphakathi. I-gelatinization iqala malunga ne-60-70°C kwaye yenzeka kuqala kumphezulu apho $T>T_{\mathrm{gel}}$.
c-320.example: Ukugalela i-100g yempuphu yekhari kumhluzi we-90°C kwenza izithsaba zeemilimitha ezimbalwa njengoko umphezulu uba yi-gel, kodwa ukuyinyibilikisa kuqala kwi-200mL yamanzi e-20-30°C kusasaza amasuntswana ngokulinganayo phantse ngaphandle kwezithsaba.
c-320.actionItem: Ukuba wenza ikhari okanye isosi namhlanje, nyibilikisa impuphu emanzini abandayo kuqala uze uyihluze, okanye vala ubushushu uyongeze kancinci ngelixa uxuba, uze uyibuyisele kwisimmer ethambileyo.

c-321.title: Ii-exfoliant ze-AHA ne-BHA zixhomekeke kwi-pH nakukuxinana
c-321.summary: Oko kugqiba iziphumo nokucaphukisa yi-pH yemveliso kunye nokuxinana kwe-asidi, hayi igama lesithako nje. Nokuba i-asidi ethambileyo inokuluma ukuba i-pH iphantsi.
c-321.principle: Ii-asidi ziyi-ionize ngokwe-$\mathrm{pH} = \mathrm{p}K_a + \log\frac{[\mathrm{A^-}]}{[\mathrm{HA}]}$, kwaye yi-asidi ekhululekileyo engenayo i-ionize ($\mathrm{HA}$) kuphela esebenza kwisikhumba. Ukuphantsi kwe-pH ngaphantsi kwe-$\mathrm{p}K_a$, kokukhula kwesabelo se-asidi ekhululekileyo.
c-321.example: Imveliso ye-glycolic acid ye-10% ($\mathrm{p}K_a$ malunga ne-3.83) yi-50% yi-asidi ekhululekileyo kwi-pH 3.83 kodwa malunga ne-87% kwi-pH 3.0, ngoko icaphukisa ngakumbi. I-Salicylic acid ($\mathrm{p}K_a$ malunga ne-2.97) ihlala yenziwa kufutshane ne-pH 3-4.
c-321.actionItem: Ukuba usebenzisa i-exfoliant namhlanje, khangela uhlobo lwe-asidi, ukuxinana kunye ne-pH, qala ngamaxesha ama-2 evekini okanye ngaphantsi, kwaye usebenzise i-sunscreen ngosuku olulandelayo.

c-322.title: I-durian ayivumelekanga kuninzi lweehotele ngenxa yevumba layo
c-322.summary: I-durian ayivumelekanga kwiihotele nakwezothutho kungekhona kuba inetyhefu, kodwa kuba ivumba layo likhulu kakhulu nakwizixa ezincinci.
c-322.principle: Ii-ester ($\mathrm{RCOOH + R'OH \rightleftharpoons RCOOR' + H_2O}$) kunye nezinto zesulfure (ii-thiol, $\mathrm{R{-}SH}$) zine-odor thresholds kuluhlu lwe-ppb, ngoko izixa ezincinci ziyabonwa.
c-322.example: I-1ppb yinxalenye enye kwibhiliyoni ngomthamo, olingana nje malunga ne-0.03mL yomphunga kwigumbi le-30m³. Yiyo loo nto ivumba lihlala kwigumbi lonke nakwisihluzo se-AC.
c-322.actionItem: Phambi kohambo lwaseMzantsi-mpuma Asia, khangela umthetho we-durian wendawo yokuhlala, kwaye utye i-durian evenkileni okanye ngaphandle.

c-323.title: Izithako ze-moisturizer zenza imisebenzi eyahlukileyo: i-ceramides, i-glycerin, ioyile
c-323.summary: I-moisturizer elungileyo idibanisa isithako esitsala amanzi, esizalisa izithuba, kunye nesithintela ukuphuma komphunga.
c-323.principle: Ii-humectants (glycerin) zitsala amanzi, ii-emollients (ceramides) zizalisa izithuba phakathi kweeseli zesikhumba, kwaye ii-occlusives (petrolatum) zithintela ukuphuma komphunga. Intshukumo yamanzi ilandela $J = -D\frac{\Delta C}{\Delta x}$.
c-323.example: I-glycerin ihlala isetyenziswa kwi-5-10%, kwaye i-petrolatum yaziwa ukunciphisa ukulahleka kwamanzi ngesikhumba ngaphezulu kwama-90%. Imveliso enazo zontathu ihlala ixesha elide emoyeni owomileyo wasebusika kunophawu olunye.
c-323.actionItem: Namhlanje, khangela uluhlu lwezithako ukufumana i-glycerin, i-ceramides neoyile okanye i-petrolatum, kwaye uyisebenzise ngaphakathi kwemizuzu emi-3 emva kokuhlamba.

c-324.title: Khangela itshimini yakho yeziko okanye isitovu ukufumana i-creosote rhoqo ngonyaka
c-324.summary: I-tar evela kumsi wamaplanga idibana kumadonga etshimini, kwaye ukuqokelela kunokubangela umlilo wetshimini, ngoko khangela rhoqo ngonyaka.
c-324.principle: Imiphunga ye-tar nomsizi ovela ekutsheni ngokungapheleleyo idibana kumadonga etshimini abandayo njenge-creosote. Ukutsha ngokunqongophala koksijini, $\mathrm{C_xH_y + O_2 \to C + CO + H_2O}$, kuvelisa okungakumbi okungatshanga.
c-324.example: I-NFPA 211 e-US icebisa ukucoca xa izinto eziqokelelweyo zifikelela kuma-3mm malunga (1/8 intshi). Amaplanga amanzi angaphezu kwe-20% yomswakama anciphisa ubushushu bokutsha kwaye akhawulezise ukuqokelela.
c-324.actionItem: Namhlanje, khangela ukuba iinkuni zakho ziyomisiwe kwi-20% yomswakama okanye ngaphantsi, kwaye ubhukishe uvavanyo nokucoca itshimini ngochwephesha.

c-325.title: Ibhotolo ifunxa iivumba xa igcinwe ecaleni kokutya okunevumba elinamandla
c-325.summary: Ibhotolo yamafutha angama-80% malunga, enyibilikisa kwaye ifunxe iimolekyuli zevumba ezivela kokutya okufana ne-kimchi okanye intlanzi.
c-325.principle: Amafutha ayi-nonpolar, ngoko anyibilikisa iimolekyuli ezingabhoyi ezithwala iivumba. I-partition coefficient yi-$K = \frac{C_{\mathrm{fat}}}{C_{\mathrm{water}}}$, kwaye i-$\log K = 3$ ithetha ukuxinana okuphezulu amaxesha ayi-1,000 kumafutha.
c-325.example: Ibhloko yebhotolo ye-200g iqulathe malunga ne-160g yamafutha. Ishiywe ingagqunyiwe ecaleni kwe-kimchi iintsuku ezimbalwa, ithatha ivumba kwaye isenokuphela ilahliwe.
c-325.actionItem: Namhlanje, faka ibhotolo yakho kwi-wrapper yayo ngaphakathi kwekhonteyina etywiniweyo kwaye uyigcine kude nokutya okunevumba elinamandla.

c-326.title: Kutheni iiglasi zibe mafu kwi-dishwasher
c-326.summary: Ukuba mafu kunokuba yifilimu yeminerali okanye ukukrazula kokwenene komphezulu weglasi. Ukumbiwa kweviniga kukuxelela ukuba yeyiphi.
c-326.principle: Amanzi athambileyo kunye ne-detergent ene-alkaline kubushushu obuphezulu kunyibilikisa uthungelwano lwe-silicate lweglasi kwaye kukrazula umphezulu. $\mathrm{SiO_2 + 2OH^- \to SiO_3^{2-} + H_2O}$
c-326.example: Ukukrazula kusisigxina, kodwa ifilimu ye-lime yamanzi anzima iyanyamalala emva kwemizuzu emi-5 kwiviniga emhlophe. Ukusebenzisa i-detergent encinci kunye nomjikelo we-eco malunga ne-55°C kunciphisa ukukrazula.
c-326.actionItem: Namhlanje, ntywilisa iglasi eyimafu kwiviniga emhlophe imizuzu emi-5 ukubona ukuba yifilimu, kwaye usebenzise kuphela isixa se-detergent esicetyiswayo.

c-327.title: Tshintsha i-mascara rhoqo emva kweenyanga ezi-3 ukuya kwezi-6
c-327.summary: I-mascara iya ecaleni ngqo kwamehlo kwaye ifumana umoya ukhuthazwa kwisetyenziso ngasinye, ngoko ibhaktheriya iyaqokelela; yitshintshe ngaphakathi kweenyanga ezi-3-6 zokuvulwa.
c-327.principle: Emva kokuvulwa, i-preservative ityiwa ngokuthe ngcembe kwaye ibhaktheriya ikhula njenge-$N = N_0\,2^{t/t_d}$. Ixesha ngalinye i-wand ingena iphuma ityhala umoya ngaphakathi, ibangela ukomisa nokungcola.
c-327.example: Phantsi kweemeko ezifanelekileyo ezinexesha lokuphindwa kabini lemizuzu engama-20, iseli enye iba yi-$2^{18}$, malunga ne-262,000, kwiiyure ezi-6. Ukuba unamehlo anokuhlohla okanye abomvu, thandabuza kuqala i-mascara endala.
c-327.actionItem: Namhlanje, bhala umhla wokuvula kwityhubhu yakho ye-mascara, uyitshintshe ngentsha ukuba indala kuneenyanga ezi-3.

c-328.title: Irayisi phesheya inencasa eyahlukileyo ngenxa yomxholo wayo we-amylose
c-328.summary: Irayisi phesheya inokuba nomgubo ohlukeneyo okanye ube ncangathi kuba umlinganiselo we-amylose ukuya kwi-amylopectin uyahluka.
c-328.principle: I-amylose engakumbi (elineer) igcina iinkozo zihlukene kwaye ziqinile, ngelixa i-amylopectin engakumbi (ebhulanchi) yenza irayisi ibe ncangathi. $\text{amylose \%} = \frac{m_{\mathrm{amylose}}}{m_{\mathrm{amylose}}+m_{\mathrm{amylopectin}}}\times 100$
c-328.example: Irayisi yenkozo emfutshane yaseKorea neJapan ineamylose malunga nama-17-20%, i-indica yenkozo ende malunga nama-22-28%, kwaye irayisi enamathelayo phantse ngama-0%. Irayisi yenkozo ende idla ngokufuna amaxesha angama-1.5-2 omthamo wayo wamanzi.
c-328.actionItem: Namhlanje, khangela ukuba ipakethe yakho yerayisi isithi inkozo emfutshane, ephakathi okanye ende, uze uyipheke ngomlinganiselo wamanzi obhaliweyo kwipakethe.

c-329.title: Khangela i-mouthwash ngeefomula ezingenayo-alkoholi kunye ne-CPC
c-329.summary: Khetha i-mouthwash ngesithako sayo esichasene nebhaktheriya (CPC) nokuba inayo i-alkoholi, enokomisa umlomo wakho.
c-329.principle: I-CPC (cetylpyridinium chloride) yi-cationic surfactant enamathela kwiimembrane zebhaktheriya ezintlawulo engalunganga kwaye ziyaphazamisa. Ukutsalana kulandela $F = k\frac{q_1 q_2}{r^2}$.
c-329.example: Iimveliso ze-CPC zihlala zingama-0.05-0.07%, ngoko i-rinse enye ye-20mL iqulathe malunga nama-10-14mg. Ezinye iimveliso ziqulathe i-ethanol engama-20% okanye ngaphezulu, ngoko abantu abatyekele ekomiseni umlomo banokukhetha engenayo i-alkoholi.
c-329.actionItem: Namhlanje, khangela ilebula ye-CPC ne-ethanol, emva koko hlamba imizuzwana engama-30 uze uyiphose kunokuyiginya.

c-330.title: Ivumba le-caulk yefestile yi-acetic acid ekhutshwa ngexesha lokuqina
c-330.summary: Ivumba leviniga le-caulk yi-acetic acid ekhutshwa njengoko i-silicone iqina, kwaye iyaphela xa ukuqina kugqityiwe.
c-330.principle: I-silicone ye-Acetoxy isabela nomswakama emoyeni, ikhulula i-acetic acid njengoko iqinisa. $\mathrm{R{-}Si(OCOCH_3)_3 + 3H_2O \to R{-}Si(OH)_3 + 3CH_3COOH}$
c-330.example: Umphezulu uthatha ulusu malunga nemizuzu eyi-10-30, kwaye i-bead ye-3mm ithatha malunga neeyure ezingama-24 ukuqina ngokupheleleyo. I-acetic acid inokonakalisa isinyithi ne-marble, ngoko sebenzisa i-neutral-cure silicone kuzo.
c-330.actionItem: Ukuba usebenzisa i-caulk namhlanje, gcina ifestile ivuliwe ukuvuthuza iiyure ezingama-24, kwaye ukhethe i-neutral-cure silicone kwisinyithi okanye ilitye.

c-331.title: Ioyile ye-olive eba mafu kwaye iqina efrijini ayonakalanga
c-331.summary: Ioyile ye-olive eba mafu kwaye iqina efrijini ayonakalanga; amafutha ayo ayi-crystallize, kwaye iyacaca kwakhona kubushushu begumbi.
c-331.principle: Nee-fatty acids ezingagcwaliswanga ziyi-crystallize ngaphantsi kwendawo yazo yokunyibilika. Ubushushu bokunyibilika bulandela $T_m = \frac{\Delta H}{\Delta S}$, kwaye ioyile ye-olive iqala ukuba mafu ngaphantsi kwe-5-10°C malunga.
c-331.example: Kwi-4°C efrijini iba mafu, kodwa imizuzu engama-30-60 kwi-20-25°C iyicacisa. Ngokwe-oxidation, indawo emnyama, ebandayo yobushushu begumbi ingcono kunefriji.
c-331.actionItem: Namhlanje, vumela ioyile ye-olive eyimafu ihlale kubushushu begumbi imizuzu engama-30 endaweni yokuyifudumeza kwi-microwave, kwaye uyigcine kwikhabhathi emnyama ukusuka ngoku.

c-332.title: Yenza i-caramel ngokunyibilikisa iswekile ngaphandle kokuxuba
c-332.summary: Uphepha ukuxuba xa wenza i-caramel ukuthintela iikristale zeswekile ukuba zibuye zenziwe kwimpendulo yekhonkco.
c-332.principle: Ikristale enye yeswekile ephaphazelayo inokuqala ukukristalayiza yonke isiraphu. Ngaphezulu kwe-160°C, i-hydrolysis ne-dehydration zibangela ukubomvu. $\mathrm{C_{12}H_{22}O_{11} + H_2O \to C_6H_{12}O_6 + C_6H_{12}O_6}$
c-332.example: Ukubilisa i-200g yeswekile kunye ne-50mL yamanzi kufikelela kwi-caramel enegolide kwi-170-180°C malunga emva kwemizuzu emi-5-10. I-caramel kubushushu obo inokubangela ukutsha okukhulu ukuba iyatshaza.
c-332.actionItem: Ukuba wenza i-caramel namhlanje, jikeleza ipani endaweni yokuxuba kwaye ugqabhuze iikristale kudonga lembiza ngebhrashi emanzi.

c-333.title: Isikhumba esibomvu phantsi kwemihombiso yesinyithi sisenokuba yi-nickel allergy
c-333.summary: Ukuba isikhumba siba bomvu kwaye siyadumba phantsi kweehlombe okanye isiqhekeza sewotshi, i-nickel esinyithini isenokuba yimbangela. Ugqirha wesikhumba unokuyiqinisekisa.
c-333.principle: I-nickel esinyithini iyi-oxidize ngenxa yomgudu kwaye inyibilike njenge-ion. $\mathrm{Ni \to Ni^{2+} + 2e^-}$ Ezi ion zinokubophelela iiprotheni zesikhumba kwaye zibangele i-contact dermatitis.
c-333.example: I-EU inciphisa ukukhutshwa kwe-nickel kwizinto ezichukumisa isikhumba ixesha elide ukuya kwi-$0.5\ \mu\mathrm{g/cm^2}$ ngeveki. Malunga nomntu ofanayo kwabalishumi kuxelwa ukuba uyaphendula kwi-nickel.
c-333.actionItem: Namhlanje, khangela ilebula ye-nickel-free kuyo nayiphi na imihombiso eqhubeka nokuyadumba, kwaye ubone ugqirha wesikhumba ukuba iimpawu ziyaqhubeka.

c-334.title: Ubukhali be-wasabi buvela kuphela xa ixutywa kwaye buyaphela ngokukhawuleza
c-334.summary: Ubukhali be-wasabi yokwenyani benziwa xa iiseli zayo zityunyuzwa ekubhutheni, kwaye bunobuthuthuzela, ngoko buphela ngokukhawuleza.
c-334.principle: Xa iiseli ziqhekeka, i-enzyme myrosinase yahlula i-glycoside sinigrin ibe yi-allyl isothiocyanate ebukhali. $\mathrm{C_{10}H_{16}KNO_9S_2 + H_2O \to C_4H_5NS + C_6H_{12}O_6 + KHSO_4}$
c-334.example: Ubukhali buyinkulu kwimizuzu emva kokuxutywa kwaye buyehla kakhulu kwimizuzu eyi-15-30. Iimveliso ezininzi ze-wasabi zetyhubhu zikakhulu yi-horseradish.
c-334.actionItem: Ukuba usebenzisa i-wasabi entsha namhlanje, yixube phambi nje kokutya kwaye uyigcine igqunyiwe, kwaye ukhangele izithako kwimveliso zetyhubhu.

c-335.title: Ukunyuka kwe-foam yesepha yezitya akuthethi ukucoca okungcono
c-335.summary: Ifowuni eninzi nokususa kakuhle amafutha zinto ezahlukeneyo; ifowuni inokuvela kwi-stabilizers.
c-335.principle: Ii-surfactants zenza ii-micelles ngaphezu kwe-critical micelle concentration (CMC) kwaye zigoqa amafutha. Uxinzelelo lomphezulu luyehla ukuya kwi-CMC kwaye luhlala phantse lungatshintshi emva koko.
c-335.example: I-CMC ye-SDS yi-8.2 mM malunga, okanye malunga nama-2.4g ngelitha. Ukongeza isepha engakumbi ngaphaya koko akunyusi kakhulu ukucoca kwaye kwenza ukuhlambulula kube nzima.
c-335.actionItem: Namhlanje, sebenzisa kuphela isixa sobungakanani bepea sesepha yezitya uze ugwebe ngokuba amafutha asusiwe, hayi ngobungakanani befowuni.

c-336.title: Iimpahla zangaphantsi ezivelisa ubushushu zifudumeza ngokufunxa umphunga womgudu
c-336.summary: Iimpahla zangaphantsi ezivelisa ubushushu zivakala zifudumele kuba umphunga wamanzi ovela emzimbeni wakho ukhulula ubushushu xa unamathela kwiifibre; umphumo uphakathi kwaye mfutshane.
c-336.principle: Xa umphunga wamanzi unamathela kwiifibre, ubushushu buyakhululwa kakhulu njengokuhambelana. $Q = m\,L$, kwaye ubushushu bokuhambelana bamanzi $L$ bungama-$2.26\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$ malunga.
c-336.example: Ukufunxa i-10g yokufuma kukhulula ukuya kuma-23kJ malunga, kodwa kuyayeka xa iifibre zizalisekile. Ukuba uthuka kakhulu kwaye indwangu ibe manzi, itsala ubushushu kude kwaye uvakalelwa ngumqando ngakumbi.
c-336.actionItem: Namhlanje, nxiba umaleko omncinci phezu kweempahla zangaphantsi ezifudumeza, kwaye ususe umaleko xa uqala ukuthuka ukuze indwangu ihlale yomile.

c-337.title: Susa iilebula neesigqubuthelo kwiibhotile ze-PET ukuze zisetyenziswe kwakhona
c-337.summary: Iibhotile ze-PET ziba ngumthombo olungileyo wokuphinda usetyenziswe kuphela ukuba ususa ilebula kwaye uzihlambulule, ukuze zingaxutywa nezinye iiplastiki.
c-337.principle: Ukusetyenziswa kwakhona kwahlula i-PET entywilayo kwi-PP ne-PE ebhabhayo ngoxinano, $\rho = \frac{m}{V}$, emva koko iyanyibilikisa. I-PET inyibilika kufuphi nama-250°C, i-PP kufuphi nama-165°C kunye ne-PE malunga nama-110-130°C.
c-337.example: I-PET inoxinano lwe-1.38g/cm³ malunga ngelixa i-PP ne-PE zimalunga nama-0.9g/cm³, ngoko zahlulahlulwa emanzini. Ukuba isigqubuthelo se-2g sixutywe nebhotile ye-20g, ukungcola kufikelela kuma-10% malunga.
c-337.actionItem: Namhlanje, khupha uze uhlambulule ibhotile yakho ye-PET, ncothula ilebula, uze uyifake kwibhinti yokuqokelela i-PET ecacileyo.

c-338.title: I-meringue ayibethwa nokuba ne-drop yamafutha
c-338.summary: Esona sizathu sixhaphakileyo sokuba i-meringue ingavuleki kukuba nethrayisi yamafutha kwibhawula okanye kumhlophe.
c-338.principle: Iiprotheni zomhlophe weqanda ziyavuleka kumda womoya namanzi kwaye zenza ifilimu ejonge amaqamza. Amafutha athatha loo ndawo kuqala kwaye avale ukwenziwa kwefilimu. Umahluko woxinzelelo kwifilimu yebhamba yi-$\Delta P = \frac{4\gamma}{r}$.
c-338.example: Abamhlophe abathathu beqanda (malunga ne-100g) yinxalenye ye-90% yamanzi ne-10% yeprotheni, ngelixa i-yolk ineamafutha angama-30% malunga, ngoko nedrop enye inciphisa kakhulu umthamo. Iibhawuli zeplastiki zihlala zinezakhelo zeoyile.
c-338.actionItem: Ukuba wenza i-meringue namhlanje, sula ibhawuli yeglasi okanye yentsimbi ngeviniga okanye ijusi yelamuni uze wahlule umhlophe ngamnye kwibhawuli encinci kuqala.

c-339.title: Yenza uvavanyo lwe-patch iintsuku ezimbini phambi kokugquma iinwele ezimhlophe
c-339.summary: Ukungavumelani nedayi yeenwele kunokuvela ngequbuliso, ngoko yenza i-patch test emva kwendlebe okanye ngaphakathi engalweni iiyure ezingama-48 phambi kokudaya.
c-339.principle: Iidayi ze-oxidative ezifana ne-para-phenylenediamine (PPD) zenza i-reactive intermediates nge-hydrogen peroxide ebophelela iiprotheni zesikhumba kwaye inokubangela ukungavumelani. $\mathrm{C_6H_4(NH_2)_2 \xrightarrow{H_2O_2} \text{reactive intermediates}}$
c-339.example: I-EU inciphisa i-PPD entloko ukuya kwi-2% emva kokuxuba. Faka isixa esincinci esingaphezulu kwengqekembe kwaye ubukele iiyure ezingama-48; ukuba kukho ububomvu, ukuyadumba okanye ukudumba, ungadayi.
c-339.actionItem: Ukuba ucwangcisela ukudaya kungekudala, yenza i-patch test iintsuku ezimbini ngaphambili ngesixa esincinci emva kwendlebe, kwaye ungadayi ukuba kuvela nayiphi na impendulo, ufune unyango ukuba inzima.

c-340.title: I-proof kwibhotile yotywala yaphesheya yiphindwe kabini ye-ABV
c-340.summary: Kwiibhotile zase-US, i-proof iphindwe kabini ukuba yialkholi ngomthamo (ABV), ngoko i-80 proof ithetha i-40%.
c-340.principle: Inkqubo ye-US yi-$\text{proof} = 2 \times \text{ABV}$. I-proof endala yase-Britani yayisebenzisa isiseko esahlukileyo, apho i-100 proof yayiyi-57.15% malunga, ngoko khangela ngelizwe.
c-340.example: Ukuthululwa kwe-45mL (1.5 oz) ye-whiskey ye-80 proof iqulathe i-$45 \times 0.40 = 18\ \mathrm{mL}$ ye-ethanol, malunga ne-14.2g, eyidrinki enye esemgangathweni yase-US. Ukuthululwa okufanayo kwi-100 proof (50%) kuqulathe malunga ne-17.8g.
c-340.actionItem: Namhlanje, yahlula i-proof yebhotile yaphesheya nayiphi ngo-2 ukufumana i-ABV, kwaye ulandele ukuba usela kangakanani.

c-341.title: Izihluzi zamanzi: ikhabhoni esebenzayo ne-reverse osmosis zisusa izinto ezahlukeneyo
c-341.summary: Ikhabhoni esebenzayo ikakhulu isusa izinto eziphilayo ezifana ne-chlorine nevumba, ngelixa i-reverse osmosis ikakhulu isusa ii-ion ezinyibilikileyo. Gqiba ukuba ufuna ukususa ntoni phambi kokuthenga.
c-341.principle: Ikhabhoni ifunxa kumphezulu wayo, ngelixa i-reverse osmosis isebenzisa uxinzelelo olungaphezu koxinzelelo lwe-osmotic $\pi = iMRT$ ukuze kudlule amanzi kuphela kwimembrane ewudlulisayo kancinci.
c-341.example: Uxinzelelo lwe-osmotic lwe-500mg/L NaCl (malunga ne-8.6 mmol/L) kwi-25°C lungama-0.42atm malunga. Iiyunithi ze-RO zasekhaya zihlala zisebenzisa i-3-4bar kwaye zisusa uninzi lweeion.
c-341.actionItem: Namhlanje, khangela ukuba isihluzo samanzi sakho sifuneka ukuba sitshintshwe nini, kwaye uqinisekise iibango zaso ngophawu lwesatifikethi esisemthethweni.

c-342.title: I-mantles ze-lantern yenkampu zikhanya ngenxa ye-rare-earth oxides
c-342.summary: Ukukhanya okukhulu kwe-lantern yegesi akulilangatye kodwa yi-rare-earth oxide mantle efudunyezwe lilo.
c-342.principle: Xa i-oxide mantle ifudunyezwa ukuya kuma-2,000K malunga, ikhupha ngamandla ngokubheka kwimiqulu yamaza abonakalayo. Ubude bamaza obuphezulu bulandela $\lambda_{\max} T = 2898\ \mu\mathrm{m\cdot K}$.
c-342.example: Kwi-2,000K, i-$\lambda_{\max}$ yi-1.45μm malunga. Ii-mantles ze-yttrium ne-cerium zikhupha ukukhanya okubonakalayo okungakumbi kakhulu kunelangatye elingenanto ngamafutha afanayo. Ii-mantles ezindala zazisebenzisa i-thorium oxide enemitha.
c-342.actionItem: Namhlanje, tshisa i-mantle entsha ngaphandle kokuqala kwayo kokusetyenziswa, ungachukumisi uthuthu, kwaye ujonge ilebula ye-thorium-free.

c-343.title: Iikomityi zephepha azisetyenziswa kwakhona njengephepha eliqhelekileyo ngenxa ye-polyethylene lining yazo
c-343.summary: Iikomityi zephepha zinefilimu yeplastiki yokuthintela amanzi, ngoko ukuzifaka kwibhinti yephepha eliqhelekileyo kwenza ukusetyenziswa kwakhona kube nzima.
c-343.principle: I-polyethylene (PE) engaphakathi kwekomityi yephepha ayinyibiliki emanzini kwaye ibhabha kwi-$\rho \approx 0.92\ \mathrm{g/cm^3}$, ngoko kunzima ukuyahlula kwifibre ngexesha le-pulping.
c-343.example: Ikomityi enye yephepha inobunzima be-10g malunga kwaye i-PE coating yi-5% malunga yoko. Ngaphandle kwenkqubo ezinikele, loo coating inokonakalisa umgangatho wesixa sonke sephepha.
c-343.actionItem: Namhlanje, zisa i-tumbler yakho, kwaye ukuba usebenzisa ikomityi yephepha, khangela umthetho wakho wendawo wokuhlela uze uyiqokelele ngokwahlukeneyo.

c-344.title: I-cream ibetha iqine kuphela xa ibandayo
c-344.summary: I-cream ibetha ibe zincopho eziqinileyo kuphela xa ibanda kakhulu; i-cream efudumeleyo ayiyi kuvuleka kungakhathaliseki ixesha olibethayo.
c-344.principle: Xa ibanda, amafutha angaphakathi kwamaglobhyuli ayi-crystallized, ngoko ukubetha kwenza amaglobhyuli adibane ngokuyinxalenye abe luthungelwano luthinta amaqamza omoya. Amafutha enyibilikileyo awakwazi ukwakha olo thungelwano.
c-344.example: Ukubetha i-200mL ye-cream enamafutha angama-35% okanye ngaphezulu kwi-4°C kunqumla umthamo kwimizuzu emi-3-5 malunga. Ngaphezulu kwe-20°C phantse ayivuleki, kwaye ukubetha ngokugqithisileyo kuyihlula ibe yibhotolo ne-buttermilk.
c-344.actionItem: Namhlanje, bandisa i-cream nebhawuli imizuzu eyi-10+ phambi kokubetha, kwaye yeka kamsinya nje ukuba kwenziwe izincopho eziqinileyo.

c-345.title: Ungayibambi i-peroxide ye-toothpaste yokumhlophisa emlonyeni ixesha elide
c-345.summary: I-peroxide kwi-toothpaste yokumhlophisa okanye kwiistrips inokucaphukisa amaqhekeza, ngoko yisebenzise kuphela ixesha elichaziweyo.
c-345.principle: I-hydrogen peroxide i-oxidize kwaye ityhale iimolekyuli zesidoda ngelixa ikhulula i-oksijini. $2\mathrm{H_2O_2} \to 2\mathrm{H_2O} + \mathrm{O_2}$ Loo mpendulo ifanayo inokucaphukisa iimembrane ze-mucous.
c-345.example: I-EU inciphisa i-hydrogen peroxide kwi-toothpaste eqhelekileyo ukuya kwi-0.1% kwaye ifuna ukongamelwa ngugqirha wamazinyo kwiimveliso zokumhlophisa ze-0.1-6%. Ukuyibamba ixesha elide kunokuchazwa kunyusa ukucaphuka kwamaqhekeza nokuvakala.
c-345.actionItem: Namhlanje, sebenzisa nayiphi na imveliso yokumhlophisa kuphela ixesha elisemgangathweni, kwaye yeka uze ubonane nogqirha wamazinyo ukuba amaqhekeza akho aluma.

c-346.title: Ungasiseli ikhephu elinyibilikisiweyo ngaphandle kokulinyanga
c-346.summary: Ikhephu libonakala licocekile kodwa liqokelela abangcolisi bomoya neentsholongwane, ngoko ikhephu elinyibilikisiweyo kufuneka libiliswe phambi kokusela.
c-346.principle: Iikristale zekhephu zibamba uthuli namasuntswana amancinci njengoko zenziwa kwaye ziwa. Ukubilisa kubulala iintsholongwane kodwa akususi izinsimbi ezinzima okanye iikhemikhali. Isivuno samanzi sixhomekeke koxinano lwekhephu, $V_{\mathrm{water}} \approx \frac{V_{\mathrm{snow}}}{10}$.
c-346.example: Ukunyibilikisa i-10L yekhephu elitsha kunika i-1L yamanzi malunga, kwaye umthetho oqhelekileyo kukubilisa ubuncinci umzuzu we-1 (imizuzu emi-3 ngaphezulu kwe-2,000m). Phepha ikhephu elikufutshane neendlela okanye elinemibala eyahlukileyo.
c-346.actionItem: Namhlanje, ngeemeko eziphuthumayo, qokelela kuphela ikhephu elitsha elicocekileyo, qala ngamanzi amancinci embizeni, linyibilikise kwaye ulibilise, kwaye ngaphandle koko thwala amanzi ebhotile.

c-347.title: Ubisi olungenalactose lubisi olunyibilikise i-lactose kwangaphambili
c-347.summary: Ubisi olungenalactose lune-lactose yalo egayiwe kwangaphambili, ngoko lufanelekile ukungabi nokuvumelana ne-lactose, kodwa iiprotheni zalo zobisi ziyahlala, ngoko alufanelekanga kwi-allergy yobisi.
c-347.principle: I-enzyme lactase i-hydrolyze i-lactose ibe yi-glucose ne-galactose. $\mathrm{C_{12}H_{22}O_{11} + H_2O \xrightarrow{\text{lactase}} C_6H_{12}O_6 + C_6H_{12}O_6}$
c-347.example: Ubisi oluqhelekileyo lunee-lactose ezingama-4.7-5g nge-100mL, ngoko i-200mL iqulathe malunga nama-9.5g. Umgangatho we-EU wokungabikho kwe-lactose yi-0.01g nge-100g okanye ngaphantsi, kwaye iswekile ekhutshelweyo yenza incasa ibe mnandi kancinci.
c-347.actionItem: Namhlanje, ukuba i-lactose ichaphazela isisu sakho, khetha imveliso engenalactose, kodwa phepha zombini ubisi oluqhelekileyo nolungenalactose ukuba unayo i-allergy yobisi.

c-348.title: Vula i-hood xa upheka kwisitovu segesi kuba ikhupha i-nitrogen dioxide
c-348.summary: Ilangatye legesi liveliswa i-nitrogen dioxide enokuthoba umoya kwikhitshi elincinci, ngoko sebenzisa i-hood ngexesha lokupheka.
c-348.principle: Kwilangatye elishushu, i-nitrogen ne-oksijini ezivela emoyeni ziyasabela ($\mathrm{N_2 + O_2 \to 2NO}$) emva koko ziyongezelela i-oxidize. $2\mathrm{NO} + \mathrm{O_2} \to 2\mathrm{NO_2}$
c-348.example: Imilinganiselo kumakhitshi amancinci angavuthuzwayo ixele i-nitrogen dioxide ngaphezu kwesikhokelo se-WHO se-1-hour se-$200\ \mu\mathrm{g/m^3}$. I-hood ekhupha ngaphandle iyehlisa kakhulu.
c-348.actionItem: Namhlanje, vula i-hood phambi kokuqala ukupheka kwaye uyigcine isebenza imizuzu eyi-10 malunga emva kokucima ilangatye.

c-349.title: Ioyile yokupheka eseleyo inokwenziwa ibe yisepha yokuhlamba
c-349.summary: Endaweni yokugalela ioyile yokupheka eseleyo emjelweni, unokuyiqokelela uyisabele ne-lye ukwenza isepha.
c-349.principle: I-saponification iguqula ii-triglycerides ne-NaOH zibe sisepha ne-glycerol. $\mathrm{C_3H_5(OOCR)_3 + 3NaOH \to C_3H_5(OH)_3 + 3RCOONa}$
c-349.example: Ioyile ye-soybean ifuna i-0.135g ye-NaOH nge-gram nganye yeoyile malunga, ngoko i-500g yeoyile ifuna i-68g malunga. I-lye iyatshisa kakhulu, ngoko iiglasi zokhuseleko neeglavu ziyimfuneko, kwaye isepha ibila malunga neeveki ezi-4.
c-349.actionItem: Namhlanje, hluza ioyile eseleyo ngesihluzo sekofu kwibhotile etywiniweyo, kwaye ungaze uyigalele emjelweni.

c-350.title: Idrop enye yamanzi yenza itshokolethi enyibilikisiweyo iqine
c-350.summary: Amanzi amancinci kwitshokolethi enyibilikisiweyo anokuyijika ngequbuliso ukusuka ekuthambeni ukuya kwimbumba eqinileyo, eneenkozo.
c-350.principle: Iswekile namasuntswana e-cocoa afunxa amanzi kwaye enze iifilimu zesiraphu ezincangathi ezinamathelisa amasuntswana, zinyusa kakhulu i-viscosity. Oku kubizwa ngokuba yi-seizing.
c-350.example: Nje ii-gram ezimbalwa zamanzi, malunga ne-1-2% yee-200g zetshokolethi, zanele ukuyiqinisa. Ukongeza amanzi amaninzi kakhulu, malunga ne-20% okanye ngaphezulu, kunokuyenza ithambe kwakhona njenge-ganache encinci.
c-350.actionItem: Namhlanje, xa unyibilikisa itshokolethi, oma ibhawuli ne-spatula kwaye ugcine umphunga namanzi aphuma kwi-double boiler ngaphandle kwebhawuli.

c-351.title: Hlamba iibhodi zokusika ngoko nangoko emva kokusetyenziswa kwaye uzomise ngokupheleleyo
c-351.summary: Ibhaktheriya ifuna ukufuma ukuze iphindaphindeke, ngoko ukuhlamba ibhodi yakho ngoko nangoko nokuyomisa ngokupheleleyo yinto ebalulekileyo.
c-351.principle: I-water activity, ebonisa ukuba amanzi akhona kangakanani, yi-$a_w = \frac{p}{p_0}$, kwaye iintsholongwane ezininzi zikhula ngokukhawuleza kwi-$a_w$ ye-0.9 malunga okanye ngaphezulu.
c-351.example: Umphezulu wenyama ekrwada une-$a_w$ ye-0.99 malunga, efanelekile ekukhuleni kwebhaktheriya. Ukumisa ibhodi imi nkqo ukuze yome ngokuhamba komoya kunciphisa ukufuma komphezulu kwaye kunciphisa ukukhula.
c-351.actionItem: Namhlanje, hlamba ibhodi yakho ngamanzi ashushu nedetergent ngoko nangoko emva kokusetyenziswa uze uyimise nkqo ukuze yome ngokupheleleyo, ugcina iibhodi zenyama ekrwada nemifuno zahlukile.

c-352.title: Ukubilisa i-Glühwein yemarike yeKrisimesi kuqhuba ivumba
c-352.summary: Iwayini ephekiweyo kufuneka ifudunyezwe kuphela ide ibe nomphunga, ingabilisiwe, ukuze ivumba nealkoholi zayo zihlale zingakumbi.
c-352.principle: I-Ethanol ibila kwi-78°C malunga, ephantsi kunamanzi, ngoko iyahamba kuqala xa ifudunyezwe. Uxinzelelo lomphunga lwengxube lulandela $P = x_{\mathrm{EtOH}}\,P^{\circ}_{\mathrm{EtOH}}$ (umthetho kaRaoult).
c-352.example: Ibhotile ye-750mL yewayini ye-12% iqulathe i-90mL malunga ye-ethanol. Ihlala ikhonzwa kwi-60-70°C, kwaye ukubilisa ngaphezulu kwe-78°C kukhupha ngokukhawuleza i-alkholi neziqwenga zevumba.
c-352.actionItem: Namhlanje, fudumeza iwayini ephekiweyo ngelangatye eliphantsi ngaphantsi kwe-70°C kwaye ususe iziqholo phambi kokuba ibile.

c-353.title: Uphawu lwe-ABC kwi-extinguisher lubonisa iintlobo zomlilo
c-353.summary: I-A, i-B ne-C kwi-extinguisher zibonisa ukuba yeyiphi imililo enokulwa nayo, kwaye iyunithi ye-ABC dry-powder yeyona khetho yasekhaya eqhelekileyo.
c-353.principle: Kuphawu lwaseKorea nolwase-US, i-A yinto ezivuthayo eziqhelekileyo, i-B ziziselo ezivuthayo kwaye i-C yimililo yombane. I-Monoammonium phosphate iyabola xa ifudunyezwa kwaye icinezela i-combustion chain reaction. $\mathrm{NH_4H_2PO_4 \to NH_3 + H_3PO_4}$
c-353.example: I-extinguisher yempuphu yasekhaya ye-3.3kg idla ngokukhupha ngaphakathi kwemizuzwana eyi-10-20 malunga, ngoko yazi indlela yokuyisebenzisa kwangaphambili. EYurophu iindidi ziyahluka, umzekelo i-C ithetha imililo yegesi, ngoko khangela imigangatho yendawo.
c-353.actionItem: Namhlanje, khangela ukuba igeyiji yoxinzelelo ye-extinguisher yakho ikuluhlu oluluhlaza kwaye uyigcine kufutshane nesandla.

c-354.title: Izishushu zezandla ezisetyenziswa kwakhona zisebenzisa ubushushu be-crystallization ye-sodium acetate
c-354.summary: Izishushu zezandla ezisetyenziswa kwakhona zisebenzisa ubushushu obukhutshwa xa isisombululo esinemisebenzi ngokugqithisileyo siyi-crystallize ngexesha elinye, kwaye ukubilisa emanzini kuyabuyisela.
c-354.principle: I-Sodium acetate trihydrate inyibilika kwi-58°C malunga, kwaye xa ulwelo oluhlile ngokugqithisileyo luyi-crystallize lukhulula ubushushu be-fusion. $Q = m\,\Delta H_{\mathrm{fus}}$, nge-$\Delta H_{\mathrm{fus}}$ malunga ne-265J/g.
c-354.example: Ipakethe ye-100g ikhulula i-26kJ malunga njengoko iyi-crystallize, kwaye umphezulu wayo unyuka ukuya kuma-50°C malunga. Ukushiya ipakethe efanayo emanzini abilayo malunga nemizuzu eyi-10 kuyibuyisela icace.
c-354.actionItem: Namhlanje, bilisa isishushu esisetyenzisiweyo emanzini kude kunyibilike yonke ikristale, siyipholise kancinci, kwaye uphephe ukuyibamba kwisikhumba esingafakwanga ixesha elide.

c-355.title: Ukuvala i-oksijini kugcina iwayini evuliweyo ilungile malunga neentsuku ezine ngaphezulu
c-355.summary: I-oksijini yeyona nto iphambili yokona iwayini evuliweyo, ngoko ukuphinda ucofe nokubeka efrijini kudla ngokufumana iintsuku ezi-3-5 ngaphezulu.
c-355.principle: I-oksijini ne-acetic acid bacteria ziguqula i-ethanol ibe yi-acetic acid nge-acetaldehyde. $\mathrm{CH_3CH_2OH + O_2 \to CH_3COOH + H_2O}$ Isantya silandela $k = Ae^{-E_a/RT}$, siqala ukunqumla isiqingatha kwi-10°C nganye yokwehla.
c-355.example: Eyaphinda yacofwa yagcinwa efrijini, ebomvu nemhlophe zombini zihlala iintsuku ezi-3-5, ngelixa ezishiywe zivuliwe kubushushu begumbi ziyehla kwiintsuku ezi-1-2. Ukuba kuseleyo kancinci, yidlulisele kwibhotile encinci ukunciphisa umoya ongaphakathi.
c-355.actionItem: Namhlanje, cofa iwayini eseleyo uze uyibeke efrijini ngoko nangoko, kwaye ukhuphe ebomvu imizuzu engama-20 phambi kokusela.

c-356.title: Iikristale ezimhlophe emazantsi ebhotile yewayini zizibeka ze-tartrate
c-356.summary: Iinkozo ezimhlophe emazantsi ebhotile okanye kwi-cork ziikristale ze-tartrate, hayi ukonakala, kwaye azinabungozi.
c-356.principle: I-Potassium hydrogen tartrate (KHT) ayinyibiliki kangako kubushushu obuphantsi kwaye iyaphuma. $\mathrm{KHC_4H_4O_6(s) \rightleftharpoons K^+ + HC_4H_4O_6^-}$ nge-$K_{sp} = [\mathrm{K^+}][\mathrm{HC_4H_4O_6^-}]$.
c-356.example: Iwayini idla ngokuqulatha i-1.5-4g/L ye-tartaric acid, kwaye iikristale zenza kancinci kwindawo yokugcina ebandayo efana nefriji. Into efanayo yi-cream of tartar esetyenziswa ekubhakeni.
c-356.actionItem: Namhlanje, ukuba ubona iikristale, ungayilahli iwayini; ime ibhotile nkqo uze uthulule kancinci, ushiye isithuba.

c-357.title: Ungafaki ioyile ye-aroma okanye i-detergent kwi-humidifier
c-357.summary: Amanzi acocekileyo kuphela afaneleke kwitanki ye-humidifier. Iioyile okanye ii-detergent ziba ngamasuntswana amancinci athi emva koko uwaphefumlele.
c-357.principle: I-humidifier ye-ultrasonic iguqula amanzi abe ngamathontsi amancinci, ithwala izinto ezinyibilikileyo emoyeni nawo. Ubunzima bento engavuthuki ekhutshiweyo yi-$m = C \times V_{\mathrm{mist}}$.
c-357.example: Kwimveliso ye-mist ye-300mL ngeyure malunga, i-additive ye-1% ithetha malunga ne-3mL yeoyile okanye i-detergent ekhutshwa njenge-aerosol rhoqo ngeyure. Iiminerali zamanzi eompompo (ucinga i-150mg/L) ziba ngama-45mg malunga othuli olumhlophe ngeyure.
c-357.actionItem: Namhlanje, tshintsha amanzi e-humidifier yonke imihla, sebenzisa i-diffuser ezinikeleyo yee-aroma, kwaye uhlambulule itanki iveki nganye.

c-358.title: I-E10 kwiipompo zaphesheya yipetroli exutywe ne-ethanol
c-358.summary: I-E10 yipetroli ene-ethanol engama-10% malunga; uninzi lweemoto zepetroli zingayisebenzisa, kodwa inamandla amancinci kancinci.
c-358.principle: I-Ethanol inamandla e-21MJ/L malunga ngomthamo, aphantsi kunepetroli e-32MJ/L malunga. $E_{\mathrm{E10}} = 0.9E_{\mathrm{gas}} + 0.1E_{\mathrm{EtOH}}$, kwaye i-octane inyuka kancinci.
c-358.example: I-E10 ibonelela nge-30.9MJ/L malunga, malunga nama-3% ngaphantsi kunepetroli, ngoko imoto eqhuba i-14km/L iya kuqhuba i-13.6km/L malunga. Khangela ilebula yesigqubuthelo sepetroli ukuqinisekisa ukuba imoto yakho ifanelekile kwi-E10.
c-358.actionItem: Namhlanje, xa ufumana imoto eqeshisiweyo, khangela ilebula yesigqubuthelo sepetroli (petroli, i-diesel, ehambelana ne-E10) kwaye ungadibanisi i-diesel nepetroli.

c-359.title: Izixhobo zokubona umsi ziyahluka: i-photoelectric ngokuchasene ne-ionization
c-359.summary: Iintlobo ezahlukeneyo zezixhobo zokubona umsi ziphendula kakuhle kwimililo eyahlukileyo, nge-photoelectric ibhetha kwimililo ecothayo etshisayo.
c-359.principle: I-alarm ye-ionization isebenzisa i-americium-241 ukwenza i-ionize umoya kwaye ikhala xa amasuntswana omsi enciphisa ukuhamba, ngelixa i-alarm ye-photoelectric ibona ukukhanya okusasazwa ngamasuntswana omsi.
c-359.example: I-Ionization iphendula ngokukhawuleza kumasuntswana amancinci (malunga nama-0.01-0.3μm) avela kwimililo evuthayo, kwaye i-photoelectric kwamakhulu (malunga nama-0.3-10μm) avela kwimililo etshisayo ngokucotha. Iyunithi ye-ionization iqulathe malunga nama-30-40 kBq e-americium.
c-359.actionItem: Namhlanje, cinezela iqhosha lovavanyo kwisixhobo sakho, kwaye usitshintshe ukuba umhla wokwenziwa ngasemva udlule iminyaka eyi-10.

c-360.title: Kuhamba nje kwemoto ye-diesel kuvala isihluzo samasuntswana
c-360.summary: Ukuba uqhuba imoto ye-diesel kuhambo olufutshane kuphela, i-exhaust ayifikeleli kubushushu obaneleyo kwaye umsizi uqokelela kwisihluzo samasuntswana e-diesel (DPF).
c-360.principle: Umsizi kwi-DPF kufuneka utshiswe ngexesha lokuvuselela. $\mathrm{C + O_2 \to CO_2}$ yenzeka kwi-350-450°C malunga ne-catalyst, kunye nokuvuselela okusebenzayo kwi-600°C malunga.
c-360.example: Kuhambo olufutshane i-exhaust ihlala ingaphantsi kwama-200°C kwaye ukuvuselela akwenzeki. Yiyo loo nto ufuna ukuhamba maxa wambi imizuzu eyi-20-30 okanye ngaphezulu ngejubane lendlela enkulu ukutshisa isihluzo sicoceke.
c-360.actionItem: Kule veki, qhuba imizuzu eyi-20-30 okanye ngaphezulu ngejubane elizinzileyo lendlela enkulu, kwaye ukhangelwe kwigaraji ukuba isibane sesilumkiso sivuliwe.

c-361.title: Isoda yokubhaka encinci yenza inyama enzima ithambe
c-361.summary: Isixa esincinci kakhulu sesoda yokubhaka sinyusa i-pH yenyama enzima ukuze ibambe amanzi amaninzi kwaye ithambe.
c-361.principle: Iiprotheni zemisipha zibamba amanzi kakubi kufutshane ne-isoelectric point yazo (pH 5-5.5 malunga). Ukunyusa i-pH yenyama (5.5-5.7 malunga) ngesoda yokubhaka yongeza intlawulo engalunganga ukuze iiprotheni zityhalane kwaye zibambe amanzi amaninzi. $\mathrm{NaHCO_3 \rightleftharpoons Na^+ + HCO_3^-}$
c-361.example: Xuba i-450g yenyama ecwecwe kunye ne-2.5g (0.5%) yesoda yokubhaka imizuzu eyi-15, uze uhlambulule. Ukugqithisa kunika incasa yesepha nokuthamba kakhulu.
c-361.actionItem: Namhlanje, ukuba inyama yokuthosa inzima, yigcobe nge-0.5% okanye ngaphantsi yesoda yokubhaka imizuzu eyi-15 kuphela, hlambulula kakuhle uze upheke.

c-362.title: Ubisi maxa wambi luyaqina kwikofu eshushu
c-362.summary: Ubisi oluqinayo kwikofu kukudityaniswa kweeprotheni ngenxa yobukhali nobushushu, kwaye ubisi olutsha luhlala lungenabungozi.
c-362.principle: I-isoelectric point ye-casein yobisi yi-pH 4.6 malunga, ngoko njengoko i-pH isondela kuyo intlawulo iyehla kwaye iiprotheni ziyadibana. Ubushushu bukhawulezisa oku kudibana.
c-362.example: Ubisi lukwi-pH 6.7 malunga kwaye ikofu malunga ne-4.8-5.1. Ubisi olwakudala lunayo i-pH esezantsi kwaye luqina lula, ngoko ukuba livumba lisuka, lilahle endaweni yokulisela.
c-362.actionItem: Namhlanje, galela ubisi ekomityini kuqala okanye usebenzise ubisi olufudumeleyo kwikofu yakho, kwaye ulahle ukuba livumba lisuka.

c-363.title: Ukuphefumlela i-helium evela kwigesi yebhaluni kuyingozi
c-363.summary: Ukuphefumlela i-helium kutshintsha ilizwi lakho, kodwa kuthatha indawo ye-oksijini kwaye kunokubangela ukukhefuzela, ngoko kuyingozi.
c-363.principle: Uxinzelelo lwenxalenye ye-oksijini kwigesi yokuphefumla yi-$P_{\mathrm{O_2}} = F_{\mathrm{O_2}} \times P$. I-helium emsulwa ine-$F_{\mathrm{O_2}} = 0$, ngoko itsala i-oksijini ngaphandle emiphungeni. Ijubane lesandi, $v = \sqrt{\frac{\gamma RT}{M}}$, liphezulu kakhulu kwi-helium, linyusa ilizwi.
c-363.example: Umoya unama-20.9% e-oksijini ngelixa i-helium ye-100% inama-0%. Ijubane lesandi kwi-helium lingama-1,007m/s malunga, malunga namaxesha ama-3 emoyeni (malunga nama-343m/s), kwaye ukuphefumla ngqo kwitanki enoxinzelelo kunokwenzakalisa imiphunga.
c-363.actionItem: Namhlanje, xa ugcwalisa iibhaluni, ungayiphefumleli i-helium, kwaye uvuthuze kwigumbi elivaliweyo.

c-364.title: Ungathumeli ifilimu esebenza ngokukhawuleza ngee-X-rays zesikhululo seenqwelo-moya
c-364.summary: Ii-X-rays zesikhululo seenqwelo-moya zinokumafusa ifilimu, ngoko kwifilimu esebenza ngokukhawuleza kukhuseleko ngakumbi ukucela uvavanyo ngesandla.
c-364.principle: Xa iikristale ze-silver halide zifunxa ii-photons zokukhanya okanye ze-X-ray, zenza umfanekiso ofihlakeleyo weeathom zesilivere. $\mathrm{AgBr + h\nu \to Ag + Br}$ Ukuvezwa kuyaqokeleleka.
c-364.example: Ifilimu ebizwa nge-ISO 800 okanye ngaphezulu inokumafusa emva kwezikhan ezininzi, kwaye ii-X-rays zeempahla ezifakwe kwi-check-in zomelele ngakumbi. Ngenxa yokuba ukuvezwa kudibana, gcina inani lezikhan ngohambo lincinci.
c-364.actionItem: Namhlanje, faka ifilimu yakho kwibhegi ecacileyo, cela uvavanyo ngesandla ekhuselweni, kwaye ungayifaki kwimithwalo ekhutshelweyo.

c-365.title: Gweba ukuhlala nentengo yeperfume nge-EDP okanye amandla e-EDT
c-365.summary: Ngeperfume, ukuxinana kwevumba (%) kukuxelela okungakumbi malunga nokuhlala nentengo kunegama.
c-365.principle: Ukuphezulu kokuxinana kwevumba, ukucotha kokuphuma komphunga kwaye kokukhona kuhlala. I-Eau de parfum (EDP) ingama-15-20% malunga, i-eau de toilette (EDT) ama-5-15% malunga kwaye i-eau de cologne (EDC) ama-2-4% malunga.
c-365.example: Kwibhotile ye-50mL, i-EDP ye-15% iqulathe i-7.5mL malunga yeoyile yevumba kwaye i-EDT ye-8% i-4mL malunga, ngoko i-EDP idla ngokubiza ngakumbi. I-EDT idla ngokuhlala iiyure ezi-3-4 malunga kwaye i-EDP iiyure ezi-5-8 malunga.
c-365.actionItem: Phambi kokuthenga iperfume, yitshize ngaphakathi engalweni uze ujonge ukuba ivumba njani emva kweeyure ezi-4.

c-366.title: I-aerogel kwii-insoles nakwiiglavu ikakhulu ngumoya obanjwe kwi-silica
c-366.summary: I-aerogel kwisixhobo sezulu elibandayo yiyilo ye-silica ikakhulu ngumoya, ngoko nomaleko omncinci uvala ubushushu kakuhle.
c-366.principle: Iipores ze-nano-size ezincinci kunendlela yamasuntswana omoya (68nm malunga) zivimba ukudluliswa kobushushu. $\lambda = \frac{k_B T}{\sqrt{2}\,\pi d^2 P}$ kwaye ukuhamba kobushushu yi-$Q = \frac{kA\,\Delta T}{L}$.
c-366.example: I-silica aerogel inokuqhuba ubushushu kwe-0.015-0.02W/m·K malunga, ephantsi kunomoya omileyo (0.026 malunga). Kwindawo ye-0.02m², ubukhulu be-3mm kunye nomahluko we-20K nge-$k = 0.02$, ilahleko yobushushu yi-2.7W malunga.
c-366.actionItem: Namhlanje, khangela umxholo wokwenene we-aerogel nobukhulu kwii-insoles neegloves zakho, kwaye uzigcine zomile kuba ukumanzi kunciphisa ukugquma.

20261119-math-g01-1.title: Linjani ubume bento esebhokisini?
20261119-math-g01-1.summary: Uzonyaniswe amehlo uva into esebhokisini, yaye uva imibono kanye kanye. Into esebhokisini yenye yobume bebhokisi, ubume besilinda, okanye ubume besibhakabhaka.
20261119-math-g01-1.principle: Ngalo lonke ixesha ufumana umbono omnye owongezelelekileyo, cutha iimilo ezinokwenzeka uze ulungise umbono wakho wokuqala ukuze uhambelane nombono omtsha.
20261119-math-g01-1.example: Bhala imo yebhokisi, imo yesilinda, nemo yebhola, kwaye kwisikhomba ngasinye phawula iimo ezinokwenzeka.
20261119-math-g01-1.actionItem: Ngalo lonke ixesha ufumana umbono omnye owongezelelekileyo, cutha iimilo ezinokwenzeka uze ulungise umbono wakho wokuqala ukuze uhambelane nombono omtsha.

20261119-math-g01-2.title: Ubude obulinganiswe ngeepepaklipu neegluu estiki: sesiphi esinde ngakumbi?
20261119-math-g01-2.summary: U-Minjun ulinganise ubude bepensile ngeepepaklipu waza wafumana iipepaklipu ezi-5. U-Seoyun ulinganise ubude bepensile enemibala ngeegluu estiki (iglu enjengentonga) waza wafumana iigluu estiki ezi-3. Bobabini bazibeke emgceni omnye macala ngamacala ngaphandle kwezikhewu. Sesiphi esinde, ipensile okanye ipensile enemibala?
20261119-math-g01-2.principle: Ipepaklipu negluu estiki zinobude obahlukileyo, ngoko awunakuthelekisa ngokujonga u-5 no-3 kuphela. Ukuba uyazi ukuba igluu estiki e-1 ingaphi iipepaklipu, unokuthelekisa ngeyunithi enye, kwaye unokuthelekisa ipensile nepensile enemibala ngqo ngokulungelelanisa isiphelo esinye.
20261119-math-g01-2.example: Ingaba ipepaklipu enye inobude obufanayo negluu estiki enye? Cinga ngoko kuqala.
20261119-math-g01-2.actionItem: Funda ukuba ubude obulinganiswe ngeeyunithi ezahlukileyo abunakuthelekiswa ngamanani odwa, ugqibe ukuba ufuna ulwazi luni ukubuthelekisa.

20261119-math-g02-1.title: Ingaba inani elilandela u-1, 2, 4 linye kuphela?
20261119-math-g02-1.summary: Umhlobo ekubeni sisigaba sethu udlala umdlalo wolandelelwano lwamanani apho babonisa amanani elinye ngexesha. Umhlobo ugqibe ngepatheni enye aze akuxelele inani elinye ngexesha.
20261119-math-g02-1.principle: Funda ukuba amanani okuqala ambalwa kuphela awamiseli ipatheni ibe yinye, nokuba kufuneka ulungise ipatheni xa inani elitsha licaciswa, uze wenze ulandelelwano lwamanani ohambelana nepatheni ngokwakho.

20261119-math-g02-2.title: Fumana inani eliyimfihlo likaSuji
20261119-math-g02-2.summary:
USuji ukhethe inani elinamadijithi amathathu waza wanika izikhokelo.
Isikhokelo 1) Idijithi kwindawo yamashumi inkulu nge-2 kunedijithi kwindawo yeeyunithi.
Isikhokelo 2) Idijithi kwindawo yeeyunithi ayingu-0.
Isikhokelo 3) Idijithi kwindawo yamakhulu inkulu kunedijithi kwindawo yamashumi.
20261119-math-g02-2.principle: 420 inayo 0 kwindawo yeeyunithi, ngoko ichasene nesikhokelo 2, kwaye 353 inayo 3 kwindawo yamakhulu, encinci kune-5 kwindawo yamashumi, ngoko ichasene nesikhokelo 3. 642 no-975 bahlangabezana nazo zonke izikhokelo ezintathu.
20261119-math-g02-2.example: Khetha inani elinye uzivavanye ngezikhokelo 1, 2, no-3 ngokulandelelana.
20261119-math-g02-2.actionItem: Sebenzisa ixabiso lendawo ukufumana inani elinamadijithi amathathu elihlangabezana nezikhokelo ezininzi ngaxeshanye, uze ukhethe izikhokelo ngokuthelekisa ukuba mangaphi amanani ashiywa sisikhokelo ngasinye.

math-g02-2.title: Fumana inani eliyimfihlo likaSuji
math-g02-2.summary:

20261119-math-g06-2.title: Ingaba Ijusi Egxininisiweyo Engakumbi Ithetha Ijusi Eyomeleleyo?

IJusi A isebenzisa iikomityi ezi-3 zegxininiso neekomityi ezi-5 zamanzi, kwaye iJusi B isebenzisa iikomityi ezi-4 zegxininiso neekomityi ezi-8 zamanzi. UHajun wathi, "B inegxininiso elingakumbi, iikomityi ezi-4, ngoko B iyomelele!" (Apha, "iyomelele" ithetha ukuba xa usela into efanayo, kukho igxininiso elingakumbi kuyo.)

20261119-math-g07-1.title: Ingaba Amaxesha Amakhulu Athetha Ukuba Benze Ngcono?

Iklasi 1 (abafundi abangama-20) neKlasi 2 (abafundi abangama-50) bathabathe uvavanyo olufanayo lwemathematika. Itheyibhile yokwabiwa kwamaxesha enamanqaku abekwe kwizithuba ezintathu imi ngolu hlobo.
Isithuba / Iklasi 1 (abafundi abangama-20) / Iklasi 2 (abafundi abangama-50)
Ngaphantsi kwamanqaku angama-60 / abafundi aba-2 / abafundi abali-10
Amanqaku angama-60 okanye ngaphezulu kodwa ngaphantsi kwama-80 / abafundi abali-10 / abafundi abangama-25
Amanqaku angama-80 okanye ngaphezulu / abafundi aba-8 / abafundi abali-15
UMinji uthe, "Kukho abafundi abaninzi abanamanqaku angama-80 okanye ngaphezulu kwiKlasi 2, abali-15, ngoko iKlasi 2 yenze ngcono kuvavanyo."

20261119-math-g08-1.title: Zeziphi iinqaku esizifunayo ukufumana amaxabiso?
20261119-math-g08-1.summary: Sifuna ukufumana ixabiso lepensile enye, x won, nelencwadi yokubhala enye, y won, kwivenkile yezixhobo zokubhala. Umnini wasibonisa amanqaku ama-5 enyaniso. Inqaku A: Iipensile ezi-2 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-3 zibiza i-3,100 won. Inqaku B: Iipensile ezi-4 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-6 zibiza i-6,200 won. Inqaku C: Incwadi yokubhala ibiza i-200 won ngaphezu kwepensile. Inqaku D: Iipensile ezi-6 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-9 zibiza i-9,300 won. Inqaku E: Iipensile ezi-5 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-5 zibiza i-6,000 won.
20261119-math-g08-1.principle: Amaqhinga A, B no-D anomlinganiselo ofanayo weepensile kwiincwadi zokubhala, 2:3, kwaye izixa zawo ziziphindaphindi ezifanayo (ihlandlo eli-1, amahlandlo ama-2, amahlandlo ama-3), ngoko aphinda ulwazi olufanayo. Ngala maqhinga kuphela, awunakuyimisela into enye esisisombululo. Ukuba udibanisa amaqhinga anemilinganiselo eyahlukileyo yamanani (C, E), ulingano olubini lunika ulwazi olwahlukileyo, ngoko amaxabiso ayamiselwa. (Ipensile 500 won, incwadi yokubhala 700 won)
20261119-math-g08-1.example: Phinda ubhale amaqhinga ngohlobo 'iipensile □ + iincwadi zokubhala □ = □원' uze uthelekise amaqhinga amabini ecaleni kwelinye.
20261119-math-g08-1.actionItem: Xa usenza ukulingana ngaxeshanye, gwebela ukuba ukulingana kunika ulwazi olwahlukileyo na, uze wenze wena ukulingana okunganiki lwazi lutsha.

20261119-math-g08-2.title: Ithuba lentloko e-1 kuphela ngeengqekembe ezimbini

20261119-math-g09-1.title: Ukuba sin A=3/5, ingaba iyafana nokuba unxantathu uba mkhulu?
20261119-math-g09-1.summary: Kunxantathu oneengile ethe nkqo ABC, ∠C=90°, icala BC licala elichasene ne-∠A, icala AC licala elikufuphi ne-∠A (hayi ihayipothenyusi), kwaye icala AB yihayipothenyusi. sin A ifundwa 'sayini A' kwaye cos A ifundwa 'khosayini A.' Kula nxantathu, sin A=3/5 (3 phezu kwe-5).
20261119-math-g09-1.principle: Ukuba wandisa onke amacala amathathu ngesiphindaphindi esifanayo, njenge-(AB, BC, AC)=(5, 3, 4), (10, 6, 8), (15, 9, 12), sin A=3/5 ihlala injalo.
20261119-math-g09-1.example: Njengomzekelo olula kakhulu, xa BC=3 kunye ne-AB=5, fumana ubude becala eliseleyo AC ngetheorem kaPythagoras.
20261119-math-g09-1.actionItem: Yenza onxantathu abaneengile ethe nkqo abaninzi abanexabiso elifanayo le-sin A, uvavanye izibakala zabafundi ababini usebenzisa iziphumo, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni umlinganiselo wetrigonometri umiselwa bubungakanani beengile.

20261119-math-g09-2.title: Kufuneka sibuze ntoni ukumisela umsebenzi omnye wequadratic?
20261119-math-g09-2.summary: Sifuna ukufumana ikhweshini yomsebenzi wequadratic y=ax²+bx+c (a ayingo-0). (y ifundwa 'y ilingana no-a x isikwere kudibaniswe no-b x kudibaniswe no-c.') Umhlobo uza kukuxelela ulwazi ngegrafu iqhekeza elinye ngexesha.
20261119-math-g09-2.principle: 'Incopho nechaphaza elinye' imiselwa ngokufaka (0, 3) kwi-y=a(x-2)²-1, nto leyo enika a=1. 'Amachaphaza amathathu' amiselwa ngokufaka (0, 3) kwi-y=a(x-1)(x-3), nto leyo enika a=1. Kwamanye amaqhekeza amathathu olwazi, naxabiso lika-a okanye ukuphakama kwencopho akumiselwanga, ngoko zikho ikhweshini ezininzi.
20261119-math-g09-2.example: Sebenza ukuba zikho imisebenzi emibini okanye ngaphezulu eyahlukileyo yequadratic ehambelana nolwazi ngalunye.
20261119-math-g09-2.actionItem: Hlela ulwazi olwaneleyo ukumisela ikhweshini enye yomsebenzi wequadratic y=ax²+bx+c kulo olungonelanga, uze ugqibe ukuba loluphi umbuzo owongezelelweyo ekufuneka ububuzwe xa lungonelanga.

20261119-math-g10-1.title: Ngaba umgca uya kuchukumisa isangqa? Xa ulwazi luvezwa isiqwenga esinye ngexesha
20261119-math-g10-1.summary: Kukho isangqa x²+y²=25 (isazulu kwimvelaphi, irediyasi 5) nomgca y=x+k. Tshintsha ixabiso lika-k ujonge inani lamachaphaza apho umgca nesangqa zidibana khona.
20261119-math-g10-1.principle: Xela indawo yomgca nesangqa ngokuxhomekeke kwixabiso lengxelo engatshintshiyo k, uhlaziye isigwebo sakho ngolwazi olutsha, uze unciphise uluhlu luka-k apho bechukumisana khona.
20261119-math-g10-1.example: Unokuhlola inani lamachaphaza okudibana ngezisombululo zekhweshini oyifumanayo ngokusombulula iikhweshini zomgca nesangqa kunye.

20261119-math-g10-2.title: Isisombululo sentsalela siphosakale phi?
20261119-math-g10-2.summary: Esi sisisombululo sikaMinjae sokufumana ikhonkco a ukuze intsalela ibe ngu-6 xa ipolynomial f(x)=x³+ax²+x+2 ihlulwa nge-x+1. (x³ kuthetha u-x e-cube, kwaye ax² kuthetha a iphindaphindwe ngesikwere sika-x.)
20261119-math-g10-2.principle: Umgca wesi-2 uphosakele. x+1 inokubhalwa njenge-x−(−1), ngoko intsalela yi-f(−1), hayi i-f(1). Imigca yesi-3 nesi-4 ilandela nje umgca wesi-2, ngoko ubalo olungaphakathi kuyo lulungile, kodwa iziphumo zayo ziphosakele.
20261119-math-g10-2.example: Bhala kwakhona i-x+1 ukuze umahluli abe nefom ye-x−(inani elithile).
20261119-math-g10-2.actionItem: Fumana umgca ophosakeleyo kwisisombululo esifumana intsalela, uyilungise, uze uhlole impendulo ephosakeleyo ngokuchasene nemeko yokuqala ukuqinisekisa impazamo.

20261119-math-g11-1.title: Fumana umgca onengxaki kwisisombululo selingano lelogarithm
20261119-math-g11-1.summary: UMinho wasombulula ulingano log₂(x−1) + log₂(x−3) = 3 waphendula, ‘Izisombululo zi-x=5 no-x=−1, ezimbini.’ Ukuyifunda ngokuvakalayo, ithi ‘log isiseko 2 se-(x ngokususa 1) ukongeza log isiseko 2 se-(x ngokususa 3) kulingana no-3’.
20261119-math-g11-1.principle: Indawo yokuqala apho kuphambuka khona ngumgca wesi-2. Xa isixa seelogarithm ezimbini sidityaniswa sibe lilogarithm enye, iimeko zexabiso elingaphakathi x−1>0 no-x−3>0 ziyanyamalala kugama, yaye ezo meko azibhalwanga ngokwahlukeneyo. Ngoko kumgca wesi-5 zombini iingcambu zamkelwa, yaye umgca wesi-6 sisigqibo eso. Ixabiso elingaphakathi kufuneka lipositivu, ngoko x>3 iyafuneka. Ukuba x=−1, ngoko x−1=−2 no-x−3=−4, amaxabiso angaphakathi anegethivu, ngoko ulingano alucacisiwe. Ukuba x=5, log₂4 + log₂2 = 2+1 = 3, ngoko liyabamba. Ngoko isisombululo lixabiso elinye x=5.
20261119-math-g11-1.example: Ngalo lonke ixesha ugama liguquka, funda ukhangela ukuba lithetha okufanayo nomgca wangaphambili.
20261119-math-g11-1.actionItem: Fumana uze ulungise ingxaki ebangelwa kukungakhangeli imeko yexabiso elingaphakathi kwilogarithm kwisisombululo selingano lelogarithm.

Ukuba x=−1, ngoko x−1=−2 no-x−3=−4, amaxabiso angaphakathi anegethivu, ngoko ulingano alucacisiwe. Ukuba x=5, log₂4 + log₂2 = 2+1 = 3, ngoko liyabamba. Ngoko isisombululo lixabiso elinye x=5.
math-g11-1.example: Ngalo lonke ixesha ugama liguquka, funda ukhangela ukuba lithetha okufanayo nomgca wangaphambili.
math-g11-1.actionItem: Fumana uze ulungise ingxaki ebangelwa kukungakhangeli imeko yexabiso elingaphakathi kwilogarithm kwisisombululo selingano lelogarithm.

20261119-math-g11-2.title: Zingaphi onxantathu onokwenziwa ngamacala amabini ne-engile e-1?
20261119-math-g11-2.summary: Konxantathu ABC, ∠A=60° kwaye ubude becala BC bungu-a=7. Xa ubude becala CA, b, bunikiwe, unokumisela ubude c becala AB wenze unxantathu. (a, b, c ngamacala achasene nee-∠A, ∠B, ∠C. cos60°=1/2.) UGaeun wathi, 'Ukuba b inkulu kune-7, onxantathu ababini abanjalo bahlala benziwa.'
20261119-math-g11-2.principle: Ukusuka kwi-49=64+c²−8c, c²−8c+15=0, (c−3)(c−5)=0, ngoko c=3 okanye 5. Amaxabiso omabini apozithivu, ngoko onxantathu ababini banokwenziwa.
20261119-math-g11-2.example: Faka a=7, b=8, cos60°=1/2 kumthetho wekhosayini ubhale ulingano lwe-c.
20261119-math-g11-2.actionItem: Vavanya ukuqhelekisa 'zihlala zimbini' ngamaxabiso athile uze uchaze ngezizathu ukuba zeziphi iimeko apho kungabambi.

20261119-math-g12-1.title: Ithi ipositivu, kodwa umntu uyagula ngokwenene na?
20261119-math-g12-1.summary: Uvavanyo lwesifo esithile lwabonakala ‘lupositivu’. Ufuna ukwazi ithuba lokuba umntu onesiphumo esipositivu uneso sifo ngokwenene. Gqiba ukuba luluphi ulwazi olufunekayo ukumisela eli thuba.
20261119-math-g12-1.principle: Abo bavavanywe bepositivu benziwe ‘ngabagulayo abavavanywe bepositivu’ ‘nabaphilileyo abavavanywe bepositivu’. Ngoko kufuneka umlinganiselo wabagulayo, ithuba lokuba ogulayo avavanywe epositivu, nethuba lokuba ophilileyo avavanywe epositivu.
20261119-math-g12-1.example: Khumbula ukuba ngawaphi amaqela amabini abantu abavavanyiweyo abanesiphumo esipositivu banokwahlulwa.
20261119-math-g12-1.actionItem: Khetha ulwazi olufunekayo ukufumana ithuba elinemeko, uze uchaze ngamanani ukuba kutheni ukuchaneka kovavanyo kwahlukile kwi-‘ithuba lokugula xa isiphumo sipositivu’.

20261119-math-g12-2.title: Ukuba icala elibomvu liyabonakala, kuthekani ngangasemva?
20261119-math-g12-2.summary: Kukho amakhadi amathathu ebhokisini. Elinye libomvu macala omabini (ikhadi elibomvu-elibomvu), elinye libomvu kwelinye icala neluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kwelinye (ikhadi elibomvu-eluhlaza), kwaye elinye luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka macala omabini (ikhadi eluhlaza-eluhlaza). Ukhetha ikhadi elinye ngokungenamkhethe ubeke icala elinye etafileni, kwaye ibomvu liyabonakala. Cinga ngethuba lokuba icala langasemva nalo libomvu.
20261119-math-g12-2.principle: Phucula ukuqikelela kwakho kokuqala (1/2) usebenzisa idatha nokuhlalutya, uze ufumane ukuba yeyiphi umgca woqikelelo ophosakeleyo ukuze utolike ithuba elinemeko ngokuchanekileyo.
20261119-math-g12-2.example: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, bhala ukuba zeziphi iimeko ozibalayo.

20261121-math-g01-1.title: Linjani ubume bento esebhokisini?
20261121-math-g01-1.summary: Uzonyaniswe amehlo uva into esebhokisini, yaye uva imibono kanye kanye. Into esebhokisini yenye yobume bebhokisi, ubume besilinda, okanye ubume besibhakabhaka.
20261121-math-g01-1.principle: Ngalo lonke ixesha ufumana umbono omnye owongezelelekileyo, cutha iimilo ezinokwenzeka uze ulungise umbono wakho wokuqala ukuze uhambelane nombono omtsha.
20261121-math-g01-1.example: Bhala imo yebhokisi, imo yesilinda, nemo yebhola, kwaye kwisikhomba ngasinye phawula iimo ezinokwenzeka.
20261121-math-g01-1.actionItem: Ngalo lonke ixesha ufumana umbono omnye owongezelelekileyo, cutha iimilo ezinokwenzeka uze ulungise umbono wakho wokuqala ukuze uhambelane nombono omtsha.

20261121-math-g01-2.title: Ubude obulinganiswe ngeepepaklipu neegluu estiki: sesiphi esinde ngakumbi?
20261121-math-g01-2.summary: U-Minjun ulinganise ubude bepensile ngeepepaklipu waza wafumana iipepaklipu ezi-5. U-Seoyun ulinganise ubude bepensile enemibala ngeegluu estiki (iglu enjengentonga) waza wafumana iigluu estiki ezi-3. Bobabini bazibeke emgceni omnye macala ngamacala ngaphandle kwezikhewu. Sesiphi esinde, ipensile okanye ipensile enemibala?
20261121-math-g01-2.principle: Ipepaklipu negluu estiki zinobude obahlukileyo, ngoko awunakuthelekisa ngokujonga u-5 no-3 kuphela. Ukuba uyazi ukuba igluu estiki e-1 ingaphi iipepaklipu, unokuthelekisa ngeyunithi enye, kwaye unokuthelekisa ipensile nepensile enemibala ngqo ngokulungelelanisa isiphelo esinye.
20261121-math-g01-2.example: Ingaba ipepaklipu enye inobude obufanayo negluu estiki enye? Cinga ngoko kuqala.
20261121-math-g01-2.actionItem: Funda ukuba ubude obulinganiswe ngeeyunithi ezahlukileyo abunakuthelekiswa ngamanani odwa, ugqibe ukuba ufuna ulwazi luni ukubuthelekisa.

20261121-math-g02-1.title: Ingaba inani elilandela u-1, 2, 4 linye kuphela?
20261121-math-g02-1.summary: Umhlobo ekubeni sisigaba sethu udlala umdlalo wolandelelwano lwamanani apho babonisa amanani elinye ngexesha. Umhlobo ugqibe ngepatheni enye aze akuxelele inani elinye ngexesha.
20261121-math-g02-1.principle: Funda ukuba amanani okuqala ambalwa kuphela awamiseli ipatheni ibe yinye, nokuba kufuneka ulungise ipatheni xa inani elitsha licaciswa, uze wenze ulandelelwano lwamanani ohambelana nepatheni ngokwakho.
20261121-math-g02-1.actionItem: Funda ukuba amanani okuqala ambalwa kuphela awamiseli ipatheni ibe yinye, nokuba kufuneka ulungise ipatheni xa inani elitsha licaciswa, uze wenze ulandelelwano lwamanani ohambelana nepatheni ngokwakho.

20261121-math-g02-2.title: Fumana inani eliyimfihlo likaSuji
20261121-math-g02-2.summary:
USuji ukhethe inani elinamadijithi amathathu waza wanika izikhokelo.
Isikhokelo 1) Idijithi kwindawo yamashumi inkulu nge-2 kunedijithi kwindawo yeeyunithi.
Isikhokelo 2) Idijithi kwindawo yeeyunithi ayingu-0.
Isikhokelo 3) Idijithi kwindawo yamakhulu inkulu kunedijithi kwindawo yamashumi.
20261121-math-g02-2.principle: 420 inayo 0 kwindawo yeeyunithi, ngoko ichasene nesikhokelo 2, kwaye 353 inayo 3 kwindawo yamakhulu, encinci kune-5 kwindawo yamashumi, ngoko ichasene nesikhokelo 3. 642 no-975 bahlangabezana nazo zonke izikhokelo ezintathu.
20261121-math-g02-2.example: Khetha inani elinye uzivavanye ngezikhokelo 1, 2, no-3 ngokulandelelana.
20261121-math-g02-2.actionItem: Sebenzisa ixabiso lendawo ukufumana inani elinamadijithi amathathu elihlangabezana nezikhokelo ezininzi ngaxeshanye, uze ukhethe izikhokelo ngokuthelekisa ukuba mangaphi amanani ashiywa sisikhokelo ngasinye.

20261121-math-g03-1.title: Iindlela Ezahlukeneyo Zokwabelana Nge-72 Zeekhandi Phakathi Kweepleyiti
20261121-math-g03-1.summary: Ufuna ukubeka ii-72 zeekhandi kwiipleyiti, wabelane ngokulinganayo kungashiyeki nanye. Inani leekhandi kwipleyiti nganye litshintsha ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni zingaphi iipleyiti osebenzisa.
20261121-math-g03-1.principle: Unokwabelana ngokulinganayo kungashiyeki nanye kuphela xa inani leepleyiti liphindaphindwe linani leekhandi kwipleyiti enye li-72. 4×18, 6×12, kunye no-9×8 zi-72, kwaye akukho nani eliphindaphindwe ngo-5 okanye ngo-7 elenza i-72.
20261121-math-g03-1.example: Kwinani ngalinye leepleyiti, wahlula i-72 ngelo nani uze uhlole ukuba ikho intsalela na.
20261121-math-g03-1.actionItem: Fumana iindlela ezininzi zokwabelana ezihlangabezana neemeko (uluhlu lwenani leepleyiti nenani leekhandi kwipleyiti nganye) ngaxeshanye, uze uchaze indlela inani leepleyiti nenani leekhandi kwipleyiti enye eziqhagamshela ngayo.

20261121-math-g03-2.title: Ukufumana Impazamo Ekwabelaneni Kweekhandi KukaSeoyeon
20261121-math-g03-2.summary: USeoyeon ufuna ukwabelana nge-85 zeekhandi ngokulinganayo phakathi kwabantu aba-4. Funda isisombululo sikaSeoyeon. Isiphumo sokwahlula linani lalo ngamnye umntu alifumanayo, kwaye intsalela linani eliseleyo emva kokwabelana.
20261121-math-g03-2.principle: Umgca wesi-3 uphosakele. Ii-khandi ezi-5 ezishiyekileyo zinokwabelwana kwakhona, ikhandi e-1 ngakumbi kubantu aba-4 ngabanye, ngoko ukuthi 'azinakwabelwana ngakumbi' akulunganga. Ukuhlola kumgca wesi-4 kubonisa kuphela ukuba isivakalisi samanani siyahambelana; akubonisi ukuba intsalela ichanekile na.
20261121-math-g03-2.example: Kumgca ngamnye, bala omnye ngomnye ukuhlola ukuba oko ukuthethayo kunjalo ngokwenene.
