20261121-math-g03-2.actionItem: Sebenzisa imeko yokuba intsalela kufuneka ibe ncinci kunomahluli ukufumana ulungise impazamo kwisisombululo, uze wahlule iimeko apho impazamo efanayo yenzeka khona nalapho ingenzeki khona.

20261121-math-g04-1.title: Ukuhlola Inkcazo ka-Seohyeon
20261121-math-g04-1.summary: U-Seohyeon wachaza oku kumhlobo. Kukho impazamo kule nkcazo.
20261121-math-g04-1.principle: Umgca 3 yindawo apho kuqala ukuphosa. Isikwere sinamacala amane alinganayo, kodwa oko akuthethi okuchasene, "ukuba amacala amane alinganayo, sisikwere." Umgca 4 uqhubeka nempazamo efanayo, kodwa indawo yokuqala engalunganga ngumgca 3.
20261121-math-g04-1.example: Funda umgca ngamnye ubhalwe kwakhona ngefom "ukuba ..., ngoko ...," ubhale kumgca ngamnye ukuba uya kwicala elifanayo nesibakala somgca wangaphambili.
20261121-math-g04-1.actionItem: Fumana impazamo yengqiqo kwinkcazo ethi 'Ukuba onke amacala amane ayafana, sisikwere,' uze uchaze iquadrilateral ngumzekelo ochasayo.

20261121-math-g04-2.title: Iphosakale Phi Xa Kutshintshwa Kwaba Ngamadijithi?
20261121-math-g04-2.summary: UMinseo wabhala isisombululo sokubhala 'amawaka amathathu amashumi amabini anesihlanu amawaka ali-10, amawaka amane nesithandathu' ngamadijithi.
20261121-math-g04-2.principle: Umgca wesi-3 yindawo yokuqala ephosakeleyo. Kumawaka amane nesithandathu, indawo yamawaka yi-4 kwaye indawo yeeyunithi yi-6, kwaye iindawo zamakhulu namashumi zazingafundwanga kodwa ziyi-0, ngoko yi-4006. Imigca yesi-4 nesi-5 iphosakele kuba iqhuba ixabiso eliphosakeleyo elisuka kumgca wesi-3.
20261121-math-g04-2.example: Kumgca ngamnye, hlola omnye ngomnye ukuba 'amagama afundwayo' 'namadijithi abhaliweyo' ayahambelana na.
20261121-math-g04-2.actionItem: Fumana umgca ophosakeleyo kwisisombululo esitshintsha inani elikhulu elifundwe ngamagama laba ngamadijithi, uze ulungise usebenzisa ii-0 kwiindawo ezingafundwanga.

20261121-math-g05-1.title: Inani Lamaqela Okwabelana Ngokulinganayo: Ukulungisa Isisombululo
20261121-math-g05-1.summary: Ufuna ukwabelana ngeelekese ezingama-48 neetshokolethi ezingama-36 ngokulinganayo ungashiyi nto phakathi kwamaqela amaninzi. UHayun wafumana inani lamaqela ngolu hlobo.
20261121-math-g05-1.principle: Umgca 2 yindawo yokuqala engachanekanga. Inani lamaqela ahlulwa ngama-48 ngokulinganayo kufuneka libe linani elihlula ama-48 ngokulinganayo, oko kukuthi, isahluli sama-48. Isiphindaphindi sinokuba sikhulu kunama-48, yaye emva koko iilekese aziphelelanga. Umgca 4 uthi into eya kushiya amaqela athile engenalekese nanye kumaqela angama-144. Umgca 1 ukopishe ingxaki kakuhle, yaye u-144 emgceni 3 uchanekile njengesiphindaphindi esiqhelekileyo esincinane kakhulu sama-48 nama-36.
20261121-math-g05-1.example: Funda umgca ngamnye ucinge ukuba oko kuthethwa kunokwenzeka ngokwenene kwimeko eneelekese ezingama-48 neetshokolethi ezingama-36.
20261121-math-g05-1.actionItem: Fumana uze ulungise indawo kwisisombululo apho kwakhethwa ubudlelwane obungachanekanga phakathi kwamanani (isahluli/isiphindaphindi), uze ucinge ngazo zonke iimeko ezihambelana neemeko.

20261121-math-g05-2.title: Ukuba Imindilili Iyafana, Ingaba Amaqela Amabini Ayafana?
20261121-math-g05-2.summary: Iqela leSibhakabhaka neqela leLwandle zithumele abantu aba-4 ngalinye kukhuphiswano lokutsiba intambo. Iirekhodi zeqela leSibhakabhaka (inani lokutsiba) zingama-20, 22, 24, nama-54, kwaye iirekhodi zeqela leLwandle zingama-28, 29, 30, nama-33. Imindilili yawo omabini amaqela ifana, ngama-30. UDoha wathi, "Imindilili iyafana, ngoko amaqela amabini alunge ngokulinganayo."
20261121-math-g05-2.principle: Umndilili yi-(isixa sazo zonke)÷(inani labantu), ngoko ukuba inani labantu liyafana kwaye imindilili iyafana, izixa ziyafana nazo (zombini zingama-120). Kodwa awunakuthi ixabiso elikhulu kakhulu, ixabiso elincinci kakhulu, nendlela zisasazeke ngayo ziyafana.
20261121-math-g05-2.example: Kukhetho ngalunye, hlola omnye ngomnye ukuba liyinyani na kwiirekhodi zeqela leSibhakabhaka neqela leLwandle.
20261121-math-g05-2.actionItem: Hlola, ngedatha nangomzekelo owenza ngokwakho, ukuba nokuba imindilili iyafana, indlela idatha esasazeke ngayo inokwahluka, uze wahlule oko umndilili ukuxelela kona nokungenako ukukuxelela.

20261121-math-g06-1.title: Ukugcina incasa yobisi lwesitrobheri ifana xa wenza ngakumbi
20261121-math-g06-1.summary: USuyeon wenze isiraphu yobisi lwesitrobheri ngeekopi ezi-3 zesitrobheri neekopi ezi-2 zobisi, yaye incasa yayilungile kanye. Ufuna ukwenza ngakumbi ngencasa efanayo, yaye uSuyeon ucinga, “Ukuba ndongeza iikopi ezi-3 ezongezelelweyo zesitrobheri, ndongeza iikopi ezi-3 ezongezelelweyo zobisi.”
20261121-math-g06-1.principle: Jonga ngedatha ukuba ukongeza amanani aphelele ngokufanayo kutshintsha incasa, uze ulungise ingqiqo yakho ngomlinganiselo ogcina umlinganiselo ufana.
20261121-math-g06-1.example: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, bhala umlinganiselo wesitrobheri kubisi ngendlela efanayo uze uthelekise.
20261121-math-g06-1.actionItem: Jonga ngedatha ukuba ukongeza amanani aphelele ngokufanayo kutshintsha incasa, uze ulungise ingqiqo yakho ngomlinganiselo ogcina umlinganiselo ufana.

20261121-math-g06-2.title: Ingaba Ijusi Egxininisiweyo Engakumbi Ithetha Ijusi Eyomeleleyo?
20261121-math-g06-2.summary: Evenkileni yeejusi, iijusi ezimbini zenziwe ngokuxuba igxininiso namanzi usebenzisa ikomityi enye. IJusi A isebenzisa iikomityi ezi-3 zegxininiso neekomityi ezi-5 zamanzi, kwaye iJusi B isebenzisa iikomityi ezi-4 zegxininiso neekomityi ezi-8 zamanzi. UHajun wathi, "B inegxininiso elingakumbi, iikomityi ezi-4, ngoko B iyomelele!" (Apha, "iyomelele" ithetha ukuba xa usela into efanayo, kukho igxininiso elingakumbi kuyo.)
20261121-math-g06-2.principle: Ukomelela kwejusi akuxhomekekanga kwigxininiso kuphela kodwa ngokuba kukho igxininiso elingakanani xa lithelekiswa nomxube wonke. A inee-komityi ezi-3 kwezi-8 zonke, kwaye B inee-komityi ezi-4 kwezi-12 zonke.
20261121-math-g06-2.example: Ukuba usela into efanayo (umzekelo, ikomityi enye), kukho igxininiso elingakanani kuyo?
20261121-math-g06-2.actionItem: Bonisa ngomzekelo ochasayo ukuba isibakala esithi "leyo inegxininiso elingakumbi isoloko iyomelele" asisoloko sisebenza, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni kufuneka uthelekise usebenzisa umlinganiselo wegxininiso kwisiqingatha sonke.

20261121-math-g07-1.title: Ingaba Amaxesha Amakhulu Athetha Ukuba Benze Ngcono?
20261121-math-g07-1.summary:
Iklasi 1 (abafundi abangama-20) neKlasi 2 (abafundi abangama-50) bathabathe uvavanyo olufanayo lwemathematika. Itheyibhile yokwabiwa kwamaxesha enamanqaku abekwe kwizithuba ezintathu imi ngolu hlobo.
Isithuba / Iklasi 1 (abafundi abangama-20) / Iklasi 2 (abafundi abangama-50)
Ngaphantsi kwamanqaku angama-60 / abafundi aba-2 / abafundi abali-10
Amanqaku angama-60 okanye ngaphezulu kodwa ngaphantsi kwama-80 / abafundi abali-10 / abafundi abangama-25
Amanqaku angama-80 okanye ngaphezulu / abafundi aba-8 / abafundi abali-15
UMinji uthe, "Kukho abafundi abaninzi abanamanqaku angama-80 okanye ngaphezulu kwiKlasi 2, abali-15, ngoko iKlasi 2 yenze ngcono kuvavanyo."
20261121-math-g07-1.principle: Ngokwezabelo, kumanqaku angama-80 okanye ngaphezulu, iKlasi 1 inama-8/20=40% kwaye iKlasi 2 inama-15/50=30%, ngoko iKlasi 1 iphezulu; kumanqaku angaphantsi kwama-60, iKlasi 1 inama-2/20=10% kwaye iKlasi 2 inama-10/50=20%, ngoko iKlasi 2 iphindwe ngo-2 kunoKlasi 1. Umndilili awunakwaziwa kwitheyibhile enezithuba ezibekiweyo, kwaye isigqibo esithelekisa kuphela inani labafundi sinenkxaso ebuthathaka.
20261121-math-g07-1.example: Kwiklasi nganye, yahlula inani labafundi kuloo sithuba ngenani elipheleleyo labafundi kuloo klasi.
20261121-math-g07-1.actionItem: Funda ingxaki yokuthelekisa amaxesha njengoko enjalo xa iiklasi ezimbini zinamanani ahlukeneyo abafundi, uze wahlule oko itheyibhile ikuvumela ukuba ukuthi ngokuqinisekileyo kunoko ungakuthi.

20261121-math-g07-2.title: Ukufunda igrafu yokuphakama kwamanzi eyenziwe ngamachaphazelo
20261121-math-g07-2.summary: Silinganise ukuphakama kwamanzi ngexesha lokuthulula amanzi kwitanki. I-axis ethe tye ngamaxesha (imizuzu) yaye i-axis ethe nkqo kukuphakama (cm). Sibhala (ixesha, ukuphakama) njengesibini esilandelanayo siyizobe njengechaphazelo kwisicwangciso sokulungelelanisa. Amachaphazelo amaninzi aveziwe ngexesha elinye.
20261121-math-g07-2.principle: Njengoko amachaphazelo ongezwa omnye emva komnye, qikelela ipatheni, ulungise uqikelelo lwakho xa amachaphazelo amatsha evela, uze ucinge ukuba ungaqiniseka ngamaxabiso aphakathi kwamachaphazelo.
20261121-math-g07-2.example: Thelekisa ukuba ukuphakama kwamachaphazelo kutshintsha kangakanani ngalo lonke ixesha ixesha lonyuka ngomzuzu o-1.
20261121-math-g07-2.actionItem: Njengoko amachaphazelo ongezwa omnye emva komnye, qikelela ipatheni, ulungise uqikelelo lwakho xa amachaphazelo amatsha evela, uze ucinge ukuba ungaqiniseka ngamaxabiso aphakathi kwamachaphazelo.

20261121-math-g08-1.title: Zeziphi iinqaku esizifunayo ukufumana amaxabiso?
20261121-math-g08-1.summary: Sifuna ukufumana ixabiso lepensile enye, x won, nelencwadi yokubhala enye, y won, kwivenkile yezixhobo zokubhala. Umnini wasibonisa amanqaku ama-5 enyaniso. Inqaku A: Iipensile ezi-2 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-3 zibiza i-3,100 won. Inqaku B: Iipensile ezi-4 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-6 zibiza i-6,200 won. Inqaku C: Incwadi yokubhala ibiza i-200 won ngaphezu kwepensile. Inqaku D: Iipensile ezi-6 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-9 zibiza i-9,300 won. Inqaku E: Iipensile ezi-5 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-5 zibiza i-6,000 won.
20261121-math-g08-1.principle: Amaqhinga A, B no-D anomlinganiselo ofanayo weepensile kwiincwadi zokubhala, 2:3, kwaye izixa zawo ziziphindaphindi ezifanayo (ihlandlo eli-1, amahlandlo ama-2, amahlandlo ama-3), ngoko aphinda ulwazi olufanayo. Ngala maqhinga kuphela, awunakuyimisela into enye esisisombululo. Ukuba udibanisa amaqhinga anemilinganiselo eyahlukileyo yamanani (C, E), ulingano olubini lunika ulwazi olwahlukileyo, ngoko amaxabiso ayamiselwa. (Ipensile 500 won, incwadi yokubhala 700 won)
20261121-math-g08-1.example: Phinda ubhale amaqhinga ngohlobo 'iipensile □ + iincwadi zokubhala □ = □원' uze uthelekise amaqhinga amabini ecaleni kwelinye.
20261121-math-g08-1.actionItem: Xa usenza ukulingana ngaxeshanye, gwebela ukuba ukulingana kunika ulwazi olwahlukileyo na, uze wenze wena ukulingana okunganiki lwazi lutsha.

20261121-math-g08-2.title: Ithuba lentloko e-1 kuphela ngeengqekembe ezimbini
20261121-math-g08-2.summary: Phosa iingqekembe ezimbini ezilungileyo ngaxeshanye, kanye. Ukuba uchaza isiphumo ngenani lamakhanda kuphela, kukho 0, 1, okanye 2. Jonga indlela ingcinga yakho 'ngethuba lentloko e-1 kuphela' etshintsha ngayo ngobungqina.
20261121-math-g08-2.principle: Hlola ngobungqina ukuba iimeko ezibaliwe 'ngenani lamakhanda' azenzeki ngokulinganayo, uze uhlaziye isigwebo sakho sokuqala ngethuba.
20261121-math-g08-2.example: Qala ucinge ukuba loluphi isigwebo esinokwenzeka 'ngobungqina obubonayo ngoku kuphela.'
20261121-math-g08-2.actionItem: Hlola ngobungqina ukuba iimeko ezibaliwe 'ngenani lamakhanda' azenzeki ngokulinganayo, uze uhlaziye isigwebo sakho sokuqala ngethuba.

20261121-math-g09-1.title: Ukuba sin A=3/5, ingaba iyafana nokuba unxantathu uba mkhulu?
20261121-math-g09-1.summary: Kunxantathu oneengile ethe nkqo ABC, ∠C=90°, icala BC licala elichasene ne-∠A, icala AC licala elikufuphi ne-∠A (hayi ihayipothenyusi), kwaye icala AB yihayipothenyusi. sin A ifundwa 'sayini A' kwaye cos A ifundwa 'khosayini A.' Kula nxantathu, sin A=3/5 (3 phezu kwe-5).
20261121-math-g09-1.principle: Ukuba wandisa onke amacala amathathu ngesiphindaphindi esifanayo, njenge-(AB, BC, AC)=(5, 3, 4), (10, 6, 8), (15, 9, 12), sin A=3/5 ihlala injalo.
20261121-math-g09-1.example: Njengomzekelo olula kakhulu, xa BC=3 kunye ne-AB=5, fumana ubude becala eliseleyo AC ngetheorem kaPythagoras.
20261121-math-g09-1.actionItem: Yenza onxantathu abaneengile ethe nkqo abaninzi abanexabiso elifanayo le-sin A, uvavanye izibakala zabafundi ababini usebenzisa iziphumo, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni umlinganiselo wetrigonometri umiselwa bubungakanani beengile.

20261121-math-g09-2.title: Kufuneka sibuze ntoni ukumisela umsebenzi omnye wequadratic?
20261121-math-g09-2.summary: Sifuna ukufumana ikhweshini yomsebenzi wequadratic y=ax²+bx+c (a ayingo-0). (y ifundwa 'y ilingana no-a x isikwere kudibaniswe no-b x kudibaniswe no-c.') Umhlobo uza kukuxelela ulwazi ngegrafu iqhekeza elinye ngexesha.
20261121-math-g09-2.principle: 'Incopho nechaphaza elinye' imiselwa ngokufaka (0, 3) kwi-y=a(x-2)²-1, nto leyo enika a=1. 'Amachaphaza amathathu' amiselwa ngokufaka (0, 3) kwi-y=a(x-1)(x-3), nto leyo enika a=1. Kwamanye amaqhekeza amathathu olwazi, naxabiso lika-a okanye ukuphakama kwencopho akumiselwanga, ngoko zikho ikhweshini ezininzi.
20261121-math-g09-2.example: Sebenza ukuba zikho imisebenzi emibini okanye ngaphezulu eyahlukileyo yequadratic ehambelana nolwazi ngalunye.
20261121-math-g09-2.actionItem: Hlela ulwazi olwaneleyo ukumisela ikhweshini enye yomsebenzi wequadratic y=ax²+bx+c kulo olungonelanga, uze ugqibe ukuba loluphi umbuzo owongezelelweyo ekufuneka ububuzwe xa lungonelanga.

20261121-math-g10-1.title: Ngaba umgca uya kuchukumisa isangqa? Xa ulwazi luvezwa isiqwenga esinye ngexesha
20261121-math-g10-1.summary: Kukho isangqa x²+y²=25 (isazulu kwimvelaphi, irediyasi 5) nomgca y=x+k. Tshintsha ixabiso lika-k ujonge inani lamachaphaza apho umgca nesangqa zidibana khona.
20261121-math-g10-1.principle: Xela indawo yomgca nesangqa ngokuxhomekeke kwixabiso lengxelo engatshintshiyo k, uhlaziye isigwebo sakho ngolwazi olutsha, uze unciphise uluhlu luka-k apho bechukumisana khona.
20261121-math-g10-1.example: Unokuhlola inani lamachaphaza okudibana ngezisombululo zekhweshini oyifumanayo ngokusombulula iikhweshini zomgca nesangqa kunye.
20261121-math-g10-1.actionItem: Xela indawo yomgca nesangqa ngokuxhomekeke kwixabiso lengxelo engatshintshiyo k, uhlaziye isigwebo sakho ngolwazi olutsha, uze unciphise uluhlu luka-k apho bechukumisana khona.

20261121-math-g10-2.title: Isisombululo sentsalela siphosakale phi?
20261121-math-g10-2.summary: Esi sisisombululo sikaMinjae sokufumana ikhonkco a ukuze intsalela ibe ngu-6 xa ipolynomial f(x)=x³+ax²+x+2 ihlulwa nge-x+1. (x³ kuthetha u-x e-cube, kwaye ax² kuthetha a iphindaphindwe ngesikwere sika-x.)
20261121-math-g10-2.principle: Umgca wesi-2 uphosakele. x+1 inokubhalwa njenge-x−(−1), ngoko intsalela yi-f(−1), hayi i-f(1). Imigca yesi-3 nesi-4 ilandela nje umgca wesi-2, ngoko ubalo olungaphakathi kuyo lulungile, kodwa iziphumo zayo ziphosakele.
20261121-math-g10-2.example: Bhala kwakhona i-x+1 ukuze umahluli abe nefom ye-x−(inani elithile).
20261121-math-g10-2.actionItem: Fumana umgca ophosakeleyo kwisisombululo esifumana intsalela, uyilungise, uze uhlole impendulo ephosakeleyo ngokuchasene nemeko yokuqala ukuqinisekisa impazamo.

20261121-math-g11-1.title: Fumana umgca onengxaki kwisisombululo selingano lelogarithm
20261121-math-g11-1.summary: UMinho wasombulula ulingano log₂(x−1) + log₂(x−3) = 3 waphendula, ‘Izisombululo zi-x=5 no-x=−1, ezimbini.’ Ukuyifunda ngokuvakalayo, ithi ‘log isiseko 2 se-(x ngokususa 1) ukongeza log isiseko 2 se-(x ngokususa 3) kulingana no-3’.
20261121-math-g11-1.principle: Indawo yokuqala apho kuphambuka khona ngumgca wesi-2. Xa isixa seelogarithm ezimbini sidityaniswa sibe lilogarithm enye, iimeko zexabiso elingaphakathi x−1>0 no-x−3>0 ziyanyamalala kugama, yaye ezo meko azibhalwanga ngokwahlukeneyo. Ngoko kumgca wesi-5 zombini iingcambu zamkelwa, yaye umgca wesi-6 sisigqibo eso. Ixabiso elingaphakathi kufuneka lipositivu, ngoko x>3 iyafuneka. Ukuba x=−1, ngoko x−1=−2 no-x−3=−4, amaxabiso angaphakathi anegethivu, ngoko ulingano alucacisiwe. Ukuba x=5, log₂4 + log₂2 = 2+1 = 3, ngoko liyabamba. Ngoko isisombululo lixabiso elinye x=5.
20261121-math-g11-1.example: Ngalo lonke ixesha ugama liguquka, funda ukhangela ukuba lithetha okufanayo nomgca wangaphambili.
20261121-math-g11-1.actionItem: Fumana uze ulungise ingxaki ebangelwa kukungakhangeli imeko yexabiso elingaphakathi kwilogarithm kwisisombululo selingano lelogarithm.

20261121-math-g11-2.title: Zingaphi onxantathu onokwenziwa ngamacala amabini ne-engile e-1?
20261121-math-g11-2.summary: Konxantathu ABC, ∠A=60° kwaye ubude becala BC bungu-a=7. Xa ubude becala CA, b, bunikiwe, unokumisela ubude c becala AB wenze unxantathu. (a, b, c ngamacala achasene nee-∠A, ∠B, ∠C. cos60°=1/2.) UGaeun wathi, 'Ukuba b inkulu kune-7, onxantathu ababini abanjalo bahlala benziwa.'
20261121-math-g11-2.principle: Ukusuka kwi-49=64+c²−8c, c²−8c+15=0, (c−3)(c−5)=0, ngoko c=3 okanye 5. Amaxabiso omabini apozithivu, ngoko onxantathu ababini banokwenziwa.
20261121-math-g11-2.example: Faka a=7, b=8, cos60°=1/2 kumthetho wekhosayini ubhale ulingano lwe-c.
20261121-math-g11-2.actionItem: Vavanya ukuqhelekisa 'zihlala zimbini' ngamaxabiso athile uze uchaze ngezizathu ukuba zeziphi iimeko apho kungabambi.

20261121-math-g12-1.title: Ithi ipositivu, kodwa umntu uyagula ngokwenene na?
20261121-math-g12-1.summary: Uvavanyo lwesifo esithile lwabonakala ‘lupositivu’. Ufuna ukwazi ithuba lokuba umntu onesiphumo esipositivu uneso sifo ngokwenene. Gqiba ukuba luluphi ulwazi olufunekayo ukumisela eli thuba.
20261121-math-g12-1.principle: Abo bavavanywe bepositivu benziwe ‘ngabagulayo abavavanywe bepositivu’ ‘nabaphilileyo abavavanywe bepositivu’. Ngoko kufuneka umlinganiselo wabagulayo, ithuba lokuba ogulayo avavanywe epositivu, nethuba lokuba ophilileyo avavanywe epositivu.
20261121-math-g12-1.example: Khumbula ukuba ngawaphi amaqela amabini abantu abavavanyiweyo abanesiphumo esipositivu banokwahlulwa.
20261121-math-g12-1.actionItem: Khetha ulwazi olufunekayo ukufumana ithuba elinemeko, uze uchaze ngamanani ukuba kutheni ukuchaneka kovavanyo kwahlukile kwi-‘ithuba lokugula xa isiphumo sipositivu’.

20261121-math-g12-2.title: Ukuba icala elibomvu liyabonakala, kuthekani ngangasemva?
20261121-math-g12-2.summary: Kukho amakhadi amathathu ebhokisini. Elinye libomvu macala omabini (ikhadi elibomvu-elibomvu), elinye libomvu kwelinye icala neluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kwelinye (ikhadi elibomvu-eluhlaza), kwaye elinye luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka macala omabini (ikhadi eluhlaza-eluhlaza). Ukhetha ikhadi elinye ngokungenamkhethe ubeke icala elinye etafileni, kwaye ibomvu liyabonakala. Cinga ngethuba lokuba icala langasemva nalo libomvu.
20261121-math-g12-2.principle: Phucula ukuqikelela kwakho kokuqala (1/2) usebenzisa idatha nokuhlalutya, uze ufumane ukuba yeyiphi umgca woqikelelo ophosakeleyo ukuze utolike ithuba elinemeko ngokuchanekileyo.
20261121-math-g12-2.example: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, bhala ukuba zeziphi iimeko ozibalayo.
20261121-math-g12-2.actionItem: Phucula ukuqikelela kwakho kokuqala (1/2) usebenzisa idatha nokuhlalutya, uze ufumane ukuba yeyiphi umgca woqikelelo ophosakeleyo ukuze utolike ithuba elinemeko ngokuchanekileyo.

20261122-math-g01-1.title: Linjani ubume bento esebhokisini?
20261122-math-g01-1.summary: Uzonyaniswe amehlo uva into esebhokisini, yaye uva imibono kanye kanye. Into esebhokisini yenye yobume bebhokisi, ubume besilinda, okanye ubume besibhakabhaka.
20261122-math-g01-1.principle: Ngalo lonke ixesha ufumana umbono omnye owongezelelekileyo, cutha iimilo ezinokwenzeka uze ulungise umbono wakho wokuqala ukuze uhambelane nombono omtsha.
20261122-math-g01-1.example: Bhala imo yebhokisi, imo yesilinda, nemo yebhola, kwaye kwisikhomba ngasinye phawula iimo ezinokwenzeka.
20261122-math-g01-1.actionItem: Ngalo lonke ixesha ufumana umbono omnye owongezelelekileyo, cutha iimilo ezinokwenzeka uze ulungise umbono wakho wokuqala ukuze uhambelane nombono omtsha.

20261122-math-g01-2.title: Ubude obulinganiswe ngeepepaklipu neegluu estiki: sesiphi esinde ngakumbi?
20261122-math-g01-2.summary: U-Minjun ulinganise ubude bepensile ngeepepaklipu waza wafumana iipepaklipu ezi-5. U-Seoyun ulinganise ubude bepensile enemibala ngeegluu estiki (iglu enjengentonga) waza wafumana iigluu estiki ezi-3. Bobabini bazibeke emgceni omnye macala ngamacala ngaphandle kwezikhewu. Sesiphi esinde, ipensile okanye ipensile enemibala?
20261122-math-g01-2.principle: Ipepaklipu negluu estiki zinobude obahlukileyo, ngoko awunakuthelekisa ngokujonga u-5 no-3 kuphela. Ukuba uyazi ukuba igluu estiki e-1 ingaphi iipepaklipu, unokuthelekisa ngeyunithi enye, kwaye unokuthelekisa ipensile nepensile enemibala ngqo ngokulungelelanisa isiphelo esinye.
20261122-math-g01-2.example: Ingaba ipepaklipu enye inobude obufanayo negluu estiki enye? Cinga ngoko kuqala.
20261122-math-g01-2.actionItem: Funda ukuba ubude obulinganiswe ngeeyunithi ezahlukileyo abunakuthelekiswa ngamanani odwa, ugqibe ukuba ufuna ulwazi luni ukubuthelekisa.

20261122-math-g02-1.title: Ingaba inani elilandela u-1, 2, 4 linye kuphela?
20261122-math-g02-1.summary: Umhlobo ekubeni sisigaba sethu udlala umdlalo wolandelelwano lwamanani apho babonisa amanani elinye ngexesha. Umhlobo ugqibe ngepatheni enye aze akuxelele inani elinye ngexesha.
20261122-math-g02-1.principle: Funda ukuba amanani okuqala ambalwa kuphela awamiseli ipatheni ibe yinye, nokuba kufuneka ulungise ipatheni xa inani elitsha licaciswa, uze wenze ulandelelwano lwamanani ohambelana nepatheni ngokwakho.
20261122-math-g02-1.actionItem: Funda ukuba amanani okuqala ambalwa kuphela awamiseli ipatheni ibe yinye, nokuba kufuneka ulungise ipatheni xa inani elitsha licaciswa, uze wenze ulandelelwano lwamanani ohambelana nepatheni ngokwakho.

20261122-math-g02-2.title: Fumana inani eliyimfihlo likaSuji
20261122-math-g02-2.summary:
USuji ukhethe inani elinamadijithi amathathu waza wanika izikhokelo.
Isikhokelo 1) Idijithi kwindawo yamashumi inkulu nge-2 kunedijithi kwindawo yeeyunithi.
Isikhokelo 2) Idijithi kwindawo yeeyunithi ayingu-0.
Isikhokelo 3) Idijithi kwindawo yamakhulu inkulu kunedijithi kwindawo yamashumi.
20261122-math-g02-2.principle: 420 inayo 0 kwindawo yeeyunithi, ngoko ichasene nesikhokelo 2, kwaye 353 inayo 3 kwindawo yamakhulu, encinci kune-5 kwindawo yamashumi, ngoko ichasene nesikhokelo 3. 642 no-975 bahlangabezana nazo zonke izikhokelo ezintathu.
20261122-math-g02-2.example: Khetha inani elinye uzivavanye ngezikhokelo 1, 2, no-3 ngokulandelelana.
20261122-math-g02-2.actionItem: Sebenzisa ixabiso lendawo ukufumana inani elinamadijithi amathathu elihlangabezana nezikhokelo ezininzi ngaxeshanye, uze ukhethe izikhokelo ngokuthelekisa ukuba mangaphi amanani ashiywa sisikhokelo ngasinye.

20261122-math-g03-1.title: Iindlela Ezahlukeneyo Zokwabelana Nge-72 Zeekhandi Phakathi Kweepleyiti
20261122-math-g03-1.summary: Ufuna ukubeka ii-72 zeekhandi kwiipleyiti, wabelane ngokulinganayo kungashiyeki nanye. Inani leekhandi kwipleyiti nganye litshintsha ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni zingaphi iipleyiti osebenzisa.
20261122-math-g03-1.principle: Unokwabelana ngokulinganayo kungashiyeki nanye kuphela xa inani leepleyiti liphindaphindwe linani leekhandi kwipleyiti enye li-72. 4×18, 6×12, kunye no-9×8 zi-72, kwaye akukho nani eliphindaphindwe ngo-5 okanye ngo-7 elenza i-72.
20261122-math-g03-1.example: Kwinani ngalinye leepleyiti, wahlula i-72 ngelo nani uze uhlole ukuba ikho intsalela na.
20261122-math-g03-1.actionItem: Fumana iindlela ezininzi zokwabelana ezihlangabezana neemeko (uluhlu lwenani leepleyiti nenani leekhandi kwipleyiti nganye) ngaxeshanye, uze uchaze indlela inani leepleyiti nenani leekhandi kwipleyiti enye eziqhagamshela ngayo.

20261122-math-g03-2.title: Ukufumana Impazamo Ekwabelaneni Kweekhandi KukaSeoyeon
20261122-math-g03-2.summary: USeoyeon ufuna ukwabelana nge-85 zeekhandi ngokulinganayo phakathi kwabantu aba-4. Funda isisombululo sikaSeoyeon. Isiphumo sokwahlula linani lalo ngamnye umntu alifumanayo, kwaye intsalela linani eliseleyo emva kokwabelana.
20261122-math-g03-2.principle: Umgca wesi-3 uphosakele. Ii-khandi ezi-5 ezishiyekileyo zinokwabelwana kwakhona, ikhandi e-1 ngakumbi kubantu aba-4 ngabanye, ngoko ukuthi 'azinakwabelwana ngakumbi' akulunganga. Ukuhlola kumgca wesi-4 kubonisa kuphela ukuba isivakalisi samanani siyahambelana; akubonisi ukuba intsalela ichanekile na.
20261122-math-g03-2.example: Kumgca ngamnye, bala omnye ngomnye ukuhlola ukuba oko ukuthethayo kunjalo ngokwenene.
20261122-math-g03-2.actionItem: Sebenzisa imeko yokuba intsalela kufuneka ibe ncinci kunomahluli ukufumana ulungise impazamo kwisisombululo, uze wahlule iimeko apho impazamo efanayo yenzeka khona nalapho ingenzeki khona.

20261122-math-g04-1.title: Ukuhlola Inkcazo ka-Seohyeon
20261122-math-g04-1.summary: U-Seohyeon wachaza oku kumhlobo. Kukho impazamo kule nkcazo.
20261122-math-g04-1.principle: Umgca 3 yindawo apho kuqala ukuphosa. Isikwere sinamacala amane alinganayo, kodwa oko akuthethi okuchasene, "ukuba amacala amane alinganayo, sisikwere." Umgca 4 uqhubeka nempazamo efanayo, kodwa indawo yokuqala engalunganga ngumgca 3.
20261122-math-g04-1.example: Funda umgca ngamnye ubhalwe kwakhona ngefom "ukuba ..., ngoko ...," ubhale kumgca ngamnye ukuba uya kwicala elifanayo nesibakala somgca wangaphambili.
20261122-math-g04-1.actionItem: Fumana impazamo yengqiqo kwinkcazo ethi 'Ukuba onke amacala amane ayafana, sisikwere,' uze uchaze iquadrilateral ngumzekelo ochasayo.

20261122-math-g04-2.title: Iphosakale Phi Xa Kutshintshwa Kwaba Ngamadijithi?
20261122-math-g04-2.summary: UMinseo wabhala isisombululo sokubhala 'amawaka amathathu amashumi amabini anesihlanu amawaka ali-10, amawaka amane nesithandathu' ngamadijithi.
20261122-math-g04-2.principle: Umgca wesi-3 yindawo yokuqala ephosakeleyo. Kumawaka amane nesithandathu, indawo yamawaka yi-4 kwaye indawo yeeyunithi yi-6, kwaye iindawo zamakhulu namashumi zazingafundwanga kodwa ziyi-0, ngoko yi-4006. Imigca yesi-4 nesi-5 iphosakele kuba iqhuba ixabiso eliphosakeleyo elisuka kumgca wesi-3.
20261122-math-g04-2.example: Kumgca ngamnye, hlola omnye ngomnye ukuba 'amagama afundwayo' 'namadijithi abhaliweyo' ayahambelana na.
20261122-math-g04-2.actionItem: Fumana umgca ophosakeleyo kwisisombululo esitshintsha inani elikhulu elifundwe ngamagama laba ngamadijithi, uze ulungise usebenzisa ii-0 kwiindawo ezingafundwanga.

20261122-math-g05-1.title: Inani Lamaqela Okwabelana Ngokulinganayo: Ukulungisa Isisombululo
20261122-math-g05-1.summary: Ufuna ukwabelana ngeelekese ezingama-48 neetshokolethi ezingama-36 ngokulinganayo ungashiyi nto phakathi kwamaqela amaninzi. UHayun wafumana inani lamaqela ngolu hlobo.
20261122-math-g05-1.principle: Umgca 2 yindawo yokuqala engachanekanga. Inani lamaqela ahlulwa ngama-48 ngokulinganayo kufuneka libe linani elihlula ama-48 ngokulinganayo, oko kukuthi, isahluli sama-48. Isiphindaphindi sinokuba sikhulu kunama-48, yaye emva koko iilekese aziphelelanga. Umgca 4 uthi into eya kushiya amaqela athile engenalekese nanye kumaqela angama-144. Umgca 1 ukopishe ingxaki kakuhle, yaye u-144 emgceni 3 uchanekile njengesiphindaphindi esiqhelekileyo esincinane kakhulu sama-48 nama-36.
20261122-math-g05-1.example: Funda umgca ngamnye ucinge ukuba oko kuthethwa kunokwenzeka ngokwenene kwimeko eneelekese ezingama-48 neetshokolethi ezingama-36.
20261122-math-g05-1.actionItem: Fumana uze ulungise indawo kwisisombululo apho kwakhethwa ubudlelwane obungachanekanga phakathi kwamanani (isahluli/isiphindaphindi), uze ucinge ngazo zonke iimeko ezihambelana neemeko.

20261122-math-g05-2.title: Ukuba Imindilili Iyafana, Ingaba Amaqela Amabini Ayafana?
20261122-math-g05-2.summary: Iqela leSibhakabhaka neqela leLwandle zithumele abantu aba-4 ngalinye kukhuphiswano lokutsiba intambo. Iirekhodi zeqela leSibhakabhaka (inani lokutsiba) zingama-20, 22, 24, nama-54, kwaye iirekhodi zeqela leLwandle zingama-28, 29, 30, nama-33. Imindilili yawo omabini amaqela ifana, ngama-30. UDoha wathi, "Imindilili iyafana, ngoko amaqela amabini alunge ngokulinganayo."
20261122-math-g05-2.principle: Umndilili yi-(isixa sazo zonke)÷(inani labantu), ngoko ukuba inani labantu liyafana kwaye imindilili iyafana, izixa ziyafana nazo (zombini zingama-120). Kodwa awunakuthi ixabiso elikhulu kakhulu, ixabiso elincinci kakhulu, nendlela zisasazeke ngayo ziyafana.
20261122-math-g05-2.example: Kukhetho ngalunye, hlola omnye ngomnye ukuba liyinyani na kwiirekhodi zeqela leSibhakabhaka neqela leLwandle.
20261122-math-g05-2.actionItem: Hlola, ngedatha nangomzekelo owenza ngokwakho, ukuba nokuba imindilili iyafana, indlela idatha esasazeke ngayo inokwahluka, uze wahlule oko umndilili ukuxelela kona nokungenako ukukuxelela.

20261122-math-g06-1.title: Ukugcina incasa yobisi lwesitrobheri ifana xa wenza ngakumbi
20261122-math-g06-1.summary: USuyeon wenze isiraphu yobisi lwesitrobheri ngeekopi ezi-3 zesitrobheri neekopi ezi-2 zobisi, yaye incasa yayilungile kanye. Ufuna ukwenza ngakumbi ngencasa efanayo, yaye uSuyeon ucinga, “Ukuba ndongeza iikopi ezi-3 ezongezelelweyo zesitrobheri, ndongeza iikopi ezi-3 ezongezelelweyo zobisi.”
20261122-math-g06-1.principle: Jonga ngedatha ukuba ukongeza amanani aphelele ngokufanayo kutshintsha incasa, uze ulungise ingqiqo yakho ngomlinganiselo ogcina umlinganiselo ufana.
20261122-math-g06-1.example: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, bhala umlinganiselo wesitrobheri kubisi ngendlela efanayo uze uthelekise.
20261122-math-g06-1.actionItem: Jonga ngedatha ukuba ukongeza amanani aphelele ngokufanayo kutshintsha incasa, uze ulungise ingqiqo yakho ngomlinganiselo ogcina umlinganiselo ufana.

20261122-math-g06-2.title: Ingaba Ijusi Egxininisiweyo Engakumbi Ithetha Ijusi Eyomeleleyo?
20261122-math-g06-2.summary: Evenkileni yeejusi, iijusi ezimbini zenziwe ngokuxuba igxininiso namanzi usebenzisa ikomityi enye. IJusi A isebenzisa iikomityi ezi-3 zegxininiso neekomityi ezi-5 zamanzi, kwaye iJusi B isebenzisa iikomityi ezi-4 zegxininiso neekomityi ezi-8 zamanzi. UHajun wathi, "B inegxininiso elingakumbi, iikomityi ezi-4, ngoko B iyomelele!" (Apha, "iyomelele" ithetha ukuba xa usela into efanayo, kukho igxininiso elingakumbi kuyo.)
20261122-math-g06-2.principle: Ukomelela kwejusi akuxhomekekanga kwigxininiso kuphela kodwa ngokuba kukho igxininiso elingakanani xa lithelekiswa nomxube wonke. A inee-komityi ezi-3 kwezi-8 zonke, kwaye B inee-komityi ezi-4 kwezi-12 zonke.
20261122-math-g06-2.example: Ukuba usela into efanayo (umzekelo, ikomityi enye), kukho igxininiso elingakanani kuyo?
20261122-math-g06-2.actionItem: Bonisa ngomzekelo ochasayo ukuba isibakala esithi "leyo inegxininiso elingakumbi isoloko iyomelele" asisoloko sisebenza, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni kufuneka uthelekise usebenzisa umlinganiselo wegxininiso kwisiqingatha sonke.

20261122-math-g07-1.title: Ingaba Amaxesha Amakhulu Athetha Ukuba Benze Ngcono?
20261122-math-g07-1.summary:
Iklasi 1 (abafundi abangama-20) neKlasi 2 (abafundi abangama-50) bathabathe uvavanyo olufanayo lwemathematika. Itheyibhile yokwabiwa kwamaxesha enamanqaku abekwe kwizithuba ezintathu imi ngolu hlobo.
Isithuba / Iklasi 1 (abafundi abangama-20) / Iklasi 2 (abafundi abangama-50)
Ngaphantsi kwamanqaku angama-60 / abafundi aba-2 / abafundi abali-10
Amanqaku angama-60 okanye ngaphezulu kodwa ngaphantsi kwama-80 / abafundi abali-10 / abafundi abangama-25
Amanqaku angama-80 okanye ngaphezulu / abafundi aba-8 / abafundi abali-15
UMinji uthe, "Kukho abafundi abaninzi abanamanqaku angama-80 okanye ngaphezulu kwiKlasi 2, abali-15, ngoko iKlasi 2 yenze ngcono kuvavanyo."
20261122-math-g07-1.principle: Ngokwezabelo, kumanqaku angama-80 okanye ngaphezulu, iKlasi 1 inama-8/20=40% kwaye iKlasi 2 inama-15/50=30%, ngoko iKlasi 1 iphezulu; kumanqaku angaphantsi kwama-60, iKlasi 1 inama-2/20=10% kwaye iKlasi 2 inama-10/50=20%, ngoko iKlasi 2 iphindwe ngo-2 kunoKlasi 1. Umndilili awunakwaziwa kwitheyibhile enezithuba ezibekiweyo, kwaye isigqibo esithelekisa kuphela inani labafundi sinenkxaso ebuthathaka.
20261122-math-g07-1.example: Kwiklasi nganye, yahlula inani labafundi kuloo sithuba ngenani elipheleleyo labafundi kuloo klasi.
20261122-math-g07-1.actionItem: Funda ingxaki yokuthelekisa amaxesha njengoko enjalo xa iiklasi ezimbini zinamanani ahlukeneyo abafundi, uze wahlule oko itheyibhile ikuvumela ukuba ukuthi ngokuqinisekileyo kunoko ungakuthi.

20261122-math-g07-2.title: Ukufunda igrafu yokuphakama kwamanzi eyenziwe ngamachaphazelo
20261122-math-g07-2.summary: Silinganise ukuphakama kwamanzi ngexesha lokuthulula amanzi kwitanki. I-axis ethe tye ngamaxesha (imizuzu) yaye i-axis ethe nkqo kukuphakama (cm). Sibhala (ixesha, ukuphakama) njengesibini esilandelanayo siyizobe njengechaphazelo kwisicwangciso sokulungelelanisa. Amachaphazelo amaninzi aveziwe ngexesha elinye.
20261122-math-g07-2.principle: Njengoko amachaphazelo ongezwa omnye emva komnye, qikelela ipatheni, ulungise uqikelelo lwakho xa amachaphazelo amatsha evela, uze ucinge ukuba ungaqiniseka ngamaxabiso aphakathi kwamachaphazelo.
20261122-math-g07-2.example: Thelekisa ukuba ukuphakama kwamachaphazelo kutshintsha kangakanani ngalo lonke ixesha ixesha lonyuka ngomzuzu o-1.
20261122-math-g07-2.actionItem: Njengoko amachaphazelo ongezwa omnye emva komnye, qikelela ipatheni, ulungise uqikelelo lwakho xa amachaphazelo amatsha evela, uze ucinge ukuba ungaqiniseka ngamaxabiso aphakathi kwamachaphazelo.

20261122-math-g08-1.title: Zeziphi iinqaku esizifunayo ukufumana amaxabiso?
20261122-math-g08-1.summary: Sifuna ukufumana ixabiso lepensile enye, x won, nelencwadi yokubhala enye, y won, kwivenkile yezixhobo zokubhala. Umnini wasibonisa amanqaku ama-5 enyaniso. Inqaku A: Iipensile ezi-2 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-3 zibiza i-3,100 won. Inqaku B: Iipensile ezi-4 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-6 zibiza i-6,200 won. Inqaku C: Incwadi yokubhala ibiza i-200 won ngaphezu kwepensile. Inqaku D: Iipensile ezi-6 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-9 zibiza i-9,300 won. Inqaku E: Iipensile ezi-5 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-5 zibiza i-6,000 won.
20261122-math-g08-1.principle: Amaqhinga A, B no-D anomlinganiselo ofanayo weepensile kwiincwadi zokubhala, 2:3, kwaye izixa zawo ziziphindaphindi ezifanayo (ihlandlo eli-1, amahlandlo ama-2, amahlandlo ama-3), ngoko aphinda ulwazi olufanayo. Ngala maqhinga kuphela, awunakuyimisela into enye esisisombululo. Ukuba udibanisa amaqhinga anemilinganiselo eyahlukileyo yamanani (C, E), ulingano olubini lunika ulwazi olwahlukileyo, ngoko amaxabiso ayamiselwa. (Ipensile 500 won, incwadi yokubhala 700 won)
20261122-math-g08-1.example: Phinda ubhale amaqhinga ngohlobo 'iipensile □ + iincwadi zokubhala □ = □원' uze uthelekise amaqhinga amabini ecaleni kwelinye.
20261122-math-g08-1.actionItem: Xa usenza ukulingana ngaxeshanye, gwebela ukuba ukulingana kunika ulwazi olwahlukileyo na, uze wenze wena ukulingana okunganiki lwazi lutsha.

20261122-math-g08-2.title: Ithuba lentloko e-1 kuphela ngeengqekembe ezimbini
20261122-math-g08-2.summary: Phosa iingqekembe ezimbini ezilungileyo ngaxeshanye, kanye. Ukuba uchaza isiphumo ngenani lamakhanda kuphela, kukho 0, 1, okanye 2. Jonga indlela ingcinga yakho 'ngethuba lentloko e-1 kuphela' etshintsha ngayo ngobungqina.
20261122-math-g08-2.principle: Hlola ngobungqina ukuba iimeko ezibaliwe 'ngenani lamakhanda' azenzeki ngokulinganayo, uze uhlaziye isigwebo sakho sokuqala ngethuba.
20261122-math-g08-2.example: Qala ucinge ukuba loluphi isigwebo esinokwenzeka 'ngobungqina obubonayo ngoku kuphela.'
20261122-math-g08-2.actionItem: Hlola ngobungqina ukuba iimeko ezibaliwe 'ngenani lamakhanda' azenzeki ngokulinganayo, uze uhlaziye isigwebo sakho sokuqala ngethuba.

20261122-math-g09-1.title: Ukuba sin A=3/5, ingaba iyafana nokuba unxantathu uba mkhulu?
20261122-math-g09-1.summary: Kunxantathu oneengile ethe nkqo ABC, ∠C=90°, icala BC licala elichasene ne-∠A, icala AC licala elikufuphi ne-∠A (hayi ihayipothenyusi), kwaye icala AB yihayipothenyusi. sin A ifundwa 'sayini A' kwaye cos A ifundwa 'khosayini A.' Kula nxantathu, sin A=3/5 (3 phezu kwe-5).
20261122-math-g09-1.principle: Ukuba wandisa onke amacala amathathu ngesiphindaphindi esifanayo, njenge-(AB, BC, AC)=(5, 3, 4), (10, 6, 8), (15, 9, 12), sin A=3/5 ihlala injalo.
20261122-math-g09-1.example: Njengomzekelo olula kakhulu, xa BC=3 kunye ne-AB=5, fumana ubude becala eliseleyo AC ngetheorem kaPythagoras.
20261122-math-g09-1.actionItem: Yenza onxantathu abaneengile ethe nkqo abaninzi abanexabiso elifanayo le-sin A, uvavanye izibakala zabafundi ababini usebenzisa iziphumo, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni umlinganiselo wetrigonometri umiselwa bubungakanani beengile.

20261122-math-g09-2.title: Kufuneka sibuze ntoni ukumisela umsebenzi omnye wequadratic?
20261122-math-g09-2.summary: Sifuna ukufumana ikhweshini yomsebenzi wequadratic y=ax²+bx+c (a ayingo-0). (y ifundwa 'y ilingana no-a x isikwere kudibaniswe no-b x kudibaniswe no-c.') Umhlobo uza kukuxelela ulwazi ngegrafu iqhekeza elinye ngexesha.
20261122-math-g09-2.principle: 'Incopho nechaphaza elinye' imiselwa ngokufaka (0, 3) kwi-y=a(x-2)²-1, nto leyo enika a=1. 'Amachaphaza amathathu' amiselwa ngokufaka (0, 3) kwi-y=a(x-1)(x-3), nto leyo enika a=1. Kwamanye amaqhekeza amathathu olwazi, naxabiso lika-a okanye ukuphakama kwencopho akumiselwanga, ngoko zikho ikhweshini ezininzi.
20261122-math-g09-2.example: Sebenza ukuba zikho imisebenzi emibini okanye ngaphezulu eyahlukileyo yequadratic ehambelana nolwazi ngalunye.
20261122-math-g09-2.actionItem: Hlela ulwazi olwaneleyo ukumisela ikhweshini enye yomsebenzi wequadratic y=ax²+bx+c kulo olungonelanga, uze ugqibe ukuba loluphi umbuzo owongezelelweyo ekufuneka ububuzwe xa lungonelanga.

20261122-math-g10-1.title: Ngaba umgca uya kuchukumisa isangqa? Xa ulwazi luvezwa isiqwenga esinye ngexesha
20261122-math-g10-1.summary: Kukho isangqa x²+y²=25 (isazulu kwimvelaphi, irediyasi 5) nomgca y=x+k. Tshintsha ixabiso lika-k ujonge inani lamachaphaza apho umgca nesangqa zidibana khona.
20261122-math-g10-1.principle: Xela indawo yomgca nesangqa ngokuxhomekeke kwixabiso lengxelo engatshintshiyo k, uhlaziye isigwebo sakho ngolwazi olutsha, uze unciphise uluhlu luka-k apho bechukumisana khona.
20261122-math-g10-1.example: Unokuhlola inani lamachaphaza okudibana ngezisombululo zekhweshini oyifumanayo ngokusombulula iikhweshini zomgca nesangqa kunye.
20261122-math-g10-1.actionItem: Xela indawo yomgca nesangqa ngokuxhomekeke kwixabiso lengxelo engatshintshiyo k, uhlaziye isigwebo sakho ngolwazi olutsha, uze unciphise uluhlu luka-k apho bechukumisana khona.

20261122-math-g10-2.title: Isisombululo sentsalela siphosakale phi?
20261122-math-g10-2.summary: Esi sisisombululo sikaMinjae sokufumana ikhonkco a ukuze intsalela ibe ngu-6 xa ipolynomial f(x)=x³+ax²+x+2 ihlulwa nge-x+1. (x³ kuthetha u-x e-cube, kwaye ax² kuthetha a iphindaphindwe ngesikwere sika-x.)
20261122-math-g10-2.principle: Umgca wesi-2 uphosakele. x+1 inokubhalwa njenge-x−(−1), ngoko intsalela yi-f(−1), hayi i-f(1). Imigca yesi-3 nesi-4 ilandela nje umgca wesi-2, ngoko ubalo olungaphakathi kuyo lulungile, kodwa iziphumo zayo ziphosakele.
20261122-math-g10-2.example: Bhala kwakhona i-x+1 ukuze umahluli abe nefom ye-x−(inani elithile).
20261122-math-g10-2.actionItem: Fumana umgca ophosakeleyo kwisisombululo esifumana intsalela, uyilungise, uze uhlole impendulo ephosakeleyo ngokuchasene nemeko yokuqala ukuqinisekisa impazamo.

20261122-math-g11-1.title: Fumana umgca onengxaki kwisisombululo selingano lelogarithm
20261122-math-g11-1.summary: UMinho wasombulula ulingano log₂(x−1) + log₂(x−3) = 3 waphendula, ‘Izisombululo zi-x=5 no-x=−1, ezimbini.’ Ukuyifunda ngokuvakalayo, ithi ‘log isiseko 2 se-(x ngokususa 1) ukongeza log isiseko 2 se-(x ngokususa 3) kulingana no-3’.
20261122-math-g11-1.principle: Indawo yokuqala apho kuphambuka khona ngumgca wesi-2. Xa isixa seelogarithm ezimbini sidityaniswa sibe lilogarithm enye, iimeko zexabiso elingaphakathi x−1>0 no-x−3>0 ziyanyamalala kugama, yaye ezo meko azibhalwanga ngokwahlukeneyo. Ngoko kumgca wesi-5 zombini iingcambu zamkelwa, yaye umgca wesi-6 sisigqibo eso. Ixabiso elingaphakathi kufuneka lipositivu, ngoko x>3 iyafuneka. Ukuba x=−1, ngoko x−1=−2 no-x−3=−4, amaxabiso angaphakathi anegethivu, ngoko ulingano alucacisiwe. Ukuba x=5, log₂4 + log₂2 = 2+1 = 3, ngoko liyabamba. Ngoko isisombululo lixabiso elinye x=5.
20261122-math-g11-1.example: Ngalo lonke ixesha ugama liguquka, funda ukhangela ukuba lithetha okufanayo nomgca wangaphambili.
20261122-math-g11-1.actionItem: Fumana uze ulungise ingxaki ebangelwa kukungakhangeli imeko yexabiso elingaphakathi kwilogarithm kwisisombululo selingano lelogarithm.

20261122-math-g11-2.title: Zingaphi onxantathu onokwenziwa ngamacala amabini ne-engile e-1?
20261122-math-g11-2.summary: Konxantathu ABC, ∠A=60° kwaye ubude becala BC bungu-a=7. Xa ubude becala CA, b, bunikiwe, unokumisela ubude c becala AB wenze unxantathu. (a, b, c ngamacala achasene nee-∠A, ∠B, ∠C. cos60°=1/2.) UGaeun wathi, 'Ukuba b inkulu kune-7, onxantathu ababini abanjalo bahlala benziwa.'
20261122-math-g11-2.principle: Ukusuka kwi-49=64+c²−8c, c²−8c+15=0, (c−3)(c−5)=0, ngoko c=3 okanye 5. Amaxabiso omabini apozithivu, ngoko onxantathu ababini banokwenziwa.
20261122-math-g11-2.example: Faka a=7, b=8, cos60°=1/2 kumthetho wekhosayini ubhale ulingano lwe-c.
20261122-math-g11-2.actionItem: Vavanya ukuqhelekisa 'zihlala zimbini' ngamaxabiso athile uze uchaze ngezizathu ukuba zeziphi iimeko apho kungabambi.

20261122-math-g12-1.title: Ithi ipositivu, kodwa umntu uyagula ngokwenene na?
20261122-math-g12-1.summary: Uvavanyo lwesifo esithile lwabonakala ‘lupositivu’. Ufuna ukwazi ithuba lokuba umntu onesiphumo esipositivu uneso sifo ngokwenene. Gqiba ukuba luluphi ulwazi olufunekayo ukumisela eli thuba.
20261122-math-g12-1.principle: Abo bavavanywe bepositivu benziwe ‘ngabagulayo abavavanywe bepositivu’ ‘nabaphilileyo abavavanywe bepositivu’. Ngoko kufuneka umlinganiselo wabagulayo, ithuba lokuba ogulayo avavanywe epositivu, nethuba lokuba ophilileyo avavanywe epositivu.
20261122-math-g12-1.example: Khumbula ukuba ngawaphi amaqela amabini abantu abavavanyiweyo abanesiphumo esipositivu banokwahlulwa.
20261122-math-g12-1.actionItem: Khetha ulwazi olufunekayo ukufumana ithuba elinemeko, uze uchaze ngamanani ukuba kutheni ukuchaneka kovavanyo kwahlukile kwi-‘ithuba lokugula xa isiphumo sipositivu’.

20261122-math-g12-2.title: Ukuba icala elibomvu liyabonakala, kuthekani ngangasemva?
20261122-math-g12-2.summary: Kukho amakhadi amathathu ebhokisini. Elinye libomvu macala omabini (ikhadi elibomvu-elibomvu), elinye libomvu kwelinye icala neluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kwelinye (ikhadi elibomvu-eluhlaza), kwaye elinye luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka macala omabini (ikhadi eluhlaza-eluhlaza). Ukhetha ikhadi elinye ngokungenamkhethe ubeke icala elinye etafileni, kwaye ibomvu liyabonakala. Cinga ngethuba lokuba icala langasemva nalo libomvu.
20261122-math-g12-2.principle: Phucula ukuqikelela kwakho kokuqala (1/2) usebenzisa idatha nokuhlalutya, uze ufumane ukuba yeyiphi umgca woqikelelo ophosakeleyo ukuze utolike ithuba elinemeko ngokuchanekileyo.
20261122-math-g12-2.example: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, bhala ukuba zeziphi iimeko ozibalayo.
20261122-math-g12-2.actionItem: Phucula ukuqikelela kwakho kokuqala (1/2) usebenzisa idatha nokuhlalutya, uze ufumane ukuba yeyiphi umgca woqikelelo ophosakeleyo ukuze utolike ithuba elinemeko ngokuchanekileyo.

20261123-math-g01-1.title: Linjani ubume bento esebhokisini?
20261123-math-g01-1.summary: Uzonyaniswe amehlo uva into esebhokisini, yaye uva imibono kanye kanye. Into esebhokisini yenye yobume bebhokisi, ubume besilinda, okanye ubume besibhakabhaka.
20261123-math-g01-1.principle: Ngalo lonke ixesha ufumana umbono omnye owongezelelekileyo, cutha iimilo ezinokwenzeka uze ulungise umbono wakho wokuqala ukuze uhambelane nombono omtsha.
20261123-math-g01-1.example: Bhala imo yebhokisi, imo yesilinda, nemo yebhola, kwaye kwisikhomba ngasinye phawula iimo ezinokwenzeka.
20261123-math-g01-1.actionItem: Ngalo lonke ixesha ufumana umbono omnye owongezelelekileyo, cutha iimilo ezinokwenzeka uze ulungise umbono wakho wokuqala ukuze uhambelane nombono omtsha.

20261123-math-g01-2.title: Ubude obulinganiswe ngeepepaklipu neegluu estiki: sesiphi esinde ngakumbi?
20261123-math-g01-2.summary: U-Minjun ulinganise ubude bepensile ngeepepaklipu waza wafumana iipepaklipu ezi-5. U-Seoyun ulinganise ubude bepensile enemibala ngeegluu estiki (iglu enjengentonga) waza wafumana iigluu estiki ezi-3. Bobabini bazibeke emgceni omnye macala ngamacala ngaphandle kwezikhewu. Sesiphi esinde, ipensile okanye ipensile enemibala?
20261123-math-g01-2.principle: Ipepaklipu negluu estiki zinobude obahlukileyo, ngoko awunakuthelekisa ngokujonga u-5 no-3 kuphela. Ukuba uyazi ukuba igluu estiki e-1 ingaphi iipepaklipu, unokuthelekisa ngeyunithi enye, kwaye unokuthelekisa ipensile nepensile enemibala ngqo ngokulungelelanisa isiphelo esinye.
20261123-math-g01-2.example: Ingaba ipepaklipu enye inobude obufanayo negluu estiki enye? Cinga ngoko kuqala.
20261123-math-g01-2.actionItem: Funda ukuba ubude obulinganiswe ngeeyunithi ezahlukileyo abunakuthelekiswa ngamanani odwa, ugqibe ukuba ufuna ulwazi luni ukubuthelekisa.

20261123-math-g02-1.title: Ingaba inani elilandela u-1, 2, 4 linye kuphela?
20261123-math-g02-1.summary: Umhlobo ekubeni sisigaba sethu udlala umdlalo wolandelelwano lwamanani apho babonisa amanani elinye ngexesha. Umhlobo ugqibe ngepatheni enye aze akuxelele inani elinye ngexesha.
20261123-math-g02-1.principle: Funda ukuba amanani okuqala ambalwa kuphela awamiseli ipatheni ibe yinye, nokuba kufuneka ulungise ipatheni xa inani elitsha licaciswa, uze wenze ulandelelwano lwamanani ohambelana nepatheni ngokwakho.
20261123-math-g02-1.actionItem: Funda ukuba amanani okuqala ambalwa kuphela awamiseli ipatheni ibe yinye, nokuba kufuneka ulungise ipatheni xa inani elitsha licaciswa, uze wenze ulandelelwano lwamanani ohambelana nepatheni ngokwakho.

20261123-math-g02-2.title: Fumana inani eliyimfihlo likaSuji
20261123-math-g02-2.summary:
USuji ukhethe inani elinamadijithi amathathu waza wanika izikhokelo.
Isikhokelo 1) Idijithi kwindawo yamashumi inkulu nge-2 kunedijithi kwindawo yeeyunithi.
Isikhokelo 2) Idijithi kwindawo yeeyunithi ayingu-0.
Isikhokelo 3) Idijithi kwindawo yamakhulu inkulu kunedijithi kwindawo yamashumi.
20261123-math-g02-2.principle: 420 inayo 0 kwindawo yeeyunithi, ngoko ichasene nesikhokelo 2, kwaye 353 inayo 3 kwindawo yamakhulu, encinci kune-5 kwindawo yamashumi, ngoko ichasene nesikhokelo 3. 642 no-975 bahlangabezana nazo zonke izikhokelo ezintathu.
20261123-math-g02-2.example: Khetha inani elinye uzivavanye ngezikhokelo 1, 2, no-3 ngokulandelelana.
20261123-math-g02-2.actionItem: Sebenzisa ixabiso lendawo ukufumana inani elinamadijithi amathathu elihlangabezana nezikhokelo ezininzi ngaxeshanye, uze ukhethe izikhokelo ngokuthelekisa ukuba mangaphi amanani ashiywa sisikhokelo ngasinye.

20261123-math-g03-1.title: Iindlela Ezahlukeneyo Zokwabelana Nge-72 Zeekhandi Phakathi Kweepleyiti
20261123-math-g03-1.summary: Ufuna ukubeka ii-72 zeekhandi kwiipleyiti, wabelane ngokulinganayo kungashiyeki nanye. Inani leekhandi kwipleyiti nganye litshintsha ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni zingaphi iipleyiti osebenzisa.
20261123-math-g03-1.principle: Unokwabelana ngokulinganayo kungashiyeki nanye kuphela xa inani leepleyiti liphindaphindwe linani leekhandi kwipleyiti enye li-72. 4×18, 6×12, kunye no-9×8 zi-72, kwaye akukho nani eliphindaphindwe ngo-5 okanye ngo-7 elenza i-72.
20261123-math-g03-1.example: Kwinani ngalinye leepleyiti, wahlula i-72 ngelo nani uze uhlole ukuba ikho intsalela na.
20261123-math-g03-1.actionItem: Fumana iindlela ezininzi zokwabelana ezihlangabezana neemeko (uluhlu lwenani leepleyiti nenani leekhandi kwipleyiti nganye) ngaxeshanye, uze uchaze indlela inani leepleyiti nenani leekhandi kwipleyiti enye eziqhagamshela ngayo.

20261123-math-g03-2.title: Ukufumana Impazamo Ekwabelaneni Kweekhandi KukaSeoyeon
20261123-math-g03-2.summary: USeoyeon ufuna ukwabelana nge-85 zeekhandi ngokulinganayo phakathi kwabantu aba-4. Funda isisombululo sikaSeoyeon. Isiphumo sokwahlula linani lalo ngamnye umntu alifumanayo, kwaye intsalela linani eliseleyo emva kokwabelana.
20261123-math-g03-2.principle: Umgca wesi-3 uphosakele. Ii-khandi ezi-5 ezishiyekileyo zinokwabelwana kwakhona, ikhandi e-1 ngakumbi kubantu aba-4 ngabanye, ngoko ukuthi 'azinakwabelwana ngakumbi' akulunganga. Ukuhlola kumgca wesi-4 kubonisa kuphela ukuba isivakalisi samanani siyahambelana; akubonisi ukuba intsalela ichanekile na.
20261123-math-g03-2.example: Kumgca ngamnye, bala omnye ngomnye ukuhlola ukuba oko ukuthethayo kunjalo ngokwenene.
20261123-math-g03-2.actionItem: Sebenzisa imeko yokuba intsalela kufuneka ibe ncinci kunomahluli ukufumana ulungise impazamo kwisisombululo, uze wahlule iimeko apho impazamo efanayo yenzeka khona nalapho ingenzeki khona.

20261123-math-g04-1.title: Ukuhlola Inkcazo ka-Seohyeon
20261123-math-g04-1.summary: U-Seohyeon wachaza oku kumhlobo. Kukho impazamo kule nkcazo.
20261123-math-g04-1.principle: Umgca 3 yindawo apho kuqala ukuphosa. Isikwere sinamacala amane alinganayo, kodwa oko akuthethi okuchasene, "ukuba amacala amane alinganayo, sisikwere." Umgca 4 uqhubeka nempazamo efanayo, kodwa indawo yokuqala engalunganga ngumgca 3.
20261123-math-g04-1.example: Funda umgca ngamnye ubhalwe kwakhona ngefom "ukuba ..., ngoko ...," ubhale kumgca ngamnye ukuba uya kwicala elifanayo nesibakala somgca wangaphambili.
20261123-math-g04-1.actionItem: Fumana impazamo yengqiqo kwinkcazo ethi 'Ukuba onke amacala amane ayafana, sisikwere,' uze uchaze iquadrilateral ngumzekelo ochasayo.

20261123-math-g04-2.title: Iphosakale Phi Xa Kutshintshwa Kwaba Ngamadijithi?
20261123-math-g04-2.summary: UMinseo wabhala isisombululo sokubhala 'amawaka amathathu amashumi amabini anesihlanu amawaka ali-10, amawaka amane nesithandathu' ngamadijithi.
20261123-math-g04-2.principle: Umgca wesi-3 yindawo yokuqala ephosakeleyo. Kumawaka amane nesithandathu, indawo yamawaka yi-4 kwaye indawo yeeyunithi yi-6, kwaye iindawo zamakhulu namashumi zazingafundwanga kodwa ziyi-0, ngoko yi-4006. Imigca yesi-4 nesi-5 iphosakele kuba iqhuba ixabiso eliphosakeleyo elisuka kumgca wesi-3.
20261123-math-g04-2.example: Kumgca ngamnye, hlola omnye ngomnye ukuba 'amagama afundwayo' 'namadijithi abhaliweyo' ayahambelana na.
20261123-math-g04-2.actionItem: Fumana umgca ophosakeleyo kwisisombululo esitshintsha inani elikhulu elifundwe ngamagama laba ngamadijithi, uze ulungise usebenzisa ii-0 kwiindawo ezingafundwanga.

20261123-math-g05-1.title: Inani Lamaqela Okwabelana Ngokulinganayo: Ukulungisa Isisombululo
20261123-math-g05-1.summary: Ufuna ukwabelana ngeelekese ezingama-48 neetshokolethi ezingama-36 ngokulinganayo ungashiyi nto phakathi kwamaqela amaninzi. UHayun wafumana inani lamaqela ngolu hlobo.
20261123-math-g05-1.principle: Umgca 2 yindawo yokuqala engachanekanga. Inani lamaqela ahlulwa ngama-48 ngokulinganayo kufuneka libe linani elihlula ama-48 ngokulinganayo, oko kukuthi, isahluli sama-48. Isiphindaphindi sinokuba sikhulu kunama-48, yaye emva koko iilekese aziphelelanga. Umgca 4 uthi into eya kushiya amaqela athile engenalekese nanye kumaqela angama-144. Umgca 1 ukopishe ingxaki kakuhle, yaye u-144 emgceni 3 uchanekile njengesiphindaphindi esiqhelekileyo esincinane kakhulu sama-48 nama-36.
20261123-math-g05-1.example: Funda umgca ngamnye ucinge ukuba oko kuthethwa kunokwenzeka ngokwenene kwimeko eneelekese ezingama-48 neetshokolethi ezingama-36.
20261123-math-g05-1.actionItem: Fumana uze ulungise indawo kwisisombululo apho kwakhethwa ubudlelwane obungachanekanga phakathi kwamanani (isahluli/isiphindaphindi), uze ucinge ngazo zonke iimeko ezihambelana neemeko.

20261123-math-g05-2.title: Ukuba Imindilili Iyafana, Ingaba Amaqela Amabini Ayafana?
20261123-math-g05-2.summary: Iqela leSibhakabhaka neqela leLwandle zithumele abantu aba-4 ngalinye kukhuphiswano lokutsiba intambo. Iirekhodi zeqela leSibhakabhaka (inani lokutsiba) zingama-20, 22, 24, nama-54, kwaye iirekhodi zeqela leLwandle zingama-28, 29, 30, nama-33. Imindilili yawo omabini amaqela ifana, ngama-30. UDoha wathi, "Imindilili iyafana, ngoko amaqela amabini alunge ngokulinganayo."
20261123-math-g05-2.principle: Umndilili yi-(isixa sazo zonke)÷(inani labantu), ngoko ukuba inani labantu liyafana kwaye imindilili iyafana, izixa ziyafana nazo (zombini zingama-120). Kodwa awunakuthi ixabiso elikhulu kakhulu, ixabiso elincinci kakhulu, nendlela zisasazeke ngayo ziyafana.
20261123-math-g05-2.example: Kukhetho ngalunye, hlola omnye ngomnye ukuba liyinyani na kwiirekhodi zeqela leSibhakabhaka neqela leLwandle.
20261123-math-g05-2.actionItem: Hlola, ngedatha nangomzekelo owenza ngokwakho, ukuba nokuba imindilili iyafana, indlela idatha esasazeke ngayo inokwahluka, uze wahlule oko umndilili ukuxelela kona nokungenako ukukuxelela.

20261123-math-g06-1.title: Ukugcina incasa yobisi lwesitrobheri ifana xa wenza ngakumbi
20261123-math-g06-1.summary: USuyeon wenze isiraphu yobisi lwesitrobheri ngeekopi ezi-3 zesitrobheri neekopi ezi-2 zobisi, yaye incasa yayilungile kanye. Ufuna ukwenza ngakumbi ngencasa efanayo, yaye uSuyeon ucinga, “Ukuba ndongeza iikopi ezi-3 ezongezelelweyo zesitrobheri, ndongeza iikopi ezi-3 ezongezelelweyo zobisi.”
20261123-math-g06-1.principle: Jonga ngedatha ukuba ukongeza amanani aphelele ngokufanayo kutshintsha incasa, uze ulungise ingqiqo yakho ngomlinganiselo ogcina umlinganiselo ufana.
20261123-math-g06-1.example: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, bhala umlinganiselo wesitrobheri kubisi ngendlela efanayo uze uthelekise.
20261123-math-g06-1.actionItem: Jonga ngedatha ukuba ukongeza amanani aphelele ngokufanayo kutshintsha incasa, uze ulungise ingqiqo yakho ngomlinganiselo ogcina umlinganiselo ufana.

20261123-math-g06-2.title: Ingaba Ijusi Egxininisiweyo Engakumbi Ithetha Ijusi Eyomeleleyo?
20261123-math-g06-2.summary: Evenkileni yeejusi, iijusi ezimbini zenziwe ngokuxuba igxininiso namanzi usebenzisa ikomityi enye. IJusi A isebenzisa iikomityi ezi-3 zegxininiso neekomityi ezi-5 zamanzi, kwaye iJusi B isebenzisa iikomityi ezi-4 zegxininiso neekomityi ezi-8 zamanzi. UHajun wathi, "B inegxininiso elingakumbi, iikomityi ezi-4, ngoko B iyomelele!" (Apha, "iyomelele" ithetha ukuba xa usela into efanayo, kukho igxininiso elingakumbi kuyo.)
20261123-math-g06-2.principle: Ukomelela kwejusi akuxhomekekanga kwigxininiso kuphela kodwa ngokuba kukho igxininiso elingakanani xa lithelekiswa nomxube wonke. A inee-komityi ezi-3 kwezi-8 zonke, kwaye B inee-komityi ezi-4 kwezi-12 zonke.
20261123-math-g06-2.example: Ukuba usela into efanayo (umzekelo, ikomityi enye), kukho igxininiso elingakanani kuyo?
20261123-math-g06-2.actionItem: Bonisa ngomzekelo ochasayo ukuba isibakala esithi "leyo inegxininiso elingakumbi isoloko iyomelele" asisoloko sisebenza, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni kufuneka uthelekise usebenzisa umlinganiselo wegxininiso kwisiqingatha sonke.

20261123-math-g07-1.title: Ingaba Amaxesha Amakhulu Athetha Ukuba Benze Ngcono?
20261123-math-g07-1.summary:
Iklasi 1 (abafundi abangama-20) neKlasi 2 (abafundi abangama-50) bathabathe uvavanyo olufanayo lwemathematika. Itheyibhile yokwabiwa kwamaxesha enamanqaku abekwe kwizithuba ezintathu imi ngolu hlobo.
Isithuba / Iklasi 1 (abafundi abangama-20) / Iklasi 2 (abafundi abangama-50)
Ngaphantsi kwamanqaku angama-60 / abafundi aba-2 / abafundi abali-10
Amanqaku angama-60 okanye ngaphezulu kodwa ngaphantsi kwama-80 / abafundi abali-10 / abafundi abangama-25
Amanqaku angama-80 okanye ngaphezulu / abafundi aba-8 / abafundi abali-15
UMinji uthe, "Kukho abafundi abaninzi abanamanqaku angama-80 okanye ngaphezulu kwiKlasi 2, abali-15, ngoko iKlasi 2 yenze ngcono kuvavanyo."
20261123-math-g07-1.principle: Ngokwezabelo, kumanqaku angama-80 okanye ngaphezulu, iKlasi 1 inama-8/20=40% kwaye iKlasi 2 inama-15/50=30%, ngoko iKlasi 1 iphezulu; kumanqaku angaphantsi kwama-60, iKlasi 1 inama-2/20=10% kwaye iKlasi 2 inama-10/50=20%, ngoko iKlasi 2 iphindwe ngo-2 kunoKlasi 1. Umndilili awunakwaziwa kwitheyibhile enezithuba ezibekiweyo, kwaye isigqibo esithelekisa kuphela inani labafundi sinenkxaso ebuthathaka.
20261123-math-g07-1.example: Kwiklasi nganye, yahlula inani labafundi kuloo sithuba ngenani elipheleleyo labafundi kuloo klasi.
20261123-math-g07-1.actionItem: Funda ingxaki yokuthelekisa amaxesha njengoko enjalo xa iiklasi ezimbini zinamanani ahlukeneyo abafundi, uze wahlule oko itheyibhile ikuvumela ukuba ukuthi ngokuqinisekileyo kunoko ungakuthi.

20261123-math-g07-2.title: Ukufunda igrafu yokuphakama kwamanzi eyenziwe ngamachaphazelo
20261123-math-g07-2.summary: Silinganise ukuphakama kwamanzi ngexesha lokuthulula amanzi kwitanki. I-axis ethe tye ngamaxesha (imizuzu) yaye i-axis ethe nkqo kukuphakama (cm). Sibhala (ixesha, ukuphakama) njengesibini esilandelanayo siyizobe njengechaphazelo kwisicwangciso sokulungelelanisa. Amachaphazelo amaninzi aveziwe ngexesha elinye.
20261123-math-g07-2.principle: Njengoko amachaphazelo ongezwa omnye emva komnye, qikelela ipatheni, ulungise uqikelelo lwakho xa amachaphazelo amatsha evela, uze ucinge ukuba ungaqiniseka ngamaxabiso aphakathi kwamachaphazelo.
20261123-math-g07-2.example: Thelekisa ukuba ukuphakama kwamachaphazelo kutshintsha kangakanani ngalo lonke ixesha ixesha lonyuka ngomzuzu o-1.
20261123-math-g07-2.actionItem: Njengoko amachaphazelo ongezwa omnye emva komnye, qikelela ipatheni, ulungise uqikelelo lwakho xa amachaphazelo amatsha evela, uze ucinge ukuba ungaqiniseka ngamaxabiso aphakathi kwamachaphazelo.

20261123-math-g08-1.title: Zeziphi iinqaku esizifunayo ukufumana amaxabiso?
20261123-math-g08-1.summary: Sifuna ukufumana ixabiso lepensile enye, x won, nelencwadi yokubhala enye, y won, kwivenkile yezixhobo zokubhala. Umnini wasibonisa amanqaku ama-5 enyaniso. Inqaku A: Iipensile ezi-2 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-3 zibiza i-3,100 won. Inqaku B: Iipensile ezi-4 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-6 zibiza i-6,200 won. Inqaku C: Incwadi yokubhala ibiza i-200 won ngaphezu kwepensile. Inqaku D: Iipensile ezi-6 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-9 zibiza i-9,300 won. Inqaku E: Iipensile ezi-5 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-5 zibiza i-6,000 won.
20261123-math-g08-1.principle: Amaqhinga A, B no-D anomlinganiselo ofanayo weepensile kwiincwadi zokubhala, 2:3, kwaye izixa zawo ziziphindaphindi ezifanayo (ihlandlo eli-1, amahlandlo ama-2, amahlandlo ama-3), ngoko aphinda ulwazi olufanayo. Ngala maqhinga kuphela, awunakuyimisela into enye esisisombululo. Ukuba udibanisa amaqhinga anemilinganiselo eyahlukileyo yamanani (C, E), ulingano olubini lunika ulwazi olwahlukileyo, ngoko amaxabiso ayamiselwa. (Ipensile 500 won, incwadi yokubhala 700 won)
20261123-math-g08-1.example: Phinda ubhale amaqhinga ngohlobo 'iipensile □ + iincwadi zokubhala □ = □원' uze uthelekise amaqhinga amabini ecaleni kwelinye.
20261123-math-g08-1.actionItem: Xa usenza ukulingana ngaxeshanye, gwebela ukuba ukulingana kunika ulwazi olwahlukileyo na, uze wenze wena ukulingana okunganiki lwazi lutsha.

20261123-math-g08-2.title: Ithuba lentloko e-1 kuphela ngeengqekembe ezimbini
20261123-math-g08-2.summary: Phosa iingqekembe ezimbini ezilungileyo ngaxeshanye, kanye. Ukuba uchaza isiphumo ngenani lamakhanda kuphela, kukho 0, 1, okanye 2. Jonga indlela ingcinga yakho 'ngethuba lentloko e-1 kuphela' etshintsha ngayo ngobungqina.
20261123-math-g08-2.principle: Hlola ngobungqina ukuba iimeko ezibaliwe 'ngenani lamakhanda' azenzeki ngokulinganayo, uze uhlaziye isigwebo sakho sokuqala ngethuba.
20261123-math-g08-2.example: Qala ucinge ukuba loluphi isigwebo esinokwenzeka 'ngobungqina obubonayo ngoku kuphela.'
20261123-math-g08-2.actionItem: Hlola ngobungqina ukuba iimeko ezibaliwe 'ngenani lamakhanda' azenzeki ngokulinganayo, uze uhlaziye isigwebo sakho sokuqala ngethuba.

20261123-math-g09-1.title: Ukuba sin A=3/5, ingaba iyafana nokuba unxantathu uba mkhulu?
20261123-math-g09-1.summary: Kunxantathu oneengile ethe nkqo ABC, ∠C=90°, icala BC licala elichasene ne-∠A, icala AC licala elikufuphi ne-∠A (hayi ihayipothenyusi), kwaye icala AB yihayipothenyusi. sin A ifundwa 'sayini A' kwaye cos A ifundwa 'khosayini A.' Kula nxantathu, sin A=3/5 (3 phezu kwe-5).
20261123-math-g09-1.principle: Ukuba wandisa onke amacala amathathu ngesiphindaphindi esifanayo, njenge-(AB, BC, AC)=(5, 3, 4), (10, 6, 8), (15, 9, 12), sin A=3/5 ihlala injalo.
20261123-math-g09-1.example: Njengomzekelo olula kakhulu, xa BC=3 kunye ne-AB=5, fumana ubude becala eliseleyo AC ngetheorem kaPythagoras.
20261123-math-g09-1.actionItem: Yenza onxantathu abaneengile ethe nkqo abaninzi abanexabiso elifanayo le-sin A, uvavanye izibakala zabafundi ababini usebenzisa iziphumo, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni umlinganiselo wetrigonometri umiselwa bubungakanani beengile.

20261123-math-g09-2.title: Kufuneka sibuze ntoni ukumisela umsebenzi omnye wequadratic?
20261123-math-g09-2.summary: Sifuna ukufumana ikhweshini yomsebenzi wequadratic y=ax²+bx+c (a ayingo-0). (y ifundwa 'y ilingana no-a x isikwere kudibaniswe no-b x kudibaniswe no-c.') Umhlobo uza kukuxelela ulwazi ngegrafu iqhekeza elinye ngexesha.
20261123-math-g09-2.principle: 'Incopho nechaphaza elinye' imiselwa ngokufaka (0, 3) kwi-y=a(x-2)²-1, nto leyo enika a=1. 'Amachaphaza amathathu' amiselwa ngokufaka (0, 3) kwi-y=a(x-1)(x-3), nto leyo enika a=1. Kwamanye amaqhekeza amathathu olwazi, naxabiso lika-a okanye ukuphakama kwencopho akumiselwanga, ngoko zikho ikhweshini ezininzi.
20261123-math-g09-2.example: Sebenza ukuba zikho imisebenzi emibini okanye ngaphezulu eyahlukileyo yequadratic ehambelana nolwazi ngalunye.
20261123-math-g09-2.actionItem: Hlela ulwazi olwaneleyo ukumisela ikhweshini enye yomsebenzi wequadratic y=ax²+bx+c kulo olungonelanga, uze ugqibe ukuba loluphi umbuzo owongezelelweyo ekufuneka ububuzwe xa lungonelanga.

20261123-math-g10-1.title: Ngaba umgca uya kuchukumisa isangqa? Xa ulwazi luvezwa isiqwenga esinye ngexesha
20261123-math-g10-1.summary: Kukho isangqa x²+y²=25 (isazulu kwimvelaphi, irediyasi 5) nomgca y=x+k. Tshintsha ixabiso lika-k ujonge inani lamachaphaza apho umgca nesangqa zidibana khona.
20261123-math-g10-1.principle: Xela indawo yomgca nesangqa ngokuxhomekeke kwixabiso lengxelo engatshintshiyo k, uhlaziye isigwebo sakho ngolwazi olutsha, uze unciphise uluhlu luka-k apho bechukumisana khona.
20261123-math-g10-1.example: Unokuhlola inani lamachaphaza okudibana ngezisombululo zekhweshini oyifumanayo ngokusombulula iikhweshini zomgca nesangqa kunye.
20261123-math-g10-1.actionItem: Xela indawo yomgca nesangqa ngokuxhomekeke kwixabiso lengxelo engatshintshiyo k, uhlaziye isigwebo sakho ngolwazi olutsha, uze unciphise uluhlu luka-k apho bechukumisana khona.

20261123-math-g10-2.title: Isisombululo sentsalela siphosakale phi?
20261123-math-g10-2.summary: Esi sisisombululo sikaMinjae sokufumana ikhonkco a ukuze intsalela ibe ngu-6 xa ipolynomial f(x)=x³+ax²+x+2 ihlulwa nge-x+1. (x³ kuthetha u-x e-cube, kwaye ax² kuthetha a iphindaphindwe ngesikwere sika-x.)
20261123-math-g10-2.principle: Umgca wesi-2 uphosakele. x+1 inokubhalwa njenge-x−(−1), ngoko intsalela yi-f(−1), hayi i-f(1). Imigca yesi-3 nesi-4 ilandela nje umgca wesi-2, ngoko ubalo olungaphakathi kuyo lulungile, kodwa iziphumo zayo ziphosakele.
20261123-math-g10-2.example: Bhala kwakhona i-x+1 ukuze umahluli abe nefom ye-x−(inani elithile).
20261123-math-g10-2.actionItem: Fumana umgca ophosakeleyo kwisisombululo esifumana intsalela, uyilungise, uze uhlole impendulo ephosakeleyo ngokuchasene nemeko yokuqala ukuqinisekisa impazamo.

20261123-math-g11-1.title: Fumana umgca onengxaki kwisisombululo selingano lelogarithm
20261123-math-g11-1.summary: UMinho wasombulula ulingano log₂(x−1) + log₂(x−3) = 3 waphendula, ‘Izisombululo zi-x=5 no-x=−1, ezimbini.’ Ukuyifunda ngokuvakalayo, ithi ‘log isiseko 2 se-(x ngokususa 1) ukongeza log isiseko 2 se-(x ngokususa 3) kulingana no-3’.
20261123-math-g11-1.principle: Indawo yokuqala apho kuphambuka khona ngumgca wesi-2. Xa isixa seelogarithm ezimbini sidityaniswa sibe lilogarithm enye, iimeko zexabiso elingaphakathi x−1>0 no-x−3>0 ziyanyamalala kugama, yaye ezo meko azibhalwanga ngokwahlukeneyo. Ngoko kumgca wesi-5 zombini iingcambu zamkelwa, yaye umgca wesi-6 sisigqibo eso. Ixabiso elingaphakathi kufuneka lipositivu, ngoko x>3 iyafuneka. Ukuba x=−1, ngoko x−1=−2 no-x−3=−4, amaxabiso angaphakathi anegethivu, ngoko ulingano alucacisiwe. Ukuba x=5, log₂4 + log₂2 = 2+1 = 3, ngoko liyabamba. Ngoko isisombululo lixabiso elinye x=5.
20261123-math-g11-1.example: Ngalo lonke ixesha ugama liguquka, funda ukhangela ukuba lithetha okufanayo nomgca wangaphambili.
20261123-math-g11-1.actionItem: Fumana uze ulungise ingxaki ebangelwa kukungakhangeli imeko yexabiso elingaphakathi kwilogarithm kwisisombululo selingano lelogarithm.

20261123-math-g11-2.title: Zingaphi onxantathu onokwenziwa ngamacala amabini ne-engile e-1?
20261123-math-g11-2.summary: Konxantathu ABC, ∠A=60° kwaye ubude becala BC bungu-a=7. Xa ubude becala CA, b, bunikiwe, unokumisela ubude c becala AB wenze unxantathu. (a, b, c ngamacala achasene nee-∠A, ∠B, ∠C. cos60°=1/2.) UGaeun wathi, 'Ukuba b inkulu kune-7, onxantathu ababini abanjalo bahlala benziwa.'
20261123-math-g11-2.principle: Ukusuka kwi-49=64+c²−8c, c²−8c+15=0, (c−3)(c−5)=0, ngoko c=3 okanye 5. Amaxabiso omabini apozithivu, ngoko onxantathu ababini banokwenziwa.
20261123-math-g11-2.example: Faka a=7, b=8, cos60°=1/2 kumthetho wekhosayini ubhale ulingano lwe-c.
20261123-math-g11-2.actionItem: Vavanya ukuqhelekisa 'zihlala zimbini' ngamaxabiso athile uze uchaze ngezizathu ukuba zeziphi iimeko apho kungabambi.

20261123-math-g12-1.title: Ithi ipositivu, kodwa umntu uyagula ngokwenene na?
20261123-math-g12-1.summary: Uvavanyo lwesifo esithile lwabonakala ‘lupositivu’. Ufuna ukwazi ithuba lokuba umntu onesiphumo esipositivu uneso sifo ngokwenene. Gqiba ukuba luluphi ulwazi olufunekayo ukumisela eli thuba.
20261123-math-g12-1.principle: Abo bavavanywe bepositivu benziwe ‘ngabagulayo abavavanywe bepositivu’ ‘nabaphilileyo abavavanywe bepositivu’. Ngoko kufuneka umlinganiselo wabagulayo, ithuba lokuba ogulayo avavanywe epositivu, nethuba lokuba ophilileyo avavanywe epositivu.
20261123-math-g12-1.example: Khumbula ukuba ngawaphi amaqela amabini abantu abavavanyiweyo abanesiphumo esipositivu banokwahlulwa.
20261123-math-g12-1.actionItem: Khetha ulwazi olufunekayo ukufumana ithuba elinemeko, uze uchaze ngamanani ukuba kutheni ukuchaneka kovavanyo kwahlukile kwi-‘ithuba lokugula xa isiphumo sipositivu’.

20261123-math-g12-2.title: Ukuba icala elibomvu liyabonakala, kuthekani ngangasemva?
20261123-math-g12-2.summary: Kukho amakhadi amathathu ebhokisini. Elinye libomvu macala omabini (ikhadi elibomvu-elibomvu), elinye libomvu kwelinye icala neluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kwelinye (ikhadi elibomvu-eluhlaza), kwaye elinye luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka macala omabini (ikhadi eluhlaza-eluhlaza). Ukhetha ikhadi elinye ngokungenamkhethe ubeke icala elinye etafileni, kwaye ibomvu liyabonakala. Cinga ngethuba lokuba icala langasemva nalo libomvu.
20261123-math-g12-2.principle: Phucula ukuqikelela kwakho kokuqala (1/2) usebenzisa idatha nokuhlalutya, uze ufumane ukuba yeyiphi umgca woqikelelo ophosakeleyo ukuze utolike ithuba elinemeko ngokuchanekileyo.
20261123-math-g12-2.example: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, bhala ukuba zeziphi iimeko ozibalayo.
20261123-math-g12-2.actionItem: Phucula ukuqikelela kwakho kokuqala (1/2) usebenzisa idatha nokuhlalutya, uze ufumane ukuba yeyiphi umgca woqikelelo ophosakeleyo ukuze utolike ithuba elinemeko ngokuchanekileyo.

20261124-math-g01-1.title: Linjani ubume bento esebhokisini?
20261124-math-g01-1.summary: Uzonyaniswe amehlo uva into esebhokisini, yaye uva imibono kanye kanye. Into esebhokisini yenye yobume bebhokisi, ubume besilinda, okanye ubume besibhakabhaka.
20261124-math-g01-1.principle: Ngalo lonke ixesha ufumana umbono omnye owongezelelekileyo, cutha iimilo ezinokwenzeka uze ulungise umbono wakho wokuqala ukuze uhambelane nombono omtsha.
20261124-math-g01-1.example: Bhala imo yebhokisi, imo yesilinda, nemo yebhola, kwaye kwisikhomba ngasinye phawula iimo ezinokwenzeka.
20261124-math-g01-1.actionItem: Ngalo lonke ixesha ufumana umbono omnye owongezelelekileyo, cutha iimilo ezinokwenzeka uze ulungise umbono wakho wokuqala ukuze uhambelane nombono omtsha.

20261124-math-g01-2.title: Ubude obulinganiswe ngeepepaklipu neegluu estiki: sesiphi esinde ngakumbi?
20261124-math-g01-2.summary: U-Minjun ulinganise ubude bepensile ngeepepaklipu waza wafumana iipepaklipu ezi-5. U-Seoyun ulinganise ubude bepensile enemibala ngeegluu estiki (iglu enjengentonga) waza wafumana iigluu estiki ezi-3. Bobabini bazibeke emgceni omnye macala ngamacala ngaphandle kwezikhewu. Sesiphi esinde, ipensile okanye ipensile enemibala?
20261124-math-g01-2.principle: Ipepaklipu negluu estiki zinobude obahlukileyo, ngoko awunakuthelekisa ngokujonga u-5 no-3 kuphela. Ukuba uyazi ukuba igluu estiki e-1 ingaphi iipepaklipu, unokuthelekisa ngeyunithi enye, kwaye unokuthelekisa ipensile nepensile enemibala ngqo ngokulungelelanisa isiphelo esinye.
20261124-math-g01-2.example: Ingaba ipepaklipu enye inobude obufanayo negluu estiki enye? Cinga ngoko kuqala.
20261124-math-g01-2.actionItem: Funda ukuba ubude obulinganiswe ngeeyunithi ezahlukileyo abunakuthelekiswa ngamanani odwa, ugqibe ukuba ufuna ulwazi luni ukubuthelekisa.

20261124-math-g02-1.title: Ingaba inani elilandela u-1, 2, 4 linye kuphela?
20261124-math-g02-1.summary: Umhlobo ekubeni sisigaba sethu udlala umdlalo wolandelelwano lwamanani apho babonisa amanani elinye ngexesha. Umhlobo ugqibe ngepatheni enye aze akuxelele inani elinye ngexesha.
20261124-math-g02-1.principle: Funda ukuba amanani okuqala ambalwa kuphela awamiseli ipatheni ibe yinye, nokuba kufuneka ulungise ipatheni xa inani elitsha licaciswa, uze wenze ulandelelwano lwamanani ohambelana nepatheni ngokwakho.
20261124-math-g02-1.actionItem: Funda ukuba amanani okuqala ambalwa kuphela awamiseli ipatheni ibe yinye, nokuba kufuneka ulungise ipatheni xa inani elitsha licaciswa, uze wenze ulandelelwano lwamanani ohambelana nepatheni ngokwakho.

20261124-math-g02-2.title: Fumana inani eliyimfihlo likaSuji
20261124-math-g02-2.summary:
USuji ukhethe inani elinamadijithi amathathu waza wanika izikhokelo.
Isikhokelo 1) Idijithi kwindawo yamashumi inkulu nge-2 kunedijithi kwindawo yeeyunithi.
Isikhokelo 2) Idijithi kwindawo yeeyunithi ayingu-0.
Isikhokelo 3) Idijithi kwindawo yamakhulu inkulu kunedijithi kwindawo yamashumi.
20261124-math-g02-2.principle: 420 inayo 0 kwindawo yeeyunithi, ngoko ichasene nesikhokelo 2, kwaye 353 inayo 3 kwindawo yamakhulu, encinci kune-5 kwindawo yamashumi, ngoko ichasene nesikhokelo 3. 642 no-975 bahlangabezana nazo zonke izikhokelo ezintathu.
20261124-math-g02-2.example: Khetha inani elinye uzivavanye ngezikhokelo 1, 2, no-3 ngokulandelelana.
20261124-math-g02-2.actionItem: Sebenzisa ixabiso lendawo ukufumana inani elinamadijithi amathathu elihlangabezana nezikhokelo ezininzi ngaxeshanye, uze ukhethe izikhokelo ngokuthelekisa ukuba mangaphi amanani ashiywa sisikhokelo ngasinye.

20261124-math-g03-1.title: Iindlela Ezahlukeneyo Zokwabelana Nge-72 Zeekhandi Phakathi Kweepleyiti
20261124-math-g03-1.summary: Ufuna ukubeka ii-72 zeekhandi kwiipleyiti, wabelane ngokulinganayo kungashiyeki nanye. Inani leekhandi kwipleyiti nganye litshintsha ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni zingaphi iipleyiti osebenzisa.
20261124-math-g03-1.principle: Unokwabelana ngokulinganayo kungashiyeki nanye kuphela xa inani leepleyiti liphindaphindwe linani leekhandi kwipleyiti enye li-72. 4×18, 6×12, kunye no-9×8 zi-72, kwaye akukho nani eliphindaphindwe ngo-5 okanye ngo-7 elenza i-72.
20261124-math-g03-1.example: Kwinani ngalinye leepleyiti, wahlula i-72 ngelo nani uze uhlole ukuba ikho intsalela na.
20261124-math-g03-1.actionItem: Fumana iindlela ezininzi zokwabelana ezihlangabezana neemeko (uluhlu lwenani leepleyiti nenani leekhandi kwipleyiti nganye) ngaxeshanye, uze uchaze indlela inani leepleyiti nenani leekhandi kwipleyiti enye eziqhagamshela ngayo.

20261124-math-g03-2.title: Ukufumana Impazamo Ekwabelaneni Kweekhandi KukaSeoyeon
20261124-math-g03-2.summary: USeoyeon ufuna ukwabelana nge-85 zeekhandi ngokulinganayo phakathi kwabantu aba-4. Funda isisombululo sikaSeoyeon. Isiphumo sokwahlula linani lalo ngamnye umntu alifumanayo, kwaye intsalela linani eliseleyo emva kokwabelana.
20261124-math-g03-2.principle: Umgca wesi-3 uphosakele. Ii-khandi ezi-5 ezishiyekileyo zinokwabelwana kwakhona, ikhandi e-1 ngakumbi kubantu aba-4 ngabanye, ngoko ukuthi 'azinakwabelwana ngakumbi' akulunganga. Ukuhlola kumgca wesi-4 kubonisa kuphela ukuba isivakalisi samanani siyahambelana; akubonisi ukuba intsalela ichanekile na.
20261124-math-g03-2.example: Kumgca ngamnye, bala omnye ngomnye ukuhlola ukuba oko ukuthethayo kunjalo ngokwenene.
20261124-math-g03-2.actionItem: Sebenzisa imeko yokuba intsalela kufuneka ibe ncinci kunomahluli ukufumana ulungise impazamo kwisisombululo, uze wahlule iimeko apho impazamo efanayo yenzeka khona nalapho ingenzeki khona.

20261124-math-g04-1.title: Ukuhlola Inkcazo ka-Seohyeon
20261124-math-g04-1.summary: U-Seohyeon wachaza oku kumhlobo. Kukho impazamo kule nkcazo.
20261124-math-g04-1.principle: Umgca 3 yindawo apho kuqala ukuphosa. Isikwere sinamacala amane alinganayo, kodwa oko akuthethi okuchasene, "ukuba amacala amane alinganayo, sisikwere." Umgca 4 uqhubeka nempazamo efanayo, kodwa indawo yokuqala engalunganga ngumgca 3.
20261124-math-g04-1.example: Funda umgca ngamnye ubhalwe kwakhona ngefom "ukuba ..., ngoko ...," ubhale kumgca ngamnye ukuba uya kwicala elifanayo nesibakala somgca wangaphambili.
20261124-math-g04-1.actionItem: Fumana impazamo yengqiqo kwinkcazo ethi 'Ukuba onke amacala amane ayafana, sisikwere,' uze uchaze iquadrilateral ngumzekelo ochasayo.

20261124-math-g04-2.title: Iphosakale Phi Xa Kutshintshwa Kwaba Ngamadijithi?
20261124-math-g04-2.summary: UMinseo wabhala isisombululo sokubhala 'amawaka amathathu amashumi amabini anesihlanu amawaka ali-10, amawaka amane nesithandathu' ngamadijithi.
20261124-math-g04-2.principle: Umgca wesi-3 yindawo yokuqala ephosakeleyo. Kumawaka amane nesithandathu, indawo yamawaka yi-4 kwaye indawo yeeyunithi yi-6, kwaye iindawo zamakhulu namashumi zazingafundwanga kodwa ziyi-0, ngoko yi-4006. Imigca yesi-4 nesi-5 iphosakele kuba iqhuba ixabiso eliphosakeleyo elisuka kumgca wesi-3.
20261124-math-g04-2.example: Kumgca ngamnye, hlola omnye ngomnye ukuba 'amagama afundwayo' 'namadijithi abhaliweyo' ayahambelana na.
20261124-math-g04-2.actionItem: Fumana umgca ophosakeleyo kwisisombululo esitshintsha inani elikhulu elifundwe ngamagama laba ngamadijithi, uze ulungise usebenzisa ii-0 kwiindawo ezingafundwanga.

20261124-math-g05-1.title: Inani Lamaqela Okwabelana Ngokulinganayo: Ukulungisa Isisombululo
20261124-math-g05-1.summary: Ufuna ukwabelana ngeelekese ezingama-48 neetshokolethi ezingama-36 ngokulinganayo ungashiyi nto phakathi kwamaqela amaninzi. UHayun wafumana inani lamaqela ngolu hlobo.
20261124-math-g05-1.principle: Umgca 2 yindawo yokuqala engachanekanga. Inani lamaqela ahlulwa ngama-48 ngokulinganayo kufuneka libe linani elihlula ama-48 ngokulinganayo, oko kukuthi, isahluli sama-48. Isiphindaphindi sinokuba sikhulu kunama-48, yaye emva koko iilekese aziphelelanga. Umgca 4 uthi into eya kushiya amaqela athile engenalekese nanye kumaqela angama-144. Umgca 1 ukopishe ingxaki kakuhle, yaye u-144 emgceni 3 uchanekile njengesiphindaphindi esiqhelekileyo esincinane kakhulu sama-48 nama-36.
20261124-math-g05-1.example: Funda umgca ngamnye ucinge ukuba oko kuthethwa kunokwenzeka ngokwenene kwimeko eneelekese ezingama-48 neetshokolethi ezingama-36.
20261124-math-g05-1.actionItem: Fumana uze ulungise indawo kwisisombululo apho kwakhethwa ubudlelwane obungachanekanga phakathi kwamanani (isahluli/isiphindaphindi), uze ucinge ngazo zonke iimeko ezihambelana neemeko.

20261124-math-g05-2.title: Ukuba Imindilili Iyafana, Ingaba Amaqela Amabini Ayafana?
20261124-math-g05-2.summary: Iqela leSibhakabhaka neqela leLwandle zithumele abantu aba-4 ngalinye kukhuphiswano lokutsiba intambo. Iirekhodi zeqela leSibhakabhaka (inani lokutsiba) zingama-20, 22, 24, nama-54, kwaye iirekhodi zeqela leLwandle zingama-28, 29, 30, nama-33. Imindilili yawo omabini amaqela ifana, ngama-30. UDoha wathi, "Imindilili iyafana, ngoko amaqela amabini alunge ngokulinganayo."
20261124-math-g05-2.principle: Umndilili yi-(isixa sazo zonke)÷(inani labantu), ngoko ukuba inani labantu liyafana kwaye imindilili iyafana, izixa ziyafana nazo (zombini zingama-120). Kodwa awunakuthi ixabiso elikhulu kakhulu, ixabiso elincinci kakhulu, nendlela zisasazeke ngayo ziyafana.
20261124-math-g05-2.example: Kukhetho ngalunye, hlola omnye ngomnye ukuba liyinyani na kwiirekhodi zeqela leSibhakabhaka neqela leLwandle.
20261124-math-g05-2.actionItem: Hlola, ngedatha nangomzekelo owenza ngokwakho, ukuba nokuba imindilili iyafana, indlela idatha esasazeke ngayo inokwahluka, uze wahlule oko umndilili ukuxelela kona nokungenako ukukuxelela.

20261124-math-g06-1.title: Ukugcina incasa yobisi lwesitrobheri ifana xa wenza ngakumbi
20261124-math-g06-1.summary: USuyeon wenze isiraphu yobisi lwesitrobheri ngeekopi ezi-3 zesitrobheri neekopi ezi-2 zobisi, yaye incasa yayilungile kanye. Ufuna ukwenza ngakumbi ngencasa efanayo, yaye uSuyeon ucinga, “Ukuba ndongeza iikopi ezi-3 ezongezelelweyo zesitrobheri, ndongeza iikopi ezi-3 ezongezelelweyo zobisi.”
20261124-math-g06-1.principle: Jonga ngedatha ukuba ukongeza amanani aphelele ngokufanayo kutshintsha incasa, uze ulungise ingqiqo yakho ngomlinganiselo ogcina umlinganiselo ufana.
20261124-math-g06-1.example: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, bhala umlinganiselo wesitrobheri kubisi ngendlela efanayo uze uthelekise.
20261124-math-g06-1.actionItem: Jonga ngedatha ukuba ukongeza amanani aphelele ngokufanayo kutshintsha incasa, uze ulungise ingqiqo yakho ngomlinganiselo ogcina umlinganiselo ufana.

20261124-math-g06-2.title: Ingaba Ijusi Egxininisiweyo Engakumbi Ithetha Ijusi Eyomeleleyo?
20261124-math-g06-2.summary: Evenkileni yeejusi, iijusi ezimbini zenziwe ngokuxuba igxininiso namanzi usebenzisa ikomityi enye. IJusi A isebenzisa iikomityi ezi-3 zegxininiso neekomityi ezi-5 zamanzi, kwaye iJusi B isebenzisa iikomityi ezi-4 zegxininiso neekomityi ezi-8 zamanzi. UHajun wathi, "B inegxininiso elingakumbi, iikomityi ezi-4, ngoko B iyomelele!" (Apha, "iyomelele" ithetha ukuba xa usela into efanayo, kukho igxininiso elingakumbi kuyo.)
20261124-math-g06-2.principle: Ukomelela kwejusi akuxhomekekanga kwigxininiso kuphela kodwa ngokuba kukho igxininiso elingakanani xa lithelekiswa nomxube wonke. A inee-komityi ezi-3 kwezi-8 zonke, kwaye B inee-komityi ezi-4 kwezi-12 zonke.
20261124-math-g06-2.example: Ukuba usela into efanayo (umzekelo, ikomityi enye), kukho igxininiso elingakanani kuyo?
20261124-math-g06-2.actionItem: Bonisa ngomzekelo ochasayo ukuba isibakala esithi "leyo inegxininiso elingakumbi isoloko iyomelele" asisoloko sisebenza, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni kufuneka uthelekise usebenzisa umlinganiselo wegxininiso kwisiqingatha sonke.

20261124-math-g07-1.title: Ingaba Amaxesha Amakhulu Athetha Ukuba Benze Ngcono?
20261124-math-g07-1.summary:
Iklasi 1 (abafundi abangama-20) neKlasi 2 (abafundi abangama-50) bathabathe uvavanyo olufanayo lwemathematika. Itheyibhile yokwabiwa kwamaxesha enamanqaku abekwe kwizithuba ezintathu imi ngolu hlobo.
Isithuba / Iklasi 1 (abafundi abangama-20) / Iklasi 2 (abafundi abangama-50)
Ngaphantsi kwamanqaku angama-60 / abafundi aba-2 / abafundi abali-10
Amanqaku angama-60 okanye ngaphezulu kodwa ngaphantsi kwama-80 / abafundi abali-10 / abafundi abangama-25
Amanqaku angama-80 okanye ngaphezulu / abafundi aba-8 / abafundi abali-15
UMinji uthe, "Kukho abafundi abaninzi abanamanqaku angama-80 okanye ngaphezulu kwiKlasi 2, abali-15, ngoko iKlasi 2 yenze ngcono kuvavanyo."
20261124-math-g07-1.principle: Ngokwezabelo, kumanqaku angama-80 okanye ngaphezulu, iKlasi 1 inama-8/20=40% kwaye iKlasi 2 inama-15/50=30%, ngoko iKlasi 1 iphezulu; kumanqaku angaphantsi kwama-60, iKlasi 1 inama-2/20=10% kwaye iKlasi 2 inama-10/50=20%, ngoko iKlasi 2 iphindwe ngo-2 kunoKlasi 1. Umndilili awunakwaziwa kwitheyibhile enezithuba ezibekiweyo, kwaye isigqibo esithelekisa kuphela inani labafundi sinenkxaso ebuthathaka.
20261124-math-g07-1.example: Kwiklasi nganye, yahlula inani labafundi kuloo sithuba ngenani elipheleleyo labafundi kuloo klasi.
