20261124-math-g07-1.actionItem: Funda ingxaki yokuthelekisa amaxesha njengoko enjalo xa iiklasi ezimbini zinamanani ahlukeneyo abafundi, uze wahlule oko itheyibhile ikuvumela ukuba ukuthi ngokuqinisekileyo kunoko ungakuthi.

20261124-math-g07-2.title: Ukufunda igrafu yokuphakama kwamanzi eyenziwe ngamachaphazelo
20261124-math-g07-2.summary: Silinganise ukuphakama kwamanzi ngexesha lokuthulula amanzi kwitanki. I-axis ethe tye ngamaxesha (imizuzu) yaye i-axis ethe nkqo kukuphakama (cm). Sibhala (ixesha, ukuphakama) njengesibini esilandelanayo siyizobe njengechaphazelo kwisicwangciso sokulungelelanisa. Amachaphazelo amaninzi aveziwe ngexesha elinye.
20261124-math-g07-2.principle: Njengoko amachaphazelo ongezwa omnye emva komnye, qikelela ipatheni, ulungise uqikelelo lwakho xa amachaphazelo amatsha evela, uze ucinge ukuba ungaqiniseka ngamaxabiso aphakathi kwamachaphazelo.
20261124-math-g07-2.example: Thelekisa ukuba ukuphakama kwamachaphazelo kutshintsha kangakanani ngalo lonke ixesha ixesha lonyuka ngomzuzu o-1.
20261124-math-g07-2.actionItem: Njengoko amachaphazelo ongezwa omnye emva komnye, qikelela ipatheni, ulungise uqikelelo lwakho xa amachaphazelo amatsha evela, uze ucinge ukuba ungaqiniseka ngamaxabiso aphakathi kwamachaphazelo.

20261124-math-g08-1.title: Zeziphi iinqaku esizifunayo ukufumana amaxabiso?
20261124-math-g08-1.summary: Sifuna ukufumana ixabiso lepensile enye, x won, nelencwadi yokubhala enye, y won, kwivenkile yezixhobo zokubhala. Umnini wasibonisa amanqaku ama-5 enyaniso. Inqaku A: Iipensile ezi-2 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-3 zibiza i-3,100 won. Inqaku B: Iipensile ezi-4 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-6 zibiza i-6,200 won. Inqaku C: Incwadi yokubhala ibiza i-200 won ngaphezu kwepensile. Inqaku D: Iipensile ezi-6 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-9 zibiza i-9,300 won. Inqaku E: Iipensile ezi-5 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-5 zibiza i-6,000 won.
20261124-math-g08-1.principle: Amaqhinga A, B no-D anomlinganiselo ofanayo weepensile kwiincwadi zokubhala, 2:3, kwaye izixa zawo ziziphindaphindi ezifanayo (ihlandlo eli-1, amahlandlo ama-2, amahlandlo ama-3), ngoko aphinda ulwazi olufanayo. Ngala maqhinga kuphela, awunakuyimisela into enye esisisombululo. Ukuba udibanisa amaqhinga anemilinganiselo eyahlukileyo yamanani (C, E), ulingano olubini lunika ulwazi olwahlukileyo, ngoko amaxabiso ayamiselwa. (Ipensile 500 won, incwadi yokubhala 700 won)
20261124-math-g08-1.example: Phinda ubhale amaqhinga ngohlobo 'iipensile □ + iincwadi zokubhala □ = □원' uze uthelekise amaqhinga amabini ecaleni kwelinye.
20261124-math-g08-1.actionItem: Xa usenza ukulingana ngaxeshanye, gwebela ukuba ukulingana kunika ulwazi olwahlukileyo na, uze wenze wena ukulingana okunganiki lwazi lutsha.

20261124-math-g08-2.title: Ithuba lentloko e-1 kuphela ngeengqekembe ezimbini
20261124-math-g08-2.summary: Phosa iingqekembe ezimbini ezilungileyo ngaxeshanye, kanye. Ukuba uchaza isiphumo ngenani lamakhanda kuphela, kukho 0, 1, okanye 2. Jonga indlela ingcinga yakho 'ngethuba lentloko e-1 kuphela' etshintsha ngayo ngobungqina.
20261124-math-g08-2.principle: Hlola ngobungqina ukuba iimeko ezibaliwe 'ngenani lamakhanda' azenzeki ngokulinganayo, uze uhlaziye isigwebo sakho sokuqala ngethuba.
20261124-math-g08-2.example: Qala ucinge ukuba loluphi isigwebo esinokwenzeka 'ngobungqina obubonayo ngoku kuphela.'
20261124-math-g08-2.actionItem: Hlola ngobungqina ukuba iimeko ezibaliwe 'ngenani lamakhanda' azenzeki ngokulinganayo, uze uhlaziye isigwebo sakho sokuqala ngethuba.

20261124-math-g09-1.title: Ukuba sin A=3/5, ingaba iyafana nokuba unxantathu uba mkhulu?
20261124-math-g09-1.summary: Kunxantathu oneengile ethe nkqo ABC, ∠C=90°, icala BC licala elichasene ne-∠A, icala AC licala elikufuphi ne-∠A (hayi ihayipothenyusi), kwaye icala AB yihayipothenyusi. sin A ifundwa 'sayini A' kwaye cos A ifundwa 'khosayini A.' Kula nxantathu, sin A=3/5 (3 phezu kwe-5).
20261124-math-g09-1.principle: Ukuba wandisa onke amacala amathathu ngesiphindaphindi esifanayo, njenge-(AB, BC, AC)=(5, 3, 4), (10, 6, 8), (15, 9, 12), sin A=3/5 ihlala injalo.
20261124-math-g09-1.example: Njengomzekelo olula kakhulu, xa BC=3 kunye ne-AB=5, fumana ubude becala eliseleyo AC ngetheorem kaPythagoras.
20261124-math-g09-1.actionItem: Yenza onxantathu abaneengile ethe nkqo abaninzi abanexabiso elifanayo le-sin A, uvavanye izibakala zabafundi ababini usebenzisa iziphumo, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni umlinganiselo wetrigonometri umiselwa bubungakanani beengile.

20261124-math-g09-2.title: Kufuneka sibuze ntoni ukumisela umsebenzi omnye wequadratic?
20261124-math-g09-2.summary: Sifuna ukufumana ikhweshini yomsebenzi wequadratic y=ax²+bx+c (a ayingo-0). (y ifundwa 'y ilingana no-a x isikwere kudibaniswe no-b x kudibaniswe no-c.') Umhlobo uza kukuxelela ulwazi ngegrafu iqhekeza elinye ngexesha.
20261124-math-g09-2.principle: 'Incopho nechaphaza elinye' imiselwa ngokufaka (0, 3) kwi-y=a(x-2)²-1, nto leyo enika a=1. 'Amachaphaza amathathu' amiselwa ngokufaka (0, 3) kwi-y=a(x-1)(x-3), nto leyo enika a=1. Kwamanye amaqhekeza amathathu olwazi, naxabiso lika-a okanye ukuphakama kwencopho akumiselwanga, ngoko zikho ikhweshini ezininzi.
20261124-math-g09-2.example: Sebenza ukuba zikho imisebenzi emibini okanye ngaphezulu eyahlukileyo yequadratic ehambelana nolwazi ngalunye.
20261124-math-g09-2.actionItem: Hlela ulwazi olwaneleyo ukumisela ikhweshini enye yomsebenzi wequadratic y=ax²+bx+c kulo olungonelanga, uze ugqibe ukuba loluphi umbuzo owongezelelweyo ekufuneka ububuzwe xa lungonelanga.

20261124-math-g10-1.title: Ngaba umgca uya kuchukumisa isangqa? Xa ulwazi luvezwa isiqwenga esinye ngexesha
20261124-math-g10-1.summary: Kukho isangqa x²+y²=25 (isazulu kwimvelaphi, irediyasi 5) nomgca y=x+k. Tshintsha ixabiso lika-k ujonge inani lamachaphaza apho umgca nesangqa zidibana khona.
20261124-math-g10-1.principle: Xela indawo yomgca nesangqa ngokuxhomekeke kwixabiso lengxelo engatshintshiyo k, uhlaziye isigwebo sakho ngolwazi olutsha, uze unciphise uluhlu luka-k apho bechukumisana khona.
20261124-math-g10-1.example: Unokuhlola inani lamachaphaza okudibana ngezisombululo zekhweshini oyifumanayo ngokusombulula iikhweshini zomgca nesangqa kunye.
20261124-math-g10-1.actionItem: Xela indawo yomgca nesangqa ngokuxhomekeke kwixabiso lengxelo engatshintshiyo k, uhlaziye isigwebo sakho ngolwazi olutsha, uze unciphise uluhlu luka-k apho bechukumisana khona.

20261124-math-g10-2.title: Isisombululo sentsalela siphosakale phi?
20261124-math-g10-2.summary: Esi sisisombululo sikaMinjae sokufumana ikhonkco a ukuze intsalela ibe ngu-6 xa ipolynomial f(x)=x³+ax²+x+2 ihlulwa nge-x+1. (x³ kuthetha u-x e-cube, kwaye ax² kuthetha a iphindaphindwe ngesikwere sika-x.)
20261124-math-g10-2.principle: Umgca wesi-2 uphosakele. x+1 inokubhalwa njenge-x−(−1), ngoko intsalela yi-f(−1), hayi i-f(1). Imigca yesi-3 nesi-4 ilandela nje umgca wesi-2, ngoko ubalo olungaphakathi kuyo lulungile, kodwa iziphumo zayo ziphosakele.
20261124-math-g10-2.example: Bhala kwakhona i-x+1 ukuze umahluli abe nefom ye-x−(inani elithile).
20261124-math-g10-2.actionItem: Fumana umgca ophosakeleyo kwisisombululo esifumana intsalela, uyilungise, uze uhlole impendulo ephosakeleyo ngokuchasene nemeko yokuqala ukuqinisekisa impazamo.

20261124-math-g11-1.title: Fumana umgca onengxaki kwisisombululo selingano lelogarithm
20261124-math-g11-1.summary: UMinho wasombulula ulingano log₂(x−1) + log₂(x−3) = 3 waphendula, ‘Izisombululo zi-x=5 no-x=−1, ezimbini.’ Ukuyifunda ngokuvakalayo, ithi ‘log isiseko 2 se-(x ngokususa 1) ukongeza log isiseko 2 se-(x ngokususa 3) kulingana no-3’.
20261124-math-g11-1.principle: Indawo yokuqala apho kuphambuka khona ngumgca wesi-2. Xa isixa seelogarithm ezimbini sidityaniswa sibe lilogarithm enye, iimeko zexabiso elingaphakathi x−1>0 no-x−3>0 ziyanyamalala kugama, yaye ezo meko azibhalwanga ngokwahlukeneyo. Ngoko kumgca wesi-5 zombini iingcambu zamkelwa, yaye umgca wesi-6 sisigqibo eso. Ixabiso elingaphakathi kufuneka lipositivu, ngoko x>3 iyafuneka. Ukuba x=−1, ngoko x−1=−2 no-x−3=−4, amaxabiso angaphakathi anegethivu, ngoko ulingano alucacisiwe. Ukuba x=5, log₂4 + log₂2 = 2+1 = 3, ngoko liyabamba. Ngoko isisombululo lixabiso elinye x=5.
20261124-math-g11-1.example: Ngalo lonke ixesha ugama liguquka, funda ukhangela ukuba lithetha okufanayo nomgca wangaphambili.
20261124-math-g11-1.actionItem: Fumana uze ulungise ingxaki ebangelwa kukungakhangeli imeko yexabiso elingaphakathi kwilogarithm kwisisombululo selingano lelogarithm.

20261124-math-g11-2.title: Zingaphi onxantathu onokwenziwa ngamacala amabini ne-engile e-1?
20261124-math-g11-2.summary: Konxantathu ABC, ∠A=60° kwaye ubude becala BC bungu-a=7. Xa ubude becala CA, b, bunikiwe, unokumisela ubude c becala AB wenze unxantathu. (a, b, c ngamacala achasene nee-∠A, ∠B, ∠C. cos60°=1/2.) UGaeun wathi, 'Ukuba b inkulu kune-7, onxantathu ababini abanjalo bahlala benziwa.'
20261124-math-g11-2.principle: Ukusuka kwi-49=64+c²−8c, c²−8c+15=0, (c−3)(c−5)=0, ngoko c=3 okanye 5. Amaxabiso omabini apozithivu, ngoko onxantathu ababini banokwenziwa.
20261124-math-g11-2.example: Faka a=7, b=8, cos60°=1/2 kumthetho wekhosayini ubhale ulingano lwe-c.
20261124-math-g11-2.actionItem: Vavanya ukuqhelekisa 'zihlala zimbini' ngamaxabiso athile uze uchaze ngezizathu ukuba zeziphi iimeko apho kungabambi.

20261124-math-g12-1.title: Ithi ipositivu, kodwa umntu uyagula ngokwenene na?
20261124-math-g12-1.summary: Uvavanyo lwesifo esithile lwabonakala ‘lupositivu’. Ufuna ukwazi ithuba lokuba umntu onesiphumo esipositivu uneso sifo ngokwenene. Gqiba ukuba luluphi ulwazi olufunekayo ukumisela eli thuba.
20261124-math-g12-1.principle: Abo bavavanywe bepositivu benziwe ‘ngabagulayo abavavanywe bepositivu’ ‘nabaphilileyo abavavanywe bepositivu’. Ngoko kufuneka umlinganiselo wabagulayo, ithuba lokuba ogulayo avavanywe epositivu, nethuba lokuba ophilileyo avavanywe epositivu.
20261124-math-g12-1.example: Khumbula ukuba ngawaphi amaqela amabini abantu abavavanyiweyo abanesiphumo esipositivu banokwahlulwa.
20261124-math-g12-1.actionItem: Khetha ulwazi olufunekayo ukufumana ithuba elinemeko, uze uchaze ngamanani ukuba kutheni ukuchaneka kovavanyo kwahlukile kwi-‘ithuba lokugula xa isiphumo sipositivu’.

20261124-math-g12-2.title: Ukuba icala elibomvu liyabonakala, kuthekani ngangasemva?
20261124-math-g12-2.summary: Kukho amakhadi amathathu ebhokisini. Elinye libomvu macala omabini (ikhadi elibomvu-elibomvu), elinye libomvu kwelinye icala neluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kwelinye (ikhadi elibomvu-eluhlaza), kwaye elinye luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka macala omabini (ikhadi eluhlaza-eluhlaza). Ukhetha ikhadi elinye ngokungenamkhethe ubeke icala elinye etafileni, kwaye ibomvu liyabonakala. Cinga ngethuba lokuba icala langasemva nalo libomvu.
20261124-math-g12-2.principle: Phucula ukuqikelela kwakho kokuqala (1/2) usebenzisa idatha nokuhlalutya, uze ufumane ukuba yeyiphi umgca woqikelelo ophosakeleyo ukuze utolike ithuba elinemeko ngokuchanekileyo.
20261124-math-g12-2.example: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, bhala ukuba zeziphi iimeko ozibalayo.
20261124-math-g12-2.actionItem: Phucula ukuqikelela kwakho kokuqala (1/2) usebenzisa idatha nokuhlalutya, uze ufumane ukuba yeyiphi umgca woqikelelo ophosakeleyo ukuze utolike ithuba elinemeko ngokuchanekileyo.

20261125-math-g01-1.title: Linjani ubume bento esebhokisini?
20261125-math-g01-1.summary: Uzonyaniswe amehlo uva into esebhokisini, yaye uva imibono kanye kanye. Into esebhokisini yenye yobume bebhokisi, ubume besilinda, okanye ubume besibhakabhaka.
20261125-math-g01-1.principle: Ngalo lonke ixesha ufumana umbono omnye owongezelelekileyo, cutha iimilo ezinokwenzeka uze ulungise umbono wakho wokuqala ukuze uhambelane nombono omtsha.
20261125-math-g01-1.example: Bhala imo yebhokisi, imo yesilinda, nemo yebhola, kwaye kwisikhomba ngasinye phawula iimo ezinokwenzeka.
20261125-math-g01-1.actionItem: Ngalo lonke ixesha ufumana umbono omnye owongezelelekileyo, cutha iimilo ezinokwenzeka uze ulungise umbono wakho wokuqala ukuze uhambelane nombono omtsha.

20261125-math-g01-2.title: Ubude obulinganiswe ngeepepaklipu neegluu estiki: sesiphi esinde ngakumbi?
20261125-math-g01-2.summary: U-Minjun ulinganise ubude bepensile ngeepepaklipu waza wafumana iipepaklipu ezi-5. U-Seoyun ulinganise ubude bepensile enemibala ngeegluu estiki (iglu enjengentonga) waza wafumana iigluu estiki ezi-3. Bobabini bazibeke emgceni omnye macala ngamacala ngaphandle kwezikhewu. Sesiphi esinde, ipensile okanye ipensile enemibala?
20261125-math-g01-2.principle: Ipepaklipu negluu estiki zinobude obahlukileyo, ngoko awunakuthelekisa ngokujonga u-5 no-3 kuphela. Ukuba uyazi ukuba igluu estiki e-1 ingaphi iipepaklipu, unokuthelekisa ngeyunithi enye, kwaye unokuthelekisa ipensile nepensile enemibala ngqo ngokulungelelanisa isiphelo esinye.
20261125-math-g01-2.example: Ingaba ipepaklipu enye inobude obufanayo negluu estiki enye? Cinga ngoko kuqala.
20261125-math-g01-2.actionItem: Funda ukuba ubude obulinganiswe ngeeyunithi ezahlukileyo abunakuthelekiswa ngamanani odwa, ugqibe ukuba ufuna ulwazi luni ukubuthelekisa.

20261125-math-g02-1.title: Ingaba inani elilandela u-1, 2, 4 linye kuphela?
20261125-math-g02-1.summary: Umhlobo ekubeni sisigaba sethu udlala umdlalo wolandelelwano lwamanani apho babonisa amanani elinye ngexesha. Umhlobo ugqibe ngepatheni enye aze akuxelele inani elinye ngexesha.
20261125-math-g02-1.principle: Funda ukuba amanani okuqala ambalwa kuphela awamiseli ipatheni ibe yinye, nokuba kufuneka ulungise ipatheni xa inani elitsha licaciswa, uze wenze ulandelelwano lwamanani ohambelana nepatheni ngokwakho.
20261125-math-g02-1.actionItem: Funda ukuba amanani okuqala ambalwa kuphela awamiseli ipatheni ibe yinye, nokuba kufuneka ulungise ipatheni xa inani elitsha licaciswa, uze wenze ulandelelwano lwamanani ohambelana nepatheni ngokwakho.

20261125-math-g02-2.title: Fumana inani eliyimfihlo likaSuji
20261125-math-g02-2.summary:
USuji ukhethe inani elinamadijithi amathathu waza wanika izikhokelo.
Isikhokelo 1) Idijithi kwindawo yamashumi inkulu nge-2 kunedijithi kwindawo yeeyunithi.
Isikhokelo 2) Idijithi kwindawo yeeyunithi ayingu-0.
Isikhokelo 3) Idijithi kwindawo yamakhulu inkulu kunedijithi kwindawo yamashumi.
20261125-math-g02-2.principle: 420 inayo 0 kwindawo yeeyunithi, ngoko ichasene nesikhokelo 2, kwaye 353 inayo 3 kwindawo yamakhulu, encinci kune-5 kwindawo yamashumi, ngoko ichasene nesikhokelo 3. 642 no-975 bahlangabezana nazo zonke izikhokelo ezintathu.
20261125-math-g02-2.example: Khetha inani elinye uzivavanye ngezikhokelo 1, 2, no-3 ngokulandelelana.
20261125-math-g02-2.actionItem: Sebenzisa ixabiso lendawo ukufumana inani elinamadijithi amathathu elihlangabezana nezikhokelo ezininzi ngaxeshanye, uze ukhethe izikhokelo ngokuthelekisa ukuba mangaphi amanani ashiywa sisikhokelo ngasinye.

20261125-math-g03-1.title: Iindlela Ezahlukeneyo Zokwabelana Nge-72 Zeekhandi Phakathi Kweepleyiti
20261125-math-g03-1.summary: Ufuna ukubeka ii-72 zeekhandi kwiipleyiti, wabelane ngokulinganayo kungashiyeki nanye. Inani leekhandi kwipleyiti nganye litshintsha ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni zingaphi iipleyiti osebenzisa.
20261125-math-g03-1.principle: Unokwabelana ngokulinganayo kungashiyeki nanye kuphela xa inani leepleyiti liphindaphindwe linani leekhandi kwipleyiti enye li-72. 4×18, 6×12, kunye no-9×8 zi-72, kwaye akukho nani eliphindaphindwe ngo-5 okanye ngo-7 elenza i-72.
20261125-math-g03-1.example: Kwinani ngalinye leepleyiti, wahlula i-72 ngelo nani uze uhlole ukuba ikho intsalela na.
20261125-math-g03-1.actionItem: Fumana iindlela ezininzi zokwabelana ezihlangabezana neemeko (uluhlu lwenani leepleyiti nenani leekhandi kwipleyiti nganye) ngaxeshanye, uze uchaze indlela inani leepleyiti nenani leekhandi kwipleyiti enye eziqhagamshela ngayo.

20261125-math-g03-2.title: Ukufumana Impazamo Ekwabelaneni Kweekhandi KukaSeoyeon
20261125-math-g03-2.summary: USeoyeon ufuna ukwabelana nge-85 zeekhandi ngokulinganayo phakathi kwabantu aba-4. Funda isisombululo sikaSeoyeon. Isiphumo sokwahlula linani lalo ngamnye umntu alifumanayo, kwaye intsalela linani eliseleyo emva kokwabelana.
20261125-math-g03-2.principle: Umgca wesi-3 uphosakele. Ii-khandi ezi-5 ezishiyekileyo zinokwabelwana kwakhona, ikhandi e-1 ngakumbi kubantu aba-4 ngabanye, ngoko ukuthi 'azinakwabelwana ngakumbi' akulunganga. Ukuhlola kumgca wesi-4 kubonisa kuphela ukuba isivakalisi samanani siyahambelana; akubonisi ukuba intsalela ichanekile na.
20261125-math-g03-2.example: Kumgca ngamnye, bala omnye ngomnye ukuhlola ukuba oko ukuthethayo kunjalo ngokwenene.
20261125-math-g03-2.actionItem: Sebenzisa imeko yokuba intsalela kufuneka ibe ncinci kunomahluli ukufumana ulungise impazamo kwisisombululo, uze wahlule iimeko apho impazamo efanayo yenzeka khona nalapho ingenzeki khona.

20261125-math-g04-1.title: Ukuhlola Inkcazo ka-Seohyeon
20261125-math-g04-1.summary: U-Seohyeon wachaza oku kumhlobo. Kukho impazamo kule nkcazo.
20261125-math-g04-1.principle: Umgca 3 yindawo apho kuqala ukuphosa. Isikwere sinamacala amane alinganayo, kodwa oko akuthethi okuchasene, "ukuba amacala amane alinganayo, sisikwere." Umgca 4 uqhubeka nempazamo efanayo, kodwa indawo yokuqala engalunganga ngumgca 3.
20261125-math-g04-1.example: Funda umgca ngamnye ubhalwe kwakhona ngefom "ukuba ..., ngoko ...," ubhale kumgca ngamnye ukuba uya kwicala elifanayo nesibakala somgca wangaphambili.
20261125-math-g04-1.actionItem: Fumana impazamo yengqiqo kwinkcazo ethi 'Ukuba onke amacala amane ayafana, sisikwere,' uze uchaze iquadrilateral ngumzekelo ochasayo.

20261125-math-g04-2.title: Iphosakale Phi Xa Kutshintshwa Kwaba Ngamadijithi?
20261125-math-g04-2.summary: UMinseo wabhala isisombululo sokubhala 'amawaka amathathu amashumi amabini anesihlanu amawaka ali-10, amawaka amane nesithandathu' ngamadijithi.
20261125-math-g04-2.principle: Umgca wesi-3 yindawo yokuqala ephosakeleyo. Kumawaka amane nesithandathu, indawo yamawaka yi-4 kwaye indawo yeeyunithi yi-6, kwaye iindawo zamakhulu namashumi zazingafundwanga kodwa ziyi-0, ngoko yi-4006. Imigca yesi-4 nesi-5 iphosakele kuba iqhuba ixabiso eliphosakeleyo elisuka kumgca wesi-3.
20261125-math-g04-2.example: Kumgca ngamnye, hlola omnye ngomnye ukuba 'amagama afundwayo' 'namadijithi abhaliweyo' ayahambelana na.
20261125-math-g04-2.actionItem: Fumana umgca ophosakeleyo kwisisombululo esitshintsha inani elikhulu elifundwe ngamagama laba ngamadijithi, uze ulungise usebenzisa ii-0 kwiindawo ezingafundwanga.

20261125-math-g05-1.title: Inani Lamaqela Okwabelana Ngokulinganayo: Ukulungisa Isisombululo
20261125-math-g05-1.summary: Ufuna ukwabelana ngeelekese ezingama-48 neetshokolethi ezingama-36 ngokulinganayo ungashiyi nto phakathi kwamaqela amaninzi. UHayun wafumana inani lamaqela ngolu hlobo.
20261125-math-g05-1.principle: Umgca 2 yindawo yokuqala engachanekanga. Inani lamaqela ahlulwa ngama-48 ngokulinganayo kufuneka libe linani elihlula ama-48 ngokulinganayo, oko kukuthi, isahluli sama-48. Isiphindaphindi sinokuba sikhulu kunama-48, yaye emva koko iilekese aziphelelanga. Umgca 4 uthi into eya kushiya amaqela athile engenalekese nanye kumaqela angama-144. Umgca 1 ukopishe ingxaki kakuhle, yaye u-144 emgceni 3 uchanekile njengesiphindaphindi esiqhelekileyo esincinane kakhulu sama-48 nama-36.
20261125-math-g05-1.example: Funda umgca ngamnye ucinge ukuba oko kuthethwa kunokwenzeka ngokwenene kwimeko eneelekese ezingama-48 neetshokolethi ezingama-36.
20261125-math-g05-1.actionItem: Fumana uze ulungise indawo kwisisombululo apho kwakhethwa ubudlelwane obungachanekanga phakathi kwamanani (isahluli/isiphindaphindi), uze ucinge ngazo zonke iimeko ezihambelana neemeko.

20261125-math-g05-2.title: Ukuba Imindilili Iyafana, Ingaba Amaqela Amabini Ayafana?
20261125-math-g05-2.summary: Iqela leSibhakabhaka neqela leLwandle zithumele abantu aba-4 ngalinye kukhuphiswano lokutsiba intambo. Iirekhodi zeqela leSibhakabhaka (inani lokutsiba) zingama-20, 22, 24, nama-54, kwaye iirekhodi zeqela leLwandle zingama-28, 29, 30, nama-33. Imindilili yawo omabini amaqela ifana, ngama-30. UDoha wathi, "Imindilili iyafana, ngoko amaqela amabini alunge ngokulinganayo."
20261125-math-g05-2.principle: Umndilili yi-(isixa sazo zonke)÷(inani labantu), ngoko ukuba inani labantu liyafana kwaye imindilili iyafana, izixa ziyafana nazo (zombini zingama-120). Kodwa awunakuthi ixabiso elikhulu kakhulu, ixabiso elincinci kakhulu, nendlela zisasazeke ngayo ziyafana.
20261125-math-g05-2.example: Kukhetho ngalunye, hlola omnye ngomnye ukuba liyinyani na kwiirekhodi zeqela leSibhakabhaka neqela leLwandle.
20261125-math-g05-2.actionItem: Hlola, ngedatha nangomzekelo owenza ngokwakho, ukuba nokuba imindilili iyafana, indlela idatha esasazeke ngayo inokwahluka, uze wahlule oko umndilili ukuxelela kona nokungenako ukukuxelela.

20261125-math-g06-1.title: Ukugcina incasa yobisi lwesitrobheri ifana xa wenza ngakumbi
20261125-math-g06-1.summary: USuyeon wenze isiraphu yobisi lwesitrobheri ngeekopi ezi-3 zesitrobheri neekopi ezi-2 zobisi, yaye incasa yayilungile kanye. Ufuna ukwenza ngakumbi ngencasa efanayo, yaye uSuyeon ucinga, “Ukuba ndongeza iikopi ezi-3 ezongezelelweyo zesitrobheri, ndongeza iikopi ezi-3 ezongezelelweyo zobisi.”
20261125-math-g06-1.principle: Jonga ngedatha ukuba ukongeza amanani aphelele ngokufanayo kutshintsha incasa, uze ulungise ingqiqo yakho ngomlinganiselo ogcina umlinganiselo ufana.
20261125-math-g06-1.example: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, bhala umlinganiselo wesitrobheri kubisi ngendlela efanayo uze uthelekise.
20261125-math-g06-1.actionItem: Jonga ngedatha ukuba ukongeza amanani aphelele ngokufanayo kutshintsha incasa, uze ulungise ingqiqo yakho ngomlinganiselo ogcina umlinganiselo ufana.

20261125-math-g06-2.title: Ingaba Ijusi Egxininisiweyo Engakumbi Ithetha Ijusi Eyomeleleyo?
20261125-math-g06-2.summary: Evenkileni yeejusi, iijusi ezimbini zenziwe ngokuxuba igxininiso namanzi usebenzisa ikomityi enye. IJusi A isebenzisa iikomityi ezi-3 zegxininiso neekomityi ezi-5 zamanzi, kwaye iJusi B isebenzisa iikomityi ezi-4 zegxininiso neekomityi ezi-8 zamanzi. UHajun wathi, "B inegxininiso elingakumbi, iikomityi ezi-4, ngoko B iyomelele!" (Apha, "iyomelele" ithetha ukuba xa usela into efanayo, kukho igxininiso elingakumbi kuyo.)
20261125-math-g06-2.principle: Ukomelela kwejusi akuxhomekekanga kwigxininiso kuphela kodwa ngokuba kukho igxininiso elingakanani xa lithelekiswa nomxube wonke. A inee-komityi ezi-3 kwezi-8 zonke, kwaye B inee-komityi ezi-4 kwezi-12 zonke.
20261125-math-g06-2.example: Ukuba usela into efanayo (umzekelo, ikomityi enye), kukho igxininiso elingakanani kuyo?
20261125-math-g06-2.actionItem: Bonisa ngomzekelo ochasayo ukuba isibakala esithi "leyo inegxininiso elingakumbi isoloko iyomelele" asisoloko sisebenza, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni kufuneka uthelekise usebenzisa umlinganiselo wegxininiso kwisiqingatha sonke.

20261125-math-g07-1.title: Ingaba Amaxesha Amakhulu Athetha Ukuba Benze Ngcono?
20261125-math-g07-1.summary:
Iklasi 1 (abafundi abangama-20) neKlasi 2 (abafundi abangama-50) bathabathe uvavanyo olufanayo lwemathematika. Itheyibhile yokwabiwa kwamaxesha enamanqaku abekwe kwizithuba ezintathu imi ngolu hlobo.
Isithuba / Iklasi 1 (abafundi abangama-20) / Iklasi 2 (abafundi abangama-50)
Ngaphantsi kwamanqaku angama-60 / abafundi aba-2 / abafundi abali-10
Amanqaku angama-60 okanye ngaphezulu kodwa ngaphantsi kwama-80 / abafundi abali-10 / abafundi abangama-25
Amanqaku angama-80 okanye ngaphezulu / abafundi aba-8 / abafundi abali-15
UMinji uthe, "Kukho abafundi abaninzi abanamanqaku angama-80 okanye ngaphezulu kwiKlasi 2, abali-15, ngoko iKlasi 2 yenze ngcono kuvavanyo."
20261125-math-g07-1.principle: Ngokwezabelo, kumanqaku angama-80 okanye ngaphezulu, iKlasi 1 inama-8/20=40% kwaye iKlasi 2 inama-15/50=30%, ngoko iKlasi 1 iphezulu; kumanqaku angaphantsi kwama-60, iKlasi 1 inama-2/20=10% kwaye iKlasi 2 inama-10/50=20%, ngoko iKlasi 2 iphindwe ngo-2 kunoKlasi 1. Umndilili awunakwaziwa kwitheyibhile enezithuba ezibekiweyo, kwaye isigqibo esithelekisa kuphela inani labafundi sinenkxaso ebuthathaka.
20261125-math-g07-1.example: Kwiklasi nganye, yahlula inani labafundi kuloo sithuba ngenani elipheleleyo labafundi kuloo klasi.
20261125-math-g07-1.actionItem: Funda ingxaki yokuthelekisa amaxesha njengoko enjalo xa iiklasi ezimbini zinamanani ahlukeneyo abafundi, uze wahlule oko itheyibhile ikuvumela ukuba ukuthi ngokuqinisekileyo kunoko ungakuthi.

20261125-math-g07-2.title: Ukufunda igrafu yokuphakama kwamanzi eyenziwe ngamachaphazelo
20261125-math-g07-2.summary: Silinganise ukuphakama kwamanzi ngexesha lokuthulula amanzi kwitanki. I-axis ethe tye ngamaxesha (imizuzu) yaye i-axis ethe nkqo kukuphakama (cm). Sibhala (ixesha, ukuphakama) njengesibini esilandelanayo siyizobe njengechaphazelo kwisicwangciso sokulungelelanisa. Amachaphazelo amaninzi aveziwe ngexesha elinye.
20261125-math-g07-2.principle: Njengoko amachaphazelo ongezwa omnye emva komnye, qikelela ipatheni, ulungise uqikelelo lwakho xa amachaphazelo amatsha evela, uze ucinge ukuba ungaqiniseka ngamaxabiso aphakathi kwamachaphazelo.
20261125-math-g07-2.example: Thelekisa ukuba ukuphakama kwamachaphazelo kutshintsha kangakanani ngalo lonke ixesha ixesha lonyuka ngomzuzu o-1.
20261125-math-g07-2.actionItem: Njengoko amachaphazelo ongezwa omnye emva komnye, qikelela ipatheni, ulungise uqikelelo lwakho xa amachaphazelo amatsha evela, uze ucinge ukuba ungaqiniseka ngamaxabiso aphakathi kwamachaphazelo.

20261125-math-g08-1.title: Zeziphi iinqaku esizifunayo ukufumana amaxabiso?
20261125-math-g08-1.summary: Sifuna ukufumana ixabiso lepensile enye, x won, nelencwadi yokubhala enye, y won, kwivenkile yezixhobo zokubhala. Umnini wasibonisa amanqaku ama-5 enyaniso. Inqaku A: Iipensile ezi-2 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-3 zibiza i-3,100 won. Inqaku B: Iipensile ezi-4 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-6 zibiza i-6,200 won. Inqaku C: Incwadi yokubhala ibiza i-200 won ngaphezu kwepensile. Inqaku D: Iipensile ezi-6 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-9 zibiza i-9,300 won. Inqaku E: Iipensile ezi-5 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-5 zibiza i-6,000 won.
20261125-math-g08-1.principle: Amaqhinga A, B no-D anomlinganiselo ofanayo weepensile kwiincwadi zokubhala, 2:3, kwaye izixa zawo ziziphindaphindi ezifanayo (ihlandlo eli-1, amahlandlo ama-2, amahlandlo ama-3), ngoko aphinda ulwazi olufanayo. Ngala maqhinga kuphela, awunakuyimisela into enye esisisombululo. Ukuba udibanisa amaqhinga anemilinganiselo eyahlukileyo yamanani (C, E), ulingano olubini lunika ulwazi olwahlukileyo, ngoko amaxabiso ayamiselwa. (Ipensile 500 won, incwadi yokubhala 700 won)
20261125-math-g08-1.example: Phinda ubhale amaqhinga ngohlobo 'iipensile □ + iincwadi zokubhala □ = □원' uze uthelekise amaqhinga amabini ecaleni kwelinye.
20261125-math-g08-1.actionItem: Xa usenza ukulingana ngaxeshanye, gwebela ukuba ukulingana kunika ulwazi olwahlukileyo na, uze wenze wena ukulingana okunganiki lwazi lutsha.

20261125-math-g08-2.title: Ithuba lentloko e-1 kuphela ngeengqekembe ezimbini
20261125-math-g08-2.summary: Phosa iingqekembe ezimbini ezilungileyo ngaxeshanye, kanye. Ukuba uchaza isiphumo ngenani lamakhanda kuphela, kukho 0, 1, okanye 2. Jonga indlela ingcinga yakho 'ngethuba lentloko e-1 kuphela' etshintsha ngayo ngobungqina.
20261125-math-g08-2.principle: Hlola ngobungqina ukuba iimeko ezibaliwe 'ngenani lamakhanda' azenzeki ngokulinganayo, uze uhlaziye isigwebo sakho sokuqala ngethuba.
20261125-math-g08-2.example: Qala ucinge ukuba loluphi isigwebo esinokwenzeka 'ngobungqina obubonayo ngoku kuphela.'
20261125-math-g08-2.actionItem: Hlola ngobungqina ukuba iimeko ezibaliwe 'ngenani lamakhanda' azenzeki ngokulinganayo, uze uhlaziye isigwebo sakho sokuqala ngethuba.

20261125-math-g09-1.title: Ukuba sin A=3/5, ingaba iyafana nokuba unxantathu uba mkhulu?
20261125-math-g09-1.summary: Kunxantathu oneengile ethe nkqo ABC, ∠C=90°, icala BC licala elichasene ne-∠A, icala AC licala elikufuphi ne-∠A (hayi ihayipothenyusi), kwaye icala AB yihayipothenyusi. sin A ifundwa 'sayini A' kwaye cos A ifundwa 'khosayini A.' Kula nxantathu, sin A=3/5 (3 phezu kwe-5).
20261125-math-g09-1.principle: Ukuba wandisa onke amacala amathathu ngesiphindaphindi esifanayo, njenge-(AB, BC, AC)=(5, 3, 4), (10, 6, 8), (15, 9, 12), sin A=3/5 ihlala injalo.
20261125-math-g09-1.example: Njengomzekelo olula kakhulu, xa BC=3 kunye ne-AB=5, fumana ubude becala eliseleyo AC ngetheorem kaPythagoras.
20261125-math-g09-1.actionItem: Yenza onxantathu abaneengile ethe nkqo abaninzi abanexabiso elifanayo le-sin A, uvavanye izibakala zabafundi ababini usebenzisa iziphumo, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni umlinganiselo wetrigonometri umiselwa bubungakanani beengile.

20261125-math-g09-2.title: Kufuneka sibuze ntoni ukumisela umsebenzi omnye wequadratic?
20261125-math-g09-2.summary: Sifuna ukufumana ikhweshini yomsebenzi wequadratic y=ax²+bx+c (a ayingo-0). (y ifundwa 'y ilingana no-a x isikwere kudibaniswe no-b x kudibaniswe no-c.') Umhlobo uza kukuxelela ulwazi ngegrafu iqhekeza elinye ngexesha.
20261125-math-g09-2.principle: 'Incopho nechaphaza elinye' imiselwa ngokufaka (0, 3) kwi-y=a(x-2)²-1, nto leyo enika a=1. 'Amachaphaza amathathu' amiselwa ngokufaka (0, 3) kwi-y=a(x-1)(x-3), nto leyo enika a=1. Kwamanye amaqhekeza amathathu olwazi, naxabiso lika-a okanye ukuphakama kwencopho akumiselwanga, ngoko zikho ikhweshini ezininzi.
20261125-math-g09-2.example: Sebenza ukuba zikho imisebenzi emibini okanye ngaphezulu eyahlukileyo yequadratic ehambelana nolwazi ngalunye.
20261125-math-g09-2.actionItem: Hlela ulwazi olwaneleyo ukumisela ikhweshini enye yomsebenzi wequadratic y=ax²+bx+c kulo olungonelanga, uze ugqibe ukuba loluphi umbuzo owongezelelweyo ekufuneka ububuzwe xa lungonelanga.

20261125-math-g10-1.title: Ngaba umgca uya kuchukumisa isangqa? Xa ulwazi luvezwa isiqwenga esinye ngexesha
20261125-math-g10-1.summary: Kukho isangqa x²+y²=25 (isazulu kwimvelaphi, irediyasi 5) nomgca y=x+k. Tshintsha ixabiso lika-k ujonge inani lamachaphaza apho umgca nesangqa zidibana khona.
20261125-math-g10-1.principle: Xela indawo yomgca nesangqa ngokuxhomekeke kwixabiso lengxelo engatshintshiyo k, uhlaziye isigwebo sakho ngolwazi olutsha, uze unciphise uluhlu luka-k apho bechukumisana khona.
20261125-math-g10-1.example: Unokuhlola inani lamachaphaza okudibana ngezisombululo zekhweshini oyifumanayo ngokusombulula iikhweshini zomgca nesangqa kunye.
20261125-math-g10-1.actionItem: Xela indawo yomgca nesangqa ngokuxhomekeke kwixabiso lengxelo engatshintshiyo k, uhlaziye isigwebo sakho ngolwazi olutsha, uze unciphise uluhlu luka-k apho bechukumisana khona.

20261125-math-g10-2.title: Isisombululo sentsalela siphosakale phi?
20261125-math-g10-2.summary: Esi sisisombululo sikaMinjae sokufumana ikhonkco a ukuze intsalela ibe ngu-6 xa ipolynomial f(x)=x³+ax²+x+2 ihlulwa nge-x+1. (x³ kuthetha u-x e-cube, kwaye ax² kuthetha a iphindaphindwe ngesikwere sika-x.)
20261125-math-g10-2.principle: Umgca wesi-2 uphosakele. x+1 inokubhalwa njenge-x−(−1), ngoko intsalela yi-f(−1), hayi i-f(1). Imigca yesi-3 nesi-4 ilandela nje umgca wesi-2, ngoko ubalo olungaphakathi kuyo lulungile, kodwa iziphumo zayo ziphosakele.
20261125-math-g10-2.example: Bhala kwakhona i-x+1 ukuze umahluli abe nefom ye-x−(inani elithile).
20261125-math-g10-2.actionItem: Fumana umgca ophosakeleyo kwisisombululo esifumana intsalela, uyilungise, uze uhlole impendulo ephosakeleyo ngokuchasene nemeko yokuqala ukuqinisekisa impazamo.

20261125-math-g11-1.title: Fumana umgca onengxaki kwisisombululo selingano lelogarithm
20261125-math-g11-1.summary: UMinho wasombulula ulingano log₂(x−1) + log₂(x−3) = 3 waphendula, ‘Izisombululo zi-x=5 no-x=−1, ezimbini.’ Ukuyifunda ngokuvakalayo, ithi ‘log isiseko 2 se-(x ngokususa 1) ukongeza log isiseko 2 se-(x ngokususa 3) kulingana no-3’.
20261125-math-g11-1.principle: Indawo yokuqala apho kuphambuka khona ngumgca wesi-2. Xa isixa seelogarithm ezimbini sidityaniswa sibe lilogarithm enye, iimeko zexabiso elingaphakathi x−1>0 no-x−3>0 ziyanyamalala kugama, yaye ezo meko azibhalwanga ngokwahlukeneyo. Ngoko kumgca wesi-5 zombini iingcambu zamkelwa, yaye umgca wesi-6 sisigqibo eso. Ixabiso elingaphakathi kufuneka lipositivu, ngoko x>3 iyafuneka. Ukuba x=−1, ngoko x−1=−2 no-x−3=−4, amaxabiso angaphakathi anegethivu, ngoko ulingano alucacisiwe. Ukuba x=5, log₂4 + log₂2 = 2+1 = 3, ngoko liyabamba. Ngoko isisombululo lixabiso elinye x=5.
20261125-math-g11-1.example: Ngalo lonke ixesha ugama liguquka, funda ukhangela ukuba lithetha okufanayo nomgca wangaphambili.
20261125-math-g11-1.actionItem: Fumana uze ulungise ingxaki ebangelwa kukungakhangeli imeko yexabiso elingaphakathi kwilogarithm kwisisombululo selingano lelogarithm.

20261125-math-g11-2.title: Zingaphi onxantathu onokwenziwa ngamacala amabini ne-engile e-1?
20261125-math-g11-2.summary: Konxantathu ABC, ∠A=60° kwaye ubude becala BC bungu-a=7. Xa ubude becala CA, b, bunikiwe, unokumisela ubude c becala AB wenze unxantathu. (a, b, c ngamacala achasene nee-∠A, ∠B, ∠C. cos60°=1/2.) UGaeun wathi, 'Ukuba b inkulu kune-7, onxantathu ababini abanjalo bahlala benziwa.'
20261125-math-g11-2.principle: Ukusuka kwi-49=64+c²−8c, c²−8c+15=0, (c−3)(c−5)=0, ngoko c=3 okanye 5. Amaxabiso omabini apozithivu, ngoko onxantathu ababini banokwenziwa.

20261125-math-g12-1.title: Ithi ipositivu, kodwa umntu uyagula ngokwenene na?
20261125-math-g12-1.summary: Uvavanyo lwesifo esithile lwabonakala ‘lupositivu’. Ufuna ukwazi ithuba lokuba umntu onesiphumo esipositivu uneso sifo ngokwenene. Gqiba ukuba luluphi ulwazi olufunekayo ukumisela eli thuba.
20261125-math-g12-1.principle: Abo bavavanywe bepositivu benziwe ‘ngabagulayo abavavanywe bepositivu’ ‘nabaphilileyo abavavanywe bepositivu’. Ngoko kufuneka umlinganiselo wabagulayo, ithuba lokuba ogulayo avavanywe epositivu, nethuba lokuba ophilileyo avavanywe epositivu.
20261125-math-g12-1.example: Khumbula ukuba ngawaphi amaqela amabini abantu abavavanyiweyo abanesiphumo esipositivu banokwahlulwa.

20261125-math-g12-2.title: Ukuba icala elibomvu liyabonakala, kuthekani ngangasemva?
20261125-math-g12-2.summary: Kukho amakhadi amathathu ebhokisini. Elinye libomvu macala omabini (ikhadi elibomvu-elibomvu), elinye libomvu kwelinye icala neluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kwelinye (ikhadi elibomvu-eluhlaza), kwaye elinye luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka macala omabini (ikhadi eluhlaza-eluhlaza). Ukhetha ikhadi elinye ngokungenamkhethe ubeke icala elinye etafileni, kwaye ibomvu liyabonakala. Cinga ngethuba lokuba icala langasemva nalo libomvu.

physics-g12-2.summary: Isuntswana elinentlawulo elinobunzima m kunye nentlawulo q, elingena ngokuthe nkqo kwimagnethi ephakathi ehambelana B, lenza intshukumo yesetyhula ngesantya v. Yeyiphi ifomula echanekileyo yomgama we-orbit r kunye nexesha T lale ntshukumo yesetyhula yesuntswana?

physics-g12-2.example: Amandla ka-Lorentz asebenza njengamandla e-centripetal kwintshukumo yesetyhula: q v B = m v² / r

20261121-physics-g10-1.title: Ukungqubana Nokhuseleko, Ukuphoswa Ngokuthe Tye kunye Nomxhuzulane
20261121-physics-g10-1.summary: Kufutshane nomhlaba, phakathi kwamabhola amabini entsimbi A kunye no-B kubude obufanayo, u-A ukhululwa awe ngokukhululekileyo kwaye u-B ukhutshwa ngamandla ngokuthe tye. Sesiphi isivakalisi esiyinyani malunga nentshukumo yala mabhola mabini? (Ungakuhoyi ukumelana komoya)
20261121-physics-g10-1.principle: Intshukumo ethe tye engatshintshiyo kunye nentshukumo yokuwa ngokukhululekileyo ethe nkqo zizimeleyo. Onke amabhola mabini awa ngokuthe nkqo ngokukhawuleza komxhuzulane okufanayo $g$, ngoko afika emhlabeni ngexesha elinye.

20261121-physics-g10-2.title: Ukungqubana Nokhuseleko, Ukuphoswa Ngokuthe Tye kunye Nomxhuzulane
20261121-physics-g10-2.summary: Amaqanda amabini anobunzima obufanayo awiswa evela kubude obufanayo ngokulandelelana kumgangatho wesamente nakumcamelo ethambileyo. Uthelekiso olufanelekileyo lwezixa zomzimba ukusuka kwisiquphe sokuchukumisa umhlaba ukuya kokuyeka luluphi?
20261121-physics-g10-2.principle: Kuba utshintsho lwenani lentshukumo lamaqanda omabini ($\Delta p$) luyafana, umxhuzulane wesantya ($I = F\Delta t$) ufana. Umcamelo wandisa ixesha lokubetha $\Delta t$ kwaye unciphisa amandla aphakathi okubetha $F = \frac{I}{\Delta t}$ ukuze iqanda lingaqhekeki.
20261121-physics-g10-2.example: Kuba awe kubude obufanayo, isantya ngaphambi kokubetha kunye notshintsho lwesantya emva kokuyeka (utshintsho lwenani lentshukumo = umxhuzulane wesantya) iyafana.
20261121-physics-g10-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261121-physics-g11-1.title: Imithetho kaNewton Yentshukumo kunye Nobudlelwane Obukhethekileyo
20261121-physics-g11-1.summary: Yeyiphi eyona ngxelo echanekileyo yomahluko wokwenyani wezimo phakathi 'kobudlelwane bentshukumo nokuphendula' kunye 'nobudlelwane bokulingana kwamandla amabini'?
20261121-physics-g11-1.principle: Intshukumo nokuphendula zisebenza ngokwahlukeneyo kwizinto ezimbini ezahlukeneyo ezisebenzisana, ngoko amandla amabini akanakudityaniswa, kodwa ekulinganeni kwamandla indawo yokusebenza ikwinto enye, ngoko adityaniswa abe nesiphumo esinguziro.
20261121-physics-g11-1.example: Intshukumo nokuphendula: amandla asunduza u-A ku-B kunye namandla asunduza u-B ku-A

20261121-physics-g11-2.title: Imithetho kaNewton Yentshukumo kunye Nobudlelwane Obukhethekileyo
20261121-physics-g11-2.summary: Kumgangatho othe tye ongenaxinzelelo, into u-A enobunzima obu-3 kg kunye nento u-B enobunzima obuyi-2 kg zibekwe zichukumisana kwaye zisunduzwa ngamandla angama-20 N ngokuthe tye kwicala luka-A. Ukukhawuleza kwazo zombini izinto kunye nobungakanani bamandla asunduza u-A ku-B buyintoni ngokulandelelana?
20261121-physics-g11-2.principle: Ukukhawuleza okupheleleyo ngu-$a = \frac{F}{m_A + m_B} = \frac{20\text{ N}}{5\text{ kg}} = 4\text{ m/s}^2$. Amandla aphumelelayo akhawulezisa into u-B kuphela ngamandla okuchukumisa asunduza u-A ku-B, ngoko $F_{AB} = m_B \cdot a = 2\text{ kg} \times 4\text{ m/s}^2 = 8\text{ N}$.
20261121-physics-g11-2.example: Inkqubo epheleleyo (A+B): F = (m<sub>A</sub> + m<sub>B</sub>) a → 20 = (3 + 2) a
20261121-physics-g11-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261121-physics-g12-1.title: Iziphumo Ze-Photoelectric, Ubume Obubini Bokukhanya, kunye Nehlabathi Elincinci Kakhulu
20261121-physics-g12-1.summary: Phakathi kweziphumo zovavanyo lwe-photoelectric effect luka-Einstein, yeyiphi inyani ekungenakucaciswa ngokwe 'theory yamaza' yokukhanya kwaye icacisiwe ngokugqibeleleyo kuphela yi 'theory ye-quantum yokukhanya (theory yamasuntswana)'?
20261121-physics-g12-1.principle: I-theory yamaza ibikezela ukuba amandla agcinwa ngexesha, kodwa kwi-photoelectric effect i-photon enye kuphela enengqokelela engaphezulu kwengqokelela ebalulekileyo ibethana ngokukhawuleza ne-elektroni kwaye idlulisele amandla, ngoko i-elektroni ikhutshwa ngokukhawuleza ngaphandle kokulibaziseka ngexesha.
20261121-physics-g12-1.example: Ngokwe-theory yamaza, nokukhanya okuthambileyo, ukuba kubengezelwa ixesha elide kwaye amandla agcinwe, kufuneka kukhutshwe, kodwa ngokwenene kukhutshwa ngokukhawuleza.

20261121-physics-g12-2.title: Iziphumo Ze-Photoelectric, Ubume Obubini Bokukhanya, kunye Nehlabathi Elincinci Kakhulu
20261121-physics-g12-2.summary: Isuntswana elinentlawulo elinobunzima m kunye nentlawulo q, elingena ngokuthe nkqo kwimagnethi ephakathi ehambelana B, lenza intshukumo yesetyhula ngesantya v. Yeyiphi ifomula echanekileyo yomgama we-orbit r kunye nexesha T lale ntshukumo yesetyhula yesuntswana?
20261121-physics-g12-2.principle: Ifomula yamandla e-centripetal $\frac{mv^2}{r} = qvB \implies r = \frac{mv}{qB}$. Ixesha $T = \frac{2\pi r}{v} = \frac{2\pi m}{qB}$, kwaye kumangalisa ukuba linexesha le-cyclotron elingaxhomekekanga kumgama we-orbit okanye isantya.
20261121-physics-g12-2.example: Amandla ka-Lorentz asebenza njengamandla e-centripetal kwintshukumo yesetyhula: q v B = m v² / r

20261122-physics-g09-1.title: Umsebenzi kunye Nokuguqulelana Kwamandla Omatshini

20261122-physics-g09-1.principle: Xa uphethe ibhokisi uhamba ngokuthe tye, amandla asebenzayo (amandla aphezulu ixhasa umxhuzulane) kunye necala lokuhamba (ngokuthe tye) yenza i-engile ye-$90^\circ$, ngoko akukho nxalenye yamandla ekwicala lokuhamba kwaye umsebenzi owenziweyo ngu-$0$.

20261122-physics-g09-2.title: Umsebenzi kunye Nokuguqulelana Kwamandla Omatshini
20261122-physics-g09-2.summary: Ngokuguqula ubunzima kunye nesantya sebhulorho, kwabethwa isiqwenga somthi kwaye kwalinganiswa umgama osunduzwe sisiqwenga somthi. Sesiphi isigqibo esiyinyani malunga nenkqubo yamandla ehambayo?

20261122-physics-g10-1.title: Ukungqubana Nokhuseleko, Ukuphoswa Ngokuthe Tye kunye Nomxhuzulane
20261122-physics-g10-1.summary: Kufutshane nomhlaba, phakathi kwamabhola amabini entsimbi A kunye no-B kubude obufanayo, u-A ukhululwa awe ngokukhululekileyo kwaye u-B ukhutshwa ngamandla ngokuthe tye. Sesiphi isivakalisi esiyinyani malunga nentshukumo yala mabhola mabini? (Ungakuhoyi ukumelana komoya)
20261122-physics-g10-1.principle: Intshukumo ethe tye engatshintshiyo kunye nentshukumo yokuwa ngokukhululekileyo ethe nkqo zizimeleyo. Onke amabhola mabini awa ngokuthe nkqo ngokukhawuleza komxhuzulane okufanayo $g$, ngoko afika emhlabeni ngexesha elinye.

20261122-physics-g10-2.title: Ukungqubana Nokhuseleko, Ukuphoswa Ngokuthe Tye kunye Nomxhuzulane
20261122-physics-g10-2.summary: Amaqanda amabini anobunzima obufanayo awiswa evela kubude obufanayo ngokulandelelana kumgangatho wesamente nakumcamelo ethambileyo. Uthelekiso olufanelekileyo lwezixa zomzimba ukusuka kwisiquphe sokuchukumisa umhlaba ukuya kokuyeka luluphi?
20261122-physics-g10-2.principle: Kuba utshintsho lwenani lentshukumo lamaqanda omabini ($\Delta p$) luyafana, umxhuzulane wesantya ($I = F\Delta t$) ufana. Umcamelo wandisa ixesha lokubetha $\Delta t$ kwaye unciphisa amandla aphakathi okubetha $F = \frac{I}{\Delta t}$ ukuze iqanda lingaqhekeki.
20261122-physics-g10-2.example: Kuba awe kubude obufanayo, isantya ngaphambi kokubetha kunye notshintsho lwesantya emva kokuyeka (utshintsho lwenani lentshukumo = umxhuzulane wesantya) iyafana.
20261122-physics-g10-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g11-1.title: Imithetho kaNewton Yentshukumo kunye Nobudlelwane Obukhethekileyo
20261122-physics-g11-1.summary: Yeyiphi eyona ngxelo echanekileyo yomahluko wokwenyani wezimo phakathi 'kobudlelwane bentshukumo nokuphendula' kunye 'nobudlelwane bokulingana kwamandla amabini'?
20261122-physics-g11-1.principle: Intshukumo nokuphendula zisebenza ngokwahlukeneyo kwizinto ezimbini ezahlukeneyo ezisebenzisana, ngoko amandla amabini akanakudityaniswa, kodwa ekulinganeni kwamandla indawo yokusebenza ikwinto enye, ngoko adityaniswa abe nesiphumo esinguziro.
20261122-physics-g11-1.example: Intshukumo nokuphendula: amandla asunduza u-A ku-B kunye namandla asunduza u-B ku-A

20261122-physics-g11-2.title: Imithetho kaNewton Yentshukumo kunye Nobudlelwane Obukhethekileyo
20261122-physics-g11-2.summary: Kumgangatho othe tye ongenaxinzelelo, into u-A enobunzima obu-3 kg kunye nento u-B enobunzima obuyi-2 kg zibekwe zichukumisana kwaye zisunduzwa ngamandla angama-20 N ngokuthe tye kwicala luka-A. Ukukhawuleza kwazo zombini izinto kunye nobungakanani bamandla asunduza u-A ku-B buyintoni ngokulandelelana?
20261122-physics-g11-2.principle: Ukukhawuleza okupheleleyo ngu-$a = \frac{F}{m_A + m_B} = \frac{20\text{ N}}{5\text{ kg}} = 4\text{ m/s}^2$. Amandla aphumelelayo akhawulezisa into u-B kuphela ngamandla okuchukumisa asunduza u-A ku-B, ngoko $F_{AB} = m_B \cdot a = 2\text{ kg} \times 4\text{ m/s}^2 = 8\text{ N}$.
20261122-physics-g11-2.example: Inkqubo epheleleyo (A+B): F = (m<sub>A</sub> + m<sub>B</sub>) a → 20 = (3 + 2) a
20261122-physics-g11-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g12-1.title: Iziphumo Ze-Photoelectric, Ubume Obubini Bokukhanya, kunye Nehlabathi Elincinci Kakhulu
20261122-physics-g12-1.summary: Phakathi kweziphumo zovavanyo lwe-photoelectric effect luka-Einstein, yeyiphi inyani ekungenakucaciswa ngokwe 'theory yamaza' yokukhanya kwaye icacisiwe ngokugqibeleleyo kuphela yi 'theory ye-quantum yokukhanya (theory yamasuntswana)'?
20261122-physics-g12-1.principle: I-theory yamaza ibikezela ukuba amandla agcinwa ngexesha, kodwa kwi-photoelectric effect i-photon enye kuphela enengqokelela engaphezulu kwengqokelela ebalulekileyo ibethana ngokukhawuleza ne-elektroni kwaye idlulisele amandla, ngoko i-elektroni ikhutshwa ngokukhawuleza ngaphandle kokulibaziseka ngexesha.
20261122-physics-g12-1.example: Ngokwe-theory yamaza, nokukhanya okuthambileyo, ukuba kubengezelwa ixesha elide kwaye amandla agcinwe, kufuneka kukhutshwe, kodwa ngokwenene kukhutshwa ngokukhawuleza.
20261122-physics-g12-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-physics-g12-2.title: Iziphumo Ze-Photoelectric, Ubume Obubini Bokukhanya, kunye Nehlabathi Elincinci Kakhulu
20261122-physics-g12-2.summary: Isuntswana elinentlawulo elinobunzima m kunye nentlawulo q, elingena ngokuthe nkqo kwimagnethi ephakathi ehambelana B, lenza intshukumo yesetyhula ngesantya v. Yeyiphi ifomula echanekileyo yomgama we-orbit r kunye nexesha T lale ntshukumo yesetyhula yesuntswana?
20261122-physics-g12-2.principle: Ifomula yamandla e-centripetal $\frac{mv^2}{r} = qvB \implies r = \frac{mv}{qB}$. Ixesha $T = \frac{2\pi r}{v} = \frac{2\pi m}{qB}$, kwaye kumangalisa ukuba linexesha le-cyclotron elingaxhomekekanga kumgama we-orbit okanye isantya.
20261122-physics-g12-2.example: Amandla ka-Lorentz asebenza njengamandla e-centripetal kwintshukumo yesetyhula: q v B = m v² / r
20261122-physics-g12-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g10-1.title: Ukungqubana Nokhuseleko, Ukuphoswa Ngokuthe Tye kunye Nomxhuzulane
20261123-physics-g10-1.summary: Kufutshane nomhlaba, phakathi kwamabhola amabini entsimbi A kunye no-B kubude obufanayo, u-A ukhululwa awe ngokukhululekileyo kwaye u-B ukhutshwa ngamandla ngokuthe tye. Sesiphi isivakalisi esiyinyani malunga nentshukumo yala mabhola mabini? (Ungakuhoyi ukumelana komoya)
20261123-physics-g10-1.principle: Intshukumo ethe tye engatshintshiyo kunye nentshukumo yokuwa ngokukhululekileyo ethe nkqo zizimeleyo. Onke amabhola mabini awa ngokuthe nkqo ngokukhawuleza komxhuzulane okufanayo $g$, ngoko afika emhlabeni ngexesha elinye.
20261123-physics-g10-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g10-2.title: Ukungqubana Nokhuseleko, Ukuphoswa Ngokuthe Tye kunye Nomxhuzulane
20261123-physics-g10-2.summary: Amaqanda amabini anobunzima obufanayo awiswa evela kubude obufanayo ngokulandelelana kumgangatho wesamente nakumcamelo ethambileyo. Uthelekiso olufanelekileyo lwezixa zomzimba ukusuka kwisiquphe sokuchukumisa umhlaba ukuya kokuyeka luluphi?
20261123-physics-g10-2.principle: Kuba utshintsho lwenani lentshukumo lamaqanda omabini ($\Delta p$) luyafana, umxhuzulane wesantya ($I = F\Delta t$) ufana. Umcamelo wandisa ixesha lokubetha $\Delta t$ kwaye unciphisa amandla aphakathi okubetha $F = \frac{I}{\Delta t}$ ukuze iqanda lingaqhekeki.
20261123-physics-g10-2.example: Kuba awe kubude obufanayo, isantya ngaphambi kokubetha kunye notshintsho lwesantya emva kokuyeka (utshintsho lwenani lentshukumo = umxhuzulane wesantya) iyafana.
20261123-physics-g10-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g11-1.title: Imithetho kaNewton Yentshukumo kunye Nobudlelwane Obukhethekileyo
20261123-physics-g11-1.summary: Yeyiphi eyona ngxelo echanekileyo yomahluko wokwenyani wezimo phakathi 'kobudlelwane bentshukumo nokuphendula' kunye 'nobudlelwane bokulingana kwamandla amabini'?
20261123-physics-g11-1.principle: Intshukumo nokuphendula zisebenza ngokwahlukeneyo kwizinto ezimbini ezahlukeneyo ezisebenzisana, ngoko amandla amabini akanakudityaniswa, kodwa ekulinganeni kwamandla indawo yokusebenza ikwinto enye, ngoko adityaniswa abe nesiphumo esinguziro.
20261123-physics-g11-1.example: Intshukumo nokuphendula: amandla asunduza u-A ku-B kunye namandla asunduza u-B ku-A

20261123-physics-g11-2.title: Imithetho kaNewton Yentshukumo kunye Nobudlelwane Obukhethekileyo
20261123-physics-g11-2.summary: Kumgangatho othe tye ongenaxinzelelo, into u-A enobunzima obu-3 kg kunye nento u-B enobunzima obuyi-2 kg zibekwe zichukumisana kwaye zisunduzwa ngamandla angama-20 N ngokuthe tye kwicala luka-A. Ukukhawuleza kwazo zombini izinto kunye nobungakanani bamandla asunduza u-A ku-B buyintoni ngokulandelelana?
20261123-physics-g11-2.principle: Ukukhawuleza okupheleleyo ngu-$a = \frac{F}{m_A + m_B} = \frac{20\text{ N}}{5\text{ kg}} = 4\text{ m/s}^2$. Amandla aphumelelayo akhawulezisa into u-B kuphela ngamandla okuchukumisa asunduza u-A ku-B, ngoko $F_{AB} = m_B \cdot a = 2\text{ kg} \times 4\text{ m/s}^2 = 8\text{ N}$.
20261123-physics-g11-2.example: Inkqubo epheleleyo (A+B): F = (m<sub>A</sub> + m<sub>B</sub>) a → 20 = (3 + 2) a
20261123-physics-g11-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g12-1.title: Iziphumo Ze-Photoelectric, Ubume Obubini Bokukhanya, kunye Nehlabathi Elincinci Kakhulu
20261123-physics-g12-1.summary: Phakathi kweziphumo zovavanyo lwe-photoelectric effect luka-Einstein, yeyiphi inyani ekungenakucaciswa ngokwe 'theory yamaza' yokukhanya kwaye icacisiwe ngokugqibeleleyo kuphela yi 'theory ye-quantum yokukhanya (theory yamasuntswana)'?
20261123-physics-g12-1.principle: I-theory yamaza ibikezela ukuba amandla agcinwa ngexesha, kodwa kwi-photoelectric effect i-photon enye kuphela enengqokelela engaphezulu kwengqokelela ebalulekileyo ibethana ngokukhawuleza ne-elektroni kwaye idlulisele amandla, ngoko i-elektroni ikhutshwa ngokukhawuleza ngaphandle kokulibaziseka ngexesha.
20261123-physics-g12-1.example: Ngokwe-theory yamaza, nokukhanya okuthambileyo, ukuba kubengezelwa ixesha elide kwaye amandla agcinwe, kufuneka kukhutshwe, kodwa ngokwenene kukhutshwa ngokukhawuleza.
20261123-physics-g12-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-physics-g12-2.title: Iziphumo Ze-Photoelectric, Ubume Obubini Bokukhanya, kunye Nehlabathi Elincinci Kakhulu
20261123-physics-g12-2.summary: Isuntswana elinentlawulo elinobunzima m kunye nentlawulo q, elingena ngokuthe nkqo kwimagnethi ephakathi ehambelana B, lenza intshukumo yesetyhula ngesantya v. Yeyiphi ifomula echanekileyo yomgama we-orbit r kunye nexesha T lale ntshukumo yesetyhula yesuntswana?
20261123-physics-g12-2.principle: Ifomula yamandla e-centripetal $\frac{mv^2}{r} = qvB \implies r = \frac{mv}{qB}$. Ixesha $T = \frac{2\pi r}{v} = \frac{2\pi m}{qB}$, kwaye kumangalisa ukuba linexesha le-cyclotron elingaxhomekekanga kumgama we-orbit okanye isantya.
20261123-physics-g12-2.example: Amandla ka-Lorentz asebenza njengamandla e-centripetal kwintshukumo yesetyhula: q v B = m v² / r
20261123-physics-g12-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g10-1.title: Ukungqubana Nokhuseleko, Ukuphoswa Ngokuthe Tye kunye Nomxhuzulane

Sesiphi isivakalisi esiyinyani malunga nentshukumo yala mabhola mabini? (Ungakuhoyi ukumelana komoya)
20261124-physics-g10-1.principle: Intshukumo ethe tye engatshintshiyo kunye nentshukumo yokuwa ngokukhululekileyo ethe nkqo zizimeleyo. Onke amabhola mabini awa ngokuthe nkqo ngokukhawuleza komxhuzulane okufanayo $g$, ngoko afika emhlabeni ngexesha elinye.

20261124-physics-g10-2.title: Ukungqubana Nokhuseleko, Ukuphoswa Ngokuthe Tye kunye Nomxhuzulane
20261124-physics-g10-2.summary: Amaqanda amabini anobunzima obufanayo awiswa evela kubude obufanayo ngokulandelelana kumgangatho wesamente nakumcamelo ethambileyo. Uthelekiso olufanelekileyo lwezixa zomzimba ukusuka kwisiquphe sokuchukumisa umhlaba ukuya kokuyeka luluphi?
20261124-physics-g10-2.principle: Kuba utshintsho lwenani lentshukumo lamaqanda omabini ($\Delta p$) luyafana, umxhuzulane wesantya ($I = F\Delta t$) ufana. Umcamelo wandisa ixesha lokubetha $\Delta t$ kwaye unciphisa amandla aphakathi okubetha $F = \frac{I}{\Delta t}$ ukuze iqanda lingaqhekeki.
20261124-physics-g10-2.example: Kuba awe kubude obufanayo, isantya ngaphambi kokubetha kunye notshintsho lwesantya emva kokuyeka (utshintsho lwenani lentshukumo = umxhuzulane wesantya) iyafana.

20261124-physics-g11-1.title: Imithetho kaNewton Yentshukumo kunye Nobudlelwane Obukhethekileyo
20261124-physics-g11-1.summary: Yeyiphi eyona ngxelo echanekileyo yomahluko wokwenyani wezimo phakathi 'kobudlelwane bentshukumo nokuphendula' kunye 'nobudlelwane bokulingana kwamandla amabini'?
20261124-physics-g11-1.principle: Intshukumo nokuphendula zisebenza ngokwahlukeneyo kwizinto ezimbini ezahlukeneyo ezisebenzisana, ngoko amandla amabini akanakudityaniswa, kodwa ekulinganeni kwamandla indawo yokusebenza ikwinto enye, ngoko adityaniswa abe nesiphumo esinguziro.
20261124-physics-g11-1.example: Intshukumo nokuphendula: amandla asunduza u-A ku-B kunye namandla asunduza u-B ku-A

20261124-physics-g11-2.title: Imithetho kaNewton Yentshukumo kunye Nobudlelwane Obukhethekileyo
20261124-physics-g11-2.summary: Kumgangatho othe tye ongenaxinzelelo, into u-A enobunzima obu-3 kg kunye nento u-B enobunzima obuyi-2 kg zibekwe zichukumisana kwaye zisunduzwa ngamandla angama-20 N ngokuthe tye kwicala luka-A. Ukukhawuleza kwazo zombini izinto kunye nobungakanani bamandla asunduza u-A ku-B buyintoni ngokulandelelana?
20261124-physics-g11-2.principle: Ukukhawuleza okupheleleyo ngu-$a = \frac{F}{m_A + m_B} = \frac{20\text{ N}}{5\text{ kg}} = 4\text{ m/s}^2$. Amandla aphumelelayo akhawulezisa into u-B kuphela ngamandla okuchukumisa asunduza u-A ku-B, ngoko $F_{AB} = m_B \cdot a = 2\text{ kg} \times 4\text{ m/s}^2 = 8\text{ N}$.
20261124-physics-g11-2.example: Inkqubo epheleleyo (A+B): F = (m<sub>A</sub> + m<sub>B</sub>) a → 20 = (3 + 2) a
20261124-physics-g11-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-physics-g12-1.title: Iziphumo Ze-Photoelectric, Ubume Obubini Bokukhanya, kunye Nehlabathi Elincinci Kakhulu
20261124-physics-g12-1.summary: Phakathi kweziphumo zovavanyo lwe-photoelectric effect luka-Einstein, yeyiphi inyani ekungenakucaciswa ngokwe 'theory yamaza' yokukhanya kwaye icacisiwe ngokugqibeleleyo kuphela yi 'theory ye-quantum yokukhanya (theory yamasuntswana)'?
20261124-physics-g12-1.principle: I-theory yamaza ibikezela ukuba amandla agcinwa ngexesha, kodwa kwi-photoelectric effect i-photon enye kuphela enengqokelela engaphezulu kwengqokelela ebalulekileyo ibethana ngokukhawuleza ne-elektroni kwaye idlulisele amandla, ngoko i-elektroni ikhutshwa ngokukhawuleza ngaphandle kokulibaziseka ngexesha.
20261124-physics-g12-1.example: Ngokwe-theory yamaza, nokukhanya okuthambileyo, ukuba kubengezelwa ixesha elide kwaye amandla agcinwe, kufuneka kukhutshwe, kodwa ngokwenene kukhutshwa ngokukhawuleza.

20261124-physics-g12-2.title: Iziphumo Ze-Photoelectric, Ubume Obubini Bokukhanya, kunye Nehlabathi Elincinci Kakhulu
20261124-physics-g12-2.summary: Isuntswana elinentlawulo elinobunzima m kunye nentlawulo q, elingena ngokuthe nkqo kwimagnethi ephakathi ehambelana B, lenza intshukumo yesetyhula ngesantya v. Yeyiphi ifomula echanekileyo yomgama we-orbit r kunye nexesha T lale ntshukumo yesetyhula yesuntswana?
20261124-physics-g12-2.principle: Ifomula yamandla e-centripetal $\frac{mv^2}{r} = qvB \implies r = \frac{mv}{qB}$. Ixesha $T = \frac{2\pi r}{v} = \frac{2\pi m}{qB}$, kwaye kumangalisa ukuba linexesha le-cyclotron elingaxhomekekanga kumgama we-orbit okanye isantya.
20261124-physics-g12-2.example: Amandla ka-Lorentz asebenza njengamandla e-centripetal kwintshukumo yesetyhula: q v B = m v² / r
20261124-physics-g12-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-physics-g10-2.title: Ukungqubana Nokhuseleko, Ukuphoswa Ngokuthe Tye kunye Nomxhuzulane

20261125-physics-g11-2.title: Imithetho kaNewton Yentshukumo kunye Nobudlelwane Obukhethekileyo

Ukukhawuleza kwazo zombini izinto kunye nobungakanani bamandla asunduza u-A ku-B buyintoni ngokulandelelana?
20261125-physics-g11-2.principle: Ukukhawuleza okupheleleyo ngu-$a = \frac{F}{m_A + m_B} = \frac{20\text{ N}}{5\text{ kg}} = 4\text{ m/s}^2$. Amandla aphumelelayo akhawulezisa into u-B kuphela ngamandla okuchukumisa asunduza u-A ku-B, ngoko $F_{AB} = m_B \cdot a = 2\text{ kg} \times 4\text{ m/s}^2 = 8\text{ N}$.
20261125-physics-g11-2.example: Inkqubo epheleleyo (A+B): F = (m<sub>A</sub> + m<sub>B</sub>) a → 20 = (3 + 2) a

20261125-physics-g12-2.title: Iziphumo Ze-Photoelectric, Ubume Obubini Bokukhanya, kunye Nehlabathi Elincinci Kakhulu
20261125-physics-g12-2.summary: Isuntswana elinentlawulo elinobunzima m kunye nentlawulo q, elingena ngokuthe nkqo kwimagnethi ephakathi ehambelana B, lenza intshukumo yesetyhula ngesantya v. Yeyiphi ifomula echanekileyo yomgama we-orbit r kunye nexesha T lale ntshukumo yesetyhula yesuntswana?

20261119-chemistry-g12-2.title: Isantya sempendulo, umgaqo kaLe Chatelier neseli yekhemikhali
20261119-chemistry-g12-2.summary: Kuvavanyo lwezantya zokuqala lwentsabela 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), xa [O₂] yagcinwa ingatshintshi kwaye [NO] yaphindwa kabini, isantya saba kuphindwa ka-4, kwaye xa [NO] yagcinwa ingatshintshi kwaye [O₂] yaphindwa kabini, isantya saba kuphindwa ka-2. 20261121-chemistry-g01-1.title: Iimpawu ezahlukeneyo zezinto nempahla

20261121-chemistry-g01-1.principle: Into enomila nomsebenzi ibizwa ngokuthi “into”, ize imathiriyeli esisiseko eyenze into ibizwe ngokuthi “impahla”.

20261121-chemistry-g01-2.summary: Umgca werabha okanye ibhaluni, xa utsalwa ngamandla uyatyeleka, kodwa xa ukhululwa ubuyela kumila wawo wokuqala. Yintoni igama lale mpawu yempahla?

20261121-chemistry-g02-1.title: Izinto ezinyibilika emanzini kunye nemixube
20261121-chemistry-g02-1.summary: Xa kongezwa ipuni yeswekile kwi-beaker equlethe amanzi ashushu yaza yashukunyiswa ngomthi wegalasi, yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo?
20261121-chemistry-g02-1.principle: Xa iswekile inyibilika emanzini, iimolekyuli zeswekile zisasazeka ngokulinganayo phakathi kweemolekyuli zamanzi zize zibe ngamanzi eswekile acacileyo angabonwayo.

20261121-chemistry-g02-2.principle: Xa ubushushu bamanzi buphezulu, ukushukuma kobushushu kweemolekyuli zamanzi kuyanda, zize ziqabane namaqhekeza eswekile rhoqo nangamandla, ngoko isantya sokunyibilika siyanda.

20261121-chemistry-g03-1.title: Iimeko ezintathu: isolidi, ulwelo negesi

20261121-chemistry-g03-2.title: Iimeko ezintathu: isolidi, ulwelo negesi
20261121-chemistry-g03-2.summary: Isirinji enye yazaliswa ngamanzi, enye yazaliswa ngomoya, yaza imilomo yazo yavalwa ngomnwe yaza ipisitoni yatyhalwa ngamandla. Yintoni eyenzekayo?
20261121-chemistry-g03-2.principle: Igesi (umoya) inemigama emikhulu kakhulu phakathi kweemolekyuli ngoko ityunyuzeleka lula xa kufakwa uxinzelelo yaye umthamo uyancipha, kodwa ulwelo (amanzi) iimolekyuli zinqumle ngokusondeleyo ngoko azityunyuzeleki ngokukhawuleza.

20261121-chemistry-g04-1.title: Ukuvuka, ukubila, ukuguquka kube lulwelo nokutshintsha komthamo womkhenkce
20261121-chemistry-g04-1.summary: Ikani yesiselo esibandayo esisandula ukukhutshwa kwisikhenkcezisi yabekwa etafileni ixesha elifutshane yaza kwavela amathontsi amanzi emphezulwini wekani. La mathontsi amanzi avela phi?

20261121-chemistry-g04-2.title: Ukuvuka, ukubila, ukuguquka kube lulwelo nokutshintsha komthamo womkhenkce
20261121-chemistry-g04-2.summary: Xa amanzi olwelo ekhenkceza abe ngumkhenkce oyisolidi, yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo yotshintsho lobunzima nomthamo?

20261121-chemistry-g05-1.title: I-solute, i-solvent, isisombululo nokuxinana
20261121-chemistry-g05-1.summary: Iswekile eyi-50 g yafakwa kumanzi a-200 g yaza yanyibilika ngokupheleleyo. Kula manzi eswekile, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ye-“solvent”, “solute” ne-“solution”?
20261121-chemistry-g05-1.principle: Amanzi, impahla enyibilikisayo, “yisolvent”, iswekile enyibilikayo “yisolute”, ize umxube ocacileyo ophuma ekuxutyweni kwazo ngokulinganayo ubizwe ngokuthi “isolution”.

20261121-chemistry-g05-2.title: I-solute, i-solvent, isisombululo nokuxinana

20261121-chemistry-g05-2.principle: Isisombululo esiyinyani (umxube ofanayo) sinamasuntswana esolute asasazeke ngokulinganayo phakathi kweemolekyuli zesolvent, ngoko nokuba sishiywe ixesha elide asityi aze ukuxinana kuyafana kuzo zonke iindawo.
20261121-chemistry-g05-2.example: Isisombululo ngumxube “ofanayo” oxutywe ngokulinganayo kwinqanaba leemolekyuli.

20261121-chemistry-g06-1.title: Ukuba nge-asidi, ukuba nge-alkali nezinto ezintathu zokutsha
20261121-chemistry-g06-1.summary: Xa kwaphoswa izisombululo ezahlukeneyo kwi-indicator yekhaphetshu ebomvu, isisombululo A saguquka sabomvu, ize isisombululo B saguquka sabaluhlaza sidlula sibe luhlaza kwaza kwaba mthubi. Yeyiphi impawu echanekileyo yezi zisombululo zombini?
20261121-chemistry-g06-1.principle: I-indicator yekhaphetshu ebomvu iguquka ibe bomvu kwizisombululo ezine-asidi, ize kwizisombululo ze-alkali iguquke ibe luhlaza, luhlaza okotyheli, okanye mthubi.
20261121-chemistry-g06-1.example: Ijusi yekhaphetshu ebomvu, i-indicator yendalo, iqulethe umbala we-anthocyanin.

20261121-chemistry-g06-2.title: Ukuba nge-asidi, ukuba nge-alkali nezinto ezintathu zokutsha
20261121-chemistry-g06-2.summary: Xa kwatshiswa i-asidi ye-hydrochloric ehlanjululweyo okanye iviniga kumaqokobhe amaqanda okanye iqhekeza lemabhile (equlethe i-calcium carbonate), kwavela iibhabhulu ezininzi. Yintoni utshintsho olwenzekayo xa le gesi iqokelelwa idluliswe kumanzi ekalika?
20261121-chemistry-g06-2.principle: Xa i-calcium carbonate ($\text{CaCO}_3$) isabela nge-asidi, kuvela igesi yekhabhon diokside ($\text{CO}_2$), ize ikhabhon diokside isabele namanzi ekalika ($\text{Ca(OH)}_2$) yenze ukuphuphuma kwe-calcium carbonate emhlophe nokwenza amanzi aluphuke.
20261121-chemistry-g06-2.example: Xa i-carbonate ne-asidi zisabela, kuvelisa igesi yekhabhon diokside (CO₂).

20261121-chemistry-g07-1.title: Umthetho kaBoyle, umthetho kaCharles notshintsho lweemeko
20261121-chemistry-g07-1.summary: Yintoni isizathu esiphambili “soxinzelelo lwegesi” esivakala emgangathweni wesikhongozeli esivaliweyo esiqulethe igesi?
20261121-chemistry-g07-1.principle: Uxinzelelo lwegesi luvela emandleni kwiyunithi yendawo awenziwa ngamasuntswana egesi aqhaqhazela ngokungaphezi nangokungalungelelananga eludongeni lwangaphakathi lwesikhongozeli.

20261121-chemistry-g07-2.title: Umthetho kaBoyle, umthetho kaCharles notshintsho lweemeko
20261121-chemistry-g07-2.summary: Kubushushu obungatshintshiyo, uxinzelelo lwegesi enomthamo we-60 mL kwi-1 atm lwenyuswa lwaya ku-3 atm. Ngokomthetho kaBoyle, umthamo wale gesi ungakanani?
20261121-chemistry-g07-2.principle: Ngokomthetho kaBoyle, xa ubushushu bungatshintshanga, $P_1 V_1 = P_2 V_2$ iyasebenza. $1\text{ atm} \times 60\text{ mL} = 3\text{ atm} \times V_2 \implies V_2 = 20\text{ mL}$.

20261121-chemistry-g08-1.title: Izinto, ii-athomu, ii-ion nempendulo yokwenza i-precipitate
20261121-chemistry-g08-1.summary: Yintoni isizathu esiphambili sokuba i-athomu eyakhiwe ngenyukliyasi ne-electrons ibe nesimo sokungathathi cala ngokombane?
20261121-chemistry-g08-1.principle: I-athomu ayithathi cala ngokombane kuba intlawulo epheleleyo (+) yee-protons zenyukliyasi esembindini nentlawulo epheleleyo (-) yee-electrons ezijikeleza ngeorbits zilingana ngokupheleleyo ngobukhulu.

20261121-chemistry-g08-2.title: Izinto, ii-athomu, ii-ion nempendulo yokwenza i-precipitate
20261121-chemistry-g08-2.summary: Yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo ngokwakhiwa kwee-“ion”, apho i-athomu engathathi cala ilahlekelwa okanye ifumana ii-electrons yaze ibe nentlawulo?
20261121-chemistry-g08-2.principle: I-athomu ilahlekelwa ii-electrons zeqokobhe elingaphandle ibe yi-cation (ubukhulu izinyithi), okanye ifumane ii-electrons yenze i-anion eyanelisayo umgaqo we-octet (ubukhulu ii-athomu ezingezizo izinyithi).

20261121-chemistry-g09-1.title: Ukulondolozwa kobunzima, umlinganiselo ongatshintshiyo, i-exothermic ne-endothermic
20261121-chemistry-g09-1.summary: Yintoni isizathu esisisiseko sokuba 'umthetho wokugcinwa kobunzima' ube yinyani xa kwenzeka utshintsho lwekhemikhali?
20261121-chemistry-g09-1.principle: Kwintsabela yekhemikhali, indlela iiathom ezidityaniswa ngayo iyatshintsha kwaye kwenziwa izinto ezintsha, kodwa iintlobo kunye nenani leeathom azenziwa okanye zitshatyalaliswe kwaye zigcinwa njengoko zazinjalo, ngoko ubunzima bonke abutshintshi.

20261121-chemistry-g10-1.principle: I-sodium chloride, into edityaniswe nge-ionic bond, inyibilika emanzini kwaye ihlukane ibe ngama-cation nama-anion, ngoko isisombululo sayo samanzi siqhuba umbane. Iswekile, into edityaniswe nge-covalent bond, inyibilika njengeemolekyuli kwaye ayinazo izithwali zentlawulo, ngoko ayiqhubi umbane.

20261121-chemistry-g10-2.title: Ibhondi ye-ion, ibhondi ye-covalent kunye ne-oxidation-reduction
20261121-chemistry-g10-2.summary: Xa isisombululo se-sodium hydroxide (NaOH) songezwa kancinci kancinci kwisixa esiqingqiweyo se-hydrochloric acid (HCl) elahlekayo, sesiphi isiphumo esichanekileyo sokulinganisa utshintsho kwinani lama-ion kunye nobushushu kwisisombululo?
20261121-chemistry-g10-2.principle: Kuba ubushushu bokungathathi cala buyakhutshwa ngexesha lentsabela yokungathathi cala, ubushushu besisombululo bufikelela kwelona nqanaba liphezulu xa kufikelelwa kwindawo yokungathathi cala, apho intsabela iphelele. Ama-ion e-chloride ($\text{Cl}^-$) ngama-spectator ion angasabeliyo, ngoko inani lawo lihlala lingatshintshi.
20261121-chemistry-g10-2.example: Xa kwenzeka intsabela yokungathathi cala (H⁺ + OH⁻ → H₂O), ubushushu bokungathathi cala buyakhutshwa.

20261121-chemistry-g11-1.title: I-mole
20261121-chemistry-g11-1.summary: Kwi-0℃ nge-1 atm, zingaphi iimoli zeemolekyuli ze-methane, nezingaphi iimoli zizonke zeeathom ze-hydrogen (H), kwi-11.2 L yegesi ye-methane (CH₄, ubunzima beemolekyuli 16)?
20261121-chemistry-g11-1.principle: Inani leemoli ze-methane li-$n = \frac{11.2\text{ L}}{22.4\text{ L/mol}} = 0.5\text{ mol}$. Imolekyuli nganye ye-$1$ ye-methane iqulethe iiathom ze-hydrogen ezi-$4$, ngoko iimoli zizonke zeeathom ze-hydrogen zi-$0.5 \times 4 = 2.0\text{ mol}$.
20261121-chemistry-g11-1.example: Kwi-0℃ nge-1 atm, i-1 mol yegesi = 22.4 L.
20261121-chemistry-g11-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261121-chemistry-g11-2.title: I-mole
20261121-chemistry-g11-2.summary: Bungakanani ubunzima be-NaOH eqinileyo ecocekileyo obufunekayo ukwenza i-500 mL yesisombululo esiqhelekileyo se-0.1 M se-sodium hydroxide (NaOH, ubunzima beefomula 40)?
20261121-chemistry-g11-2.principle: Iimoli ze-$\text{NaOH}$ ezifunekayo zi-$n = M \times V = 0.1\text{ mol/L} \times 0.5\text{ L} = 0.05\text{ mol}$. Ubunzima obufunekayo bu-$w = n \times M_w = 0.05\text{ mol} \times 40\text{ g/mol} = 2.0\text{ g}$.
20261121-chemistry-g11-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261121-chemistry-g12-1.title: Isantya sempendulo, umgaqo kaLe Chatelier neseli yekhemikhali
20261121-chemistry-g12-1.summary: Sesiphi isitatimenti esichanekileyo malunga notshintsho olwenzekayo xa 'i-positive catalyst' yongezwa kwintsabela yekhemikhali?
20261121-chemistry-g12-1.principle: I-positive catalyst inika indlela entsha yokusabela enamandla okwenza asezantsi kwaye ikhulisa ii-rate constants zeentsabela ezibheke phambili neziyivayo ngomlinganiselo ofanayo. Ayitshintshi ngaphandle kwe-reaction enthalpy ($\Delta H$) okanye i-equilibrium constant ($K$).
20261121-chemistry-g12-1.example: I-catalyst ayinako ukutshintsha umahluko wamandla (ΔH) phakathi kwezinto zokuqala nemveliso yokugqibela.
20261121-chemistry-g12-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261121-chemistry-g12-2.title: Isantya sempendulo, umgaqo kaLe Chatelier neseli yekhemikhali
20261121-chemistry-g12-2.summary: Kuvavanyo lwezantya zokuqala lwentsabela 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), xa [O₂] yagcinwa ingatshintshi kwaye [NO] yaphindwa kabini, isantya saba kuphindwa ka-4, kwaye xa [NO] yagcinwa ingatshintshi kwaye [O₂] yaphindwa kabini, isantya saba kuphindwa ka-2. Yintoni umthetho wesantya kunye ne-overall reaction order yale ntsabela?
20261121-chemistry-g12-2.principle: Xa $[\text{NO}]$ iphindwa ka-$2$ isantya siba kuphindwa ka-$4$, ngoko $m=2$, kwaye xa $[\text{O}_2]$ iphindwa ka-$2$ isantya siba kuphindwa ka-$2$, ngoko $n=1$. Umthetho wesantya yi-$v = k[\text{NO}]^2[\text{O}_2]$, kwaye i-overall reaction order yi-$2 + 1 = 3$.
20261121-chemistry-g12-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-chemistry-g01-1.title: Iimpawu ezahlukeneyo zezinto nempahla
20261122-chemistry-g01-1.summary: Yeyiphi kwezi ndlela zilandelayo edibanisa ngokuchanekileyo “into” enomila othile nomsebenzi othile ne-“ntsebenzo” eyenziwe ngayo?
20261122-chemistry-g01-1.principle: Into enomila nomsebenzi ibizwa ngokuthi “into”, ize imathiriyeli esisiseko eyenze into ibizwe ngokuthi “impahla”.
20261122-chemistry-g01-1.example: “Into” ligama lento egqityiweyo esiyisebenzisayo, ize “impahla” libe ligama lezinto ezakha into.
20261122-chemistry-g01-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-chemistry-g01-2.title: Iimpawu ezahlukeneyo zezinto nempahla
20261122-chemistry-g01-2.summary: Umgca werabha okanye ibhaluni, xa utsalwa ngamandla uyatyeleka, kodwa xa ukhululwa ubuyela kumila wawo wokuqala. Yintoni igama lale mpawu yempahla?
20261122-chemistry-g01-2.principle: Impawu apho into eguqulwe ngamandla angaphandle ibuyela kumila wayo wokuqala xa amandla elahlekile ibizwa ngokuba “kukuguquguquka”.
20261122-chemistry-g01-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-chemistry-g02-1.title: Izinto ezinyibilika emanzini kunye nemixube
20261122-chemistry-g02-1.summary: Xa kongezwa ipuni yeswekile kwi-beaker equlethe amanzi ashushu yaza yashukunyiswa ngomthi wegalasi, yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo?
20261122-chemistry-g02-1.principle: Xa iswekile inyibilika emanzini, iimolekyuli zeswekile zisasazeka ngokulinganayo phakathi kweemolekyuli zamanzi zize zibe ngamanzi eswekile acacileyo angabonwayo.
20261122-chemistry-g02-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-chemistry-g02-2.title: Izinto ezinyibilika emanzini kunye nemixube
20261122-chemistry-g02-2.summary: Kutheni iswekile inyibilika ngokukhawuleza kakhulu endebeni equlethe amanzi ashushu kuneyo equlethe amanzi abandayo?
20261122-chemistry-g02-2.principle: Xa ubushushu bamanzi buphezulu, ukushukuma kobushushu kweemolekyuli zamanzi kuyanda, zize ziqabane namaqhekeza eswekile rhoqo nangamandla, ngoko isantya sokunyibilika siyanda.
20261122-chemistry-g02-2.example: Xa ubushushu buphezulu, ukushukuma kweemolekyuli kuyakhawuleza.
20261122-chemistry-g02-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-chemistry-g03-1.title: Iimeko ezintathu: isolidi, ulwelo negesi
20261122-chemistry-g03-1.summary: Yeyiphi imeko yempahla apho imo itshintsha ngokukhululekileyo ngokwesikhongozeli, kodwa umthamo awutshintshi uhlala unjalo?
20261122-chemistry-g03-1.principle: Ulwelo lunamabophelelo phakathi kweemolekyuli athambileyo kuneesolidi ngoko imo itshintsha lula ngokwesikhongozeli, kodwa umthamo uhlala uqhelekile kuba ukutsalwa phakathi kweemolekyuli kuyagcinwa.
20261122-chemistry-g03-1.example: Cinga xa kugalelwa amanzi okanye ubisi kwenye indebe.
20261122-chemistry-g03-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-chemistry-g03-2.title: Iimeko ezintathu: isolidi, ulwelo negesi
20261122-chemistry-g03-2.summary: Isirinji enye yazaliswa ngamanzi, enye yazaliswa ngomoya, yaza imilomo yazo yavalwa ngomnwe yaza ipisitoni yatyhalwa ngamandla. Yintoni eyenzekayo?
20261122-chemistry-g03-2.principle: Igesi (umoya) inemigama emikhulu kakhulu phakathi kweemolekyuli ngoko ityunyuzeleka lula xa kufakwa uxinzelelo yaye umthamo uyancipha, kodwa ulwelo (amanzi) iimolekyuli zinqumle ngokusondeleyo ngoko azityunyuzeleki ngokukhawuleza.
20261122-chemistry-g03-2.example: Iimolekyuli zegesi zikude kakhulu omnye komnye ngoko kukho indawo engenanto eninzi.
20261122-chemistry-g03-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-chemistry-g04-1.title: Ukuvuka, ukubila, ukuguquka kube lulwelo nokutshintsha komthamo womkhenkce
20261122-chemistry-g04-1.summary: Ikani yesiselo esibandayo esisandula ukukhutshwa kwisikhenkcezisi yabekwa etafileni ixesha elifutshane yaza kwavela amathontsi amanzi emphezulwini wekani. La mathontsi amanzi avela phi?
20261122-chemistry-g04-1.principle: Umphunga wamanzi wegesi owawusemoyeni udibana nomphezulu obandayo wekani uphulukane nobushushu uguquke ube ngamathontsi amanzi olwelo, nto ebizwa ngokuba “yi-condensation (ukuguquka kube lulwelo)”.
20261122-chemistry-g04-1.example: Emoyeni kusoloko kukho umphunga wamanzi ongabonwayo.
20261122-chemistry-g04-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-chemistry-g04-2.title: Ukuvuka, ukubila, ukuguquka kube lulwelo nokutshintsha komthamo womkhenkce
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.summary: Xa amanzi olwelo ekhenkceza abe ngumkhenkce oyisolidi, yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo yotshintsho lobunzima nomthamo?
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.principle: Xa amanzi ekhenkceza abe ngumkhenkce, ubunzima buyagcinwa, kodwa kuba iimolekyuli zamanzi zenza iikristali zeheksagoni ezinendawo engenanto ngobunye be-hydrogen, umthamo unyuka malunga ne-10%.
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.example: Nokuba amanzi akhenkceza, inani lilonke leemolekyuli ezenza impahla alitshintshi.
20261122-chemistry-g04-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-chemistry-g05-1.title: I-solute, i-solvent, isisombululo nokuxinana
20261122-chemistry-g05-1.summary: Iswekile eyi-50 g yafakwa kumanzi a-200 g yaza yanyibilika ngokupheleleyo. Kula manzi eswekile, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ye-“solvent”, “solute” ne-“solution”?
20261122-chemistry-g05-1.principle: Amanzi, impahla enyibilikisayo, “yisolvent”, iswekile enyibilikayo “yisolute”, ize umxube ocacileyo ophuma ekuxutyweni kwazo ngokulinganayo ubizwe ngokuthi “isolution”.
20261122-chemistry-g05-1.example: Ulwelo olunyibilikisayo = solvent, into enyibilikayo = solute, umxube ogqityiweyo = solution.
20261122-chemistry-g05-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-chemistry-g05-2.title: I-solute, i-solvent, isisombululo nokuxinana
20261122-chemistry-g05-2.summary: Sifuna ukuphanda iimpawu zesisombululo setyuwa esikwi-beaker. Yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo yempawu yesisombululo, umxube ofanayo?
20261122-chemistry-g05-2.principle: Isisombululo esiyinyani (umxube ofanayo) sinamasuntswana esolute asasazeke ngokulinganayo phakathi kweemolekyuli zesolvent, ngoko nokuba sishiywe ixesha elide asityi aze ukuxinana kuyafana kuzo zonke iindawo.
20261122-chemistry-g05-2.example: Isisombululo ngumxube “ofanayo” oxutywe ngokulinganayo kwinqanaba leemolekyuli.
20261122-chemistry-g05-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-chemistry-g06-1.title: Ukuba nge-asidi, ukuba nge-alkali nezinto ezintathu zokutsha
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.summary: Xa kwaphoswa izisombululo ezahlukeneyo kwi-indicator yekhaphetshu ebomvu, isisombululo A saguquka sabomvu, ize isisombululo B saguquka sabaluhlaza sidlula sibe luhlaza kwaza kwaba mthubi. Yeyiphi impawu echanekileyo yezi zisombululo zombini?
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.principle: I-indicator yekhaphetshu ebomvu iguquka ibe bomvu kwizisombululo ezine-asidi, ize kwizisombululo ze-alkali iguquke ibe luhlaza, luhlaza okotyheli, okanye mthubi.
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.example: Ijusi yekhaphetshu ebomvu, i-indicator yendalo, iqulethe umbala we-anthocyanin.
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-chemistry-g06-2.title: Ukuba nge-asidi, ukuba nge-alkali nezinto ezintathu zokutsha
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.summary: Xa kwatshiswa i-asidi ye-hydrochloric ehlanjululweyo okanye iviniga kumaqokobhe amaqanda okanye iqhekeza lemabhile (equlethe i-calcium carbonate), kwavela iibhabhulu ezininzi. Yintoni utshintsho olwenzekayo xa le gesi iqokelelwa idluliswe kumanzi ekalika?
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.principle: Xa i-calcium carbonate ($\text{CaCO}_3$) isabela nge-asidi, kuvela igesi yekhabhon diokside ($\text{CO}_2$), ize ikhabhon diokside isabele namanzi ekalika ($\text{Ca(OH)}_2$) yenze ukuphuphuma kwe-calcium carbonate emhlophe nokwenza amanzi aluphuke.
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.example: Xa i-carbonate ne-asidi zisabela, kuvelisa igesi yekhabhon diokside (CO₂).
20261122-chemistry-g06-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-chemistry-g07-1.title: Umthetho kaBoyle, umthetho kaCharles notshintsho lweemeko
20261122-chemistry-g07-1.summary: Yintoni isizathu esiphambili “soxinzelelo lwegesi” esivakala emgangathweni wesikhongozeli esivaliweyo esiqulethe igesi?
20261122-chemistry-g07-1.principle: Uxinzelelo lwegesi luvela emandleni kwiyunithi yendawo awenziwa ngamasuntswana egesi aqhaqhazela ngokungaphezi nangokungalungelelananga eludongeni lwangaphakathi lwesikhongozeli.
20261122-chemistry-g07-1.example: Iimolekyuli zegesi ziqhuba ngesantya esikhulu kakhulu.
20261122-chemistry-g07-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-chemistry-g07-2.title: Umthetho kaBoyle, umthetho kaCharles notshintsho lweemeko
20261122-chemistry-g07-2.summary: Kubushushu obungatshintshiyo, uxinzelelo lwegesi enomthamo we-60 mL kwi-1 atm lwenyuswa lwaya ku-3 atm. Ngokomthetho kaBoyle, umthamo wale gesi ungakanani?
20261122-chemistry-g07-2.principle: Ngokomthetho kaBoyle, xa ubushushu bungatshintshanga, $P_1 V_1 = P_2 V_2$ iyasebenza. $1\text{ atm} \times 60\text{ mL} = 3\text{ atm} \times V_2 \implies V_2 = 20\text{ mL}$.
20261122-chemistry-g07-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-chemistry-g08-1.title: Izinto, ii-athomu, ii-ion nempendulo yokwenza i-precipitate
20261122-chemistry-g08-1.summary: Yintoni isizathu esiphambili sokuba i-athomu eyakhiwe ngenyukliyasi ne-electrons ibe nesimo sokungathathi cala ngokombane?
20261122-chemistry-g08-1.principle: I-athomu ayithathi cala ngokombane kuba intlawulo epheleleyo (+) yee-protons zenyukliyasi esembindini nentlawulo epheleleyo (-) yee-electrons ezijikeleza ngeorbits zilingana ngokupheleleyo ngobukhulu.
20261122-chemistry-g08-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261122-chemistry-g08-2.title: Izinto, ii-athomu, ii-ion nempendulo yokwenza i-precipitate
20261122-chemistry-g08-2.summary: Yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo ngokwakhiwa kwee-“ion”, apho i-athomu engathathi cala ilahlekelwa okanye ifumana ii-electrons yaze ibe nentlawulo?
20261122-chemistry-g08-2.principle: I-athomu ilahlekelwa ii-electrons zeqokobhe elingaphandle ibe yi-cation (ubukhulu izinyithi), okanye ifumane ii-electrons yenze i-anion eyanelisayo umgaqo we-octet (ubukhulu ii-athomu ezingezizo izinyithi).
20261122-chemistry-g08-2.example: I-sodium (Na) ilahlekelwa yi-electron enye ibe yi-Na⁺.
