20261122-chemistry-g09-1.title: Ukulondolozwa kobunzima, umlinganiselo ongatshintshiyo, i-exothermic ne-endothermic
20261122-chemistry-g09-1.summary: Yintoni isizathu esisisiseko sokuba 'umthetho wokugcinwa kobunzima' ube yinyani xa kwenzeka utshintsho lwekhemikhali?
20261122-chemistry-g09-1.principle: Kwintsabela yekhemikhali, indlela iiathom ezidityaniswa ngayo iyatshintsha kwaye kwenziwa izinto ezintsha, kodwa iintlobo kunye nenani leeathom azenziwa okanye zitshatyalaliswe kwaye zigcinwa njengoko zazinjalo, ngoko ubunzima bonke abutshintshi.

20261122-chemistry-g09-2.title: Ukulondolozwa kobunzima, umlinganiselo ongatshintshiyo, i-exothermic ne-endothermic
20261122-chemistry-g09-2.summary: Kwenziwa uvavanyo apho kwatshiswa ipowuda yekopolo emoyeni kwi-crucible ukwenza i-copper(II) oxide. Xa i-4 g yekopolo yasabela ngokupheleleyo, kwenziwa i-5 g ye-copper(II) oxide. Bungakanani ubunzima be-oxygen edibeneyo, kwaye ngumlinganiselo wobunzima bekopolo ukuya kwi-oxygen?
20261122-chemistry-g09-2.principle: Ubunzima be-oxygen esabeleyo bu-$5\text{ g} - 4\text{ g} = 1\text{ g}$. Ngokomthetho wemilinganiselo echanekileyo, umlinganiselo wobunzima bekopolo ukuya kwi-oxygen kwi-copper(II) oxide ihlala ingu-$4 : 1$.
20261122-chemistry-g09-2.example: Umthetho wokugcinwa kobunzima: (ikopolo 4 g) + (i-oxygen ? g) = copper(II) oxide 5 g

20261122-chemistry-g10-1.title: Ibhondi ye-ion, ibhondi ye-covalent kunye ne-oxidation-reduction
20261122-chemistry-g10-1.summary: Sesiphi isiphumo esichane kakhulu sovavanyo oluthelekisa ukuqhuba umbane kwenqaku A (sodium chloride) kunye nenqaku B (iswekile)?
20261122-chemistry-g10-1.principle: I-sodium chloride, into edityaniswe nge-ionic bond, inyibilika emanzini kwaye ihlukane ibe ngama-cation nama-anion, ngoko isisombululo sayo samanzi siqhuba umbane. Iswekile, into edityaniswe nge-covalent bond, inyibilika njengeemolekyuli kwaye ayinazo izithwali zentlawulo, ngoko ayiqhubi umbane.

20261122-chemistry-g10-2.title: Ibhondi ye-ion, ibhondi ye-covalent kunye ne-oxidation-reduction
20261122-chemistry-g10-2.summary: Xa isisombululo se-sodium hydroxide (NaOH) songezwa kancinci kancinci kwisixa esiqingqiweyo se-hydrochloric acid (HCl) elahlekayo, sesiphi isiphumo esichanekileyo sokulinganisa utshintsho kwinani lama-ion kunye nobushushu kwisisombululo?

Ama-ion e-chloride ($\text{Cl}^-$) ngama-spectator ion angasabeliyo, ngoko inani lawo lihlala lingatshintshi.

20261122-chemistry-g11-1.example: Kwi-0℃ nge-1 atm, i-1 mol yegesi = 22.4 L.

20261122-chemistry-g12-1.principle: I-positive catalyst inika indlela entsha yokusabela enamandla okwenza asezantsi kwaye ikhulisa ii-rate constants zeentsabela ezibheke phambili neziyivayo ngomlinganiselo ofanayo. Ayitshintshi ngaphandle kwe-reaction enthalpy ($\Delta H$) okanye i-equilibrium constant ($K$).

20261122-chemistry-g12-2.title: Isantya sempendulo, umgaqo kaLe Chatelier neseli yekhemikhali
20261122-chemistry-g12-2.summary: Kuvavanyo lwezantya zokuqala lwentsabela 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), xa [O₂] yagcinwa ingatshintshi kwaye [NO] yaphindwa kabini, isantya saba kuphindwa ka-4, kwaye xa [NO] yagcinwa ingatshintshi kwaye [O₂] yaphindwa kabini, isantya saba kuphindwa ka-2. Yintoni umthetho wesantya kunye ne-overall reaction order yale ntsabela?
20261122-chemistry-g12-2.principle: Xa $[\text{NO}]$ iphindwa ka-$2$ isantya siba kuphindwa ka-$4$, ngoko $m=2$, kwaye xa $[\text{O}_2]$ iphindwa ka-$2$ isantya siba kuphindwa ka-$2$, ngoko $n=1$. Umthetho wesantya yi-$v = k[\text{NO}]^2[\text{O}_2]$, kwaye i-overall reaction order yi-$2 + 1 = 3$.

20261123-chemistry-g01-1.title: Iimpawu ezahlukeneyo zezinto nempahla
20261123-chemistry-g01-1.summary: Yeyiphi kwezi ndlela zilandelayo edibanisa ngokuchanekileyo “into” enomila othile nomsebenzi othile ne-“ntsebenzo” eyenziwe ngayo?
20261123-chemistry-g01-1.principle: Into enomila nomsebenzi ibizwa ngokuthi “into”, ize imathiriyeli esisiseko eyenze into ibizwe ngokuthi “impahla”.
20261123-chemistry-g01-1.example: “Into” ligama lento egqityiweyo esiyisebenzisayo, ize “impahla” libe ligama lezinto ezakha into.

20261123-chemistry-g01-2.title: Iimpawu ezahlukeneyo zezinto nempahla
20261123-chemistry-g01-2.summary: Umgca werabha okanye ibhaluni, xa utsalwa ngamandla uyatyeleka, kodwa xa ukhululwa ubuyela kumila wawo wokuqala. Yintoni igama lale mpawu yempahla?
20261123-chemistry-g01-2.principle: Impawu apho into eguqulwe ngamandla angaphandle ibuyela kumila wayo wokuqala xa amandla elahlekile ibizwa ngokuba “kukuguquguquka”.

20261123-chemistry-g02-1.title: Izinto ezinyibilika emanzini kunye nemixube
20261123-chemistry-g02-1.summary: Xa kongezwa ipuni yeswekile kwi-beaker equlethe amanzi ashushu yaza yashukunyiswa ngomthi wegalasi, yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo?
20261123-chemistry-g02-1.principle: Xa iswekile inyibilika emanzini, iimolekyuli zeswekile zisasazeka ngokulinganayo phakathi kweemolekyuli zamanzi zize zibe ngamanzi eswekile acacileyo angabonwayo.

20261123-chemistry-g02-2.title: Izinto ezinyibilika emanzini kunye nemixube
20261123-chemistry-g02-2.summary: Kutheni iswekile inyibilika ngokukhawuleza kakhulu endebeni equlethe amanzi ashushu kuneyo equlethe amanzi abandayo?
20261123-chemistry-g02-2.principle: Xa ubushushu bamanzi buphezulu, ukushukuma kobushushu kweemolekyuli zamanzi kuyanda, zize ziqabane namaqhekeza eswekile rhoqo nangamandla, ngoko isantya sokunyibilika siyanda.

20261123-chemistry-g03-1.title: Iimeko ezintathu: isolidi, ulwelo negesi
20261123-chemistry-g03-1.summary: Yeyiphi imeko yempahla apho imo itshintsha ngokukhululekileyo ngokwesikhongozeli, kodwa umthamo awutshintshi uhlala unjalo?
20261123-chemistry-g03-1.principle: Ulwelo lunamabophelelo phakathi kweemolekyuli athambileyo kuneesolidi ngoko imo itshintsha lula ngokwesikhongozeli, kodwa umthamo uhlala uqhelekile kuba ukutsalwa phakathi kweemolekyuli kuyagcinwa.

20261123-chemistry-g03-2.title: Iimeko ezintathu: isolidi, ulwelo negesi
20261123-chemistry-g03-2.summary: Isirinji enye yazaliswa ngamanzi, enye yazaliswa ngomoya, yaza imilomo yazo yavalwa ngomnwe yaza ipisitoni yatyhalwa ngamandla. Yintoni eyenzekayo?
20261123-chemistry-g03-2.principle: Igesi (umoya) inemigama emikhulu kakhulu phakathi kweemolekyuli ngoko ityunyuzeleka lula xa kufakwa uxinzelelo yaye umthamo uyancipha, kodwa ulwelo (amanzi) iimolekyuli zinqumle ngokusondeleyo ngoko azityunyuzeleki ngokukhawuleza.

20261123-chemistry-g04-1.title: Ukuvuka, ukubila, ukuguquka kube lulwelo nokutshintsha komthamo womkhenkce
20261123-chemistry-g04-1.summary: Ikani yesiselo esibandayo esisandula ukukhutshwa kwisikhenkcezisi yabekwa etafileni ixesha elifutshane yaza kwavela amathontsi amanzi emphezulwini wekani. La mathontsi amanzi avela phi?
20261123-chemistry-g04-1.principle: Umphunga wamanzi wegesi owawusemoyeni udibana nomphezulu obandayo wekani uphulukane nobushushu uguquke ube ngamathontsi amanzi olwelo, nto ebizwa ngokuba “yi-condensation (ukuguquka kube lulwelo)”.
20261123-chemistry-g04-1.example: Emoyeni kusoloko kukho umphunga wamanzi ongabonwayo.

20261123-chemistry-g04-2.title: Ukuvuka, ukubila, ukuguquka kube lulwelo nokutshintsha komthamo womkhenkce
20261123-chemistry-g04-2.summary: Xa amanzi olwelo ekhenkceza abe ngumkhenkce oyisolidi, yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo yotshintsho lobunzima nomthamo?
20261123-chemistry-g04-2.principle: Xa amanzi ekhenkceza abe ngumkhenkce, ubunzima buyagcinwa, kodwa kuba iimolekyuli zamanzi zenza iikristali zeheksagoni ezinendawo engenanto ngobunye be-hydrogen, umthamo unyuka malunga ne-10%.

20261123-chemistry-g05-1.title: I-solute, i-solvent, isisombululo nokuxinana
20261123-chemistry-g05-1.summary: Iswekile eyi-50 g yafakwa kumanzi a-200 g yaza yanyibilika ngokupheleleyo. Kula manzi eswekile, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ye-“solvent”, “solute” ne-“solution”?
20261123-chemistry-g05-1.principle: Amanzi, impahla enyibilikisayo, “yisolvent”, iswekile enyibilikayo “yisolute”, ize umxube ocacileyo ophuma ekuxutyweni kwazo ngokulinganayo ubizwe ngokuthi “isolution”.

20261123-chemistry-g05-2.title: I-solute, i-solvent, isisombululo nokuxinana
20261123-chemistry-g05-2.summary: Sifuna ukuphanda iimpawu zesisombululo setyuwa esikwi-beaker. Yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo yempawu yesisombululo, umxube ofanayo?
20261123-chemistry-g05-2.principle: Isisombululo esiyinyani (umxube ofanayo) sinamasuntswana esolute asasazeke ngokulinganayo phakathi kweemolekyuli zesolvent, ngoko nokuba sishiywe ixesha elide asityi aze ukuxinana kuyafana kuzo zonke iindawo.
20261123-chemistry-g05-2.example: Isisombululo ngumxube “ofanayo” oxutywe ngokulinganayo kwinqanaba leemolekyuli.
20261123-chemistry-g05-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261123-chemistry-g06-1.title: Ukuba nge-asidi, ukuba nge-alkali nezinto ezintathu zokutsha
20261123-chemistry-g06-1.summary: Xa kwaphoswa izisombululo ezahlukeneyo kwi-indicator yekhaphetshu ebomvu, isisombululo A saguquka sabomvu, ize isisombululo B saguquka sabaluhlaza sidlula sibe luhlaza kwaza kwaba mthubi. Yeyiphi impawu echanekileyo yezi zisombululo zombini?
20261123-chemistry-g06-1.principle: I-indicator yekhaphetshu ebomvu iguquka ibe bomvu kwizisombululo ezine-asidi, ize kwizisombululo ze-alkali iguquke ibe luhlaza, luhlaza okotyheli, okanye mthubi.
20261123-chemistry-g06-1.example: Ijusi yekhaphetshu ebomvu, i-indicator yendalo, iqulethe umbala we-anthocyanin.

20261123-chemistry-g06-2.title: Ukuba nge-asidi, ukuba nge-alkali nezinto ezintathu zokutsha
20261123-chemistry-g06-2.summary: Xa kwatshiswa i-asidi ye-hydrochloric ehlanjululweyo okanye iviniga kumaqokobhe amaqanda okanye iqhekeza lemabhile (equlethe i-calcium carbonate), kwavela iibhabhulu ezininzi. Yintoni utshintsho olwenzekayo xa le gesi iqokelelwa idluliswe kumanzi ekalika?
20261123-chemistry-g06-2.principle: Xa i-calcium carbonate ($\text{CaCO}_3$) isabela nge-asidi, kuvela igesi yekhabhon diokside ($\text{CO}_2$), ize ikhabhon diokside isabele namanzi ekalika ($\text{Ca(OH)}_2$) yenze ukuphuphuma kwe-calcium carbonate emhlophe nokwenza amanzi aluphuke.

20261123-chemistry-g07-1.title: Umthetho kaBoyle, umthetho kaCharles notshintsho lweemeko
20261123-chemistry-g07-1.summary: Yintoni isizathu esiphambili “soxinzelelo lwegesi” esivakala emgangathweni wesikhongozeli esivaliweyo esiqulethe igesi?
20261123-chemistry-g07-1.principle: Uxinzelelo lwegesi luvela emandleni kwiyunithi yendawo awenziwa ngamasuntswana egesi aqhaqhazela ngokungaphezi nangokungalungelelananga eludongeni lwangaphakathi lwesikhongozeli.

20261123-chemistry-g07-2.summary: Kubushushu obungatshintshiyo, uxinzelelo lwegesi enomthamo we-60 mL kwi-1 atm lwenyuswa lwaya ku-3 atm. Ngokomthetho kaBoyle, umthamo wale gesi ungakanani?
20261123-chemistry-g07-2.principle: Ngokomthetho kaBoyle, xa ubushushu bungatshintshanga, $P_1 V_1 = P_2 V_2$ iyasebenza. $1\text{ atm} \times 60\text{ mL} = 3\text{ atm} \times V_2 \implies V_2 = 20\text{ mL}$.

20261123-chemistry-g08-1.title: Izinto, ii-athomu, ii-ion nempendulo yokwenza i-precipitate
20261123-chemistry-g08-1.summary: Yintoni isizathu esiphambili sokuba i-athomu eyakhiwe ngenyukliyasi ne-electrons ibe nesimo sokungathathi cala ngokombane?

20261123-chemistry-g08-2.summary: Yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo ngokwakhiwa kwee-“ion”, apho i-athomu engathathi cala ilahlekelwa okanye ifumana ii-electrons yaze ibe nentlawulo?
20261123-chemistry-g08-2.principle: I-athomu ilahlekelwa ii-electrons zeqokobhe elingaphandle ibe yi-cation (ubukhulu izinyithi), okanye ifumane ii-electrons yenze i-anion eyanelisayo umgaqo we-octet (ubukhulu ii-athomu ezingezizo izinyithi).

20261124-chemistry-g01-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g01-2.title: Iimpawu ezahlukeneyo zezinto nempahla
20261124-chemistry-g01-2.summary: Umgca werabha okanye ibhaluni, xa utsalwa ngamandla uyatyeleka, kodwa xa ukhululwa ubuyela kumila wawo wokuqala. Yintoni igama lale mpawu yempahla?
20261124-chemistry-g01-2.principle: Impawu apho into eguqulwe ngamandla angaphandle ibuyela kumila wayo wokuqala xa amandla elahlekile ibizwa ngokuba “kukuguquguquka”.
20261124-chemistry-g01-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g02-1.title: Izinto ezinyibilika emanzini kunye nemixube
20261124-chemistry-g02-1.summary: Xa kongezwa ipuni yeswekile kwi-beaker equlethe amanzi ashushu yaza yashukunyiswa ngomthi wegalasi, yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo?
20261124-chemistry-g02-1.principle: Xa iswekile inyibilika emanzini, iimolekyuli zeswekile zisasazeka ngokulinganayo phakathi kweemolekyuli zamanzi zize zibe ngamanzi eswekile acacileyo angabonwayo.
20261124-chemistry-g02-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g02-2.title: Izinto ezinyibilika emanzini kunye nemixube
20261124-chemistry-g02-2.summary: Kutheni iswekile inyibilika ngokukhawuleza kakhulu endebeni equlethe amanzi ashushu kuneyo equlethe amanzi abandayo?
20261124-chemistry-g02-2.principle: Xa ubushushu bamanzi buphezulu, ukushukuma kobushushu kweemolekyuli zamanzi kuyanda, zize ziqabane namaqhekeza eswekile rhoqo nangamandla, ngoko isantya sokunyibilika siyanda.
20261124-chemistry-g02-2.example: Xa ubushushu buphezulu, ukushukuma kweemolekyuli kuyakhawuleza.
20261124-chemistry-g02-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g03-1.title: Iimeko ezintathu: isolidi, ulwelo negesi
20261124-chemistry-g03-1.summary: Yeyiphi imeko yempahla apho imo itshintsha ngokukhululekileyo ngokwesikhongozeli, kodwa umthamo awutshintshi uhlala unjalo?
20261124-chemistry-g03-1.principle: Ulwelo lunamabophelelo phakathi kweemolekyuli athambileyo kuneesolidi ngoko imo itshintsha lula ngokwesikhongozeli, kodwa umthamo uhlala uqhelekile kuba ukutsalwa phakathi kweemolekyuli kuyagcinwa.
20261124-chemistry-g03-1.example: Cinga xa kugalelwa amanzi okanye ubisi kwenye indebe.
20261124-chemistry-g03-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g03-2.title: Iimeko ezintathu: isolidi, ulwelo negesi
20261124-chemistry-g03-2.summary: Isirinji enye yazaliswa ngamanzi, enye yazaliswa ngomoya, yaza imilomo yazo yavalwa ngomnwe yaza ipisitoni yatyhalwa ngamandla. Yintoni eyenzekayo?
20261124-chemistry-g03-2.principle: Igesi (umoya) inemigama emikhulu kakhulu phakathi kweemolekyuli ngoko ityunyuzeleka lula xa kufakwa uxinzelelo yaye umthamo uyancipha, kodwa ulwelo (amanzi) iimolekyuli zinqumle ngokusondeleyo ngoko azityunyuzeleki ngokukhawuleza.
20261124-chemistry-g03-2.example: Iimolekyuli zegesi zikude kakhulu omnye komnye ngoko kukho indawo engenanto eninzi.
20261124-chemistry-g03-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g04-1.title: Ukuvuka, ukubila, ukuguquka kube lulwelo nokutshintsha komthamo womkhenkce
20261124-chemistry-g04-1.summary: Ikani yesiselo esibandayo esisandula ukukhutshwa kwisikhenkcezisi yabekwa etafileni ixesha elifutshane yaza kwavela amathontsi amanzi emphezulwini wekani. La mathontsi amanzi avela phi?
20261124-chemistry-g04-1.principle: Umphunga wamanzi wegesi owawusemoyeni udibana nomphezulu obandayo wekani uphulukane nobushushu uguquke ube ngamathontsi amanzi olwelo, nto ebizwa ngokuba “yi-condensation (ukuguquka kube lulwelo)”.
20261124-chemistry-g04-1.example: Emoyeni kusoloko kukho umphunga wamanzi ongabonwayo.
20261124-chemistry-g04-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g04-2.title: Ukuvuka, ukubila, ukuguquka kube lulwelo nokutshintsha komthamo womkhenkce
20261124-chemistry-g04-2.summary: Xa amanzi olwelo ekhenkceza abe ngumkhenkce oyisolidi, yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo yotshintsho lobunzima nomthamo?
20261124-chemistry-g04-2.principle: Xa amanzi ekhenkceza abe ngumkhenkce, ubunzima buyagcinwa, kodwa kuba iimolekyuli zamanzi zenza iikristali zeheksagoni ezinendawo engenanto ngobunye be-hydrogen, umthamo unyuka malunga ne-10%.
20261124-chemistry-g04-2.example: Nokuba amanzi akhenkceza, inani lilonke leemolekyuli ezenza impahla alitshintshi.
20261124-chemistry-g04-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g05-1.title: I-solute, i-solvent, isisombululo nokuxinana
20261124-chemistry-g05-1.summary: Iswekile eyi-50 g yafakwa kumanzi a-200 g yaza yanyibilika ngokupheleleyo. Kula manzi eswekile, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ye-“solvent”, “solute” ne-“solution”?
20261124-chemistry-g05-1.principle: Amanzi, impahla enyibilikisayo, “yisolvent”, iswekile enyibilikayo “yisolute”, ize umxube ocacileyo ophuma ekuxutyweni kwazo ngokulinganayo ubizwe ngokuthi “isolution”.
20261124-chemistry-g05-1.example: Ulwelo olunyibilikisayo = solvent, into enyibilikayo = solute, umxube ogqityiweyo = solution.
20261124-chemistry-g05-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g05-2.title: I-solute, i-solvent, isisombululo nokuxinana
20261124-chemistry-g05-2.summary: Sifuna ukuphanda iimpawu zesisombululo setyuwa esikwi-beaker. Yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo yempawu yesisombululo, umxube ofanayo?
20261124-chemistry-g05-2.principle: Isisombululo esiyinyani (umxube ofanayo) sinamasuntswana esolute asasazeke ngokulinganayo phakathi kweemolekyuli zesolvent, ngoko nokuba sishiywe ixesha elide asityi aze ukuxinana kuyafana kuzo zonke iindawo.
20261124-chemistry-g05-2.example: Isisombululo ngumxube “ofanayo” oxutywe ngokulinganayo kwinqanaba leemolekyuli.
20261124-chemistry-g05-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g06-1.title: Ukuba nge-asidi, ukuba nge-alkali nezinto ezintathu zokutsha
20261124-chemistry-g06-1.summary: Xa kwaphoswa izisombululo ezahlukeneyo kwi-indicator yekhaphetshu ebomvu, isisombululo A saguquka sabomvu, ize isisombululo B saguquka sabaluhlaza sidlula sibe luhlaza kwaza kwaba mthubi. Yeyiphi impawu echanekileyo yezi zisombululo zombini?
20261124-chemistry-g06-1.principle: I-indicator yekhaphetshu ebomvu iguquka ibe bomvu kwizisombululo ezine-asidi, ize kwizisombululo ze-alkali iguquke ibe luhlaza, luhlaza okotyheli, okanye mthubi.
20261124-chemistry-g06-1.example: Ijusi yekhaphetshu ebomvu, i-indicator yendalo, iqulethe umbala we-anthocyanin.
20261124-chemistry-g06-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g06-2.title: Ukuba nge-asidi, ukuba nge-alkali nezinto ezintathu zokutsha
20261124-chemistry-g06-2.summary: Xa kwatshiswa i-asidi ye-hydrochloric ehlanjululweyo okanye iviniga kumaqokobhe amaqanda okanye iqhekeza lemabhile (equlethe i-calcium carbonate), kwavela iibhabhulu ezininzi. Yintoni utshintsho olwenzekayo xa le gesi iqokelelwa idluliswe kumanzi ekalika?
20261124-chemistry-g06-2.principle: Xa i-calcium carbonate ($\text{CaCO}_3$) isabela nge-asidi, kuvela igesi yekhabhon diokside ($\text{CO}_2$), ize ikhabhon diokside isabele namanzi ekalika ($\text{Ca(OH)}_2$) yenze ukuphuphuma kwe-calcium carbonate emhlophe nokwenza amanzi aluphuke.
20261124-chemistry-g06-2.example: Xa i-carbonate ne-asidi zisabela, kuvelisa igesi yekhabhon diokside (CO₂).
20261124-chemistry-g06-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g07-1.title: Umthetho kaBoyle, umthetho kaCharles notshintsho lweemeko
20261124-chemistry-g07-1.summary: Yintoni isizathu esiphambili “soxinzelelo lwegesi” esivakala emgangathweni wesikhongozeli esivaliweyo esiqulethe igesi?
20261124-chemistry-g07-1.principle: Uxinzelelo lwegesi luvela emandleni kwiyunithi yendawo awenziwa ngamasuntswana egesi aqhaqhazela ngokungaphezi nangokungalungelelananga eludongeni lwangaphakathi lwesikhongozeli.
20261124-chemistry-g07-1.example: Iimolekyuli zegesi ziqhuba ngesantya esikhulu kakhulu.
20261124-chemistry-g07-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g07-2.title: Umthetho kaBoyle, umthetho kaCharles notshintsho lweemeko
20261124-chemistry-g07-2.summary: Kubushushu obungatshintshiyo, uxinzelelo lwegesi enomthamo we-60 mL kwi-1 atm lwenyuswa lwaya ku-3 atm. Ngokomthetho kaBoyle, umthamo wale gesi ungakanani?
20261124-chemistry-g07-2.principle: Ngokomthetho kaBoyle, xa ubushushu bungatshintshanga, $P_1 V_1 = P_2 V_2$ iyasebenza. $1\text{ atm} \times 60\text{ mL} = 3\text{ atm} \times V_2 \implies V_2 = 20\text{ mL}$.
20261124-chemistry-g07-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g08-1.title: Izinto, ii-athomu, ii-ion nempendulo yokwenza i-precipitate
20261124-chemistry-g08-1.summary: Yintoni isizathu esiphambili sokuba i-athomu eyakhiwe ngenyukliyasi ne-electrons ibe nesimo sokungathathi cala ngokombane?
20261124-chemistry-g08-1.principle: I-athomu ayithathi cala ngokombane kuba intlawulo epheleleyo (+) yee-protons zenyukliyasi esembindini nentlawulo epheleleyo (-) yee-electrons ezijikeleza ngeorbits zilingana ngokupheleleyo ngobukhulu.
20261124-chemistry-g08-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g08-2.title: Izinto, ii-athomu, ii-ion nempendulo yokwenza i-precipitate
20261124-chemistry-g08-2.summary: Yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo ngokwakhiwa kwee-“ion”, apho i-athomu engathathi cala ilahlekelwa okanye ifumana ii-electrons yaze ibe nentlawulo?
20261124-chemistry-g08-2.principle: I-athomu ilahlekelwa ii-electrons zeqokobhe elingaphandle ibe yi-cation (ubukhulu izinyithi), okanye ifumane ii-electrons yenze i-anion eyanelisayo umgaqo we-octet (ubukhulu ii-athomu ezingezizo izinyithi).
20261124-chemistry-g08-2.example: I-sodium (Na) ilahlekelwa yi-electron enye ibe yi-Na⁺.
20261124-chemistry-g08-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g09-1.title: Ukulondolozwa kobunzima, umlinganiselo ongatshintshiyo, i-exothermic ne-endothermic
20261124-chemistry-g09-1.summary: Yintoni isizathu esisisiseko sokuba 'umthetho wokugcinwa kobunzima' ube yinyani xa kwenzeka utshintsho lwekhemikhali?
20261124-chemistry-g09-1.principle: Kwintsabela yekhemikhali, indlela iiathom ezidityaniswa ngayo iyatshintsha kwaye kwenziwa izinto ezintsha, kodwa iintlobo kunye nenani leeathom azenziwa okanye zitshatyalaliswe kwaye zigcinwa njengoko zazinjalo, ngoko ubunzima bonke abutshintshi.
20261124-chemistry-g09-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g09-2.title: Ukulondolozwa kobunzima, umlinganiselo ongatshintshiyo, i-exothermic ne-endothermic
20261124-chemistry-g09-2.summary: Kwenziwa uvavanyo apho kwatshiswa ipowuda yekopolo emoyeni kwi-crucible ukwenza i-copper(II) oxide. Xa i-4 g yekopolo yasabela ngokupheleleyo, kwenziwa i-5 g ye-copper(II) oxide. Bungakanani ubunzima be-oxygen edibeneyo, kwaye ngumlinganiselo wobunzima bekopolo ukuya kwi-oxygen?
20261124-chemistry-g09-2.principle: Ubunzima be-oxygen esabeleyo bu-$5\text{ g} - 4\text{ g} = 1\text{ g}$. Ngokomthetho wemilinganiselo echanekileyo, umlinganiselo wobunzima bekopolo ukuya kwi-oxygen kwi-copper(II) oxide ihlala ingu-$4 : 1$.
20261124-chemistry-g09-2.example: Umthetho wokugcinwa kobunzima: (ikopolo 4 g) + (i-oxygen ? g) = copper(II) oxide 5 g
20261124-chemistry-g09-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g10-1.title: Ibhondi ye-ion, ibhondi ye-covalent kunye ne-oxidation-reduction
20261124-chemistry-g10-1.summary: Sesiphi isiphumo esichane kakhulu sovavanyo oluthelekisa ukuqhuba umbane kwenqaku A (sodium chloride) kunye nenqaku B (iswekile)?
20261124-chemistry-g10-1.principle: I-sodium chloride, into edityaniswe nge-ionic bond, inyibilika emanzini kwaye ihlukane ibe ngama-cation nama-anion, ngoko isisombululo sayo samanzi siqhuba umbane. Iswekile, into edityaniswe nge-covalent bond, inyibilika njengeemolekyuli kwaye ayinazo izithwali zentlawulo, ngoko ayiqhubi umbane.
20261124-chemistry-g10-1.example: Into edityaniswe nge-ionic bond (NaCl) iyaphuma ibe ngama-ion ahamba ngokukhululekileyo xa inyibilika emanzini.
20261124-chemistry-g10-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g10-2.title: Ibhondi ye-ion, ibhondi ye-covalent kunye ne-oxidation-reduction
20261124-chemistry-g10-2.summary: Xa isisombululo se-sodium hydroxide (NaOH) songezwa kancinci kancinci kwisixa esiqingqiweyo se-hydrochloric acid (HCl) elahlekayo, sesiphi isiphumo esichanekileyo sokulinganisa utshintsho kwinani lama-ion kunye nobushushu kwisisombululo?
20261124-chemistry-g10-2.principle: Kuba ubushushu bokungathathi cala buyakhutshwa ngexesha lentsabela yokungathathi cala, ubushushu besisombululo bufikelela kwelona nqanaba liphezulu xa kufikelelwa kwindawo yokungathathi cala, apho intsabela iphelele. Ama-ion e-chloride ($\text{Cl}^-$) ngama-spectator ion angasabeliyo, ngoko inani lawo lihlala lingatshintshi.
20261124-chemistry-g10-2.example: Xa kwenzeka intsabela yokungathathi cala (H⁺ + OH⁻ → H₂O), ubushushu bokungathathi cala buyakhutshwa.
20261124-chemistry-g10-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g11-1.title: I-mole
20261124-chemistry-g11-1.summary: Kwi-0℃ nge-1 atm, zingaphi iimoli zeemolekyuli ze-methane, nezingaphi iimoli zizonke zeeathom ze-hydrogen (H), kwi-11.2 L yegesi ye-methane (CH₄, ubunzima beemolekyuli 16)?
20261124-chemistry-g11-1.principle: Inani leemoli ze-methane li-$n = \frac{11.2\text{ L}}{22.4\text{ L/mol}} = 0.5\text{ mol}$. Imolekyuli nganye ye-$1$ ye-methane iqulethe iiathom ze-hydrogen ezi-$4$, ngoko iimoli zizonke zeeathom ze-hydrogen zi-$0.5 \times 4 = 2.0\text{ mol}$.
20261124-chemistry-g11-1.example: Kwi-0℃ nge-1 atm, i-1 mol yegesi = 22.4 L.
20261124-chemistry-g11-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g11-2.title: I-mole
20261124-chemistry-g11-2.summary: Bungakanani ubunzima be-NaOH eqinileyo ecocekileyo obufunekayo ukwenza i-500 mL yesisombululo esiqhelekileyo se-0.1 M se-sodium hydroxide (NaOH, ubunzima beefomula 40)?
20261124-chemistry-g11-2.principle: Iimoli ze-$\text{NaOH}$ ezifunekayo zi-$n = M \times V = 0.1\text{ mol/L} \times 0.5\text{ L} = 0.05\text{ mol}$. Ubunzima obufunekayo bu-$w = n \times M_w = 0.05\text{ mol} \times 40\text{ g/mol} = 2.0\text{ g}$.
20261124-chemistry-g11-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g12-1.title: Isantya sempendulo, umgaqo kaLe Chatelier neseli yekhemikhali
20261124-chemistry-g12-1.summary: Sesiphi isitatimenti esichanekileyo malunga notshintsho olwenzekayo xa 'i-positive catalyst' yongezwa kwintsabela yekhemikhali?
20261124-chemistry-g12-1.principle: I-positive catalyst inika indlela entsha yokusabela enamandla okwenza asezantsi kwaye ikhulisa ii-rate constants zeentsabela ezibheke phambili neziyivayo ngomlinganiselo ofanayo. Ayitshintshi ngaphandle kwe-reaction enthalpy ($\Delta H$) okanye i-equilibrium constant ($K$).
20261124-chemistry-g12-1.example: I-catalyst ayinako ukutshintsha umahluko wamandla (ΔH) phakathi kwezinto zokuqala nemveliso yokugqibela.
20261124-chemistry-g12-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261124-chemistry-g12-2.title: Isantya sempendulo, umgaqo kaLe Chatelier neseli yekhemikhali
20261124-chemistry-g12-2.summary: Kuvavanyo lwezantya zokuqala lwentsabela 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), xa [O₂] yagcinwa ingatshintshi kwaye [NO] yaphindwa kabini, isantya saba kuphindwa ka-4, kwaye xa [NO] yagcinwa ingatshintshi kwaye [O₂] yaphindwa kabini, isantya saba kuphindwa ka-2. Yintoni umthetho wesantya kunye ne-overall reaction order yale ntsabela?
20261124-chemistry-g12-2.principle: Xa $[\text{NO}]$ iphindwa ka-$2$ isantya siba kuphindwa ka-$4$, ngoko $m=2$, kwaye xa $[\text{O}_2]$ iphindwa ka-$2$ isantya siba kuphindwa ka-$2$, ngoko $n=1$. Umthetho wesantya yi-$v = k[\text{NO}]^2[\text{O}_2]$, kwaye i-overall reaction order yi-$2 + 1 = 3$.
20261124-chemistry-g12-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g03-1.title: Iimeko ezintathu: isolidi, ulwelo negesi
20261125-chemistry-g03-1.summary: Yeyiphi imeko yempahla apho imo itshintsha ngokukhululekileyo ngokwesikhongozeli, kodwa umthamo awutshintshi uhlala unjalo?
20261125-chemistry-g03-1.principle: Ulwelo lunamabophelelo phakathi kweemolekyuli athambileyo kuneesolidi ngoko imo itshintsha lula ngokwesikhongozeli, kodwa umthamo uhlala uqhelekile kuba ukutsalwa phakathi kweemolekyuli kuyagcinwa.
20261125-chemistry-g03-1.example: Cinga xa kugalelwa amanzi okanye ubisi kwenye indebe.
20261125-chemistry-g03-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g03-2.title: Iimeko ezintathu: isolidi, ulwelo negesi
20261125-chemistry-g03-2.summary: Isirinji enye yazaliswa ngamanzi, enye yazaliswa ngomoya, yaza imilomo yazo yavalwa ngomnwe yaza ipisitoni yatyhalwa ngamandla. Yintoni eyenzekayo?
20261125-chemistry-g03-2.principle: Igesi (umoya) inemigama emikhulu kakhulu phakathi kweemolekyuli ngoko ityunyuzeleka lula xa kufakwa uxinzelelo yaye umthamo uyancipha, kodwa ulwelo (amanzi) iimolekyuli zinqumle ngokusondeleyo ngoko azityunyuzeleki ngokukhawuleza.
20261125-chemistry-g03-2.example: Iimolekyuli zegesi zikude kakhulu omnye komnye ngoko kukho indawo engenanto eninzi.
20261125-chemistry-g03-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g04-1.title: Ukuvuka, ukubila, ukuguquka kube lulwelo nokutshintsha komthamo womkhenkce
20261125-chemistry-g04-1.summary: Ikani yesiselo esibandayo esisandula ukukhutshwa kwisikhenkcezisi yabekwa etafileni ixesha elifutshane yaza kwavela amathontsi amanzi emphezulwini wekani. La mathontsi amanzi avela phi?
20261125-chemistry-g04-1.principle: Umphunga wamanzi wegesi owawusemoyeni udibana nomphezulu obandayo wekani uphulukane nobushushu uguquke ube ngamathontsi amanzi olwelo, nto ebizwa ngokuba “yi-condensation (ukuguquka kube lulwelo)”.
20261125-chemistry-g04-1.example: Emoyeni kusoloko kukho umphunga wamanzi ongabonwayo.
20261125-chemistry-g04-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g04-2.title: Ukuvuka, ukubila, ukuguquka kube lulwelo nokutshintsha komthamo womkhenkce
20261125-chemistry-g04-2.summary: Xa amanzi olwelo ekhenkceza abe ngumkhenkce oyisolidi, yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo yotshintsho lobunzima nomthamo?
20261125-chemistry-g04-2.principle: Xa amanzi ekhenkceza abe ngumkhenkce, ubunzima buyagcinwa, kodwa kuba iimolekyuli zamanzi zenza iikristali zeheksagoni ezinendawo engenanto ngobunye be-hydrogen, umthamo unyuka malunga ne-10%.
20261125-chemistry-g04-2.example: Nokuba amanzi akhenkceza, inani lilonke leemolekyuli ezenza impahla alitshintshi.
20261125-chemistry-g04-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g05-1.title: I-solute, i-solvent, isisombululo nokuxinana
20261125-chemistry-g05-1.summary: Iswekile eyi-50 g yafakwa kumanzi a-200 g yaza yanyibilika ngokupheleleyo. Kula manzi eswekile, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ye-“solvent”, “solute” ne-“solution”?
20261125-chemistry-g05-1.principle: Amanzi, impahla enyibilikisayo, “yisolvent”, iswekile enyibilikayo “yisolute”, ize umxube ocacileyo ophuma ekuxutyweni kwazo ngokulinganayo ubizwe ngokuthi “isolution”.
20261125-chemistry-g05-1.example: Ulwelo olunyibilikisayo = solvent, into enyibilikayo = solute, umxube ogqityiweyo = solution.
20261125-chemistry-g05-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g05-2.title: I-solute, i-solvent, isisombululo nokuxinana
20261125-chemistry-g05-2.summary: Sifuna ukuphanda iimpawu zesisombululo setyuwa esikwi-beaker. Yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo yempawu yesisombululo, umxube ofanayo?
20261125-chemistry-g05-2.principle: Isisombululo esiyinyani (umxube ofanayo) sinamasuntswana esolute asasazeke ngokulinganayo phakathi kweemolekyuli zesolvent, ngoko nokuba sishiywe ixesha elide asityi aze ukuxinana kuyafana kuzo zonke iindawo.
20261125-chemistry-g05-2.example: Isisombululo ngumxube “ofanayo” oxutywe ngokulinganayo kwinqanaba leemolekyuli.
20261125-chemistry-g05-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g06-1.title: Ukuba nge-asidi, ukuba nge-alkali nezinto ezintathu zokutsha
20261125-chemistry-g06-1.summary: Xa kwaphoswa izisombululo ezahlukeneyo kwi-indicator yekhaphetshu ebomvu, isisombululo A saguquka sabomvu, ize isisombululo B saguquka sabaluhlaza sidlula sibe luhlaza kwaza kwaba mthubi. Yeyiphi impawu echanekileyo yezi zisombululo zombini?
20261125-chemistry-g06-1.principle: I-indicator yekhaphetshu ebomvu iguquka ibe bomvu kwizisombululo ezine-asidi, ize kwizisombululo ze-alkali iguquke ibe luhlaza, luhlaza okotyheli, okanye mthubi.
20261125-chemistry-g06-1.example: Ijusi yekhaphetshu ebomvu, i-indicator yendalo, iqulethe umbala we-anthocyanin.
20261125-chemistry-g06-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g06-2.title: Ukuba nge-asidi, ukuba nge-alkali nezinto ezintathu zokutsha
20261125-chemistry-g06-2.summary: Xa kwatshiswa i-asidi ye-hydrochloric ehlanjululweyo okanye iviniga kumaqokobhe amaqanda okanye iqhekeza lemabhile (equlethe i-calcium carbonate), kwavela iibhabhulu ezininzi. Yintoni utshintsho olwenzekayo xa le gesi iqokelelwa idluliswe kumanzi ekalika?
20261125-chemistry-g06-2.principle: Xa i-calcium carbonate ($\text{CaCO}_3$) isabela nge-asidi, kuvela igesi yekhabhon diokside ($\text{CO}_2$), ize ikhabhon diokside isabele namanzi ekalika ($\text{Ca(OH)}_2$) yenze ukuphuphuma kwe-calcium carbonate emhlophe nokwenza amanzi aluphuke.
20261125-chemistry-g06-2.example: Xa i-carbonate ne-asidi zisabela, kuvelisa igesi yekhabhon diokside (CO₂).
20261125-chemistry-g06-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g07-1.title: Umthetho kaBoyle, umthetho kaCharles notshintsho lweemeko
20261125-chemistry-g07-1.summary: Yintoni isizathu esiphambili “soxinzelelo lwegesi” esivakala emgangathweni wesikhongozeli esivaliweyo esiqulethe igesi?
20261125-chemistry-g07-1.principle: Uxinzelelo lwegesi luvela emandleni kwiyunithi yendawo awenziwa ngamasuntswana egesi aqhaqhazela ngokungaphezi nangokungalungelelananga eludongeni lwangaphakathi lwesikhongozeli.
20261125-chemistry-g07-1.example: Iimolekyuli zegesi ziqhuba ngesantya esikhulu kakhulu.
20261125-chemistry-g07-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g07-2.title: Umthetho kaBoyle, umthetho kaCharles notshintsho lweemeko
20261125-chemistry-g07-2.summary: Kubushushu obungatshintshiyo, uxinzelelo lwegesi enomthamo we-60 mL kwi-1 atm lwenyuswa lwaya ku-3 atm. Ngokomthetho kaBoyle, umthamo wale gesi ungakanani?
20261125-chemistry-g07-2.principle: Ngokomthetho kaBoyle, xa ubushushu bungatshintshanga, $P_1 V_1 = P_2 V_2$ iyasebenza. $1\text{ atm} \times 60\text{ mL} = 3\text{ atm} \times V_2 \implies V_2 = 20\text{ mL}$.
20261125-chemistry-g07-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g08-1.title: Izinto, ii-athomu, ii-ion nempendulo yokwenza i-precipitate
20261125-chemistry-g08-1.summary: Yintoni isizathu esiphambili sokuba i-athomu eyakhiwe ngenyukliyasi ne-electrons ibe nesimo sokungathathi cala ngokombane?
20261125-chemistry-g08-1.principle: I-athomu ayithathi cala ngokombane kuba intlawulo epheleleyo (+) yee-protons zenyukliyasi esembindini nentlawulo epheleleyo (-) yee-electrons ezijikeleza ngeorbits zilingana ngokupheleleyo ngobukhulu.
20261125-chemistry-g08-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g08-2.title: Izinto, ii-athomu, ii-ion nempendulo yokwenza i-precipitate
20261125-chemistry-g08-2.summary: Yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo ngokwakhiwa kwee-“ion”, apho i-athomu engathathi cala ilahlekelwa okanye ifumana ii-electrons yaze ibe nentlawulo?
20261125-chemistry-g08-2.principle: I-athomu ilahlekelwa ii-electrons zeqokobhe elingaphandle ibe yi-cation (ubukhulu izinyithi), okanye ifumane ii-electrons yenze i-anion eyanelisayo umgaqo we-octet (ubukhulu ii-athomu ezingezizo izinyithi).
20261125-chemistry-g08-2.example: I-sodium (Na) ilahlekelwa yi-electron enye ibe yi-Na⁺.
20261125-chemistry-g08-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g09-1.title: Ukulondolozwa kobunzima, umlinganiselo ongatshintshiyo, i-exothermic ne-endothermic
20261125-chemistry-g09-1.summary: Yintoni isizathu esisisiseko sokuba 'umthetho wokugcinwa kobunzima' ube yinyani xa kwenzeka utshintsho lwekhemikhali?
20261125-chemistry-g09-1.principle: Kwintsabela yekhemikhali, indlela iiathom ezidityaniswa ngayo iyatshintsha kwaye kwenziwa izinto ezintsha, kodwa iintlobo kunye nenani leeathom azenziwa okanye zitshatyalaliswe kwaye zigcinwa njengoko zazinjalo, ngoko ubunzima bonke abutshintshi.
20261125-chemistry-g09-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g09-2.title: Ukulondolozwa kobunzima, umlinganiselo ongatshintshiyo, i-exothermic ne-endothermic
20261125-chemistry-g09-2.summary: Kwenziwa uvavanyo apho kwatshiswa ipowuda yekopolo emoyeni kwi-crucible ukwenza i-copper(II) oxide. Xa i-4 g yekopolo yasabela ngokupheleleyo, kwenziwa i-5 g ye-copper(II) oxide. Bungakanani ubunzima be-oxygen edibeneyo, kwaye ngumlinganiselo wobunzima bekopolo ukuya kwi-oxygen?
20261125-chemistry-g09-2.principle: Ubunzima be-oxygen esabeleyo bu-$5\text{ g} - 4\text{ g} = 1\text{ g}$. Ngokomthetho wemilinganiselo echanekileyo, umlinganiselo wobunzima bekopolo ukuya kwi-oxygen kwi-copper(II) oxide ihlala ingu-$4 : 1$.
20261125-chemistry-g09-2.example: Umthetho wokugcinwa kobunzima: (ikopolo 4 g) + (i-oxygen ? g) = copper(II) oxide 5 g
20261125-chemistry-g09-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g10-1.title: Ibhondi ye-ion, ibhondi ye-covalent kunye ne-oxidation-reduction
20261125-chemistry-g10-1.summary: Sesiphi isiphumo esichane kakhulu sovavanyo oluthelekisa ukuqhuba umbane kwenqaku A (sodium chloride) kunye nenqaku B (iswekile)?
20261125-chemistry-g10-1.principle: I-sodium chloride, into edityaniswe nge-ionic bond, inyibilika emanzini kwaye ihlukane ibe ngama-cation nama-anion, ngoko isisombululo sayo samanzi siqhuba umbane. Iswekile, into edityaniswe nge-covalent bond, inyibilika njengeemolekyuli kwaye ayinazo izithwali zentlawulo, ngoko ayiqhubi umbane.
20261125-chemistry-g10-1.example: Into edityaniswe nge-ionic bond (NaCl) iyaphuma ibe ngama-ion ahamba ngokukhululekileyo xa inyibilika emanzini.
20261125-chemistry-g10-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g10-2.title: Ibhondi ye-ion, ibhondi ye-covalent kunye ne-oxidation-reduction
20261125-chemistry-g10-2.summary: Xa isisombululo se-sodium hydroxide (NaOH) songezwa kancinci kancinci kwisixa esiqingqiweyo se-hydrochloric acid (HCl) elahlekayo, sesiphi isiphumo esichanekileyo sokulinganisa utshintsho kwinani lama-ion kunye nobushushu kwisisombululo?
20261125-chemistry-g10-2.principle: Kuba ubushushu bokungathathi cala buyakhutshwa ngexesha lentsabela yokungathathi cala, ubushushu besisombululo bufikelela kwelona nqanaba liphezulu xa kufikelelwa kwindawo yokungathathi cala, apho intsabela iphelele. Ama-ion e-chloride ($\text{Cl}^-$) ngama-spectator ion angasabeliyo, ngoko inani lawo lihlala lingatshintshi.
20261125-chemistry-g10-2.example: Xa kwenzeka intsabela yokungathathi cala (H⁺ + OH⁻ → H₂O), ubushushu bokungathathi cala buyakhutshwa.
20261125-chemistry-g10-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g11-1.title: I-mole
20261125-chemistry-g11-1.summary: Kwi-0℃ nge-1 atm, zingaphi iimoli zeemolekyuli ze-methane, nezingaphi iimoli zizonke zeeathom ze-hydrogen (H), kwi-11.2 L yegesi ye-methane (CH₄, ubunzima beemolekyuli 16)?
20261125-chemistry-g11-1.principle: Inani leemoli ze-methane li-$n = \frac{11.2\text{ L}}{22.4\text{ L/mol}} = 0.5\text{ mol}$. Imolekyuli nganye ye-$1$ ye-methane iqulethe iiathom ze-hydrogen ezi-$4$, ngoko iimoli zizonke zeeathom ze-hydrogen zi-$0.5 \times 4 = 2.0\text{ mol}$.
20261125-chemistry-g11-1.example: Kwi-0℃ nge-1 atm, i-1 mol yegesi = 22.4 L.
20261125-chemistry-g11-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g11-2.title: I-mole
20261125-chemistry-g11-2.summary: Bungakanani ubunzima be-NaOH eqinileyo ecocekileyo obufunekayo ukwenza i-500 mL yesisombululo esiqhelekileyo se-0.1 M se-sodium hydroxide (NaOH, ubunzima beefomula 40)?
20261125-chemistry-g11-2.principle: Iimoli ze-$\text{NaOH}$ ezifunekayo zi-$n = M \times V = 0.1\text{ mol/L} \times 0.5\text{ L} = 0.05\text{ mol}$. Ubunzima obufunekayo bu-$w = n \times M_w = 0.05\text{ mol} \times 40\text{ g/mol} = 2.0\text{ g}$.
20261125-chemistry-g11-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g12-1.title: Isantya sempendulo, umgaqo kaLe Chatelier neseli yekhemikhali
20261125-chemistry-g12-1.summary: Sesiphi isitatimenti esichanekileyo malunga notshintsho olwenzekayo xa 'i-positive catalyst' yongezwa kwintsabela yekhemikhali?
20261125-chemistry-g12-1.principle: I-positive catalyst inika indlela entsha yokusabela enamandla okwenza asezantsi kwaye ikhulisa ii-rate constants zeentsabela ezibheke phambili neziyivayo ngomlinganiselo ofanayo. Ayitshintshi ngaphandle kwe-reaction enthalpy ($\Delta H$) okanye i-equilibrium constant ($K$).
20261125-chemistry-g12-1.example: I-catalyst ayinako ukutshintsha umahluko wamandla (ΔH) phakathi kwezinto zokuqala nemveliso yokugqibela.
20261125-chemistry-g12-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261125-chemistry-g12-2.title: Isantya sempendulo, umgaqo kaLe Chatelier neseli yekhemikhali
20261125-chemistry-g12-2.summary: Kuvavanyo lwezantya zokuqala lwentsabela 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), xa [O₂] yagcinwa ingatshintshi kwaye [NO] yaphindwa kabini, isantya saba kuphindwa ka-4, kwaye xa [NO] yagcinwa ingatshintshi kwaye [O₂] yaphindwa kabini, isantya saba kuphindwa ka-2. Yintoni umthetho wesantya kunye ne-overall reaction order yale ntsabela?
20261125-chemistry-g12-2.principle: Xa $[\text{NO}]$ iphindwa ka-$2$ isantya siba kuphindwa ka-$4$, ngoko $m=2$, kwaye xa $[\text{O}_2]$ iphindwa ka-$2$ isantya siba kuphindwa ka-$2$, ngoko $n=1$. Umthetho wesantya yi-$v = k[\text{NO}]^2[\text{O}_2]$, kwaye i-overall reaction order yi-$2 + 1 = 3$.
20261125-chemistry-g12-2.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

USue uneminyaka eyi-11. Ukhwela ngeenyawo esiya echibini yedwa, kwaye unekepusi.

20261119-english-g03-1.title: Fumana ixesha lokufunda kwishedyuli kaMina yoMgqibelo
20261119-english-g03-1.summary:
Ishedyuli kaMina yoMgqibelo (ebhalwe ngombhalo kuphela, ngaphandle komfanekiso):

10 a.m.: I can start my free time.
12 p.m. - 1 p.m.: Lunch
1 p.m. - 2 p.m.: Dance class
5 p.m.: Dinner. I must finish before dinner.

UMina ufuna ukufunda incwadi iyure e-1. Uqala kwiyure epheleleyo aze agqibe kwiyure epheleleyo.
20261119-english-g03-1.principle: Ixesha lokuzonwabisa liqala ngo-10 a.m., kwaye 12 ukuya kwi-14 zizele sisidlo sasemini nomdaniso. Akukho ntshukumo kwishedyuli ukusuka kwi-15 ukuya kwi-16 nokusuka kwi-16 ukuya kwi-17, kwaye ziphela phambi kokutya kwangokuhlwa.
20261119-english-g03-1.example: Tshintsha amaxesha eshedyuli abe manani eeyure ezingama-24 uze uzobe istrip sexesha.
20261119-english-g03-1.actionItem: Yiza namaxesha ahlukeneyo okuqala ukufunda ahlangabezana nayo yonke imiqathango yeshedyuli, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni amanye amaxesha engasebenzi.

20261119-english-g03-2.summary: Uza kubhala umboniso apho umhlobo wakho uMina ukhathazekile ngexesha lovavanyo. Umbhalo ochaza imvakalelo ngqo nombhalo oyibonisa ngezenzo ufikelela kumfundi ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo.
20261119-english-g03-2.principle: Ukusuka kwizandla ezibandayo nokujonga iwotshi kaninzi, umfundi unokuqikelela ukuxhalaba. Ukuyawa ngoxa ujonge ngefestile kucebisa ukudinwa, nokubhomboloza ngoxa ubhala ngokukhawuleza kucebisa ukuphumla okanye ukuzithemba.

20261119-english-g04-1.title: Inqaku likaMama nexesha lokudlala likaJisu
20261119-english-g04-1.summary:
Inqaku uMama alishiye etafileni (libhalwe ngamagama kuphela, akukho mfanekiso):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Emva koko umhlobo wakhe uJisu wathumela isicatshulwa. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"
20261119-english-g04-1.principle: Iklasi yepiyano yi-4:00-4:30, ngoko 4:15-4:30 iyagqithisana, kwaye ukukhupha inkunkuma ngo-5:00 kuwela ngaphakathi kwe-4:15-5:15. Ukufika ekhaya ngo-3:30 nesidlo sasebusuku ngo-6:30 zingaphandle kwexesha lepaki.
20261119-english-g04-1.example: Beka umgca ngamnye ecaleni kwexesha lepaki '4:15-5:15' enye ngenye, uze ubone ukuba iphela phambi kwayo okanye iqala emva kwayo.
20261119-english-g04-1.actionItem: Thelekisa izicwangciso ezininzi ezikwinqaku likaMama nexesha elicetyiswe ngumhlobo, fumana apho zingahambelani khona, uze uthi hayi ngesiNgesi ngelixa ucebisa ixesha elahlukileyo.

20261119-english-g04-2.title: Gqiba amaxesha okuhamba inja nomsebenzi wasekhaya
20261119-english-g04-2.summary:
Inqaku uTata alishiyileyo (libhalwe ngamagama kuphela, akukho mfanekiso):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

Ngezantsi, bhala ixesha ngalinye njenge-'imizuzu emingaphi emva kwe-4:00 p.m.'. Umzekelo, ukuba uqala ngo-4:30, bhala u-30, kwaye ukuba uqala ngo-5:15, bhala u-75.
20261119-english-g04-2.principle: Umsebenzi wasekhaya yi-5:00-6:00 kwaye ukuhamba yi-5:30-6:00, ngoko imisebenzi emibini iyagqithisana ukusuka ku-5:30 ukuya ku-6:00. Ukuhamba kuqala emva kwe-5:00 kwaye zombini ziyaphela phambi kwe-6:30, ngoko ezinye iimeko zigcinwe.
20261119-english-g04-2.example: Yongeza ixesha elithathayo (ngemizuzu) kwixesha lokuqala lomsebenzi ngamnye ukufumana ixesha eliphela ngalo.
20261119-english-g04-2.actionItem: Yenza iindibaniselwano ezininzi ezahlukeneyo zexesha lokuhamba nexesha lomsebenzi wasekhaya ezihlangabezana nazo zonke iimeko zenqaku likaDadewethu.

20261119-english-g10-2.title: Ingaba umzekelo o-1 unokwenza ukuba kuthiwe 'ngalo lonke ixesha'?
20261119-english-g10-2.summary:
Esi licandelo lesicatshulwa esapapashwa kwiphephandaba lesikolo (amanani emigca aqala ku-1).
1) Our school should ban phones from the building.
2) Last month, Mina got a new phone, and her math score dropped from 90 to 75.
3) So phones clearly make all students' grades worse.
4) Also, phones are noisy in the hallway, and some students look up answers during tests.
5) Therefore, the school should ban them for everyone.
20261119-english-g10-2.principle: Umgca o-3 yingxaki. Ukuthi amanqaku "ngokuqinisekileyo" aya kuba mabi ku"bonke abafundi" ngokusekelwe kukwehla kwamanqaku komfundi o-1 kuphela (umgca o-2) sisigqibo esikhulu kunobungqina. Ukwehla kwamanqaku kunokuba nezinye izizathu, ezinje ngobunzima bovavanyo okanye imeko. Umgca o-4 unika uhlobo oluhlukileyo lwesizathu kumanqaku (ingxolo, ukukopa), ngoko kufuneka uqwalaselwe ngokwahlukeneyo kule ngxaki. U"anqatshelwe wonke umntu" womgca o-5 naso sisekele kwesi sigqibo, kodwa indawo apho ingxaki iqala khona umgca o-3.
20261119-english-g10-2.actionItem: Kwisicatshulwa esiphikisanayo, fumana umgca apho ubungqina bungaxhasi ibango ngokwaneleyo, usibhale kwakhona njengesivakalisi esinocoselelo ngakumbi, uze ugqibe ukuba ngowuphi ubungqina obongezelelweyo obufunekayo.

Libango elisuka kwinqaku lesikolo. "Students who eat breakfast get higher test scores, so the school should provide free breakfast." Njengobungqina, iziphumo zophando lwabafundi abangama-200 zazibonisiwe ngolu hlobo.

Group | Number of students | Average score
Students who eat breakfast | 130 | 82
Students who skip breakfast | 70 | 74
20261119-english-g12-1.principle: b ihlola ezinye izizathu (ubuthongo, ixesha lokufunda), c ihlola isiphumo sophindlo lwangempela, kwaye e ihlola ukulunga kothelekiso. a no-d asingobungqina bokuba izidlo zikhulisa amanqaku.
20261119-english-g12-1.example: Hlola ukuba ulwazi ngalunye lunceda ukuphendula umbuzo, 'Ingaba unxibelelwano phakathi kwesidlo sakusasa namanqaku sisizathu?'
20261119-english-g12-1.actionItem: Gweba ukuba isiphumo sophando sisixelela ngo-"sizathu", khetha ulwazi olongezelelweyo oluyimfuneko kuloo mgwebo, uze ucebise ngesiNgesi indlela yokuthelekisa yokuhlola impembelelo yokutya mahala.

20261119-english-g12-2.example: Wahlule amagama asesihlokweni anika iinyani kwawo anika imvakalelo.
