20261121-english-g01-1.title: Fumana izenzo ezingahambelani nesaziso sechibi
20261121-english-g01-1.summary:
Isaziso emnyango wechibi (sibhalwe ngamagama kuphela, akukho mfanekiso):

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = an adult)

Abantu abane baya echibini.
UMina uneminyaka eyi-7. Uza noMama wakhe, kwaye unekepusi.
UJun uneminyaka eyi-10. Uza yedwa, kwaye akanayo ikepusi.
UTom uneminyaka eyi-6. Uza nomntakwabo. Umntakwabo uneminyaka eyi-9. UTom unekepusi.
USue uneminyaka eyi-11. Ukhwela ngeenyawo esiya echibini yedwa, kwaye unekepusi.
20261121-english-g01-1.principle: UJun akanayo ikepusi, ngoko uphula umthetho 2. UTom uphantsi kwe-8, kodwa umntakwabo oze naye uneminyaka eyi-9, ngoko akangomntu 'omdala', kwaye uTom uphula umthetho 3. UMina weza noMama wakhe, kwaye uSue uneminyaka eyi-11, ngoko kulungile ukuba ahambe aze yedwa.
20261121-english-g01-1.example: Yenza itheyibhile enobudala bomntu ngamnye, ngubani amphelekileyo, nekepusi, omnye ngomnye.
20261121-english-g01-1.actionItem: Hambelanisa imithetho emithathu esesazisweni nemeko yomntu ngamnye, ukhethe iimeko ezophula imithetho, uze uthi isizathu ngesiNgesi.

20261121-english-g01-2.title: Lungisa umgca ongalunganga kwisaziso sezinto ezilahlekileyo esikhutshiweyo
20261121-english-g01-2.summary:
Isaziso kwibhodi yeendaba yesikolo (sibhalwe ngamagama kuphela):

Lost and Found
Found: a blue water bottle, near Room 3.
Ask Ms. Park in Room 1 after school.

Umhlobo wakho uJia wabona esi saziso kuba ebekhangela ibhotile yakhe yamanzi, wathumela umyalezo kuHana. UHana ufuna ukuyithelekisa nesaziso.
20261121-english-g01-2.principle: Umgca 4 awuchanekanga. Kwisaziso, uMs. Park useGumbini 1, kodwa umyalezo uthi Igumbi 3, ngoko akuchanekanga. I-blue kumgca 2 ifana nesaziso, kwaye iRoom 3 kumgca 3 yindawo ibhotile eyafunyanwa kuyo, ngoko ichanekile.
20261121-english-g01-2.example: Khomisa amagama akwisaziso (umbala, inani legumbi, igama lomntu) omnye ngomnye uze uwahambelanise nemigca yomyalezo.
20261121-english-g01-2.actionItem: Thelekisa isaziso sezinto ezilahlekileyo nomyalezo umhlobo awukopishe kuso, umgca ngomgca, ufumane umgca ongalunganga, uze uwubhale kwakhona ngokuchanekileyo.

20261121-english-g02-1.title: 'Two tickets, please.' ikuphi? Ukugweba ukuba ulwazi luyaneliseka na
20261121-english-g02-1.summary:
Uphulaphule into ethethwe yindoda nomthengisi weethikithi. Abazange bathi ikuphi.

Man: Two tickets, please.
Clerk: Here you are. The show starts at 7:00.
20261121-english-g02-1.principle: I-Ticket ne-show ngamagama asetyenziswa kwiindawo ezininzi, ezifana nesinema okanye iholo yekonsathi. Kunzima ukugqiba enye ngemigca emibini kuphela.
20261121-english-g02-1.example: Cinga ngeendawo ezimbini okanye ezintathu apho le migca mibini ingathethwa khona.
20261121-english-g02-1.actionItem: Gweba ukuba ungayigqiba indawo ngemigca emibini eviwe kuphela, uze ukhethe isalathiso esongezelelweyo esahlula iindawo.

20261121-english-g02-2.title: Yeyiphi impendulo ehambelana nokubulisa kukatitshala? Ukucinga ngemida yembeko
20261121-english-g02-2.summary:
Utitshala uthi ekuseni, "How are you today, Mina?"

Umhlobo wakho uJin uthe, "In English, speaking politely is always better. You can just talk that way to everyone."
20261121-english-g02-2.principle: I-b ne-d iphendula ukubulisa yaye ibuza ngokubuyisela kolunye umntu, ngoko ifanelekile kutitshala. I-a ayicwangciswanga kakhulu yaye i-c ivakala ingenambeko.
20261121-english-g02-2.example: Khangela ngokwahlukileyo ukuba impendulo ihambelana nombuzo kwaye ifanelekile kutitshala.
20261121-english-g02-2.actionItem: Khetha impendulo ehambelana nokubulisa kukatitshala, uze uxele imeko apho isibakala esithi 'ukuthobeka kusoloko kungcono' singasebenziyo.

20261121-english-g03-1.title: Fumana ixesha lokufunda kwishedyuli kaMina yoMgqibelo
20261121-english-g03-1.summary:
Ishedyuli kaMina yoMgqibelo (ebhalwe ngombhalo kuphela, ngaphandle komfanekiso):

10 a.m.: I can start my free time.
12 p.m. - 1 p.m.: Lunch
1 p.m. - 2 p.m.: Dance class
5 p.m.: Dinner. I must finish before dinner.

UMina ufuna ukufunda incwadi iyure e-1. Uqala kwiyure epheleleyo aze agqibe kwiyure epheleleyo.
20261121-english-g03-1.principle: Ixesha lokuzonwabisa liqala ngo-10 a.m., kwaye 12 ukuya kwi-14 zizele sisidlo sasemini nomdaniso. Akukho ntshukumo kwishedyuli ukusuka kwi-15 ukuya kwi-16 nokusuka kwi-16 ukuya kwi-17, kwaye ziphela phambi kokutya kwangokuhlwa.
20261121-english-g03-1.example: Tshintsha amaxesha eshedyuli abe manani eeyure ezingama-24 uze uzobe istrip sexesha.
20261121-english-g03-1.actionItem: Yiza namaxesha ahlukeneyo okuqala ukufunda ahlangabezana nayo yonke imiqathango yeshedyuli, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni amanye amaxesha engasebenzi.

20261121-english-g03-2.title: Bonisa 'worry' ngaphandle kokuyithetha
20261121-english-g03-2.summary: Uza kubhala umboniso apho umhlobo wakho uMina ukhathazekile ngexesha lovavanyo. Umbhalo ochaza imvakalelo ngqo nombhalo oyibonisa ngezenzo ufikelela kumfundi ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo.
20261121-english-g03-2.principle: Ukusuka kwizandla ezibandayo nokujonga iwotshi kaninzi, umfundi unokuqikelela ukuxhalaba. Ukuyawa ngoxa ujonge ngefestile kucebisa ukudinwa, nokubhomboloza ngoxa ubhala ngokukhawuleza kucebisa ukuphumla okanye ukuzithemba.
20261121-english-g03-2.example: Kwimibhalo emithathu nganye, khetha ubhale isenzo okanye utshintsho lomzimba luka-Mina.
20261121-english-g03-2.actionItem: Bhala umbhalo omfutshane apho umfundi anokuqikelela imvakalelo ngezenzo nemikhondo yomzimba kuphela, ngaphandle kwegama lemvakalelo.

20261121-english-g04-1.title: Inqaku likaMama nexesha lokudlala likaJisu
20261121-english-g04-1.summary:
Inqaku uMama alishiye etafileni (libhalwe ngamagama kuphela, akukho mfanekiso):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Emva koko umhlobo wakhe uJisu wathumela isicatshulwa. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"
20261121-english-g04-1.principle: Iklasi yepiyano yi-4:00-4:30, ngoko 4:15-4:30 iyagqithisana, kwaye ukukhupha inkunkuma ngo-5:00 kuwela ngaphakathi kwe-4:15-5:15. Ukufika ekhaya ngo-3:30 nesidlo sasebusuku ngo-6:30 zingaphandle kwexesha lepaki.
20261121-english-g04-1.example: Beka umgca ngamnye ecaleni kwexesha lepaki '4:15-5:15' enye ngenye, uze ubone ukuba iphela phambi kwayo okanye iqala emva kwayo.
20261121-english-g04-1.actionItem: Thelekisa izicwangciso ezininzi ezikwinqaku likaMama nexesha elicetyiswe ngumhlobo, fumana apho zingahambelani khona, uze uthi hayi ngesiNgesi ngelixa ucebisa ixesha elahlukileyo.

20261121-english-g04-2.title: Gqiba amaxesha okuhamba inja nomsebenzi wasekhaya
20261121-english-g04-2.summary:
Inqaku uTata alishiyileyo (libhalwe ngamagama kuphela, akukho mfanekiso):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

Ngezantsi, bhala ixesha ngalinye njenge-'imizuzu emingaphi emva kwe-4:00 p.m.'. Umzekelo, ukuba uqala ngo-4:30, bhala u-30, kwaye ukuba uqala ngo-5:15, bhala u-75.
20261121-english-g04-2.principle: Umsebenzi wasekhaya yi-5:00-6:00 kwaye ukuhamba yi-5:30-6:00, ngoko imisebenzi emibini iyagqithisana ukusuka ku-5:30 ukuya ku-6:00. Ukuhamba kuqala emva kwe-5:00 kwaye zombini ziyaphela phambi kwe-6:30, ngoko ezinye iimeko zigcinwe.
20261121-english-g04-2.example: Yongeza ixesha elithathayo (ngemizuzu) kwixesha lokuqala lomsebenzi ngamnye ukufumana ixesha eliphela ngalo.
20261121-english-g04-2.actionItem: Yenza iindibaniselwano ezininzi ezahlukeneyo zexesha lokuhamba nexesha lomsebenzi wasekhaya ezihlangabezana nazo zonke iimeko zenqaku likaDadewethu.

20261121-english-g05-1.title: Ingcinga yakho iyatshintsha njengoko ufunda iposta
20261121-english-g05-1.summary: UJun akalilo ilungu leGreen Library. Umhlobo wakhe uAra lilungu leGreen Library. Aba bobabini baza kufunda iposta ephambi kwenerali umgca omnye ngexesha.
20261121-english-g05-1.principle: Tshintsha isigwebo sakho rhoqo xa ulwazi lweposta luveza inyathelo ngenyathelo, uze wenze umbuzo wesiNgesi okhangela ulwazi olungekho kwiposta.
20261121-english-g05-1.example: Hlola ukuba isivakalisi esitsha ngeli xesha sitshintsha ugwebo lwakho lwangaphambili.
20261121-english-g05-1.actionItem: Tshintsha isigwebo sakho rhoqo xa ulwazi lweposta luveza inyathelo ngenyathelo, uze wenze umbuzo wesiNgesi okhangela ulwazi olungekho kwiposta.

20261121-english-g05-2.title: 'Most popular' - ngaba umbhalo uyayixhasa?
20261121-english-g05-2.summary:
Iklasi kaMina inekona yokufunda enekhabhathi yeencwadi.

Iklasi yethu inekona yokufunda. Kukho iincwadi ezingama-20 kwishelufu. Ezili-12 kuzo ziphathelele izilwanyana. Ezi-4 ziphathelele isithuba, kwaye ezi-4 ziincwadi zamabali. Utitshala akazange athenge zincwadi zintsha kulo nyaka.

UMina uthi, "Animal books are the most popular in our class."
20261121-english-g05-2.principle: Umbhalo ukuxelela kuphela inani leencwadi kwishelufu (iincwadi ezili-12 zezilwanyana, njalo njalo). Awuthi zeziphi iincwadi abafundi abazifunda okanye abazityalela kakhulu, ngoko asinakukhangela isibakala esithi 'most popular'.
20261121-english-g05-2.example: Cinga ukuba u-'popular' uthetha ntoni kumazwi kaMina, uze ufune isivakalisi embhalweni esikuxelela oko.
20261121-english-g05-2.actionItem: Cinga ukuba ulwazi lwamanani embhalweni luyalixhasa na isibakala (ukuthandwa), uze wenze umbuzo wesiNgesi onokukhangela isibakala.

20261121-english-g06-1.title: Ingaba ikilabhu yeencwadi iphumelele? Ukutshintsha isigwebo sakho njengoko ubungqina bukhula
20261121-english-g06-1.summary: Ikilabhu entsha yeencwadi iqalile esikolweni sethu. Utitshala wathi, "The club is a success." Uza kufumana ubungqina inxalenye enye ngexesha uze ucinge ukuba esi sitatimenti sichanekile na.
20261121-english-g06-1.principle: Njengoko idatha yongezwa inxalenye enye ngexesha, tshintsha isigwebo sakho ngebango elithi 'ikilabhu yeencwadi iphumelele', uze ugqibe ngesiNgesi usebenzisa iziqwenga ezimbini zobungqina.
20261121-english-g06-1.example: Hlula oko idatha onayo ngoku iqinisekisa kuko nokungekaziwa.
20261121-english-g06-1.actionItem: Njengoko idatha yongezwa inxalenye enye ngexesha, tshintsha isigwebo sakho ngebango elithi 'ikilabhu yeencwadi iphumelele', uze ugqibe ngesiNgesi usebenzisa iziqwenga ezimbini zobungqina.

20261121-english-g06-2.title: Ukwenza iitheyibhile ukufumana amatyala apho isibhengezo siyinyaniso
20261121-english-g06-2.summary: Abafundi abangama-20 kwiklasi enye nganye bavotela intshukumo emva kwexesha lesnack: ibhola yonyawo, ubugcisa, okanye umculo. Iivoti ziyabizwa ngokuba zi-s (ibhola yonyawo), a (ubugcisa), kunye ne-m (umculo).
20261121-english-g06-2.principle: Iivoti ezi-8 zininzi kuneebugcisa (6) nomculo (6), ngoko zezona zininzi, kwaye zincinci kune-10, isiqingatha sama-20, ngoko asiyisiqingatha. Ngoko a ilungile.
20261121-english-g06-2.example: Dibanisa i-8, 6, kunye ne-6, fumana isiqingatha sabafundi abangama-20, uze uthelekise.
20261121-english-g06-2.actionItem: Yenza iitheyibhile ezininzi zeevoti wena apho isibhengezo sesiNgesi 'it got the most votes, but not half of the class' siyinyaniso.

20261121-english-g07-1.title: UBen uza kuza kwitheko? Ukuphonononga intsingiselo efihliweyo yeempendulo zakhe
20261121-english-g07-1.summary:
Incoko phakathi kukaJisu noBen (ebhalwe ngombhalo kuphela, ngaphandle kwemifanekiso):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.
20261121-english-g07-1.principle: Umdlalo webhola yeenyawo usekuseni yaye itheko lisentsimbi yesi-4 p.m., ngoko amaxesha awadibani. UBen wathi kuphela usenokukhathala, yaye ekugqibeleni wathi uya kuhlola nomama wakhe kuqala. Ngoko kukho into egqityiweyo (ixesha) nento eseleyo (imvume kamama wakhe), yaye akukagqitywa.
20261121-english-g07-1.example: Wahlule amazwi kaBen abe ngamacandelo amane: 'soccer game,' 'party time,' 'tired,' kunye 'nomama.'
20261121-english-g07-1.actionItem: Wahlule iimpendulo zikaBen kwincoko umgca ngomgca, wahlule oko kugqityiweyo kwaloo kusele, uze wenze ugwebo ngaphandle kokuthi 'uya kuza' okanye 'akayi kuza.'

20261121-english-g07-2.title: Ingaba 'That's fine.' ithetha ngenene ukuba kulungile?
20261121-english-g07-2.summary: USam noTata bathetha ngamaCebo eLwesihlanu. Incoko iyatyhilwa kumacandelo amathathu. Ibhalwe ngombhalo kuphela, ngaphandle kwemifanekiso.
20261121-english-g07-2.principle: Ufunda incoko ngaphezulu kancinci ngexesha, yenza ugwebo malunga neemvakalelo zangaphakathi zomthethi, uze ulungise ugwebo lwakho lwangaphambili xa isalathiso esitsha sivela.
20261121-english-g07-2.example: Fumana isandi esitsha o-1 okanye igama elitsha kweli candelo.
20261121-english-g07-2.actionItem: Ufunda incoko ngaphezulu kancinci ngexesha, yenza ugwebo malunga neemvakalelo zangaphakathi zomthethi, uze ulungise ugwebo lwakho lwangaphambili xa isalathiso esitsha sivela.

20261121-english-g08-1.title: Phinda ubhale isibhengezo esithi ukuya kwithala leencwadi rhoqo kunyusa amanqaku
20261121-english-g08-1.summary: Umbhali we-blog ufuna ukubhala oku: 'Library visits make students' scores go up.' Masijonge esi sivakalisi ngokuchasene nedatha.
20261121-english-g08-1.principle: Ngalo lonke ixesha idatha entsha ivezwa, gqiba kwakhona ukuba ungaqiniseka kangakanani ngesibhengezo, uze uphinde ubhale isivakalisi sokugqibela.
20261121-english-g08-1.example: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, jonga ukuba ulwazi olutsha luxhasa isigwebo sangaphambili okanye luyasishukumisa.
20261121-english-g08-1.actionItem: Ngalo lonke ixesha idatha entsha ivezwa, gqiba kwakhona ukuba ungaqiniseka kangakanani ngesibhengezo, uze uphinde ubhale isivakalisi sokugqibela.

20261121-english-g08-2.title: Lungisa umgca onenani elingalunganga kwibhlog yokucoca unxweme
20261121-english-g08-2.summary: Umfundi weklasi enye wabhala le post kwibhlog yesikolo. (Ngumbhalo kuphela. Umgca ngamnye unenani.)
20261121-english-g08-2.principle: Umgca 3 uthi baqokelele iingxowa ezingama-30 kwiyure yokuqala, kwaye umgca 4 uthi isixa yayiziingxowa ezili-18. Isixa asinakuba sincinci kunoko kuqokelelwe kwiyure yokuqala. Le post yodwa ayinakukuxelela ukuba ngumgca 3 okanye 4 ongalunganga, ngoko unokukhetha nawuphi.
20261121-english-g08-2.example: Qokelela kuphela imigca enamanani uze uyithelekise.
20261121-english-g08-2.actionItem: Fumana izivakalisi ezimbini zamanani kwibhlog ezingahambelaniyo, uze uzibhale kwakhona ukuze zihambelane nolwazi oluqinisekisiweyo.

20261121-english-g09-1.title: Ukucinga okufihlakeleyo kwi-'we sold 200 fewer lunches'
20261121-english-g09-1.summary:
Oku kubekwe ebhodini yezaziso phambi kwekhefi yesikolo.

"This month, the cafeteria sold 200 fewer lunches than last month. So students did not like the new menu."
20261121-english-g09-1.principle: Ukusuka kwinyani yokuba ukuthengisa kuhle, ukuya ku-'it didn't suit their taste', ezinye iimeko (inani labafundi, inani leentsuku zesikolo, njalo njalo) kufuneka zifane. Ukuba bebembalwa abafundi okanye iintsuku zesikolo, ukuthengisa bekuya kuhla nokuba incasa ifana.
20261121-english-g09-1.example: Qala ubhale ngolwimi lwakho ukuba yintoni enokuba sisizathu se-"fewer lunches were sold."
20261121-english-g09-1.actionItem: Fumana ukucinga okungathethwanga okufunekayo ukuze isibakala sibe sinyani, ubhale ngesiNgesi enye inkcazelo eshukumisa loo nto ikucingayo.

20261121-english-g09-2.title: Tshintsha ukhetho lwerestyuranti njengoko uphononongo olungakumbi lufika oluthile ngexesha
20261121-english-g09-2.summary: Usapho luyakhetha irestyuranti yesidlo sasemini phambi kwemuvi (iqala ngentsimbi yesi-3:00 p.m.). Ixesha lesidlo sasemini liyure e-1 eqala ngo-12:30. Ulwazi loluvo lutyhilwa ngecandelo e-1 ngexesha.
20261121-english-g09-2.principle: Funda uphononongo lwerestyuranti inyathelo ngenyathelo, lungisa ugwebo lwakho, uze ubhale ngesiNgesi imiqathango yenkcazo onokuyithemba.
20261121-english-g09-2.example: Fumana igama elinye okanye inani elinye oliqaphela okokuqala kweli candelo.
20261121-english-g09-2.actionItem: Funda uphononongo lwerestyuranti inyathelo ngenyathelo, lungisa ugwebo lwakho, uze ubhale ngesiNgesi imiqathango yenkcazo onokuyithemba.

20261121-english-g10-1.title: Sibhala njani izaziso ezimbini eziphikisanayo kwiphephandaba lesikolo?
20261121-english-g10-1.summary:
Ukwiqela lokubhala ephepheni lesiNgesi lesikolo. Izaziso ezimbini ngetheko ziyahluka.

School notice: "Festival: Friday, 4 p.m., in the gym. Free for all students."
Student council poster: "Festival: Friday, 5 p.m., in the gym. Tickets: 1,000 won."

Awukaqinisekisi ukuba leliphi elichanekileyo.
20261121-english-g10-1.principle: Ukuba ayiqinisekisiwe, into elungileyo kukuxela oko umthombo ngamnye kwezi mbini uthi, uze uxelele abafundi ukuba isahlolwa. Ukukhetha icala elinye ukuliqinisekisa, okanye ukuxelela abantu ukuba bangezi ngaphandle kwalo lwazi, kuxuba abafundi.
20261121-english-g10-1.example: Thelekisa ukuba sesiphi ulwazi ngasinye isaziso esinika abafundi nesesiphi esifihlayo.
20261121-english-g10-1.actionItem: Bhalela abafundi (abafundi) into ethetha izaziso ezimbini ezahlukeneyo ngokufanelekileyo, ichaza oko okungaqinisekiswanga nento abafundi abamele bayenze.

20261121-english-g10-2.title: Ingaba umzekelo o-1 unokwenza ukuba kuthiwe 'ngalo lonke ixesha'?
20261121-english-g10-2.summary:
Esi licandelo lesicatshulwa esapapashwa kwiphephandaba lesikolo (amanani emigca aqala ku-1).
1) Our school should ban phones from the building.
2) Last month, Mina got a new phone, and her math score dropped from 90 to 75.
3) So phones clearly make all students' grades worse.
4) Also, phones are noisy in the hallway, and some students look up answers during tests.
5) Therefore, the school should ban them for everyone.
20261121-english-g10-2.principle: Umgca o-3 yingxaki. Ukuthi amanqaku "ngokuqinisekileyo" aya kuba mabi ku"bonke abafundi" ngokusekelwe kukwehla kwamanqaku komfundi o-1 kuphela (umgca o-2) sisigqibo esikhulu kunobungqina. Ukwehla kwamanqaku kunokuba nezinye izizathu, ezinje ngobunzima bovavanyo okanye imeko. Umgca o-4 unika uhlobo oluhlukileyo lwesizathu kumanqaku (ingxolo, ukukopa), ngoko kufuneka uqwalaselwe ngokwahlukeneyo kule ngxaki. U"anqatshelwe wonke umntu" womgca o-5 naso sisekele kwesi sigqibo, kodwa indawo apho ingxaki iqala khona umgca o-3.
20261121-english-g10-2.actionItem: Kwisicatshulwa esiphikisanayo, fumana umgca apho ubungqina bungaxhasi ibango ngokwaneleyo, usibhale kwakhona njengesivakalisi esinocoselelo ngakumbi, uze ugqibe ukuba ngowuphi ubungqina obongezelelweyo obufunekayo.

20261121-english-g11-1.title: Umyalelo womsebenzi ongacacanga: yintoni ekufuneka uyibuze kuqala?
20261121-english-g11-1.summary:
Le yi-imeyile eyafunyanwa ngu-Jiho ongumqeqeshwa evela kumxhasi weqela u-Ms. Han.

Hi Jiho,
Please send the sales summary to the client before the meeting.
Thanks,
Ms. Han

Iinyaniso ezaziwa ngu-Jiho: Ikhalenda yeqela ibonisa intlanganiso ne-Aurora Co. ngoLwesibini ngentsimbi ye-10:00 nentlanganiso ne-Blue Pine Ltd. ngoLwesine ngentsimbi ye-14:00. Ifolda eyabelanayo inamafayile ahlukeneyo esishwankathelo sentengiso kaJulayi, Agasti kunye noSeptemba.
20261121-english-g11-1.principle: Ukuba umxhasi nexesha azimiselwanga, usenokuthumela ifayile engalunganga kumxhasi ongalunganga. Kwifomathi, ungamisela into engagqibekanga njenge-PDF umazise, kwaye ukuba u-Ms. Han usemsebenzini akunanto yokwenza nomsebenzi ngokwawo.
20261121-english-g11-1.example: Jonga ukuba 'kubani,' 'ntoni,' kunye 'nesiphelo' nganye iyaphuma njengento enye kanye kwi-imeyile.
20261121-english-g11-1.actionItem: Kwi-imeyile yomsebenzi engacacanga, khetha ulwazi olufuneka luqinisekiswe phambi kokuba wenze, uze ubhale i-imeyile yemibuzo elula ukuyiphendula.

20261121-english-g11-2.title: Ingaba kungenxa yeklabhu yokufunda? Ngowuphi ulwazi onokusenza sazi?
20261121-english-g11-2.summary:
Le yinxalenye yengxelo yebhunga labafundi.

"Students who joined the school reading club had higher English test scores than students who did not (average 82 vs 74). So the reading club raises English scores."

Umfundi uMina ufuna ukujonga ukuba esi siphelo silunge na. Abafundi bangena kwiklabhu ngokufaka isicelo ukuba bayafuna.
20261121-english-g11-2.principle: Ukuba uyawazi amanqaku angaphambi kokujoyina, unokuthelekisa ukuba amanqaku amalungu ayesele ephezulu okanye anyuke emva kokujoyina. Ngenxa yokuba abafundi bangena ngokufaka isicelo, abafundi abaninzi abasele bemhle kwisiNgesi basenokuba bangenile.
20261121-english-g11-2.example: Cinga ukuba inyani yokuba abafundi bangena 'ngokufaka isicelo ukuba bayafuna' ingachaphazela njani indawo yokuqala yamaqela amabini.
20261121-english-g11-2.actionItem: Khetha ukuba ngowuphi ulwazi olufunekayo ukuxela ukuba umahluko wamanqaku phakathi kwamalungu eklabhu nabangengawo yimpembelelo yeklabhu, uze ubhale ngesiNgesi umbuzo wokufumana olo lwazi.

20261121-english-g12-1.title: Abafundi abatya isidlo sakusasa banamabanga aphezulu: yintoni enye esiyidingayo ukuyazi?
20261121-english-g12-1.summary:
Libango elisuka kwinqaku lesikolo. "Students who eat breakfast get higher test scores, so the school should provide free breakfast." Njengobungqina, iziphumo zophando lwabafundi abangama-200 zazibonisiwe ngolu hlobo.

Group | Number of students | Average score
Students who eat breakfast | 130 | 82
Students who skip breakfast | 70 | 74
20261121-english-g12-1.principle: b ihlola ezinye izizathu (ubuthongo, ixesha lokufunda), c ihlola isiphumo sophindlo lwangempela, kwaye e ihlola ukulunga kothelekiso. a no-d asingobungqina bokuba izidlo zikhulisa amanqaku.
20261121-english-g12-1.example: Hlola ukuba ulwazi ngalunye lunceda ukuphendula umbuzo, 'Ingaba unxibelelwano phakathi kwesidlo sakusasa namanqaku sisizathu?'
20261121-english-g12-1.actionItem: Gweba ukuba isiphumo sophando sisixelela ngo-"sizathu", khetha ulwazi olongezelelweyo oluyimfuneko kuloo mgwebo, uze ucebise ngesiNgesi indlela yokuthelekisa yokuhlola impembelelo yokutya mahala.

20261121-english-g12-2.title: Into efanayo, izihloko ezahlukeneyo: ukugweba kuyatshintsha njengoko ulwazi lukhula
20261121-english-g12-2.summary: Inqaku ngekhansile yesixeko eqinisekisa ukunyusa iimali zokupaka kufuphi nesikhululo likhutshwa ngamanqanaba. Bukela ukuba ukugweba kwakho kuyatshintsha na ngalo lonke ixesha ulwazi lukhula.
20261121-english-g12-2.principle: Njengoko ulwazi lukhula, hlaziya ukugweba kwakho ukuba ithoni neziqendu ezishiyiweyo zesihloko ziyithambekisa njani kwelinye icala xa kuthelekiswa neenyani, uze ucacise into enye ngesiNgesi.
20261121-english-g12-2.example: Wahlule amagama asesihlokweni anika iinyani kwawo anika imvakalelo.
20261121-english-g12-2.actionItem: Njengoko ulwazi lukhula, hlaziya ukugweba kwakho ukuba ithoni neziqendu ezishiyiweyo zesihloko ziyithambekisa njani kwelinye icala xa kuthelekiswa neenyani, uze ucacise into enye ngesiNgesi.

20261122-english-g01-1.title: Fumana izenzo ezingahambelani nesaziso sechibi
20261122-english-g01-1.summary:
Isaziso emnyango wechibi (sibhalwe ngamagama kuphela, akukho mfanekiso):

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = an adult)

Abantu abane baya echibini.
UMina uneminyaka eyi-7. Uza noMama wakhe, kwaye unekepusi.
UJun uneminyaka eyi-10. Uza yedwa, kwaye akanayo ikepusi.
UTom uneminyaka eyi-6. Uza nomntakwabo. Umntakwabo uneminyaka eyi-9. UTom unekepusi.
USue uneminyaka eyi-11. Ukhwela ngeenyawo esiya echibini yedwa, kwaye unekepusi.
20261122-english-g01-1.principle: UJun akanayo ikepusi, ngoko uphula umthetho 2. UTom uphantsi kwe-8, kodwa umntakwabo oze naye uneminyaka eyi-9, ngoko akangomntu 'omdala', kwaye uTom uphula umthetho 3. UMina weza noMama wakhe, kwaye uSue uneminyaka eyi-11, ngoko kulungile ukuba ahambe aze yedwa.
20261122-english-g01-1.example: Yenza itheyibhile enobudala bomntu ngamnye, ngubani amphelekileyo, nekepusi, omnye ngomnye.
20261122-english-g01-1.actionItem: Hambelanisa imithetho emithathu esesazisweni nemeko yomntu ngamnye, ukhethe iimeko ezophula imithetho, uze uthi isizathu ngesiNgesi.

20261122-english-g01-2.title: Lungisa umgca ongalunganga kwisaziso sezinto ezilahlekileyo esikhutshiweyo
20261122-english-g01-2.summary:
Isaziso kwibhodi yeendaba yesikolo (sibhalwe ngamagama kuphela):

Lost and Found
Found: a blue water bottle, near Room 3.
Ask Ms. Park in Room 1 after school.

Umhlobo wakho uJia wabona esi saziso kuba ebekhangela ibhotile yakhe yamanzi, wathumela umyalezo kuHana. UHana ufuna ukuyithelekisa nesaziso.
20261122-english-g01-2.principle: Umgca 4 awuchanekanga. Kwisaziso, uMs. Park useGumbini 1, kodwa umyalezo uthi Igumbi 3, ngoko akuchanekanga. I-blue kumgca 2 ifana nesaziso, kwaye iRoom 3 kumgca 3 yindawo ibhotile eyafunyanwa kuyo, ngoko ichanekile.
20261122-english-g01-2.example: Khomisa amagama akwisaziso (umbala, inani legumbi, igama lomntu) omnye ngomnye uze uwahambelanise nemigca yomyalezo.
20261122-english-g01-2.actionItem: Thelekisa isaziso sezinto ezilahlekileyo nomyalezo umhlobo awukopishe kuso, umgca ngomgca, ufumane umgca ongalunganga, uze uwubhale kwakhona ngokuchanekileyo.

20261122-english-g02-1.title: 'Two tickets, please.' ikuphi? Ukugweba ukuba ulwazi luyaneliseka na
20261122-english-g02-1.summary:
Uphulaphule into ethethwe yindoda nomthengisi weethikithi. Abazange bathi ikuphi.

Man: Two tickets, please.
Clerk: Here you are. The show starts at 7:00.
20261122-english-g02-1.principle: I-Ticket ne-show ngamagama asetyenziswa kwiindawo ezininzi, ezifana nesinema okanye iholo yekonsathi. Kunzima ukugqiba enye ngemigca emibini kuphela.
20261122-english-g02-1.example: Cinga ngeendawo ezimbini okanye ezintathu apho le migca mibini ingathethwa khona.
20261122-english-g02-1.actionItem: Gweba ukuba ungayigqiba indawo ngemigca emibini eviwe kuphela, uze ukhethe isalathiso esongezelelweyo esahlula iindawo.

20261122-english-g02-2.title: Yeyiphi impendulo ehambelana nokubulisa kukatitshala? Ukucinga ngemida yembeko
20261122-english-g02-2.summary:
Utitshala uthi ekuseni, "How are you today, Mina?"

Umhlobo wakho uJin uthe, "In English, speaking politely is always better. You can just talk that way to everyone."
20261122-english-g02-2.principle: I-b ne-d iphendula ukubulisa yaye ibuza ngokubuyisela kolunye umntu, ngoko ifanelekile kutitshala. I-a ayicwangciswanga kakhulu yaye i-c ivakala ingenambeko.
20261122-english-g02-2.example: Khangela ngokwahlukileyo ukuba impendulo ihambelana nombuzo kwaye ifanelekile kutitshala.
20261122-english-g02-2.actionItem: Khetha impendulo ehambelana nokubulisa kukatitshala, uze uxele imeko apho isibakala esithi 'ukuthobeka kusoloko kungcono' singasebenziyo.

20261122-english-g03-1.title: Fumana ixesha lokufunda kwishedyuli kaMina yoMgqibelo
20261122-english-g03-1.summary:
Ishedyuli kaMina yoMgqibelo (ebhalwe ngombhalo kuphela, ngaphandle komfanekiso):

10 a.m.: I can start my free time.
12 p.m. - 1 p.m.: Lunch
1 p.m. - 2 p.m.: Dance class
5 p.m.: Dinner. I must finish before dinner.

UMina ufuna ukufunda incwadi iyure e-1. Uqala kwiyure epheleleyo aze agqibe kwiyure epheleleyo.
20261122-english-g03-1.principle: Ixesha lokuzonwabisa liqala ngo-10 a.m., kwaye 12 ukuya kwi-14 zizele sisidlo sasemini nomdaniso. Akukho ntshukumo kwishedyuli ukusuka kwi-15 ukuya kwi-16 nokusuka kwi-16 ukuya kwi-17, kwaye ziphela phambi kokutya kwangokuhlwa.
20261122-english-g03-1.example: Tshintsha amaxesha eshedyuli abe manani eeyure ezingama-24 uze uzobe istrip sexesha.
20261122-english-g03-1.actionItem: Yiza namaxesha ahlukeneyo okuqala ukufunda ahlangabezana nayo yonke imiqathango yeshedyuli, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni amanye amaxesha engasebenzi.

20261122-english-g03-2.title: Bonisa 'worry' ngaphandle kokuyithetha
20261122-english-g03-2.summary: Uza kubhala umboniso apho umhlobo wakho uMina ukhathazekile ngexesha lovavanyo. Umbhalo ochaza imvakalelo ngqo nombhalo oyibonisa ngezenzo ufikelela kumfundi ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo.
20261122-english-g03-2.principle: Ukusuka kwizandla ezibandayo nokujonga iwotshi kaninzi, umfundi unokuqikelela ukuxhalaba. Ukuyawa ngoxa ujonge ngefestile kucebisa ukudinwa, nokubhomboloza ngoxa ubhala ngokukhawuleza kucebisa ukuphumla okanye ukuzithemba.
20261122-english-g03-2.example: Kwimibhalo emithathu nganye, khetha ubhale isenzo okanye utshintsho lomzimba luka-Mina.
20261122-english-g03-2.actionItem: Bhala umbhalo omfutshane apho umfundi anokuqikelela imvakalelo ngezenzo nemikhondo yomzimba kuphela, ngaphandle kwegama lemvakalelo.

20261122-english-g04-1.title: Inqaku likaMama nexesha lokudlala likaJisu
20261122-english-g04-1.summary:
Inqaku uMama alishiye etafileni (libhalwe ngamagama kuphela, akukho mfanekiso):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Emva koko umhlobo wakhe uJisu wathumela isicatshulwa. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"
20261122-english-g04-1.principle: Iklasi yepiyano yi-4:00-4:30, ngoko 4:15-4:30 iyagqithisana, kwaye ukukhupha inkunkuma ngo-5:00 kuwela ngaphakathi kwe-4:15-5:15. Ukufika ekhaya ngo-3:30 nesidlo sasebusuku ngo-6:30 zingaphandle kwexesha lepaki.
20261122-english-g04-1.example: Beka umgca ngamnye ecaleni kwexesha lepaki '4:15-5:15' enye ngenye, uze ubone ukuba iphela phambi kwayo okanye iqala emva kwayo.
20261122-english-g04-1.actionItem: Thelekisa izicwangciso ezininzi ezikwinqaku likaMama nexesha elicetyiswe ngumhlobo, fumana apho zingahambelani khona, uze uthi hayi ngesiNgesi ngelixa ucebisa ixesha elahlukileyo.

20261122-english-g04-2.title: Gqiba amaxesha okuhamba inja nomsebenzi wasekhaya
20261122-english-g04-2.summary:
Inqaku uTata alishiyileyo (libhalwe ngamagama kuphela, akukho mfanekiso):

Mina,
You come home at 4:00 p.m. I come home at 6:30 p.m.
- Walk the dog for 30 minutes. Not before 5:00 p.m. It is too hot.
- Do your homework for 60 minutes.
- Finish both before I come home.
- Do not do both at the same time.

Ngezantsi, bhala ixesha ngalinye njenge-'imizuzu emingaphi emva kwe-4:00 p.m.'. Umzekelo, ukuba uqala ngo-4:30, bhala u-30, kwaye ukuba uqala ngo-5:15, bhala u-75.
20261122-english-g04-2.principle: Umsebenzi wasekhaya yi-5:00-6:00 kwaye ukuhamba yi-5:30-6:00, ngoko imisebenzi emibini iyagqithisana ukusuka ku-5:30 ukuya ku-6:00. Ukuhamba kuqala emva kwe-5:00 kwaye zombini ziyaphela phambi kwe-6:30, ngoko ezinye iimeko zigcinwe.
20261122-english-g04-2.example: Yongeza ixesha elithathayo (ngemizuzu) kwixesha lokuqala lomsebenzi ngamnye ukufumana ixesha eliphela ngalo.
20261122-english-g04-2.actionItem: Yenza iindibaniselwano ezininzi ezahlukeneyo zexesha lokuhamba nexesha lomsebenzi wasekhaya ezihlangabezana nazo zonke iimeko zenqaku likaDadewethu.

20261122-english-g05-1.title: Ingcinga yakho iyatshintsha njengoko ufunda iposta
20261122-english-g05-1.summary: UJun akalilo ilungu leGreen Library. Umhlobo wakhe uAra lilungu leGreen Library. Aba bobabini baza kufunda iposta ephambi kwenerali umgca omnye ngexesha.
20261122-english-g05-1.principle: Tshintsha isigwebo sakho rhoqo xa ulwazi lweposta luveza inyathelo ngenyathelo, uze wenze umbuzo wesiNgesi okhangela ulwazi olungekho kwiposta.
20261122-english-g05-1.example: Hlola ukuba isivakalisi esitsha ngeli xesha sitshintsha ugwebo lwakho lwangaphambili.
20261122-english-g05-1.actionItem: Tshintsha isigwebo sakho rhoqo xa ulwazi lweposta luveza inyathelo ngenyathelo, uze wenze umbuzo wesiNgesi okhangela ulwazi olungekho kwiposta.

20261122-english-g05-2.title: 'Most popular' - ngaba umbhalo uyayixhasa?
20261122-english-g05-2.summary:
Iklasi kaMina inekona yokufunda enekhabhathi yeencwadi.

Iklasi yethu inekona yokufunda. Kukho iincwadi ezingama-20 kwishelufu. Ezili-12 kuzo ziphathelele izilwanyana. Ezi-4 ziphathelele isithuba, kwaye ezi-4 ziincwadi zamabali. Utitshala akazange athenge zincwadi zintsha kulo nyaka.

UMina uthi, "Animal books are the most popular in our class."
20261122-english-g05-2.principle: Umbhalo ukuxelela kuphela inani leencwadi kwishelufu (iincwadi ezili-12 zezilwanyana, njalo njalo). Awuthi zeziphi iincwadi abafundi abazifunda okanye abazityalela kakhulu, ngoko asinakukhangela isibakala esithi 'most popular'.
20261122-english-g05-2.example: Cinga ukuba u-'popular' uthetha ntoni kumazwi kaMina, uze ufune isivakalisi embhalweni esikuxelela oko.
20261122-english-g05-2.actionItem: Cinga ukuba ulwazi lwamanani embhalweni luyalixhasa na isibakala (ukuthandwa), uze wenze umbuzo wesiNgesi onokukhangela isibakala.

20261122-english-g06-1.title: Ingaba ikilabhu yeencwadi iphumelele? Ukutshintsha isigwebo sakho njengoko ubungqina bukhula
20261122-english-g06-1.summary: Ikilabhu entsha yeencwadi iqalile esikolweni sethu. Utitshala wathi, "The club is a success." Uza kufumana ubungqina inxalenye enye ngexesha uze ucinge ukuba esi sitatimenti sichanekile na.
20261122-english-g06-1.principle: Njengoko idatha yongezwa inxalenye enye ngexesha, tshintsha isigwebo sakho ngebango elithi 'ikilabhu yeencwadi iphumelele', uze ugqibe ngesiNgesi usebenzisa iziqwenga ezimbini zobungqina.
20261122-english-g06-1.example: Hlula oko idatha onayo ngoku iqinisekisa kuko nokungekaziwa.
20261122-english-g06-1.actionItem: Njengoko idatha yongezwa inxalenye enye ngexesha, tshintsha isigwebo sakho ngebango elithi 'ikilabhu yeencwadi iphumelele', uze ugqibe ngesiNgesi usebenzisa iziqwenga ezimbini zobungqina.

20261122-english-g06-2.title: Ukwenza iitheyibhile ukufumana amatyala apho isibhengezo siyinyaniso
20261122-english-g06-2.summary: Abafundi abangama-20 kwiklasi enye nganye bavotela intshukumo emva kwexesha lesnack: ibhola yonyawo, ubugcisa, okanye umculo. Iivoti ziyabizwa ngokuba zi-s (ibhola yonyawo), a (ubugcisa), kunye ne-m (umculo).
20261122-english-g06-2.principle: Iivoti ezi-8 zininzi kuneebugcisa (6) nomculo (6), ngoko zezona zininzi, kwaye zincinci kune-10, isiqingatha sama-20, ngoko asiyisiqingatha. Ngoko a ilungile.
20261122-english-g06-2.example: Dibanisa i-8, 6, kunye ne-6, fumana isiqingatha sabafundi abangama-20, uze uthelekise.
20261122-english-g06-2.actionItem: Yenza iitheyibhile ezininzi zeevoti wena apho isibhengezo sesiNgesi 'it got the most votes, but not half of the class' siyinyaniso.

20261122-english-g07-1.title: UBen uza kuza kwitheko? Ukuphonononga intsingiselo efihliweyo yeempendulo zakhe
20261122-english-g07-1.summary:
Incoko phakathi kukaJisu noBen (ebhalwe ngombhalo kuphela, ngaphandle kwemifanekiso):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.
20261122-english-g07-1.principle: Umdlalo webhola yeenyawo usekuseni yaye itheko lisentsimbi yesi-4 p.m., ngoko amaxesha awadibani. UBen wathi kuphela usenokukhathala, yaye ekugqibeleni wathi uya kuhlola nomama wakhe kuqala. Ngoko kukho into egqityiweyo (ixesha) nento eseleyo (imvume kamama wakhe), yaye akukagqitywa.
20261122-english-g07-1.example: Wahlule amazwi kaBen abe ngamacandelo amane: 'soccer game,' 'party time,' 'tired,' kunye 'nomama.'
20261122-english-g07-1.actionItem: Wahlule iimpendulo zikaBen kwincoko umgca ngomgca, wahlule oko kugqityiweyo kwaloo kusele, uze wenze ugwebo ngaphandle kokuthi 'uya kuza' okanye 'akayi kuza.'

20261122-english-g07-2.title: Ingaba 'That's fine.' ithetha ngenene ukuba kulungile?
20261122-english-g07-2.summary: USam noTata bathetha ngamaCebo eLwesihlanu. Incoko iyatyhilwa kumacandelo amathathu. Ibhalwe ngombhalo kuphela, ngaphandle kwemifanekiso.
20261122-english-g07-2.principle: Ufunda incoko ngaphezulu kancinci ngexesha, yenza ugwebo malunga neemvakalelo zangaphakathi zomthethi, uze ulungise ugwebo lwakho lwangaphambili xa isalathiso esitsha sivela.
20261122-english-g07-2.example: Fumana isandi esitsha o-1 okanye igama elitsha kweli candelo.
20261122-english-g07-2.actionItem: Ufunda incoko ngaphezulu kancinci ngexesha, yenza ugwebo malunga neemvakalelo zangaphakathi zomthethi, uze ulungise ugwebo lwakho lwangaphambili xa isalathiso esitsha sivela.

20261122-english-g08-1.title: Phinda ubhale isibhengezo esithi ukuya kwithala leencwadi rhoqo kunyusa amanqaku
20261122-english-g08-1.summary: Umbhali we-blog ufuna ukubhala oku: 'Library visits make students' scores go up.' Masijonge esi sivakalisi ngokuchasene nedatha.
20261122-english-g08-1.principle: Ngalo lonke ixesha idatha entsha ivezwa, gqiba kwakhona ukuba ungaqiniseka kangakanani ngesibhengezo, uze uphinde ubhale isivakalisi sokugqibela.
20261122-english-g08-1.example: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, jonga ukuba ulwazi olutsha luxhasa isigwebo sangaphambili okanye luyasishukumisa.
20261122-english-g08-1.actionItem: Ngalo lonke ixesha idatha entsha ivezwa, gqiba kwakhona ukuba ungaqiniseka kangakanani ngesibhengezo, uze uphinde ubhale isivakalisi sokugqibela.

20261122-english-g08-2.title: Lungisa umgca onenani elingalunganga kwibhlog yokucoca unxweme
20261122-english-g08-2.summary: Umfundi weklasi enye wabhala le post kwibhlog yesikolo. (Ngumbhalo kuphela. Umgca ngamnye unenani.)
20261122-english-g08-2.principle: Umgca 3 uthi baqokelele iingxowa ezingama-30 kwiyure yokuqala, kwaye umgca 4 uthi isixa yayiziingxowa ezili-18. Isixa asinakuba sincinci kunoko kuqokelelwe kwiyure yokuqala. Le post yodwa ayinakukuxelela ukuba ngumgca 3 okanye 4 ongalunganga, ngoko unokukhetha nawuphi.
20261122-english-g08-2.example: Qokelela kuphela imigca enamanani uze uyithelekise.
20261122-english-g08-2.actionItem: Fumana izivakalisi ezimbini zamanani kwibhlog ezingahambelaniyo, uze uzibhale kwakhona ukuze zihambelane nolwazi oluqinisekisiweyo.

20261122-english-g09-1.title: Ukucinga okufihlakeleyo kwi-'we sold 200 fewer lunches'
20261122-english-g09-1.summary:
Oku kubekwe ebhodini yezaziso phambi kwekhefi yesikolo.

"This month, the cafeteria sold 200 fewer lunches than last month. So students did not like the new menu."
20261122-english-g09-1.principle: Ukusuka kwinyani yokuba ukuthengisa kuhle, ukuya ku-'it didn't suit their taste', ezinye iimeko (inani labafundi, inani leentsuku zesikolo, njalo njalo) kufuneka zifane. Ukuba bebembalwa abafundi okanye iintsuku zesikolo, ukuthengisa bekuya kuhla nokuba incasa ifana.
20261122-english-g09-1.example: Qala ubhale ngolwimi lwakho ukuba yintoni enokuba sisizathu se-"fewer lunches were sold."
20261122-english-g09-1.actionItem: Fumana ukucinga okungathethwanga okufunekayo ukuze isibakala sibe sinyani, ubhale ngesiNgesi enye inkcazelo eshukumisa loo nto ikucingayo.

20261122-english-g09-2.title: Tshintsha ukhetho lwerestyuranti njengoko uphononongo olungakumbi lufika oluthile ngexesha
20261122-english-g09-2.summary: Usapho luyakhetha irestyuranti yesidlo sasemini phambi kwemuvi (iqala ngentsimbi yesi-3:00 p.m.). Ixesha lesidlo sasemini liyure e-1 eqala ngo-12:30. Ulwazi loluvo lutyhilwa ngecandelo e-1 ngexesha.
20261122-english-g09-2.principle: Funda uphononongo lwerestyuranti inyathelo ngenyathelo, lungisa ugwebo lwakho, uze ubhale ngesiNgesi imiqathango yenkcazo onokuyithemba.
20261122-english-g09-2.example: Fumana igama elinye okanye inani elinye oliqaphela okokuqala kweli candelo.
20261122-english-g09-2.actionItem: Funda uphononongo lwerestyuranti inyathelo ngenyathelo, lungisa ugwebo lwakho, uze ubhale ngesiNgesi imiqathango yenkcazo onokuyithemba.

20261122-english-g10-1.title: Sibhala njani izaziso ezimbini eziphikisanayo kwiphephandaba lesikolo?
20261122-english-g10-1.summary:
Ukwiqela lokubhala ephepheni lesiNgesi lesikolo. Izaziso ezimbini ngetheko ziyahluka.

School notice: "Festival: Friday, 4 p.m., in the gym. Free for all students."
Student council poster: "Festival: Friday, 5 p.m., in the gym. Tickets: 1,000 won."

Awukaqinisekisi ukuba leliphi elichanekileyo.
20261122-english-g10-1.principle: Ukuba ayiqinisekisiwe, into elungileyo kukuxela oko umthombo ngamnye kwezi mbini uthi, uze uxelele abafundi ukuba isahlolwa. Ukukhetha icala elinye ukuliqinisekisa, okanye ukuxelela abantu ukuba bangezi ngaphandle kwalo lwazi, kuxuba abafundi.
20261122-english-g10-1.example: Thelekisa ukuba sesiphi ulwazi ngasinye isaziso esinika abafundi nesesiphi esifihlayo.
20261122-english-g10-1.actionItem: Bhalela abafundi (abafundi) into ethetha izaziso ezimbini ezahlukeneyo ngokufanelekileyo, ichaza oko okungaqinisekiswanga nento abafundi abamele bayenze.

20261122-english-g10-2.title: Ingaba umzekelo o-1 unokwenza ukuba kuthiwe 'ngalo lonke ixesha'?
20261122-english-g10-2.summary:
Esi licandelo lesicatshulwa esapapashwa kwiphephandaba lesikolo (amanani emigca aqala ku-1).
1) Our school should ban phones from the building.
2) Last month, Mina got a new phone, and her math score dropped from 90 to 75.
3) So phones clearly make all students' grades worse.
4) Also, phones are noisy in the hallway, and some students look up answers during tests.
5) Therefore, the school should ban them for everyone.
20261122-english-g10-2.principle: Umgca o-3 yingxaki. Ukuthi amanqaku "ngokuqinisekileyo" aya kuba mabi ku"bonke abafundi" ngokusekelwe kukwehla kwamanqaku komfundi o-1 kuphela (umgca o-2) sisigqibo esikhulu kunobungqina. Ukwehla kwamanqaku kunokuba nezinye izizathu, ezinje ngobunzima bovavanyo okanye imeko. Umgca o-4 unika uhlobo oluhlukileyo lwesizathu kumanqaku (ingxolo, ukukopa), ngoko kufuneka uqwalaselwe ngokwahlukeneyo kule ngxaki. U"anqatshelwe wonke umntu" womgca o-5 naso sisekele kwesi sigqibo, kodwa indawo apho ingxaki iqala khona umgca o-3.
20261122-english-g10-2.actionItem: Kwisicatshulwa esiphikisanayo, fumana umgca apho ubungqina bungaxhasi ibango ngokwaneleyo, usibhale kwakhona njengesivakalisi esinocoselelo ngakumbi, uze ugqibe ukuba ngowuphi ubungqina obongezelelweyo obufunekayo.

20261122-english-g11-1.title: Umyalelo womsebenzi ongacacanga: yintoni ekufuneka uyibuze kuqala?
20261122-english-g11-1.summary:
Le yi-imeyile eyafunyanwa ngu-Jiho ongumqeqeshwa evela kumxhasi weqela u-Ms. Han.

Hi Jiho,
Please send the sales summary to the client before the meeting.
Thanks,
Ms. Han

Iinyaniso ezaziwa ngu-Jiho: Ikhalenda yeqela ibonisa intlanganiso ne-Aurora Co. ngoLwesibini ngentsimbi ye-10:00 nentlanganiso ne-Blue Pine Ltd. ngoLwesine ngentsimbi ye-14:00. Ifolda eyabelanayo inamafayile ahlukeneyo esishwankathelo sentengiso kaJulayi, Agasti kunye noSeptemba.
20261122-english-g11-1.principle: Ukuba umxhasi nexesha azimiselwanga, usenokuthumela ifayile engalunganga kumxhasi ongalunganga. Kwifomathi, ungamisela into engagqibekanga njenge-PDF umazise, kwaye ukuba u-Ms. Han usemsebenzini akunanto yokwenza nomsebenzi ngokwawo.
20261122-english-g11-1.example: Jonga ukuba 'kubani,' 'ntoni,' kunye 'nesiphelo' nganye iyaphuma njengento enye kanye kwi-imeyile.
20261122-english-g11-1.actionItem: Kwi-imeyile yomsebenzi engacacanga, khetha ulwazi olufuneka luqinisekiswe phambi kokuba wenze, uze ubhale i-imeyile yemibuzo elula ukuyiphendula.

20261122-english-g11-2.title: Ingaba kungenxa yeklabhu yokufunda? Ngowuphi ulwazi onokusenza sazi?
20261122-english-g11-2.summary:
Le yinxalenye yengxelo yebhunga labafundi.

"Students who joined the school reading club had higher English test scores than students who did not (average 82 vs 74). So the reading club raises English scores."

Umfundi uMina ufuna ukujonga ukuba esi siphelo silunge na. Abafundi bangena kwiklabhu ngokufaka isicelo ukuba bayafuna.
20261122-english-g11-2.principle: Ukuba uyawazi amanqaku angaphambi kokujoyina, unokuthelekisa ukuba amanqaku amalungu ayesele ephezulu okanye anyuke emva kokujoyina. Ngenxa yokuba abafundi bangena ngokufaka isicelo, abafundi abaninzi abasele bemhle kwisiNgesi basenokuba bangenile.
20261122-english-g11-2.example: Cinga ukuba inyani yokuba abafundi bangena 'ngokufaka isicelo ukuba bayafuna' ingachaphazela njani indawo yokuqala yamaqela amabini.
20261122-english-g11-2.actionItem: Khetha ukuba ngowuphi ulwazi olufunekayo ukuxela ukuba umahluko wamanqaku phakathi kwamalungu eklabhu nabangengawo yimpembelelo yeklabhu, uze ubhale ngesiNgesi umbuzo wokufumana olo lwazi.

20261122-english-g12-1.title: Abafundi abatya isidlo sakusasa banamabanga aphezulu: yintoni enye esiyidingayo ukuyazi?
20261122-english-g12-1.summary:
Libango elisuka kwinqaku lesikolo. "Students who eat breakfast get higher test scores, so the school should provide free breakfast." Njengobungqina, iziphumo zophando lwabafundi abangama-200 zazibonisiwe ngolu hlobo.

Group | Number of students | Average score
Students who eat breakfast | 130 | 82
Students who skip breakfast | 70 | 74
20261122-english-g12-1.principle: b ihlola ezinye izizathu (ubuthongo, ixesha lokufunda), c ihlola isiphumo sophindlo lwangempela, kwaye e ihlola ukulunga kothelekiso. a no-d asingobungqina bokuba izidlo zikhulisa amanqaku.
20261122-english-g12-1.example: Hlola ukuba ulwazi ngalunye lunceda ukuphendula umbuzo, 'Ingaba unxibelelwano phakathi kwesidlo sakusasa namanqaku sisizathu?'
20261122-english-g12-1.actionItem: Gweba ukuba isiphumo sophando sisixelela ngo-"sizathu", khetha ulwazi olongezelelweyo oluyimfuneko kuloo mgwebo, uze ucebise ngesiNgesi indlela yokuthelekisa yokuhlola impembelelo yokutya mahala.

20261122-english-g12-2.title: Into efanayo, izihloko ezahlukeneyo: ukugweba kuyatshintsha njengoko ulwazi lukhula
20261122-english-g12-2.summary: Inqaku ngekhansile yesixeko eqinisekisa ukunyusa iimali zokupaka kufuphi nesikhululo likhutshwa ngamanqanaba. Bukela ukuba ukugweba kwakho kuyatshintsha na ngalo lonke ixesha ulwazi lukhula.
20261122-english-g12-2.principle: Njengoko ulwazi lukhula, hlaziya ukugweba kwakho ukuba ithoni neziqendu ezishiyiweyo zesihloko ziyithambekisa njani kwelinye icala xa kuthelekiswa neenyani, uze ucacise into enye ngesiNgesi.
20261122-english-g12-2.example: Wahlule amagama asesihlokweni anika iinyani kwawo anika imvakalelo.
