20261121-korean-l3-2.actionItem: Fumana umgca ekuzazisweni ovakala ungaqhelekanga, uchaze isizathu, uze uwubhale kwakhona ukuze uvakale ngokwendalo.

20261121-korean-l4-1.title: Bhukisha igumbi
20261121-korean-l4-1.summary:
Iqela lakho lifuna ukusebenzisa igumbi emva kwesikolo. Funda isaziso nomyalezo ovela kumntu weqela 서준.

[방과 후 교실 이용 안내]
- 이용 시간: 오후 1시 ~ 6시
- 한 번에 1시간이나 2시간 쓸 수 있어요.
- 오후 3시 ~ 4시는 청소 시간이라 쓸 수 없어요.

서준: 저는 수업이 2시에 끝나서 2시 전에는 갈 수 없어요. 시작 시간은 정각으로 해 주세요.
20261121-korean-l4-1.principle: 2시 ~ 4시 iquka 3시 ~ 4시, xa igumbi licociwa. Isicwangciso ngasinye kufuneka sikhangelwe ngexesha lasonke, hayi ukuqala kuphela.
20261121-korean-l4-1.example: Bhala iyure yokuqala neyure yokuphela yesicwangciso.
20261121-korean-l4-1.actionItem: Dibanisa imithetho yegumbi isuka kwisaziso nomyalezo womnye uphawu lweqela, ufumane izicwangciso ezahlukeneyo zokubhukisha ezanelisa yonke imeko.

20261121-korean-l4-2.title: Kuhambile kakhulu kwichibi lokubhukuda?
20261121-korean-l4-2.summary:
Kukho isaziso emnyango wechibi lokubhukuda, yaye umhlobo wakho 민지 ukuthumelela umyalezo.

[수영 수업 안내]
- 수업: 화요일, 목요일 오후 4시 30분 ~ 5시 30분
- 수업 시작 10분 전까지 수영장 앞으로 오세요.
- 수업이 시작되면 문을 닫아요. 늦으면 들어갈 수 없어요.

민지: 목요일 수영 수업, 4시 40분까지 가면 돼요?
20261121-korean-l4-2.principle: Ngo-목요일 kukho iklasi ngo-4:30. Umnyango uvalwa xa iqala, yaye isaziso sicela abantu ukuba bafike ngemizuzu eyi-10 ngaphambili (4:20). U-4:40 ungemva kwawo omabini la maxesha.
20261121-korean-l4-2.example: Fumana 목요일 kwisaziso uze ufunde ixesha lokuqala leklasi.
20261121-korean-l4-2.actionItem: Dibanisa isaziso nomyalezo womhlobo ukugweba ukuba ixesha elicetywayo lokufika liyasebenza na, bhekisa kwimigca enqumayo, uze ubhale impendulo enika umhla wokugqibela wokwenene.

20261121-korean-l5-1.title: Isaziso sohambo lwesikolo esinengxaki yexesha
20261121-korean-l5-1.summary: Iklasi yakho ifumene esi saziso kutitshala ngomyalezo.
20261121-korean-l5-1.principle: Imigca 3 no-4 iyadibana: iklasi ifika epakini nge-11:30, kodwa isidlo sasemini 'emva kokufika' singo-11:00. Imigca 1, 2 no-5 iyahambelana.
20261121-korean-l5-1.example: Beka amaxesha ewotshi emigca ngokulandelelana uze uthelekise.
20261121-korean-l5-1.actionItem: Fumana ingxabano kwisaziso sohambo, ugqibe ukuba yintoni enokufikelelwa, uze ubhale umbuzo onembeko oyisombululayo.

20261121-korean-l5-2.title: Ndifuna ukubuza mbuzo ni?
20261121-korean-l5-2.summary:
Umfundi osebenza naye uHana uthumela lo myalezo ngoLwesithathu. NgoMgqibelo usebenza ukuya kutsho nge-1:00 emva kwemini, kwaye ungachitha ubuninzi be-10,000 won kumsebenzi.
하나: 이번 토요일에 서울숲에서 자전거를 탈 거예요. 자전거는 한 시간에 5,000원이에요. 같이 갈래요?
20261121-korean-l5-2.principle: Imida yakho emibini yixesha lokuphela komsebenzi (1:00) kunye nebhajethi (10,000 won). Ixesha lokuqala liphendula umda wokuqala kwaye inani leeyure (lihlutshwa ngo-5,000 won) liphendula owesibini.
20261121-korean-l5-2.example: Bhala kuqala imida yakho emibini, uze ubuze ukuba leliphi inkcukacha engekhoyo elinokukuvumela ukuvavanya omnye ngamnye.
20261121-korean-l5-2.actionItem: Gqiba ukuba ngawaphi amaqhekeza olwazi ongekabikho ewafunayo phambi kokuba wamkele isimemo, uze ubuze ngqo ngawo ngesiKorea esinembeko.

20261121-korean-l6-1.title: Ndifaka isicelo phi?
20261121-korean-l6-1.summary: Yi-4:20 emva kwemini. Ukwi-카운터 le-주민센터 (iziko lenkonzo yoluntu) yommandla. Ufuna ukufaka isicelo sepasipoti. Awuqinisekanga ukuba unayo na ifoto yepasipoti ekhaya lakho esikhwameni.
20261121-korean-l6-1.principle: Hlaziya indlela oyifunda ngayo iimpendulo zomphathi njengoko kuvela inxalenye ngakumbi yencoko, uze ubuze umbuzo olandelayo onengqiqo.
20261121-korean-l6-1.example: Latha ngokusebenzisa kuphela oko ukufundileyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.
20261121-korean-l6-1.actionItem: Hlaziya indlela oyifunda ngayo iimpendulo zomphathi njengoko kuvela inxalenye ngakumbi yencoko, uze ubuze umbuzo olandelayo onengqiqo.

20261121-korean-l6-2.title: Sesiphi isiqikelelo aya kuvuma kuso umntu omdala?
20261121-korean-l6-2.summary:
Ungumfundi wonyaka wokuqala wasenyuvesithi. 민준 선배 ngumdala weklabhu, omdala ngeminyaka emithathu; uthethe naye kabini kuphela. Wabhala amanqaku amahle kwintetho yeveki ephelileyo. Uvavanyo lwakho luvela emva kwemini ngomso kwaye ufuna ukubona amanqaku namhlanje. Ubhale imiyalezo emine yokuqikelela:

Draft A: 선배, 지난주 필기 보내 줘요. 내일 시험이에요.
Draft B: 선배님, 혹시 지난주 필기를 사진으로 보내 주실 수 있을까요? 내일 시험이라서요.
Draft C: 선배님, 바쁘시겠지만 시간 되실 때 아무 때나 지난주 필기를 보여 주시면 정말 감사하겠습니다.
Draft D: 선배님, 필기 보내 주세요. 안 보내 주시면 저 시험 망해요.
20261121-korean-l6-2.principle: Draft B ibuza ukuba kunokwenzeka (혹시 + -(으)ㄹ 수 있을까요), inika isizathu, kwaye isizathu sibonisa uxinzelelo lwexesha. Draft C inentlonipho kakhulu kodwa ayizange ithi iyadingeka ngomso, ngoko umntu omdala usenokuphendula kwiveki ezayo. Draft A ayinasondelo sembeko kumntu omdala okude, kwaye Draft D iyamxinzelela.
20261121-korean-l6-2.example: Thelekisa ukuba nganye ivakala njengebhalelwe bani.
20261121-korean-l6-2.actionItem: Gweba izicelo ezine ngamagama azo ucacise ukuba zeziphi iimpawu ezenza isicelo silula ukuvunywa nokuba zeziphi ezinentlonipho ebonakalayo ezisasilela.

20261122-korean-l1-1.title: Sesiphi isikhombisi esikhokelela kwindawo yokupaka?
20261122-korean-l1-1.summary:
Undwendwe luqhuba lufika esikolweni kwaye lufuna ukushiya imoto iyure e-1. Izikhombisi ezintathu ziyabonakala (akukho mifanekiso, ngoko zichazwa ngamagama).

Isikhombisi A: oonobumba abamhlophe '주차 금지' kwibhodi ebomvu. Isangqa esibomvu esinomgca othe tye siwela umzobo omncinci wemoto. Sibotshelelwe kucingo lwesikolo.
Isikhombisi B: ibhodi eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, oonobumba abamhlophe '방문자 주차장' kunye nomcibisholo olatha ngasekunene. Simi ecaleni kwendlela.
Isikhombisi C: ibhodi eluhlaza, oonobumba abamhlophe '주차장 출구' kunye nomcibisholo olatha ngasemva ngakwindlela. Sixhonywe phezu kwendlela emxinwa apho iimoto zihamba zingaphandle.

Amagama: 주차(장) = indawo yokupaka; 방문자 = undwendwe; 입구 = ukungena; 출구 = ukuphuma.
20261122-korean-l1-1.principle: Isikhombisi B sesabundwendwe, sibiza indawo yokupaka kwaye sinika isalathiso. Isikhombisi A sinegama lokuqala elifanayo kodwa sithwele uphawu lwenqanaba. Isikhombisi C sibiza indawo yokupaka nasi, kodwa 출구 ithetha ukuphuma, ngoko sibonisa apho iimoto zishiya khona.
20261122-korean-l1-1.example: Dwelisa oko isikhombisi ngasinye sikuthethayo ngamagama, nokuba uphawu lwaso okanye umcibisholo wongeza ntoni.
20261122-korean-l1-1.actionItem: Funda izikhombisi ezintathu zendlela ezimfutshane, udibanise amagama notolo nophawu oluchaziweyo, uze ugwebe ukuba sesiphi ngokwenene esikhokelela undwendwe ukuba lipake; khusela ugwebo ngokuchasene nokufunda kwesiqingatha komhlobo.

20261122-korean-l1-2.summary:
Uphawu emnyango wethala leencwadi (umgca omnye emqolweni):

오전 9시 ~ 오후 6시
낮 12시 ~ 1시 쉬어요

20261122-korean-l4-1.actionItem: Dibanisa imithetho yegumbi isuka kwisaziso nomyalezo womnye uphawu lweqela, ufumane izicwangciso ezahlukeneyo zokubhukisha ezanelisa yonke imeko.

20261122-korean-l4-2.title: Kuhambile kakhulu kwichibi lokubhukuda?
20261122-korean-l4-2.summary:
Kukho isaziso emnyango wechibi lokubhukuda, yaye umhlobo wakho 민지 ukuthumelela umyalezo.

[수영 수업 안내]
- 수업: 화요일, 목요일 오후 4시 30분 ~ 5시 30분
- 수업 시작 10분 전까지 수영장 앞으로 오세요.
- 수업이 시작되면 문을 닫아요. 늦으면 들어갈 수 없어요.

민지: 목요일 수영 수업, 4시 40분까지 가면 돼요?
20261122-korean-l4-2.principle: Ngo-목요일 kukho iklasi ngo-4:30. Umnyango uvalwa xa iqala, yaye isaziso sicela abantu ukuba bafike ngemizuzu eyi-10 ngaphambili (4:20). U-4:40 ungemva kwawo omabini la maxesha.
20261122-korean-l4-2.example: Fumana 목요일 kwisaziso uze ufunde ixesha lokuqala leklasi.
20261122-korean-l4-2.actionItem: Dibanisa isaziso nomyalezo womhlobo ukugweba ukuba ixesha elicetywayo lokufika liyasebenza na, bhekisa kwimigca enqumayo, uze ubhale impendulo enika umhla wokugqibela wokwenene.

20261122-korean-l5-1.title: Isaziso sohambo lwesikolo esinengxaki yexesha
20261122-korean-l5-1.summary: Iklasi yakho ifumene esi saziso kutitshala ngomyalezo.
20261122-korean-l5-1.principle: Imigca 3 no-4 iyadibana: iklasi ifika epakini nge-11:30, kodwa isidlo sasemini 'emva kokufika' singo-11:00. Imigca 1, 2 no-5 iyahambelana.
20261122-korean-l5-1.example: Beka amaxesha ewotshi emigca ngokulandelelana uze uthelekise.
20261122-korean-l5-1.actionItem: Fumana ingxabano kwisaziso sohambo, ugqibe ukuba yintoni enokufikelelwa, uze ubhale umbuzo onembeko oyisombululayo.

20261122-korean-l5-2.title: Ndifuna ukubuza mbuzo ni?
20261122-korean-l5-2.summary:
Umfundi osebenza naye uHana uthumela lo myalezo ngoLwesithathu. NgoMgqibelo usebenza ukuya kutsho nge-1:00 emva kwemini, kwaye ungachitha ubuninzi be-10,000 won kumsebenzi.
하나: 이번 토요일에 서울숲에서 자전거를 탈 거예요. 자전거는 한 시간에 5,000원이에요. 같이 갈래요?
20261122-korean-l5-2.principle: Imida yakho emibini yixesha lokuphela komsebenzi (1:00) kunye nebhajethi (10,000 won). Ixesha lokuqala liphendula umda wokuqala kwaye inani leeyure (lihlutshwa ngo-5,000 won) liphendula owesibini.
20261122-korean-l5-2.example: Bhala kuqala imida yakho emibini, uze ubuze ukuba leliphi inkcukacha engekhoyo elinokukuvumela ukuvavanya omnye ngamnye.
20261122-korean-l5-2.actionItem: Gqiba ukuba ngawaphi amaqhekeza olwazi ongekabikho ewafunayo phambi kokuba wamkele isimemo, uze ubuze ngqo ngawo ngesiKorea esinembeko.

20261122-korean-l6-1.title: Ndifaka isicelo phi?
20261122-korean-l6-1.summary: Yi-4:20 emva kwemini. Ukwi-카운터 le-주민센터 (iziko lenkonzo yoluntu) yommandla. Ufuna ukufaka isicelo sepasipoti. Awuqinisekanga ukuba unayo na ifoto yepasipoti ekhaya lakho esikhwameni.
20261122-korean-l6-1.principle: Hlaziya indlela oyifunda ngayo iimpendulo zomphathi njengoko kuvela inxalenye ngakumbi yencoko, uze ubuze umbuzo olandelayo onengqiqo.
20261122-korean-l6-1.example: Latha ngokusebenzisa kuphela oko ukufundileyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.
20261122-korean-l6-1.actionItem: Hlaziya indlela oyifunda ngayo iimpendulo zomphathi njengoko kuvela inxalenye ngakumbi yencoko, uze ubuze umbuzo olandelayo onengqiqo.

20261122-korean-l6-2.title: Sesiphi isiqikelelo aya kuvuma kuso umntu omdala?
20261122-korean-l6-2.summary:
Ungumfundi wonyaka wokuqala wasenyuvesithi. 민준 선배 ngumdala weklabhu, omdala ngeminyaka emithathu; uthethe naye kabini kuphela. Wabhala amanqaku amahle kwintetho yeveki ephelileyo. Uvavanyo lwakho luvela emva kwemini ngomso kwaye ufuna ukubona amanqaku namhlanje. Ubhale imiyalezo emine yokuqikelela:

Draft A: 선배, 지난주 필기 보내 줘요. 내일 시험이에요.
Draft B: 선배님, 혹시 지난주 필기를 사진으로 보내 주실 수 있을까요? 내일 시험이라서요.
Draft C: 선배님, 바쁘시겠지만 시간 되실 때 아무 때나 지난주 필기를 보여 주시면 정말 감사하겠습니다.
Draft D: 선배님, 필기 보내 주세요. 안 보내 주시면 저 시험 망해요.
20261122-korean-l6-2.principle: Draft B ibuza ukuba kunokwenzeka (혹시 + -(으)ㄹ 수 있을까요), inika isizathu, kwaye isizathu sibonisa uxinzelelo lwexesha. Draft C inentlonipho kakhulu kodwa ayizange ithi iyadingeka ngomso, ngoko umntu omdala usenokuphendula kwiveki ezayo. Draft A ayinasondelo sembeko kumntu omdala okude, kwaye Draft D iyamxinzelela.
20261122-korean-l6-2.example: Thelekisa ukuba nganye ivakala njengebhalelwe bani.
20261122-korean-l6-2.actionItem: Gweba izicelo ezine ngamagama azo ucacise ukuba zeziphi iimpawu ezenza isicelo silula ukuvunywa nokuba zeziphi ezinentlonipho ebonakalayo ezisasilela.

20261123-korean-l1-1.title: Sesiphi isikhombisi esikhokelela kwindawo yokupaka?
20261123-korean-l1-1.summary:
Undwendwe luqhuba lufika esikolweni kwaye lufuna ukushiya imoto iyure e-1. Izikhombisi ezintathu ziyabonakala (akukho mifanekiso, ngoko zichazwa ngamagama).

Isikhombisi A: oonobumba abamhlophe '주차 금지' kwibhodi ebomvu. Isangqa esibomvu esinomgca othe tye siwela umzobo omncinci wemoto. Sibotshelelwe kucingo lwesikolo.
Isikhombisi B: ibhodi eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, oonobumba abamhlophe '방문자 주차장' kunye nomcibisholo olatha ngasekunene. Simi ecaleni kwendlela.
Isikhombisi C: ibhodi eluhlaza, oonobumba abamhlophe '주차장 출구' kunye nomcibisholo olatha ngasemva ngakwindlela. Sixhonywe phezu kwendlela emxinwa apho iimoto zihamba zingaphandle.

Amagama: 주차(장) = indawo yokupaka; 방문자 = undwendwe; 입구 = ukungena; 출구 = ukuphuma.
20261123-korean-l1-1.principle: Isikhombisi B sesabundwendwe, sibiza indawo yokupaka kwaye sinika isalathiso. Isikhombisi A sinegama lokuqala elifanayo kodwa sithwele uphawu lwenqanaba. Isikhombisi C sibiza indawo yokupaka nasi, kodwa 출구 ithetha ukuphuma, ngoko sibonisa apho iimoto zishiya khona.
20261123-korean-l1-1.example: Dwelisa oko isikhombisi ngasinye sikuthethayo ngamagama, nokuba uphawu lwaso okanye umcibisholo wongeza ntoni.
20261123-korean-l1-1.actionItem: Funda izikhombisi ezintathu zendlela ezimfutshane, udibanise amagama notolo nophawu oluchaziweyo, uze ugwebe ukuba sesiphi ngokwenene esikhokelela undwendwe ukuba lipake; khusela ugwebo ngokuchasene nokufunda kwesiqingatha komhlobo.

20261123-korean-l1-2.title: Ungangena nini ethaleni leencwadi?
20261123-korean-l1-2.summary:
Uphawu emnyango wethala leencwadi (umgca omnye emqolweni):

도서관
오전 9시 ~ 오후 6시
낮 12시 ~ 1시 쉬어요
일요일 쉬어요

Amagama: 오전 = a.m.; 오후 = p.m.; 낮 = emini; 쉬어요 = (liphumla); ~ ifundwa 'ukuya' (ukusuka ... ukuya ...). Ufuna ukutyelela ngoLwesithathu.
20261123-korean-l1-2.principle: Imigca 2 no-3 isebenza kuzo zonke iintsuku eziqhelekileyo. Umgca 1 ligama kwaye umgca 4 umalunga neCawa kuphela.
20261123-korean-l1-2.example: Buza kumgca ngamnye: ingaba isebenza ngoLwesithathu?
20261123-korean-l1-2.actionItem: Funda uphawu olunemigca emininzi, gqiba ukuba yeyiphi imigca ebalulekileyo ngosuku olunikiweyo, uze ufumane amaxesha amaninzi okufika ahambelana nawo onke.

20261123-korean-l2-1.title: Ngubani ohambayo, ngubani oseleyo?
20261123-korean-l2-1.summary:
지우 ngumfundi kwaye uthetha ngembeko nabadala. Kathathu 지우 uthi sala kakuhle. Jonga ngubani ohamba kwaye ngubani osala apho esebenza khona.

Scene 1: 지우 ugqiba ukuthetha egumbini luka-선생님 aze aphume. 선생님 usala kwidesika.
Scene 2: 지우 no-선생님 bashiya isikolo kunye. Esangweni bahamba ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo.
Scene 3: 지우 utya isidlo sasemini ekhaya luka-할머니. Emva koko 지우 uya ekhaya. 할머니 usala ekhaya.
20261123-korean-l2-1.principle: 안녕히 계세요 ithethwa ngohambayo kosalayo. 지우 uyaphuma kwaye 선생님 usala kwidesika.
20261123-korean-l2-1.example: Buza: ngubani ohambayo, ngubani osala egumbini?
20261123-korean-l2-1.actionItem: Khetha esiphi isibingelelo sokuhlukana esifanelekileyo ngokuxhomekeke kwabo bahambayo nabo baseleyo, qaphela imeko apho bobabini behamba, uze ubhale isibingelelo sokuhlukana ngembeko kunye nombulelo.

20261123-korean-l2-2.title: Enkosi kumhlobo, enkosi kutitshala
20261123-korean-l2-2.summary: 서준 unike umfundi osebenza naye incwadi kwaye lo mfundi wabhala emva: '책 줘서 고마워!' Ngoku utitshala ka-서준 unika 서준 incwadi, kwaye 서준 ufuna ukuthumela umyalezo ohambelana nje kakhulu kutitshala.
20261123-korean-l2-2.principle: Zombini isenzi malunga noko utitshala akwenzileyo (줘서 iba yi-주셔서) negama lombulelo (고마워 liba yi-고맙습니다 okanye i-감사합니다) zibonisa ubudlelwane, yaye intsingiselo kufuneka ihlale 'enkosi ngokundinika incwadi'.
20261123-korean-l2-2.example: Jonga izinto ezimbini kuhlobo ngalunye: isenzi sokwenziwa kwatitshala kunye negama lombulelo.
20261123-korean-l2-2.actionItem: Khetha umbulelo ofanelekileyo kutitshala, uze ubhale kwakhona umyalezo ngamazwi akho.

20261123-korean-l3-1.title: Ngubani onike imali yepokotho?
20261123-korean-l3-1.summary:
Abafundi ababini, 지우 no-하나, bathetha ngentetho enembeko ye--요. IsiKorea sihlala sishiya isihloko (ngubani owenza isenzo). (댁 = igama lembeko lekhaya lomntu.)

지우: 어제 뭐 했어요?
하나: 할머니 댁에 갔어요. 맛있는 밥을 먹었어요. 용돈도 주셨어요.
지우: 좋았겠어요!
20261123-korean-l3-1.principle: Umbhalo awunasihloko, kodwa imo yesenzi ibonisa ukuba umnikeli ngumntu ekufuneka ahlonitshwe, kwaye ngumntu kuphela onjalo kwibali ngu-할머니, apho 하나 wayekhele khona. 'Mhlawumbi' ichanekile: umbhalo awuyithethi ngqo.
20261123-korean-l3-1.example: Jonga isiphelo se-주셨어요 uze usithelekise ne-먹었어요 kumgca odlulileyo.
20261123-korean-l3-1.actionItem: Qikelela ukuba isihloko esishiyiweyo sibhekisa kubani, khomba ubungqina kumbhalo, uze uthi ukuqikelela kutshintsha njani xa kususwa umkhondo omnye.

20261123-korean-l3-2.title: Umgca omnye ongaqhelekanga ekuziziseni
20261123-korean-l3-2.summary: Umfundi omtsha, 이민수, uzazisa kwiklasi. Imigca emihlanu iyabonakaliswa. Umgca omnye uvakala ungaqhelekanga kumamelwane waseKorea.
20261123-korean-l3-2.principle: Umgca 2 awuqhelekanga. 님 ligama lesihloko elongezwa kumagama abanye abantu ukubonisa imbeko. Ukulibeka kwigama lakho kuvakala ngathi uyazidumisa. Eminye imigca ilungile ekuzazisweni kwiklasi.
20261123-korean-l3-2.example: Funda umgca ngamnye ngokuvakalayo ngokungathi uthetha kwiklasi yakho. Yeyiphi eyayinokwenza abamamelayo bancume?
20261123-korean-l3-2.actionItem: Fumana umgca ekuzazisweni ovakala ungaqhelekanga, uchaze isizathu, uze uwubhale kwakhona ukuze uvakale ngokwendalo.

20261123-korean-l4-1.title: Bhukisha igumbi
20261123-korean-l4-1.summary:
Iqela lakho lifuna ukusebenzisa igumbi emva kwesikolo. Funda isaziso nomyalezo ovela kumntu weqela 서준.

[방과 후 교실 이용 안내]
- 이용 시간: 오후 1시 ~ 6시
- 한 번에 1시간이나 2시간 쓸 수 있어요.
- 오후 3시 ~ 4시는 청소 시간이라 쓸 수 없어요.

서준: 저는 수업이 2시에 끝나서 2시 전에는 갈 수 없어요. 시작 시간은 정각으로 해 주세요.

20261124-korean-l1-2.title: Ungangena nini ethaleni leencwadi?
20261124-korean-l1-2.summary:
Uphawu emnyango wethala leencwadi (umgca omnye emqolweni):

도서관
오전 9시 ~ 오후 6시
낮 12시 ~ 1시 쉬어요
일요일 쉬어요

Amagama: 오전 = a.m.; 오후 = p.m.; 낮 = emini; 쉬어요 = (liphumla); ~ ifundwa 'ukuya' (ukusuka ... ukuya ...). Ufuna ukutyelela ngoLwesithathu.
20261124-korean-l1-2.principle: Imigca 2 no-3 isebenza kuzo zonke iintsuku eziqhelekileyo. Umgca 1 ligama kwaye umgca 4 umalunga neCawa kuphela.
20261124-korean-l1-2.example: Buza kumgca ngamnye: ingaba isebenza ngoLwesithathu?
20261124-korean-l1-2.actionItem: Funda uphawu olunemigca emininzi, gqiba ukuba yeyiphi imigca ebalulekileyo ngosuku olunikiweyo, uze ufumane amaxesha amaninzi okufika ahambelana nawo onke.

20261124-korean-l2-1.title: Ngubani ohambayo, ngubani oseleyo?
20261124-korean-l2-1.summary:
지우 ngumfundi kwaye uthetha ngembeko nabadala. Kathathu 지우 uthi sala kakuhle. Jonga ngubani ohamba kwaye ngubani osala apho esebenza khona.

Scene 1: 지우 ugqiba ukuthetha egumbini luka-선생님 aze aphume. 선생님 usala kwidesika.
Scene 2: 지우 no-선생님 bashiya isikolo kunye. Esangweni bahamba ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo.
Scene 3: 지우 utya isidlo sasemini ekhaya luka-할머니. Emva koko 지우 uya ekhaya. 할머니 usala ekhaya.
20261124-korean-l2-1.principle: 안녕히 계세요 ithethwa ngohambayo kosalayo. 지우 uyaphuma kwaye 선생님 usala kwidesika.
20261124-korean-l2-1.example: Buza: ngubani ohambayo, ngubani osala egumbini?
20261124-korean-l2-1.actionItem: Khetha esiphi isibingelelo sokuhlukana esifanelekileyo ngokuxhomekeke kwabo bahambayo nabo baseleyo, qaphela imeko apho bobabini behamba, uze ubhale isibingelelo sokuhlukana ngembeko kunye nombulelo.

20261124-korean-l2-2.title: Enkosi kumhlobo, enkosi kutitshala
20261124-korean-l2-2.summary: 서준 unike umfundi osebenza naye incwadi kwaye lo mfundi wabhala emva: '책 줘서 고마워!' Ngoku utitshala ka-서준 unika 서준 incwadi, kwaye 서준 ufuna ukuthumela umyalezo ohambelana nje kakhulu kutitshala.
20261124-korean-l2-2.principle: Zombini isenzi malunga noko utitshala akwenzileyo (줘서 iba yi-주셔서) negama lombulelo (고마워 liba yi-고맙습니다 okanye i-감사합니다) zibonisa ubudlelwane, yaye intsingiselo kufuneka ihlale 'enkosi ngokundinika incwadi'.
20261124-korean-l2-2.example: Jonga izinto ezimbini kuhlobo ngalunye: isenzi sokwenziwa kwatitshala kunye negama lombulelo.
20261124-korean-l2-2.actionItem: Khetha umbulelo ofanelekileyo kutitshala, uze ubhale kwakhona umyalezo ngamazwi akho.

20261124-korean-l3-1.title: Ngubani onike imali yepokotho?
20261124-korean-l3-1.summary:
Abafundi ababini, 지우 no-하나, bathetha ngentetho enembeko ye--요. IsiKorea sihlala sishiya isihloko (ngubani owenza isenzo). (댁 = igama lembeko lekhaya lomntu.)

지우: 어제 뭐 했어요?
하나: 할머니 댁에 갔어요. 맛있는 밥을 먹었어요. 용돈도 주셨어요.
지우: 좋았겠어요!
20261124-korean-l3-1.principle: Umbhalo awunasihloko, kodwa imo yesenzi ibonisa ukuba umnikeli ngumntu ekufuneka ahlonitshwe, kwaye ngumntu kuphela onjalo kwibali ngu-할머니, apho 하나 wayekhele khona. 'Mhlawumbi' ichanekile: umbhalo awuyithethi ngqo.
20261124-korean-l3-1.example: Jonga isiphelo se-주셨어요 uze usithelekise ne-먹었어요 kumgca odlulileyo.
20261124-korean-l3-1.actionItem: Qikelela ukuba isihloko esishiyiweyo sibhekisa kubani, khomba ubungqina kumbhalo, uze uthi ukuqikelela kutshintsha njani xa kususwa umkhondo omnye.

20261124-korean-l3-2.title: Umgca omnye ongaqhelekanga ekuziziseni
20261124-korean-l3-2.summary: Umfundi omtsha, 이민수, uzazisa kwiklasi. Imigca emihlanu iyabonakaliswa. Umgca omnye uvakala ungaqhelekanga kumamelwane waseKorea.
20261124-korean-l3-2.principle: Umgca 2 awuqhelekanga. 님 ligama lesihloko elongezwa kumagama abanye abantu ukubonisa imbeko. Ukulibeka kwigama lakho kuvakala ngathi uyazidumisa. Eminye imigca ilungile ekuzazisweni kwiklasi.
20261124-korean-l3-2.example: Funda umgca ngamnye ngokuvakalayo ngokungathi uthetha kwiklasi yakho. Yeyiphi eyayinokwenza abamamelayo bancume?
20261124-korean-l3-2.actionItem: Fumana umgca ekuzazisweni ovakala ungaqhelekanga, uchaze isizathu, uze uwubhale kwakhona ukuze uvakale ngokwendalo.

20261124-korean-l4-1.title: Bhukisha igumbi
20261124-korean-l4-1.summary:
Iqela lakho lifuna ukusebenzisa igumbi emva kwesikolo. Funda isaziso nomyalezo ovela kumntu weqela 서준.

[방과 후 교실 이용 안내]
- 이용 시간: 오후 1시 ~ 6시
- 한 번에 1시간이나 2시간 쓸 수 있어요.
- 오후 3시 ~ 4시는 청소 시간이라 쓸 수 없어요.

서준: 저는 수업이 2시에 끝나서 2시 전에는 갈 수 없어요. 시작 시간은 정각으로 해 주세요.
20261124-korean-l4-1.principle: 2시 ~ 4시 iquka 3시 ~ 4시, xa igumbi licociwa. Isicwangciso ngasinye kufuneka sikhangelwe ngexesha lasonke, hayi ukuqala kuphela.
20261124-korean-l4-1.example: Bhala iyure yokuqala neyure yokuphela yesicwangciso.
20261124-korean-l4-1.actionItem: Dibanisa imithetho yegumbi isuka kwisaziso nomyalezo womnye uphawu lweqela, ufumane izicwangciso ezahlukeneyo zokubhukisha ezanelisa yonke imeko.

20261124-korean-l4-2.title: Kuhambile kakhulu kwichibi lokubhukuda?
20261124-korean-l4-2.summary:
Kukho isaziso emnyango wechibi lokubhukuda, yaye umhlobo wakho 민지 ukuthumelela umyalezo.

[수영 수업 안내]
- 수업: 화요일, 목요일 오후 4시 30분 ~ 5시 30분
- 수업 시작 10분 전까지 수영장 앞으로 오세요.
- 수업이 시작되면 문을 닫아요. 늦으면 들어갈 수 없어요.

민지: 목요일 수영 수업, 4시 40분까지 가면 돼요?
20261124-korean-l4-2.principle: Ngo-목요일 kukho iklasi ngo-4:30. Umnyango uvalwa xa iqala, yaye isaziso sicela abantu ukuba bafike ngemizuzu eyi-10 ngaphambili (4:20). U-4:40 ungemva kwawo omabini la maxesha.
20261124-korean-l4-2.example: Fumana 목요일 kwisaziso uze ufunde ixesha lokuqala leklasi.
20261124-korean-l4-2.actionItem: Dibanisa isaziso nomyalezo womhlobo ukugweba ukuba ixesha elicetywayo lokufika liyasebenza na, bhekisa kwimigca enqumayo, uze ubhale impendulo enika umhla wokugqibela wokwenene.

20261124-korean-l5-1.title: Isaziso sohambo lwesikolo esinengxaki yexesha
20261124-korean-l5-1.summary: Iklasi yakho ifumene esi saziso kutitshala ngomyalezo.
20261124-korean-l5-1.principle: Imigca 3 no-4 iyadibana: iklasi ifika epakini nge-11:30, kodwa isidlo sasemini 'emva kokufika' singo-11:00. Imigca 1, 2 no-5 iyahambelana.
20261124-korean-l5-1.example: Beka amaxesha ewotshi emigca ngokulandelelana uze uthelekise.
20261124-korean-l5-1.actionItem: Fumana ingxabano kwisaziso sohambo, ugqibe ukuba yintoni enokufikelelwa, uze ubhale umbuzo onembeko oyisombululayo.

20261124-korean-l5-2.title: Ndifuna ukubuza mbuzo ni?
20261124-korean-l5-2.summary:
Umfundi osebenza naye uHana uthumela lo myalezo ngoLwesithathu. NgoMgqibelo usebenza ukuya kutsho nge-1:00 emva kwemini, kwaye ungachitha ubuninzi be-10,000 won kumsebenzi.
하나: 이번 토요일에 서울숲에서 자전거를 탈 거예요. 자전거는 한 시간에 5,000원이에요. 같이 갈래요?
20261124-korean-l5-2.principle: Imida yakho emibini yixesha lokuphela komsebenzi (1:00) kunye nebhajethi (10,000 won). Ixesha lokuqala liphendula umda wokuqala kwaye inani leeyure (lihlutshwa ngo-5,000 won) liphendula owesibini.
20261124-korean-l5-2.example: Bhala kuqala imida yakho emibini, uze ubuze ukuba leliphi inkcukacha engekhoyo elinokukuvumela ukuvavanya omnye ngamnye.
20261124-korean-l5-2.actionItem: Gqiba ukuba ngawaphi amaqhekeza olwazi ongekabikho ewafunayo phambi kokuba wamkele isimemo, uze ubuze ngqo ngawo ngesiKorea esinembeko.

20261124-korean-l6-1.title: Ndifaka isicelo phi?
20261124-korean-l6-1.summary: Yi-4:20 emva kwemini. Ukwi-카운터 le-주민센터 (iziko lenkonzo yoluntu) yommandla. Ufuna ukufaka isicelo sepasipoti. Awuqinisekanga ukuba unayo na ifoto yepasipoti ekhaya lakho esikhwameni.
20261124-korean-l6-1.principle: Hlaziya indlela oyifunda ngayo iimpendulo zomphathi njengoko kuvela inxalenye ngakumbi yencoko, uze ubuze umbuzo olandelayo onengqiqo.
20261124-korean-l6-1.example: Latha ngokusebenzisa kuphela oko ukufundileyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.
20261124-korean-l6-1.actionItem: Hlaziya indlela oyifunda ngayo iimpendulo zomphathi njengoko kuvela inxalenye ngakumbi yencoko, uze ubuze umbuzo olandelayo onengqiqo.

20261124-korean-l6-2.title: Sesiphi isiqikelelo aya kuvuma kuso umntu omdala?
20261124-korean-l6-2.summary:
Ungumfundi wonyaka wokuqala wasenyuvesithi. 민준 선배 ngumdala weklabhu, omdala ngeminyaka emithathu; uthethe naye kabini kuphela. Wabhala amanqaku amahle kwintetho yeveki ephelileyo. Uvavanyo lwakho luvela emva kwemini ngomso kwaye ufuna ukubona amanqaku namhlanje. Ubhale imiyalezo emine yokuqikelela:

Draft A: 선배, 지난주 필기 보내 줘요. 내일 시험이에요.
Draft B: 선배님, 혹시 지난주 필기를 사진으로 보내 주실 수 있을까요? 내일 시험이라서요.
Draft C: 선배님, 바쁘시겠지만 시간 되실 때 아무 때나 지난주 필기를 보여 주시면 정말 감사하겠습니다.
Draft D: 선배님, 필기 보내 주세요. 안 보내 주시면 저 시험 망해요.
20261124-korean-l6-2.principle: Draft B ibuza ukuba kunokwenzeka (혹시 + -(으)ㄹ 수 있을까요), inika isizathu, kwaye isizathu sibonisa uxinzelelo lwexesha. Draft C inentlonipho kakhulu kodwa ayizange ithi iyadingeka ngomso, ngoko umntu omdala usenokuphendula kwiveki ezayo. Draft A ayinasondelo sembeko kumntu omdala okude, kwaye Draft D iyamxinzelela.

20261124-korean-l6-2.actionItem: Gweba izicelo ezine ngamagama azo ucacise ukuba zeziphi iimpawu ezenza isicelo silula ukuvunywa nokuba zeziphi ezinentlonipho ebonakalayo ezisasilela.

20261125-korean-l3-1.principle: Umbhalo awunasihloko, kodwa imo yesenzi ibonisa ukuba umnikeli ngumntu ekufuneka ahlonitshwe, kwaye ngumntu kuphela onjalo kwibali ngu-할머니, apho 하나 wayekhele khona. 'Mhlawumbi' ichanekile: umbhalo awuyithethi ngqo.
20261125-korean-l3-1.example: Jonga isiphelo se-주셨어요 uze usithelekise ne-먹었어요 kumgca odlulileyo.
20261125-korean-l3-1.actionItem: Qikelela ukuba isihloko esishiyiweyo sibhekisa kubani, khomba ubungqina kumbhalo, uze uthi ukuqikelela kutshintsha njani xa kususwa umkhondo omnye.

20261125-korean-l3-2.title: Umgca omnye ongaqhelekanga ekuziziseni
20261125-korean-l3-2.summary: Umfundi omtsha, 이민수, uzazisa kwiklasi. Imigca emihlanu iyabonakaliswa. Umgca omnye uvakala ungaqhelekanga kumamelwane waseKorea.
20261125-korean-l3-2.principle: Umgca 2 awuqhelekanga. 님 ligama lesihloko elongezwa kumagama abanye abantu ukubonisa imbeko. Ukulibeka kwigama lakho kuvakala ngathi uyazidumisa. Eminye imigca ilungile ekuzazisweni kwiklasi.
20261125-korean-l3-2.example: Funda umgca ngamnye ngokuvakalayo ngokungathi uthetha kwiklasi yakho. Yeyiphi eyayinokwenza abamamelayo bancume?
20261125-korean-l3-2.actionItem: Fumana umgca ekuzazisweni ovakala ungaqhelekanga, uchaze isizathu, uze uwubhale kwakhona ukuze uvakale ngokwendalo.

20261125-korean-l4-1.title: Bhukisha igumbi
20261125-korean-l4-1.summary:
Iqela lakho lifuna ukusebenzisa igumbi emva kwesikolo. Funda isaziso nomyalezo ovela kumntu weqela 서준.

[방과 후 교실 이용 안내]
- 이용 시간: 오후 1시 ~ 6시
- 한 번에 1시간이나 2시간 쓸 수 있어요.
- 오후 3시 ~ 4시는 청소 시간이라 쓸 수 없어요.

서준: 저는 수업이 2시에 끝나서 2시 전에는 갈 수 없어요. 시작 시간은 정각으로 해 주세요.
20261125-korean-l4-1.principle: 2시 ~ 4시 iquka 3시 ~ 4시, xa igumbi licociwa. Isicwangciso ngasinye kufuneka sikhangelwe ngexesha lasonke, hayi ukuqala kuphela.
20261125-korean-l4-1.example: Bhala iyure yokuqala neyure yokuphela yesicwangciso.
20261125-korean-l4-1.actionItem: Dibanisa imithetho yegumbi isuka kwisaziso nomyalezo womnye uphawu lweqela, ufumane izicwangciso ezahlukeneyo zokubhukisha ezanelisa yonke imeko.

20261125-korean-l4-2.title: Kuhambile kakhulu kwichibi lokubhukuda?
20261125-korean-l4-2.summary:
Kukho isaziso emnyango wechibi lokubhukuda, yaye umhlobo wakho 민지 ukuthumelela umyalezo.

[수영 수업 안내]
- 수업: 화요일, 목요일 오후 4시 30분 ~ 5시 30분
- 수업 시작 10분 전까지 수영장 앞으로 오세요.
- 수업이 시작되면 문을 닫아요. 늦으면 들어갈 수 없어요.

민지: 목요일 수영 수업, 4시 40분까지 가면 돼요?
20261125-korean-l4-2.principle: Ngo-목요일 kukho iklasi ngo-4:30. Umnyango uvalwa xa iqala, yaye isaziso sicela abantu ukuba bafike ngemizuzu eyi-10 ngaphambili (4:20). U-4:40 ungemva kwawo omabini la maxesha.
20261125-korean-l4-2.example: Fumana 목요일 kwisaziso uze ufunde ixesha lokuqala leklasi.
20261125-korean-l4-2.actionItem: Dibanisa isaziso nomyalezo womhlobo ukugweba ukuba ixesha elicetywayo lokufika liyasebenza na, bhekisa kwimigca enqumayo, uze ubhale impendulo enika umhla wokugqibela wokwenene.

20261125-korean-l5-1.title: Isaziso sohambo lwesikolo esinengxaki yexesha
20261125-korean-l5-1.summary: Iklasi yakho ifumene esi saziso kutitshala ngomyalezo.
20261125-korean-l5-1.principle: Imigca 3 no-4 iyadibana: iklasi ifika epakini nge-11:30, kodwa isidlo sasemini 'emva kokufika' singo-11:00. Imigca 1, 2 no-5 iyahambelana.
20261125-korean-l5-1.example: Beka amaxesha ewotshi emigca ngokulandelelana uze uthelekise.
20261125-korean-l5-1.actionItem: Fumana ingxabano kwisaziso sohambo, ugqibe ukuba yintoni enokufikelelwa, uze ubhale umbuzo onembeko oyisombululayo.

20261125-korean-l5-2.title: Ndifuna ukubuza mbuzo ni?
20261125-korean-l5-2.summary:
Umfundi osebenza naye uHana uthumela lo myalezo ngoLwesithathu. NgoMgqibelo usebenza ukuya kutsho nge-1:00 emva kwemini, kwaye ungachitha ubuninzi be-10,000 won kumsebenzi.
하나: 이번 토요일에 서울숲에서 자전거를 탈 거예요. 자전거는 한 시간에 5,000원이에요. 같이 갈래요?
20261125-korean-l5-2.principle: Imida yakho emibini yixesha lokuphela komsebenzi (1:00) kunye nebhajethi (10,000 won). Ixesha lokuqala liphendula umda wokuqala kwaye inani leeyure (lihlutshwa ngo-5,000 won) liphendula owesibini.
20261125-korean-l5-2.example: Bhala kuqala imida yakho emibini, uze ubuze ukuba leliphi inkcukacha engekhoyo elinokukuvumela ukuvavanya omnye ngamnye.
20261125-korean-l5-2.actionItem: Gqiba ukuba ngawaphi amaqhekeza olwazi ongekabikho ewafunayo phambi kokuba wamkele isimemo, uze ubuze ngqo ngawo ngesiKorea esinembeko.

20261125-korean-l6-1.title: Ndifaka isicelo phi?
20261125-korean-l6-1.summary: Yi-4:20 emva kwemini. Ukwi-카운터 le-주민센터 (iziko lenkonzo yoluntu) yommandla. Ufuna ukufaka isicelo sepasipoti. Awuqinisekanga ukuba unayo na ifoto yepasipoti ekhaya lakho esikhwameni.
20261125-korean-l6-1.principle: Hlaziya indlela oyifunda ngayo iimpendulo zomphathi njengoko kuvela inxalenye ngakumbi yencoko, uze ubuze umbuzo olandelayo onengqiqo.
20261125-korean-l6-1.example: Latha ngokusebenzisa kuphela oko ukufundileyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.
20261125-korean-l6-1.actionItem: Hlaziya indlela oyifunda ngayo iimpendulo zomphathi njengoko kuvela inxalenye ngakumbi yencoko, uze ubuze umbuzo olandelayo onengqiqo.

20261125-korean-l6-2.title: Sesiphi isiqikelelo aya kuvuma kuso umntu omdala?
20261125-korean-l6-2.summary:
Ungumfundi wonyaka wokuqala wasenyuvesithi. 민준 선배 ngumdala weklabhu, omdala ngeminyaka emithathu; uthethe naye kabini kuphela. Wabhala amanqaku amahle kwintetho yeveki ephelileyo. Uvavanyo lwakho luvela emva kwemini ngomso kwaye ufuna ukubona amanqaku namhlanje. Ubhale imiyalezo emine yokuqikelela:

Draft A: 선배, 지난주 필기 보내 줘요. 내일 시험이에요.
Draft B: 선배님, 혹시 지난주 필기를 사진으로 보내 주실 수 있을까요? 내일 시험이라서요.
Draft C: 선배님, 바쁘시겠지만 시간 되실 때 아무 때나 지난주 필기를 보여 주시면 정말 감사하겠습니다.
Draft D: 선배님, 필기 보내 주세요. 안 보내 주시면 저 시험 망해요.
20261125-korean-l6-2.principle: Draft B ibuza ukuba kunokwenzeka (혹시 + -(으)ㄹ 수 있을까요), inika isizathu, kwaye isizathu sibonisa uxinzelelo lwexesha. Draft C inentlonipho kakhulu kodwa ayizange ithi iyadingeka ngomso, ngoko umntu omdala usenokuphendula kwiveki ezayo. Draft A ayinasondelo sembeko kumntu omdala okude, kwaye Draft D iyamxinzelela.
20261125-korean-l6-2.example: Thelekisa ukuba nganye ivakala njengebhalelwe bani.
20261125-korean-l6-2.actionItem: Gweba izicelo ezine ngamagama azo ucacise ukuba zeziphi iimpawu ezenza isicelo silula ukuvunywa nokuba zeziphi ezinentlonipho ebonakalayo ezisasilela.

20261118-life-all.title: Leave the Microwave Center Empty
20261118-life-all.summary: Arranging food in a ring on the plate makes a microwave heat more evenly.
20261118-life-all.principle: Microwaves at 2.45GHz form standing waves with wavelength λ = c/f ≈ 12.2cm, creating hot and cold spots.
20261118-life-all.example: The plate center often gets less energy and stays cold. A ring layout plus one stir midway can cut temperature differences by 20°C or more.
20261118-life-all.actionItem: Today arrange food in a ring with the middle empty and stir halfway through.

20261119-life-all-2.title: Bubble Wrap Window Insulation
20261119-life-all-2.summary: Sticking bubble wrap to a window traps still air that cuts heat loss sharply.
20261119-life-all-2.principle: Still air conducts only about 0.026W/m · K, 1/40 of glass (1.0). In Q = UAΔT the coefficient U falls.
20261119-life-all-2.example: A 2m² single pane with a 20°C indoor-outdoor gap and U ≈ 5.8 loses 232W. Bubble wrap lowering U to about 3.5 gives 140W, saving roughly 90W.
20261119-life-all-2.actionItem: Today spray water on a window and press bubble wrap, flat side to the glass.

20261126-math-g01-1.title: Linjani ubume bento esebhokisini?
20261126-math-g01-1.summary: Uzonyaniswe amehlo uva into esebhokisini, yaye uva imibono kanye kanye. Into esebhokisini yenye yobume bebhokisi, ubume besilinda, okanye ubume besibhakabhaka.
20261126-math-g01-1.principle: Ngalo lonke ixesha ufumana umbono omnye owongezelelekileyo, cutha iimilo ezinokwenzeka uze ulungise umbono wakho wokuqala ukuze uhambelane nombono omtsha.
20261126-math-g01-1.example: Bhala imo yebhokisi, imo yesilinda, nemo yebhola, kwaye kwisikhomba ngasinye phawula iimo ezinokwenzeka.
20261126-math-g01-1.actionItem: Ngalo lonke ixesha ufumana umbono omnye owongezelelekileyo, cutha iimilo ezinokwenzeka uze ulungise umbono wakho wokuqala ukuze uhambelane nombono omtsha.

20261126-math-g02-1.title: Ingaba inani elilandela u-1, 2, 4 linye kuphela?
20261126-math-g02-1.summary: Umhlobo ekubeni sisigaba sethu udlala umdlalo wolandelelwano lwamanani apho babonisa amanani elinye ngexesha. Umhlobo ugqibe ngepatheni enye aze akuxelele inani elinye ngexesha.
20261126-math-g02-1.principle: Funda ukuba amanani okuqala ambalwa kuphela awamiseli ipatheni ibe yinye, nokuba kufuneka ulungise ipatheni xa inani elitsha licaciswa, uze wenze ulandelelwano lwamanani ohambelana nepatheni ngokwakho.
20261126-math-g02-1.actionItem: Funda ukuba amanani okuqala ambalwa kuphela awamiseli ipatheni ibe yinye, nokuba kufuneka ulungise ipatheni xa inani elitsha licaciswa, uze wenze ulandelelwano lwamanani ohambelana nepatheni ngokwakho.

20261126-math-g03-1.title: Iindlela Ezahlukeneyo Zokwabelana Nge-72 Zeekhandi Phakathi Kweepleyiti
20261126-math-g03-1.summary: Ufuna ukubeka ii-72 zeekhandi kwiipleyiti, wabelane ngokulinganayo kungashiyeki nanye. Inani leekhandi kwipleyiti nganye litshintsha ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni zingaphi iipleyiti osebenzisa.
20261126-math-g03-1.principle: Unokwabelana ngokulinganayo kungashiyeki nanye kuphela xa inani leepleyiti liphindaphindwe linani leekhandi kwipleyiti enye li-72. 4×18, 6×12, kunye no-9×8 zi-72, kwaye akukho nani eliphindaphindwe ngo-5 okanye ngo-7 elenza i-72.
20261126-math-g03-1.example: Kwinani ngalinye leepleyiti, wahlula i-72 ngelo nani uze uhlole ukuba ikho intsalela na.
20261126-math-g03-1.actionItem: Fumana iindlela ezininzi zokwabelana ezihlangabezana neemeko (uluhlu lwenani leepleyiti nenani leekhandi kwipleyiti nganye) ngaxeshanye, uze uchaze indlela inani leepleyiti nenani leekhandi kwipleyiti enye eziqhagamshela ngayo.

20261126-math-g04-1.title: Ukuhlola Inkcazo ka-Seohyeon
20261126-math-g04-1.summary: U-Seohyeon wachaza oku kumhlobo. Kukho impazamo kule nkcazo.
20261126-math-g04-1.principle: Umgca 3 yindawo apho kuqala ukuphosa. Isikwere sinamacala amane alinganayo, kodwa oko akuthethi okuchasene, "ukuba amacala amane alinganayo, sisikwere." Umgca 4 uqhubeka nempazamo efanayo, kodwa indawo yokuqala engalunganga ngumgca 3.
20261126-math-g04-1.example: Funda umgca ngamnye ubhalwe kwakhona ngefom "ukuba ..., ngoko ...," ubhale kumgca ngamnye ukuba uya kwicala elifanayo nesibakala somgca wangaphambili.
20261126-math-g04-1.actionItem: Fumana impazamo yengqiqo kwinkcazo ethi 'Ukuba onke amacala amane ayafana, sisikwere,' uze uchaze iquadrilateral ngumzekelo ochasayo.

20261126-math-g05-1.title: Inani Lamaqela Okwabelana Ngokulinganayo: Ukulungisa Isisombululo
20261126-math-g05-1.summary: Ufuna ukwabelana ngeelekese ezingama-48 neetshokolethi ezingama-36 ngokulinganayo ungashiyi nto phakathi kwamaqela amaninzi. UHayun wafumana inani lamaqela ngolu hlobo.
20261126-math-g05-1.principle: Umgca 2 yindawo yokuqala engachanekanga. Inani lamaqela ahlulwa ngama-48 ngokulinganayo kufuneka libe linani elihlula ama-48 ngokulinganayo, oko kukuthi, isahluli sama-48. Isiphindaphindi sinokuba sikhulu kunama-48, yaye emva koko iilekese aziphelelanga. Umgca 4 uthi into eya kushiya amaqela athile engenalekese nanye kumaqela angama-144. Umgca 1 ukopishe ingxaki kakuhle, yaye u-144 emgceni 3 uchanekile njengesiphindaphindi esiqhelekileyo esincinane kakhulu sama-48 nama-36.
20261126-math-g05-1.example: Funda umgca ngamnye ucinge ukuba oko kuthethwa kunokwenzeka ngokwenene kwimeko eneelekese ezingama-48 neetshokolethi ezingama-36.
20261126-math-g05-1.actionItem: Fumana uze ulungise indawo kwisisombululo apho kwakhethwa ubudlelwane obungachanekanga phakathi kwamanani (isahluli/isiphindaphindi), uze ucinge ngazo zonke iimeko ezihambelana neemeko.

20261126-math-g06-1.title: Ukugcina incasa yobisi lwesitrobheri ifana xa wenza ngakumbi
20261126-math-g06-1.summary: USuyeon wenze isiraphu yobisi lwesitrobheri ngeekopi ezi-3 zesitrobheri neekopi ezi-2 zobisi, yaye incasa yayilungile kanye. Ufuna ukwenza ngakumbi ngencasa efanayo, yaye uSuyeon ucinga, “Ukuba ndongeza iikopi ezi-3 ezongezelelweyo zesitrobheri, ndongeza iikopi ezi-3 ezongezelelweyo zobisi.”
20261126-math-g06-1.principle: Jonga ngedatha ukuba ukongeza amanani aphelele ngokufanayo kutshintsha incasa, uze ulungise ingqiqo yakho ngomlinganiselo ogcina umlinganiselo ufana.
20261126-math-g06-1.example: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, bhala umlinganiselo wesitrobheri kubisi ngendlela efanayo uze uthelekise.
20261126-math-g06-1.actionItem: Jonga ngedatha ukuba ukongeza amanani aphelele ngokufanayo kutshintsha incasa, uze ulungise ingqiqo yakho ngomlinganiselo ogcina umlinganiselo ufana.

20261126-math-g07-1.title: Ingaba Amaxesha Amakhulu Athetha Ukuba Benze Ngcono?
20261126-math-g07-1.summary:
Iklasi 1 (abafundi abangama-20) neKlasi 2 (abafundi abangama-50) bathabathe uvavanyo olufanayo lwemathematika. Itheyibhile yokwabiwa kwamaxesha enamanqaku abekwe kwizithuba ezintathu imi ngolu hlobo.
Isithuba / Iklasi 1 (abafundi abangama-20) / Iklasi 2 (abafundi abangama-50)
Ngaphantsi kwamanqaku angama-60 / abafundi aba-2 / abafundi abali-10
Amanqaku angama-60 okanye ngaphezulu kodwa ngaphantsi kwama-80 / abafundi abali-10 / abafundi abangama-25
Amanqaku angama-80 okanye ngaphezulu / abafundi aba-8 / abafundi abali-15
UMinji uthe, "Kukho abafundi abaninzi abanamanqaku angama-80 okanye ngaphezulu kwiKlasi 2, abali-15, ngoko iKlasi 2 yenze ngcono kuvavanyo."
20261126-math-g07-1.principle: Ngokwezabelo, kumanqaku angama-80 okanye ngaphezulu, iKlasi 1 inama-8/20=40% kwaye iKlasi 2 inama-15/50=30%, ngoko iKlasi 1 iphezulu; kumanqaku angaphantsi kwama-60, iKlasi 1 inama-2/20=10% kwaye iKlasi 2 inama-10/50=20%, ngoko iKlasi 2 iphindwe ngo-2 kunoKlasi 1. Umndilili awunakwaziwa kwitheyibhile enezithuba ezibekiweyo, kwaye isigqibo esithelekisa kuphela inani labafundi sinenkxaso ebuthathaka.
20261126-math-g07-1.example: Kwiklasi nganye, yahlula inani labafundi kuloo sithuba ngenani elipheleleyo labafundi kuloo klasi.
20261126-math-g07-1.actionItem: Funda ingxaki yokuthelekisa amaxesha njengoko enjalo xa iiklasi ezimbini zinamanani ahlukeneyo abafundi, uze wahlule oko itheyibhile ikuvumela ukuba ukuthi ngokuqinisekileyo kunoko ungakuthi.

20261126-math-g08-1.title: Zeziphi iinqaku esizifunayo ukufumana amaxabiso?
20261126-math-g08-1.summary: Sifuna ukufumana ixabiso lepensile enye, x won, nelencwadi yokubhala enye, y won, kwivenkile yezixhobo zokubhala. Umnini wasibonisa amanqaku ama-5 enyaniso. Inqaku A: Iipensile ezi-2 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-3 zibiza i-3,100 won. Inqaku B: Iipensile ezi-4 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-6 zibiza i-6,200 won. Inqaku C: Incwadi yokubhala ibiza i-200 won ngaphezu kwepensile. Inqaku D: Iipensile ezi-6 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-9 zibiza i-9,300 won. Inqaku E: Iipensile ezi-5 neencwadi zokubhala ezi-5 zibiza i-6,000 won.
20261126-math-g08-1.principle: Amaqhinga A, B no-D anomlinganiselo ofanayo weepensile kwiincwadi zokubhala, 2:3, kwaye izixa zawo ziziphindaphindi ezifanayo (ihlandlo eli-1, amahlandlo ama-2, amahlandlo ama-3), ngoko aphinda ulwazi olufanayo. Ngala maqhinga kuphela, awunakuyimisela into enye esisisombululo. Ukuba udibanisa amaqhinga anemilinganiselo eyahlukileyo yamanani (C, E), ulingano olubini lunika ulwazi olwahlukileyo, ngoko amaxabiso ayamiselwa. (Ipensile 500 won, incwadi yokubhala 700 won)
20261126-math-g08-1.example: Phinda ubhale amaqhinga ngohlobo 'iipensile □ + iincwadi zokubhala □ = □원' uze uthelekise amaqhinga amabini ecaleni kwelinye.
20261126-math-g08-1.actionItem: Xa usenza ukulingana ngaxeshanye, gwebela ukuba ukulingana kunika ulwazi olwahlukileyo na, uze wenze wena ukulingana okunganiki lwazi lutsha.

20261126-math-g09-1.title: Ukuba sin A=3/5, ingaba iyafana nokuba unxantathu uba mkhulu?
20261126-math-g09-1.summary: Kunxantathu oneengile ethe nkqo ABC, ∠C=90°, icala BC licala elichasene ne-∠A, icala AC licala elikufuphi ne-∠A (hayi ihayipothenyusi), kwaye icala AB yihayipothenyusi. sin A ifundwa 'sayini A' kwaye cos A ifundwa 'khosayini A.' Kula nxantathu, sin A=3/5 (3 phezu kwe-5).
20261126-math-g09-1.principle: Ukuba wandisa onke amacala amathathu ngesiphindaphindi esifanayo, njenge-(AB, BC, AC)=(5, 3, 4), (10, 6, 8), (15, 9, 12), sin A=3/5 ihlala injalo.
20261126-math-g09-1.example: Njengomzekelo olula kakhulu, xa BC=3 kunye ne-AB=5, fumana ubude becala eliseleyo AC ngetheorem kaPythagoras.
20261126-math-g09-1.actionItem: Yenza onxantathu abaneengile ethe nkqo abaninzi abanexabiso elifanayo le-sin A, uvavanye izibakala zabafundi ababini usebenzisa iziphumo, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni umlinganiselo wetrigonometri umiselwa bubungakanani beengile.

20261126-math-g10-1.title: Ngaba umgca uya kuchukumisa isangqa? Xa ulwazi luvezwa isiqwenga esinye ngexesha
20261126-math-g10-1.summary: Kukho isangqa x²+y²=25 (isazulu kwimvelaphi, irediyasi 5) nomgca y=x+k. Tshintsha ixabiso lika-k ujonge inani lamachaphaza apho umgca nesangqa zidibana khona.
20261126-math-g10-1.principle: Xela indawo yomgca nesangqa ngokuxhomekeke kwixabiso lengxelo engatshintshiyo k, uhlaziye isigwebo sakho ngolwazi olutsha, uze unciphise uluhlu luka-k apho bechukumisana khona.
20261126-math-g10-1.example: Unokuhlola inani lamachaphaza okudibana ngezisombululo zekhweshini oyifumanayo ngokusombulula iikhweshini zomgca nesangqa kunye.
20261126-math-g10-1.actionItem: Xela indawo yomgca nesangqa ngokuxhomekeke kwixabiso lengxelo engatshintshiyo k, uhlaziye isigwebo sakho ngolwazi olutsha, uze unciphise uluhlu luka-k apho bechukumisana khona.

20261126-math-g11-1.title: Fumana umgca onengxaki kwisisombululo selingano lelogarithm
20261126-math-g11-1.summary: UMinho wasombulula ulingano log₂(x−1) + log₂(x−3) = 3 waphendula, ‘Izisombululo zi-x=5 no-x=−1, ezimbini.’ Ukuyifunda ngokuvakalayo, ithi ‘log isiseko 2 se-(x ngokususa 1) ukongeza log isiseko 2 se-(x ngokususa 3) kulingana no-3’.
20261126-math-g11-1.principle: Indawo yokuqala apho kuphambuka khona ngumgca wesi-2. Xa isixa seelogarithm ezimbini sidityaniswa sibe lilogarithm enye, iimeko zexabiso elingaphakathi x−1>0 no-x−3>0 ziyanyamalala kugama, yaye ezo meko azibhalwanga ngokwahlukeneyo. Ngoko kumgca wesi-5 zombini iingcambu zamkelwa, yaye umgca wesi-6 sisigqibo eso. Ixabiso elingaphakathi kufuneka lipositivu, ngoko x>3 iyafuneka. Ukuba x=−1, ngoko x−1=−2 no-x−3=−4, amaxabiso angaphakathi anegethivu, ngoko ulingano alucacisiwe. Ukuba x=5, log₂4 + log₂2 = 2+1 = 3, ngoko liyabamba. Ngoko isisombululo lixabiso elinye x=5.
20261126-math-g11-1.example: Ngalo lonke ixesha ugama liguquka, funda ukhangela ukuba lithetha okufanayo nomgca wangaphambili.
20261126-math-g11-1.actionItem: Fumana uze ulungise ingxaki ebangelwa kukungakhangeli imeko yexabiso elingaphakathi kwilogarithm kwisisombululo selingano lelogarithm.

20261126-math-g12-1.title: Ithi ipositivu, kodwa umntu uyagula ngokwenene na?
20261126-math-g12-1.summary: Uvavanyo lwesifo esithile lwabonakala ‘lupositivu’. Ufuna ukwazi ithuba lokuba umntu onesiphumo esipositivu uneso sifo ngokwenene. Gqiba ukuba luluphi ulwazi olufunekayo ukumisela eli thuba.
20261126-math-g12-1.principle: Abo bavavanywe bepositivu benziwe ‘ngabagulayo abavavanywe bepositivu’ ‘nabaphilileyo abavavanywe bepositivu’. Ngoko kufuneka umlinganiselo wabagulayo, ithuba lokuba ogulayo avavanywe epositivu, nethuba lokuba ophilileyo avavanywe epositivu.
20261126-math-g12-1.example: Khumbula ukuba ngawaphi amaqela amabini abantu abavavanyiweyo abanesiphumo esipositivu banokwahlulwa.
20261126-math-g12-1.actionItem: Khetha ulwazi olufunekayo ukufumana ithuba elinemeko, uze uchaze ngamanani ukuba kutheni ukuchaneka kovavanyo kwahlukile kwi-‘ithuba lokugula xa isiphumo sipositivu’.

20261126-physics-g01-1.title: Izinto Ezitsalwa Ziimagnethi kunye Namandla Emagnethi
20261126-physics-g01-1.summary: Phakathi koku, yintoni eyenzekayo xa ipali ye-N neye-S yemagnethi zisondelelene ngobuso?
20261126-physics-g01-1.principle: Imagnethi ineempawu zokutsala xa iipali ezingafaniyo (i-N ne-S) zidibana, kwaye iipali ezifanayo zineempawu zokuphosa.

20261126-physics-g02-1.title: Ukungcangcazela Nokugqithiswa Xa Kwenziwa Isandi
20261126-physics-g02-1.summary: Emva kokubetha ifolokhi yesandi ngesando serabha ize ibekwe ngobunono kumphezulu wamanzi kwitanki, kwenzeka ntoni?
20261126-physics-g02-1.principle: Ifolokhi yesandi eyenza isandi iyanyikima, ngoko xa ichukumisa amanzi iwaqhumisa ngeenxa zonke yenze amaza.

20261126-physics-g03-1.title: Ukuhamba Ngqo Kokukhanya kunye Noguquko Lwezithunzi
20261126-physics-g03-1.summary: Xa kubekwe amaphepha amathathu anemingxuma ecaleni komnye phambi kwetorshi, ungawubeka njani imingxuma ukuze ubone ukukhanya kwelinye icala?
20261126-physics-g03-1.principle: Ukukhanya kuhamba ngomgca othe ngqo (ukuhamba ngokuthe ngqo kokukhanya), ngoko ukukhanya kukwazi ukuwela yonke imingxuma emithathu kuphela xa imingxuma ikumgca omnye.

20261126-physics-g04-1.title: Isikali Sokulinganisa kunye Nomgaqo Wokulingana
20261126-physics-g04-1.summary: Kwisikali esinengalo ezimbini, kulengiswe ubunzima obuyi-20 g kwindawo ekude ngezahlulo ezi-4 ukusuka kwiphoyinti yokuxhasa ngasekhohlo. Ubunzima bokulengiswa kwindawo ekude ngezahlulo ezi-2 ukusuka kwiphoyinti yokuxhasa ngasekunene ukuze kulingane yintoni?
20261126-physics-g04-1.principle: Ngokomgaqo wokulinganisa, umzuzwana wasekhohlo ($4\text{ isahlulo} \times 20\text{ g} = 80$) nomzuzwana wasekunene ($2\text{ isahlulo} \times ? = 80$) kufuneka belingane, ngoko kufuneka kulengiswe ubunzima $40\text{ g}$.

20261126-physics-g05-1.title: Ukuchaza Nokuthelekisa Isantya
20261126-physics-g05-1.summary: Yeyiphi inkcazo yesayensi echanekileyo yokuqhathanisa isantya (ukukhawuleza) kwento?
20261126-physics-g05-1.principle: Xa kuhanjwa umgama ofanayo, xa ixesha lifutshane, kwenziwa ngokukhawuleza, kwaye xa kuhanjwa ngexesha elifanayo, xa umgama mde, isantya siphezulu.

20261126-physics-g06-1.title: Ukudityaniswa Kweesekethe Zombane kunye Nemifanekiso Eyilwe Zii-convex Lenses
20261126-physics-g06-1.summary: Umntu ufuna ukukhanyisa isibane ngebhetri e-1, izibane ezi-2 kunye nesiphakamisi ngocingo. Yeyiphi imeko echanekileyo 'yesekethe evaliweyo' ekhanyisa isibane?
20261126-physics-g06-1.principle: Ukuze umbane uhambe, kufuneka kwenziwe isekethe evaliweyo edityaniswe ngaphandle kokuqhawuka ukusuka kwipali enye yebhetri ngeempawu zombane ukuya kwipali ephikisayo.

20261126-physics-g07-1.title: Ukulingana Komxhuzulane, Ukungqubana, kunye Nokudada
20261126-physics-g07-1.summary: Umhambi wasemajukujukwini onobunzima obuyi-60 kg eMhlabeni ufike kumphezulu weNyanga. Yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo ye-'misa' ne-'bunzima' kumphezulu weNyanga? (Umxhuzulane weNyanga yi-1/6 yowoMhlaba)
20261126-physics-g07-1.principle: Imisa yinani lento eyenza into, ngoko ihlala ingatshintshi (60 kg) nokuba kwesiphi isizinda, kodwa ubunzima ngamandla omxhuzulane, ngoko kwiNyanga buyehla bube yi-1/6 yowoMhlaba, ekukho malunga ne-98 N.

20261126-physics-g08-1.title: Umthetho ka-Ohm kunye Nomthamo Wobushushu
20261126-physics-g08-1.summary: Xa ivolthi eyi-30 V isetyenziswa kucingo lwe-nichrome olunokumelana okuyi-10 Ω, amandla ombane ahamba kucingo lwe-nichrome angakanani?

20261126-physics-g09-1.title: Umsebenzi kunye Nokuguqulelana Kwamandla Omatshini
20261126-physics-g09-1.summary: Kwi-physics, yeyiphi imeko ehambelana nexesha apho inani 'lomsebenzi wesayensi' lingu-0?
20261126-physics-g09-1.principle: Xa uphethe ibhokisi uhamba ngokuthe tye, amandla asebenzayo (amandla aphezulu ixhasa umxhuzulane) kunye necala lokuhamba (ngokuthe tye) yenza i-engile ye-$90^\circ$, ngoko akukho nxalenye yamandla ekwicala lokuhamba kwaye umsebenzi owenziweyo ngu-$0$.

20261126-physics-g10-1.title: Ukungqubana Nokhuseleko, Ukuphoswa Ngokuthe Tye kunye Nomxhuzulane
20261126-physics-g10-1.summary: Kufutshane nomhlaba, phakathi kwamabhola amabini entsimbi A kunye no-B kubude obufanayo, u-A ukhululwa awe ngokukhululekileyo kwaye u-B ukhutshwa ngamandla ngokuthe tye. Sesiphi isivakalisi esiyinyani malunga nentshukumo yala mabhola mabini? (Ungakuhoyi ukumelana komoya)
20261126-physics-g10-1.principle: Intshukumo ethe tye engatshintshiyo kunye nentshukumo yokuwa ngokukhululekileyo ethe nkqo zizimeleyo. Onke amabhola mabini awa ngokuthe nkqo ngokukhawuleza komxhuzulane okufanayo $g$, ngoko afika emhlabeni ngexesha elinye.

20261126-physics-g11-1.title: Imithetho kaNewton Yentshukumo kunye Nobudlelwane Obukhethekileyo
20261126-physics-g11-1.summary: Yeyiphi eyona ngxelo echanekileyo yomahluko wokwenyani wezimo phakathi 'kobudlelwane bentshukumo nokuphendula' kunye 'nobudlelwane bokulingana kwamandla amabini'?
20261126-physics-g11-1.principle: Intshukumo nokuphendula zisebenza ngokwahlukeneyo kwizinto ezimbini ezahlukeneyo ezisebenzisana, ngoko amandla amabini akanakudityaniswa, kodwa ekulinganeni kwamandla indawo yokusebenza ikwinto enye, ngoko adityaniswa abe nesiphumo esinguziro.

20261126-physics-g12-1.title: Iziphumo Ze-Photoelectric, Ubume Obubini Bokukhanya, kunye Nehlabathi Elincinci Kakhulu
20261126-physics-g12-1.summary: Phakathi kweziphumo zovavanyo lwe-photoelectric effect luka-Einstein, yeyiphi inyani ekungenakucaciswa ngokwe 'theory yamaza' yokukhanya kwaye icacisiwe ngokugqibeleleyo kuphela yi 'theory ye-quantum yokukhanya (theory yamasuntswana)'?
20261126-physics-g12-1.principle: I-theory yamaza ibikezela ukuba amandla agcinwa ngexesha, kodwa kwi-photoelectric effect i-photon enye kuphela enengqokelela engaphezulu kwengqokelela ebalulekileyo ibethana ngokukhawuleza ne-elektroni kwaye idlulisele amandla, ngoko i-elektroni ikhutshwa ngokukhawuleza ngaphandle kokulibaziseka ngexesha.
20261126-physics-g12-1.example: Ngokwe-theory yamaza, nokukhanya okuthambileyo, ukuba kubengezelwa ixesha elide kwaye amandla agcinwe, kufuneka kukhutshwe, kodwa ngokwenene kukhutshwa ngokukhawuleza.

20261126-chemistry-g01-1.title: Iimpawu ezahlukeneyo zezinto nempahla
20261126-chemistry-g01-1.summary: Yeyiphi kwezi ndlela zilandelayo edibanisa ngokuchanekileyo “into” enomila othile nomsebenzi othile ne-“ntsebenzo” eyenziwe ngayo?
20261126-chemistry-g01-1.principle: Into enomila nomsebenzi ibizwa ngokuthi “into”, ize imathiriyeli esisiseko eyenze into ibizwe ngokuthi “impahla”.
20261126-chemistry-g01-1.example: “Into” ligama lento egqityiweyo esiyisebenzisayo, ize “impahla” libe ligama lezinto ezakha into.
20261126-chemistry-g01-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-chemistry-g02-1.title: Izinto ezinyibilika emanzini kunye nemixube
20261126-chemistry-g02-1.summary: Xa kongezwa ipuni yeswekile kwi-beaker equlethe amanzi ashushu yaza yashukunyiswa ngomthi wegalasi, yeyiphi inkcazo echanekileyo?
20261126-chemistry-g02-1.principle: Xa iswekile inyibilika emanzini, iimolekyuli zeswekile zisasazeka ngokulinganayo phakathi kweemolekyuli zamanzi zize zibe ngamanzi eswekile acacileyo angabonwayo.
20261126-chemistry-g02-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-chemistry-g03-1.title: Iimeko ezintathu: isolidi, ulwelo negesi
20261126-chemistry-g03-1.summary: Yeyiphi imeko yempahla apho imo itshintsha ngokukhululekileyo ngokwesikhongozeli, kodwa umthamo awutshintshi uhlala unjalo?
20261126-chemistry-g03-1.principle: Ulwelo lunamabophelelo phakathi kweemolekyuli athambileyo kuneesolidi ngoko imo itshintsha lula ngokwesikhongozeli, kodwa umthamo uhlala uqhelekile kuba ukutsalwa phakathi kweemolekyuli kuyagcinwa.
20261126-chemistry-g03-1.example: Cinga xa kugalelwa amanzi okanye ubisi kwenye indebe.
20261126-chemistry-g03-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-chemistry-g04-1.title: Ukuvuka, ukubila, ukuguquka kube lulwelo nokutshintsha komthamo womkhenkce
20261126-chemistry-g04-1.summary: Ikani yesiselo esibandayo esisandula ukukhutshwa kwisikhenkcezisi yabekwa etafileni ixesha elifutshane yaza kwavela amathontsi amanzi emphezulwini wekani. La mathontsi amanzi avela phi?
20261126-chemistry-g04-1.principle: Umphunga wamanzi wegesi owawusemoyeni udibana nomphezulu obandayo wekani uphulukane nobushushu uguquke ube ngamathontsi amanzi olwelo, nto ebizwa ngokuba “yi-condensation (ukuguquka kube lulwelo)”.

20261126-chemistry-g05-1.title: I-solute, i-solvent, isisombululo nokuxinana
20261126-chemistry-g05-1.summary: Iswekile eyi-50 g yafakwa kumanzi a-200 g yaza yanyibilika ngokupheleleyo. Kula manzi eswekile, yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ye-“solvent”, “solute” ne-“solution”?
20261126-chemistry-g05-1.principle: Amanzi, impahla enyibilikisayo, “yisolvent”, iswekile enyibilikayo “yisolute”, ize umxube ocacileyo ophuma ekuxutyweni kwazo ngokulinganayo ubizwe ngokuthi “isolution”.
20261126-chemistry-g05-1.example: Ulwelo olunyibilikisayo = solvent, into enyibilikayo = solute, umxube ogqityiweyo = solution.

20261126-chemistry-g06-1.title: Ukuba nge-asidi, ukuba nge-alkali nezinto ezintathu zokutsha
20261126-chemistry-g06-1.summary: Xa kwaphoswa izisombululo ezahlukeneyo kwi-indicator yekhaphetshu ebomvu, isisombululo A saguquka sabomvu, ize isisombululo B saguquka sabaluhlaza sidlula sibe luhlaza kwaza kwaba mthubi. Yeyiphi impawu echanekileyo yezi zisombululo zombini?
20261126-chemistry-g06-1.principle: I-indicator yekhaphetshu ebomvu iguquka ibe bomvu kwizisombululo ezine-asidi, ize kwizisombululo ze-alkali iguquke ibe luhlaza, luhlaza okotyheli, okanye mthubi.
20261126-chemistry-g06-1.example: Ijusi yekhaphetshu ebomvu, i-indicator yendalo, iqulethe umbala we-anthocyanin.

20261126-chemistry-g07-1.title: Umthetho kaBoyle, umthetho kaCharles notshintsho lweemeko
20261126-chemistry-g07-1.summary: Yintoni isizathu esiphambili “soxinzelelo lwegesi” esivakala emgangathweni wesikhongozeli esivaliweyo esiqulethe igesi?
20261126-chemistry-g07-1.principle: Uxinzelelo lwegesi luvela emandleni kwiyunithi yendawo awenziwa ngamasuntswana egesi aqhaqhazela ngokungaphezi nangokungalungelelananga eludongeni lwangaphakathi lwesikhongozeli.
20261126-chemistry-g07-1.example: Iimolekyuli zegesi ziqhuba ngesantya esikhulu kakhulu.
20261126-chemistry-g07-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-chemistry-g08-1.title: Izinto, ii-athomu, ii-ion nempendulo yokwenza i-precipitate
20261126-chemistry-g08-1.summary: Yintoni isizathu esiphambili sokuba i-athomu eyakhiwe ngenyukliyasi ne-electrons ibe nesimo sokungathathi cala ngokombane?
20261126-chemistry-g08-1.principle: I-athomu ayithathi cala ngokombane kuba intlawulo epheleleyo (+) yee-protons zenyukliyasi esembindini nentlawulo epheleleyo (-) yee-electrons ezijikeleza ngeorbits zilingana ngokupheleleyo ngobukhulu.
20261126-chemistry-g08-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-chemistry-g09-1.title: Ukulondolozwa kobunzima, umlinganiselo ongatshintshiyo, i-exothermic ne-endothermic
20261126-chemistry-g09-1.summary: Yintoni isizathu esisisiseko sokuba 'umthetho wokugcinwa kobunzima' ube yinyani xa kwenzeka utshintsho lwekhemikhali?
20261126-chemistry-g09-1.principle: Kwintsabela yekhemikhali, indlela iiathom ezidityaniswa ngayo iyatshintsha kwaye kwenziwa izinto ezintsha, kodwa iintlobo kunye nenani leeathom azenziwa okanye zitshatyalaliswe kwaye zigcinwa njengoko zazinjalo, ngoko ubunzima bonke abutshintshi.
20261126-chemistry-g09-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-chemistry-g10-1.title: Ibhondi ye-ion, ibhondi ye-covalent kunye ne-oxidation-reduction
20261126-chemistry-g10-1.summary: Sesiphi isiphumo esichane kakhulu sovavanyo oluthelekisa ukuqhuba umbane kwenqaku A (sodium chloride) kunye nenqaku B (iswekile)?
20261126-chemistry-g10-1.principle: I-sodium chloride, into edityaniswe nge-ionic bond, inyibilika emanzini kwaye ihlukane ibe ngama-cation nama-anion, ngoko isisombululo sayo samanzi siqhuba umbane. Iswekile, into edityaniswe nge-covalent bond, inyibilika njengeemolekyuli kwaye ayinazo izithwali zentlawulo, ngoko ayiqhubi umbane.
20261126-chemistry-g10-1.example: Into edityaniswe nge-ionic bond (NaCl) iyaphuma ibe ngama-ion ahamba ngokukhululekileyo xa inyibilika emanzini.
20261126-chemistry-g10-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-chemistry-g11-1.title: I-mole
20261126-chemistry-g11-1.summary: Kwi-0℃ nge-1 atm, zingaphi iimoli zeemolekyuli ze-methane, nezingaphi iimoli zizonke zeeathom ze-hydrogen (H), kwi-11.2 L yegesi ye-methane (CH₄, ubunzima beemolekyuli 16)?
20261126-chemistry-g11-1.principle: Inani leemoli ze-methane li-$n = \frac{11.2\text{ L}}{22.4\text{ L/mol}} = 0.5\text{ mol}$. Imolekyuli nganye ye-$1$ ye-methane iqulethe iiathom ze-hydrogen ezi-$4$, ngoko iimoli zizonke zeeathom ze-hydrogen zi-$0.5 \times 4 = 2.0\text{ mol}$.
20261126-chemistry-g11-1.example: Kwi-0℃ nge-1 atm, i-1 mol yegesi = 22.4 L.
20261126-chemistry-g11-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-chemistry-g12-1.title: Isantya sempendulo, umgaqo kaLe Chatelier neseli yekhemikhali
20261126-chemistry-g12-1.summary: Sesiphi isitatimenti esichanekileyo malunga notshintsho olwenzekayo xa 'i-positive catalyst' yongezwa kwintsabela yekhemikhali?
20261126-chemistry-g12-1.principle: I-positive catalyst inika indlela entsha yokusabela enamandla okwenza asezantsi kwaye ikhulisa ii-rate constants zeentsabela ezibheke phambili neziyivayo ngomlinganiselo ofanayo. Ayitshintshi ngaphandle kwe-reaction enthalpy ($\Delta H$) okanye i-equilibrium constant ($K$).
20261126-chemistry-g12-1.example: I-catalyst ayinako ukutshintsha umahluko wamandla (ΔH) phakathi kwezinto zokuqala nemveliso yokugqibela.
20261126-chemistry-g12-1.actionItem: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.

20261126-english-g01-1.title: Fumana izenzo ezingahambelani nesaziso sechibi
20261126-english-g01-1.summary:
Isaziso emnyango wechibi (sibhalwe ngamagama kuphela, akukho mfanekiso):

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = an adult)

Abantu abane baya echibini.
UMina uneminyaka eyi-7. Uza noMama wakhe, kwaye unekepusi.
UJun uneminyaka eyi-10. Uza yedwa, kwaye akanayo ikepusi.
UTom uneminyaka eyi-6. Uza nomntakwabo. Umntakwabo uneminyaka eyi-9. UTom unekepusi.
USue uneminyaka eyi-11. Ukhwela ngeenyawo esiya echibini yedwa, kwaye unekepusi.
20261126-english-g01-1.principle: UJun akanayo ikepusi, ngoko uphula umthetho 2. UTom uphantsi kwe-8, kodwa umntakwabo oze naye uneminyaka eyi-9, ngoko akangomntu 'omdala', kwaye uTom uphula umthetho 3. UMina weza noMama wakhe, kwaye uSue uneminyaka eyi-11, ngoko kulungile ukuba ahambe aze yedwa.
20261126-english-g01-1.example: Yenza itheyibhile enobudala bomntu ngamnye, ngubani amphelekileyo, nekepusi, omnye ngomnye.
20261126-english-g01-1.actionItem: Hambelanisa imithetho emithathu esesazisweni nemeko yomntu ngamnye, ukhethe iimeko ezophula imithetho, uze uthi isizathu ngesiNgesi.

20261126-english-g02-1.title: 'Two tickets, please.' ikuphi? Ukugweba ukuba ulwazi luyaneliseka na
20261126-english-g02-1.summary:
Uphulaphule into ethethwe yindoda nomthengisi weethikithi. Abazange bathi ikuphi.

Man: Two tickets, please.
Clerk: Here you are. The show starts at 7:00.
20261126-english-g02-1.principle: I-Ticket ne-show ngamagama asetyenziswa kwiindawo ezininzi, ezifana nesinema okanye iholo yekonsathi. Kunzima ukugqiba enye ngemigca emibini kuphela.
20261126-english-g02-1.example: Cinga ngeendawo ezimbini okanye ezintathu apho le migca mibini ingathethwa khona.
20261126-english-g02-1.actionItem: Gweba ukuba ungayigqiba indawo ngemigca emibini eviwe kuphela, uze ukhethe isalathiso esongezelelweyo esahlula iindawo.

20261126-english-g03-1.title: Fumana ixesha lokufunda kwishedyuli kaMina yoMgqibelo
20261126-english-g03-1.summary:
Ishedyuli kaMina yoMgqibelo (ebhalwe ngombhalo kuphela, ngaphandle komfanekiso):

10 a.m.: I can start my free time.
12 p.m. - 1 p.m.: Lunch
1 p.m. - 2 p.m.: Dance class
5 p.m.: Dinner. I must finish before dinner.

UMina ufuna ukufunda incwadi iyure e-1. Uqala kwiyure epheleleyo aze agqibe kwiyure epheleleyo.
20261126-english-g03-1.principle: Ixesha lokuzonwabisa liqala ngo-10 a.m., kwaye 12 ukuya kwi-14 zizele sisidlo sasemini nomdaniso. Akukho ntshukumo kwishedyuli ukusuka kwi-15 ukuya kwi-16 nokusuka kwi-16 ukuya kwi-17, kwaye ziphela phambi kokutya kwangokuhlwa.
20261126-english-g03-1.example: Tshintsha amaxesha eshedyuli abe manani eeyure ezingama-24 uze uzobe istrip sexesha.
20261126-english-g03-1.actionItem: Yiza namaxesha ahlukeneyo okuqala ukufunda ahlangabezana nayo yonke imiqathango yeshedyuli, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni amanye amaxesha engasebenzi.

20261126-english-g04-1.title: Inqaku likaMama nexesha lokudlala likaJisu
20261126-english-g04-1.summary:
Inqaku uMama alishiye etafileni (libhalwe ngamagama kuphela, akukho mfanekiso):

Mina,
Today's plan:
3:30 p.m. Come home.
4:00 p.m. Piano class (30 minutes).
5:00 p.m. Take out the trash.
6:30 p.m. Dinner with Mom and Dad.

Emva koko umhlobo wakhe uJisu wathumela isicatshulwa. "Let's play at the park from 4:15 to 5:15 today!"
20261126-english-g04-1.principle: Iklasi yepiyano yi-4:00-4:30, ngoko 4:15-4:30 iyagqithisana, kwaye ukukhupha inkunkuma ngo-5:00 kuwela ngaphakathi kwe-4:15-5:15. Ukufika ekhaya ngo-3:30 nesidlo sasebusuku ngo-6:30 zingaphandle kwexesha lepaki.
20261126-english-g04-1.example: Beka umgca ngamnye ecaleni kwexesha lepaki '4:15-5:15' enye ngenye, uze ubone ukuba iphela phambi kwayo okanye iqala emva kwayo.
20261126-english-g04-1.actionItem: Thelekisa izicwangciso ezininzi ezikwinqaku likaMama nexesha elicetyiswe ngumhlobo, fumana apho zingahambelani khona, uze uthi hayi ngesiNgesi ngelixa ucebisa ixesha elahlukileyo.

20261126-english-g05-1.title: Ingcinga yakho iyatshintsha njengoko ufunda iposta
20261126-english-g05-1.summary: UJun akalilo ilungu leGreen Library. Umhlobo wakhe uAra lilungu leGreen Library. Aba bobabini baza kufunda iposta ephambi kwenerali umgca omnye ngexesha.
20261126-english-g05-1.principle: Tshintsha isigwebo sakho rhoqo xa ulwazi lweposta luveza inyathelo ngenyathelo, uze wenze umbuzo wesiNgesi okhangela ulwazi olungekho kwiposta.
20261126-english-g05-1.example: Hlola ukuba isivakalisi esitsha ngeli xesha sitshintsha ugwebo lwakho lwangaphambili.
20261126-english-g05-1.actionItem: Tshintsha isigwebo sakho rhoqo xa ulwazi lweposta luveza inyathelo ngenyathelo, uze wenze umbuzo wesiNgesi okhangela ulwazi olungekho kwiposta.

20261126-english-g06-1.title: Ingaba ikilabhu yeencwadi iphumelele? Ukutshintsha isigwebo sakho njengoko ubungqina bukhula
20261126-english-g06-1.summary: Ikilabhu entsha yeencwadi iqalile esikolweni sethu. Utitshala wathi, "The club is a success." Uza kufumana ubungqina inxalenye enye ngexesha uze ucinge ukuba esi sitatimenti sichanekile na.
20261126-english-g06-1.principle: Njengoko idatha yongezwa inxalenye enye ngexesha, tshintsha isigwebo sakho ngebango elithi 'ikilabhu yeencwadi iphumelele', uze ugqibe ngesiNgesi usebenzisa iziqwenga ezimbini zobungqina.
20261126-english-g06-1.example: Hlula oko idatha onayo ngoku iqinisekisa kuko nokungekaziwa.
20261126-english-g06-1.actionItem: Njengoko idatha yongezwa inxalenye enye ngexesha, tshintsha isigwebo sakho ngebango elithi 'ikilabhu yeencwadi iphumelele', uze ugqibe ngesiNgesi usebenzisa iziqwenga ezimbini zobungqina.

20261126-english-g07-1.title: UBen uza kuza kwitheko? Ukuphonononga intsingiselo efihliweyo yeempendulo zakhe
20261126-english-g07-1.summary:
Incoko phakathi kukaJisu noBen (ebhalwe ngombhalo kuphela, ngaphandle kwemifanekiso):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.
20261126-english-g07-1.principle: Umdlalo webhola yeenyawo usekuseni yaye itheko lisentsimbi yesi-4 p.m., ngoko amaxesha awadibani. UBen wathi kuphela usenokukhathala, yaye ekugqibeleni wathi uya kuhlola nomama wakhe kuqala. Ngoko kukho into egqityiweyo (ixesha) nento eseleyo (imvume kamama wakhe), yaye akukagqitywa.
20261126-english-g07-1.example: Wahlule amazwi kaBen abe ngamacandelo amane: 'soccer game,' 'party time,' 'tired,' kunye 'nomama.'
20261126-english-g07-1.actionItem: Wahlule iimpendulo zikaBen kwincoko umgca ngomgca, wahlule oko kugqityiweyo kwaloo kusele, uze wenze ugwebo ngaphandle kokuthi 'uya kuza' okanye 'akayi kuza.'

20261126-english-g08-1.title: Phinda ubhale isibhengezo esithi ukuya kwithala leencwadi rhoqo kunyusa amanqaku
20261126-english-g08-1.summary: Umbhali we-blog ufuna ukubhala oku: 'Library visits make students' scores go up.' Masijonge esi sivakalisi ngokuchasene nedatha.
20261126-english-g08-1.principle: Ngalo lonke ixesha idatha entsha ivezwa, gqiba kwakhona ukuba ungaqiniseka kangakanani ngesibhengezo, uze uphinde ubhale isivakalisi sokugqibela.
20261126-english-g08-1.example: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, jonga ukuba ulwazi olutsha luxhasa isigwebo sangaphambili okanye luyasishukumisa.
20261126-english-g08-1.actionItem: Ngalo lonke ixesha idatha entsha ivezwa, gqiba kwakhona ukuba ungaqiniseka kangakanani ngesibhengezo, uze uphinde ubhale isivakalisi sokugqibela.

20261126-english-g09-1.title: Ukucinga okufihlakeleyo kwi-'we sold 200 fewer lunches'
20261126-english-g09-1.summary:
Oku kubekwe ebhodini yezaziso phambi kwekhefi yesikolo.

"This month, the cafeteria sold 200 fewer lunches than last month. So students did not like the new menu."
20261126-english-g09-1.principle: Ukusuka kwinyani yokuba ukuthengisa kuhle, ukuya ku-'it didn't suit their taste', ezinye iimeko (inani labafundi, inani leentsuku zesikolo, njalo njalo) kufuneka zifane. Ukuba bebembalwa abafundi okanye iintsuku zesikolo, ukuthengisa bekuya kuhla nokuba incasa ifana.
20261126-english-g09-1.example: Qala ubhale ngolwimi lwakho ukuba yintoni enokuba sisizathu se-"fewer lunches were sold."
20261126-english-g09-1.actionItem: Fumana ukucinga okungathethwanga okufunekayo ukuze isibakala sibe sinyani, ubhale ngesiNgesi enye inkcazelo eshukumisa loo nto ikucingayo.

20261126-english-g10-1.title: Sibhala njani izaziso ezimbini eziphikisanayo kwiphephandaba lesikolo?
20261126-english-g10-1.summary:
Ukwiqela lokubhala ephepheni lesiNgesi lesikolo. Izaziso ezimbini ngetheko ziyahluka.

School notice: "Festival: Friday, 4 p.m., in the gym. Free for all students."
Student council poster: "Festival: Friday, 5 p.m., in the gym. Tickets: 1,000 won."

Awukaqinisekisi ukuba leliphi elichanekileyo.
20261126-english-g10-1.principle: Ukuba ayiqinisekisiwe, into elungileyo kukuxela oko umthombo ngamnye kwezi mbini uthi, uze uxelele abafundi ukuba isahlolwa. Ukukhetha icala elinye ukuliqinisekisa, okanye ukuxelela abantu ukuba bangezi ngaphandle kwalo lwazi, kuxuba abafundi.
20261126-english-g10-1.example: Thelekisa ukuba sesiphi ulwazi ngasinye isaziso esinika abafundi nesesiphi esifihlayo.
20261126-english-g10-1.actionItem: Bhalela abafundi (abafundi) into ethetha izaziso ezimbini ezahlukeneyo ngokufanelekileyo, ichaza oko okungaqinisekiswanga nento abafundi abamele bayenze.

20261126-english-g11-1.title: Umyalelo womsebenzi ongacacanga: yintoni ekufuneka uyibuze kuqala?
20261126-english-g11-1.summary:
Le yi-imeyile eyafunyanwa ngu-Jiho ongumqeqeshwa evela kumxhasi weqela u-Ms. Han.

Hi Jiho,
Please send the sales summary to the client before the meeting.
Thanks,
Ms. Han

Iinyaniso ezaziwa ngu-Jiho: Ikhalenda yeqela ibonisa intlanganiso ne-Aurora Co. ngoLwesibini ngentsimbi ye-10:00 nentlanganiso ne-Blue Pine Ltd. ngoLwesine ngentsimbi ye-14:00. Ifolda eyabelanayo inamafayile ahlukeneyo esishwankathelo sentengiso kaJulayi, Agasti kunye noSeptemba.
20261126-english-g11-1.principle: Ukuba umxhasi nexesha azimiselwanga, usenokuthumela ifayile engalunganga kumxhasi ongalunganga. Kwifomathi, ungamisela into engagqibekanga njenge-PDF umazise, kwaye ukuba u-Ms. Han usemsebenzini akunanto yokwenza nomsebenzi ngokwawo.
20261126-english-g11-1.example: Jonga ukuba 'kubani,' 'ntoni,' kunye 'nesiphelo' nganye iyaphuma njengento enye kanye kwi-imeyile.
20261126-english-g11-1.actionItem: Kwi-imeyile yomsebenzi engacacanga, khetha ulwazi olufuneka luqinisekiswe phambi kokuba wenze, uze ubhale i-imeyile yemibuzo elula ukuyiphendula.

20261126-english-g12-1.title: Abafundi abatya isidlo sakusasa banamabanga aphezulu: yintoni enye esiyidingayo ukuyazi?
20261126-english-g12-1.summary:
Libango elisuka kwinqaku lesikolo. "Students who eat breakfast get higher test scores, so the school should provide free breakfast." Njengobungqina, iziphumo zophando lwabafundi abangama-200 zazibonisiwe ngolu hlobo.

Group | Number of students | Average score
Students who eat breakfast | 130 | 82
Students who skip breakfast | 70 | 74
20261126-english-g12-1.principle: b ihlola ezinye izizathu (ubuthongo, ixesha lokufunda), c ihlola isiphumo sophindlo lwangempela, kwaye e ihlola ukulunga kothelekiso. a no-d asingobungqina bokuba izidlo zikhulisa amanqaku.
20261126-english-g12-1.example: Hlola ukuba ulwazi ngalunye lunceda ukuphendula umbuzo, 'Ingaba unxibelelwano phakathi kwesidlo sakusasa namanqaku sisizathu?'
20261126-english-g12-1.actionItem: Gweba ukuba isiphumo sophando sisixelela ngo-"sizathu", khetha ulwazi olongezelelweyo oluyimfuneko kuloo mgwebo, uze ucebise ngesiNgesi indlela yokuthelekisa yokuhlola impembelelo yokutya mahala.

20261126-korean-l1-1.title: Sesiphi isikhombisi esikhokelela kwindawo yokupaka?
20261126-korean-l1-1.summary:
Undwendwe luqhuba lufika esikolweni kwaye lufuna ukushiya imoto iyure e-1. Izikhombisi ezintathu ziyabonakala (akukho mifanekiso, ngoko zichazwa ngamagama).

Isikhombisi A: oonobumba abamhlophe '주차 금지' kwibhodi ebomvu. Isangqa esibomvu esinomgca othe tye siwela umzobo omncinci wemoto. Sibotshelelwe kucingo lwesikolo.
Isikhombisi B: ibhodi eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, oonobumba abamhlophe '방문자 주차장' kunye nomcibisholo olatha ngasekunene. Simi ecaleni kwendlela.
Isikhombisi C: ibhodi eluhlaza, oonobumba abamhlophe '주차장 출구' kunye nomcibisholo olatha ngasemva ngakwindlela. Sixhonywe phezu kwendlela emxinwa apho iimoto zihamba zingaphandle.

Amagama: 주차(장) = indawo yokupaka; 방문자 = undwendwe; 입구 = ukungena; 출구 = ukuphuma.
20261126-korean-l1-1.principle: Isikhombisi B sesabundwendwe, sibiza indawo yokupaka kwaye sinika isalathiso. Isikhombisi A sinegama lokuqala elifanayo kodwa sithwele uphawu lwenqanaba. Isikhombisi C sibiza indawo yokupaka nasi, kodwa 출구 ithetha ukuphuma, ngoko sibonisa apho iimoto zishiya khona.
20261126-korean-l1-1.example: Dwelisa oko isikhombisi ngasinye sikuthethayo ngamagama, nokuba uphawu lwaso okanye umcibisholo wongeza ntoni.
20261126-korean-l1-1.actionItem: Funda izikhombisi ezintathu zendlela ezimfutshane, udibanise amagama notolo nophawu oluchaziweyo, uze ugwebe ukuba sesiphi ngokwenene esikhokelela undwendwe ukuba lipake; khusela ugwebo ngokuchasene nokufunda kwesiqingatha komhlobo.

20261126-korean-l2-1.title: Ngubani ohambayo, ngubani oseleyo?
20261126-korean-l2-1.summary:
지우 ngumfundi kwaye uthetha ngembeko nabadala. Kathathu 지우 uthi sala kakuhle. Jonga ngubani ohamba kwaye ngubani osala apho esebenza khona.

Scene 1: 지우 ugqiba ukuthetha egumbini luka-선생님 aze aphume. 선생님 usala kwidesika.
Scene 2: 지우 no-선생님 bashiya isikolo kunye. Esangweni bahamba ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo.
Scene 3: 지우 utya isidlo sasemini ekhaya luka-할머니. Emva koko 지우 uya ekhaya. 할머니 usala ekhaya.
20261126-korean-l2-1.principle: 안녕히 계세요 ithethwa ngohambayo kosalayo. 지우 uyaphuma kwaye 선생님 usala kwidesika.
20261126-korean-l2-1.example: Buza: ngubani ohambayo, ngubani osala egumbini?
20261126-korean-l2-1.actionItem: Khetha esiphi isibingelelo sokuhlukana esifanelekileyo ngokuxhomekeke kwabo bahambayo nabo baseleyo, qaphela imeko apho bobabini behamba, uze ubhale isibingelelo sokuhlukana ngembeko kunye nombulelo.

20261126-korean-l3-1.title: Ngubani onike imali yepokotho?
20261126-korean-l3-1.summary:
Abafundi ababini, 지우 no-하나, bathetha ngentetho enembeko ye--요. IsiKorea sihlala sishiya isihloko (ngubani owenza isenzo). (댁 = igama lembeko lekhaya lomntu.)

지우: 어제 뭐 했어요?
하나: 할머니 댁에 갔어요. 맛있는 밥을 먹었어요. 용돈도 주셨어요.
지우: 좋았겠어요!
20261126-korean-l3-1.principle: Umbhalo awunasihloko, kodwa imo yesenzi ibonisa ukuba umnikeli ngumntu ekufuneka ahlonitshwe, kwaye ngumntu kuphela onjalo kwibali ngu-할머니, apho 하나 wayekhele khona. 'Mhlawumbi' ichanekile: umbhalo awuyithethi ngqo.
20261126-korean-l3-1.example: Jonga isiphelo se-주셨어요 uze usithelekise ne-먹었어요 kumgca odlulileyo.
20261126-korean-l3-1.actionItem: Qikelela ukuba isihloko esishiyiweyo sibhekisa kubani, khomba ubungqina kumbhalo, uze uthi ukuqikelela kutshintsha njani xa kususwa umkhondo omnye.

20261126-korean-l4-1.title: Bhukisha igumbi
20261126-korean-l4-1.summary:
Iqela lakho lifuna ukusebenzisa igumbi emva kwesikolo. Funda isaziso nomyalezo ovela kumntu weqela 서준.

[방과 후 교실 이용 안내]
- 이용 시간: 오후 1시 ~ 6시
- 한 번에 1시간이나 2시간 쓸 수 있어요.
- 오후 3시 ~ 4시는 청소 시간이라 쓸 수 없어요.

서준: 저는 수업이 2시에 끝나서 2시 전에는 갈 수 없어요. 시작 시간은 정각으로 해 주세요.
20261126-korean-l4-1.principle: 2시 ~ 4시 iquka 3시 ~ 4시, xa igumbi licociwa. Isicwangciso ngasinye kufuneka sikhangelwe ngexesha lasonke, hayi ukuqala kuphela.
20261126-korean-l4-1.example: Bhala iyure yokuqala neyure yokuphela yesicwangciso.
20261126-korean-l4-1.actionItem: Dibanisa imithetho yegumbi isuka kwisaziso nomyalezo womnye uphawu lweqela, ufumane izicwangciso ezahlukeneyo zokubhukisha ezanelisa yonke imeko.

20261126-korean-l5-1.title: Isaziso sohambo lwesikolo esinengxaki yexesha
20261126-korean-l5-1.summary: Iklasi yakho ifumene esi saziso kutitshala ngomyalezo.
20261126-korean-l5-1.principle: Imigca 3 no-4 iyadibana: iklasi ifika epakini nge-11:30, kodwa isidlo sasemini 'emva kokufika' singo-11:00. Imigca 1, 2 no-5 iyahambelana.
20261126-korean-l5-1.example: Beka amaxesha ewotshi emigca ngokulandelelana uze uthelekise.
20261126-korean-l5-1.actionItem: Fumana ingxabano kwisaziso sohambo, ugqibe ukuba yintoni enokufikelelwa, uze ubhale umbuzo onembeko oyisombululayo.

20261126-korean-l6-1.title: Ndifaka isicelo phi?
20261126-korean-l6-1.summary: Yi-4:20 emva kwemini. Ukwi-카운터 le-주민센터 (iziko lenkonzo yoluntu) yommandla. Ufuna ukufaka isicelo sepasipoti. Awuqinisekanga ukuba unayo na ifoto yepasipoti ekhaya lakho esikhwameni.
20261126-korean-l6-1.principle: Hlaziya indlela oyifunda ngayo iimpendulo zomphathi njengoko kuvela inxalenye ngakumbi yencoko, uze ubuze umbuzo olandelayo onengqiqo.
20261126-korean-l6-1.example: Latha ngokusebenzisa kuphela oko ukufundileyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.

20261126-life-all-1.title: Leave the Microwave Center Empty
20261126-life-all-1.summary: Arranging food in a ring on the plate makes a microwave heat more evenly.
20261126-life-all-1.principle: Microwaves at 2.45GHz form standing waves with wavelength λ = c/f ≈ 12.2cm, creating hot and cold spots.
20261126-life-all-1.example: The plate center often gets less energy and stays cold. A ring layout plus one stir midway can cut temperature differences by 20°C or more.
20261126-life-all-1.actionItem: Today arrange food in a ring with the middle empty and stir halfway through.
